book.title: Tanakh
book.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
book.license: Hebrew: Miqra according to the Masorah via Sefaria, CC BY-SA. English: JPS 1917, public domain.
book.notes: Torah, Nevi’im and Ketuvim in the Hebrew order. Hebrew verse numbering is retained; a few books (e.g. Joel) differ from Christian numbering.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֧י יֱהֹוִ֛ה לְאַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל קֵ֑ץ בָּ֣א הַקֵּ֔ץ עַל־[אַרְבַּ֖ע] (ארבעת) כַּנְפ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'th bn'dm khh'mr 'dny yhvh l'dmt yshr'l qts b' hqts 'l['rb'] ('rb't) khnpvt h'rts
verses.translation: ’And thou, son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD concerning the land of Israel: An end! the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּה֙ הַקֵּ֣ץ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֤י אַפִּי֙ בָּ֔ךְ וּשְׁפַטְתִּ֖יךְ כִּדְרָכָ֑יִךְ וְנָתַתִּ֣י עָלַ֔יִךְ אֵ֖ת כׇּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: 'th hqts 'lykh vshlchty 'py bkh vshpttykh khdrkhykh vntty 'lykh 't khltv'bvtykh
verses.translation: Now is the end upon thee, and I will send Mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways; and I will bring upon thee all thine abominations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֛י עָלַ֖יִךְ וְלֹ֣א אֶחְמ֑וֹל כִּ֣י דְרָכַ֜יִךְ עָלַ֣יִךְ אֶתֵּ֗ן וְתוֹעֲבוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּתוֹכֵ֣ךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֔יןָ וִידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl'tchvs 'yny 'lykh vl' 'chmvl khy drkhykh 'lykh 'tn vtv'bvtykh btvkhkh thyyn vyd'tm khy'ny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And Mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity; but I will bring thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I am the LORD. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה רָעָ֛ה אַחַ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִנֵּ֥ה בָאָֽה׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh r'h 'cht r'h hnh b'h
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: An evil, a singular evil, behold, it cometh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֵ֣ץ בָּ֔א בָּ֥א הַקֵּ֖ץ הֵקִ֣יץ אֵלָ֑יִךְ הִנֵּ֖ה בָּאָֽה׃
verses.translit: qts b' b' hqts hqyts 'lykh hnh b'h
verses.translation: An end is come, the end is come, it awaketh against thee; behold, it cometh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֧אָה הַצְּפִירָ֛ה אֵלֶ֖יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֑רֶץ בָּ֣א הָעֵ֗ת קָר֛וֹב הַיּ֥וֹם מְהוּמָ֖ה וְלֹא־הֵ֥ד הָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: b'h htspyrh 'lykh yvshb h'rts b' h't qrvb hyvm mhvmh vl'hd hrym
verses.translation: The turn is come unto thee, O inhabitant of the land; the time is come, the day of tumult is near, and not of joyful shouting upon the mountains.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּ֣ה מִקָּר֗וֹב אֶשְׁפּ֤וֹךְ חֲמָתִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וְכִלֵּיתִ֤י אַפִּי֙ בָּ֔ךְ וּשְׁפַטְתִּ֖יךְ כִּדְרָכָ֑יִךְ וְנָתַתִּ֣י עָלַ֔יִךְ אֵ֖ת כׇּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: 'th mqrvb 'shpvkh chmty 'lykh vkhlyty 'py bkh vshpttykh khdrkhykh vntty 'lykh 't khltv'bvtykh
verses.translation: Now will I shortly pour out My fury upon thee, and spend Mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways; and I will bring upon thee all thine abominations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֖י וְלֹ֣א אֶחְמ֑וֹל כִּדְרָכַ֜יִךְ עָלַ֣יִךְ אֶתֵּ֗ן וְתוֹעֲבוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּתוֹכֵ֣ךְ תִּהְיֶ֔יןָ וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה מַכֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vl'tchvs 'yny vl' 'chmvl khdrkhykh 'lykh 'tn vtv'bvtykh btvkhkh thyyn vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh mkhh
verses.translation: And Mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity; I will bring upon thee according to thy ways, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I the LORD do smite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה הַיּ֖וֹם הִנֵּ֣ה בָאָ֑ה יָֽצְאָה֙ הַצְּפִרָ֔ה צָ֚ץ הַמַּטֶּ֔ה פָּרַ֖ח הַזָּדֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: hnh hyvm hnh b'h yts'h htsprh tsts hmth prch hzdvn
verses.translation: Behold the day; behold, it cometh; the turn is come forth; the rod hath blossomed, arrogancy hath budded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶחָמָ֥ס ׀ קָ֖ם לְמַטֵּה־רֶ֑שַׁע לֹא־מֵהֶ֞ם וְלֹ֧א מֵהֲמוֹנָ֛ם וְלֹ֥א מֶהֱמֵהֶ֖ם וְלֹא־נֹ֥הַּ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hchms  qm lmthrsh' l'mhm vl' mhmvnm vl' mhmhm vl'nh bhm
verses.translation: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness; nought cometh from them, nor from their tumult, nor from their turmoil, neither is there eminency among them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֤א הָעֵת֙ הִגִּ֣יעַ הַיּ֔וֹם הַקּוֹנֶה֙ אַל־יִשְׂמָ֔ח וְהַמֹּכֵ֖ר אַל־יִתְאַבָּ֑ל כִּ֥י חָר֖וֹן אֶל־כׇּל־הֲמוֹנָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: b' h't hgy' hyvm hqvnh 'lyshmch vhmkhr 'lyt'bl khy chrvn 'lkhlhmvnh
verses.translation: The time is come, the day draweth near; let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn; for wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י הַמֹּכֵ֗ר אֶל־הַמִּמְכָּר֙ לֹ֣א יָשׁ֔וּב וְע֥וֹד בַּחַיִּ֖ים חַיָּתָ֑ם כִּֽי־חָז֤וֹן אֶל־כׇּל־הֲמוֹנָהּ֙ לֹ֣א יָשׁ֔וּב וְאִ֧ישׁ בַּעֲוֺנ֛וֹ חַיָּת֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִתְחַזָּֽקוּ׃
verses.translit: khy hmkhr 'lhmmkhr l' yshvb v'vd bchyym chytm khychzvn 'lkhlhmvnh l' yshvb v'ysh b'vnv chytv l' ytchzqv
verses.translation: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they be yet alive; for the vision is touching the whole multitude thereof, which shall not return; neither shall any stand possessed of the iniquity of his life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּקְע֤וּ בַתָּק֙וֹעַ֙ וְהָכִ֣ין הַכֹּ֔ל וְאֵ֥ין הֹלֵ֖ךְ לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה כִּ֥י חֲרוֹנִ֖י אֶל־כׇּל־הֲמוֹנָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: tq'v btqv' vhkhyn hkhl v'yn hlkh lmlchmh khy chrvny 'lkhlhmvnh
verses.translation: They have blown the horn, and have made all ready, but none goeth to the battle; for My wrath is upon all the multitude thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַחֶ֣רֶב בַּח֔וּץ וְהַדֶּ֥בֶר וְהָרָעָ֖ב מִבָּ֑יִת אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּשָּׂדֶה֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יָמ֔וּת וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּעִ֔יר רָעָ֥ב וָדֶ֖בֶר יֹאכְלֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: hchrb bchvts vhdbr vhr'b mbyt 'shr bshdh bchrb ymvt v'shr b'yr r'b vdbr y'khlnv
verses.translation: The sword is without, and the pestilence and the famine within; he that is in the field shall die with the sword, and he that is in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָֽלְטוּ֙ פְּלִ֣יטֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָי֣וּ אֶל־הֶהָרִ֗ים כְּיוֹנֵ֧י הַגֵּאָי֛וֹת כֻּלָּ֖ם הֹמ֑וֹת אִ֖ישׁ בַּעֲוֺנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vpltv plytyhm vhyv 'lhhrym khyvny hg'yvt khlm hmvt 'ysh b'vnv
verses.translation: But they that shall at all escape of them, shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, every one in his iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַיָּדַ֖יִם תִּרְפֶּ֑ינָה וְכׇל־בִּרְכַּ֖יִם תֵּלַ֥כְנָה מָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: khlhydym trpynh vkhlbrkhym tlkhnh mym
verses.translation: All hands shall be slack, and all knees shall drip with water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָגְר֣וּ שַׂקִּ֔ים וְכִסְּתָ֥ה אוֹתָ֖ם פַּלָּצ֑וּת וְאֶ֤ל כׇּל־פָּנִים֙ בּוּשָׁ֔ה וּבְכׇל־רָאשֵׁיהֶ֖ם קׇרְחָֽה׃
verses.translit: vchgrv shqym vkhsth 'vtm pltsvt v'l khlpnym bvshh vbkhlr'shyhm qrchh
verses.translation: They shall also gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame shall be upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּסְפָּ֞ם בַּחוּצ֣וֹת יַשְׁלִ֗יכוּ וּזְהָבָם֮ לְנִדָּ֣ה יִֽהְיֶה֒ כַּסְפָּ֨ם וּזְהָבָ֜ם לֹא־יוּכַ֣ל לְהַצִּילָ֗ם בְּיוֹם֙ עֶבְרַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה נַפְשָׁם֙ לֹ֣א יְשַׂבֵּ֔עוּ וּמֵעֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּ֑אוּ כִּֽי־מִכְשׁ֥וֹל עֲוֺנָ֖ם הָיָֽה׃
verses.translit: khspm bchvtsvt yshlykhv vzhbm lndh yhyh khspm vzhbm l'yvkhl lhtsylm byvm 'brt yhvh npshm l' yshb'v vm'yhm l' yml'v khymkhshvl 'vnm hyh
verses.translation: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be as an unclean thing; their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD; they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels; because it hath been the stumblingblock of their iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּצְבִ֤י עֶדְיוֹ֙ לְגָא֣וֹן שָׂמָ֔הוּ וְצַלְמֵ֧י תוֹעֲבֹתָ֛ם שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶ֖ם עָ֣שׂוּ ב֑וֹ עַל־כֵּ֛ן נְתַתִּ֥יו לָהֶ֖ם לְנִדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vtsby 'dyv lg'vn shmhv vtslmy tv'btm shqvtsyhm 'shv bv 'lkhn nttyv lhm lndh
verses.translation: And as for the beauty of their ornament, which was set for a pride, they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things thereof; therefore have I made it unto them as an unclean thing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְתַתִּ֤יו בְּיַֽד־הַזָּרִים֙ לָבַ֔ז וּלְרִשְׁעֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ לְשָׁלָ֑ל (וחללוה) [וְחִלְּלֽוּהוּ]׃
verses.translit: vnttyv bydhzrym lbz vlrsh'y h'rts lshll (vchllvh) [vchllvhv]
verses.translation: And I will give it into the hands of the strangers for a prey, and to the wicked of the earth for a spoil; and they shall profane it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲסִבּוֹתִ֤י פָנַי֙ מֵהֶ֔ם וְחִלְּל֖וּ אֶת־צְפוּנִ֑י וּבָאוּ־בָ֥הּ פָּרִיצִ֖ים וְחִלְּלֽוּהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhsbvty pny mhm vchllv 'ttspvny vb'vbh prytsym vchllvh {p}
verses.translation: I will also turn My face from them, and they shall profane My secret place; and robbers shall enter into it, and profane it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֖ה הָרַתּ֑וֹק כִּ֣י הָאָ֗רֶץ מָֽלְאָה֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣ט דָּמִ֔ים וְהָעִ֖יר מָלְאָ֥ה חָמָֽס׃
verses.translit: 'shh hrtvq khy h'rts ml'h mshpt dmym vh'yr ml'h chms
verses.translation: Make the chain; for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵֽבֵאתִי֙ רָעֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם וְיָרְשׁ֖וּ אֶת־בָּתֵּיהֶ֑ם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ גְּא֣וֹן עַזִּ֔ים וְנִחֲל֖וּ מְקַֽדְשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhb'ty r'y gvym vyrshv 'tbtyhm vhshbty g'vn 'zym vnchlv mqdshyhm
verses.translation: Wherefore I will bring the worst of the nations, and they shall possess their houses; I will also make the pride of the strong to cease; and their holy places shall be profaned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְפָ֖דָה־בָ֑א וּבִקְשׁ֥וּ שָׁל֖וֹם וָאָֽיִן׃
verses.translit: qpdhb' vbqshv shlvm v'yn
verses.translation: Horror cometh; and they shall seek peace, and there shall be none.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֹוָ֤ה עַל־הֹוָה֙ תָּב֔וֹא וּשְׁמֻעָ֥ה אֶל־שְׁמוּעָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה וּבִקְשׁ֤וּ חָזוֹן֙ מִנָּבִ֔יא וְתוֹרָה֙ תֹּאבַ֣ד מִכֹּהֵ֔ן וְעֵצָ֖ה מִזְּקֵנִֽים׃
verses.translit: hvh 'lhvh tbv' vshm'h 'lshmv'h thyh vbqshv chzvn mnby' vtvrh t'bd mkhhn v'tsh mzqnym
verses.translation: Calamity shall come upon calamity, and rumour shall be upon rumour; and they shall seek a vision of the prophet, and instruction shall perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יִתְאַבָּ֗ל וְנָשִׂיא֙ יִלְבַּ֣שׁ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וִידֵ֥י עַם־הָאָ֖רֶץ תִּבָּהַ֑לְנָה מִדַּרְכָּ֞ם אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה אֹתָם֙ וּבְמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶ֣ם אֶשְׁפְּטֵ֔ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hmlkh yt'bl vnshy' ylbsh shmmh vydy 'mh'rts tbhlnh mdrkhm ''shh 'tm vbmshptyhm 'shptm vyd'v khy'ny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: The king shall mourn, and the prince shall be clothed with appalment, and the hands of the people of the land shall be enfeebled; I will do unto them after their way, and according to their deserts will I judge them; and they shall know that I am the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשִּׁשִּׁ֗ית בַּשִּׁשִּׁי֙ בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֣ה לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ אֲנִי֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בְּבֵיתִ֔י וְזִקְנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יוֹשְׁבִ֣ים לְפָנָ֑י וַתִּפֹּ֤ל עָלַי֙ שָׁ֔ם יַ֖ד אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy  bshnh hshshyt bshshy bchmshh lchdsh 'ny yvshb bbyty vzqny yhvdh yvshbym lpny vtpl 'ly shm yd 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the sixth year, in the sixth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I sat in my house, and the elders of Judah sat before me, that the hand of the Lord GOD fell there upon me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶרְאֶ֗ה וְהִנֵּ֤ה דְמוּת֙ כְּמַרְאֵה־אֵ֔שׁ מִמַּרְאֵ֥ה מׇתְנָ֛יו וּלְמַ֖טָּה אֵ֑שׁ וּמִמׇּתְנָ֣יו וּלְמַ֔עְלָה כְּמַרְאֵה־זֹ֖הַר כְּעֵ֥ין הַחַשְׁמַֽלָה׃
verses.translit: v'r'h vhnh dmvt khmr'h'sh mmr'h mtnyv vlmth 'sh vmmtnyv vlm'lh khmr'hzhr kh'yn hchshmlh
verses.translation: Then I beheld, and lo a likeness as the appearance of fire: from the appearance of his loins and downward, fire; and from his loins and upward, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of electrum.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ תַּבְנִ֣ית יָ֔ד וַיִּקָּחֵ֖נִי בְּצִיצִ֣ת רֹאשִׁ֑י וַתִּשָּׂ֣א אֹתִ֣י ר֣וּחַ ׀ בֵּֽין־הָאָ֣רֶץ וּבֵ֣ין הַשָּׁמַ֡יִם וַתָּבֵא֩ אֹתִ֨י יְרוּשָׁלַ֜͏ְמָה בְּמַרְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֶל־פֶּ֜תַח שַׁ֤עַר הַפְּנִימִית֙ הַפּוֹנֶ֣ה צָפ֔וֹנָה אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֣ם מוֹשַׁ֔ב סֵ֖מֶל הַקִּנְאָ֥ה הַמַּקְנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshlch tbnyt yd vyqchny btsytst r'shy vtsh' 'ty rvch  bynh'rts vbyn hshmym vtb' 'ty yrvshl͏mh bmr'vt 'lhym 'lptch sh'r hpnymyt hpvnh tspvnh 'shrshm mvshb sml hqn'h hmqnh
verses.translation: And the form of a hand was put forth, and I was taken by a lock of my head; and a spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heaven, and brought me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the door of the gate of the inner court that looketh toward the north; where was the seat of the image of jealousy, which provoketh to jealousy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִ֨נֵּה־שָׁ֔ם כְּב֖וֹד אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּמַּרְאֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי בַּבִּקְעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhnhshm khbvd 'lhy yshr'l khmr'h 'shr r'yty bbq'h
verses.translation: And, behold, the glory of the God of Israel was there, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם שָׂא־נָ֥א עֵינֶ֖יךָ דֶּ֣רֶךְ צָפ֑וֹנָה וָאֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ צָפ֔וֹנָה וְהִנֵּ֤ה מִצָּפוֹן֙ לְשַׁ֣עַר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ סֵ֛מֶל הַקִּנְאָ֥ה הַזֶּ֖ה בַּבִּאָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm sh'n' 'ynykh drkh tspvnh v'sh' 'yny drkh tspvnh vhnh mtspvn lsh'r hmzbch sml hqn'h hzh bb'h
verses.translation: Then said He unto me: ‘Son of man, lift up thine eyes now the way toward the north.’ So I lifted up mine eyes the way toward the north, and behold northward of the gate of the altar this image of jealousy in the entry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם הֲרֹאֶ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה (מהם) [מָ֣ה הֵ֣ם] עֹשִׂ֑ים תּוֹעֵב֨וֹת גְּדֹל֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל  עֹשִׂ֣ים פֹּ֗ה לְרׇֽחֳקָה֙ מֵעַ֣ל מִקְדָּשִׁ֔י וְעוֹד֙ תָּשׁ֣וּב תִּרְאֶ֔ה תּוֹעֵב֖וֹת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm hr'h 'th (mhm) [mh hm] 'shym tv'bvt gdlvt 'shr byt yshr'l  'shym ph lrchqh m'l mqdshy v'vd tshvb tr'h tv'bvt gdlvt {p}
verses.translation: And He said unto me: ‘Son of man, seest thou what they do? even the great abominations that the house of Israel do commit here, that I should go far off from My sanctuary? but thou shalt again see yet greater abominations.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתִ֖י אֶל־פֶּ֣תַח הֶחָצֵ֑ר וָאֶרְאֶ֕ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה חֹר־אֶחָ֖ד בַּקִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'ty 'lptch hchtsr v'r'h vhnh chr'chd bqyr
verses.translation: And He brought me to the door of the court; and when I looked, behold a hole in the wall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־אָדָ֖ם חֲתׇר־נָ֣א בַקִּ֑יר וָאֶחְתֹּ֣ר בַּקִּ֔יר וְהִנֵּ֖ה פֶּ֥תַח אֶחָֽד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm chtrn' bqyr v'chtr bqyr vhnh ptch 'chd {s}
verses.translation: Then said He unto me: ‘Son of man, dig now in the wall’; and when I had digged in the wall, behold a door.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י בֹּ֤א וּרְאֵה֙ אֶת־הַתּוֹעֵב֣וֹת הָרָע֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם עֹשִׂ֖ים פֹּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly b' vr'h 'thtv'bvt hr'vt 'shr hm 'shym ph
verses.translation: And He said unto me: ‘Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָבוֹא֮ וָאֶרְאֶה֒ וְהִנֵּ֨ה כׇל־תַּבְנִ֜ית רֶ֤מֶשׂ וּבְהֵמָה֙ שֶׁ֔קֶץ וְכׇל־גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מְחֻקֶּ֥ה עַל־הַקִּ֖יר סָבִ֥יב ׀ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: v'bv' v'r'h vhnh khltbnyt rmsh vbhmh shqts vkhlglvly byt yshr'l mchqh 'lhqyr sbyb  sbyb
verses.translation: So I went in and saw; and behold every detestable form of creeping things and beasts, and all the idols of the house of Israel, portrayed upon the wall round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁבְעִ֣ים אִ֣ישׁ מִזִּקְנֵ֣י בֵֽית־יִ֠שְׂרָאֵ֠ל וְיַאֲזַנְיָ֨הוּ בֶן־שָׁפָ֜ן עֹמֵ֤ד בְּתוֹכָם֙ עֹמְדִ֣ים לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וְאִ֥ישׁ מִקְטַרְתּ֖וֹ בְּיָד֑וֹ וַעֲתַ֥ר עֲנַֽן־הַקְּטֹ֖רֶת עֹלֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vshb'ym 'ysh mzqny bytyshr'l vy'znyhv bnshpn 'md btvkhm 'mdym lpnyhm v'ysh mqtrtv bydv v'tr 'nnhqtrt 'lh
verses.translation: And there stood before them seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel, and in the midst of them stood Jaazaniah the son of Shaphan, every man with his censer in his hand; and a thick cloud of incense went up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַי֮ הֲרָאִ֣יתָ בֶן־אָדָם֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר זִקְנֵ֤י בֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עֹשִׂ֣ים בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ אִ֖ישׁ בְּחַדְרֵ֣י מַשְׂכִּית֑וֹ כִּ֣י אֹמְרִ֗ים אֵ֤ין יְהֹוָה֙ רֹאֶ֣ה אֹתָ֔נוּ עָזַ֥ב יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hr'yt bn'dm 'shr zqny bytyshr'l 'shym bchshkh 'ysh bchdry mshkhytv khy 'mrym 'yn yhvh r'h 'tnv 'zb yhvh 'th'rts
verses.translation: Then said He unto me: ‘Son of man, hast thou seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his chambers of imagery? for they say: The LORD seeth us not, the LORD hath forsaken the land.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י ע֣וֹד תָּשׁ֥וּב תִּרְאֶ֛ה תּוֹעֵב֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֥מָּה עֹשִֽׂים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly 'vd tshvb tr'h tv'bvt gdlvt 'shrhmh 'shym
verses.translation: He said also unto me: ‘Thou shalt again see yet greater abominations which they do.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֣א אֹתִ֗י אֶל־פֶּ֙תַח֙ שַׁ֣עַר בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֶל־הַצָּפ֑וֹנָה וְהִנֵּה־שָׁם֙ הַנָּשִׁ֣ים יֹשְׁב֔וֹת מְבַכּ֖וֹת אֶת־הַתַּמּֽוּז׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyb' 'ty 'lptch sh'r bytyhvh 'shr 'lhtspvnh vhnhshm hnshym yshbvt mbkhvt 'thtmvz {s}
verses.translation: Then He brought me to the door of the gate of the LORD’S house which was toward the north; and, behold, there sat the women weeping for Tammuz.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלַ֖י הֲרָאִ֣יתָ בֶן־אָדָ֑ם ע֣וֹד תָּשׁ֥וּב תִּרְאֶ֛ה תּוֹעֵב֖וֹת גְּדֹל֥וֹת מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hr'yt bn'dm 'vd tshvb tr'h tv'bvt gdlvt m'lh
verses.translation: Then said He unto me: ‘Hast thou seen this, O son of man? thou shalt again see yet greater abominations than these.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֣א אֹתִ֗י אֶל־חֲצַ֣ר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה֮ הַפְּנִימִית֒ וְהִנֵּה־פֶ֜תַח הֵיכַ֣ל יְהֹוָ֗ה בֵּ֤ין הָֽאוּלָם֙ וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כְּעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אִ֑ישׁ אֲחֹ֨רֵיהֶ֜ם אֶל־הֵיכַ֤ל יְהֹוָה֙ וּפְנֵיהֶ֣ם קֵ֔דְמָה וְהֵ֛מָּה מִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֥ם קֵ֖דְמָה לַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vyb' 'ty 'lchtsr bytyhvh hpnymyt vhnhptch hykhl yhvh byn h'vlm vbyn hmzbch kh'shrym vchmshh 'ysh 'chryhm 'lhykhl yhvh vpnyhm qdmh vhmh mshtchvytm qdmh lshmsh
verses.translation: And He brought me into the inner court of the LORD’S house, and, behold, at the door of the temple of the LORD, between the porch and the altar, were about five and twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the LORD, and their faces toward the east; and they worshipped the sun toward the east.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַי֮ הֲרָאִ֣יתָ בֶן־אָדָם֒ הֲנָקֵל֙ לְבֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה מֵעֲשׂ֕וֹת אֶת־הַתּוֹעֵב֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂוּ־פֹ֑ה כִּֽי־מָלְא֨וּ אֶת־הָאָ֜רֶץ חָמָ֗ס וַיָּשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ לְהַכְעִיסֵ֔נִי וְהִנָּ֛ם שֹׁלְחִ֥ים אֶת־הַזְּמוֹרָ֖ה אֶל־אַפָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hr'yt bn'dm hnql lbyt yhvdh m'shvt 'thtv'bvt 'shr 'shvph khyml'v 'th'rts chms vyshbv lhkh'ysny vhnm shlchym 'thzmvrh 'l'pm
verses.translation: Then He said unto me: ‘Hast thou seen this, O son of man? Is it a light thing to the house of Judah that they commit the abominations which they commit here in that they fill the land with violence, and provoke Me still more, and, lo, they put the branch to their nose?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־אֲנִי֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֣ה בְחֵמָ֔ה לֹא־תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֖י וְלֹ֣א אֶחְמֹ֑ל וְקָרְא֤וּ בְאׇזְנַי֙ ק֣וֹל גָּד֔וֹל וְלֹ֥א אֶשְׁמַ֖ע אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vgm'ny ''shh bchmh l'tchvs 'yny vl' 'chml vqr'v b'zny qvl gdvl vl' 'shm' 'vtm
verses.translation: Therefore will I also deal in fury; Mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity; and though they cry in Mine ears with a loud voice, yet will I not hear them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֣א בְאׇזְנַ֗י ק֤וֹל גָּדוֹל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר קָרְב֖וּ פְּקֻדּ֣וֹת הָעִ֑יר וְאִ֛ישׁ כְּלִ֥י מַשְׁחֵת֖וֹ בְּיָדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyqr' b'zny qvl gdvl l'mr qrbv pqdvt h'yr v'ysh khly mshchtv bydv
verses.translation: Then he called in mine ears with a loud voice, saying: ‘Cause ye them that have charge over the city to draw near, every man with his destroying weapon in his hand.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה שִׁשָּׁ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֡ים בָּאִ֣ים  מִדֶּרֶךְ־שַׁ֨עַר הָעֶלְי֜וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר  מׇפְנֶ֣ה צָפ֗וֹנָה וְאִ֨ישׁ כְּלִ֤י מַפָּצוֹ֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וְאִישׁ־אֶחָ֤ד בְּתוֹכָם֙ לָבֻ֣שׁ בַּדִּ֔ים וְקֶ֥סֶת הַסֹּפֵ֖ר בְּמׇתְנָ֑יו וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ וַיַּ֣עַמְד֔וּ אֵ֖צֶל מִזְבַּ֥ח הַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: vhnh shshh 'nshym b'ym  mdrkhsh'r h'lyvn 'shr  mpnh tspvnh v'ysh khly mptsv bydv v'ysh'chd btvkhm lbsh bdym vqst hspr bmtnyv vyb'v vy'mdv 'tsl mzbch hnchsht
verses.translation: And, behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate, which lieth toward the north, every man with his weapon of destruction in his hand; and one man in the midst of them clothed in linen, with a writer’s inkhorn on his side. And they went in, and stood beside the brazen altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְב֣וֹד  אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נַֽעֲלָה֙ מֵעַ֤ל הַכְּרוּב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה עָלָ֔יו אֶ֖ל מִפְתַּ֣ן הַבָּ֑יִת וַיִּקְרָ֗א אֶל־הָאִישׁ֙ הַלָּבֻ֣שׁ הַבַּדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר קֶ֥סֶת הַסֹּפֵ֖ר בְּמׇתְנָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vkhbvd  'lhy yshr'l n'lh m'l hkhrvb 'shr hyh 'lyv 'l mptn hbyt vyqr' 'lh'ysh hlbsh hbdym 'shr qst hspr bmtnyv {p}
verses.translation: And the glory of the God of Israel was gone up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and He called to the man clothed in linen, who had the writer’s inkhorn on his side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלָ֔ו עֲבֹר֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעִ֔יר בְּת֖וֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְהִתְוִ֨יתָ תָּ֜ו עַל־מִצְח֣וֹת הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַנֶּֽאֱנָחִים֙ וְהַנֶּ֣אֱנָקִ֔ים עַ֚ל כׇּל־הַתּ֣וֹעֵב֔וֹת הַֽנַּעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lv 'br btvkh h'yr btvkh yrvshl͏m vhtvyt tv 'lmtschvt h'nshym hn'nchym vhn'nqym 'l khlhtv'bvt hn'shvt btvkhh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him: ‘Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that are done in the midst thereof.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּלְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ אָמַ֣ר בְּאׇזְנַ֔י עִבְר֥וּ בָעִ֛יר אַחֲרָ֖יו וְהַכּ֑וּ (על) [אַל־]תָּחֹ֥ס (עיניכם) [עֵינְכֶ֖ם] וְאַל־תַּחְמֹֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: vl'lh 'mr b'zny 'brv b'yr 'chryv vhkhv ('l) ['l]tchs ('ynykhm) ['ynkhm] v'ltchmlv
verses.translation: And to the others He said in my hearing: ‘Go ye through the city after him, and smite; let not your eye spare, neither have ye pity;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָקֵ֡ן בָּח֣וּר וּבְתוּלָה֩ וְטַ֨ף וְנָשִׁ֜ים תַּהַרְג֣וּ לְמַשְׁחִ֗ית וְעַל־כׇּל־אִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־עָלָ֤יו הַתָּו֙ אַל־תִּגַּ֔שׁוּ וּמִמִּקְדָּשִׁ֖י תָּחֵ֑לּוּ וַיָּחֵ֙לּוּ֙ בָּאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הַזְּקֵנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: zqn bchvr vbtvlh vtf vnshym thrgv lmshchyt v'lkhl'ysh 'shr'lyv htv 'ltgshv vmmqdshy tchlv vychlv b'nshym hzqnym 'shr lpny hbyt
verses.translation: slay utterly the old man, the young man and the maiden, and little children and women; but come not near any man upon whom is the mark; and begin at My sanctuary.’ Then they began at the elders that were before the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם טַמְּא֣וּ אֶת־הַבַּ֗יִת וּמַלְא֧וּ אֶת־הַחֲצֵר֛וֹת חֲלָלִ֖ים צֵ֑אוּ וְיָצְא֖וּ וְהִכּ֥וּ בָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm tm'v 'thbyt vml'v 'thchtsrvt chllym ts'v vyts'v vhkhv b'yr
verses.translation: And He said unto them: ‘Defile the house, and fill the courts with the slain; go ye forth.’ And they went forth, and smote in the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כְּהַכּוֹתָ֔ם וְנֵֽאשְׁאַ֖ר אָ֑נִי וָאֶפְּלָ֨ה עַל־פָּנַ֜י וָאֶזְעַ֗ק וָֽאֹמַר֙ אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה הֲמַשְׁחִ֣ית אַתָּ֗ה אֵ֚ת כׇּל־שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּשׇׁפְכְּךָ֥ אֶת־חֲמָתְךָ֖ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vyhy khhkhvtm vn'sh'r 'ny v'plh 'lpny v'z'q v'mr 'hh 'dny yhvh hmshchyt 'th 't khlsh'ryt yshr'l bshpkhkh 'tchmtkh 'lyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And it came to pass, while they were smiting, and I was left, that I fell upon my face, and cried, and said: ‘Ah Lord GOD! wilt Thou destroy all the residue of Israel in Thy pouring out of Thy fury upon Jerusalem?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י עֲוֺ֨ן בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וִֽיהוּדָה֙ גָּדוֹל֙ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וַתִּמָּלֵ֤א הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ דָּמִ֔ים וְהָעִ֖יר מָלְאָ֣ה מֻטֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י אָמְר֗וּ עָזַ֤ב יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֵ֥ין יְהֹוָ֖ה רֹאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly 'vn bytyshr'l vyhvdh gdvl bm'd m'd vtml' h'rts dmym vh'yr ml'h mth khy 'mrv 'zb yhvh 'th'rts v'yn yhvh r'h
verses.translation: Then said He unto me: ‘The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah is exceeding great, and the land is full of blood, and the city full of wresting of judgment; for they say: The LORD hath forsaken the land, and the LORD seeth not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֨ם־אֲנִ֔י לֹא־תָח֥וֹס עֵינִ֖י וְלֹ֣א אֶחְמֹ֑ל דַּרְכָּ֖ם בְּרֹאשָׁ֥ם נָתָֽתִּי׃
verses.translit: vgm'ny l'tchvs 'yny vl' 'chml drkhm br'shm ntty
verses.translation: And as for Me also, Mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity, but I will bring their way upon their head.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֞ה הָאִ֣ישׁ  לְבֻ֣שׁ הַבַּדִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הַקֶּ֙סֶת֙ בְּמׇתְנָ֔יו מֵשִׁ֥יב דָּבָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר עָשִׂ֕יתִי (כאשר) [כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר] צִוִּיתָֽנִי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhnh h'ysh  lbsh hbdym 'shr hqst bmtnyv mshyb dbr l'mr 'shyty (kh'shr) [khkhl 'shr] tsvytny {p}
verses.translation: And, behold, the man clothed in linen, who had the inkhorn on his side, reported, saying: ‘I have done according to all that Thou hast commanded me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶרְאֶ֗ה וְהִנֵּ֤ה אֶל־הָרָקִ֙יעַ֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים כְּאֶ֣בֶן סַפִּ֔יר כְּמַרְאֵ֖ה דְּמ֣וּת כִּסֵּ֑א נִרְאָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'r'h vhnh 'lhrqy' 'shr 'lr'sh hkhrbym kh'bn spyr khmr'h dmvt khs' nr'h 'lyhm
verses.translation: Then I looked, and, behold, upon the firmament that was over the head of the cherubim, there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר אֶל־הָאִ֣ישׁ  לְבֻ֣שׁ הַבַּדִּ֗ים וַיֹּ֡אמֶר בֹּא֩ אֶל־בֵּינ֨וֹת לַגַּלְגַּ֜ל אֶל־תַּ֣חַת לַכְּר֗וּב וּמַלֵּ֨א חׇפְנֶ֤יךָ גַֽחֲלֵי־אֵשׁ֙ מִבֵּינ֣וֹת לַכְּרֻבִ֔ים וּזְרֹ֖ק עַל־הָעִ֑יר וַיָּבֹ֖א לְעֵינָֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lh'ysh  lbsh hbdym vy'mr b' 'lbynvt lglgl 'ltcht lkhrvb vml' chpnykh gchly'sh mbynvt lkhrbym vzrq 'lh'yr vyb' l'yny
verses.translation: And He spoke unto the man clothed in linen, and said: ‘Go in between the wheelwork, even under the cherub, and fill both thy hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and dash them against the city.’ And he went in in my sight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַכְּרֻבִ֗ים עֹ֥מְדִ֛ים מִימִ֥ין לַבַּ֖יִת בְּבֹא֣וֹ הָאִ֑ישׁ וְהֶעָנָ֣ן מָלֵ֔א אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֖ר הַפְּנִימִֽית׃
verses.translit: vhkhrbym 'mdym mymyn lbyt bb'v h'ysh vh'nn ml' 'thchtsr hpnymyt
verses.translation: Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤רׇם כְּבוֹד־יְהֹוָה֙ מֵעַ֣ל הַכְּר֔וּב עַ֖ל מִפְתַּ֣ן הַבָּ֑יִת וַיִּמָּלֵ֤א הַבַּ֙יִת֙ אֶת־הֶ֣עָנָ֔ן וְהֶֽחָצֵר֙ מָֽלְאָ֔ה אֶת־נֹ֖גַהּ כְּב֥וֹד יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyrm khbvdyhvh m'l hkhrvb 'l mptn hbyt vyml' hbyt 'th'nn vhchtsr ml'h 'tngh khbvd yhvh
verses.translation: And the glory of the LORD mounted up from the cherub to the threshold of the house; and the house was filled with the cloud, and the court was full of the brightness of the LORD’S glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקוֹל֙ כַּנְפֵ֣י הַכְּרוּבִ֔ים נִשְׁמַ֕ע עַד־הֶחָצֵ֖ר הַחִֽיצֹנָ֑ה כְּק֥וֹל אֵל־שַׁדַּ֖י בְּדַבְּרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vqvl khnpy hkhrvbym nshm' 'dhchtsr hchytsnh khqvl 'lshdy bdbrv
verses.translation: And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when He speaketh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּצַוֺּתוֹ֙ אֶת־הָאִ֤ישׁ לְבֻֽשׁ־הַבַּדִּים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר קַ֥ח אֵשׁ֙ מִבֵּינ֣וֹת לַגַּלְגַּ֔ל מִבֵּינ֖וֹת לַכְּרוּבִ֑ים וַיָּבֹא֙ וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֔ד אֵ֖צֶל הָאוֹפָֽן׃
verses.translit: vyhy btsvtv 'th'ysh lbshhbdym l'mr qch 'sh mbynvt lglgl mbynvt lkhrvbym vyb' vy'md 'tsl h'vpn
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when He commanded the man clothed in linen, saying: ‘Take fire from between the wheelwork, from between the cherubim’, that he went in, and stood beside a wheel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ הַכְּר֨וּב אֶת־יָד֜וֹ מִבֵּינ֣וֹת לַכְּרוּבִ֗ים אֶל־הָאֵשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בֵּינ֣וֹת הַכְּרֻבִ֔ים וַיִּשָּׂא֙ וַיִּתֵּ֔ן אֶל־חׇפְנֵ֖י לְבֻ֣שׁ הַבַּדִּ֑ים וַיִּקַּ֖ח וַיֵּצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vyshlch hkhrvb 'tydv mbynvt lkhrvbym 'lh'sh 'shr bynvt hkhrbym vysh' vytn 'lchpny lbsh hbdym vyqch vyts'
verses.translation: And the cherub stretched forth his hand from between the cherubim unto the fire that was between the cherubim, and took thereof, and put it into the hands of him that was clothed in linen, who took it and went out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרָ֖א לַכְּרֻבִ֑ים תַּבְנִית֙ יַד־אָדָ֔ם תַּ֖חַת כַּנְפֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyr' lkhrbym tbnyt yd'dm tcht khnpyhm
verses.translation: And there appeared in the cherubim the form of a man’s hand under their wings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶרְאֶ֗ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה אוֹפַנִּים֮ אֵ֣צֶל הַכְּרוּבִים֒ אוֹפַ֣ן אֶחָ֗ד אֵ֚צֶל הַכְּר֣וּב אֶחָ֔ד וְאוֹפַ֣ן אֶחָ֔ד אֵ֖צֶל הַכְּר֣וּב אֶחָ֑ד וּמַרְאֵה֙ הָא֣וֹפַנִּ֔ים כְּעֵ֖ין אֶ֥בֶן תַּרְשִֽׁישׁ׃
verses.translit: v'r'h vhnh 'rb'h 'vpnym 'tsl hkhrvbym 'vpn 'chd 'tsl hkhrvb 'chd v'vpn 'chd 'tsl hkhrvb 'chd vmr'h h'vpnym kh'yn 'bn trshysh
verses.translation: And I looked, and behold four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and another wheel beside another cherub; and the appearance of the wheels was as the colour of a beryl stone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַ֨רְאֵיהֶ֔ם דְּמ֥וּת אֶחָ֖ד לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר יִהְיֶ֥ה הָאוֹפַ֖ן בְּת֥וֹךְ הָאוֹפָֽן׃
verses.translit: vmr'yhm dmvt 'chd l'rb'tm kh'shr yhyh h'vpn btvkh h'vpn
verses.translation: And as for their appearance, they four had one likeness, as if a wheel had been within a wheel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּלֶכְתָּ֗ם אֶל־אַרְבַּ֤עַת רִבְעֵיהֶם֙ יֵלֵ֔כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּ֑ם כִּ֣י הַמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יִפְנֶ֤ה הָרֹאשׁ֙ אַחֲרָ֣יו יֵלֵ֔כוּ לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖בּוּ בְּלֶכְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: blkhtm 'l'rb't rb'yhm ylkhv l' ysbv blkhtm khy hmqvm 'shrypnh hr'sh 'chryv ylkhv l' ysbv blkhtm
verses.translation: When they went, they went toward their four sides; they turned not as they went, but to the place whither the head looked they followed it; they turned not as they went.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־בְּשָׂרָם֙ וְגַבֵּהֶ֔ם וִידֵיהֶ֖ם וְכַנְפֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָאוֹפַנִּ֗ים מְלֵאִ֤ים עֵינַ֙יִם֙ סָבִ֔יב לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֖ם אוֹפַנֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhlbshrm vgbhm vydyhm vkhnpyhm vh'vpnym ml'ym 'ynym sbyb l'rb'tm 'vpnyhm
verses.translation: And their whole body, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels were full of eyes round about, even the wheels that they four had.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָא֖וֹפַנִּ֑ים לָהֶ֛ם קוֹרָ֥א הַגַּלְגַּ֖ל בְּאׇזְנָֽי׃
verses.translit: l'vpnym lhm qvr' hglgl b'zny
verses.translation: As for the wheels, they were called in my hearing The wheelwork.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעָ֥ה פָנִ֖ים לְאֶחָ֑ד פְּנֵ֨י הָאֶחָ֜ד פְּנֵ֣י הַכְּר֗וּב וּפְנֵ֤י הַשֵּׁנִי֙ פְּנֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם וְהַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ פְּנֵ֣י אַרְיֵ֔ה וְהָרְבִיעִ֖י פְּנֵי־נָֽשֶׁר׃
verses.translit: v'rb'h pnym l'chd pny h'chd pny hkhrvb vpny hshny pny 'dm vhshlyshy pny 'ryh vhrby'y pnynshr
verses.translation: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of the cherub, and the second face was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּרֹ֖מּוּ הַכְּרוּבִ֑ים הִ֣יא הַחַיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי בִּֽנְהַר־כְּבָֽר׃
verses.translit: vyrmv hkhrvbym hy' hchyh 'shr r'yty bnhrkhbr
verses.translation: And the cherubim mounted up—this is the living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְלֶ֙כֶת֙ הַכְּרוּבִ֔ים יֵלְכ֥וּ הָאוֹפַנִּ֖ים אֶצְלָ֑ם וּבִשְׂאֵ֨ת הַכְּרוּבִ֜ים אֶת־כַּנְפֵיהֶ֗ם לָרוּם֙ מֵעַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹֽא־יִסַּ֧בּוּ הָאוֹפַנִּ֛ים גַּם־הֵ֖ם מֵאֶצְלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vblkht hkhrvbym ylkhv h'vpnym 'tslm vbsh't hkhrvbym 'tkhnpyhm lrvm m'l h'rts l'ysbv h'vpnym gmhm m'tslm
verses.translation: And when the cherubim went, the wheels went beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to mount up from the earth, the same wheels also turned not from beside them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעׇמְדָ֣ם יַעֲמֹ֔דוּ וּבְרוֹמָ֖ם יֵר֣וֹמּוּ אוֹתָ֑ם כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ הַחַיָּ֖ה בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: b'mdm y'mdv vbrvmm yrvmv 'vtm khy rvch hchyh bhm
verses.translation: When they stood, these stood, and when they mounted up, these mounted up with them; for the spirit of the living creature was in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהֹוָ֔ה מֵעַ֖ל מִפְתַּ֣ן הַבָּ֑יִת וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד עַל־הַכְּרוּבִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyts' khbvd yhvh m'l mptn hbyt vy'md 'lhkhrvbym
verses.translation: And the glory of the LORD went forth from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂא֣וּ הַכְּרוּבִ֣ים אֶת־כַּ֠נְפֵיהֶ֠ם וַיֵּר֨וֹמּוּ מִן־הָאָ֤רֶץ לְעֵינַי֙ בְּצֵאתָ֔ם וְהָאוֹפַנִּ֖ים לְעֻמָּתָ֑ם וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֗ד פֶּ֣תַח שַׁ֤עַר בֵּית־יְהֹוָה֙ הַקַּדְמוֹנִ֔י וּכְב֧וֹד אֱלֹהֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.translit: vysh'v hkhrvbym 'tkhnpyhm vyrvmv mnh'rts l'yny bts'tm vh'vpnym l'mtm vy'md ptch sh'r bytyhvh hqdmvny vkhbvd 'lhyyshr'l 'lyhm mlm'lh
verses.translation: And the cherubim lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went forth, and the wheels beside them; and they stood at the door of the east gate of the LORD’S house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֣יא הַחַיָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֛יתִי תַּ֥חַת אֱלֹהֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בִּֽנְהַר־כְּבָ֑ר וָאֵדַ֕ע כִּ֥י כְרוּבִ֖ים הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: hy' hchyh 'shr r'yty tcht 'lhyyshr'l bnhrkhbr v'd' khy khrvbym hmh
verses.translation: This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַרְבָּעָ֨ה אַרְבָּעָ֤ה פָנִים֙ לְאֶחָ֔ד וְאַרְבַּ֥ע כְּנָפַ֖יִם לְאֶחָ֑ד וּדְמוּת֙ יְדֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם תַּ֖חַת כַּנְפֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'rb'h 'rb'h pnym l'chd v'rb' khnpym l'chd vdmvt ydy 'dm tcht khnpyhm
verses.translation: Every one had four faces apiece, and every one four wings; and the likeness of the hands of a man was under their wings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּדְמ֣וּת פְּנֵיהֶ֔ם הֵ֣מָּה הַפָּנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָאִ֙יתִי֙ עַל־נְהַר־כְּבָ֔ר מַרְאֵיהֶ֖ם וְאוֹתָ֑ם אִ֛ישׁ אֶל־עֵ֥בֶר פָּנָ֖יו יֵלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: vdmvt pnyhm hmh hpnym 'shr r'yty 'lnhrkhbr mr'yhm v'vtm 'ysh 'l'br pnyv ylkhv
verses.translation: And as for the likeness of their faces, they were the faces which I saw by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves; they went every one straight forward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּשָּׂ֨א אֹתִ֜י ר֗וּחַ וַתָּבֵ֣א אֹ֠תִ֠י אֶל־שַׁ֨עַר בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֤ה הַקַּדְמוֹנִי֙ הַפּוֹנֶ֣ה קָדִ֔ימָה וְהִנֵּה֙ בְּפֶ֣תַח הַשַּׁ֔עַר עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֖ה אִ֑ישׁ וָאֶרְאֶ֨ה בְתוֹכָ֜ם אֶת־יַאֲזַנְיָ֧ה בֶן־עַזֻּ֛ר וְאֶת־פְּלַטְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־בְּנָיָ֖הוּ שָׂרֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtsh' 'ty rvch vtb' 'ty 'lsh'r bytyhvh hqdmvny hpvnh qdymh vhnh bptch hsh'r 'shrym vchmshh 'ysh v'r'h btvkhm 'ty'znyh bn'zr v'tpltyhv bnbnyhv shry h'm {p}
verses.translation: Then a spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of the LORD’S house, which looketh eastward; and behold at the door of the gate five and twenty men; and I saw in the midst of them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם אֵ֣לֶּה הָאֲנָשִׁ֞ים הַחֹשְׁבִ֥ים אָ֛וֶן וְהַיֹּעֲצִ֥ים עֲצַת־רָ֖ע בָּעִ֥יר הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm 'lh h'nshym hchshbym 'vn vhy'tsym 'tstr' b'yr hz't
verses.translation: And He said unto me: ‘Son of man, these are the men that devise iniquity, and that give wicked counsel in this city;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֹ֣מְרִ֔ים לֹ֥א בְקָר֖וֹב בְּנ֣וֹת בָּתִּ֑ים הִ֣יא הַסִּ֔יר וַאֲנַ֖חְנוּ הַבָּשָֽׂר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: h'mrym l' bqrvb bnvt btym hy' hsyr v'nchnv hbshr {s}
verses.translation: that say: The time is not near to build houses! this city is the caldron, and we are the flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֖ן הִנָּבֵ֣א עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם הִנָּבֵ֖א בֶּן־אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnb' 'lyhm hnb' bn'dm
verses.translation: Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, O son of man.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּפֹּ֣ל עָלַי֮ ר֣וּחַ יְהֹוָה֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י אֱמֹר֙ כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה כֵּ֥ן אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמַעֲל֥וֹת רוּחֲכֶ֖ם אֲנִ֥י יְדַעְתִּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vtpl 'ly rvch yhvh vy'mr 'ly 'mr khh'mr yhvh khn 'mrtm byt yshr'l vm'lvt rvchkhm 'ny yd'tyh
verses.translation: And the spirit of the LORD fell upon me, and He said unto me: ‘Speak: Thus saith the LORD: Thus have ye said, O house of Israel; for I know the things that come into your mind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִרְבֵּיתֶ֥ם חַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם בָּעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את וּמִלֵּאתֶ֥ם חוּצֹתֶ֖יהָ חָלָֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hrbytm chllykhm b'yr hz't vml'tm chvtstyh chll {p}
verses.translation: Ye have multiplied your slain in this city, and ye have filled the streets thereof with the slain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ חַלְלֵיכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שַׂמְתֶּ֣ם בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ הֵ֥מָּה הַבָּשָׂ֖ר וְהִ֣יא הַסִּ֑יר וְאֶתְכֶ֖ם הוֹצִ֥יא מִתּוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr 'dny yhvh chllykhm 'shr shmtm btvkhh hmh hbshr vhy' hsyr v'tkhm hvtsy' mtvkhh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: Your slain whom ye have laid in the midst of it, they are the flesh, and this city is the caldron; but ye shall be brought forth out of the midst of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶ֖רֶב יְרֵאתֶ֑ם וְחֶ֙רֶב֙ אָבִ֣יא עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: chrb yr'tm vchrb 'by' 'lykhm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Ye have feared the sword; and the sword will I bring upon you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹצֵאתִ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִתּוֹכָ֔הּ וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם בְּיַד־זָרִ֑ים וְעָשִׂ֥יתִי בָכֶ֖ם שְׁפָטִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhvts'ty 'tkhm mtvkhh vntty 'tkhm bydzrym v'shyty bkhm shptym
verses.translation: And I will bring you forth out of the midst thereof, and deliver you into the hands of strangers, and will execute judgments among you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחֶ֣רֶב תִּפֹּ֔לוּ עַל־גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶשְׁפּ֣וֹט אֶתְכֶ֑ם וִידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: bchrb tplv 'lgbvl yshr'l 'shpvt 'tkhm vyd'tm khy'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Ye shall fall by the sword: I will judge you upon the border of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִ֗יא לֹֽא־תִהְיֶ֤ה לָכֶם֙ לְסִ֔יר וְאַתֶּ֛ם תִּהְי֥וּ בְתוֹכָ֖הּ לְבָשָׂ֑ר אֶל־גְּב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hy' l'thyh lkhm lsyr v'tm thyv btvkhh lbshr 'lgbvl yshr'l 'shpt 'tkhm
verses.translation: Though this city shall not be your caldron, ye shall be the flesh in the midst thereof; I will judge you upon the border of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּחֻקַּי֙ לֹ֣א הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י לֹ֣א עֲשִׂיתֶ֑ם וּֽכְמִשְׁפְּטֵ֧י הַגּוֹיִ֛ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyd'tm khy'ny yhvh 'shr bchqy l' hlkhtm vmshpty l' 'shytm vkhmshpty hgvym 'shr sbybvtykhm 'shytm
verses.translation: and ye shall know that I am the LORD; for ye have not walked in My statutes, neither have ye executed Mine ordinances, but have done after the ordinances of the nations that are round about you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כְּהִנָּ֣בְאִ֔י וּפְלַטְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־בְּנָיָ֖ה מֵ֑ת וָאֶפֹּ֨ל עַל־פָּנַ֜י וָאֶזְעַ֣ק קוֹל־גָּד֗וֹל וָֽאֹמַר֙ אֲהָהּ֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה כָּלָה֙ אַתָּ֣ה עֹשֶׂ֔ה אֵ֖ת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyhy khhnb'y vpltyhv bnbnyh mt v'pl 'lpny v'z'q qvlgdvl v'mr 'hh 'dny yhvh khlh 'th 'shh 't sh'ryt yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when I prophesied, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. Then fell I down upon my face, and cried with a loud voice, and said: ‘Ah Lord GOD! wilt Thou make a full end of the remnant of Israel?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם אַחֶ֤יךָ אַחֶ֙יךָ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י גְאֻלָּתֶ֔ךָ וְכׇל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כֻּלֹּ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֩ אָמְר֨וּ לָהֶ֜ם יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם רַֽחֲקוּ֙ מֵעַ֣ל יְהֹוָ֔ה לָ֥נוּ הִ֛יא נִתְּנָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ לְמוֹרָשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bn'dm 'chykh 'chykh 'nshy g'ltkh vkhlbyt yshr'l khlh 'shr 'mrv lhm yshby yrvshl͏m rchqv m'l yhvh lnv hy' ntnh h'rts lmvrshh {s}
verses.translation: ’Son of man, as for thy brethren, even thy brethren, the men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel, all of them, concerning whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem have said: Get you far from the LORD! unto us is this land given for a possession;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן אֱמֹ֗ר כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ כִּ֤י הִרְחַקְתִּים֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וְכִ֥י הֲפִיצוֹתִ֖ים בָּאֲרָצ֑וֹת וָאֱהִ֤י לָהֶם֙ לְמִקְדָּ֣שׁ מְעַ֔ט בָּאֲרָצ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֥אוּ שָֽׁם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr khh'mr 'dny yhvh khy hrchqtym bgvym vkhy hpytsvtym b'rtsvt v'hy lhm lmqdsh m't b'rtsvt 'shrb'v shm {s}
verses.translation: therefore say: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Although I have removed them far off among the nations, and although I have scattered them among the countries, yet have I been to them as a little sanctuary in the countries where they are come;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן אֱמֹ֗ר כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ וְקִבַּצְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְאָסַפְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִן־הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְפֹצוֹתֶ֖ם בָּהֶ֑ם וְנָתַתִּ֥י לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr khh'mr 'dny yhvh vqbtsty 'tkhm mnh'mym v'spty 'tkhm mnh'rtsvt 'shr nptsvtm bhm vntty lkhm 't'dmt yshr'l
verses.translation: therefore say: Thus saith the Lord GOD: I will even gather you from the peoples, and assemble you out of the countries where ye have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֖אוּ־שָׁ֑מָּה וְהֵסִ֜ירוּ אֶת־כׇּל־שִׁקּוּצֶ֛יהָ וְאֶת־כׇּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹתֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: vb'vshmh vhsyrv 'tkhlshqvtsyh v'tkhltv'bvtyh mmnh
verses.translation: And they shall come thither, and they shall take away all the detestable things thereof and all the abominations thereof from thence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י לָהֶם֙ לֵ֣ב אֶחָ֔ד וְר֥וּחַ חֲדָשָׁ֖ה אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וַהֲסִ֨רֹתִ֜י לֵ֤ב הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ מִבְּשָׂרָ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֥י לָהֶ֖ם לֵ֥ב בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: vntty lhm lb 'chd vrvch chdshh 'tn bqrbkhm vhsrty lb h'bn mbshrm vntty lhm lb bshr
verses.translation: And I will give them one heart, and I will put a new spirit within you; and I will remove the stony heart out of their flesh, and will give them a heart of flesh;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֙עַן֙ בְּחֻקֹּתַ֣י יֵלֵ֔כוּ וְאֶת־מִשְׁפָּטַ֥י יִשְׁמְר֖וּ וְעָשׂ֣וּ אֹתָ֑ם וְהָיוּ־לִ֣י לְעָ֔ם וַאֲנִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: lm'n bchqty ylkhv v'tmshpty yshmrv v'shv 'tm vhyvly l'm v'ny 'hyh lhm l'lhym
verses.translation: that they may walk in My statutes, and keep Mine ordinances, and do them; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־לֵ֧ב שִׁקּוּצֵיהֶ֛ם וְתוֹעֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם לִבָּ֣ם הֹלֵ֑ךְ דַּרְכָּם֙ בְּרֹאשָׁ֣ם נָתַ֔תִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: v'llb shqvtsyhm vtv'bvtyhm lbm hlkh drkhm br'shm ntty n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: But as for them whose heart walketh after the heart of their detestable things and their abominations, I will bring their way upon their own heads, saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂא֤וּ הַכְּרוּבִים֙ אֶת־כַּנְפֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָאוֹפַנִּ֖ים לְעֻמָּתָ֑ם וּכְב֧וֹד אֱלֹהֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃
verses.translit: vysh'v hkhrvbym 'tkhnpyhm vh'vpnym l'mtm vkhbvd 'lhyyshr'l 'lyhm mlm'lh
verses.translation: Then did the cherubim lift up their wings, and the wheels were beside them; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֙עַל֙ כְּב֣וֹד יְהֹוָ֔ה מֵעַ֖ל תּ֣וֹךְ הָעִ֑יר וַֽיַּעֲמֹד֙ עַל־הָהָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר מִקֶּ֥דֶם לָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vy'l khbvd yhvh m'l tvkh h'yr vy'md 'lhhr 'shr mqdm l'yr
verses.translation: And the glory of the LORD went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְר֣וּחַ נְשָׂאַ֗תְנִי וַתְּבִאֵ֤נִי כַשְׂדִּ֙ימָה֙ אֶל־הַגּוֹלָ֔ה בַּמַּרְאֶ֖ה בְּר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיַּ֙עַל֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִֽיתִי׃
verses.translit: vrvch nsh'tny vtb'ny khshdymh 'lhgvlh bmr'h brvch 'lhym vy'l m'ly hmr'h 'shr r'yty
verses.translation: And a spirit lifted me up, and brought me in the vision by the spirit of God into Chaldea, to them of the captivity. So the vision that I had seen went up from Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֲדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־הַגּוֹלָ֑ה אֵ֛ת כׇּל־דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֶרְאָֽנִי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'dbr 'lhgvlh 't khldbry yhvh 'shr hr'ny {p}
verses.translation: Then I spoke unto them of the captivity all the things that the LORD had shown me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: The word of the LORD also came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם בְּת֥וֹךְ בֵּית־הַמֶּ֖רִי אַתָּ֣ה יֹשֵׁ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֵינַ֩יִם֩ לָהֶ֨ם לִרְא֜וֹת וְלֹ֣א רָא֗וּ אׇזְנַ֨יִם לָהֶ֤ם לִשְׁמֹ֙עַ֙ וְלֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֔עוּ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽם׃
verses.translit: bn'dm btvkh bythmry 'th yshb 'shr 'ynym lhm lr'vt vl' r'v 'znym lhm lshm' vl' shm'v khy byt mry hm
verses.translation: ’Son of man, thou dwellest in the midst of the rebellious house, that have eyes to see, and see not, that have ears to hear, and hear not; for they are a rebellious house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְךָ֙ כְּלֵ֣י גוֹלָ֔ה וּגְלֵ֥ה יוֹמָ֖ם לְעֵינֵיהֶ֑ם וְגָלִ֨יתָ מִמְּקוֹמְךָ֜ אֶל־מָק֤וֹם אַחֵר֙ לְעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם אוּלַ֣י יִרְא֔וּ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: v'th bn'dm 'shh lkh khly gvlh vglh yvmm l'ynyhm vglyt mmqvmkh 'lmqvm 'chr l'ynyhm 'vly yr'v khy byt mry hmh
verses.translation: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for exile, and remove as though for exile by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight; it may be they will perceive, for they are a rebellious house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹצֵאתָ֨ כֵלֶ֜יךָ כִּכְלֵ֥י גוֹלָ֛ה יוֹמָ֖ם לְעֵינֵיהֶ֑ם וְאַתָּ֗ה תֵּצֵ֤א בָעֶ֙רֶב֙ לְעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם כְּמוֹצָאֵ֖י גּוֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhvts't khlykh khkhly gvlh yvmm l'ynyhm v'th tts' b'rb l'ynyhm khmvts'y gvlh
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for exile; and thou shalt go forth thyself at even in their sight, as when men go forth into exile.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם חֲתׇר־לְךָ֣ בַקִּ֑יר וְהוֹצֵאתָ֖ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l'ynyhm chtrlkh bqyr vhvts't bv
verses.translation: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעֵ֨ינֵיהֶ֜ם עַל־כָּתֵ֤ף תִּשָּׂא֙ בָּעֲלָטָ֣ה תוֹצִ֔יא פָּנֶ֣יךָ תְכַסֶּ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תִרְאֶ֖ה אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־מוֹפֵ֥ת נְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: l'ynyhm 'lkhtf tsh' b'lth tvtsy' pnykh tkhsh vl' tr'h 'th'rts khymvpt nttykh lbyt yshr'l
verses.translation: In their sight shalt thou bear it upon thy shoulder, and carry it forth in the darkness; thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground; for I have set thee for a sign unto the house of Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאַ֣עַשׂ כֵּן֮ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צֻוֵּ֒יתִי֒ כֵּ֠לַ֠י הוֹצֵ֜אתִי כִּכְלֵ֤י גוֹלָה֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וּבָעֶ֛רֶב חָתַֽרְתִּי־לִ֥י בַקִּ֖יר בְּיָ֑ד בָּעֲלָטָ֥ה הוֹצֵ֛אתִי עַל־כָּתֵ֥ף נָשָׂ֖אתִי לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v''sh khn kh'shr tsvyty khly hvts'ty khkhly gvlh yvmm vb'rb chtrtyly bqyr byd b'lth hvts'ty 'lkhtf nsh'ty l'ynyhm {p}
verses.translation: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for exile, and in the even I digged through the wall with my hand; I carried out in the darkness, and bore it upon my shoulder in their sight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֧י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י בַּבֹּ֥קֶר לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly bbqr l'mr
verses.translation: And in the morning came the word of the LORD unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם הֲלֹ֨א אָמְר֥וּ אֵלֶ֛יךָ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑רִי מָ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה עֹשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: bn'dm hl' 'mrv 'lykh byt yshr'l byt hmry mh 'th 'shh
verses.translation: ’Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee: What doest thou?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה הַנָּשִׂ֞יא הַמַּשָּׂ֤א הַזֶּה֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וְכׇל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֥מָּה בְתוֹכָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mr 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnshy' hmsh' hzh byrvshl͏m vkhlbyt yshr'l 'shrhmh btvkhm
verses.translation: Say thou unto them: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Concerning the prince, even this burden, in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel among whom they are,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱמֹ֖ר אֲנִ֣י מֽוֹפֶתְכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֗יתִי כֵּ֚ן יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם בַּגּוֹלָ֥ה בַשְּׁבִ֖י יֵלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: 'mr 'ny mvptkhm kh'shr 'shyty khn y'shh lhm bgvlh bshby ylkhv
verses.translation: say: I am your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them—they shall go into exile, into captivity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנָּשִׂ֨יא אֲשֶׁר־בְּתוֹכָ֜ם אֶל־כָּתֵ֤ף יִשָּׂא֙ בָּעֲלָטָ֣ה וְיֵצֵ֔א בַּקִּ֥יר יַחְתְּר֖וּ לְה֣וֹצִיא ב֑וֹ פָּנָ֣יו יְכַסֶּ֔ה יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־יִרְאֶ֥ה לַעַ֛יִן ה֖וּא אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhnshy' 'shrbtvkhm 'lkhtf ysh' b'lth vyts' bqyr ychtrv lhvtsy' bv pnyv ykhsh y'n 'shr l'yr'h l'yn hv' 'th'rts
verses.translation: And the prince that is among them shall bear upon his shoulder, and go forth in the darkness; they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby; he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with his eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָרַשְׂתִּ֤י אֶת־רִשְׁתִּי֙ עָלָ֔יו וְנִתְפַּ֖שׂ בִּמְצוּדָתִ֑י וְהֵבֵאתִ֨י אֹת֤וֹ בָבֶ֙לָה֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְאוֹתָ֥הּ לֹֽא־יִרְאֶ֖ה וְשָׁ֥ם יָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vprshty 'trshty 'lyv vntpsh bmtsvdty vhb'ty 'tv bblh 'rts khshdym v'vth l'yr'h vshm ymvt
verses.translation: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in My snare; and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר סְבִיבֹתָ֥יו עֶזְרֹ֛ה וְכׇל־אֲגַפָּ֖יו אֱזָרֶ֣ה לְכׇל־ר֑וּחַ וְחֶ֖רֶב אָרִ֥יק אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr sbybtyv 'zrh vkhl'gpyv 'zrh lkhlrvch vchrb 'ryq 'chryhm
verses.translation: And I will disperse toward every wind all that are round about him to help him, and all his troops; and I will draw out the sword after them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה בַּהֲפִיצִ֤י אוֹתָם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וְזֵרִיתִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyd'v khy'ny yhvh bhpytsy 'vtm bgvym vzryty 'vtm b'rtsvt
verses.translation: And they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹתַרְתִּ֤י מֵהֶם֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר מֵחֶ֖רֶב מֵרָעָ֣ב וּמִדָּ֑בֶר לְמַ֨עַן יְסַפְּר֜וּ אֶת־כׇּל־תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם בַּגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣אוּ שָׁ֔ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhvtrty mhm 'nshy mspr mchrb mr'b vmdbr lm'n ysprv 'tkhltv'bvtyhm bgvym 'shrb'v shm vyd'v khy'ny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the nations whither they come; and they shall know that I am the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם לַחְמְךָ֖ בְּרַ֣עַשׁ תֹּאכֵ֑ל וּמֵימֶ֕יךָ בְּרׇגְזָ֥ה וּבִדְאָגָ֖ה תִּשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: bn'dm lchmkh br'sh t'khl vmymykh brgzh vbd'gh tshth
verses.translation: ’Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with anxiety;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֶל־עַ֣ם הָאָ֡רֶץ כֹּֽה־אָמַר֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י יֱהֹוִ֜ה לְיוֹשְׁבֵ֤י יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ אֶל־אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַחְמָם֙ בִּדְאָגָ֣ה יֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּמֵימֵיהֶ֖ם בְּשִׁמָּמ֣וֹן יִשְׁתּ֑וּ לְמַ֜עַן תֵּשַׁ֤ם אַרְצָהּ֙ מִמְּלֹאָ֔הּ מֵחֲמַ֖ס כׇּֽל־הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'mrt 'l'm h'rts khh'mr 'dny yhvh lyvshby yrvshl͏m 'l'dmt yshr'l lchmm bd'gh y'khlv vmymyhm bshmmvn yshtv lm'n tshm 'rtsh mml'h mchms khlhyshbym bh
verses.translation: and say unto the people of the land: Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem in the land of Israel. They shall eat their bread with anxiety, and drink their water with appalment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶעָרִ֤ים הַנּֽוֹשָׁבוֹת֙ תֶּחֱרַ֔בְנָה וְהָאָ֖רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֑ה וִידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vh'rym hnvshbvt tchrbnh vh'rts shmmh thyh vyd'tm khy'ny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם מָֽה־הַמָּשָׁ֤ל הַזֶּה֙ לָכֶ֔ם עַל־אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר יַֽאַרְכוּ֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וְאָבַ֖ד כׇּל־חָזֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: bn'dm mhhmshl hzh lkhm 'l'dmt yshr'l l'mr y'rkhv hymym v'bd khlchzvn
verses.translation: ’Son of man, what is that proverb that ye have in the land of Israel, saying: The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ הִשְׁבַּ֙תִּי֙ אֶת־הַמָּשָׁ֣ל הַזֶּ֔ה וְלֹֽא־יִמְשְׁל֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ ע֖וֹד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֚י אִם־דַּבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם קָֽרְבוּ֙ הַיָּמִ֔ים וּדְבַ֖ר כׇּל־חָזֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr 'lyhm khh'mr 'dny yhvh hshbty 'thmshl hzh vl'ymshlv 'tv 'vd byshr'l khy 'mdbr 'lyhm qrbv hymym vdbr khlchzvn
verses.translation: Tell them therefore: Thus saith the Lord GOD: I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them: The days are at hand, and the word of every vision.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹ֣א יִהְיֶ֥ה ע֛וֹד כׇּל־חֲז֥וֹן שָׁ֖וְא וּמִקְסַ֣ם חָלָ֑ק בְּת֖וֹךְ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khy l' yhyh 'vd khlchzvn shv' vmqsm chlq btvkh byt yshr'l
verses.translation: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor smooth divination within the house of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י  אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה אֲדַבֵּר֙ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲדַבֵּ֤ר דָּבָר֙ וְיֵ֣עָשֶׂ֔ה לֹ֥א תִמָּשֵׁ֖ךְ ע֑וֹד כִּ֣י בִימֵיכֶ֞ם בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֗רִי אֲדַבֵּ֤ר דָּבָר֙ וַעֲשִׂיתִ֔יו נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy  'ny yhvh 'dbr 't 'shr 'dbr dbr vy'shh l' tmshkh 'vd khy bymykhm byt hmry 'dbr dbr v'shytyv n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: For I am the LORD; I will speak, what word soever it be that I shall speak, and it shall be performed; it shall be no more delayed; for in your days, O rebellious house, will I speak the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם הִנֵּ֤ה בֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֹֽמְרִ֔ים הֶחָז֛וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ה֥וּא חֹזֶ֖ה לְיָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וּלְעִתִּ֥ים רְחוֹק֖וֹת ה֥וּא נִבָּֽא׃
verses.translit: bn'dm hnh bytyshr'l 'mrym hchzvn 'shrhv' chzh lymym rbym vl'tym rchvqvt hv' nb'
verses.translation: ’Son of man, behold, they of the house of Israel say: The vision that he seeth is for many days to come, and he prophesieth of times that are far off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה לֹא־תִמָּשֵׁ֥ךְ ע֖וֹד כׇּל־דְּבָרָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲדַבֵּ֤ר דָּבָר֙ וְיֵ֣עָשֶׂ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr 'lyhm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh l'tmshkh 'vd khldbry 'shr 'dbr dbr vy'shh n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: Therefore say unto them: Thus saith the Lord GOD: There shall none of My words be delayed any more, but the word which I shall speak shall be performed, saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם הִנָּבֵ֛א אֶל־נְבִיאֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הַנִּבָּאִ֑ים וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לִנְבִיאֵ֣י מִלִּבָּ֔ם שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: bn'dm hnb' 'lnby'y yshr'l hnb'ym v'mrt lnby'y mlbm shm'v dbryhvh
verses.translation: ’Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own heart: Hear ye the word of the LORD:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה ה֖וֹי עַל־הַנְּבִיאִ֣ים הַנְּבָלִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֹלְכִ֛ים אַחַ֥ר רוּחָ֖ם וּלְבִלְתִּ֥י רָאֽוּ׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hvy 'lhnby'ym hnblym 'shr hlkhym 'chr rvchm vlblty r'v
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Woe unto the vile prophets, that follow their own spirit, and things which they have not seen!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּשֻׁעָלִ֖ים בׇּחֳרָב֑וֹת נְבִיאֶ֥יךָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הָיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: khsh'lym bchrbvt nby'ykh yshr'l hyv
verses.translation: O Israel, thy prophets have been like foxes in ruins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א עֲלִיתֶם֙ בַּפְּרָצ֔וֹת וַתִּגְדְּר֥וּ גָדֵ֖ר עַל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לַעֲמֹ֥ד בַּמִּלְחָמָ֖ה בְּי֥וֹם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: l' 'lytm bprtsvt vtgdrv gdr 'lbyt yshr'l l'md bmlchmh byvm yhvh
verses.translation: Ye have not gone up into the breaches, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָ֤זוּ שָׁוְא֙ וְקֶ֣סֶם כָּזָ֔ב הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיהֹוָ֖ה לֹ֣א שְׁלָחָ֑ם וְיִחֲל֖וּ לְקַיֵּ֥ם דָּבָֽר׃
verses.translit: chzv shv' vqsm khzb h'mrym n'myhvh vyhvh l' shlchm vychlv lqym dbr
verses.translation: They have seen vanity and lying divination, that say: The LORD saith; and the LORD hath not sent them, yet they hope that the word would be confirmed!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֤וֹא מַֽחֲזֵה־שָׁוְא֙ חֲזִיתֶ֔ם וּמִקְסַ֥ם כָּזָ֖ב אֲמַרְתֶּ֑ם וְאֹֽמְרִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַאֲנִ֖י לֹ֥א דִבַּֽרְתִּי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hlv' mchzhshv' chzytm vmqsm khzb 'mrtm v'mrym n'myhvh v'ny l' dbrty {s}
verses.translation: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say: The LORD saith; albeit I have not spoken?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן דַּבֶּרְכֶ֣ם שָׁ֔וְא וַחֲזִיתֶ֖ם כָּזָ֑ב לָכֵן֙ הִנְנִ֣י אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n dbrkhm shv' vchzytm khzb lkhn hnny 'lykhm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I am against you, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֣ה יָדִ֗י אֶֽל־הַנְּבִיאִ֞ים הַחֹזִ֣ים שָׁוְא֮ וְהַקֹּסְמִ֣ים כָּזָב֒ בְּס֧וֹד עַמִּ֣י לֹֽא־יִֽהְי֗וּ וּבִכְתָ֤ב בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֹ֣א יִכָּתֵ֔בוּ וְאֶל־אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹ֣א יָבֹ֑אוּ וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyth ydy 'lhnby'ym hchzym shv' vhqsmym khzb bsvd 'my l'yhyv vbkhtb bytyshr'l l' ykhtbv v'l'dmt yshr'l l' yb'v vyd'tm khy 'ny 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And My hand shall be against the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies; they shall not be in the council of My people, neither shall they be written in the register of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I am the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֣עַן וּבְיַ֜עַן הִטְע֧וּ אֶת־עַמִּ֛י לֵאמֹ֥ר שָׁל֖וֹם וְאֵ֣ין שָׁל֑וֹם וְהוּא֙ בֹּ֣נֶה חַ֔יִץ וְהִנָּ֛ם טָחִ֥ים אֹת֖וֹ תָּפֵֽל׃
verses.translit: y'n vby'n ht'v 't'my l'mr shlvm v'yn shlvm vhv' bnh chyts vhnm tchym 'tv tpl
verses.translation: Because, even because they have led My people astray, saying: Peace, and there is no peace; and when it buildeth up a slight wall, behold, they daub it with whited plaster;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱמֹ֛ר אֶל־טָחֵ֥י תָפֵ֖ל וְיִפֹּ֑ל הָיָ֣ה  גֶּ֣שֶׁם שׁוֹטֵ֗ף וְאַתֵּ֜נָה אַבְנֵ֤י אֶלְגָּבִישׁ֙ תִּפֹּ֔לְנָה וְר֥וּחַ סְעָר֖וֹת תְּבַקֵּֽעַ׃
verses.translit: 'mr 'ltchy tpl vypl hyh  gshm shvtf v'tnh 'bny 'lgbysh tplnh vrvch s'rvt tbq'
verses.translation: say unto them that daub it with whited plaster, that it shall fall; there shall be an overflowing shower, and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall, and a stormy wind shall break forth,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֖ה נָפַ֣ל הַקִּ֑יר הֲלוֹא֙ יֵאָמֵ֣ר אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אַיֵּ֥ה הַטִּ֖יחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר טַחְתֶּֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhnh npl hqyr hlv' y'mr 'lykhm 'yh htych 'shr tchtm {s}
verses.translation: and, lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you: Where is the daubing wherewith ye have daubed it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה וּבִקַּעְתִּ֥י רוּחַ־סְעָר֖וֹת בַּחֲמָתִ֑י וְגֶ֤שֶׁם שֹׁטֵף֙ בְּאַפִּ֣י יִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְאַבְנֵ֥י אֶלְגָּבִ֖ישׁ בְּחֵמָ֥ה לְכָלָֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh vbq'ty rvchs'rvt bchmty vgshm shtf b'py yhyh v'bny 'lgbysh bchmh lkhlh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: I will even cause a stormy wind to break forth in My fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in Mine anger, and great hailstones in fury to consume it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָ֨רַסְתִּ֜י אֶת־הַקִּ֨יר אֲשֶׁר־טַחְתֶּ֥ם תָּפֵ֛ל וְהִגַּעְתִּ֥יהוּ אֶל־הָאָ֖רֶץ וְנִגְלָ֣ה יְסֹד֑וֹ וְנָֽפְלָה֙ וּכְלִיתֶ֣ם בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ וִידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhrsty 'thqyr 'shrtchtm tpl vhg'tyhv 'lh'rts vnglh ysdv vnplh vkhlytm btvkhh vyd'tm khy'ny yhvh
verses.translation: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with whited plaster, and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be uncovered; and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִלֵּיתִ֤י אֶת־חֲמָתִי֙ בַּקִּ֔יר וּבַטָּחִ֥ים אֹת֖וֹ תָּפֵ֑ל וְאֹמַ֤ר לָכֶם֙ אֵ֣ין הַקִּ֔יר וְאֵ֖ין הַטָּחִ֥ים אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vkhlyty 'tchmty bqyr vbtchym 'tv tpl v'mr lkhm 'yn hqyr v'yn htchym 'tv
verses.translation: Thus will I spend My fury upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with whited plaster; and I will say unto you: The wall is no more, neither they that daubed it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְבִיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַֽנִּבְּאִים֙ אֶל־יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וְהַחֹזִ֥ים לָ֖הּ חֲז֣וֹן שָׁלֹ֑ם וְאֵ֣ין שָׁלֹ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: nby'y yshr'l hnb'ym 'lyrvshl͏m vhchzym lh chzvn shlm v'yn shlm n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: to wit, the prophets of Israel that prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and that see visions of peace for her, and there is no peace, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶל־בְּנ֣וֹת עַמְּךָ֔ הַמִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וֹת מִֽלִּבְּהֶ֑ן וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עֲלֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: v'th bn'dm shym pnykh 'lbnvt 'mkh hmtnb'vt mlbhn vhnb' 'lyhn
verses.translation: And thou, son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, that prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה הוֹי֩ לִֽמְתַפְּר֨וֹת כְּסָת֜וֹת עַ֣ל  כׇּל־אַצִּילֵ֣י יָדַ֗י וְעֹשׂ֧וֹת הַמִּסְפָּח֛וֹת עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ כׇּל־קוֹמָ֖ה לְצוֹדֵ֣ד נְפָשׁ֑וֹת הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ תְּצוֹדֵ֣דְנָה לְעַמִּ֔י וּנְפָשׁ֖וֹת לָכֶ֥נָה תְחַיֶּֽינָה׃
verses.translit: v'mrt khh'mr  'dny yhvh hvy lmtprvt khstvt 'l  khl'tsyly ydy v'shvt hmspchvt 'lr'sh khlqvmh ltsvdd npshvt hnpshvt ttsvddnh l'my vnpshvt lkhnh tchyynh
verses.translation: and say: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Woe to the women that sew cushions upon all elbows, and make pads for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of My people, and save souls alive for yourselves?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּחַלֶּלְ֨נָה אֹתִ֜י אֶל־עַמִּ֗י בְּשַׁעֲלֵ֣י שְׂעֹרִים֮ וּבִפְת֣וֹתֵי לֶחֶם֒ לְהָמִ֤ית נְפָשׁוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־תְמוּתֶ֔נָה וּלְחַיּ֥וֹת נְפָשׁ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־תִֽחְיֶ֑ינָה בְּכַ֨זֶּבְכֶ֔ם לְעַמִּ֖י שֹׁמְעֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vtchllnh 'ty 'l'my bsh'ly sh'rym vbptvty lchm lhmyt npshvt 'shr l'tmvtnh vlchyvt npshvt 'shr l'tchyynh bkhzbkhm l'my shm'y khzb {s}
verses.translation: And ye have profaned Me among My people for handfuls of barley and for crumbs of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to My people that hearken unto lies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה הִנְנִ֤י אֶל־כִּסְּתוֹתֵיכֶ֙נָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אַ֠תֵּ֠נָה מְצֹדְד֨וֹת שָׁ֤ם אֶת־הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ לְפֹ֣רְח֔וֹת וְקָרַעְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔ם מֵעַ֖ל זְרוֹעֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי֙ אֶת־הַנְּפָשׁ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם מְצֹדְד֥וֹת אֶת־נְפָשִׁ֖ים לְפֹרְחֹֽת׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr  'dny yhvh hnny 'lkhstvtykhnh 'shr 'tnh mtsddvt shm 'thnpshvt lprchvt vqr'ty 'tm m'l zrv'tykhm vshlchty 'thnpshvt 'shr 'tm mtsddvt 'tnpshym lprcht
verses.translation: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, I am against your cushions, wherewith ye hunt the souls as birds, and I will tear them from your arms; and I will let the souls go, even the souls that ye hunt as birds.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקָרַעְתִּ֞י אֶת־מִסְפְּחֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִצַּלְתִּ֤י אֶת־עַמִּי֙ מִיֶּדְכֶ֔ן וְלֹא־יִהְי֥וּ ע֛וֹד בְּיֶדְכֶ֖ן לִמְצוּדָ֑ה וִידַעְתֶּ֖ן כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vqr'ty 'tmspchtykhm vhtslty 't'my mydkhn vl'yhyv 'vd bydkhn lmtsvdh vyd'tn khy'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Your pads also will I tear, and deliver My people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֣עַן הַכְא֤וֹת לֵב־צַדִּיק֙ שֶׁ֔קֶר וַאֲנִ֖י לֹ֣א הִכְאַבְתִּ֑יו וּלְחַזֵּק֙ יְדֵ֣י רָשָׁ֔ע לְבִלְתִּי־שׁ֛וּב מִדַּרְכּ֥וֹ הָרָ֖ע לְהַחֲיֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: y'n hkh'vt lbtsdyq shqr v'ny l' hkh'btyv vlchzq ydy rsh' lbltyshvb mdrkhv hr' lhchytv
verses.translation: Because with lies ye have cowed the heart of the righteous, when I have not grieved him; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, that he be saved alive;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֚וְא לֹ֣א תֶחֱזֶ֔ינָה וְקֶ֖סֶם לֹא־תִקְסַ֣מְנָה ע֑וֹד וְהִצַּלְתִּ֤י אֶת־עַמִּי֙ מִיֶּדְכֶ֔ן וִידַעְתֶּ֖ן כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn shv' l' tchzynh vqsm l'tqsmnh 'vd vhtslty 't'my mydkhn vyd'tn khy'ny yhvh
verses.translation: therefore ye shall no more see vanity, nor divine divinations; and I will deliver My people out of your hand; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּב֤וֹא אֵלַי֙ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִזִּקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ לְפָנָֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vybv' 'ly 'nshym mzqny yshr'l vyshbv lpny {p}
verses.translation: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הֶעֱל֤וּ גִלּֽוּלֵיהֶם֙ עַל־לִבָּ֔ם וּמִכְשׁ֣וֹל עֲוֺנָ֔ם נָתְנ֖וּ נֹ֣כַח פְּנֵיהֶ֑ם הַאִדָּרֹ֥שׁ אִדָּרֵ֖שׁ לָהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bn'dm h'nshym h'lh h'lv glvlyhm 'llbm vmkhshvl 'vnm ntnv nkhch pnyhm h'drsh 'drsh lhm {s}
verses.translation: ’Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their mind, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face; should I be inquired of at all by them?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן דַּבֵּר־א֠וֹתָ֠ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה אִ֣ישׁ אִ֣ישׁ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ יַעֲלֶ֨ה אֶת־גִּלּוּלָ֜יו אֶל־לִבּ֗וֹ וּמִכְשׁ֤וֹל עֲוֺנוֹ֙ יָשִׂים֙ נֹ֣כַח פָּנָ֔יו וּבָ֖א אֶל־הַנָּבִ֑יא אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה נַעֲנֵ֧יתִי ל֦וֹ (בה) [בָ֖א] בְּרֹ֥ב גִּלּוּלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: lkhn dbr'vtm v'mrt 'lyhm khh'mr  'dny yhvh 'ysh 'ysh mbyt yshr'l 'shr y'lh 'tglvlyv 'llbv vmkhshvl 'vnv yshym nkhch pnyv vb' 'lhnby' 'ny yhvh n'nyty lv (bh) [b'] brb glvlyv
