verses.translation: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his mind, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet—I the LORD will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֛עַן תְּפֹ֥שׂ אֶת־בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּלִבָּ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָזֹ֙רוּ֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י בְּגִלּוּלֵיהֶ֖ם כֻּלָּֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: lm'n tpsh 'tbytyshr'l blbm 'shr nzrv m'ly bglvlyhm khlm {s}
verses.translation: that I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all turned away from Me through their idols.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר  אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה שׁ֣וּבוּ וְהָשִׁ֔יבוּ מֵעַ֖ל גִּלּוּלֵיכֶ֑ם וּמֵעַ֥ל כׇּל־תּוֹעֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם הָשִׁ֥יבוּ פְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr  'lbyt yshr'l khh 'mr 'dny yhvh shvbv vhshybv m'l glvlykhm vm'l khltv'btykhm hshybv pnykhm
verses.translation: Therefore say unto the house of Israel: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Return ye, and turn yourselves from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ אִ֨ישׁ אִ֜ישׁ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּמֵהַגֵּר֮ אֲשֶׁר־יָג֣וּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְיִנָּזֵ֣ר מֵאַחֲרַ֗י וְיַ֤עַל גִּלּוּלָיו֙ אֶל־לִבּ֔וֹ וּמִכְשׁ֣וֹל עֲוֺנ֔וֹ יָשִׂ֖ים נֹ֣כַח פָּנָ֑יו וּבָ֤א אֶל־הַנָּבִיא֙ לִדְרׇשׁ־ל֣וֹ בִ֔י אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה נַעֲנֶה־לּ֖וֹ בִּֽי׃
verses.translit: khy 'ysh 'ysh mbyt yshr'l vmhgr 'shrygvr byshr'l vynzr m'chry vy'l glvlyv 'llbv vmkhshvl 'vnv yshym nkhch pnyv vb' 'lhnby' ldrshlv by 'ny yhvh n'nhlv by
verses.translation: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that separateth himself from Me, and taketh his idols into his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet, that he inquire for him of Me—I the LORD will answer him by Myself,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י פָנַ֜י בָּאִ֣ישׁ הַה֗וּא וַהֲשִׂמֹתִ֙יהוּ֙ לְא֣וֹת וְלִמְשָׁלִ֔ים וְהִכְרַתִּ֖יו מִתּ֣וֹךְ עַמִּ֑י וִידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vntty pny b'ysh hhv' vhshmtyhv l'vt vlmshlym vhkhrtyv mtvkh 'my vyd'tm khy'ny yhvh {s}
verses.translation: and I will set My face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of My people; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנָּבִ֤יא כִֽי־יְפֻתֶּה֙ וְדִבֶּ֣ר דָּבָ֔ר אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ פִּתֵּ֔יתִי אֵ֖ת הַנָּבִ֣יא הַה֑וּא וְנָטִ֤יתִי אֶת־יָדִי֙ עָלָ֔יו וְהִ֨שְׁמַדְתִּ֔יו מִתּ֖וֹךְ עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vhnby' khyypth vdbr dbr 'ny yhvh ptyty 't hnby' hhv' vntyty 'tydy 'lyv vhshmdtyv mtvkh 'my yshr'l
verses.translation: And when the prophet is enticed and speaketh a word, I the LORD have enticed that prophet, and I will stretch out My hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of My people Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָ֑ם כַּעֲוֺן֙ הַדֹּרֵ֔שׁ כַּעֲוֺ֥ן הַנָּבִ֖יא יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vnsh'v 'vnm kh'vn hdrsh kh'vn hnby' yhyh
verses.translation: And they shall bear their iniquity; the iniquity of the prophet shall be even as the iniquity of him that inquireth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְ֠מַ֠עַן לֹא־יִתְע֨וּ ע֤וֹד בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵֽאַחֲרַ֔י וְלֹא־יִטַּמְּא֥וּ ע֖וֹד בְּכׇל־פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָיוּ־לִ֣י לְעָ֗ם וַאֲנִי֙ אֶהְיֶ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lm'n l'yt'v 'vd bytyshr'l m'chry vl'ytm'v 'vd bkhlpsh'yhm vhyvly l'm v'ny 'hyh lhm l'lhym n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: that the house of Israel may go no more astray from Me, neither defile themselves any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be My people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם אֶ֚רֶץ כִּ֤י תֶֽחֱטָא־לִי֙ לִמְעׇל־מַ֔עַל וְנָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ וְשָׁבַ֥רְתִּי לָ֖הּ מַטֵּה־לָ֑חֶם וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּי־בָ֣הּ רָעָ֔ב וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָֽה׃
verses.translit: bn'dm 'rts khy tcht'ly lm'lm'l vntyty ydy 'lyh vshbrty lh mthlchm vhshlchtybh r'b vhkhrty mmnh 'dm vbhmh
verses.translation: ’Son of man, when a land sinneth against Me by trespassing grievously, and I stretch out My hand upon it, and break the staff of the bread thereof, and send famine upon it, and cut off from it man and beast;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הָי֠וּ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ נֹ֖חַ (דנאל) [דָּנִיֵּ֣אל] וְאִיּ֑וֹב הֵ֤מָּה בְצִדְקָתָם֙ יְנַצְּל֣וּ נַפְשָׁ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyv shlsht h'nshym h'lh btvkhh nch (dn'l) [dny'l] v'yvb hmh btsdqtm yntslv npshm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver but their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לוּ־חַיָּ֥ה רָעָ֛ה אַעֲבִ֥יר בָּאָ֖רֶץ וְשִׁכְּלָ֑תָּה וְהָיְתָ֤ה שְׁמָמָה֙ מִבְּלִ֣י עוֹבֵ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֖י הַחַיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: lvchyh r'h ''byr b'rts vshkhlth vhyth shmmh mbly 'vbr mpny hchyh
verses.translation: If I cause evil beasts to pass through the land, and they bereave it, and it be desolate, so that no man may pass through because of the beasts;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵלֶּה֮ בְּתוֹכָהּ֒ חַי־אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה אִם־בָּנִ֥ים וְאִם־בָּנ֖וֹת יַצִּ֑ילוּ הֵ֤מָּה לְבַדָּם֙ יִנָּצֵ֔לוּ וְהָאָ֖רֶץ תִּהְיֶ֥ה שְׁמָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: shlsht h'nshym h'lh btvkhh chy'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'mbnym v'mbnvt ytsylv hmh lbdm yntslv vh'rts thyh shmmh
verses.translation: though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֛וֹ חֶ֥רֶב אָבִ֖יא עַל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֑יא וְאָמַרְתִּ֗י חֶ֚רֶב תַּעֲבֹ֣ר בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'v chrb 'by' 'lh'rts hhy' v'mrty chrb t'br b'rts vhkhrty mmnh 'dm vbhmh
verses.translation: Or if I bring a sword upon that land, and say: Let the sword go through the land, so that I cut off from it man and beast;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֘לֶּה֮ בְּתוֹכָהּ֒ חַי־אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה לֹ֥א יַצִּ֖ילוּ בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנ֑וֹת כִּ֛י הֵ֥ם לְבַדָּ֖ם יִנָּצֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: vshlsht h'nshym h'lh btvkhh chy'ny n'm 'dny yhvh l' ytsylv bnym vbnvt khy hm lbdm yntslv
verses.translation: though these three men were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֛וֹ דֶּ֥בֶר אֲשַׁלַּ֖ח אֶל־הָאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֑יא וְשָׁפַכְתִּ֨י חֲמָתִ֤י עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ בְּדָ֔ם לְהַכְרִ֥ית מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'v dbr 'shlch 'lh'rts hhy' vshpkhty chmty 'lyh bdm lhkhryt mmnh 'dm vbhmh
verses.translation: Or if I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out My fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֹ֨חַ (דנאל) [דָּנִיֵּ֣אל] וְאִיּוֹב֮ בְּתוֹכָהּ֒ חַי־אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה אִם־בֵּ֥ן אִם־בַּ֖ת יַצִּ֑ילוּ הֵ֥מָּה בְצִדְקָתָ֖ם יַצִּ֥ילוּ נַפְשָֽׁם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnch (dn'l) [dny'l] v'yvb btvkhh chy'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'mbn 'mbt ytsylv hmh btsdqtm ytsylv npshm {p}
verses.translation: though Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall but deliver their own souls by their righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה אַ֣ף כִּֽי־אַרְבַּ֣עַת שְׁפָטַ֣י ׀ הָרָעִ֡ים חֶ֠רֶב וְרָעָ֞ב וְחַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ וָדֶ֔בֶר שִׁלַּ֖חְתִּי אֶל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם לְהַכְרִ֥ית מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'f khy'rb't shpty  hr'ym chrb vr'b vchyh r'h vdbr shlchty 'lyrvshl͏m lhkhryt mmnh 'dm vbhmh
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD: How much more when I send My four sore judgments against Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the evil beasts, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה נֽוֹתְרָה־בָּ֜הּ פְּלֵטָ֗ה הַֽמּוּצָאִים֮ בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנוֹת֒ הִנָּם֙ יוֹצְאִ֣ים אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וּרְאִיתֶ֥ם אֶת־דַּרְכָּ֖ם וְאֶת־עֲלִילוֹתָ֑ם וְנִחַמְתֶּ֗ם עַל־הָרָעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבֵ֙אתִי֙ עַל־יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם אֵ֛ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵבֵ֖אתִי עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vhnh nvtrhbh plth hmvts'ym bnym vbnvt hnm yvts'ym 'lykhm vr'ytm 'tdrkhm v't'lylvtm vnchmtm 'lhr'h 'shr hb'ty 'lyrvshl͏m 't khl'shr hb'ty 'lyh
verses.translation: And, behold, though there be left a remnant therein that shall be brought forth, both sons and daughters; behold, when they come forth unto you, and ye see their way and their doings, then ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, even concerning all that I have brought upon it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִחֲמ֣וּ אֶתְכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־תִרְא֥וּ אֶת־דַּרְכָּ֖ם וְאֶת־עֲלִילוֹתָ֑ם וִידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּי֩ לֹ֨א חִנָּ֤ם עָשִׂ֙יתִי֙ אֵ֣ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֣יתִי בָ֔הּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnchmv 'tkhm khytr'v 'tdrkhm v't'lylvtm vyd'tm khy l' chnm 'shyty 't khl'shr'shyty bh n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: and they shall comfort you, when ye see their way and their doings, and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם מַה־יִּהְיֶ֥ה עֵץ־הַגֶּ֖פֶן מִכׇּל־עֵ֑ץ הַזְּמוֹרָ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָיָ֖ה בַּעֲצֵ֥י הַיָּֽעַר׃
verses.translit: bn'dm mhyhyh 'tshgpn mkhl'ts hzmvrh 'shr hyh b'tsy hy'r
verses.translation: ’Son of man, what is the vine-tree more than any tree, the vine branch which grew up among the trees of the forest?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיֻקַּ֤ח מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ עֵ֔ץ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת לִמְלָאכָ֑ה אִם־יִקְח֤וּ מִמֶּ֙נּוּ֙ יָתֵ֔ד לִתְל֥וֹת עָלָ֖יו כׇּל־כֶּֽלִי׃
verses.translit: hyqch mmnv 'ts l'shvt lml'khh 'myqchv mmnv ytd ltlvt 'lyv khlkhly
verses.translation: Shall wood be taken thereof to make any work? or will men take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה לָאֵ֖שׁ נִתַּ֣ן לְאׇכְלָ֑ה אֵת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י קְצוֹתָ֜יו אָכְלָ֤ה הָאֵשׁ֙ וְתוֹכ֣וֹ נָחָ֔ר הֲיִצְלַ֖ח לִמְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.translit: hnh l'sh ntn l'khlh 't shny qtsvtyv 'khlh h'sh vtvkhv nchr hytslch lml'khh
verses.translation: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire hath devoured both the ends of it, and the midst of it is singed; is it profitable for any work?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ בִּֽהְיוֹת֣וֹ תָמִ֔ים לֹ֥א יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לִמְלָאכָ֑ה אַ֣ף כִּי־אֵ֤שׁ אֲכָלַ֙תְהוּ֙ וַיֵּחָ֔ר וְנַעֲשָׂ֥ה ע֖וֹד לִמְלָאכָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hnh bhyvtv tmym l' y'shh lml'khh 'f khy'sh 'khlthv vychr vn'shh 'vd lml'khh {s}
verses.translation: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work; how much less, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is singed, shall it yet be meet for any work?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עֵץ־הַגֶּ֙פֶן֙ בְּעֵ֣ץ הַיַּ֔עַר אֲשֶׁר־נְתַתִּ֥יו לָאֵ֖שׁ לְאׇכְלָ֑ה כֵּ֣ן נָתַ֔תִּי אֶת־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh kh'shr 'tshgpn b'ts hy'r 'shrnttyv l'sh l'khlh khn ntty 'tyshby yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: As the vine-tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so do I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־פָּנַי֙ בָּהֶ֔ם מֵהָאֵ֣שׁ יָצָ֔אוּ וְהָאֵ֖שׁ תֹּאכְלֵ֑ם וִֽידַעְתֶּם֙ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּשׂוּמִ֥י אֶת־פָּנַ֖י בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vntty 'tpny bhm mh'sh yts'v vh'sh t'khlm vyd'tm khy'ny yhvh bshvmy 'tpny bhm
verses.translation: And I will set My face against them; out of the fire are they come forth, and the fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I set My face against them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֑ה יַ֚עַן מָ֣עֲלוּ מַ֔עַל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vntty 'th'rts shmmh y'n m'lv m'l n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And I will make the land desolate, because they have acted treacherously, saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם הוֹדַ֥ע אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם אֶת־תּוֹעֲבֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: bn'dm hvd' 'tyrvshl͏m 'ttv'btyh
verses.translation: ’Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה־אָמַ֨ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ לִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם מְכֹרֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ וּמֹ֣לְדֹתַ֔יִךְ מֵאֶ֖רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑י אָבִ֥יךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֖י וְאִמֵּ֥ךְ חִתִּֽית׃
verses.translit: v'mrt khh'mr 'dny yhvh lyrvshl͏m mkhrtykh vmldtykh m'rts hkhn'ny 'bykh h'mry v'mkh chtyt
verses.translation: and say: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem: Thine origin and thy nativity is of the land of the Canaanite; the Amorite was thy father, and thy mother was a Hittite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמוֹלְדוֹתַ֗יִךְ בְּי֨וֹם הוּלֶּ֤דֶת אוֹתָךְ֙ לֹא־כׇרַּ֣ת שׇׁרֵּ֔ךְ וּבְמַ֥יִם לֹא־רֻחַ֖צְתְּ לְמִשְׁעִ֑י וְהׇמְלֵ֙חַ֙ לֹ֣א הֻמְלַ֔חַתְּ וְהׇחְתֵּ֖ל לֹ֥א חֻתָּֽלְתְּ׃
verses.translit: vmvldvtykh byvm hvldt 'vtkh l'khrt shrkh vbmym l'rchtst lmsh'y vhmlch l' hmlcht vhchtl l' chtlt
verses.translation: And as for thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water for cleansing; thou was not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־חָ֨סָה עָלַ֜יִךְ עַ֗יִן לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ֛ךְ אַחַ֥ת מֵאֵ֖לֶּה לְחֻמְלָ֣ה עָלָ֑יִךְ וַֽתֻּשְׁלְכִ֞י אֶל־פְּנֵ֤י הַשָּׂדֶה֙ בְּגֹ֣עַל נַפְשֵׁ֔ךְ בְּי֖וֹם הֻלֶּ֥דֶת אֹתָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: l'chsh 'lykh 'yn l'shvt lkh 'cht m'lh lchmlh 'lykh vtshlkhy 'lpny hshdh bg'l npshkh byvm hldt 'tkh
verses.translation: No eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field in the loathsomeness of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶעֱבֹ֤ר עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ וָֽאֶרְאֵ֔ךְ מִתְבּוֹסֶ֖סֶת בְּדָמָ֑יִךְ וָאֹ֤מַר לָךְ֙ בְּדָמַ֣יִךְ חֲיִ֔י וָאֹ֥מַר לָ֖ךְ בְּדָמַ֥יִךְ חֲיִֽי׃
verses.translit: v''br 'lykh v'r'kh mtbvsst bdmykh v'mr lkh bdmykh chyy v'mr lkh bdmykh chyy
verses.translation: And when I passed by thee, and saw thee wallowing in thy blood, I said unto thee: In thy blood, live; yea, I said unto thee: In thy blood, live;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְבָבָ֗ה כְּצֶ֤מַח הַשָּׂדֶה֙ נְתַתִּ֔יךְ וַתִּרְבִּי֙ וַֽתִּגְדְּלִ֔י וַתָּבֹ֖אִי בַּעֲדִ֣י עֲדָיִ֑ים שָׁדַ֤יִם נָכֹ֙נוּ֙ וּשְׂעָרֵ֣ךְ צִמֵּ֔חַ וְאַ֖תְּ עֵרֹ֥ם וְעֶרְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: rbbh khtsmch hshdh nttykh vtrby vtgdly vtb'y b'dy 'dyym shdym nkhnv vsh'rkh tsmch v't 'rm v'ryh
verses.translation: I cause thee to increase, even as the growth of the field. And thou didst increase and grow up, and thou camest to excellent beauty: thy breasts were fashioned, and thy hair was grown; yet thou wast naked and bare.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶעֱבֹ֨ר עָלַ֜יִךְ וָאֶרְאֵ֗ךְ וְהִנֵּ֤ה עִתֵּךְ֙ עֵ֣ת דֹּדִ֔ים וָאֶפְרֹ֤שׂ כְּנָפִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וָאֲכַסֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתֵ֑ךְ וָאֶשָּׁ֣בַֽע לָ֠ךְ וָאָב֨וֹא בִבְרִ֜ית אֹתָ֗ךְ נְאֻ֛ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֖ה וַתִּֽהְיִי־לִֽי׃
verses.translit: v''br 'lykh v'r'kh vhnh 'tkh 't ddym v'prsh khnpy 'lykh v'khsh 'rvtkh v'shb' lkh v'bv' bbryt 'tkh n'm 'dny yhvh vthyyly
verses.translation: Now when I passed by thee, and looked upon thee, and, behold, thy time was the time of love, I spread my skirt over thee, and covered thy nakedness; yea, I swore unto thee, and entered into a covenant with thee, saith the Lord GOD, and thou becamest Mine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶרְחָצֵ֣ךְ בַּמַּ֔יִם וָאֶשְׁטֹ֥ף דָּמַ֖יִךְ מֵעָלָ֑יִךְ וָאֲסֻכֵ֖ךְ בַּשָּֽׁמֶן׃
verses.translit: v'rchtskh bmym v'shtf dmykh m'lykh v'skhkh bshmn
verses.translation: Then washed I thee with water; yea, I cleansed away thy blood from thee, and I anointed thee with oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאַלְבִּישֵׁ֣ךְ רִקְמָ֔ה וָאֶנְעֲלֵ֖ךְ תָּ֑חַשׁ וָאֶחְבְּשֵׁ֣ךְ בַּשֵּׁ֔שׁ וַאֲכַסֵּ֖ךְ מֶֽשִׁי׃
verses.translit: v'lbyshkh rqmh v'n'lkh tchsh v'chbshkh bshsh v'khskh mshy
verses.translation: I clothed thee also with richly woven work, and shod thee with sealskin, and I wound fine linen about thy head, and covered thee with silk.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶעְדֵּ֖ךְ עֶ֑דִי וָאֶתְּנָ֤ה צְמִידִים֙ עַל־יָדַ֔יִךְ וְרָבִ֖יד עַל־גְּרוֹנֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: v''dkh 'dy v'tnh tsmydym 'lydykh vrbyd 'lgrvnkh
verses.translation: I decked thee also with ornaments, and I put bracelets upon thy hands, and a chain on thy neck.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָ֥אֶתֵּֽן־נֶ֙זֶם֙ עַל־אַפֵּ֔ךְ וַעֲגִילִ֖ים עַל־אׇזְנָ֑יִךְ וַעֲטֶ֥רֶת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת בְּרֹאשֵֽׁךְ׃
verses.translit: v'tnnzm 'l'pkh v'gylym 'l'znykh v'trt tp'rt br'shkh
verses.translation: And I put a ring upon thy nose, and earrings in thine ears, and a beautiful crown upon thy head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּעְדִּ֞י זָהָ֣ב וָכֶ֗סֶף וּמַלְבּוּשֵׁךְ֙ (ששי) [שֵׁ֤שׁ] וָמֶ֙שִׁי֙ וְרִקְמָ֔ה סֹ֧לֶת וּדְבַ֛שׁ וָשֶׁ֖מֶן (אכלתי) [אָכָ֑לְתְּ] וַתִּ֙יפִי֙ בִּמְאֹ֣ד מְאֹ֔ד וַֽתִּצְלְחִ֖י לִמְלוּכָֽה׃
verses.translit: vt'dy zhb vkhsf vmlbvshkh (shshy) [shsh] vmshy vrqmh slt vdbsh vshmn ('khlty) ['khlt] vtypy bm'd m'd vttslchy lmlvkhh
verses.translation: Thus wast thou decked with gold and silver; and thy raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and richly woven work; thou didst eat fine flour, and honey, and oil; and thou didst wax exceeding beautiful, and thou wast meet for royal estate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֨צֵא לָ֥ךְ שֵׁ֛ם בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם בְּיׇפְיֵ֑ךְ כִּ֣י  כָּלִ֣יל ה֗וּא בַּהֲדָרִי֙ אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֣מְתִּי עָלַ֔יִךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: vyts' lkh shm bgvym bypykh khy  khlyl hv' bhdry 'shrshmty 'lykh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And thy renown went forth among the nations for thy beauty; for it was perfect, through My splendour which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּבְטְחִ֣י בְיׇפְיֵ֔ךְ וַתִּזְנִ֖י עַל־שְׁמֵ֑ךְ וַתִּשְׁפְּכִ֧י אֶת־תַּזְנוּתַ֛יִךְ עַל־כׇּל־עוֹבֵ֖ר לוֹ־יֶֽהִי׃
verses.translit: vtbtchy bypykh vtzny 'lshmkh vtshpkhy 'ttznvtykh 'lkhl'vbr lvyhy
verses.translation: But thou didst trust in thy beauty and play the harlot because of thy renown, and didst pour out thy harlotries on every one that passed by; his it was.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְחִ֣י מִבְּגָדַ֗יִךְ וַתַּֽעֲשִׂי־לָךְ֙ בָּמ֣וֹת טְלֻא֔וֹת וַתִּזְנִ֖י עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א בָא֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vtqchy mbgdykh vt'shylkh bmvt tl'vt vtzny 'lyhm l' b'vt vl' yhyh
verses.translation: And thou didst take of thy garments, and didst make for thee high places decked with divers colours, and didst play the harlot upon them; the like things shall not come, neither shall it be so.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְחִ֞י כְּלֵ֣י תִפְאַרְתֵּ֗ךְ מִזְּהָבִ֤י וּמִכַּסְפִּי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔ךְ וַתַּעֲשִׂי־לָ֖ךְ צַלְמֵ֣י זָכָ֑ר וַתִּזְנִי־בָֽם׃
verses.translit: vtqchy khly tp'rtkh mzhby vmkhspy 'shr ntty lkh vt'shylkh tslmy zkhr vtznybm
verses.translation: Thou didst also take thy fair jewels of My gold and of My silver, which I had given thee, and madest for thee images of men, and didst play the harlot with them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְחִ֛י אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֥י רִקְמָתֵ֖ךְ וַתְּכַסִּ֑ים וְשַׁמְנִי֙ וּקְטׇרְתִּ֔י (נתתי) [נָתַ֖תְּ] לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vtqchy 'tbgdy rqmtkh vtkhsym vshmny vqtrty (ntty) [ntt] lpnyhm
verses.translation: and thou didst take thy richly woven garments and cover them, and didst set Mine oil and Mine incense before them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלַחְמִי֩ אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֨תִּי לָ֜ךְ סֹ֣לֶת וָשֶׁ֤מֶן וּדְבַשׁ֙ הֶאֱכַלְתִּ֔יךְ וּנְתַתִּ֧יהוּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֛ם לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ וַיֶּ֑הִי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: vlchmy 'shrntty lkh slt vshmn vdbsh h'khltykh vnttyhv lpnyhm lrych nychch vyhy n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: My bread also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, wherewith I fed thee, thou didst even set it before them for a sweet savour, and thus it was; saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּקְחִ֞י אֶת־בָּנַ֤יִךְ וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָלַ֣דְתְּ לִ֔י וַתִּזְבָּחִ֥ים לָהֶ֖ם לֶאֱכ֑וֹל הַמְעַ֖ט (מתזנותך) [מִתַּזְנוּתָֽיִךְ]׃
verses.translit: vtqchy 'tbnykh v'tbnvtykh 'shr yldt ly vtzbchym lhm l'khvl hm't (mtznvtkh) [mtznvtykh]
verses.translation: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto Me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. Were thy harlotries a small matter,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽתִּשְׁחֲטִ֖י אֶת־בָּנָ֑י וַֽתִּתְּנִ֔ים בְּהַעֲבִ֥יר אוֹתָ֖ם לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vtshchty 'tbny vttnym bh'byr 'vtm lhm
verses.translation: that thou hast slain My children, and delivered them up, in setting them apart unto them?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֤ת כׇּל־תּוֹעֲבֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ וְתַזְנֻתַ֔יִךְ לֹ֥א (זכרתי) [זָכַ֖רְתְּ] אֶת־יְמֵ֣י נְעוּרָ֑יִךְ בִּֽהְיוֹתֵךְ֙ עֵירֹ֣ם וְעֶרְיָ֔ה מִתְבּוֹסֶ֥סֶת בְּדָמֵ֖ךְ הָיִֽית׃
verses.translit: v't khltv'btykh vtzntykh l' (zkhrty) [zkhrt] 'tymy n'vrykh bhyvtkh 'yrm v'ryh mtbvsst bdmkh hyyt
verses.translation: And in all thine abominations and thy harlotries thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, and wast wallowing in thy blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֕י אַחֲרֵ֖י כׇּל־רָעָתֵ֑ךְ א֣וֹי א֣וֹי לָ֔ךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'chry khlr'tkh 'vy 'vy lkh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And it came to pass after all thy wickedness—woe, woe unto thee! saith the Lord GOD—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּבְנִי־לָ֖ךְ גָּ֑ב וַתַּעֲשִׂי־לָ֥ךְ רָמָ֖ה בְּכׇל־רְחֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: vtbnylkh gb vt'shylkh rmh bkhlrchvb
verses.translation: that thou hast built unto thee an eminent place, and hast made thee a lofty place in every street.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶל־כׇּל־רֹ֣אשׁ דֶּ֗רֶךְ בָּנִית֙ רָמָתֵ֔ךְ וַתְּתַֽעֲבִי֙ אֶת־יׇפְיֵ֔ךְ וַתְּפַשְּׂקִ֥י אֶת־רַגְלַ֖יִךְ לְכׇל־עוֹבֵ֑ר וַתַּרְבִּ֖י אֶת־[תַּזְנוּתָֽיִךְ] (תזנותך)׃
verses.translit: 'lkhlr'sh drkh bnyt rmtkh vtt'by 'typykh vtpshqy 'trglykh lkhl'vbr vtrby 't[tznvtykh] (tznvtkh)
verses.translation: Thou hast built thy lofty place at every head of the way, and hast made thy beauty an abomination, and hast opened thy feet to every one that passed by, and multiplied thy harlotries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּזְנִ֧י אֶל־בְּנֵי־מִצְרַ֛יִם שְׁכֵנַ֖יִךְ גִּדְלֵ֣י בָשָׂ֑ר וַתַּרְבִּ֥י אֶת־תַּזְנֻתֵ֖ךְ לְהַכְעִיסֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vtzny 'lbnymtsrym shkhnykh gdly bshr vtrby 'ttzntkh lhkh'ysny
verses.translation: Thou hast also played the harlot with the Egyptians, thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast multiplied thy harlotry, to provoke Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה נָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עָלַ֔יִךְ וָאֶגְרַ֖ע חֻקֵּ֑ךְ וָאֶתְּנֵ֞ךְ בְּנֶ֤פֶשׁ שֹׂנְאוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ בְּנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים הַנִּכְלָמ֖וֹת מִדַּרְכֵּ֥ךְ זִמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vhnh ntyty ydy 'lykh v'gr' chqkh v'tnkh bnpsh shn'vtykh bnvt plshtym hnkhlmvt mdrkhkh zmh
verses.translation: Behold, therefore I have stretched out My hand over thee, and have diminished thine allowance, and delivered thee unto the will of them that hate thee, the daughters of the Philistines, that are ashamed of thy lewd way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּזְנִי֙ אֶל־בְּנֵ֣י אַשּׁ֔וּר מִבִּלְתִּ֖י שׇׂבְעָתֵ֑ךְ וַתִּזְנִ֕ים וְגַ֖ם לֹ֥א שָׂבָֽעַתְּ׃
verses.translit: vtzny 'lbny 'shvr mblty shb'tkh vtznym vgm l' shb't
verses.translation: Thou hast played the harlot also with the Assyrians, without having enough; yea, thou hast played the harlot with them, and yet thou wast not satisfied.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּרְבִּ֧י אֶת־תַּזְנוּתֵ֛ךְ אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן כַּשְׂדִּ֑ימָה וְגַם־בְּזֹ֖את לֹ֥א שָׂבָֽעַתְּ׃
verses.translit: vtrby 'ttznvtkh 'l'rts khn'n khshdymh vgmbz't l' shb't
verses.translation: Thou hast moreover multiplied thy harlotry with the land of traffic, even with Chaldea; and yet thou didst not have enough herewith.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָ֤ה אֲמֻלָה֙ לִבָּתֵ֔ךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה בַּֽעֲשׂוֹתֵךְ֙ אֶת־כׇּל־אֵ֔לֶּה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה אִשָּֽׁה־זוֹנָ֖ה שַׁלָּֽטֶת׃
verses.translit: mh 'mlh lbtkh n'm 'dny yhvh b'shvtkh 'tkhl'lh m'shh 'shhzvnh shltt
verses.translation: How weak is thy heart, saith the Lord GOD, seeing thou doest all these things, the work of a wanton harlot;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּבְנוֹתַ֤יִךְ גַּבֵּךְ֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ כׇּל־דֶּ֔רֶךְ וְרָמָתֵ֥ךְ (עשיתי) [עָשִׂ֖ית] בְּכׇל־רְח֑וֹב וְלֹא־[הָיִ֥ית] (הייתי) כַּזּוֹנָ֖ה לְקַלֵּ֥ס אֶתְנָֽן׃
verses.translit: bbnvtykh gbkh br'sh khldrkh vrmtkh ('shyty) ['shyt] bkhlrchvb vl'[hyyt] (hyyty) khzvnh lqls 'tnn
verses.translation: in that thou buildest thine eminent place in the head of every way, and makest thy lofty place in every street; and hast not been as a harlot that enhanceth her hire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאִשָּׁ֖ה הַמְּנָאָ֑פֶת תַּ֣חַת אִישָׁ֔הּ תִּקַּ֖ח אֶת־זָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: h'shh hmn'pt tcht 'yshh tqch 'tzrym
verses.translation: Thou wife that committest adultery, that takest strangers instead of thy husband—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכׇל־זֹנ֖וֹת יִתְּנוּ־נֵ֑דֶה וְאַ֨תְּ נָתַ֤תְּ אֶת־נְדָנַ֙יִךְ֙ לְכׇל־מְאַֽהֲבַ֔יִךְ וַתִּשְׁחֳדִ֣י אוֹתָ֗ם לָב֥וֹא אֵלַ֛יִךְ מִסָּבִ֖יב בְּתַזְנוּתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: lkhlznvt ytnvndh v't ntt 'tndnykh lkhlm'hbykh vtshchdy 'vtm lbv' 'lykh msbyb btznvtykh
verses.translation: to all harlots gifts are given; but thou hast given thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hast bribed them to come unto thee from every side in thy harlotries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִי־בָ֨ךְ הֵ֤פֶךְ מִן־הַנָּשִׁים֙ בְּתַזְנוּתַ֔יִךְ וְאַחֲרַ֖יִךְ לֹ֣א זוּנָּ֑ה וּבְתִתֵּ֣ךְ אֶתְנָ֗ן וְאֶתְנַ֛ן לֹ֥א נִתַּן־לָ֖ךְ וַתְּהִ֥י לְהֶֽפֶךְ׃
verses.translit: vyhybkh hpkh mnhnshym btznvtykh v'chrykh l' zvnh vbttkh 'tnn v'tnn l' ntnlkh vthy lhpkh
verses.translation: And the contrary is in thee from other women, in that thou didst solicit to harlotry, and wast not solicited; and in that thou givest hire, and no hire is given unto thee, thus thou art contrary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן זוֹנָ֔ה שִׁמְעִ֖י דְּבַר־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lkhn zvnh shm'y dbryhvh {p}
verses.translation: Wherefore, O harlot, hear the word of the LORD!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה יַ֣עַן הִשָּׁפֵ֤ךְ נְחֻשְׁתֵּךְ֙ וַתִּגָּלֶ֣ה עֶרְוָתֵ֔ךְ בְּתַזְנוּתַ֖יִךְ עַל־מְאַֽהֲבָ֑יִךְ וְעַל֙ כׇּל־גִּלּוּלֵ֣י תוֹעֲבוֹתַ֔יִךְ וְכִדְמֵ֣י בָנַ֔יִךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תְּ לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khh'mr 'dny yhvh y'n hshpkh nchshtkh vtglh 'rvtkh btznvtykh 'lm'hbykh v'l khlglvly tv'bvtykh vkhdmy bnykh 'shr ntt lhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness uncovered through thy harlotries with thy lovers; and because of all the idols of thy abominations, and for the blood of thy children, that thou didst give unto them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֠כֵ֠ן הִנְנִ֨י מְקַבֵּ֤ץ אֶת־כׇּל־מְאַהֲבַ֙יִךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָרַ֣בְתְּ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֵת֙ כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהַ֔בְתְּ עַ֖ל כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֑את וְקִבַּצְתִּי֩ אֹתָ֨ם עָלַ֜יִךְ מִסָּבִ֗יב וְגִלֵּיתִ֤י עֶרְוָתֵךְ֙ אֲלֵהֶ֔ם וְרָא֖וּ אֶת־כׇּל־עֶרְוָתֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnny mqbts 'tkhlm'hbykh 'shr 'rbt 'lyhm v't khl'shr 'hbt 'l khl'shr shn't vqbtsty 'tm 'lykh msbyb vglyty 'rvtkh 'lhm vr'v 'tkhl'rvtkh
verses.translation: therefore behold, I will gather all thy lovers, unto whom thou hast been pleasant, and all them that thou hast loved, with all them that thou hast hated; I will even gather them against thee from every side, and will uncover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁפַטְתִּיךְ֙ מִשְׁפְּטֵ֣י נֹאֲפ֔וֹת וְשֹׁפְכֹ֖ת דָּ֑ם וּנְתַתִּ֕יךְ דַּ֥ם חֵמָ֖ה וְקִנְאָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshpttykh mshpty n'pvt vshpkht dm vnttykh dm chmh vqn'h
verses.translation: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will bring upon thee the blood of fury and jealousy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֹתָ֜ךְ בְּיָדָ֗ם וְהָרְס֤וּ גַבֵּךְ֙ וְנִתְּצ֣וּ רָמֹתַ֔יִךְ וְהִפְשִׁ֤יטוּ אוֹתָךְ֙ בְּגָדַ֔יִךְ וְלָקְח֖וּ כְּלֵ֣י תִפְאַרְתֵּ֑ךְ וְהִנִּיח֖וּךְ עֵירֹ֥ם וְעֶרְיָֽה׃
verses.translit: vntty 'tkh bydm vhrsv gbkh vnttsv rmtykh vhpshytv 'vtkh bgdykh vlqchv khly tp'rtkh vhnychvkh 'yrm v'ryh
verses.translation: I will also give thee into their hand, and they shall throw down thine eminent place, and break down thy lofty places; and they shall strip thee of thy clothes, and take thy fair jewels; and they shall leave thee naked and bare.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶעֱל֤וּ עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ קָהָ֔ל וְרָגְמ֥וּ אוֹתָ֖ךְ בָּאָ֑בֶן וּבִתְּק֖וּךְ בְּחַרְבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vh'lv 'lykh qhl vrgmv 'vtkh b'bn vbtqvkh bchrbvtm
verses.translation: They shall also bring up an assembly against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׂרְפ֤וּ בָתַּ֙יִךְ֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וְעָשׂוּ־בָ֣ךְ שְׁפָטִ֔ים לְעֵינֵ֖י נָשִׁ֣ים רַבּ֑וֹת וְהִשְׁבַּתִּיךְ֙ מִזּוֹנָ֔ה וְגַם־אֶתְנַ֖ן לֹ֥א תִתְּנִי־עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vshrpv btykh b'sh v'shvbkh shptym l'yny nshym rbvt vhshbtykh mzvnh vgm'tnn l' ttny'vd
verses.translation: And they shall burn thy houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women; and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou shalt also give no hire any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲנִחֹתִ֤י חֲמָתִי֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְסָ֥רָה קִנְאָתִ֖י מִמֵּ֑ךְ וְשָׁ֣קַטְתִּ֔י וְלֹ֥א אֶכְעַ֖ס עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: vhnchty chmty bkh vsrh qn'ty mmkh vshqtty vl' 'kh's 'vd
verses.translation: So will I satisfy My fury upon thee, and My jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־[זָכַרְתְּ֙] (זכרתי) אֶת־יְמֵ֣י נְעוּרַ֔יִךְ וַתִּרְגְּזִי־לִ֖י בְּכׇל־אֵ֑לֶּה וְגַם־אֲנִ֨י הֵ֜א דַּרְכֵּ֣ךְ  בְּרֹ֣אשׁ נָתַ֗תִּי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה וְלֹ֤א (עשיתי) [עָשִׂית֙] אֶת־הַזִּמָּ֔ה עַ֖ל כׇּל־תּוֹעֲבֹתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: y'n 'shr l'[zkhrt] (zkhrty) 'tymy n'vrykh vtrgzyly bkhl'lh vgm'ny h' drkhkh  br'sh ntty n'm 'dny yhvh vl' ('shyty) ['shyt] 'thzmh 'l khltv'btykh
verses.translation: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted Me in all these things; lo, therefore I also will bring thy way upon thy head, saith the Lord GOD; or hast thou not committed this lewdness above all thine abominations?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה֙ כׇּל־הַמֹּשֵׁ֔ל עָלַ֥יִךְ יִמְשֹׁ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר כְּאִמָּ֖הֿ בִּתָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: hnh khlhmshl 'lykh ymshl l'mr kh'mh bth
verses.translation: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use this proverb against thee, saying: As the mother, so her daughter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּת־אִמֵּ֣ךְ אַ֔תְּ גֹּעֶ֥לֶת אִישָׁ֖הּ וּבָנֶ֑יהָ וַאֲח֨וֹת אֲחוֹתֵ֜ךְ אַ֗תְּ אֲשֶׁ֤ר גָּֽעֲלוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁיהֶ֣ן וּבְנֵיהֶ֔ן אִמְּכֶ֣ן חִתִּ֔ית וַאֲבִיכֶ֖ן אֱמֹרִֽי׃
verses.translit: bt'mkh 't g'lt 'yshh vbnyh v'chvt 'chvtkh 't 'shr g'lv 'nshyhn vbnyhn 'mkhn chtyt v'bykhn 'mry
verses.translation: Thou art thy mother’s daughter, that loatheth her husband and her children; and thou art the sister of thy sisters, who loathed their husbands and their children; your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחוֹתֵ֨ךְ הַגְּדוֹלָ֤ה שֹׁמְרוֹן֙ הִ֣יא וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ הַיּוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת עַל־שְׂמֹאולֵ֑ךְ וַאֲחוֹתֵ֞ךְ הַקְּטַנָּ֣ה מִמֵּ֗ךְ הַיּוֹשֶׁ֙בֶת֙ מִֽימִינֵ֔ךְ סְדֹ֖ם וּבְנוֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'chvtkh hgdvlh shmrvn hy' vbnvtyh hyvshbt 'lshm'vlkh v'chvtkh hqtnh mmkh hyvshbt mymynkh sdm vbnvtyh
verses.translation: And thine elder sister is Samaria, that dwelleth at thy left hand, she and her daughters; and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א בְדַרְכֵיהֶן֙ הָלַ֔כְתְּ וּכְתוֹעֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֖ן (עשיתי) [עָשִׂ֑ית] כִּמְעַ֣ט קָ֔ט וַתַּשְׁחִ֥תִי מֵהֵ֖ן בְּכׇל־דְּרָכָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: vl' bdrkhyhn hlkht vkhtv'bvtyhn ('shyty) ['shyt] khm't qt vtshchty mhn bkhldrkhykh
verses.translation: Yet hast thou not walked in their ways, nor done after their abominations; but in a very little while thou didst deal more corruptly than they in all thy ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַי־אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה אִם־עָֽשְׂתָה֙ סְדֹ֣ם אֲחוֹתֵ֔ךְ הִ֖יא וּבְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ית אַ֖תְּ וּבְנוֹתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: chy'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'm'shth sdm 'chvtkh hy' vbnvtyh kh'shr 'shyt 't vbnvtykh
verses.translation: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּה־זֶ֣ה הָיָ֔ה עֲוֺ֖ן סְדֹ֣ם אֲחוֹתֵ֑ךְ גָּא֨וֹן שִׂבְעַת־לֶ֜חֶם וְשַׁלְוַ֣ת הַשְׁקֵ֗ט הָ֤יָה לָהּ֙ וְלִבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְיַד־עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְי֖וֹן לֹ֥א הֶחֱזִֽיקָה׃
verses.translit: hnhzh hyh 'vn sdm 'chvtkh g'vn shb'tlchm vshlvt hshqt hyh lh vlbnvtyh vyd'ny v'byvn l' hchzyqh
verses.translation: Behold, this was the iniquity of thy sister Sodom: pride, fulness of bread, and careless ease was in her and in her daughters; neither did she strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽתִּגְבְּהֶ֔ינָה וַתַּעֲשֶׂ֥ינָה תוֹעֵבָ֖ה לְפָנָ֑י וָאָסִ֥יר אֶתְהֶ֖ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִֽיתִי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vtgbhynh vt'shynh tv'bh lpny v'syr 'thn kh'shr r'yty {s}
verses.translation: And they were haughty, and committed abomination before Me; therefore I removed them when I saw it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן כַּחֲצִ֥י חַטֹּאתַ֖יִךְ לֹ֣א חָטָ֑אָה וַתַּרְבִּ֤י אֶת־תּוֹעֲבוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ מֵהֵ֔נָּה וַתְּצַדְּקִי֙ אֶת־[אֲחוֹתַ֔יִךְ] (אחותך) בְּכׇל־תּוֹעֲבֹתַ֖יִךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר (עשיתי) [עָשִֽׂית]׃
verses.translit: vshmrvn khchtsy cht'tykh l' cht'h vtrby 'ttv'bvtykh mhnh vttsdqy 't['chvtykh] ('chvtkh) bkhltv'btykh 'shr ('shyty) ['shyt]
verses.translation: Neither hath Samaria committed even half of thy sins; but thou hast multiplied thine abominations more than they, and hast justified thy sisters by all thine abominations which thou hast done.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אַ֣תְּ  שְׂאִ֣י כְלִמָּתֵ֗ךְ אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּלַּלְתְּ֙ לַאֲחוֹתֵ֔ךְ בְּחַטֹּאתַ֛יִךְ אֲשֶׁר־הִתְעַ֥בְתְּ מֵהֵ֖ן תִּצְדַּ֣קְנָה מִמֵּ֑ךְ וְגַם־אַ֥תְּ בּ֙וֹשִׁי֙ וּשְׂאִ֣י כְלִמָּתֵ֔ךְ בְּצַדֶּקְתֵּ֖ךְ אַחְיוֹתֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: gm't  sh'y khlmtkh 'shr pllt l'chvtkh bcht'tykh 'shrht'bt mhn ttsdqnh mmkh vgm't bvshy vsh'y khlmtkh btsdqtkh 'chyvtkh
verses.translation: Thou also, bear thine own shame, in that thou hast given judgment for thy sisters; through thy sins that thou hast committed more abominable than they, they are more righteous than thou; yea, be thou also confounded, and bear thy shame, in that thou hast justified thy sisters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת־שְׁבִ֣יתְהֶ֔ן אֶת־[שְׁב֤וּת] (שבית) סְדֹם֙ וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְאֶת־[שְׁב֥וּת] (שבית) שֹׁמְר֖וֹן וּבְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ (ושבית) [וּשְׁב֥וּת] שְׁבִיתַ֖יִךְ בְּתוֹכָֽהְנָה׃
verses.translit: vshbty 'tshbythn 't[shbvt] (shbyt) sdm vbnvtyh v't[shbvt] (shbyt) shmrvn vbnvtyh (vshbyt) [vshbvt] shbytykh btvkhhnh
verses.translation: And I will turn their captivity, the captivity of Sodom and her daughters, and the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, and the captivity of thy captives in the midst of them;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֙עַן֙ תִּשְׂאִ֣י כְלִמָּתֵ֔ךְ וְנִכְלַ֕מְתְּ מִכֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית בְּנַחֲמֵ֖ךְ אֹתָֽן׃
verses.translit: lm'n tsh'y khlmtkh vnkhlmt mkhl 'shr 'shyt bnchmkh 'tn
verses.translation: that thou mayest bear thine own shame, and mayest be ashamed because of all that thou hast done, in that thou art a comfort unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחוֹתַ֗יִךְ סְדֹ֤ם וּבְנוֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ תָּשֹׁ֣בְןָ לְקַדְמָתָ֔ן וְשֹֽׁמְרוֹן֙ וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ תָּשֹׁ֖בְןָ לְקַדְמָתָ֑ן וְאַתְּ֙ וּבְנוֹתַ֔יִךְ תְּשֻׁבֶ֖ינָה לְקַדְמַתְכֶֽן׃
verses.translit: v'chvtykh sdm vbnvtyh tshbn lqdmtn vshmrvn vbnvtyh tshbn lqdmtn v't vbnvtykh tshbynh lqdmtkhn
verses.translation: And thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, shall return to their former estate, and Samaria and her daughters shall return to their former estate, and thou and thy daughters shall return to your former estate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְל֤וֹא הָֽיְתָה֙ סְדֹ֣ם אֲחוֹתֵ֔ךְ לִשְׁמוּעָ֖ה בְּפִ֑יךְ בְּי֖וֹם גְּאוֹנָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: vlv' hyth sdm 'chvtkh lshmv'h bpykh byvm g'vnykh
verses.translation: For thy sister Sodom was not mentioned by thy mouth in the day of thy pride;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּטֶ֘רֶם֮ תִּגָּלֶ֣ה רָעָתֵךְ֒ כְּמ֗וֹ עֵ֚ת חֶרְפַּ֣ת בְּנוֹת־אֲרָ֔ם וְכׇל־סְבִיבוֹתֶ֖יהָ בְּנ֣וֹת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים הַשָּׁאט֥וֹת אוֹתָ֖ךְ מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: btrm tglh r'tkh khmv 't chrpt bnvt'rm vkhlsbybvtyh bnvt plshtym hsh'tvt 'vtkh msbyb
verses.translation: before thy wickedness was uncovered, as at the time of the taunt of the daughters of Aram, and of all that are round about her, the daughters of the Philistines, that have thee in disdain round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־זִמָּתֵ֥ךְ וְאֶת־תּוֹעֲבוֹתַ֖יִךְ אַ֣תְּ נְשָׂאתִ֑ים נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'tzmtkh v'ttv'bvtykh 't nsh'tym n'm yhvh {s}
verses.translation: Thou hast borne thy lewdness and thine abominations, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה (ועשית) [וְעָשִׂ֥יתִי] אוֹתָ֖ךְ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑ית אֲשֶׁר־בָּזִ֥ית אָלָ֖ה לְהָפֵ֥ר בְּרִֽית׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh (v'shyt) [v'shyty] 'vtkh kh'shr 'shyt 'shrbzyt 'lh lhpr bryt
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD: I will even deal with thee as thou hast done, who hast despised the oath in breaking the covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָכַרְתִּ֨י אֲנִ֧י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֛י אוֹתָ֖ךְ בִּימֵ֣י נְעוּרָ֑יִךְ וַהֲקִימוֹתִ֥י לָ֖ךְ בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vzkhrty 'ny 'tbryty 'vtkh bymy n'vrykh vhqymvty lkh bryt 'vlm
verses.translation: Nevertheless I will remember My covenant with thee in the days of thy youth, and I will establish unto thee an everlasting covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָכַ֣רְתְּ אֶת־דְּרָכַ֘יִךְ֮ וְנִכְלַמְתְּ֒ בְּקַחְתֵּ֗ךְ אֶת־אֲחוֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ הַגְּדֹל֣וֹת מִמֵּ֔ךְ אֶל־הַקְּטַנּ֖וֹת מִמֵּ֑ךְ וְנָתַתִּ֨י אֶתְהֶ֥ן לָ֛ךְ לְבָנ֖וֹת וְלֹ֥א מִבְּרִיתֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vzkhrt 'tdrkhykh vnkhlmt bqchtkh 't'chvtykh hgdlvt mmkh 'lhqtnvt mmkh vntty 'thn lkh lbnvt vl' mbrytkh
verses.translation: Then shalt thou remember thy ways, and be ashamed, when thou shalt receive thy sisters, thine elder sisters and thy younger; and I will give them unto thee for daughters, but not because of thy covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲקִימֹתִ֥י אֲנִ֛י אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhqymty 'ny 'tbryty 'tkh vyd't khy'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will establish My covenant with thee, and thou shalt know that I am the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֤עַן תִּזְכְּרִי֙ וָבֹ֔שְׁתְּ וְלֹ֨א יִֽהְיֶה־לָּ֥ךְ עוֹד֙ פִּתְח֣וֹן פֶּ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י כְּלִמָּתֵ֑ךְ בְּכַפְּרִי־לָךְ֙ לְכׇל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ית נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lm'n tzkhry vbsht vl' yhyhlkh 'vd ptchvn ph mpny khlmtkh bkhprylkh lkhl'shr 'shyt n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: that thou mayest remember, and be confounded, and never open thy mouth any more, because of thy shame; when I have forgiven thee all that thou hast done, saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם ח֥וּד חִידָ֖ה וּמְשֹׁ֣ל מָשָׁ֑ל אֶל־בֵּ֖ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: bn'dm chvd chydh vmshl mshl 'lbyt yshr'l
verses.translation: ’Son of man, put forth a riddle, and speak a parable unto the house of Israel,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֞ כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה הַנֶּ֤שֶׁר הַגָּדוֹל֙ גְּד֤וֹל הַכְּנָפַ֙יִם֙ אֶ֣רֶךְ הָאֵ֔בֶר מָלֵא֙ הַנּוֹצָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ל֖וֹ הָרִקְמָ֑ה בָּ֚א אֶל־הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן וַיִּקַּ֖ח אֶת־צַמֶּ֥רֶת הָאָֽרֶז׃
verses.translit: v'mrt khh'mr  'dny yhvh hnshr hgdvl gdvl hkhnpym 'rkh h'br ml' hnvtsh 'shrlv hrqmh b' 'lhlbnvn vyqch 'ttsmrt h'rz
verses.translation: and say: Thus saith the Lord GOD: A great eagle with great wings And long pinions, Full of feathers, which had divers colours, Came unto Lebanon, And took the top of the cedar;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֛ת רֹ֥אשׁ יְנִיקוֹתָ֖יו קָטָ֑ף וַיְבִיאֵ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן בְּעִ֥יר רֹכְלִ֖ים שָׂמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 't r'sh ynyqvtyv qtf vyby'hv 'l'rts khn'n b'yr rkhlym shmv
verses.translation: He cropped off the topmost of the young twigs thereof, And carried it into a land of traffic; He set it in a city of merchants.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֙ מִזֶּ֣רַע הָאָ֔רֶץ וַֽיִּתְּנֵ֖הוּ בִּשְׂדֵה־זָ֑רַע קָ֚ח עַל־מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים צַפְצָפָ֖ה שָׂמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyqch mzr' h'rts vytnhv bshdhzr' qch 'lmym rbym tsptsph shmv
verses.translation: He took also of the seed of the land, And planted it in a fruitful soil; He placed it beside many waters, He set it as a slip.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּצְמַ֡ח וַיְהִי֩ לְגֶ֨פֶן סֹרַ֜חַת שִׁפְלַ֣ת קוֹמָ֗ה לִפְנ֤וֹת דָּֽלִיּוֹתָיו֙ אֵלָ֔יו וְשׇׁרָשָׁ֖יו תַּחְתָּ֣יו יִהְי֑וּ וַתְּהִ֣י לְגֶ֔פֶן וַתַּ֣עַשׂ בַּדִּ֔ים וַתְּשַׁלַּ֖ח פֹּרֹֽאות׃
verses.translit: vytsmch vyhy lgpn srcht shplt qvmh lpnvt dlyvtyv 'lyv vshrshyv tchtyv yhyv vthy lgpn vt'sh bdym vtshlch pr'vt
verses.translation: And it grew, and became a spreading vine Of low stature, Whose tendrils might turn toward him, And the roots thereof be under him; So it became a vine, and brought forth branches, And shot forth sprigs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י נֶֽשֶׁר־אֶחָד֙ גָּד֔וֹל גְּד֥וֹל כְּנָפַ֖יִם וְרַב־נוֹצָ֑ה וְהִנֵּה֩ הַגֶּ֨פֶן הַזֹּ֜את כָּפְנָ֧ה שׇׁרָשֶׁ֣יהָ עָלָ֗יו וְדָֽלִיּוֹתָיו֙ שִׁלְחָה־לּ֔וֹ לְהַשְׁק֣וֹת אוֹתָ֔הּ מֵעֲרֻג֖וֹת מַטָּעָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vyhy nshr'chd gdvl gdvl khnpym vrbnvtsh vhnh hgpn hz't khpnh shrshyh 'lyv vdlyvtyv shlchhlv lhshqvt 'vth m'rgvt mt'h
verses.translation: There was also another great eagle with great wings And many feathers; And, behold, this vine did bend Its roots toward him, And shot forth its branches toward him, from the beds of its plantation, That he might water it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶל־שָׂ֥דֶה טּ֛וֹב אֶל־מַ֥יִם רַבִּ֖ים הִ֣יא שְׁתוּלָ֑ה לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת עָנָף֙ וְלָשֵׂ֣את פֶּ֔רִי לִהְי֖וֹת לְגֶ֥פֶן אַדָּֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: 'lshdh tvb 'lmym rbym hy' shtvlh l'shvt 'nf vlsh't pry lhyvt lgpn 'drt
verses.translation: It was planted in a good soil By many waters, That it might bring forth branches, and that it might bear fruit, That it might be a stately vine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱמֹ֗ר כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֖ה תִּצְלָ֑ח הֲלוֹא֩ אֶת־שׇׁרָשֶׁ֨יהָ יְנַתֵּ֜ק וְאֶת־פִּרְיָ֣הּ  יְקוֹסֵ֣ס וְיָבֵ֗שׁ כׇּל־טַרְפֵּ֤י צִמְחָהּ֙ תִּיבָ֔שׁ וְלֹֽא־בִזְרֹ֤עַ גְּדוֹלָה֙ וּבְעַם־רָ֔ב לְמַשְׂא֥וֹת אוֹתָ֖הּ מִשׇּׁרָשֶֽׁיהָ׃
verses.translit: 'mr khh 'mr 'dny yhvh ttslch hlv' 'tshrshyh yntq v'tpryh  yqvss vybsh khltrpy tsmchh tybsh vl'bzr' gdvlh vb'mrb lmsh'vt 'vth mshrshyh
verses.translation: Say thou: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Shall it prosper? Shall he not pull up the roots thereof, And cut off the fruit thereof, that it wither, Yea, wither in all its sprouting leaves? Neither shall great power or much people be at hand When it is plucked up by the roots thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֥ה שְׁתוּלָ֖ה הֲתִצְלָ֑ח הֲלֹא֩ כְגַ֨עַת בָּ֜הּ ר֤וּחַ הַקָּדִים֙ תִּיבַ֣שׁ יָבֹ֔שׁ עַל־עֲרֻגֹ֥ת צִמְחָ֖הּ תִּיבָֽשׁ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhnh shtvlh httslch hl' khg't bh rvch hqdym tybsh ybsh 'l'rgt tsmchh tybsh {p}
verses.translation: Yea, behold, being planted, shall it prosper? Shall it not utterly wither, when the east wind toucheth it? In the beds where it grew it shall wither.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱמׇר־נָא֙ לְבֵ֣ית הַמֶּ֔רִי הֲלֹ֥א יְדַעְתֶּ֖ם מָה־אֵ֑לֶּה אֱמֹ֗ר הִנֵּה־בָ֨א מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֤ל יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֶת־מַלְכָּהּ֙ וְאֶת־שָׂרֶ֔יהָ וַיָּבֵ֥א אוֹתָ֛ם אֵלָ֖יו בָּבֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: 'mrn' lbyt hmry hl' yd'tm mh'lh 'mr hnhb' mlkhbbl yrvshl͏m vyqch 'tmlkhh v'tshryh vyb' 'vtm 'lyv bblh
verses.translation: ’Say now to the rebellious house: Know ye not what these things mean? tell them: Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took the king thereof, and the princes thereof, and brought them to him to Babylon;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֙ מִזֶּ֣רַע הַמְּלוּכָ֔ה וַיִּכְרֹ֥ת אִתּ֖וֹ בְּרִ֑ית וַיָּבֵ֤א אֹתוֹ֙ בְּאָלָ֔ה וְאֶת־אֵילֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ לָקָֽח׃
verses.translit: vyqch mzr' hmlvkhh vykhrt 'tv bryt vyb' 'tv b'lh v't'yly h'rts lqch
verses.translation: and he took of the seed royal, and made a covenant with him, and brought him under an oath, and the mighty of the land he took away;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִֽהְיוֹת֙ מַמְלָכָ֣ה שְׁפָלָ֔ה לְבִלְתִּ֖י הִתְנַשֵּׂ֑א לִשְׁמֹ֥ר אֶת־בְּרִית֖וֹ לְעׇמְדָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: lhyvt mmlkhh shplh lblty htnsh' lshmr 'tbrytv l'mdh
verses.translation: that his might be a lowly kingdom, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּמְרׇד־בּ֗וֹ לִשְׁלֹ֤חַ מַלְאָכָיו֙ מִצְרַ֔יִם לָתֶת־ל֥וֹ סוּסִ֖ים וְעַם־רָ֑ב הֲיִצְלָ֤ח הֲיִמָּלֵט֙ הָעֹשֵׂ֣ה אֵ֔לֶּה וְהֵפֵ֥ר בְּרִ֖ית וְנִמְלָֽט׃
verses.translit: vymrdbv lshlch ml'khyv mtsrym lttlv svsym v'mrb hytslch hymlt h'shh 'lh vhpr bryt vnmlt
verses.translation: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and much people. Shall he prosper? shall he escape that doeth such things? shall he break the covenant, and yet escape?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַי־אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ אִם־לֹ֗א בִּמְקוֹם֙ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַמַּמְלִ֣יךְ אֹת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּזָה֙ אֶת־אָ֣לָת֔וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵפֵ֖ר אֶת־בְּרִית֑וֹ אִתּ֥וֹ בְתוֹךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל יָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: chy'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'ml' bmqvm hmlkh hmmlykh 'tv 'shr bzh 't'ltv v'shr hpr 'tbrytv 'tv btvkhbbl ymvt
verses.translation: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely in the place where the king dwelleth that made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the midst of Babylon he shall die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא֩ בְחַ֨יִל גָּד֜וֹל וּבְקָהָ֣ל רָ֗ב יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה אוֹת֤וֹ פַרְעֹה֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה בִּשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ סֹלְלָ֖ה וּבִבְנ֣וֹת דָּיֵ֑ק לְהַכְרִ֖ית נְפָשׁ֥וֹת רַבּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vl' bchyl gdvl vbqhl rb y'shh 'vtv pr'h bmlchmh bshpkh sllh vbbnvt dyq lhkhryt npshvt rbvt
verses.translation: Neither shall Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company succour him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts, to cut off many souls;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָזָ֥ה אָלָ֖ה לְהָפֵ֣ר בְּרִ֑ית וְהִנֵּ֨ה נָתַ֥ן יָד֛וֹ וְכׇל־אֵ֥לֶּה עָשָׂ֖ה לֹ֥א יִמָּלֵֽט׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vbzh 'lh lhpr bryt vhnh ntn ydv vkhl'lh 'shh l' ymlt {s}
verses.translation: seeing he hath despised the oath by breaking the covenant, when, lo, he had given his hand, and hath done all these things, he shall not escape.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־אָמַ֨ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֮ חַי־אָ֒נִי֒ אִם־לֹ֗א אָֽלָתִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּזָ֔ה וּבְרִיתִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵפִ֑יר וּנְתַתִּ֖יו בְּרֹאשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr 'dny yhvh chy'ny 'ml' 'lty 'shr bzh vbryty 'shr hpyr vnttyv br'shv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: As I live, surely Mine oath that he hath despised, and My covenant that he hath broken, I will even bring it upon his own head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָרַשְׂתִּ֤י עָלָיו֙ רִשְׁתִּ֔י וְנִתְפַּ֖שׂ בִּמְצוּדָתִ֑י וַהֲבִיאוֹתִ֣יהוּ בָבֶ֗לָה וְנִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֤י אִתּוֹ֙ שָׁ֔ם מַעֲל֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָעַל־בִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vprshty 'lyv rshty vntpsh bmtsvdty vhby'vtyhv bblh vnshptty 'tv shm m'lv 'shr m'lby
verses.translation: And I will spread My net upon him, and he shall be taken in My snare, and I will bring him to Babylon, and will plead with him there for his treachery that he hath committed against Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת כׇּל־מִבְרָחָ֤ו בְּכׇל־אֲגַפָּיו֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֔לוּ וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֖ים לְכׇל־ר֣וּחַ יִפָּרֵ֑שׂוּ וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v't khlmbrchv bkhl'gpyv bchrb yplv vhnsh'rym lkhlrvch yprshv vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh dbrty {p}
verses.translation: And all his mighty men in all his bands shall fall by the sword, and they that remain shall be scattered toward every wind; and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה וְלָקַ֣חְתִּי אָ֗נִי מִצַּמֶּ֧רֶת הָאֶ֛רֶז הָרָמָ֖ה וְנָתָ֑תִּי מֵרֹ֤אשׁ יֹֽנְקוֹתָיו֙ רַ֣ךְ אֶקְטֹ֔ף וְשָׁתַ֣לְתִּי אָ֔נִי עַ֥ל הַר־גָּבֹ֖הַּ וְתָלֽוּל׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh vlqchty 'ny mtsmrt h'rz hrmh vntty mr'sh ynqvtyv rkh 'qtf vshtlty 'ny 'l hrgbh vtlvl
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Moreover I will take, even I, of the lofty top of the cedar, and will set it; I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it upon a high mountain and eminent;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּהַ֨ר מְר֤וֹם יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶשְׁתֳּלֶ֔נּוּ וְנָשָׂ֤א עָנָף֙ וְעָ֣שָׂה פֶ֔רִי וְהָיָ֖ה לְאֶ֣רֶז אַדִּ֑יר וְשָׁכְנ֣וּ תַחְתָּ֗יו כֹּ֚ל צִפּ֣וֹר כׇּל־כָּנָ֔ף בְּצֵ֥ל דָּלִיּוֹתָ֖יו תִּשְׁכֹּֽנָּה׃
verses.translit: bhr mrvm yshr'l 'shtlnv vnsh' 'nf v'shh pry vhyh l'rz 'dyr vshkhnv tchtyv khl tspvr khlkhnf btsl dlyvtyv tshkhnh
verses.translation: in the mountain of the height of Israel will I plant it; and it shall bring forth boughs, and bear fruit, and be a stately cedar; and under it shall dwell all fowl of every wing, in the shadow of the branches thereof shall they dwell.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽיָדְע֞וּ כׇּל־עֲצֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ הִשְׁפַּ֣לְתִּי  עֵ֣ץ גָּבֹ֗הַּ הִגְבַּ֙הְתִּי֙ עֵ֣ץ שָׁפָ֔ל הוֹבַ֙שְׁתִּי֙ עֵ֣ץ לָ֔ח וְהִפְרַ֖חְתִּי עֵ֣ץ יָבֵ֑שׁ אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִֽׂיתִי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyd'v khl'tsy hshdh khy 'ny yhvh hshplty  'ts gbh hgbhty 'ts shpl hvbshty 'ts lch vhprchty 'ts ybsh 'ny yhvh dbrty v'shyty {p}
verses.translation: And all the trees of the field shall know that I the LORD have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish; I the LORD have spoken and have done it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־לָּכֶ֗ם אַתֶּם֙ מֹֽשְׁלִים֙ אֶת־הַמָּשָׁ֣ל הַזֶּ֔ה עַל־אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר אָבוֹת֙ יֹ֣אכְלוּ בֹ֔סֶר וְשִׁנֵּ֥י הַבָּנִ֖ים תִּקְהֶֽינָה׃
verses.translit: mhlkhm 'tm mshlym 'thmshl hzh 'l'dmt yshr'l l'mr 'bvt y'khlv bsr vshny hbnym tqhynh
verses.translation: ’What mean ye, that ye use this proverb in the land of Israel, saying: The fathers have eaten sour grapes, And the children’s teeth are set on edge?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַי־אָ֕נִי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה אִם־יִהְיֶ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם ע֗וֹד מְשֹׁ֛ל הַמָּשָׁ֥ל הַזֶּ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: chy'ny n'm 'dny yhvh 'myhyh lkhm 'vd mshl hmshl hzh byshr'l
verses.translation: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, ye shall not have occasion any more to use this proverb in Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ן כׇּל־הַנְּפָשׁוֹת֙ לִ֣י הֵ֔נָּה כְּנֶ֧פֶשׁ הָאָ֛ב וּכְנֶ֥פֶשׁ הַבֵּ֖ן לִי־הֵ֑נָּה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַחֹטֵ֖את הִ֥יא תָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: hn khlhnpshvt ly hnh khnpsh h'b vkhnpsh hbn lyhnh hnpsh hcht't hy' tmvt
verses.translation: Behold, all souls are Mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son is Mine; the soul that sinneth, it shall die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֖ישׁ כִּֽי־יִהְיֶ֣ה צַדִּ֑יק וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'ysh khyyhyh tsdyq v'shh mshpt vtsdqh
verses.translation: But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶל־הֶֽהָרִים֙ לֹ֣א אָכָ֔ל וְעֵינָיו֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔א אֶל־גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֶת־אֵ֤שֶׁת רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ לֹ֣א טִמֵּ֔א וְאֶל־אִשָּׁ֥ה נִדָּ֖ה לֹ֥א יִקְרָֽב׃
verses.translit: 'lhhrym l' 'khl v'ynyv l' nsh' 'lglvly byt yshr'l v't'sht r'hv l' tm' v'l'shh ndh l' yqrb
verses.translation: and hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, neither hath defiled his neighbour’s wife, neither hath come near to a woman in her impurity;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִישׁ֙ לֹ֣א יוֹנֶ֔ה חֲבֹלָת֥וֹ חוֹב֙ יָשִׁ֔יב גְּזֵלָ֖ה לֹ֣א יִגְזֹ֑ל לַחְמוֹ֙ לְרָעֵ֣ב יִתֵּ֔ן וְעֵירֹ֖ם יְכַסֶּה־בָּֽגֶד׃
verses.translit: v'ysh l' yvnh chbltv chvb yshyb gzlh l' ygzl lchmv lr'b ytn v'yrm ykhshbgd
verses.translation: and hath not wronged any, but hath restored his pledge for a debt, hath taken nought by robbery, hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּנֶּ֣שֶׁךְ לֹֽא־יִתֵּ֗ן וְתַרְבִּית֙ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔ח מֵעָ֖וֶל יָשִׁ֣יב יָד֑וֹ מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱמֶת֙ יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה בֵּ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ לְאִֽישׁ׃
verses.translit: bnshkh l'ytn vtrbyt l' yqch m'vl yshyb ydv mshpt 'mt y'shh byn 'ysh l'ysh
verses.translation: he that hath not given forth upon interest, neither hath taken any increase, that hath withdrawn his hand from iniquity, hath executed true justice between man and man,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֧י יְהַלֵּ֛ךְ וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֥י שָׁמַ֖ר לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אֱמֶ֑ת צַדִּ֥יק הוּא֙ חָיֹ֣ה יִֽחְיֶ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: bchqvty yhlkh vmshpty shmr l'shvt 'mt tsdyq hv' chyh ychyh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: hath walked in My statutes, and hath kept Mine ordinances, to deal truly; he is just, he shall surely live, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹלִ֥יד בֵּן־פָּרִ֖יץ שֹׁפֵ֣ךְ דָּ֑ם וְעָ֣שָׂה אָ֔ח מֵאַחַ֖ד מֵאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vhvlyd bnpryts shpkh dm v'shh 'ch m'chd m'lh
verses.translation: If he beget a son that is a robber, a shedder of blood, and that doeth to a brother any of these things,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְה֕וּא אֶת־כׇּל־אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֣א עָשָׂ֑ה כִּ֣י גַ֤ם אֶל־הֶהָרִים֙ אָכַ֔ל וְאֶת־אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖הוּ טִמֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: vhv' 'tkhl'lh l' 'shh khy gm 'lhhrym 'khl v't'sht r'hv tm'
verses.translation: whereas he himself had not done any of these things, for he hath even eaten upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbour’s wife,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָנִ֤י וְאֶבְיוֹן֙ הוֹנָ֔ה גְּזֵל֣וֹת גָּזָ֔ל חֲבֹ֖ל לֹ֣א יָשִׁ֑יב וְאֶל־הַגִּלּוּלִים֙ נָשָׂ֣א עֵינָ֔יו תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: 'ny v'byvn hvnh gzlvt gzl chbl l' yshyb v'lhglvlym nsh' 'ynyv tv'bh 'shh
verses.translation: hath wronged the poor and needy, hath taken by robbery, hath not restored the pledge, and hath lifted up his eyes to the idols, hath committed abomination,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּנֶּ֧שֶׁךְ נָתַ֛ן וְתַרְבִּ֥ית לָקַ֖ח וָחָ֑י לֹ֣א יִֽחְיֶ֗ה אֵ֣ת כׇּל־הַתּוֹעֵב֤וֹת הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ עָשָׂ֔ה מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת דָּמָ֖יו בּ֥וֹ יִֽהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: bnshkh ntn vtrbyt lqch vchy l' ychyh 't khlhtv'bvt h'lh 'shh mvt yvmt dmyv bv yhyh
verses.translation: hath given forth upon interest, and hath taken increase; shall he then live? he shall not live—he hath done all these abominations; he shall surely be put to death, his blood shall be upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה֙ הוֹלִ֣יד בֵּ֔ן וַיַּ֕רְא אֶת־כׇּל־חַטֹּ֥את אָבִ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה וַיִּרְאֶ֕ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה כָּהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: vhnh hvlyd bn vyr' 'tkhlcht't 'byv 'shr 'shh vyr'h vl' y'shh khhn
verses.translation: Now, lo, if he beget a son, that seeth all his father’s sins, which he hath done, and considereth, and doeth not such like,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־הֶהָרִים֙ לֹ֣א אָכָ֔ל וְעֵינָיו֙ לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֔א אֶל־גִּלּוּלֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֶת־אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖הוּ לֹ֥א טִמֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: 'lhhrym l' 'khl v'ynyv l' nsh' 'lglvly byt yshr'l 't'sht r'hv l' tm'
verses.translation: that hath not eaten upon the mountains, neither hath lifted up his eyes to the idols of the house of Israel, hath not defiled his neighbour’s wife,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִישׁ֙ לֹ֣א הוֹנָ֔ה חֲבֹל֙ לֹ֣א חָבָ֔ל וּגְזֵלָ֖ה לֹ֣א גָזָ֑ל לַחְמוֹ֙ לְרָעֵ֣ב נָתָ֔ן וְעֵר֖וֹם כִּסָּה־בָֽגֶד׃
verses.translit: v'ysh l' hvnh chbl l' chbl vgzlh l' gzl lchmv lr'b ntn v'rvm khshbgd
verses.translation: neither hath wronged any, hath not taken aught to pledge, neither hath taken by robbery, but hath given his bread to the hungry, and hath covered the naked with a garment,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵעָנִ֞י הֵשִׁ֣יב יָד֗וֹ נֶ֤שֶׁךְ וְתַרְבִּית֙ לֹ֣א לָקָ֔ח מִשְׁפָּטַ֣י עָשָׂ֔ה בְּחֻקּוֹתַ֖י הָלָ֑ךְ ה֗וּא לֹ֥א יָמ֛וּת בַּעֲוֺ֥ן אָבִ֖יו חָיֹ֥ה יִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: m'ny hshyb ydv nshkh vtrbyt l' lqch mshpty 'shh bchqvty hlkh hv' l' ymvt b'vn 'byv chyh ychyh
verses.translation: that hath withdrawn his hand from the poor, that hath not received interest nor increase, hath executed Mine ordinances, hath walked in My statutes; he shall not die for the iniquity of his father, he shall surely live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָבִ֞יו כִּֽי־עָ֣שַׁק עֹ֗שֶׁק גָּזַל֙ גֵּ֣זֶל אָ֔ח וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ט֛וֹב עָשָׂ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ עַמָּ֑יו וְהִנֵּה־מֵ֖ת בַּעֲוֺנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'byv khy'shq 'shq gzl gzl 'ch v'shr l'tvb 'shh btvkh 'myv vhnhmt b'vnv
verses.translation: As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, committed robbery on his brother, and did that which is not good among his people, behold, he dieth for his iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם מַדֻּ֛עַ לֹא־נָשָׂ֥א הַבֵּ֖ן בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הָאָ֑ב וְהַבֵּ֞ן מִשְׁפָּ֧ט וּצְדָקָ֣ה עָשָׂ֗ה אֵ֣ת כׇּל־חֻקּוֹתַ֥י שָׁמַ֛ר וַיַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם חָיֹ֥ה יִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mrtm md' l'nsh' hbn b'vn h'b vhbn mshpt vtsdqh 'shh 't khlchqvty shmr vy'shh 'tm chyh ychyh
verses.translation: Yet say ye: Why doth not the son bear the iniquity of the father with him? When the son hath done that which is lawful and right, and hath kept all My statutes, and hath done them, he shall surely live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַחֹטֵ֖את הִ֣יא תָמ֑וּת בֵּ֞ן לֹא־יִשָּׂ֣א  בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הָאָ֗ב וְאָב֙ לֹ֤א יִשָּׂא֙ בַּעֲוֺ֣ן הַבֵּ֔ן צִדְקַ֤ת הַצַּדִּיק֙ עָלָ֣יו תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְרִשְׁעַ֥ת (רשע) [הָרָשָׁ֖ע] עָלָ֥יו תִּֽהְיֶֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hnpsh hcht't hy' tmvt bn l'ysh'  b'vn h'b v'b l' ysh' b'vn hbn tsdqt htsdyq 'lyv thyh vrsh't (rsh') [hrsh'] 'lyv thyh {s}
verses.translation: The soul that sinneth, it shall die; the son shall not bear the iniquity of the father with him, neither shall the father bear the iniquity of the son with him; the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked shall be upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָרָשָׁ֗ע כִּ֤י יָשׁוּב֙ מִכׇּל־חַטֹּאתָו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְשָׁמַר֙ אֶת־כׇּל־חֻקּוֹתַ֔י וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָ֑ה חָיֹ֥ה יִֽחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vhrsh' khy yshvb mkhlcht'tv 'shr 'shh vshmr 'tkhlchqvty v'shh mshpt vtsdqh chyh ychyh l' ymvt
verses.translation: But if the wicked turn from all his sins that he hath committed, and keep all My statutes, and do that which is lawful and right, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־פְּשָׁעָיו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה לֹ֥א יִזָּכְר֖וּ ל֑וֹ בְּצִדְקָת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה יִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: khlpsh'yv 'shr 'shh l' yzkhrv lv btsdqtv 'shr'shh ychyh
verses.translation: None of his transgressions that he hath committed shall be remembered against him; for his righteousness that he hath done he shall live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶחָפֹ֤ץ אֶחְפֹּץ֙ מ֣וֹת רָשָׁ֔ע נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה הֲל֛וֹא בְּשׁוּב֥וֹ מִדְּרָכָ֖יו וְחָיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hchpts 'chpts mvt rsh' n'm 'dny yhvh hlv' bshvbv mdrkhyv vchyh {s}
verses.translation: Have I any pleasure at all that the wicked should die? saith the Lord GOD; and not rather that he should return from his ways, and live?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְשׁ֨וּב צַדִּ֤יק מִצִּדְקָתוֹ֙ וְעָ֣שָׂה עָ֔וֶל כְּכֹ֨ל הַתּוֹעֵב֜וֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֧ה הָרָשָׁ֛ע יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה וָחָ֑י כׇּל־צִדְקֹתָ֤ו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה֙ לֹ֣א תִזָּכַ֔רְנָה בְּמַעֲל֧וֹ אֲשֶׁר־מָעַ֛ל וּבְחַטָּאת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־חָטָ֖א בָּ֥ם יָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vbshvb tsdyq mtsdqtv v'shh 'vl khkhl htv'bvt 'shr'shh hrsh' y'shh vchy khltsdqtv 'shr'shh l' tzkhrnh bm'lv 'shrm'l vbcht'tv 'shrcht' bm ymvt
verses.translation: But when the righteous turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, and doeth according to all the abominations that the wicked man doeth, shall he live? None of his righteous deeds that he hath done shall be remembered; for his trespass that he trespassed, and for his sin that he hath sinned, for them shall he die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑י שִׁמְעוּ־נָא֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲדַרְכִּי֙ לֹ֣א יִתָּכֵ֔ן הֲלֹ֥א דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: v'mrtm l' ytkhn drkh 'dny shm'vn' byt yshr'l hdrkhy l' ytkhn hl' drkhykhm l' ytkhnv
verses.translation: Yet ye say: The way of the Lord is not equal. Hear now, O house of Israel: Is it My way that is not equal? is it not your ways that are unequal?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשׁוּב־צַדִּ֧יק מִצִּדְקָת֛וֹ וְעָ֥שָׂה עָ֖וֶל וּמֵ֣ת עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם בְּעַוְל֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה יָמֽוּת׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bshvbtsdyq mtsdqtv v'shh 'vl vmt 'lyhm b'vlv 'shr'shh ymvt {s}
verses.translation: When the righteous man turneth away from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall die therefor; for his iniquity that he hath done shall he die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְשׁ֣וּב רָשָׁ֗ע מֵֽרִשְׁעָתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וַיַּ֥עַשׂ מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָ֑ה ה֖וּא אֶת־נַפְשׁ֥וֹ יְחַיֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vbshvb rsh' mrsh'tv 'shr 'shh vy'sh mshpt vtsdqh hv' 'tnpshv ychyh
verses.translation: Again, when the wicked man turneth away from his wickedness that he hath committed, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall save his soul alive.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְאֶ֣ה (וישוב) [וַיָּ֔שׇׁב] מִכׇּל־פְּשָׁעָ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה חָי֥וֹ יִֽחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: vyr'h (vyshvb) [vyshb] mkhlpsh'yv 'shr 'shh chyv ychyh l' ymvt
verses.translation: Because he considereth, and turneth away from all his transgressions that he hath committed, he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑י הַדְּרָכַ֞י לֹ֤א יִתָּֽכְנוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֲלֹ֥א דַרְכֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵֽן׃
verses.translit: v'mrv byt yshr'l l' ytkhn drkh 'dny hdrkhy l' ytkhnv byt yshr'l hl' drkhykhm l' ytkhn
verses.translation: Yet saith the house of Israel: The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, is it My ways that are not equal? is it not your ways that are unequal?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ אִ֨ישׁ כִּדְרָכָ֜יו אֶשְׁפֹּ֤ט אֶתְכֶם֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה שׁ֤וּבוּ וְהָשִׁ֙יבוּ֙ מִכׇּל־פִּשְׁעֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם לְמִכְשׁ֖וֹל עָוֺֽן׃
verses.translit: lkhn 'ysh khdrkhyv 'shpt 'tkhm byt yshr'l n'm 'dny yhvh shvbv vhshybv mkhlpsh'ykhm vl'yhyh lkhm lmkhshvl 'vn
verses.translation: Therefore I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one according to his ways, saith the Lord GOD. Return ye, and turn yourselves from all your transgressions; so shall they not be a stumblingblock of iniquity unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְׁלִ֣יכוּ מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֗ם אֶת־כׇּל־פִּשְׁעֵיכֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פְּשַׁעְתֶּ֣ם בָּ֔ם וַעֲשׂ֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם לֵ֥ב חָדָ֖שׁ וְר֣וּחַ חֲדָשָׁ֑ה וְלָ֥מָּה תָמֻ֖תוּ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: hshlykhv m'lykhm 'tkhlpsh'ykhm 'shr psh'tm bm v'shv lkhm lb chdsh vrvch chdshh vlmh tmtv byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Cast away from you all your transgressions, wherein ye have transgressed; and make you a new heart and a new spirit; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א אֶחְפֹּץ֙ בְּמ֣וֹת הַמֵּ֔ת נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה וְהָשִׁ֖יבוּ וִֽחְיֽוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy l' 'chpts bmvt hmt n'm 'dny yhvh vhshybv vchyv {p}
verses.translation: For I have no pleasure in the death of him that dieth, saith the Lord GOD; wherefore turn yourselves, and live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּה֙ שָׂ֣א קִינָ֔ה אֶל־נְשִׂיאֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'th sh' qynh 'lnshy'y yshr'l
verses.translation: Moreover, take thou up a lamentation for the princes of Israel,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ מָ֤ה אִמְּךָ֙ לְבִיָּ֔א בֵּ֥ין אֲרָי֖וֹת רָבָ֑צָה בְּת֥וֹךְ כְּפִרִ֖ים רִבְּתָ֥ה גוּרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: v'mrt mh 'mkh lby' byn 'ryvt rbtsh btvkh khprym rbth gvryh
verses.translation: and say: How was thy mother a lioness; Among lions she couched, In the midst of the young lions She reared her whelps!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּ֛עַל אֶחָ֥ד מִגֻּרֶ֖יהָ כְּפִ֣יר הָיָ֑ה וַיִּלְמַ֥ד לִטְרׇף־טֶ֖רֶף אָדָ֥ם אָכָֽל׃
verses.translit: vt'l 'chd mgryh khpyr hyh vylmd ltrftrf 'dm 'khl
verses.translation: And she brought up one of her whelps, He became a young lion; And he learned to catch the prey, He devoured men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֥וּ אֵלָ֛יו גּוֹיִ֖ם בְּשַׁחְתָּ֣ם נִתְפָּ֑שׂ וַיְבִאֻ֥הוּ בַחַחִ֖ים אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vyshm'v 'lyv gvym bshchtm ntpsh vyb'hv bchchym 'l'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Then the nations assembled against him, He was taken in their pit; And they brought him with hooks Unto the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּ֙רֶא֙ כִּ֣י נֽוֹחֲלָ֔ה אָבְדָ֖ה תִּקְוָתָ֑הּ וַתִּקַּ֛ח אֶחָ֥ד מִגֻּרֶ֖יהָ כְּפִ֥יר שָׂמָֽתְהוּ׃
verses.translit: vtr' khy nvchlh 'bdh tqvth vtqch 'chd mgryh khpyr shmthv
verses.translation: Now when she saw that she was disappointed, And her hope was lost, Then she took another of her whelps, And made him a young lion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְהַלֵּ֥ךְ בְּתוֹךְ־אֲרָי֖וֹת כְּפִ֣יר הָיָ֑ה וַיִּלְמַ֥ד לִטְרׇף־טֶ֖רֶף אָדָ֥ם אָכָֽל׃
verses.translit: vythlkh btvkh'ryvt khpyr hyh vylmd ltrftrf 'dm 'khl
verses.translation: And he went up and down among the lions, He became a young lion; And he learned to catch the prey, He devoured men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֙דַע֙ אַלְמְנוֹתָ֔יו וְעָרֵיהֶ֖ם הֶחֱרִ֑יב וַתֵּ֤שַׁם אֶ֙רֶץ֙ וּמְלֹאָ֔הּ מִקּ֖וֹל שַׁאֲגָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyd' 'lmnvtyv v'ryhm hchryb vtshm 'rts vml'h mqvl sh'gtv
verses.translation: And he knew their castles, And laid waste their cities; And the land was desolate, And the fulness thereof, Because of the noise of his roaring.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ עָלָ֥יו גּוֹיִ֛ם סָבִ֖יב מִמְּדִינ֑וֹת וַֽיִּפְרְשׂ֥וּ עָלָ֛יו רִשְׁתָּ֖ם בְּשַׁחְתָּ֥ם נִתְפָּֽשׂ׃
verses.translit: vytnv 'lyv gvym sbyb mmdynvt vyprshv 'lyv rshtm bshchtm ntpsh
verses.translation: Then the nations cried out against him On every side from the provinces; And they spread their net over him, He was taken in their pit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֤הוּ בַסּ֙וּגַר֙ בַּחַחִ֔ים וַיְבִאֻ֖הוּ אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל יְבִאֻ֙הוּ֙ בַּמְּצֹד֔וֹת לְמַ֗עַן לֹא־יִשָּׁמַ֥ע קוֹל֛וֹ ע֖וֹד אֶל־הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vytnhv bsvgr bchchym vyb'hv 'lmlkh bbl yb'hv bmtsdvt lm'n l'yshm' qvlv 'vd 'lhry yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: And they put him in a cage with hooks, And brought him to the king of Babylon; That they might bring him into strongholds, So that his voice should no more be heard Upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִמְּךָ֥ כַגֶּ֛פֶן בְּדָמְךָ֖ עַל־מַ֣יִם שְׁתוּלָ֑ה פֹּֽרִיָּה֙ וַעֲנֵפָ֔ה הָיְתָ֖ה מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: 'mkh khgpn bdmkh 'lmym shtvlh pryh v'nph hyth mmym rbym
verses.translation: Thy mother was like a vine, in thy likeness, Planted by the waters; She was fruitful and full of branches By reason of many waters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ־לָ֞הּ מַטּ֣וֹת עֹ֗ז אֶל־שִׁבְטֵי֙ מֹֽשְׁלִ֔ים וַתִּגְבַּ֥הּ קוֹמָת֖וֹ עַל־בֵּ֣ין עֲבֹתִ֑ים וַיֵּרָ֣א בְגׇבְה֔וֹ בְּרֹ֖ב דָּלִיֹּתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyhyvlh mtvt 'z 'lshbty mshlym vtgbh qvmtv 'lbyn 'btym vyr' bgbhv brb dlytyv
verses.translation: And she had strong rods To be sceptres for them that bore rule; And her stature was exalted Among the thick branches, And she was seen in her height With the multitude of her tendrils.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֻּתַּ֤שׁ בְּחֵמָה֙ לָאָ֣רֶץ הֻשְׁלָ֔כָה וְר֥וּחַ הַקָּדִ֖ים הוֹבִ֣ישׁ פִּרְיָ֑הּ הִתְפָּרְק֧וּ וְיָבֵ֛שׁוּ מַטֵּ֥ה עֻזָּ֖הּ אֵ֥שׁ אֲכָלָֽתְהוּ׃
verses.translit: vttsh bchmh l'rts hshlkhh vrvch hqdym hvbysh pryh htprqv vybshv mth 'zh 'sh 'khlthv
verses.translation: But she was plucked up in fury, She was cast down to the ground, And the east wind dried up her fruit; Her strong rods were broken off and withered, The fire consumed her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה שְׁתוּלָ֣ה בַמִּדְבָּ֑ר בְּאֶ֖רֶץ צִיָּ֥ה וְצָמָֽא׃
verses.translit: v'th shtvlh bmdbr b'rts tsyh vtsm'
verses.translation: And now she is planted in the wilderness, In a dry and thirsty ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֵּצֵ֨א אֵ֜שׁ מִמַּטֵּ֤ה בַדֶּ֙יהָ֙ פִּרְיָ֣הּ אָכָ֔לָה וְלֹא־הָ֥יָה בָ֛הּ מַטֵּה־עֹ֖ז שֵׁ֣בֶט לִמְשׁ֑וֹל קִ֥ינָה הִ֖יא וַתְּהִ֥י לְקִינָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtts' 'sh mmth bdyh pryh 'khlh vl'hyh bh mth'z shbt lmshvl qynh hy' vthy lqynh {p}
verses.translation: And fire is gone out of the rod of her branches, It hath devoured her fruit, So that there is in her no strong rod To be a sceptre to rule.’ This is a lamentation, and it was for a lamentation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
