verses.translation: At Tehaphnehes also the day shall withdraw itself, When I shall break there the yokes of Egypt, And the pride of her power shall cease in her; As for her, a cloud shall cover her, And her daughters shall go into captivity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתִי שְׁפָטִ֖ים בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'shyty shptym bmtsrym vyd'v khy'ny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: Thus will I execute judgments in Egypt; And they shall know that I am the LORD.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה בָּרִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּשִׁבְעָ֣ה לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy b'cht 'shrh shnh br'shvn bshb'h lchdsh hyh dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, in the seventh day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם אֶת־זְר֛וֹעַ פַּרְעֹ֥ה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֖יִם שָׁבָ֑רְתִּי וְהִנֵּ֣ה לֹֽא־חֻ֠בְּשָׁ֠ה לָתֵ֨ת רְפֻא֜וֹת לָשׂ֥וּם חִתּ֛וּל לְחׇבְשָׁ֥הּ לְחׇזְקָ֖הּ לִתְפֹּ֥שׂ בֶּחָֽרֶב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bn'dm 'tzrv' pr'h mlkhmtsrym shbrty vhnh l'chbshh ltt rp'vt lshvm chtvl lchbshh lchzqh ltpsh bchrb {s}
verses.translation: ’Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and, lo, it hath not been bound up to be healed, to put a roller, that it be bound up and wax strong, that it hold the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה הִנְנִי֙ אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֔יִם וְשָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־זְרֹ֣עֹתָ֔יו אֶת־הַחֲזָקָ֖ה וְאֶת־הַנִּשְׁבָּ֑רֶת וְהִפַּלְתִּ֥י אֶת־הַחֶ֖רֶב מִיָּדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr  'dny yhvh hnny 'lpr'h mlkhmtsrym vshbrty 'tzr'tyv 'thchzqh v'thnshbrt vhplty 'thchrb mydv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and will break his arms, the strong, and that which was broken; and I will cause the sword to fall out of his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲפִצוֹתִ֥י אֶת־מִצְרַ֖יִם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וְזֵרִיתִ֖ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vhptsvty 'tmtsrym bgvym vzrytm b'rtsvt
verses.translation: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and will disperse them through the countries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחִזַּקְתִּ֗י אֶת־זְרֹעוֹת֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־חַרְבִּ֖י בְּיָד֑וֹ וְשָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־זְרֹע֣וֹת פַּרְעֹ֔ה וְנָאַ֛ק נַאֲק֥וֹת חָלָ֖ל לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vchzqty 'tzr'vt mlkh bbl vntty 'tchrby bydv vshbrty 'tzr'vt pr'h vn'q n'qvt chll lpnyv
verses.translation: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put My sword in his hand; but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he shall groan before him with the groanings of a deadly wounded man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַחֲזַקְתִּ֗י אֶת־זְרֹעוֹת֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וּזְרֹע֥וֹת פַּרְעֹ֖ה תִּפֹּ֑לְנָה וְֽיָדְע֞וּ כִּי־אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה בְּתִתִּ֤י חַרְבִּי֙ בְּיַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֔ל וְנָטָ֥ה אוֹתָ֖הּ אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vhchzqty 'tzr'vt mlkh bbl vzr'vt pr'h tplnh vyd'v khy'ny yhvh btty chrby byd mlkhbbl vnth 'vth 'l'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: And I will hold up the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharaoh shall fall down; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I shall put My sword into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out upon the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲפִצוֹתִ֤י אֶת־מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וְזֵרִיתִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם בָּאֲרָצ֑וֹת וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhptsvty 'tmtsrym bgvym vzryty 'vtm b'rtsvt vyd'v khy'ny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations, and disperse them through the countries; and they shall know that I am the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּאַחַ֤ת עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה בַּשְּׁלִישִׁ֖י בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy b'cht 'shrh shnh bshlyshy b'chd lchdsh hyh dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם אֱמֹ֛ר אֶל־פַּרְעֹ֥ה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֖יִם וְאֶל־הֲמוֹנ֑וֹ אֶל־מִ֖י דָּמִ֥יתָ בְגׇדְלֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: bn'dm 'mr 'lpr'h mlkhmtsrym v'lhmvnv 'lmy dmyt bgdlkh
verses.translation: ’Son of man, say unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to his multitude: Whom art thou like in thy greatness?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה אַשּׁ֜וּר אֶ֣רֶז בַּלְּבָנ֗וֹן יְפֵ֥ה עָנָ֛ף וְחֹ֥רֶשׁ מֵצַ֖ל וּגְבַ֣הּ קוֹמָ֑ה וּבֵ֣ין עֲבֹתִ֔ים הָיְתָ֖ה צַמַּרְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hnh 'shvr 'rz blbnvn yph 'nf vchrsh mtsl vgbh qvmh vbyn 'btym hyth tsmrtv
verses.translation: Behold, the Assyrian was a cedar in Lebanon, With fair branches, and with a shadowing shroud, And of a high stature; And its top was among the thick boughs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַ֣יִם גִּדְּל֔וּהוּ תְּה֖וֹם רֹמְמָ֑תְהוּ אֶת־נַהֲרֹתֶ֗יהָ הֹלֵךְ֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת מַטָּעָ֔הּ וְאֶת־תְּעָלֹתֶ֣יהָ שִׁלְחָ֔ה אֶ֖ל כׇּל־עֲצֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: mym gdlvhv thvm rmmthv 'tnhrtyh hlkh sbybvt mt'h v'tt'ltyh shlchh 'l khl'tsy hshdh
verses.translation: The waters nourished it, The deep made it to grow; Her rivers ran round About her plantation, And she sent out her conduits Unto all the trees of the field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּן֙ גָּבְהָ֣א קֹמָת֔וֹ מִכֹּ֖ל עֲצֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וַתִּרְבֶּ֨ינָה סַֽרְעַפֹּתָ֜יו וַתֶּאֱרַ֧כְנָה פֹארֹתָ֛ו מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּ֖ים בְּשַׁלְּחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn gbh' qmtv mkhl 'tsy hshdh vtrbynh sr'ptyv vt'rkhnh p'rtv mmym rbym bshlchv
verses.translation: Therefore its stature was exalted Above all the trees of the field; And its boughs were multiplied, And its branches became long, Because of the multitude of waters, when it shot them forth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּסְעַפֹּתָ֤יו קִֽנְנוּ֙ כׇּל־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְתַ֤חַת פֹּֽארֹתָיו֙ יָֽלְד֔וּ כֹּ֖ל חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה וּבְצִלּוֹ֙ יֵֽשְׁב֔וּ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיִ֥ם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: bs'ptyv qnnv khl'vf hshmym vtcht p'rtyv yldv khl chyt hshdh vbtslv yshbv khl gvym rbym
verses.translation: All the fowls of heaven made Their nests in its boughs, And all the beasts of the field did bring forth their young Under its branches, And under its shadow dwelt All great nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְּיִ֣ף בְּגׇדְל֔וֹ בְּאֹ֖רֶךְ דָּלִיּוֹתָ֑יו כִּֽי־הָיָ֥ה שׇׁרְשׁ֖וֹ אֶל־מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyyf bgdlv b'rkh dlyvtyv khyhyh shrshv 'lmym rbym
verses.translation: Thus was it fair in its greatness, In the length of its branches; For its root was By many waters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲרָזִ֣ים לֹֽא־עֲמָמֻ֘הוּ֮ בְּגַן־אֱלֹהִים֒ בְּרוֹשִׁ֗ים לֹ֤א דָמוּ֙ אֶל־סְעַפֹּתָ֔יו וְעַרְמֹנִ֥ים לֹא־הָי֖וּ כְּפֹרֹאתָ֑יו כׇּל־עֵץ֙ בְּגַן־אֱלֹהִ֔ים לֹא־דָמָ֥ה אֵלָ֖יו בְּיׇפְיֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'rzym l''mmhv bgn'lhym brvshym l' dmv 'ls'ptyv v'rmnym l'hyv khpr'tyv khl'ts bgn'lhym l'dmh 'lyv bypyv
verses.translation: The cedars in the garden of God Could not hide it; The cypress-trees were not Like its boughs, And the plane-trees were not As its branches; Nor was any tree in the garden of God Like unto it in its beauty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָפֶ֣ה עֲשִׂיתִ֔יו בְּרֹ֖ב דָּלִיּוֹתָ֑יו וַיְקַנְאֻ֙הוּ֙ כׇּל־עֲצֵי־עֵ֔דֶן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּגַ֥ן הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yph 'shytyv brb dlyvtyv vyqn'hv khl'tsy'dn 'shr bgn h'lhym {p}
verses.translation: I made it fair By the multitude of its branches; So that all the trees of Eden, That were in the garden of God, envied it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה יַ֕עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּבַ֖הְתָּ בְּקוֹמָ֑ה וַיִּתֵּ֤ן צַמַּרְתּוֹ֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ין עֲבוֹתִ֔ים וְרָ֥ם לְבָב֖וֹ בְּגׇבְהֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n 'shr gbht bqvmh vytn tsmrtv 'lbyn 'bvtym vrm lbbv bgbhv
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: Because thou art exalted in stature, and he hath set his top among the thick boughs, and his heart is lifted up in his height;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶ֨תְּנֵ֔הוּ בְּיַ֖ד אֵ֣יל גּוֹיִ֑ם עָשׂ֤וֹ יַֽעֲשֶׂה֙ ל֔וֹ כְּרִשְׁע֖וֹ גֵּרַשְׁתִּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: v'tnhv byd 'yl gvym 'shv y'shh lv khrsh'v grshthv
verses.translation: I do even deliver him into the hand of the mighty one of the nations; he shall surely deal with him; I do drive him out according to his wickedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּכְרְתֻ֧הוּ זָרִ֛ים עָרִיצֵ֥י גוֹיִ֖ם וַֽיִּטְּשֻׁ֑הוּ אֶל־הֶ֠הָרִ֠ים וּבְכׇל־גֵּ֨אָי֜וֹת נָפְל֣וּ דָלִיּוֹתָ֗יו וַתִּשָּׁבַ֤רְנָה פֹֽרֹאתָיו֙ בְּכֹל֙ אֲפִיקֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיֵּרְד֧וּ מִצִּלּ֛וֹ כׇּל־עַמֵּ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ וַֽיִּטְּשֻֽׁהוּ׃
verses.translit: vykhrthv zrym 'rytsy gvym vytshhv 'lhhrym vbkhlg'yvt nplv dlyvtyv vtshbrnh pr'tyv bkhl 'pyqy h'rts vyrdv mtslv khl'my h'rts vytshhv
verses.translation: And strangers, the terrible of the nations, do cut him off, and cast him down; upon the mountains and in all the valleys his branches are fallen, and his boughs lie broken in all the channels of the land; and all the peoples of the earth do go down from his shadow, and do leave him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־מַפַּלְתּ֥וֹ יִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ כׇּל־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְאֶל־פֹּרֹאתָ֣יו הָי֔וּ כֹּ֖ל חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lmpltv yshkhnv khl'vf hshmym v'lpr'tyv hyv khl chyt hshdh
verses.translation: Upon his carcass all the fowls of the heaven do dwell, and upon his branches are all the beasts of the field;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ לֹא־יִגְבְּה֨וּ בְקוֹמָתָ֜ם כׇּל־עֲצֵי־מַ֗יִם וְלֹֽא־יִתְּנ֤וּ אֶת־צַמַּרְתָּם֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ין עֲבֹתִ֔ים וְלֹֽא־יַעַמְד֧וּ אֵלֵיהֶ֛ם בְּגׇבְהָ֖ם כׇּל־שֹׁ֣תֵי מָ֑יִם כִּֽי־כֻלָּם֩ נִתְּנ֨וּ לַמָּ֜וֶת אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֗ית בְּת֛וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָ֖ם אֶל־י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lm'n 'shr l'ygbhv bqvmtm khl'tsymym vl'ytnv 'ttsmrtm 'lbyn 'btym vl'y'mdv 'lyhm bgbhm khlshty mym khykhlm ntnv lmvt 'l'rts tchtyt btvkh bny 'dm 'lyvrdy bvr {p}
verses.translation: to the end that none of all the trees by the waters exalt themselves in their stature, neither set their top among the thick boughs, nor that their mighty ones stand up in their height, even all that drink water; for they are all delivered unto death, to the nether parts of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה בְּי֨וֹם רִדְתּ֤וֹ שְׁא֙וֹלָה֙ הֶאֱבַ֜לְתִּי כִּסֵּ֤תִי עָלָיו֙ אֶת־תְּה֔וֹם וָֽאֶמְנַע֙ נַהֲרוֹתֶ֔יהָ וַיִּכָּלְא֖וּ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וָאַקְדִּ֤ר עָלָיו֙ לְבָנ֔וֹן וְכׇל־עֲצֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה עָלָ֥יו עֻלְפֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: khh'mr 'dny yhvh byvm rdtv sh'vlh h'blty khsty 'lyv 'tthvm v'mn' nhrvtyh vykhl'v mym rbym v'qdr 'lyv lbnvn vkhl'tsy hshdh 'lyv 'lph
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: In the day when he went down to the nether-world I caused the deep to mourn and cover itself for him, and I restrained the rivers thereof, and the great waters were stayed; and I caused Lebanon to mourn for him, and all the trees of the field fainted for him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקּ֤וֹל מַפַּלְתּוֹ֙ הִרְעַ֣שְׁתִּי גוֹיִ֔ם בְּהוֹרִדִ֥י אֹת֛וֹ שְׁא֖וֹלָה אֶת־י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֑וֹר וַיִּנָּ֨חֲמ֜וּ בְּאֶ֤רֶץ תַּחְתִּית֙ כׇּל־עֲצֵי־עֵ֔דֶן מִבְחַ֥ר וְטוֹב־לְבָנ֖וֹן כׇּל־שֹׁ֥תֵי מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: mqvl mpltv hr'shty gvym bhvrdy 'tv sh'vlh 'tyvrdy bvr vynchmv b'rts tchtyt khl'tsy'dn mbchr vtvblbnvn khlshty mym
verses.translation: I made the nations to shake at the sound of his fall, when I cast him down to the nether-world with them that descend into the pit; and all the trees of Eden, the choice and best of Lebanon, all that drink water, were comforted in the nether parts of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־הֵ֗ם אִתּ֛וֹ יָרְד֥וּ שְׁא֖וֹלָה אֶל־חַלְלֵי־חָ֑רֶב וּזְרֹע֛וֹ יָשְׁב֥וּ בְצִלּ֖וֹ בְּת֥וֹךְ גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: gmhm 'tv yrdv sh'vlh 'lchllychrb vzr'v yshbv btslv btvkh gvym
verses.translation: They also went down into the nether-world with him unto them that are slain by the sword; yea, they that were in his arm, that dwelt under his shadow in the midst of the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶל־מִ֨י דָמִ֥יתָ כָּ֛כָה בְּכָב֥וֹד וּבְגֹ֖דֶל בַּעֲצֵי־עֵ֑דֶן וְהוּרַדְתָּ֨ אֶת־עֲצֵי־עֵ֜דֶן אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ תַּחְתִּ֗ית בְּת֨וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֤ים תִּשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת־חַלְלֵי־חֶ֔רֶב ה֤וּא פַרְעֹה֙ וְכׇל־הֲמוֹנֹ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lmy dmyt khkhh bkhbvd vbgdl b'tsy'dn vhvrdt 't'tsy'dn 'l'rts tchtyt btvkh 'rlym tshkhb 'tchllychrb hv' pr'h vkhlhmvnh n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: To whom art thou thus like in glory and in greatness among the trees of Eden? yet shall thou be brought down with the trees of Eden unto the nether parts of the earth; thou shalt lie in the midst of the uncircumcised, with them that are slain by the sword. This is Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה בִּשְׁנֵֽי־עָשָׂ֥ר חֹ֖דֶשׁ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy bshty 'shrh shnh bshny'shr chdsh b'chd lchdsh hyh dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, in the first day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם שָׂ֤א קִינָה֙ עַל־פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַ֔יִם וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֔יו כְּפִ֥יר גּוֹיִ֖ם נִדְמֵ֑יתָ וְאַתָּה֙ כַּתַּנִּ֣ים בַּיַּמִּ֔ים וַתָּ֣גַח בְּנַהֲרוֹתֶ֗יךָ וַתִּדְלַח־מַ֙יִם֙ בְּרַגְלֶ֔יךָ וַתִּרְפֹּ֖ס נַהֲרוֹתָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bn'dm sh' qynh 'lpr'h mlkhmtsrym v'mrt 'lyv khpyr gvym ndmyt v'th khtnym bymym vtgch bnhrvtykh vtdlchmym brglykh vtrps nhrvtm {s}
verses.translation: ’Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say unto him: Thou didst liken thyself unto a young lion of the nations; Whereas thou art as a dragon in the seas; And thou didst gush forth with thy rivers, And didst trouble the waters with thy feet, And foul their rivers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה וּפָרַשְׂתִּ֤י עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־רִשְׁתִּ֔י בִּקְהַ֖ל עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְהֶעֱל֖וּךָ בְּחֶרְמִֽי׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh vprshty 'lykh 'trshty bqhl 'mym rbym vh'lvkh bchrmy
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: I will therefore spread out My net over thee With a company of many peoples; And they shall bring thee up in My net.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְטַשְׁתִּ֣יךָ בָאָ֔רֶץ עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה אֲטִילֶ֑ךָ וְהִשְׁכַּנְתִּ֤י עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ כׇּל־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְהִשְׂבַּעְתִּ֥י מִמְּךָ֖ חַיַּ֥ת כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vntshtykh b'rts 'lpny hshdh 'tylkh vhshkhnty 'lykh khl'vf hshmym vhshb'ty mmkh chyt khlh'rts
verses.translation: And I will cast thee upon the land, I will hurl thee upon the open field, And will cause all the fowls of the heaven to settle upon thee, And I will fill the beasts of the whole earth with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־בְּשָׂרְךָ֖ עַל־הֶהָרִ֑ים וּמִלֵּאתִ֥י הַגֵּאָי֖וֹת רָמוּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vntty 'tbshrkh 'lhhrym vml'ty hg'yvt rmvtkh
verses.translation: And I will lay thy flesh upon the mountains, And fill the valleys with thy foulness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁקֵיתִ֨י אֶ֧רֶץ צָפָֽתְךָ֛ מִדָּמְךָ֖ אֶל־הֶהָרִ֑ים וַאֲפִקִ֖ים יִמָּלְא֥וּן מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: vhshqyty 'rts tsptkh mdmkh 'lhhrym v'pqym yml'vn mmkh
verses.translation: I will also water with thy blood the land wherein thou swimmest, even to the mountains; And the channels shall be full of thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִסֵּיתִ֤י בְכַבּֽוֹתְךָ֙ שָׁמַ֔יִם וְהִקְדַּרְתִּ֖י אֶת־כֹּֽכְבֵיהֶ֑ם שֶׁ֚מֶשׁ בֶּעָנָ֣ן אֲכַסֶּ֔נּוּ וְיָרֵ֖חַ לֹא־יָאִ֥יר אוֹרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vkhsyty bkhbvtkh shmym vhqdrty 'tkhkhbyhm shmsh b'nn 'khsnv vyrch l'y'yr 'vrv
verses.translation: And when I shall extinguish thee, I will cover the heaven, And make the stars thereof black; I will cover the sun with a cloud, And the moon shall not give her light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־מְא֤וֹרֵי אוֹר֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם אַקְדִּירֵ֖ם עָלֶ֑יךָ וְנָתַ֤תִּֽי חֹ֙שֶׁךְ֙ עַֽל־אַרְצְךָ֔ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: khlm'vry 'vr bshmym 'qdyrm 'lykh vntty chshkh 'l'rtskh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: All the bright lights of heaven Will I make black over thee, And set darkness upon thy land, Saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִ֨כְעַסְתִּ֔י לֵ֖ב עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים בַּהֲבִיאִ֤י שִׁבְרְךָ֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם עַל־אֲרָצ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יְדַעְתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vhkh'sty lb 'mym rbym bhby'y shbrkh bgvym 'l'rtsvt 'shr l'yd'tm
verses.translation: I will also vex the hearts of many peoples, when I shall bring thy destruction among the nations, into the countries which thou hast not known.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִ֨י עָלֶ֜יךָ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וּמַלְכֵיהֶם֙ יִשְׂעֲר֤וּ עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ שַׂ֔עַר בְּעוֹפְפִ֥י חַרְבִּ֖י עַל־פְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְחָרְד֤וּ לִרְגָעִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְנַפְשׁ֔וֹ בְּי֖וֹם מַפַּלְתֶּֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhshmvty 'lykh 'mym rbym vmlkhyhm ysh'rv 'lykh sh'r b'vppy chrby 'lpnyhm vchrdv lrg'ym 'ysh lnpshv byvm mpltkh {p}
verses.translation: Yea, I will make many peoples appalled at thee, and their kings shall be horribly afraid for thee, when I shall brandish My sword before them; and they shall tremble at every moment, every man for his own life, in the day of thy fall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה חֶ֥רֶב מֶלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל תְּבוֹאֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh chrb mlkhbbl tbv'kh
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD: The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּחַרְב֤וֹת גִּבּוֹרִים֙ אַפִּ֣יל הֲמוֹנֶ֔ךָ עָרִיצֵ֥י גוֹיִ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑ם וְשָֽׁדְדוּ֙ אֶת־גְּא֣וֹן מִצְרַ֔יִם וְנִשְׁמַ֖ד כׇּל־הֲמוֹנָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: bchrbvt gbvrym 'pyl hmvnkh 'rytsy gvym khlm vshddv 'tg'vn mtsrym vnshmd khlhmvnh
verses.translation: By the swords of the mighty will I cause thy multitude to fall; The terrible of the nations are they all; And they shall spoil the pride of Egypt, And all the multitude thereof shall be destroyed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַֽאֲבַדְתִּי֙ אֶת־כׇּל־בְּהֶמְתָּ֔הּ מֵעַ֖ל מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְלֹ֨א תִדְלָחֵ֤ם רֶֽגֶל־אָדָם֙ ע֔וֹד וּפַרְס֥וֹת בְּהֵמָ֖ה לֹ֥א תִדְלָחֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vh'bdty 'tkhlbhmth m'l mym rbym vl' tdlchm rgl'dm 'vd vprsvt bhmh l' tdlchm
verses.translation: I will destroy also all the beasts thereof From beside many waters; Neither shall the foot of man trouble them any more, Nor the hoofs of beasts trouble them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֚ז אַשְׁקִ֣יעַ מֵימֵיהֶ֔ם וְנַהֲרוֹתָ֖ם כַּשֶּׁ֣מֶן אוֹלִ֑יךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: 'z 'shqy' mymyhm vnhrvtm khshmn 'vlykh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Then will I make their waters to settle, And cause their rivers to run like oil, Saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּתִתִּי֩ אֶת־אֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם שְׁמָמָ֣ה וּנְשַׁמָּ֗ה אֶ֚רֶץ מִמְּלֹאָ֔הּ בְּהַכּוֹתִ֖י אֶת־כׇּל־י֣וֹשְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: btty 't'rts mtsrym shmmh vnshmh 'rts mml'h bhkhvty 'tkhlyvshby bh vyd'v khy'ny yhvh
verses.translation: When I shall make the land of Egypt desolate and waste, A land destitute of that whereof it was full, When I shall smite all them that dwell therein, Then shall they know that I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קִינָ֥ה הִיא֙ וְק֣וֹנְנ֔וּהָ בְּנ֥וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֖ם תְּקוֹנֵ֣נָּה אוֹתָ֑הּ עַל־מִצְרַ֤יִם וְעַל־כׇּל־הֲמוֹנָהּ֙ תְּקוֹנֵ֣נָּה אוֹתָ֔הּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: qynh hy' vqvnnvh bnvt hgvym tqvnnh 'vth 'lmtsrym v'lkhlhmvnh tqvnnh 'vth n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: This is the lamentation wherewith they shall lament; The daughters of the nations shall lament therewith; For Egypt, and for all her multitude, shall they lament therewith, Saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy bshty 'shrh shnh bchmshh 'shr lchdsh hyh dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: It came to pass also in the twelfth year, in the fifteenth day of the month, that the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם נְהֵ֛ה עַל־הֲמ֥וֹן מִצְרַ֖יִם וְהוֹרִדֵ֑הוּ א֠וֹתָ֠הּ וּבְנ֨וֹת גּוֹיִ֧ם אַדִּרִ֛ם אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ תַּחְתִּיּ֖וֹת אֶת־י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: bn'dm nhh 'lhmvn mtsrym vhvrdhv 'vth vbnvt gvym 'drm 'l'rts tchtyvt 'tyvrdy bvr
verses.translation: ’Son of man, wail for the multitude of Egypt, and cast them down, even her, with the daughters of the mighty nations, unto the nether parts of the earth, with them that go down into the pit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִמִּ֖י נָעָ֑מְתָּ רְדָ֥ה וְהׇשְׁכְּבָ֖ה אֶת־עֲרֵלִֽים׃
verses.translit: mmy n'mt rdh vhshkhbh 't'rlym
verses.translation: Whom dost thou pass in beauty? Go down, and be thou laid with the uncircumcised.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּת֥וֹךְ חַלְלֵי־חֶ֖רֶב יִפֹּ֑לוּ חֶ֣רֶב נִתָּ֔נָה מׇשְׁכ֥וּ אוֹתָ֖הּ וְכׇל־הֲמוֹנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: btvkh chllychrb yplv chrb ntnh mshkhv 'vth vkhlhmvnyh
verses.translation: They shall fall in the midst of them that are slain by the sword; she is delivered to the sword; draw her down and all her multitudes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְדַבְּרוּ־ל֞וֹ אֵלֵ֧י גִבּוֹרִ֛ים מִתּ֥וֹךְ שְׁא֖וֹל אֶת־עֹֽזְרָ֑יו יָ֥רְד֛וּ שָׁכְב֥וּ הָעֲרֵלִ֖ים חַלְלֵי־חָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: ydbrvlv 'ly gbvrym mtvkh sh'vl 't'zryv yrdv shkhbv h'rlym chllychrb
verses.translation: The strong among the mighty shall speak of him out of the midst of the nether-world with them that helped him; they are gone down, they lie still, even the uncircumcised, slain by the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם אַשּׁוּר֙ וְכׇל־קְהָלָ֔הּ סְבִיבוֹתָ֖יו קִבְרֹתָ֑יו כֻּלָּ֣ם חֲלָלִ֔ים הַנֹּפְלִ֖ים בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: shm 'shvr vkhlqhlh sbybvtyv qbrtyv khlm chllym hnplym bchrb
verses.translation: Asshur is there and all her company; their graves are round about them; all of them slain, fallen by the sword;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִתְּנ֤וּ קִבְרֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ בְּיַרְכְּתֵי־ב֔וֹר וַיְהִ֣י קְהָלָ֔הּ סְבִיב֖וֹת קְבֻרָתָ֑הּ כֻּלָּ֤ם חֲלָלִים֙ נֹפְלִ֣ים בַּחֶ֔רֶב אֲשֶׁר־נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּ֖ית בְּאֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: 'shr ntnv qbrtyh byrkhtybvr vyhy qhlh sbybvt qbrth khlm chllym nplym bchrb 'shrntnv chtyt b'rts chyym
verses.translation: whose graves are set in the uttermost parts of the pit, and her company is round about her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who caused terror in the land of the living.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם עֵילָם֙ וְכׇל־הֲמוֹנָ֔הּ סְבִיב֖וֹת קְבֻרָתָ֑הּ כֻּלָּ֣ם חֲלָלִים֩ הַנֹּפְלִ֨ים בַּחֶ֜רֶב אֲֽשֶׁר־יָרְד֥וּ עֲרֵלִ֣ים  אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ תַּחְתִּיּ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתְנ֤וּ חִתִּיתָם֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֔ים וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ כְלִמָּתָ֖ם אֶת־י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: shm 'ylm vkhlhmvnh sbybvt qbrth khlm chllym hnplym bchrb 'shryrdv 'rlym  'l'rts tchtyvt 'shr ntnv chtytm b'rts chyym vysh'v khlmtm 'tyvrdy bvr
verses.translation: There is Elam and all her multitude round about her grave; all of them slain, fallen by the sword, who are gone down uncircumcised into the nether parts of the earth, who caused their terror in the land of the living; yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּת֣וֹךְ חֲ֠לָלִ֠ים נָתְנ֨וּ מִשְׁכָּ֥ב לָהּ֙ בְּכׇל־הֲמוֹנָ֔הּ סְבִיבוֹתָ֖יו קִבְרֹתֶ֑הָ כֻּלָּ֣ם עֲרֵלִ֣ים חַלְלֵי־חֶ֡רֶב כִּֽי־נִתַּ֨ן חִתִּיתָ֜ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֗ים וַיִּשְׂא֤וּ כְלִמָּתָם֙ אֶת־י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֔וֹר בְּת֥וֹךְ חֲלָלִ֖ים נִתָּֽן׃
verses.translit: btvkh chllym ntnv mshkhb lh bkhlhmvnh sbybvtyv qbrth khlm 'rlym chllychrb khyntn chtytm b'rts chyym vysh'v khlmtm 'tyvrdy bvr btvkh chllym ntn
verses.translation: They have set her a bed in the midst of the slain with all her multitude; her graves are round about them; all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; because their terror was caused in the land of the living, yet have they borne their shame with them that go down to the pit; they are put in the midst of them that are slain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֣ם מֶ֤שֶׁךְ תֻּבַל֙ וְכׇל־הֲמוֹנָ֔הּ סְבִיבוֹתָ֖יו קִבְרוֹתֶ֑יהָ כֻּלָּ֤ם עֲרֵלִים֙ מְחֻ֣לְלֵי חֶ֔רֶב כִּי־נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּיתָ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: shm mshkh tbl vkhlhmvnh sbybvtyv qbrvtyh khlm 'rlym mchlly chrb khyntnv chtytm b'rts chyym
verses.translation: There is Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude; her graves are round about them; all of them uncircumcised, slain by the sword; because they caused their terror in the land of the living.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א יִשְׁכְּבוּ֙ אֶת־גִּבּוֹרִ֔ים נֹפְלִ֖ים מֵעֲרֵלִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָרְדֽוּ־שְׁא֣וֹל בִּכְלֵֽי־מִלְחַמְתָּם֩ וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֶת־חַרְבוֹתָ֜ם תַּ֣חַת רָאשֵׁיהֶ֗ם וַתְּהִ֤י עֲוֺֽנֹתָם֙ עַל־עַצְמוֹתָ֔ם כִּֽי־חִתִּ֥ית גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים בְּאֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vl' yshkhbv 'tgbvrym nplym m'rlym 'shr yrdvsh'vl bkhlymlchmtm vytnv 'tchrbvtm tcht r'shyhm vthy 'vntm 'l'tsmvtm khychtyt gbvrym b'rts chyym
verses.translation: And they that are inferior to the uncircumcised shall not lie with the mighty that are gone down to the nether-world with their weapons of war, whose swords are laid under their heads, and whose iniquities are upon their bones; because the terror of the mighty was in the land of the living.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה בְּת֧וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֛ים תִּשָּׁבַ֥ר וְתִשְׁכַּ֖ב אֶת־חַלְלֵי־חָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: v'th btvkh 'rlym tshbr vtshkhb 'tchllychrb
verses.translation: But thou, in the midst of the uncircumcised shalt thou be broken and lie, even with them that are slain by the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֣מָּה אֱד֗וֹם מְלָכֶ֙יהָ֙ וְכׇל־נְשִׂיאֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁר־נִתְּנ֥וּ בִגְבוּרָתָ֖ם אֶת־חַלְלֵי־חָ֑רֶב הֵ֛מָּה אֶת־עֲרֵלִ֥ים יִשְׁכָּ֖בוּ וְאֶת־יֹ֥רְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: shmh 'dvm mlkhyh vkhlnshy'yh 'shrntnv bgbvrtm 'tchllychrb hmh 't'rlym yshkhbv v'tyrdy bvr
verses.translation: There is Edom, her kings and all her princes, who for all their might are laid with them that are slain by the sword; they shall lie with the uncircumcised, and with them that go down to the pit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֣מָּה נְסִיכֵ֥י צָפ֛וֹן כֻּלָּ֖ם וְכׇל־צִדֹנִ֑י אֲשֶׁר־יָרְד֣וּ אֶת־חֲלָלִ֗ים בְּחִתִּיתָ֤ם מִגְֿבֽוּרָתָם֙ בּוֹשִׁ֔ים וַיִּשְׁכְּב֤וּ עֲרֵלִים֙ אֶת־חַלְלֵי־חֶ֔רֶב וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ כְלִמָּתָ֖ם אֶת־י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: shmh nsykhy tspvn khlm vkhltsdny 'shryrdv 'tchllym bchtytm mgbvrtm bvshym vyshkhbv 'rlym 'tchllychrb vysh'v khlmtm 'tyvrdy bvr
verses.translation: There are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Zidonians, who are gone down with the slain, ashamed for all the terror which they caused by their might, and they lie uncircumcised with them that are slain by the sword, and bear their shame with them that go down to the pit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹתָם֙ יִרְאֶ֣ה פַרְעֹ֔ה וְנִחַ֖ם עַל־כׇּל־הֲמוֹנֹ֑ה חַלְלֵי־חֶ֙רֶב֙ פַּרְעֹ֣ה וְכׇל־חֵיל֔וֹ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: 'vtm yr'h pr'h vnchm 'lkhlhmvnh chllychrb pr'h vkhlchylv n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: These shall Pharaoh see, and shall be comforted over all his multitude; even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־[חִתִּיתִ֖י] (חתיתו) בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֑ים וְהֻשְׁכַּב֩ בְּת֨וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֜ים אֶת־חַלְלֵי־חֶ֗רֶב פַּרְעֹה֙ וְכׇל־הֲמוֹנֹ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khyntty 't[chtyty] (chtytv) b'rts chyym vhshkhb btvkh 'rlym 'tchllychrb pr'h vkhlhmvnh n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: For I have put My terror in the land of the living; and he shall be laid in the midst of the uncircumcised, with them that are slain by the sword, even Pharaoh and all his multitude, saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶל־בְּנֵֽי־עַמְּךָ֙ וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֶ֕רֶץ כִּֽי־אָבִ֥יא עָלֶ֖יהָ חָ֑רֶב וְלָקְח֨וּ עַם־הָאָ֜רֶץ אִ֤ישׁ אֶחָד֙ מִקְצֵיהֶ֔ם וְנָתְנ֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ לָהֶ֖ם לְצֹפֶֽה׃
verses.translit: bn'dm dbr 'lbny'mkh v'mrt 'lyhm 'rts khy'by' 'lyh chrb vlqchv 'mh'rts 'ysh 'chd mqtsyhm vntnv 'tv lhm ltsph
verses.translation: ’Son of man, speak to the children of thy people, and say unto them: When I bring the sword upon a land, if the people of the land take a man from among them, and set him for their watchman;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאָ֥ה אֶת־הַחֶ֖רֶב בָּאָ֣ה עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְתָקַ֥ע בַּשּׁוֹפָ֖ר וְהִזְהִ֥יר אֶת־הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vr'h 'thchrb b'h 'lh'rts vtq' bshvpr vhzhyr 'th'm
verses.translation: if, when he seeth the sword come upon the land, he blow the horn, and warn the people;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁמַ֨ע הַשֹּׁמֵ֜עַ אֶת־ק֤וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָר֙ וְלֹ֣א נִזְהָ֔ר וַתָּ֥בוֹא חֶ֖רֶב וַתִּקָּחֵ֑הוּ דָּמ֖וֹ בְּרֹאשׁ֥וֹ יִֽהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vshm' hshm' 'tqvl hshvpr vl' nzhr vtbv' chrb vtqchhv dmv br'shv yhyh
verses.translation: then whosoever heareth the sound of the horn, and taketh not warning, if the sword come, and take him away, his blood shall be upon his own head;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵת֩ ק֨וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֤ר שָׁמַע֙ וְלֹ֣א נִזְהָ֔ר דָּמ֖וֹ בּ֣וֹ יִֽהְיֶ֑ה וְה֥וּא נִזְהָ֖ר נַפְשׁ֥וֹ מִלֵּֽט׃
verses.translit: 't qvl hshvpr shm' vl' nzhr dmv bv yhyh vhv' nzhr npshv mlt
verses.translation: he heard the sound of the horn, and took not warning, his blood shall be upon him; whereas if he had taken warning, he would have delivered his soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הַצֹּפֶ֠ה כִּי־יִרְאֶ֨ה אֶת־הַחֶ֜רֶב בָּאָ֗ה וְלֹֽא־תָקַ֤ע בַּשּׁוֹפָר֙ וְהָעָ֣ם לֹֽא־נִזְהָ֔ר וַתָּב֣וֹא חֶ֔רֶב וַתִּקַּ֥ח מֵהֶ֖ם נָ֑פֶשׁ ה֚וּא בַּעֲוֺנ֣וֹ נִלְקָ֔ח וְדָמ֖וֹ מִיַּֽד־הַצֹּפֶ֥ה אֶדְרֹֽשׁ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhtsph khyyr'h 'thchrb b'h vl'tq' bshvpr vh'm l'nzhr vtbv' chrb vtqch mhm npsh hv' b'vnv nlqch vdmv mydhtsph 'drsh {p}
verses.translation: But if the watchman see the sword come, and blow not the horn, and the people be not warned, and the sword do come, and take any person from among them, he is taken away in his iniquity, but his blood will I require at the watchman’s hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֔ם צֹפֶ֥ה נְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֤ מִפִּי֙ דָּבָ֔ר וְהִזְהַרְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: v'th bn'dm tsph nttykh lbyt yshr'l vshm't mpy dbr vhzhrt 'tm mmny
verses.translation: So thou, son of man, I have set thee a watchman unto the house of Israel; therefore, when thou shalt hear the word at My mouth, warn them from Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאׇמְרִ֣י לָרָשָׁ֗ע רָשָׁע֙ מ֣וֹת תָּמ֔וּת וְלֹ֣א דִבַּ֔רְתָּ לְהַזְהִ֥יר רָשָׁ֖ע מִדַּרְכּ֑וֹ ה֤וּא רָשָׁע֙ בַּעֲוֺנ֣וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְדָמ֖וֹ מִיָּדְךָ֥ אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: b'mry lrsh' rsh' mvt tmvt vl' dbrt lhzhyr rsh' mdrkhv hv' rsh' b'vnv ymvt vdmv mydkh 'bqsh
verses.translation: When I say unto the wicked: O wicked man, thou shalt surely die, and thou dost not speak to warn the wicked from his way; that wicked man shall die in his iniquity, but his blood will I require at thy hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠אַתָּ֠ה כִּי־הִזְהַ֨רְתָּ רָשָׁ֤ע מִדַּרְכּוֹ֙ לָשׁ֣וּב מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְלֹא־שָׁ֖ב מִדַּרְכּ֑וֹ ה֚וּא בַּעֲוֺנ֣וֹ יָמ֔וּת וְאַתָּ֖ה נַפְשְׁךָ֥ הִצַּֽלְתָּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'th khyhzhrt rsh' mdrkhv lshvb mmnh vl'shb mdrkhv hv' b'vnv ymvt v'th npshkh htslt {p}
verses.translation: Nevertheless, if thou warn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he turn not from his way; he shall die in his iniquity, but thou hast delivered thy soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם אֱמֹר֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֵּ֤ן אֲמַרְתֶּם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כִּֽי־פְשָׁעֵ֥ינוּ וְחַטֹּאתֵ֖ינוּ עָלֵ֑ינוּ וּבָ֛ם אֲנַ֥חְנוּ נְמַקִּ֖ים וְאֵ֥יךְ נִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th bn'dm 'mr 'lbyt yshr'l khn 'mrtm l'mr khypsh'ynv vcht'tynv 'lynv vbm 'nchnv nmqym v'ykh nchyh
verses.translation: Therefore, O thou son of man, say unto the house of Israel: Thus ye speak, saying: Our transgressions and our sins are upon us, and we pine away in them; how then can we live?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱמֹ֨ר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם חַי־אָ֣נִי  נְאֻ֣ם  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה אִם־אֶחְפֹּץ֙ בְּמ֣וֹת הָרָשָׁ֔ע כִּ֣י אִם־בְּשׁ֥וּב רָשָׁ֛ע מִדַּרְכּ֖וֹ וְחָיָ֑ה שׁ֣וּבוּ שׁ֜וּבוּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֧ם הָרָעִ֛ים וְלָ֥מָּה תָמ֖וּתוּ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'mr 'lyhm chy'ny  n'm  'dny yhvh 'm'chpts bmvt hrsh' khy 'mbshvb rsh' mdrkhv vchyh shvbv shvbv mdrkhykhm hr'ym vlmh tmvtv byt yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: Say unto them: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but that the wicked turn from his way and live; turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Israel?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם אֱמֹ֤ר אֶל־בְּנֵֽי־עַמְּךָ֙ צִדְקַ֣ת הַצַּדִּ֗יק לֹ֤א תַצִּילֶ֙נּוּ֙ בְּי֣וֹם פִּשְׁע֔וֹ וְרִשְׁעַ֤ת הָֽרָשָׁע֙ לֹא־יִכָּ֣שֶׁל בָּ֔הּ בְּי֖וֹם שׁוּב֣וֹ מֵֽרִשְׁע֑וֹ וְצַדִּ֗יק לֹ֥א יוּכַ֛ל לִֽחְי֥וֹת בָּ֖הּ בְּי֥וֹם חֲטֹאתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'th bn'dm 'mr 'lbny'mkh tsdqt htsdyq l' ttsylnv byvm psh'v vrsh't hrsh' l'ykhshl bh byvm shvbv mrsh'v vtsdyq l' yvkhl lchyvt bh byvm cht'tv
verses.translation: And thou, son of man, say unto the children of thy people: The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him in the day of his transgression; and as for the wickedness of the wicked, he shall not stumble thereby in the day that he turneth from his wickedness; neither shall he that is righteous be able to live thereby in the day that he sinneth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאׇמְרִ֤י לַצַּדִּיק֙ חָיֹ֣ה יִֽחְיֶ֔ה וְהוּא־בָטַ֥ח עַל־צִדְקָת֖וֹ וְעָ֣שָׂה עָ֑וֶל כׇּל־צִדְקֹתָו֙ לֹ֣א תִזָּכַ֔רְנָה וּבְעַוְל֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֖ה בּ֥וֹ יָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: b'mry ltsdyq chyh ychyh vhv'btch 'ltsdqtv v'shh 'vl khltsdqtv l' tzkhrnh vb'vlv 'shr'shh bv ymvt
verses.translation: When I say to the righteous, that he shall surely live; if he trust to his righteousness, and commit iniquity, none of his righteous deeds shall be remembered; but for his iniquity that he hath committed, for it shall he die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְאׇמְרִ֥י לָרָשָׁ֖ע מ֣וֹת תָּמ֑וּת וְשָׁב֙ מֵֽחַטָּאת֔וֹ וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: vb'mry lrsh' mvt tmvt vshb mcht'tv v'shh mshpt vtsdqh
verses.translation: Again, when I say unto the wicked: Thou shalt surely die; if he turn from his sin, and do that which is lawful and right;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲבֹ֨ל יָשִׁ֤יב רָשָׁע֙ גְּזֵלָ֣ה יְשַׁלֵּ֔ם בְּחֻקּ֤וֹת הַֽחַיִּים֙ הָלַ֔ךְ לְבִלְתִּ֖י עֲשׂ֣וֹת עָ֑וֶל חָי֥וֹ יִֽחְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃
verses.translit: chbl yshyb rsh' gzlh yshlm bchqvt hchyym hlkh lblty 'shvt 'vl chyv ychyh l' ymvt
verses.translation: if the wicked restore the pledge, give back that which he had taken by robbery, walk in the statutes of life, committing no iniquity; he shall surely live, he shall not die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־חַטֹּאתָו֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֔א לֹ֥א תִזָּכַ֖רְנָה ל֑וֹ מִשְׁפָּ֧ט וּצְדָקָ֛ה עָשָׂ֖ה חָי֥וֹ יִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: khlcht'tv 'shr cht' l' tzkhrnh lv mshpt vtsdqh 'shh chyv ychyh
verses.translation: None of his sins that he hath committed shall be remembered against him; he hath done that which is lawful and right; he shall surely live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמְּךָ֔ לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑י וְהֵ֖מָּה דַּרְכָּ֥ם לֹא־יִתָּכֵֽן׃
verses.translit: v'mrv bny 'mkh l' ytkhn drkh 'dny vhmh drkhm l'ytkhn
verses.translation: Yet the children of thy people say: The way of the Lord is not equal; but as for them, their way is not equal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשׁוּב־צַדִּ֥יק מִצִּדְקָת֖וֹ וְעָ֣שָׂה עָ֑וֶל וּמֵ֖ת בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: bshvbtsdyq mtsdqtv v'shh 'vl vmt bhm
verses.translation: When the righteous turneth from his righteousness, and committeth iniquity, he shall even die thereby.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְשׁ֤וּב רָשָׁע֙ מֵֽרִשְׁעָת֔וֹ וְעָשָׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָ֑ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם ה֥וּא יִֽחְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vbshvb rsh' mrsh'tv v'shh mshpt vtsdqh 'lyhm hv' ychyh
verses.translation: And when the wicked turneth from his wickedness, and doeth that which is lawful and right, he shall live thereby.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם לֹ֥א יִתָּכֵ֖ן דֶּ֣רֶךְ אֲדֹנָ֑י אִ֧ישׁ כִּדְרָכָ֛יו אֶשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶתְכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mrtm l' ytkhn drkh 'dny 'ysh khdrkhyv 'shpvt 'tkhm byt yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: Yet ye say: The way of the Lord is not equal. O house of Israel, I will judge you every one after his ways.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֞י בִּשְׁתֵּ֧י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֗ה בָּעֲשִׂרִ֛י בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ לְגָלוּתֵ֑נוּ בָּא־אֵלַ֨י הַפָּלִ֧יט מִירוּשָׁלַ֛͏ִם לֵאמֹ֖ר הֻכְּתָ֥ה הָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vyhy bshty 'shrh shnh b'shry bchmshh lchdsh lglvtnv b''ly hplyt myrvshl͏m l'mr hkhth h'yr
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the twelfth year of our captivity, in the tenth month, in the fifth day of the month, that one that had escaped out of Jerusalem came unto me, saying: ‘The city is smitten.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַד־יְהֹוָה֩ הָיְתָ֨ה אֵלַ֜י בָּעֶ֗רֶב לִפְנֵי֙ בּ֣וֹא הַפָּלִ֔יט וַיִּפְתַּ֣ח אֶת־פִּ֔י עַד־בּ֥וֹא אֵלַ֖י בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וַיִּפָּ֣תַח פִּ֔י וְלֹ֥א נֶאֱלַ֖מְתִּי עֽוֹד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vydyhvh hyth 'ly b'rb lpny bv' hplyt vyptch 'tpy 'dbv' 'ly bbqr vyptch py vl' n'lmty 'vd {p}
verses.translation: Now the hand of the LORD had been upon me in the evening, before he that was escaped came; and He had opened my mouth against his coming to me in the morning; and my mouth was opened, and I was no more dumb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם יֹ֠שְׁבֵ֠י הֶחֳרָב֨וֹת הָאֵ֜לֶּה עַל־אַדְמַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֹמְרִ֣ים לֵאמֹ֔ר אֶחָד֙ הָיָ֣ה אַבְרָהָ֔ם וַיִּירַ֖שׁ אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַאֲנַ֣חְנוּ רַבִּ֔ים לָ֛נוּ נִתְּנָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ לְמוֹרָשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bn'dm yshby hchrbvt h'lh 'l'dmt yshr'l 'mrym l'mr 'chd hyh 'brhm vyyrsh 'th'rts v'nchnv rbym lnv ntnh h'rts lmvrshh {s}
verses.translation: ’Son of man, they that inhabit those waste places in the land of Israel speak, saying: Abraham was one, and he inherited the land; but we are many; the land is given us for inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ אֱמֹ֨ר אֲלֵהֶ֜ם כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה עַל־הַדָּ֧ם ׀ תֹּאכֵ֛לוּ וְעֵינֵכֶ֛ם תִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶל־גִּלּוּלֵיכֶ֖ם וְדָ֣ם תִּשְׁפֹּ֑כוּ וְהָאָ֖רֶץ תִּירָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr 'lhm khh'mr  'dny yhvh 'lhdm  t'khlv v'ynkhm tsh'v 'lglvlykhm vdm tshpkhv vh'rts tyrshv
verses.translation: Wherefore say unto them: Thus saith the Lord GOD. Ye eat with the blood, and lift up your eyes unto your idols, and shed blood; and shall ye possess the land?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲמַדְתֶּ֤ם עַֽל־חַרְבְּכֶם֙ עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ן תּוֹעֵבָ֔ה וְאִ֛ישׁ אֶת־אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖הוּ טִמֵּאתֶ֑ם וְהָאָ֖רֶץ תִּירָֽשׁוּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'mdtm 'lchrbkhm 'shytn tv'bh v'ysh 't'sht r'hv tm'tm vh'rts tyrshv {s}
verses.translation: Ye stand upon your sword, ye work abomination, and ye defile every one his neighbour’s wife; and shall ye possess the land?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־תֹאמַ֨ר אֲלֵהֶ֜ם כֹּה־אָמַ֨ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֮ חַי־אָ֒נִי֒ אִם־לֹ֞א אֲשֶׁ֤ר בֶּֽחֳרָבוֹת֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֔לוּ וַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לַחַיָּ֥ה נְתַתִּ֖יו לְאׇכְל֑וֹ וַאֲשֶׁ֛ר בַּמְּצָד֥וֹת וּבַמְּעָר֖וֹת בַּדֶּ֥בֶר יָמֽוּתוּ׃
verses.translit: khht'mr 'lhm khh'mr 'dny yhvh chy'ny 'ml' 'shr bchrbvt bchrb yplv v'shr 'lpny hshdh lchyh nttyv l'khlv v'shr bmtsdvt vbm'rvt bdbr ymvtv
verses.translation: Thus shalt thou say unto them: Thus saith the Lord GOD: As I live, surely they that are in the waste places shall fall by the sword, and him that is in the open field will I give to the beasts to be devoured, and they that are in the strongholds and in the caves shall die of the pestilence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י אֶת־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שְׁמָמָ֣ה וּמְשַׁמָּ֔ה וְנִשְׁבַּ֖ת גְּא֣וֹן עֻזָּ֑הּ וְשָׁ֥מְמ֛וּ הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֵ֥ין עוֹבֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vntty 'th'rts shmmh vmshmh vnshbt g'vn 'zh vshmmv hry yshr'l m'yn 'vbr
verses.translation: And I will make the land most desolate, and the pride of her power shall cease; and the mountains of Israel shall be desolate, so that none shall pass through.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה בְּתִתִּ֤י אֶת־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שְׁמָמָ֣ה וּמְשַׁמָּ֔ה עַ֥ל כׇּל־תּוֹעֲבֹתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyd'v khy'ny yhvh btty 'th'rts shmmh vmshmh 'l khltv'btm 'shr 'shv {p}
verses.translation: Then shall they know that I am the LORD, when I have made the land most desolate, because of all their abominations which they have committed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֔ם בְּנֵ֣י עַמְּךָ֗ הַנִּדְבָּרִ֤ים בְּךָ֙ אֵ֣צֶל הַקִּיר֔וֹת וּבְפִתְחֵ֖י הַבָּתִּ֑ים וְדִבֶּר־חַ֣ד אֶת־אַחַ֗ד אִ֤ישׁ אֶת־אָחִיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בֹּאוּ־נָ֣א וְשִׁמְע֔וּ מָ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר הַיּוֹצֵ֖א מֵאֵ֥ת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th bn'dm bny 'mkh hndbrym bkh 'tsl hqyrvt vbptchy hbtym vdbrchd 't'chd 'ysh 't'chyv l'mr b'vn' vshm'v mh hdbr hyvts' m't yhvh
verses.translation: And as for thee, son of man, the children of thy people that talk of thee by the walls and in the doors of the houses, and speak one to another, every one to his brother, saying: Come, I pray you, and hear what is the word that cometh forth from the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָב֣וֹאוּ אֵ֠לֶ֠יךָ כִּמְבוֹא־עָ֞ם וְיֵשְׁב֤וּ לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ עַמִּ֔י וְשָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־דְּבָרֶ֔יךָ וְאוֹתָ֖ם לֹ֣א יַעֲשׂ֑וּ כִּֽי־עֲגָבִ֤ים בְּפִיהֶם֙ הֵ֣מָּה עֹשִׂ֔ים אַחֲרֵ֥י בִצְעָ֖ם לִבָּ֥ם הֹלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vybv'v 'lykh khmbv''m vyshbv lpnykh 'my vshm'v 'tdbrykh v'vtm l' y'shv khy'gbym bpyhm hmh 'shym 'chry bts'm lbm hlkh
verses.translation: and come unto thee as the people cometh, and sit before thee as My people, and hear thy words, but do them not—for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goeth after their covetousness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנְּךָ֤ לָהֶם֙ כְּשִׁ֣יר עֲגָבִ֔ים יְפֵ֥ה ק֖וֹל וּמֵטִ֣ב נַגֵּ֑ן וְשָֽׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־דְּבָרֶ֔יךָ וְעֹשִׂ֥ים אֵינָ֖ם אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhnkh lhm khshyr 'gbym yph qvl vmtb ngn vshm'v 'tdbrykh v'shym 'ynm 'vtm
verses.translation: and, lo, thou art unto them as a love song of one that hath a pleasant voice, and can play well on an instrument; so they hear thy words, but they do them not—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְבֹאָ֑הּ הִנֵּ֣ה בָאָ֔ה וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י נָבִ֖יא הָיָ֥ה בְתוֹכָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbb'h hnh b'h vyd'v khy nby' hyh btvkhm {p}
verses.translation: when this cometh to pass—behold, it cometh—then shall they know that a prophet hath been among them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל־רוֹעֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִנָּבֵ֣א וְאָמַרְתָּ֩ אֲלֵיהֶ֨ם לָרֹעִ֜ים כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה ה֤וֹי רֹעֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָיוּ֙ רֹעִ֣ים אוֹתָ֔ם הֲל֣וֹא הַצֹּ֔אן יִרְע֖וּ הָרֹעִֽים׃
verses.translit: bn'dm hnb' 'lrv'y yshr'l hnb' v'mrt 'lyhm lr'ym khh'mr  'dny yhvh hvy r'yyshr'l 'shr hyv r'ym 'vtm hlv' hts'n yr'v hr'ym
verses.translation: ’Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say unto them, even to the shepherds: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Woe unto the shepherds of Israel that have fed themselves! should not the shepherds feed the sheep?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הַחֵ֤לֶב תֹּאכֵ֙לוּ֙ וְאֶת־הַצֶּ֣מֶר תִּלְבָּ֔שׁוּ הַבְּרִיאָ֖ה תִּזְבָּ֑חוּ הַצֹּ֖אן לֹ֥א תִרְעֽוּ׃
verses.translit: 'thchlb t'khlv v'thtsmr tlbshv hbry'h tzbchv hts'n l' tr'v
verses.translation: Ye did eat the fat, and ye clothed you with the wool, ye killed the fatlings; but ye fed not the sheep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶֽת־הַנַּחְלוֹת֩ לֹ֨א חִזַּקְתֶּ֜ם וְאֶת־הַחוֹלָ֣ה לֹֽא־רִפֵּאתֶ֗ם וְלַנִּשְׁבֶּ֙רֶת֙ לֹ֣א חֲבַשְׁתֶּ֔ם וְאֶת־הַנִּדַּ֙חַת֙ לֹ֣א הֲשֵׁבֹתֶ֔ם וְאֶת־הָאֹבֶ֖דֶת לֹ֣א בִקַּשְׁתֶּ֑ם וּבְחׇזְקָ֛ה רְדִיתֶ֥ם אֹתָ֖ם וּבְפָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.translit: 'thnchlvt l' chzqtm v'thchvlh l'rp'tm vlnshbrt l' chbshtm v'thndcht l' hshbtm v'th'bdt l' bqshtm vbchzqh rdytm 'tm vbprkh
verses.translation: The weak have ye not strengthened, neither have ye healed that which was sick, neither have ye bound up that which was broken, neither have ye brought back that which was driven away, neither have ye sought that which was lost; but with force have ye ruled over them and with rigour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּפוּצֶ֖ינָה מִבְּלִ֣י רֹעֶ֑ה וַתִּהְיֶ֧ינָה לְאׇכְלָ֛ה לְכׇל־חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וַתְּפוּצֶֽינָה׃
verses.translit: vtpvtsynh mbly r'h vthyynh l'khlh lkhlchyt hshdh vtpvtsynh
verses.translation: So were they scattered, because there was no shepherd; and they became food to all the beasts of the field, and were scattered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁגּ֤וּ צֹאנִי֙ בְּכׇל־הֶ֣הָרִ֔ים וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־גִּבְעָ֣ה רָמָ֑ה וְעַ֨ל כׇּל־פְּנֵ֤י הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ נָפֹ֣צוּ צֹאנִ֔י וְאֵ֥ין דּוֹרֵ֖שׁ וְאֵ֥ין מְבַקֵּֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: yshgv ts'ny bkhlhhrym v'l khlgb'h rmh v'l khlpny h'rts nptsv ts'ny v'yn dvrsh v'yn mbqsh
verses.translation: My sheep wandered through all the mountains, and upon every high hill, yea, upon all the face of the earth were My sheep scattered, and there was none that did search or seek.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן רֹעִ֔ים שִׁמְע֖וּ אֶת־דְּבַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn r'ym shm'v 'tdbr yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַי־אָ֜נִי נְאֻ֣ם  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה אִם־לֹ֣א יַ֣עַן הֱיֽוֹת־צֹאנִ֣י ׀ לָבַ֡ז וַתִּהְיֶ֩ינָה֩ צֹאנִ֨י לְאׇכְלָ֜ה לְכׇל־חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ מֵאֵ֣ין רֹעֶ֔ה וְלֹא־דָרְשׁ֥וּ רֹעַ֖י אֶת־צֹאנִ֑י וַיִּרְע֤וּ הָרֹעִים֙ אוֹתָ֔ם וְאֶת־צֹאנִ֖י לֹ֥א רָעֽוּ׃
verses.translit: chy'ny n'm  'dny yhvh 'ml' y'n hyvtts'ny  lbz vthyynh ts'ny l'khlh lkhlchyt hshdh m'yn r'h vl'drshv r'y 'tts'ny vyr'v hr'ym 'vtm v'tts'ny l' r'v
verses.translation: As I live, saith the Lord GOD, surely forasmuch as My sheep became a prey, and My sheep became food to all the beasts of the field, because there was no shepherd, neither did My shepherds search for My sheep, but the shepherds fed themselves, and fed not My sheep;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ הָרֹעִ֔ים שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn hr'ym shm'v dbryhvh
verses.translation: therefore, ye shepherds, hear the word of the LORD:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה הִנְנִ֨י אֶֽל־הָרֹעִ֜ים וְֽדָרַשְׁתִּ֧י אֶת־צֹאנִ֣י מִיָּדָ֗ם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּים֙ מֵרְע֣וֹת צֹ֔אן וְלֹא־יִרְע֥וּ ע֛וֹד הָרֹעִ֖ים אוֹתָ֑ם וְהִצַּלְתִּ֤י צֹאנִי֙ מִפִּיהֶ֔ם וְלֹא־תִֽהְיֶ֥יןָ לָהֶ֖ם לְאׇכְלָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khh'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'lhr'ym vdrshty 'tts'ny mydm vhshbtym mr'vt ts'n vl'yr'v 'vd hr'ym 'vtm vhtslty ts'ny mpyhm vl'thyyn lhm l'khlh {s}
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require My sheep at their hand, and cause them to cease from feeding the sheep; neither shall the shepherds feed themselves any more; and I will deliver My sheep from their mouth, that they may not be food for them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה הִנְנִי־אָ֕נִי וְדָרַשְׁתִּ֥י אֶת־צֹאנִ֖י וּבִקַּרְתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny'ny vdrshty 'tts'ny vbqrtym
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, here am I, and I will search for My sheep, and seek them out.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּבַקָּרַת֩ רֹעֶ֨ה עֶדְר֜וֹ בְּיוֹם־הֱיוֹת֤וֹ בְתוֹךְ־צֹאנוֹ֙ נִפְרָשׁ֔וֹת כֵּ֖ן אֲבַקֵּ֣ר אֶת־צֹאנִ֑י וְהִצַּלְתִּ֣י אֶתְהֶ֗ם מִכׇּל־הַמְּקוֹמֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָפֹ֣צוּ שָׁ֔ם בְּי֥וֹם עָנָ֖ן וַעֲרָפֶֽל׃
verses.translit: khbqrt r'h 'drv byvmhyvtv btvkhts'nv nprshvt khn 'bqr 'tts'ny vhtslty 'thm mkhlhmqvmt 'shr nptsv shm byvm 'nn v'rpl
verses.translation: As a shepherd seeketh out his flock in the day that he is among his sheep that are separated, so will I seek out My sheep; and I will deliver them out of all places whither they have been scattered in the day of clouds and thick darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹצֵאתִ֣ים מִן־הָעַמִּ֗ים וְקִבַּצְתִּים֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת וַהֲבִיאוֹתִ֖ים אֶל־אַדְמָתָ֑ם וּרְעִיתִים֙ אֶל־הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּאֲפִיקִ֕ים וּבְכֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhvts'tym mnh'mym vqbtstym mnh'rtsvt vhby'vtym 'l'dmtm vr'ytym 'lhry yshr'l b'pyqym vbkhl mvshby h'rts
verses.translation: And I will bring them out from the peoples, and gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land; and I will feed them upon the mountains of Israel, by the streams, and in all the habitable places of the country.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּמִרְעֶה־טּוֹב֙ אֶרְעֶ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם וּבְהָרֵ֥י מְרֽוֹם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִהְיֶ֣ה נְוֵהֶ֑ם שָׁ֤ם תִּרְבַּ֙צְנָה֙ בְּנָ֣וֶה טּ֔וֹב וּמִרְעֶ֥ה שָׁמֵ֛ן תִּרְעֶ֖ינָה אֶל־הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: bmr'htvb 'r'h 'tm vbhry mrvmyshr'l yhyh nvhm shm trbtsnh bnvh tvb vmr'h shmn tr'ynh 'lhry yshr'l
verses.translation: I will feed them in a good pasture, and upon the high mountains of Israel shall their fold be; there shall they lie down in a good fold, and in a fat pasture shall they feed upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֨י אֶרְעֶ֤ה צֹאנִי֙ וַאֲנִ֣י אַרְבִּיצֵ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: 'ny 'r'h ts'ny v'ny 'rbytsm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: I will feed My sheep, and I will cause them to lie down, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶת־הָאֹבֶ֤דֶת אֲבַקֵּשׁ֙ וְאֶת־הַנִּדַּ֣חַת אָשִׁ֔יב וְלַנִּשְׁבֶּ֣רֶת אֶֽחֱבֹ֔שׁ וְאֶת־הַחוֹלָ֖ה אֲחַזֵּ֑ק וְאֶת־הַשְּׁמֵנָ֧ה וְאֶת־הַחֲזָקָ֛ה אַשְׁמִ֖יד אֶרְעֶ֥נָּה בְמִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: 'th'bdt 'bqsh v'thndcht 'shyb vlnshbrt 'chbsh v'thchvlh 'chzq v'thshmnh v'thchzqh 'shmyd 'r'nh bmshpt
verses.translation: I will seek that which was lost, and will bring back that which was driven away, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen that which was sick; and the fat and the strong I will destroy, I will feed them in justice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֵּ֣נָה צֹאנִ֔י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י שֹׁפֵט֙ בֵּֽין־שֶׂ֣ה לָשֶׂ֔ה לָאֵילִ֖ים וְלָעַתּוּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'tnh ts'ny khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny shpt bynshh lshh l'ylym vl'tvdym
verses.translation: And as for you, O My flock, thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, I judge between cattle and cattle, even the rams and the he-goats.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמְעַ֣ט מִכֶּ֗ם הַמִּרְעֶ֤ה הַטּוֹב֙ תִּרְע֔וּ וְיֶ֙תֶר֙ מִרְעֵיכֶ֔ם תִּרְמְס֖וּ בְּרַגְלֵיכֶ֑ם וּמִשְׁקַע־מַ֣יִם תִּשְׁתּ֔וּ וְאֵת֙ הַנּ֣וֹתָרִ֔ים בְּרַגְלֵיכֶ֖ם תִּרְפֹּשֽׂוּן׃
verses.translit: hm't mkhm hmr'h htvb tr'v vytr mr'ykhm trmsv brglykhm vmshq'mym tshtv v't hnvtrym brglykhm trpshvn
verses.translation: Seemeth it a small thing unto you to have fed upon the good pasture, but ye must tread down with your feet the residue of your pasture? and to have drunk of the settled waters, but ye must foul the residue with your feet?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצֹאנִ֑י מִרְמַ֤ס רַגְלֵיכֶם֙ תִּרְעֶ֔ינָה וּמִרְפַּ֥שׂ רַגְלֵיכֶ֖ם תִּשְׁתֶּֽינָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vts'ny mrms rglykhm tr'ynh vmrpsh rglykhm tshtynh {p}
verses.translation: And as for My sheep, they eat that which ye have trodden with your feet, and they drink that which ye have fouled with your feet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֖ה אֲלֵיהֶ֑ם הִנְנִי־אָ֕נִי וְשָֽׁפַטְתִּי֙ בֵּֽין־שֶׂ֣ה בִרְיָ֔ה וּבֵ֥ין שֶׂ֖ה רָזָֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'lyhm hnny'ny vshptty bynshh bryh vbyn shh rzh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD unto them: Behold, I, even I, will judge between the fat cattle and the lean cattle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֗עַן בְּצַ֤ד וּבְכָתֵף֙ תֶּהְדֹּ֔פוּ וּבְקַרְנֵיכֶ֥ם תְּנַגְּח֖וּ כׇּל־הַנַּחְל֑וֹת עַ֣ד אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֲפִיצוֹתֶ֛ם אוֹתָ֖נָה אֶל־הַחֽוּצָה׃
verses.translit: y'n btsd vbkhtf thdpv vbqrnykhm tngchv khlhnchlvt 'd 'shr hpytsvtm 'vtnh 'lhchvtsh
verses.translation: Because ye thrust with side and with shoulder, and push all the weak with your horns, till ye have scattered them abroad;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י לְצֹאנִ֔י וְלֹא־תִהְיֶ֥ינָה ע֖וֹד לָבַ֑ז וְשָׁ֣פַטְתִּ֔י בֵּ֥ין שֶׂ֖ה לָשֶֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vhvsh'ty lts'ny vl'thyynh 'vd lbz vshptty byn shh lshh
verses.translation: therefore will I save My flock, and they shall no more be a prey; and I will judge between cattle and cattle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֨י עֲלֵיהֶ֜ם רֹעֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ וְרָעָ֣ה אֶתְהֶ֔ן אֵ֖ת עַבְדִּ֣י דָוִ֑יד ה֚וּא יִרְעֶ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם וְהֽוּא־יִהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ן לְרֹעֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vhqmty 'lyhm r'h 'chd vr'h 'thn 't 'bdy dvyd hv' yr'h 'tm vhv'yhyh lhn lr'h
verses.translation: And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even My servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶֽהְיֶ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים וְעַבְדִּ֥י דָוִ֖ד נָשִׂ֣יא בְתוֹכָ֑ם אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃
verses.translit: v'ny yhvh 'hyh lhm l'lhym v'bdy dvd nshy' btvkhm 'ny yhvh dbrty
verses.translation: And I the LORD will be their God, and My servant David prince among them; I the LORD have spoken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכָרַתִּ֤י לָהֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית שָׁל֔וֹם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּ֥י חַיָּֽה־רָעָ֖ה מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיָשְׁב֤וּ בַמִּדְבָּר֙ לָבֶ֔טַח וְיָשְׁנ֖וּ בַּיְּעָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vkhrty lhm bryt shlvm vhshbty chyhr'h mnh'rts vyshbv bmdbr lbtch vyshnv by'rym
verses.translation: And I will make with them a covenant of peace, and will cause evil beasts to cease out of the land; and they shall dwell safely in the wilderness, and sleep in the woods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אוֹתָ֛ם וּסְבִיב֥וֹת גִּבְעָתִ֖י בְּרָכָ֑ה וְהוֹרַדְתִּ֤י הַגֶּ֙שֶׁם֙ בְּעִתּ֔וֹ גִּשְׁמֵ֥י בְרָכָ֖ה יִֽהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vntty 'vtm vsbybvt gb'ty brkhh vhvrdty hgshm b'tv gshmy brkhh yhyv
verses.translation: And I will make them and the places round about My hill a blessing; and I will cause the shower to come down in its season; there shall be showers of blessing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַן֩ עֵ֨ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֜ה אֶת־פִּרְי֗וֹ וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תִּתֵּ֣ן יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְהָי֥וּ עַל־אַדְמָתָ֖ם לָבֶ֑טַח וְֽיָדְע֞וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה בְּשִׁבְרִי֙ אֶת־מֹט֣וֹת עֻלָּ֔ם וְהִ֨צַּלְתִּ֔ים מִיַּ֖ד הָעֹבְדִ֥ים בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vntn 'ts hshdh 'tpryv vh'rts ttn ybvlh vhyv 'l'dmtm lbtch vyd'v khy'ny yhvh bshbry 'tmtvt 'lm vhtsltym myd h'bdym bhm
verses.translation: And the tree of the field shall yield its fruit, and the earth shall yield her produce, and they shall be safe in their land; and they shall know that I am the LORD, when I have broken the bars of their yoke, and have delivered them out of the hand of those that made bondmen of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־יִהְי֨וּ ע֥וֹד בַּז֙ לַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְחַיַּ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ לֹ֣א תֹאכְלֵ֑ם וְיָשְׁב֥וּ לָבֶ֖טַח וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vl'yhyv 'vd bz lgvym vchyt h'rts l' t'khlm vyshbv lbtch v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: And they shall no more be a prey to the nations, neither shall the beast of the earth devour them; but they shall dwell safely, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲקִמֹתִ֥י לָהֶ֛ם מַטָּ֖ע לְשֵׁ֑ם וְלֹא־יִהְי֨וּ ע֜וֹד אֲסֻפֵ֤י רָעָב֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹא־יִשְׂא֥וּ ע֖וֹד כְּלִמַּ֥ת הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: vhqmty lhm mt' lshm vl'yhyv 'vd 'spy r'b b'rts vl'ysh'v 'vd khlmt hgvym
verses.translation: And I will raise up unto them a plantation for renown, and they shall be no more consumed with hunger in the land, neither bear the shame of the nations any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֧י יְהֹוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם אִתָּ֑ם וְהֵ֗מָּה עַמִּי֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm 'tm vhmh 'my byt yshr'l n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And they shall know that I the LORD their God am with them, and that they, the house of Israel, are My people, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֵּ֥ן צֹאנִ֛י צֹ֥אן מַרְעִיתִ֖י אָדָ֣ם אַתֶּ֑ם אֲנִי֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'tn ts'ny ts'n mr'yty 'dm 'tm 'ny 'lhykhm n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And ye My sheep, the sheep of My pasture, are men, and I am your God, saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֥ים פָּנֶ֖יךָ עַל־הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֑יר וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: bn'dm shym pnykh 'lhr sh'yr vhnb' 'lyv
verses.translation: ’Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַ֣רְתָּ לּ֗וֹ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י אֵלֶ֖יךָ הַר־שֵׂעִ֑יר וְנָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ וּנְתַתִּ֖יךָ שְׁמָמָ֥ה וּמְשַׁמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mrt lv khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'lykh hrsh'yr vntyty ydy 'lykh vnttykh shmmh vmshmh
verses.translation: and say unto it: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, I am against thee, O mount Seir, and I will stretch out My hand against thee, and I will make thee most desolate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָרֶ֙יךָ֙ חׇרְבָּ֣ה אָשִׂ֔ים וְאַתָּ֖ה שְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֑ה וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'rykh chrbh 'shym v'th shmmh thyh vyd't khy'ny yhvh
verses.translation: I will lay thy cities waste, and thou shalt be desolate; and thou shalt know that I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֗עַן הֱי֤וֹת לְךָ֙ אֵיבַ֣ת עוֹלָ֔ם וַתַּגֵּ֥ר אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַל־יְדֵי־חָ֑רֶב בְּעֵ֣ת אֵידָ֔ם בְּעֵ֖ת עֲוֺ֥ן קֵֽץ׃
verses.translit: y'n hyvt lkh 'ybt 'vlm vtgr 'tbnyyshr'l 'lydychrb b't 'ydm b't 'vn qts
verses.translation: Because thou hast had a hatred of old, and hast hurled the children of Israel unto the power of the sword in the time of their calamity, in the time of the iniquity of the end;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן חַי־אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה כִּֽי־לְדָ֥ם אֶעֶשְׂךָ֖ וְדָ֣ם יִרְדְּפֶ֑ךָ אִם־לֹ֥א דָ֛ם שָׂנֵ֖אתָ וְדָ֥ם יִרְדְּפֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: lkhn chy'ny n'm 'dny yhvh khyldm ''shkh vdm yrdpkh 'ml' dm shn't vdm yrdpkh
verses.translation: therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will prepare thee unto blood, and blood shall pursue thee; surely thou hast hated thine own blood, therefore blood shall pursue thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת־הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר לְשִֽׁמְמָ֖ה וּשְׁמָמָ֑ה וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עֹבֵ֥ר וָשָֽׁב׃
verses.translit: vntty 'thr sh'yr lshmmh vshmmh vhkhrty mmnv 'br vshb
verses.translation: Thus will I make mount Seir most desolate, and cut off from it him that passeth through and him that returneth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִלֵּאתִ֥י אֶת־הָרָ֖יו חֲלָלָ֑יו גִּבְעוֹתֶ֤יךָ וְגֵיאוֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ וְכׇל־אֲפִיקֶ֔יךָ חַלְלֵי־חֶ֖רֶב יִפְּל֥וּ בָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vml'ty 'thryv chllyv gb'vtykh vgy'vtykh vkhl'pyqykh chllychrb yplv bhm
verses.translation: And I will fill his mountains with his slain; in thy hills and in thy valleys and in all thy streams shall they fall that are slain with the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִֽׁמְמ֤וֹת עוֹלָם֙ אֶתֶּנְךָ֔ וְעָרֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א (תישבנה) [תָשֹׁ֑בְנָה] וִידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: shmmvt 'vlm 'tnkh v'rykh l' (tyshbnh) [tshbnh] vyd'tm khy'ny yhvh
verses.translation: I will make thee perpetual desolations, and thy cities shall not return; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֣עַן אֲ֠מׇרְךָ֠ אֶת־שְׁנֵ֨י הַגּוֹיִ֜ם וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּ֧י הָאֲרָצ֛וֹת לִ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ינָה וִֽירַשְׁנ֑וּהָ וַיהֹוָ֖ה שָׁ֥ם הָיָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: y'n 'mrkh 'tshny hgvym v'tshty h'rtsvt ly thyynh vyrshnvh vyhvh shm hyh {s}
verses.translation: Because thou hast said: These two nations and these two countries shall be mine, and we will possess it; whereas the LORD was there;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן חַי־אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ וְעָשִׂ֗יתִי כְּאַפְּךָ֙ וּכְקִנְאָ֣תְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתָה מִשִּׂנְאָתֶ֖יךָ בָּ֑ם וְנוֹדַ֥עְתִּי בָ֖ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶשְׁפְּטֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: lkhn chy'ny n'm 'dny yhvh v'shyty kh'pkh vkhqn'tkh 'shr 'shyth mshn'tykh bm vnvd'ty bm kh'shr 'shptkh
verses.translation: therefore, as I live, saith the Lord GOD, I will do according to thine anger and according to thine envy, which thou hast used out of thy hatred against them; and I will make Myself known among them, when I shall judge thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽיָדַעְתָּ֮ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָה֒ שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי  אֶת־כׇּל־נָאָֽצוֹתֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַ֛רְתָּ עַל־הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֣ר ׀ [שָׁמֵ֑מוּ] (שממה) לָ֥נוּ נִתְּנ֖וּ לְאׇכְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyd't khy 'ny yhvh shm'ty  'tkhln'tsvtykh 'shr 'mrt 'lhry yshr'l l'mr  [shmmv] (shmmh) lnv ntnv l'khlh
verses.translation: And thou shalt know that I the LORD have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying: They are laid desolate, they are given us to devour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּגְדִּ֤ילוּ עָלַי֙ בְּפִיכֶ֔ם וְהַעְתַּרְתֶּ֥ם עָלַ֖י דִּבְרֵיכֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י שָׁמָֽעְתִּי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vtgdylv 'ly bpykhm vh'trtm 'ly dbrykhm 'ny shm'ty {s}
verses.translation: And ye have magnified yourselves against Me with your mouth, and have multiplied your words against Me; I have heard it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה כִּשְׂמֹ֙חַ֙ כׇּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֖ה אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh khshmch khlh'rts shmmh ''shhlkh
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּשִׂמְחָ֨תְךָ֜ לְנַחֲלַ֧ת בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׁמֵ֖מָה כֵּ֣ן אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּ֑ךְ שְׁמָמָ֨ה תִהְיֶ֤ה הַר־שֵׂעִיר֙ וְכׇל־אֱד֣וֹם כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khshmchtkh lnchlt bytyshr'l 'l 'shrshmmh khn ''shhlkh shmmh thyh hrsh'yr vkhl'dvm khlh vyd'v khy'ny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: As thou didst rejoice over the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate, so will I do unto thee; thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Edom, even all of it; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֔ם הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ הָרֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th bn'dm hnb' 'lhry yshr'l v'mrt hry yshr'l shm'v dbryhvh
verses.translation: And thou, son of man, prophesy unto the mountains of Israel, and say: Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה יַ֣עַן אָמַ֧ר הָאוֹיֵ֛ב עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם הֶאָ֑ח וּבָמ֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם לְמוֹרָשָׁ֖ה הָ֥יְתָה לָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n 'mr h'vyb 'lykhm h'ch vbmvt 'vlm lmvrshh hyth lnv
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Because the enemy hath said against you: Aha! even the ancient high places are ours in possession;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א וְאָמַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה יַ֣עַן בְּיַ֡עַן שַׁמּוֹת֩ וְשָׁאֹ֨ף אֶתְכֶ֜ם מִסָּבִ֗יב לִֽהְיֽוֹתְכֶ֤ם מֽוֹרָשָׁה֙ לִשְׁאֵרִ֣ית הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וַתֵּ֥עֲל֛וּ עַל־שְׂפַ֥ת לָשׁ֖וֹן וְדִבַּת־עָֽם׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnb' v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n by'n shmvt vsh'f 'tkhm msbyb lhyvtkhm mvrshh lsh'ryt hgvym vt'lv 'lshpt lshvn vdbt'm
verses.translation: therefore prophesy, and say: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Because, even because they have made you desolate, and swallowed you up on every side, that ye might be a possession unto the rest of the nations, and ye are taken up in the lips of talkers, and the evil report of the people;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱ֠הֹוִ֠ה לֶהָרִ֨ים וְלַגְּבָע֜וֹת לָאֲפִיקִ֣ים וְלַגֵּאָי֗וֹת וְלֶחֳרָב֤וֹת הַשֹּֽׁמְמוֹת֙ וְלֶעָרִ֣ים הַנֶּעֱזָב֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֤וּ לְבַז֙ וּלְלַ֔עַג לִשְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: lkhn hry yshr'l shm'v dbr'dny yhvh khh'mr 'dny yhvh lhrym vlgb'vt l'pyqym vlg'yvt vlchrbvt hshmmvt vl'rym hn'zbvt 'shr hyv lbz vll'g lsh'ryt hgvym 'shr msbyb
verses.translation: therefore, ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD: Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains and to the hills, to the streams and to the valleys, to the desolate wastes and to the cities that are forsaken, which are become a prey and derision to the residue of the nations that are round about;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ אִם־לֹ֠א בְּאֵ֨שׁ קִנְאָתִ֥י דִבַּ֛רְתִּי עַל־שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַגּוֹיִ֖ם וְעַל־אֱד֣וֹם כֻּלָּ֑א אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנֽוּ־אֶת־אַרְצִ֣י ׀ לָ֠הֶ֠ם לְמ֨וֹרָשָׁ֜ה בְּשִׂמְחַ֤ת כׇּל־לֵבָב֙ בִּשְׁאָ֣ט נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְמַ֥עַן מִגְרָשָׁ֖הּ לָבַֽז׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr 'dny yhvh 'ml' b'sh qn'ty dbrty 'lsh'ryt hgvym v'l'dvm khl' 'shr ntnv't'rtsy  lhm lmvrshh bshmcht khllbb bsh't npsh lm'n mgrshh lbz
verses.translation: therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: Surely in the fire of My jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the nations, and against all Edom, that have appointed My land unto themselves for a possession with the joy of all their heart, with disdain of soul, to cast it out for a prey;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֕ן הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל־אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֡ לֶהָרִ֣ים וְ֠לַגְּבָע֠וֹת לָאֲפִיקִ֨ים וְלַגֵּאָי֜וֹת כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה הִנְנִ֨י בְקִנְאָתִ֤י וּבַֽחֲמָתִי֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי יַ֛עַן כְּלִמַּ֥ת גּוֹיִ֖ם נְשָׂאתֶֽם׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnb' 'l'dmt yshr'l v'mrt lhrym vlgb'vt l'pyqym vlg'yvt khh'mr  'dny yhvh hnny bqn'ty vbchmty dbrty y'n khlmt gvym nsh'tm
verses.translation: therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say unto the mountains and to the hills, to the streams and to the valleys: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, I have spoken in My jealousy and in My fury, because ye have borne the shame of the nations;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה אֲנִ֖י נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת־יָדִ֑י אִם־לֹ֤א הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָכֶ֣ם מִסָּבִ֔יב הֵ֖מָּה כְּלִמָּתָ֥ם יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'ny nsh'ty 'tydy 'ml' hgvym 'shr lkhm msbyb hmh khlmtm ysh'v
verses.translation: therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: I have lifted up My hand: Surely the nations that are round about you, they shall bear their shame.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֞ם הָרֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַנְפְּכֶ֣ם תִּתֵּ֔נוּ וּפֶרְיְכֶ֥ם תִּשְׂא֖וּ לְעַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֥י קֵרְב֖וּ לָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: v'tm hry yshr'l 'npkhm ttnv vprykhm tsh'v l'my yshr'l khy qrbv lbv'
verses.translation: But ye, O mountains of Israel, ye shall shoot forth your branches, and yield your fruit to My people Israel; for they are at hand to come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֖י הִנְנִ֣י אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וּפָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְנֶעֱבַדְתֶּ֖ם וְנִזְרַעְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: khy hnny 'lykhm vpnyty 'lykhm vn'bdtm vnzr'tm
verses.translation: For, behold, I am for you, and I will turn unto you, and ye shall be tilled and sown;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ אָדָ֔ם כׇּל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כֻּלֹּ֑ה וְנֹֽשְׁבוּ֙ הֶעָרִ֔ים וְהֶחֳרָב֖וֹת תִּבָּנֶֽינָה׃
verses.translit: vhrbyty 'lykhm 'dm khlbyt yshr'l khlh vnshbv h'rym vhchrbvt tbnynh
verses.translation: and I will multiply men upon you, all the house of Israel, even all of it; and the cities shall be inhabited, and the waste places shall be builded;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָ֖ה וְרָב֣וּ וּפָר֑וּ וְהוֹשַׁבְתִּ֨י אֶתְכֶ֜ם כְּקַדְמֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהֵיטִֽבֹתִי֙ מֵרִאשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וִידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhrbyty 'lykhm 'dm vbhmh vrbv vprv vhvshbty 'tkhm khqdmvtykhm vhytbty mr'shtykhm vyd'tm khy'ny yhvh
verses.translation: and I will multiply upon you man and beast, and they shall increase and be fruitful; and I will cause you to be inhabited after your former estate, and will do better unto you than at your beginnings; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹלַכְתִּי֩ עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם אָדָ֜ם אֶת־עַמִּ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וִירֵשׁ֔וּךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה וְלֹא־תוֹסִ֥ף ע֖וֹד לְשַׁכְּלָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhvlkhty 'lykhm 'dm 't'my yshr'l vyrshvkh vhyyt lhm lnchlh vl'tvsf 'vd lshkhlm {s}
verses.translation: Yea, I will cause men to walk upon you, even my people Israel, and they shall possess thee, and thou shalt be their inheritance; and thou shalt no more henceforth bereave them of children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן אֹמְרִ֣ים לָכֶ֔ם אֹכֶ֥לֶת אָדָ֖ם (אתי) [אָ֑תְּ] וּמְשַׁכֶּ֥לֶת (גויך) [גּוֹיַ֖יִךְ] הָיִֽית׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh y'n 'mrym lkhm 'khlt 'dm ('ty) ['t] vmshkhlt (gvykh) [gvyykh] hyyt
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Because they say unto you: Thou land art a devourer of men, and hast been a bereaver of thy nations;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן אָדָם֙ לֹא־תֹ֣אכְלִי ע֔וֹד (וגויך) [וְגוֹיַ֖יִךְ] לֹ֣א (תכשלי) [תְשַׁכְּלִי־]ע֑וֹד נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn 'dm l't'khly 'vd (vgvykh) [vgvyykh] l' (tkhshly) [tshkhly]'vd n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: therefore thou shalt devour men no more, neither bereave thy nations any more, saith the Lord GOD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־אַשְׁמִ֨יעַ אֵלַ֤יִךְ עוֹד֙ כְּלִמַּ֣ת הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְחֶרְפַּ֥ת עַמִּ֖ים לֹ֣א תִשְׂאִי־ע֑וֹד (וגויך) [וְגוֹיַ֙יִךְ֙] לֹא־תַכְשִׁ֣לִי ע֔וֹד נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl''shmy' 'lykh 'vd khlmt hgvym vchrpt 'mym l' tsh'y'vd (vgvykh) [vgvyykh] l'tkhshly 'vd n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: neither will I suffer the shame of the nations any more to be heard against thee, neither shalt thou bear the reproach of the peoples any more, neither shalt thou cause thy nations to stumble any more, saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים עַל־אַדְמָתָ֔ם וַיְטַמְּא֣וּ אוֹתָ֔הּ בְּדַרְכָּ֖ם וּבַעֲלִֽילוֹתָ֑ם כְּטֻמְאַת֙ הַנִּדָּ֔ה הָיְתָ֥ה דַרְכָּ֖ם לְפָנָֽי׃
