verses.translit: bn'dm byt yshr'l yshbym 'l'dmtm vytm'v 'vth bdrkhm vb'lylvtm khtm't hndh hyth drkhm lpny
verses.translation: ’Son of man, when the house of Israel dwelt in their own land, they defiled it by their way and by their doings; their way before Me was as the uncleanness of a woman in her impurity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ חֲמָתִי֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם עַל־הַדָּ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־שָׁפְכ֣וּ עַל־הָאָ֑רֶץ וּבְגִלּוּלֵיהֶ֖ם טִמְּאֽוּהָ׃
verses.translit: v'shpkh chmty 'lyhm 'lhdm 'shrshpkhv 'lh'rts vbglvlyhm tm'vh
verses.translation: Wherefore I poured out My fury upon them for the blood which they had shed upon the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָפִ֤יץ אֹתָם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וַיִּזָּר֖וּ בָּאֲרָצ֑וֹת כְּדַרְכָּ֥ם וְכַעֲלִילוֹתָ֖ם שְׁפַטְתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: v'pyts 'tm bgvym vyzrv b'rtsvt khdrkhm vkh'lylvtm shpttym
verses.translation: and I scattered them among the nations, and they were dispersed through the countries; according to their way and according to their doings I judged them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּב֗וֹא אֶל־הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣אוּ שָׁ֔ם וַֽיְחַלְּל֖וּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשִׁ֑י בֶּאֱמֹ֤ר לָהֶם֙ עַם־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֵ֔לֶּה וּמֵאַרְצ֖וֹ יָצָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: vybv' 'lhgvym 'shrb'v shm vychllv 'tshm qdshy b'mr lhm 'myhvh 'lh vm'rtsv yts'v
verses.translation: And when they came unto the nations, whither they came, they profaned My holy name; in that men said of them: These are the people of the LORD, and are gone forth out of His land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶחְמֹ֖ל עַל־שֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשִׁ֑י אֲשֶׁ֤ר חִלְּלֻ֙הוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֥אוּ שָֽׁמָּה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'chml 'lshm qdshy 'shr chllhv byt yshr'l bgvym 'shrb'v shmh {p}
verses.translation: But I had pity for My holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations, whither they came.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר לְבֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה לֹ֧א לְמַעַנְכֶ֛ם אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י אִם־לְשֵׁם־קׇדְשִׁי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חִלַּלְתֶּ֔ם בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֥אתֶם שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr lbytyshr'l khh 'mr 'dny yhvh l' lm'nkhm 'ny 'shh byt yshr'l khy 'mlshmqdshy 'shr chlltm bgvym 'shrb'tm shm
verses.translation: Therefore say unto the house of Israel: Thus saith the Lord GOD: I do not this for your sake, O house of Israel, but for My holy name, which ye have profaned among the nations, whither ye came.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּ֞י אֶת־שְׁמִ֣י הַגָּד֗וֹל הַֽמְחֻלָּל֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר חִלַּלְתֶּ֖ם בְּתוֹכָ֑ם וְיָדְע֨וּ הַגּוֹיִ֜ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה בְּהִקָּדְשִׁ֥י בָכֶ֖ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vqdshty 'tshmy hgdvl hmchll bgvym 'shr chlltm btvkhm vyd'v hgvym khy'ny yhvh n'm 'dny yhvh bhqdshy bkhm l'ynyhm
verses.translation: And I will sanctify My great name, which hath been profaned among the nations, which ye have profaned in the midst of them; and the nations shall know that I am the LORD, saith the Lord GOD, when I shall be sanctified in you before their eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְקִבַּצְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִכׇּל־הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֶל־אַדְמַתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vlqchty 'tkhm mnhgvym vqbtsty 'tkhm mkhlh'rtsvt vhb'ty 'tkhm 'l'dmtkhm
verses.translation: For I will take you from among the nations, and gather you out of all the countries, and will bring you into your own land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָרַקְתִּ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם מַ֥יִם טְהוֹרִ֖ים וּטְהַרְתֶּ֑ם מִכֹּ֧ל טֻמְאוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם וּמִכׇּל־גִּלּ֥וּלֵיכֶ֖ם אֲטַהֵ֥ר אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vzrqty 'lykhm mym thvrym vthrtm mkhl tm'vtykhm vmkhlglvlykhm 'thr 'tkhm
verses.translation: And I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean; from all your uncleannesses, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ לֵ֣ב חָדָ֔שׁ וְר֥וּחַ חֲדָשָׁ֖ה אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וַהֲסִ֨רֹתִ֜י אֶת־לֵ֤ב הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ מִבְּשַׂרְכֶ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֥י לָכֶ֖ם לֵ֥ב בָּשָֽׂר׃
verses.translit: vntty lkhm lb chdsh vrvch chdshh 'tn bqrbkhm vhsrty 'tlb h'bn mbshrkhm vntty lkhm lb bshr
verses.translation: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you; and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you a heart of flesh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־רוּחִ֖י אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְעָשִׂ֗יתִי אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־בְּחֻקַּי֙ תֵּלֵ֔כוּ וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֥י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'trvchy 'tn bqrbkhm v'shyty 't 'shrbchqy tlkhv vmshpty tshmrv v'shytm
verses.translation: And I will put My spirit within you, and cause you to walk in My statutes, and ye shall keep Mine ordinances, and do them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִישַׁבְתֶּ֣ם בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וִהְיִ֤יתֶם לִי֙ לְעָ֔ם וְאָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshbtm b'rts 'shr ntty l'btykhm vhyytm ly l'm v'nkhy 'hyh lkhm l'lhym
verses.translation: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be My people, and I will be your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִכֹּ֖ל טֻמְאֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְקָרָ֤אתִי אֶל־הַדָּגָן֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אֹת֔וֹ וְלֹא־אֶתֵּ֥ן עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם רָעָֽב׃
verses.translit: vhvsh'ty 'tkhm mkhl tm'vtykhm vqr'ty 'lhdgn vhrbyty 'tv vl''tn 'lykhm r'b
verses.translation: And I will save you from all your uncleannesses; and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִרְבֵּיתִי֙ אֶת־פְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ וּתְנוּבַ֖ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה לְמַ֗עַן אֲ֠שֶׁ֠ר לֹ֣א תִקְח֥וּ ע֛וֹד חֶרְפַּ֥ת רָעָ֖ב בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: vhrbyty 'tpry h'ts vtnvbt hshdh lm'n 'shr l' tqchv 'vd chrpt r'b bgvym
verses.translation: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye may receive no more the reproach of famine among the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־דַּרְכֵיכֶ֣ם הָרָעִ֔ים וּמַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־טוֹבִ֑ים וּנְקֹֽטֹתֶם֙ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל עֲוֺנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל תּוֹעֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vzkhrtm 'tdrkhykhm hr'ym vm'llykhm 'shr l'tvbym vnqttm bpnykhm 'l 'vntykhm v'l tv'bvtykhm
verses.translation: Then shall ye remember your evil ways, and your doings that were not good; and ye shall loathe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֧א לְמַעַנְכֶ֣ם אֲנִֽי־עֹשֶׂ֗ה נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה יִוָּדַ֖ע לָכֶ֑ם בּ֧וֹשׁוּ וְהִכָּֽלְמ֛וּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l' lm'nkhm 'ny'shh n'm 'dny yhvh yvd' lkhm bvshv vhkhlmv mdrkhykhm byt yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: Not for your sake do I this, saith the Lord GOD, be it known unto you; be ashamed and confounded for your ways, O house of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה בְּיוֹם֙ טַהֲרִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִכֹּ֖ל עֲוֺנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהֽוֹשַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת־הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים וְנִבְנ֖וּ הֶחֳרָבֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh byvm thry 'tkhm mkhl 'vnvtykhm vhvshbty 'th'rym vnbnv hchrbvt
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: In the day that I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the waste places shall be builded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאָ֥רֶץ הַנְּשַׁמָּ֖ה תֵּעָבֵ֑ד תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיְתָ֣ה שְׁמָמָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כׇּל־עוֹבֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vh'rts hnshmh t'bd tcht 'shr hyth shmmh l'yny khl'vbr
verses.translation: And the land that was desolate shall be tilled, whereas it was a desolation in the sight of all that passed by.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמְר֗וּ הָאָ֤רֶץ הַלֵּ֙זוּ֙ הַנְּשַׁמָּ֔ה הָיְתָ֖ה כְּגַן־עֵ֑דֶן וְהֶעָרִ֧ים הֶחֳרֵב֛וֹת וְהַֽנְשַׁמּ֥וֹת וְהַנֶּהֱרָס֖וֹת בְּצוּר֥וֹת יָשָֽׁבוּ׃
verses.translit: v'mrv h'rts hlzv hnshmh hyth khgn'dn vh'rym hchrbvt vhnshmvt vhnhrsvt btsvrvt yshbv
verses.translation: And they shall say: This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are fortified and inhabited.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָדְע֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽשָּׁאֲרוּ֮ סְבִיבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֒ כִּ֣י  אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה בָּנִ֙יתִי֙ הַנֶּ֣הֱרָס֔וֹת נָטַ֖עְתִּי הַנְּשַׁמָּ֑ה אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִֽׂיתִי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyd'v hgvym 'shr ysh'rv sbybvtykhm khy  'ny yhvh bnyty hnhrsvt nt'ty hnshmh 'ny yhvh dbrty v'shyty {s}
verses.translation: Then the nations that are left round about you shall know that I the LORD have builded the ruined places, and planted that which was desolate; I the LORD have spoken it, and I will do it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה ע֗וֹד זֹ֛את אִדָּרֵ֥שׁ לְבֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָהֶ֑ם אַרְבֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם כַּצֹּ֖אן אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'vd z't 'drsh lbytyshr'l l'shvt lhm 'rbh 'tm khts'n 'dm
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: I will yet for this be inquired of by the house of Israel, to do it for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּצֹ֣אן קׇדָשִׁ֗ים כְּצֹ֤אן יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ בְּמ֣וֹעֲדֶ֔יהָ כֵּ֤ן תִּֽהְיֶ֙ינָה֙ הֶעָרִ֣ים הֶחֳרֵב֔וֹת מְלֵא֖וֹת צֹ֣אן אָדָ֑ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khts'n qdshym khts'n yrvshl͏m bmv'dyh khn thyynh h'rym hchrbvt ml'vt ts'n 'dm vyd'v khy'ny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: As the flock for sacrifice, as the flock of Jerusalem in her appointed seasons, so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men; and they shall know that I am the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָיְתָ֣ה עָלַי֮ יַד־יְהֹוָה֒ וַיּוֹצִאֵ֤נִֽי בְר֙וּחַ֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיְנִיחֵ֖נִי בְּת֣וֹךְ הַבִּקְעָ֑ה וְהִ֖יא מְלֵאָ֥ה עֲצָמֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: hyth 'ly ydyhvh vyvts'ny brvch yhvh vynychny btvkh hbq'h vhy' ml'h 'tsmvt
verses.translation: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and the LORD carried me out in a spirit, and set me down in the midst of the valley, and it was full of bones;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֶעֱבִירַ֥נִי עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֑יב וְהִנֵּ֨ה רַבּ֤וֹת מְאֹד֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הַבִּקְעָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֖ה יְבֵשׁ֥וֹת מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vh'byrny 'lyhm sbyb  sbyb vhnh rbvt m'd 'lpny hbq'h vhnh ybshvt m'd
verses.translation: and He caused me to pass by them round about, and, behold, there were very many in the open valley; and, lo, they were very dry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם הֲתִֽחְיֶ֖ינָה הָעֲצָמ֣וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וָאֹמַ֕ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֖ה אַתָּ֥ה יָדָֽעְתָּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm htchyynh h'tsmvt h'lh v'mr 'dny yhvh 'th yd't
verses.translation: And He said unto me: ‘Son of man, can these bones live?’ And I answered: ‘O Lord GOD, Thou knowest.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל־הָעֲצָמ֣וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם הָֽעֲצָמוֹת֙ הַיְבֵשׁ֔וֹת שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hnb' 'lh'tsmvt h'lh v'mrt 'lyhm h'tsmvt hybshvt shm'v dbryhvh
verses.translation: Then He said unto me: ‘Prophesy over these bones, and say unto them: O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה לָעֲצָמ֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה הִנֵּ֨ה אֲנִ֜י מֵבִ֥יא בָכֶ֛ם ר֖וּחַ וִחְיִיתֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh l'tsmvt h'lh hnh 'ny mby' bkhm rvch vchyytm
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones: Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּי֩ עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם גִּידִ֜ים וְֽהַעֲלֵתִ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם בָּשָׂ֗ר וְקָרַמְתִּ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ ע֔וֹר וְנָתַתִּ֥י בָכֶ֛ם ר֖וּחַ וִחְיִיתֶ֑ם וִידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vntty 'lykhm gydym vh'lty 'lykhm bshr vqrmty 'lykhm 'vr vntty bkhm rvch vchyytm vyd'tm khy'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I am the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִבֵּ֖אתִי כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צֻוֵּ֑יתִי וַֽיְהִי־ק֤וֹל כְּהִנָּֽבְאִי֙ וְהִנֵּה־רַ֔עַשׁ וַתִּקְרְב֣וּ עֲצָמ֔וֹת עֶ֖צֶם אֶל־עַצְמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vnb'ty kh'shr tsvyty vyhyqvl khhnb'y vhnhr'sh vtqrbv 'tsmvt 'tsm 'l'tsmv
verses.translation: So I prophesied as I was commanded; and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a commotion, and the bones came together, bone to its bone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאִ֜יתִי וְהִנֵּֽה־עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם גִּדִים֙ וּבָשָׂ֣ר עָלָ֔ה וַיִּקְרַ֧ם עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם ע֖וֹר מִלְמָ֑עְלָה וְר֖וּחַ אֵ֥ין בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vr'yty vhnh'lyhm gdym vbshr 'lh vyqrm 'lyhm 'vr mlm'lh vrvch 'yn bhm
verses.translation: And I beheld, and, lo, there were sinews upon them, and flesh came up, and skin covered them above; but there was no breath in them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־הָר֑וּחַ הִנָּבֵ֣א בֶן־אָ֠דָ֠ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֶל־הָר֜וּחַ {ס} כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה מֵאַרְבַּ֤ע רוּחוֹת֙ בֹּ֣אִי הָר֔וּחַ וּפְחִ֛י בַּהֲרוּגִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה וְיִֽחְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hnb' 'lhrvch hnb' bn'dm v'mrt 'lhrvch {s} khh'mr  'dny yhvh m'rb' rvchvt b'y hrvch vpchy bhrvgym h'lh vychyv
verses.translation: Then said He unto me: ‘Prophesy unto the breath, prophesy, son of man, and say to the breath: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנַּבֵּ֖אתִי כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֑נִי וַתָּבוֹא֩ בָהֶ֨ם הָר֜וּחַ וַיִּֽחְי֗וּ וַיַּֽעַמְדוּ֙ עַל־רַגְלֵיהֶ֔ם חַ֖יִל גָּד֥וֹל מְאֹד־מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vhnb'ty kh'shr tsvny vtbv' bhm hrvch vychyv vy'mdv 'lrglyhm chyl gdvl m'dm'd
verses.translation: So I prophesied as He commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great host.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֘אמֶר֮ אֵלַי֒ בֶּן־אָדָ֕ם הָעֲצָמ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה כׇּל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵ֑מָּה הִנֵּ֣ה אֹמְרִ֗ים יָבְשׁ֧וּ עַצְמוֹתֵ֛ינוּ וְאָבְדָ֥ה תִקְוָתֵ֖נוּ נִגְזַ֥רְנוּ לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm h'tsmvt h'lh khlbyt yshr'l hmh hnh 'mrym ybshv 'tsmvtynv v'bdh tqvtnv ngzrnv lnv
verses.translation: Then He said unto me: ‘Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel; behold, they say: Our bones are dried up, and our hope is lost; we are clean cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֩ הִנָּבֵ֨א וְאָמַרְתָּ֜ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ הִנֵּה֩ אֲנִ֨י פֹתֵ֜חַ אֶת־קִבְרֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהַעֲלֵיתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִקִּבְרוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם עַמִּ֑י וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֶל־אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnb' v'mrt 'lyhm khh'mr 'dny yhvh hnh 'ny ptch 'tqbrvtykhm vh'lyty 'tkhm mqbrvtykhm 'my vhb'ty 'tkhm 'l'dmt yshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore prophesy, and say unto them: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, O My people; and I will bring you into the land of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה בְּפִתְחִ֣י אֶת־קִבְרֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וּבְהַעֲלוֹתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִקִּבְרוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם עַמִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vyd'tm khy'ny yhvh bptchy 'tqbrvtykhm vbh'lvty 'tkhm mqbrvtykhm 'my
verses.translation: And ye shall know that I am the LORD, when I have opened your graves, and caused you to come up out of your graves, O My people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י רוּחִ֤י בָכֶם֙ וִחְיִיתֶ֔ם וְהִנַּחְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם עַל־אַדְמַתְכֶ֑ם וִידַעְתֶּ֞ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֧י יְהֹוָ֛ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִׂ֖יתִי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vntty rvchy bkhm vchyytm vhnchty 'tkhm 'l'dmtkhm vyd'tm khy'ny yhvh dbrty v'shyty n'myhvh {p}
verses.translation: And I will put My spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I will place you in your own land; and ye shall know that I the LORD have spoken, and performed it, saith the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם קַח־לְךָ֙ עֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֔ד וּכְתֹ֤ב עָלָיו֙ לִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְלִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֲבֵרָ֑ו וּלְקַח֙ עֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֔ד וּכְת֣וֹב עָלָ֗יו לְיוֹסֵף֙ עֵ֣ץ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְכׇל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֲבֵרָֽו׃
verses.translit: v'th bn'dm qchlkh 'ts 'chd vkhtb 'lyv lyhvdh vlbny yshr'l chbrv vlqch 'ts 'chd vkhtvb 'lyv lyvsf 'ts 'prym vkhlbyt yshr'l chbrv
verses.translation: ’And thou, son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it: For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions; then take another stick, and write upon it: For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and of all the house of Israel his companions;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקָרַ֨ב אֹתָ֜ם אֶחָ֧ד אֶל־אֶחָ֛ד לְךָ֖ לְעֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֑ד וְהָי֥וּ לַאֲחָדִ֖ים בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vqrb 'tm 'chd 'l'chd lkh l'ts 'chd vhyv l'chdym bydkh
verses.translation: and join them for thee one to another into one stick, that they may become one in thy hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ יֹאמְר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יךָ בְּנֵ֥י עַמְּךָ֖ לֵאמֹ֑ר הֲלֽוֹא־תַגִּ֥יד לָ֖נוּ מָה־אֵ֥לֶּה לָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vkh'shr y'mrv 'lykh bny 'mkh l'mr hlv'tgyd lnv mh'lh lkh
verses.translation: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying: Wilt thou not tell us what thou meanest by these?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵהֶ֗ם כֹּה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ הִנֵּה֩ אֲנִ֨י לֹקֵ֜חַ אֶת־עֵ֤ץ יוֹסֵף֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיַד־אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְשִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֲבֵרָ֑ו וְנָתַתִּי֩ אוֹתָ֨ם עָלָ֜יו אֶת־עֵ֣ץ יְהוּדָ֗ה וַֽעֲשִׂיתִם֙ לְעֵ֣ץ אֶחָ֔ד וְהָי֥וּ אֶחָ֖ד בְּיָדִֽי׃
verses.translit: dbr 'lhm khh'mr 'dny yhvh hnh 'ny lqch 't'ts yvsf 'shr byd'prym vshbty yshr'l chbrv vntty 'vtm 'lyv 't'ts yhvdh v'shytm l'ts 'chd vhyv 'chd bydy
verses.translation: say into them: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions; and I will put them unto him together with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in My hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֨וּ הָעֵצִ֜ים אֲֽשֶׁר־תִּכְתֹּ֧ב עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם בְּיָדְךָ֖ לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyv h'tsym 'shrtkhtb 'lyhm bydkh l'ynyhm
verses.translation: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thy hand before their eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כֹּה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ הִנֵּ֨ה אֲנִ֤י לֹקֵ֙חַ֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִבֵּ֥ין הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָֽלְכוּ־שָׁ֑ם וְקִבַּצְתִּ֤י אֹתָם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם אֶל־אַדְמָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vdbr 'lyhm khh'mr 'dny yhvh hnh 'ny lqch 'tbny yshr'l mbyn hgvym 'shr hlkhvshm vqbtsty 'tm msbyb vhb'ty 'vtm 'l'dmtm
verses.translation: And say unto them: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the nations, whither they are gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתִי אֹ֠תָ֠ם לְג֨וֹי אֶחָ֤ד בָּאָ֙רֶץ֙ בְּהָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמֶ֧לֶךְ אֶחָ֛ד יִהְיֶ֥ה לְכֻלָּ֖ם לְמֶ֑לֶךְ וְלֹ֤א (יהיה) [יִֽהְיוּ־]עוֹד֙ לִשְׁנֵ֣י גוֹיִ֔ם וְלֹ֨א יֵחָ֥צוּ ע֛וֹד לִשְׁתֵּ֥י מַמְלָכ֖וֹת עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: v'shyty 'tm lgvy 'chd b'rts bhry yshr'l vmlkh 'chd yhyh lkhlm lmlkh vl' (yhyh) [yhyv]'vd lshny gvym vl' ychtsv 'vd lshty mmlkhvt 'vd
verses.translation: and I will make them one nation in the land, upon the mountains of Israel, and one king shall be king to them all; and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֧א יִֽטַּמְּא֣וּ ע֗וֹד בְּגִלּֽוּלֵיהֶם֙ וּבְשִׁקּ֣וּצֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְכֹ֖ל פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֑ם וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֗ם מִכֹּ֤ל מוֹשְׁבֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטְא֣וּ בָהֶ֔ם וְטִהַרְתִּ֤י אוֹתָם֙ וְהָיוּ־לִ֣י לְעָ֔ם וַאֲנִ֕י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vl' ytm'v 'vd bglvlyhm vbshqvtsyhm vbkhl psh'yhm vhvsh'ty 'tm mkhl mvshbtyhm 'shr cht'v bhm vthrty 'vtm vhyvly l'm v'ny 'hyh lhm l'lhym
verses.translation: neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions; but I will save them out of all their dwelling-places, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them; so shall they be My people, and I will be their God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַבְדִּ֤י דָוִד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְרוֹעֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד יִהְיֶ֣ה לְכֻלָּ֑ם וּבְמִשְׁפָּטַ֣י יֵלֵ֔כוּ וְחֻקּוֹתַ֥י יִשְׁמְר֖וּ וְעָשׂ֥וּ אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'bdy dvd mlkh 'lyhm vrv'h 'chd yhyh lkhlm vbmshpty ylkhv vchqvty yshmrv v'shv 'vtm
verses.translation: And My servant David shall be king over them, and they all shall have one shepherd; they shall also walk in Mine ordinances, and observe My statutes, and do them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָשְׁב֣וּ עַל־הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַ֙תִּי֙ לְעַבְדִּ֣י לְיַֽעֲקֹ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָֽשְׁבוּ־בָ֖הּ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְיָשְׁב֣וּ עָלֶ֡יהָ הֵ֠מָּה וּבְנֵיהֶ֞ם וּבְנֵ֤י בְנֵיהֶם֙ עַד־עוֹלָ֔ם וְדָוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֔י נָשִׂ֥יא לָהֶ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshbv 'lh'rts 'shr ntty l'bdy ly'qb 'shr yshbvbh 'bvtykhm vyshbv 'lyh hmh vbnyhm vbny bnyhm 'd'vlm vdvd 'bdy nshy' lhm l'vlm
verses.translation: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob My servant, wherein your fathers dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, they, and their children, and their children’s children, for ever; and David My servant shall be their prince for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכָרַתִּ֤י לָהֶם֙ בְּרִ֣ית שָׁל֔וֹם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָ֖ם יִהְיֶ֣ה אוֹתָ֑ם וּנְתַתִּים֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אוֹתָ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֧י אֶת־מִקְדָּשִׁ֛י בְּתוֹכָ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vkhrty lhm bryt shlvm bryt 'vlm yhyh 'vtm vnttym vhrbyty 'vtm vntty 'tmqdshy btvkhm l'vlm
verses.translation: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them—it shall be an everlasting covenant with them; and I will establish them, and multiply them, and will set My sanctuary in the midst of them for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה מִשְׁכָּנִי֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתִי לָהֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִ֑ים וְהֵ֖מָּה יִהְיוּ־לִ֥י לְעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyh mshkhny 'lyhm vhyyty lhm l'lhym vhmh yhyvly l'm
verses.translation: My dwelling-place also shall be over them; and I will be their God, and they shall be My people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה מְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בִּהְי֧וֹת מִקְדָּשִׁ֛י בְּתוֹכָ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyd'v hgvym khy 'ny yhvh mqdsh 'tyshr'l bhyvt mqdshy btvkhm l'vlm {p}
verses.translation: And the nations shall know that I am the LORD that sanctify Israel, when My sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for ever.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֶּן־אָדָ֗ם שִׂ֤ים פָּנֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶל־גּוֹג֙ אֶ֣רֶץ הַמָּג֔וֹג נְשִׂ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ מֶ֣שֶׁךְ וְתֻבָ֑ל וְהִנָּבֵ֖א עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: bn'dm shym pnykh 'lgvg 'rts hmgvg nshy' r'sh mshkh vtbl vhnb' 'lyv
verses.translation: ’Son of man, set thy face toward Gog, of the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ גּ֔וֹג נְשִׂ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ מֶ֥שֶׁךְ וְתֻבָֽל׃
verses.translit: v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'lykh gvg nshy' r'sh mshkh vtbl
verses.translation: and say: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשׁ֣וֹבַבְתִּ֔יךָ וְנָתַתִּ֥י חַחִ֖ים בִּלְחָיֶ֑יךָ וְהוֹצֵאתִי֩ אוֹתְךָ֨ וְאֶת־כׇּל־חֵילֶ֜ךָ סוּסִ֣ים וּפָרָשִׁ֗ים לְבֻשֵׁ֤י מִכְלוֹל֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם קָהָ֥ל רָב֙ צִנָּ֣ה וּמָגֵ֔ן תֹּפְשֵׂ֥י חֲרָב֖וֹת כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vshvbbtykh vntty chchym blchyykh vhvts'ty 'vtkh v'tkhlchylkh svsym vprshym lbshy mkhlvl khlm qhl rb tsnh vmgn tpshy chrbvt khlm
verses.translation: and I will turn thee about, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed most gorgeously, a great company with buckler and shield, all of them handling swords:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּרַ֛ס כּ֥וּשׁ וּפ֖וּט אִתָּ֑ם כֻּלָּ֖ם מָגֵ֥ן וְכוֹבָֽע׃
verses.translit: prs khvsh vpvt 'tm khlm mgn vkhvb'
verses.translation: Persia, Cush, and Put with them, all of them with shield and helmet;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֹּ֚מֶר וְכׇל־אֲגַפֶּ֔יהָ בֵּ֚ית תּֽוֹגַרְמָ֔ה יַרְכְּתֵ֥י צָפ֖וֹן וְאֶת־כׇּל־אֲגַפָּ֑יו עַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: gmr vkhl'gpyh byt tvgrmh yrkhty tspvn v'tkhl'gpyv 'mym rbym 'tkh
verses.translation: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah in the uttermost parts of the north, and all his bands; even many peoples with thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִכֹּן֙ וְהָכֵ֣ן לְךָ֔ אַתָּ֕ה וְכׇל־קְהָלֶ֖ךָ הַנִּקְהָלִ֣ים עָלֶ֑יךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לְמִשְׁמָֽר׃
verses.translit: hkhn vhkhn lkh 'th vkhlqhlkh hnqhlym 'lykh vhyyt lhm lmshmr
verses.translation: Be thou prepared, and prepare for thyself, thou, and all thy company that are assembled unto thee, and be thou guarded of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִיָּמִ֣ים רַבִּים֮ תִּפָּקֵד֒ בְּאַחֲרִ֨ית הַשָּׁנִ֜ים תָּב֣וֹא  אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ  מְשׁוֹבֶ֣בֶת מֵחֶ֗רֶב מְקֻבֶּ֙צֶת֙ מֵעַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים עַ֚ל הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־הָי֥וּ לְחׇרְבָּ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד וְהִיא֙ מֵעַמִּ֣ים הוּצָ֔אָה וְיָשְׁב֥וּ לָבֶ֖טַח כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: mymym rbym tpqd b'chryt hshnym tbv'  'l'rts  mshvbbt mchrb mqbtst m'mym rbym 'l hry yshr'l 'shrhyv lchrbh tmyd vhy' m'mym hvts'h vyshbv lbtch khlm
verses.translation: After many days thou shalt be mustered for service, in the latter years thou shalt come against the land that is brought back from the sword, that is gathered out of many peoples, against the mountains of Israel, which have been a continual waste; but it is brought forth out of the peoples, and they dwell safely all of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָלִ֙יתָ֙ כַּשֹּׁאָ֣ה תָב֔וֹא כֶּעָנָ֛ן לְכַסּ֥וֹת הָאָ֖רֶץ תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה אַתָּה֙ וְכׇל־אֲגַפֶּ֔יךָ וְעַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים אוֹתָֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lyt khsh'h tbv' kh'nn lkhsvt h'rts thyh 'th vkhl'gpykh v'mym rbym 'vtkh {s}
verses.translation: And thou shalt ascend, thou shalt come like a storm, thou shalt be like a cloud to cover the land, thou, and all thy bands, and many peoples with thee. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה וְהָיָ֣ה  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יַעֲל֤וּ דְבָרִים֙ עַל־לְבָבֶ֔ךָ וְחָשַׁבְתָּ֖ מַחֲשֶׁ֥בֶת רָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh vhyh  byvm hhv' y'lv dbrym 'llbbkh vchshbt mchshbt r'h
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: It shall come to pass in that day, that things shall come into thy mind, and thou shalt devise an evil device;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֗ אֶֽעֱלֶה֙ עַל־אֶ֣רֶץ פְּרָז֔וֹת אָבוֹא֙ הַשֹּׁ֣קְטִ֔ים יֹשְׁבֵ֖י לָבֶ֑טַח כֻּלָּ֗ם יֹֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּאֵ֣ין חוֹמָ֔ה וּבְרִ֥יחַ וּדְלָתַ֖יִם אֵ֥ין לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mrt ''lh 'l'rts przvt 'bv' hshqtym yshby lbtch khlm yshbym b'yn chvmh vbrych vdltym 'yn lhm
verses.translation: and thou shalt say: I will go up against the land of unwalled villages; I will come upon them that are at quiet, that dwell safely, all of them dwelling without walls, and having neither bars nor gates;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׁלֹ֥ל שָׁלָ֖ל וְלָבֹ֣ז בַּ֑ז לְהָשִׁ֨יב יָדְךָ֜ עַל־חֳרָב֣וֹת נוֹשָׁב֗וֹת וְאֶל־עַם֙ מְאֻסָּ֣ף מִגּוֹיִ֔ם עֹשֶׂה֙ מִקְנֶ֣ה וְקִנְיָ֔ן יֹשְׁבֵ֖י עַל־טַבּ֥וּר הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: lshll shll vlbz bz lhshyb ydkh 'lchrbvt nvshbvt v'l'm m'sf mgvym 'shh mqnh vqnyn yshby 'ltbvr h'rts
verses.translation: to take the spoil and to take the prey; to turn thy hand against the waste places that are now inhabited, and against the people that are gathered out of the nations, that have gotten cattle and goods, that dwell in the middle of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁבָ֡א וּ֠דְדָ֠ן וְסֹחֲרֵ֨י תַרְשִׁ֤ישׁ וְכׇל־כְּפִירֶ֙יהָ֙ יֹאמְר֣וּ לְךָ֔ הֲלִשְׁלֹ֤ל שָׁלָל֙ אַתָּ֣ה בָ֔א הֲלָבֹ֥ז בַּ֖ז הִקְהַ֣לְתָּ קְהָלֶ֑ךָ לָשֵׂ֣את  כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֗ב לָקַ֙חַת֙ מִקְנֶ֣ה וְקִנְיָ֔ן לִשְׁלֹ֖ל שָׁלָ֥ל גָּדֽוֹל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shb' vddn vschry trshysh vkhlkhpyryh y'mrv lkh hlshll shll 'th b' hlbz bz hqhlt qhlkh lsh't  khsf vzhb lqcht mqnh vqnyn lshll shll gdvl {s}
verses.translation: Sheba, and Dedan, and the merchants of Tarshish, with all the magnates thereof, shall say unto thee: Comest thou to take the spoil? hast thou assembled thy company to take the prey? to carry away silver and gold, to take away cattle and goods, to take great spoil?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א בֶן־אָדָ֔ם וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ לְג֔וֹג כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה הֲל֣וֹא  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא בְּשֶׁ֨בֶת עַמִּ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לָבֶ֖טַח תֵּדָֽע׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnb' bn'dm v'mrt lgvg khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hlv'  byvm hhv' bshbt 'my yshr'l lbtch td'
verses.translation: Therefore, son of man, prophesy, and say unto Gog: Thus saith the Lord GOD: In that day when My people Israel dwelleth safely, shalt thou not know it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֤אתָ מִמְּקֽוֹמְךָ֙ מִיַּרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֔וֹן אַתָּ֕ה וְעַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים אִתָּ֑ךְ רֹכְבֵ֤י סוּסִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם קָהָ֥ל גָּד֖וֹל וְחַ֥יִל רָֽב׃
verses.translit: vb't mmqvmkh myrkhty tspvn 'th v'mym rbym 'tkh rkhby svsym khlm qhl gdvl vchyl rb
verses.translation: And thou shalt come from thy place out of the uttermost parts of the north, thou, and many peoples with thee, all of them riding upon horses, a great company and a mighty army;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָלִ֙יתָ֙ עַל־עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֶּעָנָ֖ן לְכַסּ֣וֹת הָאָ֑רֶץ בְּאַחֲרִ֨ית הַיָּמִ֜ים תִּהְיֶ֗ה וַהֲבִאוֹתִ֙יךָ֙ עַל־אַרְצִ֔י לְמַ֩עַן֩ דַּ֨עַת הַגּוֹיִ֜ם אֹתִ֗י בְּהִקָּדְשִׁ֥י בְךָ֛ לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם גּֽוֹג׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lyt 'l'my yshr'l kh'nn lkhsvt h'rts b'chryt hymym thyh vhb'vtykh 'l'rtsy lm'n d't hgvym 'ty bhqdshy bkh l'ynyhm gvg {s}
verses.translation: and thou shalt come up against My people Israel, as a cloud to cover the land; it shall be in the end of days, and I will bring thee against My land, that the nations may know Me, when I shall be sanctified through thee, O Gog, before their eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה הַאַתָּה־ה֨וּא אֲשֶׁר־דִּבַּ֜רְתִּי בְּיָמִ֣ים קַדְמוֹנִ֗ים בְּיַד֙ עֲבָדַי֙ נְבִיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַֽנִּבְּאִ֛ים בַּיָּמִ֥ים הָהֵ֖ם שָׁנִ֑ים לְהָבִ֥יא אֹתְךָ֖ עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khh'mr 'dny yhvh h'thhv' 'shrdbrty bymym qdmvnym byd 'bdy nby'y yshr'l hnb'ym bymym hhm shnym lhby' 'tkh 'lyhm {s}
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Art thou he of whom I spoke in old time by My servants the prophets of Israel, that prophesied in those days for many years, that I would bring thee against them?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא בְּי֨וֹם בּ֥וֹא גוֹג֙ עַל־אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה תַּעֲלֶ֥ה חֲמָתִ֖י בְּאַפִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vhyh  byvm hhv' byvm bv' gvg 'l'dmt yshr'l n'm 'dny yhvh t'lh chmty b'py
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, saith the Lord GOD, that My fury shall arise up in My nostrils.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְקִנְאָתִ֥י בְאֵשׁ־עֶבְרָתִ֖י דִּבַּ֑רְתִּי אִם־לֹ֣א  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ רַ֣עַשׁ גָּד֔וֹל עַ֖ל אַדְמַ֥ת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vbqn'ty b'sh'brty dbrty 'ml'  byvm hhv' yhyh r'sh gdvl 'l 'dmt yshr'l
verses.translation: For in My jealousy and in the fire of My wrath have I spoken: Surely in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָעֲשׁ֣וּ מִפָּנַ֡י דְּגֵ֣י הַיָּם֩ וְע֨וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם וְחַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה וְכׇל־הָרֶ֙מֶשׂ֙ הָרֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל־הָאֲדָמָ֔ה וְכֹל֙ הָאָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וְנֶהֶרְס֣וּ הֶהָרִ֗ים וְנָֽפְלוּ֙ הַמַּדְרֵג֔וֹת וְכׇל־חוֹמָ֖ה לָאָ֥רֶץ תִּפּֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vr'shv mpny dgy hym v'vf hshmym vchyt hshdh vkhlhrmsh hrmsh 'lh'dmh vkhl h'dm 'shr 'lpny h'dmh vnhrsv hhrym vnplv hmdrgvt vkhlchvmh l'rts tpvl
verses.translation: so that the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the heaven, and the beasts of the field and all creeping things that creep upon the ground, and all the men that are upon the face of the earth, shall shake at My presence, and the mountains shall be thrown down, and the steep places shall fall, and every wall shall fall to the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקָרָ֨אתִי עָלָ֤יו לְכׇל־הָרַי֙ חֶ֔רֶב נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה חֶ֥רֶב אִ֖ישׁ בְּאָחִ֥יו תִּהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vqr'ty 'lyv lkhlhry chrb n'm 'dny yhvh chrb 'ysh b'chyv thyh
verses.translation: And I will call for a sword against him throughout all my mountains, saith the Lord GOD; every man’s sword shall be against his brother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֥י אִתּ֖וֹ בְּדֶ֣בֶר וּבְדָ֑ם וְגֶ֣שֶׁם שׁוֹטֵף֩ וְאַבְנֵ֨י אֶלְגָּבִ֜ישׁ אֵ֣שׁ וְגׇפְרִ֗ית אַמְטִ֤יר עָלָיו֙ וְעַל־אֲגַפָּ֔יו וְעַל־עַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vnshptty 'tv bdbr vbdm vgshm shvtf v'bny 'lgbysh 'sh vgpryt 'mtyr 'lyv v'l'gpyv v'l'mym rbym 'shr 'tv
verses.translation: And I will plead against him with pestilence and with blood; and I will cause to rain upon him, and upon his bands, and upon the many peoples that are with him, an overflowing shower, and great hailstones, fire, and brimstone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִתְגַּדִּלְתִּי֙ וְהִתְקַדִּשְׁתִּ֔י וְנ֣וֹדַעְתִּ֔י לְעֵינֵ֖י גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhtgdlty vhtqdshty vnvd'ty l'yny gvym rbym vyd'v khy'ny yhvh {s}
verses.translation: Thus will I magnify Myself, and sanctify Myself, and I will make Myself known in the eyes of many nations; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה בֶן־אָדָם֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א עַל־גּ֔וֹג וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה הִנְנִ֤י אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ גּ֔וֹג נְשִׂ֕יא רֹ֖אשׁ מֶ֥שֶׁךְ וְתֻבָֽל׃
verses.translit: v'th bn'dm hnb' 'lgvg v'mrt khh 'mr 'dny yhvh hnny 'lykh gvg nshy' r'sh mshkh vtbl
verses.translation: And thou, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, chief prince of Meshech and Tubal;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֹׁבַבְתִּ֙יךָ֙ וְשִׁשֵּׁאתִ֔יךָ וְהַעֲלִיתִ֖יךָ מִיַּרְכְּתֵ֣י צָפ֑וֹן וַהֲבִאוֹתִ֖ךָ עַל־הָרֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vshbbtykh vshsh'tykh vh'lytykh myrkhty tspvn vhb'vtkh 'lhry yshr'l
verses.translation: and I will turn thee about and lead thee on, and will cause thee to come up from the uttermost parts of the north; and I will bring thee upon the mountains of Israel;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִכֵּיתִ֥י קַשְׁתְּךָ֖ מִיַּ֣ד שְׂמֹאולֶ֑ךָ וְחִצֶּ֕יךָ מִיַּ֥ד יְמִינְךָ֖ אַפִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: vhkhyty qshtkh myd shm'vlkh vchtsykh myd ymynkh 'pyl
verses.translation: and I will smite thy bow out of thy left hand, and will cause thine arrows to fall out of thy right hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־הָרֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל תִּפּ֗וֹל אַתָּה֙ וְכׇל־אֲגַפֶּ֔יךָ וְעַמִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתָּ֑ךְ לְעֵ֨יט צִפּ֧וֹר כׇּל־כָּנָ֛ף וְחַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה נְתַתִּ֥יךָ לְאׇכְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lhry yshr'l tpvl 'th vkhl'gpykh v'mym 'shr 'tkh l'yt tspvr khlkhnf vchyt hshdh nttykh l'khlh
verses.translation: Thou shalt fall upon the mountains of Israel, thou, and all thy bands, and the peoples that are with thee; I will give thee unto the ravenous birds of every sort and to the beasts of the field, to be devoured.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה תִּפּ֑וֹל כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י דִבַּ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lpny hshdh tpvl khy 'ny dbrty n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Thou shalt fall upon the open field; for I have spoken it, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־אֵ֣שׁ בְּמָג֔וֹג וּבְיֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאִיִּ֖ים לָבֶ֑טַח וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּי־אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshlchty'sh bmgvg vbyshby h'yym lbtch vyd'v khy'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And I will send a fire on Magog, and on them that dwell safely in the isles; and they shall know that I am the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־שֵׁ֨ם קׇדְשִׁ֜י אוֹדִ֗יעַ בְּתוֹךְ֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹא־אַחֵ֥ל אֶת־שֵׁם־קׇדְשִׁ֖י ע֑וֹד וְיָדְע֤וּ הַגּוֹיִם֙ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה קָד֖וֹשׁ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'tshm qdshy 'vdy' btvkh 'my yshr'l vl''chl 'tshmqdshy 'vd vyd'v hgvym khy'ny yhvh qdvsh byshr'l
verses.translation: And My holy name will I make known in the midst of My people Israel; neither will I suffer My holy name to be profaned any more; and the nations shall know that I am the LORD, the Holy One in Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה בָאָה֙ וְנִֽהְיָ֔תָה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה ה֥וּא הַיּ֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּֽרְתִּי׃
verses.translit: hnh b'h vnhyth n'm 'dny yhvh hv' hyvm 'shr dbrty
verses.translation: Behold, it cometh, and it shall be done, saith the Lord GOD; This is the day whereof I have spoken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽיָצְא֞וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י  עָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּבִעֲר֡וּ וְ֠הִשִּׂ֠יקוּ בְּנֶ֨שֶׁק וּמָגֵ֤ן וְצִנָּה֙ בְּקֶ֣שֶׁת וּבְחִצִּ֔ים וּבְמַקֵּ֥ל יָ֖ד וּבְרֹ֑מַח וּבִעֲר֥וּ בָהֶ֛ם אֵ֖שׁ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyts'v yshby  'ry yshr'l vb'rv vhshyqv bnshq vmgn vtsnh bqsht vbchtsym vbmql yd vbrmch vb'rv bhm 'sh shb' shnym
verses.translation: And they that dwell in the cities of Israel shall go forth, and shall make fires of the weapons and use them as fuel, both the shields and the bucklers, the bows and the arrows, and the hand-staves, and the spears, and they shall make fires of them seven years;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־יִשְׂא֨וּ עֵצִ֜ים מִן־הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה וְלֹ֤א יַחְטְבוּ֙ מִן־הַיְּעָרִ֔ים כִּ֥י בַנֶּ֖שֶׁק יְבַעֲרוּ־אֵ֑שׁ וְשָׁלְל֣וּ אֶת־שֹׁלְלֵיהֶ֗ם וּבָֽזְזוּ֙ אֶת־בֹּ֣זְזֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vl'ysh'v 'tsym mnhshdh vl' ychtbv mnhy'rym khy bnshq yb'rv'sh vshllv 'tshllyhm vbzzv 'tbzzyhm n'm 'dny yhvh {s}
verses.translation: so that they shall take no wood out of the field, neither cut down any out of the forests, for they shall make fires of the weapons; and they shall spoil those that spoiled them, and rob those that robbed them, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה בַיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא אֶתֵּ֣ן לְגוֹג֩ ׀ מְקֽוֹם־שָׁ֨ם קֶ֜בֶר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גֵּ֤י הָעֹֽבְרִים֙ קִדְמַ֣ת הַיָּ֔ם וְחֹסֶ֥מֶת הִ֖יא אֶת־הָעֹֽבְרִ֑ים וְקָ֣בְרוּ שָׁ֗ם אֶת־גּוֹג֙ וְאֶת־כׇּל־הֲמוֹנֹ֔ה וְקָ֣רְא֔וּ גֵּ֖יא הֲמ֥וֹן גּֽוֹג׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' 'tn lgvg  mqvmshm qbr byshr'l gy h'brym qdmt hym vchsmt hy' 'th'brym vqbrv shm 'tgvg v'tkhlhmvnh vqr'v gy' hmvn gvg
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will give unto Gog a place fit for burial in Israel, the valley of them that pass through on the east of the sea; and it shall stop them that pass through; and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude; and they shall call it the valley of Hamon-gog.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּקְבָרוּם֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמַ֖עַן טַהֵ֣ר אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ שִׁבְעָ֖ה חֳדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vqbrvm byt yshr'l lm'n thr 'th'rts shb'h chdshym
verses.translation: And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying them, that they may cleanse the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקָֽבְרוּ֙ כׇּל־עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהָיָ֥ה לָהֶ֖ם לְשֵׁ֑ם י֚וֹם הִכָּ֣בְדִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: vqbrv khl'm h'rts vhyh lhm lshm yvm hkhbdy n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them, and it shall be to them a renown; in the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַנְשֵׁ֨י תָמִ֤יד יַבְדִּ֙ילוּ֙ עֹבְרִ֣ים בָּאָ֔רֶץ מְקַבְּרִ֣ים אֶת־הָעֹבְרִ֗ים אֶת־הַנּוֹתָרִ֛ים עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ לְטַהֲרָ֑הּ מִקְצֵ֥ה שִׁבְעָה־חֳדָשִׁ֖ים יַחְקֹֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: v'nshy tmyd ybdylv 'brym b'rts mqbrym 'th'brym 'thnvtrym 'lpny h'rts lthrh mqtsh shb'hchdshym ychqrv
verses.translation: And they shall set apart men of continual employment, that shall pass through the land to bury with them that pass through those that remain upon the face of the land, to cleanse it; after the end of seven months shall they search.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָבְר֤וּ הָעֹֽבְרִים֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְרָאָה֙ עֶ֣צֶם אָדָ֔ם וּבָנָ֥ה אֶצְל֖וֹ צִיּ֑וּן עַ֣ד קָבְר֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ הַֽמְקַבְּרִ֔ים אֶל־גֵּ֖יא הֲמ֥וֹן גּֽוֹג׃
verses.translit: v'brv h'brym b'rts vr'h 'tsm 'dm vbnh 'tslv tsyvn 'd qbrv 'tv hmqbrym 'lgy' hmvn gvg
verses.translation: And when they that pass through shall pass through the land, and any seeth a man’s bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon-gog.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֥ם שֶׁם־עִ֛יר הֲמוֹנָ֖הֿ וְטִהֲר֥וּ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vgm shm'yr hmvnh vthrv h'rts {p}
verses.translation: And Hamonah shall also be the name of a city. Thus shall they cleanse the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֨ה בֶן־אָדָ֜ם כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה אֱמֹר֩ לְצִפּ֨וֹר כׇּל־כָּנָ֜ף וּלְכֹ֣ל  חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה הִקָּבְצ֤וּ וָבֹ֙אוּ֙ הֵאָסְפ֣וּ מִסָּבִ֔יב עַל־זִבְחִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֜י זֹבֵ֤חַ לָכֶם֙ זֶ֣בַח גָּד֔וֹל עַ֖ל הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם בָּשָׂ֖ר וּשְׁתִ֥יתֶם דָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th bn'dm khh'mr  'dny yhvh 'mr ltspvr khlkhnf vlkhl  chyt hshdh hqbtsv vb'v h'spv msbyb 'lzbchy 'shr 'ny zbch lkhm zbch gdvl 'l hry yshr'l v'khltm bshr vshtytm dm
verses.translation: And thou, son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD: Speak unto the birds of every sort, and to every beast of the field: Assemble yourselves, and come; gather yourselves on every side to My feast that I do prepare for you, even a great feast, upon the mountains of Israel, that ye may eat flesh and drink blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשַׂ֤ר גִּבּוֹרִים֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ וְדַם־נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ תִּשְׁתּ֑וּ אֵילִ֨ים כָּרִ֤ים וְעַתּוּדִים֙ פָּרִ֔ים מְרִיאֵ֥י בָשָׁ֖ן כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: bshr gbvrym t'khlv vdmnshy'y h'rts tshtv 'ylym khrym v'tvdym prym mry'y bshn khlm
verses.translation: The flesh of the mighty shall ye eat, and the blood of the princes of the earth shall ye drink; rams, lambs, and goats, bullocks, fatlings of Bashan are they all of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּם־חֵ֣לֶב לְשׇׂבְעָ֔ה וּשְׁתִ֥יתֶם דָּ֖ם לְשִׁכָּר֑וֹן מִזִּבְחִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־זָבַ֥חְתִּי לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'khltmchlb lshb'h vshtytm dm lshkhrvn mzbchy 'shrzbchty lkhm
verses.translation: And ye shall eat fat till ye be full, and drink blood till ye be drunken, of My feast which I have prepared for you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׂבַעְתֶּ֤ם עַל־שֻׁלְחָנִי֙ ס֣וּס וָרֶ֔כֶב גִּבּ֖וֹר וְכׇל־אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: vshb'tm 'lshlchny svs vrkhb gbvr vkhl'ysh mlchmh n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And ye shall be filled at My table with horses and horsemen, with mighty men, and with all men of war, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־כְּבוֹדִ֖י בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וְרָא֣וּ כׇל־הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֶת־מִשְׁפָּטִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי וְאֶת־יָדִ֖י אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֥מְתִּי בָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vntty 'tkhbvdy bgvym vr'v khlhgvym 'tmshpty 'shr 'shyty v'tydy 'shrshmty bhm
verses.translation: And I will set My glory among the nations, and all the nations shall see My judgment that I have executed, and My hand that I have laid upon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם מִן־הַיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא וָהָֽלְאָה׃
verses.translit: vyd'v byt yshr'l khy 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm mnhyvm hhv' vhl'h
verses.translation: So the house of Israel shall know that I am the LORD their God, from that day and forward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָדְע֣וּ הַ֠גּוֹיִ֠ם כִּ֣י בַעֲוֺנָ֞ם גָּל֣וּ בֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעֲלוּ־בִ֔י וָאַסְתִּ֥ר פָּנַ֖י מֵהֶ֑ם וָֽאֶתְּנֵם֙ בְּיַ֣ד צָרֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּפְּל֥וּ בַחֶ֖רֶב כֻּלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vyd'v hgvym khy b'vnm glv bytyshr'l 'l 'shr m'lvby v'str pny mhm v'tnm byd tsryhm vyplv bchrb khlm
verses.translation: And the nations shall know that the house of Israel went into captivity for their iniquity, because they broke faith with Me, and I hid My face from them; so I gave them into the hand of their adversaries, and they fell all of them by the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּטֻמְאָתָ֥ם וּכְפִשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם עָשִׂ֣יתִי אֹתָ֑ם וָאַסְתִּ֥ר פָּנַ֖י מֵהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khtm'tm vkhpsh'yhm 'shyty 'tm v'str pny mhm {s}
verses.translation: According to their uncleanness and according to their transgressions did I unto them; and I hid My face from them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה עַתָּ֗ה אָשִׁיב֙ אֶת־(שבית) [שְׁב֣וּת] יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְרִחַמְתִּ֖י כׇּל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְקִנֵּאתִ֖י לְשֵׁ֥ם קׇדְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'th 'shyb 't(shbyt) [shbvt] y'qb vrchmty khlbyt yshr'l vqn'ty lshm qdshy
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: Now will I bring back the captivity of Jacob, and have compassion upon the whole house of Israel; and I will be jealous for My holy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָשׂוּ֙ אֶת־כְּלִמָּתָ֔ם וְאֶת־כׇּל־מַעֲלָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָעֲלוּ־בִ֑י בְּשִׁבְתָּ֧ם עַל־אַדְמָתָ֛ם לָבֶ֖טַח וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vnshv 'tkhlmtm v'tkhlm'lm 'shr m'lvby bshbtm 'l'dmtm lbtch v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: And they shall bear their shame, and all their breach of faith which they have committed against Me, when they shall dwell safely in their land, and none shall make them afraid;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשׁוֹבְבִ֤י אוֹתָם֙ מִן־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים וְקִבַּצְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔ם מֵאַרְצ֖וֹת אֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וְנִקְדַּ֣שְׁתִּי בָ֔ם לְעֵינֵ֖י הַגּוֹיִ֥ם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: bshvbby 'vtm mnh'mym vqbtsty 'tm m'rtsvt 'ybyhm vnqdshty bm l'yny hgvym rbym
verses.translation: when I have brought them back from the peoples, and gathered them out of their enemies’lands, and am sanctified in them in the sight of many nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָדְע֗וּ כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם בְּהַגְלוֹתִ֤י אֹתָם֙ אֶל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְכִנַּסְתִּ֖ים עַל־אַדְמָתָ֑ם וְלֹא־אוֹתִ֥יר ע֛וֹד מֵהֶ֖ם שָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vyd'v khy 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm bhglvty 'tm 'lhgvym vkhnstym 'l'dmtm vl''vtyr 'vd mhm shm
verses.translation: And they shall know that I am the LORD their God, in that I caused them to go into captivity among the nations, and have gathered them unto their own land; and I will leave none of them any more there;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־אַסְתִּ֥יר ע֛וֹד פָּנַ֖י מֵהֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁפַ֤כְתִּי אֶת־רוּחִי֙ עַל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl''styr 'vd pny mhm 'shr shpkhty 'trvchy 'lbyt yshr'l n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: neither will I hide My face any more from them; for I have poured out My spirit upon the house of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְחָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנָ֣ה לְ֠גָלוּתֵ֠נוּ בְּרֹ֨אשׁ הַשָּׁנָ֜ה בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ בְּאַרְבַּ֤ע עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה אַחַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֻכְּתָ֖ה הָעִ֑יר בְּעֶ֣צֶם  הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֗ה הָיְתָ֤ה עָלַי֙ יַד־יְהֹוָ֔ה וַיָּבֵ֥א אֹתִ֖י שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: b'shrym vchmsh shnh lglvtnv br'sh hshnh b'shvr lchdsh b'rb' 'shrh shnh 'chr 'shr hkhth h'yr b'tsm  hyvm hzh hyth 'ly ydyhvh vyb' 'ty shmh
verses.translation: In the five and twentieth year of our captivity, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in the selfsame day, the hand of the LORD was upon me, and He brought me thither.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּמַרְא֣וֹת אֱלֹהִ֔ים הֱבִיאַ֖נִי אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְנִיחֵ֗נִי אֶל־הַ֤ר גָּבֹ֙הַּ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְעָלָ֥יו כְּמִבְנֵה־עִ֖יר מִנֶּֽגֶב׃
verses.translit: bmr'vt 'lhym hby'ny 'l'rts yshr'l vynychny 'lhr gbh m'd v'lyv khmbnh'yr mngb
verses.translation: In the visions of God brought He me into the land of Israel, and set me down upon a very high mountain, whereon was as it were the frame of a city on the south.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּבֵ֨יא אוֹתִ֜י שָׁ֗מָּה וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ֙ מַרְאֵ֙הוּ֙ כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וּפְתִיל־פִּשְׁתִּ֥ים בְּיָד֖וֹ וּקְנֵ֣ה הַמִּדָּ֑ה וְה֥וּא עֹמֵ֖ד בַּשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.translit: vyby' 'vty shmh vhnh'ysh mr'hv khmr'h nchsht vptylpshtym bydv vqnh hmdh vhv' 'md bsh'r
verses.translation: And He brought me thither, and, behold, there was a man, whose appearance was like the appearance of brass, with a line of flax in his hand, and a measuring reed; and he stood in the gate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֵלַ֜י הָאִ֗ישׁ בֶּן־אָדָ֡ם רְאֵ֣ה בְעֵינֶ֩יךָ֩ וּבְאׇזְנֶ֨יךָ שְּׁמָ֜ע וְשִׂ֣ים לִבְּךָ֗ לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־אֲנִי֙ מַרְאֶ֣ה אוֹתָ֔ךְ כִּ֛י לְמַ֥עַן הַרְאוֹתְכָ֖ה הֻבָ֣אתָה הֵ֑נָּה הַגֵּ֛ד אֶת־כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר־אַתָּ֥ה רֹאֶ֖ה לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vydbr 'ly h'ysh bn'dm r'h b'ynykh vb'znykh shm' vshym lbkh lkhl 'shr'ny mr'h 'vtkh khy lm'n hr'vtkhh hb'th hnh hgd 'tkhl'shr'th r'h lbyt yshr'l
verses.translation: And the man said unto me: ‘Son of man, behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears, and set thy heart upon all that I shall show thee, for to the intent that I might show them unto thee art thou brought thither; declare all that thou seest to the house of Israel.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֥ה חוֹמָ֛ה מִח֥וּץ לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֑יב וּבְיַ֨ד הָאִ֜ישׁ קְנֵ֣ה הַמִּדָּ֗ה שֵׁשׁ־אַמּ֤וֹת בָּֽאַמָּה֙ וָטֹ֔פַח וַיָּ֜מׇד אֶת־רֹ֤חַב הַבִּנְיָן֙ קָנֶ֣ה אֶחָ֔ד וְקוֹמָ֖ה קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vhnh chvmh mchvts lbyt sbyb  sbyb vbyd h'ysh qnh hmdh shsh'mvt b'mh vtpch vymd 'trchb hbnyn qnh 'chd vqvmh qnh 'chd
verses.translation: And behold a wall on the outside of the house round about, and in the man’s hand a measuring reed of six cubits long, of a cubit and a hand-breadth each; so he measured the breadth of the building, one reed, and the height, one reed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּב֗וֹא אֶל־שַׁ֙עַר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנָיו֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֔ימָה וַיַּ֖עַל בְּמַעֲלוֹתָ֑ו וַיָּ֣מׇד  אֶת־סַ֣ף הַשַּׁ֗עַר קָנֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ רֹ֔חַב וְאֵת֙ סַ֣ף אֶחָ֔ד קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד רֹֽחַב׃
verses.translit: vybv' 'lsh'r 'shr pnyv drkh hqdymh vy'l bm'lvtv vymd  'tsf hsh'r qnh 'chd rchb v't sf 'chd qnh 'chd rchb
verses.translation: Then came he unto the gate which looketh toward the east, and went up the steps thereof; and he measured the jamb of the gate, one reed broad, and the other jamb, one reed broad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַתָּ֗א קָנֶ֨ה אֶחָ֥ד אֹ֙רֶךְ֙ וְקָנֶ֤ה אֶחָד֙ רֹ֔חַב וּבֵ֥ין הַתָּאִ֖ים חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וְסַ֣ף הַ֠שַּׁ֠עַר מֵאֵ֨צֶל אֻלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֛עַר מֵהַבַּ֖יִת קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vht' qnh 'chd 'rkh vqnh 'chd rchb vbyn ht'ym chmsh 'mvt vsf hsh'r m'tsl 'lm hsh'r mhbyt qnh 'chd
verses.translation: And every cell was one reed long, and one reed broad; and the space between the cells was five cubits; and the jambs of the gate by the porch of the gate within were one reed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֜מׇד אֶת־אֻלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֛עַר מֵהַבַּ֖יִת קָנֶ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vymd 't'lm hsh'r mhbyt qnh 'chd
verses.translation: He measured also the porch of the gate toward the house, one reed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֜מׇד אֶת־אֻלָ֤ם הַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ שְׁמֹנֶ֣ה אַמּ֔וֹת וְאֵילָ֖ו שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֑וֹת וְאֻלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֖עַר מֵהַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vymd 't'lm hsh'r shmnh 'mvt v'ylv shtym 'mvt v'lm hsh'r mhbyt
verses.translation: Then measured he the porch of the gate, eight cubits; and the posts thereof, two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתָאֵ֨י הַשַּׁ֜עַר דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֗ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה מִפֹּה֙ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה מִפֹּ֔ה מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לִשְׁלׇשְׁתָּ֑ם וּמִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לָאֵילִ֖ם מִפֹּ֥ה וּמִפּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vt'y hsh'r drkh hqdym shlshh mph vshlshh mph mdh 'cht lshlshtm vmdh 'cht l'ylm mph vmpv
verses.translation: And the cells of the gate eastward were three on this side, and three on that side; they three were of one measure; and the posts had one measure on this side and on that side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֛מׇד אֶת־רֹ֥חַב פֶּתַח־הַשַּׁ֖עַר עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֑וֹת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַשַּׁ֔עַר שְׁל֥וֹשׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה אַמּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vymd 'trchb ptchhsh'r 'shr 'mvt 'rkh hsh'r shlvsh 'shrh 'mvt
verses.translation: And he measured the breadth of the entry of the gate, ten cubits; and the length of the gate, thirteen cubits;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּגְב֞וּל לִפְנֵ֤י הַתָּאוֹת֙ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֔ת וְאַמָּֽה־אַחַ֥ת גְּב֖וּל מִפֹּ֑ה וְהַתָּ֕א שֵׁשׁ־אַמּ֣וֹת מִפּ֔וֹ וְשֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vgbvl lpny ht'vt 'mh 'cht v'mh'cht gbvl mph vht' shsh'mvt mpv vshsh 'mvt mpv
verses.translation: and a border before the cells, one cubit [on this side], and a border, one cubit on that side; and the cells, six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מׇד אֶת־הַשַּׁ֗עַר מִגַּ֤ג הַתָּא֙ לְגַגּ֔וֹ רֹ֕חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת פֶּ֖תַח נֶ֥גֶד פָּֽתַח׃
verses.translit: vymd 'thsh'r mgg ht' lggv rchb 'shrym vchmsh 'mvt ptch ngd ptch
verses.translation: And he measured the gate from the roof of the one cell to the roof of the other, a breadth of five and twenty cubits; door against door.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־אֵילִ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה וְאֶל־אֵיל֙ הֶחָצֵ֔ר הַשַּׁ֖עַר סָבִ֥יב ׀ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vy'sh 't'ylym shshym 'mh v'l'yl hchtsr hsh'r sbyb  sbyb
verses.translation: He made also posts of threescore cubits; even unto the posts of the court in the gates round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֗ל פְּנֵי֙ הַשַּׁ֣עַר (היאתון) [הָאִית֔וֹן] עַל־לִפְנֵ֕י אֻלָ֥ם הַשַּׁ֖עַר הַפְּנִימִ֑י חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'l pny hsh'r (hy'tvn) [h'ytvn] 'llpny 'lm hsh'r hpnymy chmshym 'mh
verses.translation: And from the forefront of the gate of the entrance unto the forefront of the inner porch of the gate were fifty cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחַלּוֹנ֣וֹת אֲטֻמ֣וֹת אֶֽל־הַתָּאִ֡ים וְאֶל֩ אֵלֵיהֵ֨מָה לִפְנִ֤ימָה לַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֔יב וְכֵ֖ן לָאֵֽלַמּ֑וֹת וְחַלּוֹנ֞וֹת סָבִ֤יב ׀ סָבִיב֙ לִפְנִ֔ימָה וְאֶל־אַ֖יִל תִּמֹרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vchlvnvt 'tmvt 'lht'ym v'l 'lyhmh lpnymh lsh'r sbyb  sbyb vkhn l'lmvt vchlvnvt sbyb  sbyb lpnymh v'l'yl tmrym
verses.translation: And there were narrow windows to the cells and to their posts within the gate round about, and likewise to the arches; and windows were round about inward; and upon each post were palm-trees.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֗נִי אֶל־הֶחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֤ה לְשָׁכוֹת֙ וְרִֽצְפָ֔ה עָשׂ֥וּי לֶחָצֵ֖ר סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֑יב שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים לְשָׁכ֖וֹת אֶל־הָרִֽצְפָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyby'ny 'lhchtsr hchytsvnh vhnh lshkhvt vrtsph 'shvy lchtsr sbyb  sbyb shlshym lshkhvt 'lhrtsph
verses.translation: Then brought he me into the outer court, and, lo, there were chambers and a pavement, made for the court round about; thirty chambers were upon the pavement.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָרִֽצְפָה֙ אֶל־כֶּ֣תֶף הַשְּׁעָרִ֔ים לְעֻמַּ֖ת אֹ֣רֶךְ הַשְּׁעָרִ֑ים הָרִֽצְפָ֖ה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhrtsph 'lkhtf hsh'rym l'mt 'rkh hsh'rym hrtsph htchtvnh
verses.translation: And the pavement was by the side of the gates, corresponding unto the length of the gates, even the lower pavement.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מׇד רֹ֡חַב מִלִּפְנֵי֩ הַשַּׁ֨עַר הַתַּחְתּ֜וֹנָה לִפְנֵ֨י הֶחָצֵ֧ר הַפְּנִימִ֛י מִח֖וּץ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה הַקָּדִ֖ים וְהַצָּפֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vymd rchb mlpny hsh'r htchtvnh lpny hchtsr hpnymy mchvts m'h 'mh hqdym vhtspvn
verses.translation: Then he measured the breadth from the forefront of the lower gate unto the forefront of the inner court without, a hundred cubits, eastward as also northward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַשַּׁ֗עַר אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנָיו֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן לֶחָצֵ֖ר הַחִיצוֹנָ֑ה מָדַ֥ד אׇרְכּ֖וֹ וְרׇחְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhsh'r 'shr pnyv drkh htspvn lchtsr hchytsvnh mdd 'rkhv vrchbv
verses.translation: And the gate of the outer court that looked toward the north, he measured the length thereof and the breadth thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתָאָ֗ו שְׁלוֹשָׁ֤ה מִפּוֹ֙ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה מִפּ֔וֹ וְאֵילָ֤ו וְאֵֽלַמָּו֙ הָיָ֔ה כְּמִדַּ֖ת הַשַּׁ֣עַר הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אׇרְכּ֔וֹ וְרֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים בָּאַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vt'v shlvshh mpv vshlshh mpv v'ylv v'lmv hyh khmdt hsh'r hr'shvn chmshym 'mh 'rkhv vrchb chmsh v'shrym b'mh
verses.translation: And the cells thereof were three on this side and three on that side; and the posts thereof and the arches thereof were after the measure of the first gate; the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחַלּוֹנָ֤ו וְאֵֽילַמָּו֙ וְתִ֣ימֹרָ֔ו כְּמִדַּ֣ת הַשַּׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וּבְמַעֲל֥וֹת שֶׁ֙בַע֙ יַעֲלוּ־ב֔וֹ וְאֵילַמָּ֖ו לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vchlvnv v'ylmv vtymrv khmdt hsh'r 'shr pnyv drkh hqdym vbm'lvt shb' y'lvbv v'ylmv lpnyhm
verses.translation: And the windows thereof, and the arches thereof, and the palm-trees thereof, were after the measure of the gate that looketh toward the east; and it was ascended by seven steps; and the arches thereof were before them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁ֙עַר֙ לֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔י נֶ֣גֶד הַשַּׁ֔עַר לַצָּפ֖וֹן וְלַקָּדִ֑ים וַיָּ֧מׇד מִשַּׁ֛עַר אֶל־שַׁ֖עַר מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vsh'r lchtsr hpnymy ngd hsh'r ltspvn vlqdym vymd msh'r 'lsh'r m'h 'mh
verses.translation: And there was a gate to the inner court over against the other gate, northward as also eastward; and he measured from gate to gate a hundred cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּוֹלִכֵ֙נִי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֔וֹם וְהִנֵּה־שַׁ֖עַר דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֑וֹם וּמָדַ֤ד אֵילָו֙ וְאֵ֣ילַמָּ֔ו כַּמִּדּ֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vyvlkhny drkh hdrvm vhnhsh'r drkh hdrvm vmdd 'ylv v'ylmv khmdvt h'lh
verses.translation: And he led me toward the south, and behold a gate toward the south; and he measured the posts thereof, and the arches thereof according to these measures.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחַלּוֹנִ֨ים ל֤וֹ וּלְאֵֽילַמָּו֙ סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֔יב כְּהַחַלֹּנ֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְרֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vchlvnym lv vl'ylmv sbyb  sbyb khhchlnvt h'lh chmshym 'mh 'rkh vrchb chmsh v'shrym 'mh
verses.translation: And there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about, like those windows; the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמַעֲל֤וֹת שִׁבְעָה֙ עֹֽלוֹתָ֔ו וְאֵלַמָּ֖ו לִפְנֵיהֶ֑ם וְתִמֹרִ֣ים ל֗וֹ אֶחָ֥ד מִפּ֛וֹ וְאֶחָ֥ד מִפּ֖וֹ אֶל־אֵילָֽו׃
verses.translit: vm'lvt shb'h 'lvtv v'lmv lpnyhm vtmrym lv 'chd mpv v'chd mpv 'l'ylv
verses.translation: And there were seven steps to go up to it, and the arches thereof were before them; and it had palm-trees, one on this side, and another on that side, upon the posts thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁ֛עַר לֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖י דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֑וֹם וַיָּ֨מׇד מִשַּׁ֧עַר אֶל־הַשַּׁ֛עַר דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַדָּר֖וֹם מֵאָ֥ה אַמּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vsh'r lchtsr hpnymy drkh hdrvm vymd msh'r 'lhsh'r drkh hdrvm m'h 'mvt
verses.translation: And there was a gate to the inner court toward the south; and he measured from gate to gate toward the south a hundred cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֛נִי אֶל־חָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖י בְּשַׁ֣עַר הַדָּר֑וֹם וַיָּ֙מׇד֙ אֶת־הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַדָּר֔וֹם כַּמִּדּ֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vyby'ny 'lchtsr hpnymy bsh'r hdrvm vymd 'thsh'r hdrvm khmdvt h'lh
verses.translation: Then he brought me to the inner court by the south gate; and he measured the south gate according to these measures;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתָאָ֞ו וְאֵילָ֤ו וְאֵֽלַמָּו֙ כַּמִּדּ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְחַלּוֹנ֥וֹת ל֛וֹ וּלְאֵלַמָּ֖ו סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֑יב חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים אַמָּה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְרֹ֕חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְחָמֵ֖שׁ אַמּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vt'v v'ylv v'lmv khmdvt h'lh vchlvnvt lv vl'lmv sbyb  sbyb chmshym 'mh 'rkh vrchb 'shrym vchmsh 'mvt
verses.translation: and the cells thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures; and there were windows in it and in the arches thereof round about; it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵלַמּ֖וֹת סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֑יב אֹ֗רֶךְ חָמֵ֤שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֖חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'lmvt sbyb  sbyb 'rkh chmsh v'shrym 'mh vrchb chmsh 'mvt
verses.translation: And there were arches round about, five and twenty cubits long, and five cubits broad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵלַמָּ֗ו אֶל־חָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣צוֹנָ֔ה וְתִמֹרִ֖ים אֶל־אֵילָ֑ו וּמַעֲל֥וֹת שְׁמוֹנֶ֖ה מַעֲלָֽו׃
verses.translit: v'lmv 'lchtsr hchtsvnh vtmrym 'l'ylv vm'lvt shmvnh m'lv
verses.translation: And the arches thereof were toward the outer court; and palm-trees were upon the posts thereof; and the going up to it had eight steps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֛נִי אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖י דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וַיָּ֣מׇד אֶת־הַשַּׁ֔עַר כַּמִּדּ֖וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vyby'ny 'lhchtsr hpnymy drkh hqdym vymd 'thsh'r khmdvt h'lh
verses.translation: And he brought me into the inner court toward the east; and he measured the gate according to these measures;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתָאָ֞ו וְאֵלָ֤ו וְאֵֽלַמָּו֙ כַּמִּדּ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה וְחַלּוֹנ֥וֹת ל֛וֹ וּלְאֵלַמָּ֖ו סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֑יב אֹ֚רֶךְ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vt'v v'lv v'lmv khmdvt h'lh vchlvnvt lv vl'lmv sbyb  sbyb 'rkh chmshym 'mh vrchb chmsh v'shrym 'mh
verses.translation: and the cells thereof, and the posts thereof, and the arches thereof, according to these measures; and there were windows therein and in the arches thereof round about; it was fifty cubits long, and five and twenty cubits broad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵלַמָּ֗ו לֶחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וְתִמֹרִ֥ים אֶל־אֵלָ֖ו מִפּ֣וֹ וּמִפּ֑וֹ וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מַעֲל֖וֹת מַעֲלָֽו׃
verses.translit: v'lmv lchtsr hchytsvnh vtmrym 'l'lv mpv vmpv vshmnh m'lvt m'lv
verses.translation: And the arches thereof were toward the outer court; and palm-trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side; and the going up to it had eight steps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֖נִי אֶל־שַׁ֣עַר הַצָּפ֑וֹן וּמָדַ֖ד כַּמִּדּ֥וֹת הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: vyby'ny 'lsh'r htspvn vmdd khmdvt h'lh
verses.translation: And he brought me to the north gate; and he measured it according to these measures;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּאָו֙ אֵלָ֣ו וְאֵלַמָּ֔ו וְחַלּוֹנ֥וֹת ל֖וֹ סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֑יב אֹ֚רֶךְ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֕חַב חָמֵ֥שׁ וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: t'v 'lv v'lmv vchlvnvt lv sbyb  sbyb 'rkh chmshym 'mh vrchb chmsh v'shrym 'mh
verses.translation: the cells thereof, the posts thereof, and the arches thereof; and there were windows therein round about; the length was fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵילָ֗ו לֶחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וְתִמֹרִ֥ים אֶל־אֵילָ֖ו מִפּ֣וֹ וּמִפּ֑וֹ וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מַעֲל֖וֹת מַעֲלָֽו׃
verses.translit: v'ylv lchtsr hchytsvnh vtmrym 'l'ylv mpv vmpv vshmnh m'lvt m'lv
verses.translation: And the posts thereof were toward the outer court; and palm-trees were upon the posts thereof, on this side, and on that side; and the going up to it had eight steps.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִשְׁכָּ֣ה וּפִתְחָ֔הּ בְּאֵילִ֖ים הַשְּׁעָרִ֑ים שָׁ֖ם יָדִ֥יחוּ אֶת־הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vlshkhh vptchh b'ylym hsh'rym shm ydychv 'th'lh
verses.translation: And a chamber with the entry thereof was by the posts at the gates; there was the burnt-offering to be washed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְאֻלָ֣ם הַשַּׁ֗עַר שְׁנַ֤יִם שֻׁלְחָנוֹת֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם שֻׁלְחָנ֖וֹת מִפֹּ֑ה לִשְׁח֤וֹט אֲלֵיהֶם֙ הָעוֹלָ֔ה וְהַחַטָּ֖את וְהָאָשָֽׁם׃
verses.translit: vb'lm hsh'r shnym shlchnvt mpv vshnym shlchnvt mph lshchvt 'lyhm h'vlh vhcht't vh'shm
verses.translation: And in the porch of the gate were two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slay thereon the burnt-offering and the sin-offering and the guilt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־הַכָּתֵ֣ף מִח֗וּצָה לָֽעוֹלֶה֙ לְפֶ֙תַח֙ הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַצָּפ֔וֹנָה שְׁנַ֖יִם שֻׁלְחָנ֑וֹת וְאֶל־הַכָּתֵ֣ף הָאַחֶ֗רֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ לְאֻלָ֣ם הַשַּׁ֔עַר שְׁנַ֖יִם שֻׁלְחָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'lhkhtf mchvtsh l'vlh lptch hsh'r htspvnh shnym shlchnvt v'lhkhtf h'chrt 'shr l'lm hsh'r shnym shlchnvt
verses.translation: And on the one side without, as one goeth up to the entry of the gate toward the north, were two tables; and on the other side of the porch of the gate were two tables.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַרְבָּעָ֨ה שֻׁלְחָנ֜וֹת מִפֹּ֗ה וְאַרְבָּעָ֧ה שֻׁלְחָנ֛וֹת מִפֹּ֖ה לְכֶ֣תֶף הַשָּׁ֑עַר שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה שֻׁלְחָנ֖וֹת אֲלֵיהֶ֥ם יִשְׁחָֽטוּ׃
verses.translit: 'rb'h shlchnvt mph v'rb'h shlchnvt mph lkhtf hsh'r shmvnh shlchnvt 'lyhm yshchtv
verses.translation: Four tables were on this side, and four tables on that side, by the side of the gate; eight tables, whereupon to slay the sacrifices.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַרְבָּעָה֩ שֻׁלְחָנ֨וֹת לָעוֹלָ֜ה אַבְנֵ֣י גָזִ֗ית אֹ֩רֶךְ֩ אַמָּ֨ה אַחַ֤ת וָחֵ֙צִי֙ וְרֹ֨חַב אַמָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ וָחֵ֔צִי וְגֹ֖בַהּ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם וְיַנִּ֤יחוּ אֶת־הַכֵּלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחֲט֧וּ אֶת־הָעוֹלָ֛ה בָּ֖ם וְהַזָּֽבַח׃
verses.translit: v'rb'h shlchnvt l'vlh 'bny gzyt 'rkh 'mh 'cht vchtsy vrchb 'mh 'cht vchtsy vgbh 'mh 'cht 'lyhm vynychv 'thkhlym 'shr yshchtv 'th'vlh bm vhzbch
verses.translation: Moreover there were four tables for the burnt-offering, of hewn stone, a cubit and a half long, and a cubit and a half broad, and one cubit high, whereupon to lay the instruments wherewith the burnt-offering and the sacrifice are slain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַֽשְׁפַתַּ֗יִם טֹ֧פַח אֶחָ֛ד מוּכָנִ֥ים בַּבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֑יב וְאֶל־הַשֻּׁלְחָנ֖וֹת בְּשַׂ֥ר הַקׇּרְבָֽן׃
verses.translit: vhshptym tpch 'chd mvkhnym bbyt sbyb  sbyb v'lhshlchnvt bshr hqrbn
verses.translation: And the slabs, a handbreadth long, were fastened within round about; and upon the tables was to be the flesh of the offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִח֩וּצָה֩ לַשַּׁ֨עַר הַפְּנִימִ֜י לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת שָׁרִ֗ים בֶּחָצֵ֤ר הַפְּנִימִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֗ר אֶל־כֶּ֙תֶף֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַצָּפ֔וֹן וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֑וֹם אֶחָ֗ד אֶל־כֶּ֙תֶף֙ שַׁ֣עַר הַקָּדִ֔ים פְּנֵ֖י דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַצָּפֹֽן׃
verses.translit: vmchvtsh lsh'r hpnymy lshkhvt shrym bchtsr hpnymy 'shr 'lkhtf sh'r htspvn vpnyhm drkh hdrvm 'chd 'lkhtf sh'r hqdym pny drkh htspn
verses.translation: And without the inner gate were chambers for the guard in the inner court, which was at the side of the north gate, and their prospect was toward the south; one at the side of the east gate having the prospect toward the north.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלָ֑י זֹ֣ה הַלִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנֶ֙יהָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֔וֹם לַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vydbr 'ly zh hlshkhh 'shr pnyh drkh hdrvm lkhhnym shmry mshmrt hbyt
verses.translation: And he said unto me: ‘This chamber, whose prospect is toward the south, is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַלִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר פָּנֶ֙יהָ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן לַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ הֵ֣מָּה בְנֵֽי־צָד֗וֹק הַקְּרֵבִ֧ים מִבְּנֵֽי־לֵוִ֛י אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה לְשָׁרְתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhlshkhh 'shr pnyh drkh htspvn lkhhnym shmry mshmrt hmzbch hmh bnytsdvq hqrbym mbnylvy 'lyhvh lshrtv
verses.translation: And the chamber whose prospect is toward the north is for the priests, the keepers of the charge of the altar; these are the sons of Zadok, who from among the sons of Levi come near to the LORD to minister unto Him.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨מׇד אֶת־הֶחָצֵ֜ר אֹ֣רֶךְ  מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֗ה וְרֹ֛חַב מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה מְרֻבָּ֑עַת וְהַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לִפְנֵ֥י הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vymd 'thchtsr 'rkh  m'h 'mh vrchb m'h 'mh mrb't vhmzbch lpny hbyt
verses.translation: And he measured the court, a hundred cubits long, and a hundred cubits broad, foursquare; and the altar was before the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבִאֵ֘נִי֮ אֶל־אֻלָ֣ם הַבַּ֒יִת֒ וַיָּ֙מָד֙ אֵ֣ל אֻלָ֔ם חָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִפֹּ֔ה וְחָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפֹּ֑ה וְרֹ֣חַב הַשַּׁ֔עַר שָׁלֹ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyb'ny 'l'lm hbyt vymd 'l 'lm chmsh 'mvt mph vchmsh 'mvt mph vrchb hsh'r shlsh 'mvt mpv vshlsh 'mvt mpv
verses.translation: Then he brought me to the porch of the house, and measured each post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side; and the breadth of the gate was three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֹ֣רֶךְ הָאֻלָ֞ם עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה וְרֹ֙חַב֙ עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אַמָּ֔ה וּבַֽמַּעֲל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲל֖וּ אֵלָ֑יו וְעַמֻּדִים֙ אֶל־הָ֣אֵילִ֔ים אֶחָ֥ד מִפֹּ֖ה וְאֶחָ֥ד מִפֹּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'rkh h'lm 'shrym 'mh vrchb 'shty 'shrh 'mh vbm'lvt 'shr y'lv 'lyv v'mdym 'lh'ylym 'chd mph v'chd mph
verses.translation: The length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and it was by steps that it was ascended; and there were pillars by the posts, one on this side, and another on that side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֖נִי אֶל־הַהֵיכָ֑ל וַיָּ֣מׇד אֶת־הָאֵילִ֗ים שֵׁשׁ־אַמּ֨וֹת רֹ֧חַב מִפּ֛וֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־אַמּֽוֹת־רֹ֥חַב מִפּ֖וֹ רֹ֥חַב הָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.translit: vyby'ny 'lhhykhl vymd 'th'ylym shsh'mvt rchb mpv vshsh'mvtrchb mpv rchb h'hl
verses.translation: And he brought me to athe temple, and measured the posts, six cubits broad on the one side, and six cubits broad on the other side, which was the breadth of the tent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרֹ֣חַב הַפֶּ֘תַח֮ עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּוֹת֒ וְכִתְפ֣וֹת הַפֶּ֔תַח חָמֵ֤שׁ אַמּוֹת֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וְחָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת מִפּ֑וֹ וַיָּ֤מׇד אׇרְכּוֹ֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְרֹ֖חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vrchb hptch 'shr 'mvt vkhtpvt hptch chmsh 'mvt mpv vchmsh 'mvt mpv vymd 'rkhv 'rb'ym 'mh vrchb 'shrym 'mh
verses.translation: And the breadth of the entrance was ten cubits; and the sides of the entrance were five cubits on the one side, and five cubits on the other side; and he measured the length thereof, forty cubits, and the breadth, twenty cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֣א לִפְנִ֔ימָה וַיָּ֥מׇד אֵֽיל־הַפֶּ֖תַח שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֑וֹת וְהַפֶּ֙תַח֙ שֵׁ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת וְרֹ֥חַב הַפֶּ֖תַח שֶׁ֥בַע אַמּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vb' lpnymh vymd 'ylhptch shtym 'mvt vhptch shsh 'mvt vrchb hptch shb' 'mvt
verses.translation: Then went he inward, and measured each post of the entrance, two cubits; and the entrance, six cubits; and the breadth of the entrance, seven cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֨מׇד אֶת־אׇרְכּ֜וֹ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּ֗ה וְרֹ֛חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י הַהֵיכָ֑ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י זֶ֖ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃
