verses.translit: vymd 't'rkhv 'shrym 'mh vrchb 'shrym 'mh 'lpny hhykhl vy'mr 'ly zh qdsh hqdshym
verses.translation: And he measured the length thereof, twenty cubits, and the breadth, twenty cubits, before the temple; and he said unto me: ‘This is the most holy place.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֥מׇד קִֽיר־הַבַּ֖יִת שֵׁ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וְרֹ֣חַב הַצֵּלָע֩ אַרְבַּ֨ע אַמּ֜וֹת סָבִ֧יב ׀ סָבִ֛יב לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vymd qyrhbyt shsh 'mvt vrchb htsl' 'rb' 'mvt sbyb  sbyb lbyt sbyb
verses.translation: Then he measured the wall of the house, six cubits; and the breadth of every side-chamber, four cubits, round about the house on every side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַצְּלָעוֹת֩ צֵלָ֨ע אֶל־צֵלָ֜ע שָׁל֧וֹשׁ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים פְּעָמִ֗ים וּ֠בָא֠וֹת בַּקִּ֨יר אֲשֶׁר־לַבַּ֧יִת לַצְּלָע֛וֹת סָבִ֥יב ׀ סָבִ֖יב לִהְי֣וֹת אֲחוּזִ֑ים וְלֹֽא־יִהְי֥וּ אֲחוּזִ֖ים בְּקִ֥יר הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vhtsl'vt tsl' 'ltsl' shlvsh vshlshym p'mym vb'vt bqyr 'shrlbyt ltsl'vt sbyb  sbyb lhyvt 'chvzym vl'yhyv 'chvzym bqyr hbyt
verses.translation: And the side-chambers were one over another, three and thirty times; and there were cornices in the wall which belonged to the house for the side-chambers round about, that they might have hold therein, and not have hold in the wall of the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽרָחֲבָ֡ה וְֽנָסְבָה֩ לְמַ֨עְלָה לְמַ֜עְלָה לַצְּלָע֗וֹת כִּ֣י מֽוּסַב־הַ֠בַּ֠יִת לְמַ֨עְלָה לְמַ֜עְלָה סָבִ֤יב ׀ סָבִיב֙ לַבַּ֔יִת עַל־כֵּ֥ן רֹחַב־לַבַּ֖יִת לְמָ֑עְלָה וְכֵ֧ן הַתַּחְתּוֹנָ֛ה יַעֲלֶ֥ה עַל־הָעֶלְיוֹנָ֖ה לַתִּיכוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vrchbh vnsbh lm'lh lm'lh ltsl'vt khy mvsbhbyt lm'lh lm'lh sbyb  sbyb lbyt 'lkhn rchblbyt lm'lh vkhn htchtvnh y'lh 'lh'lyvnh ltykhvnh
verses.translation: And the side-chambers were broader as they wound about higher and higher; for the winding about of the house went higher and higher round about the house; therefore the breadth of the house continued upward; and so one went up from the lowest row to the highest by the middle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָאִ֧יתִי לַבַּ֛יִת גֹּ֖בַהּ סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֑יב (מיסדות) [מוּסְד֤וֹת] הַצְּלָעוֹת֙ מְל֣וֹ הַקָּנֶ֔ה שֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת אַצִּֽילָה׃
verses.translit: vr'yty lbyt gbh sbyb  sbyb (mysdvt) [mvsdvt] htsl'vt mlv hqnh shsh 'mvt 'tsylh
verses.translation: I saw also that the house had a raised basement round about; the foundations of the side-chambers were a full reed of six cubits to the joining.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רֹ֣חַב הַקִּ֧יר אֲֽשֶׁר־לַצֵּלָ֛ע אֶל־הַח֖וּץ חָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֑וֹת וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר מֻנָּ֔ח בֵּ֥ית צְלָע֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: rchb hqyr 'shrltsl' 'lhchvts chmsh 'mvt v'shr mnch byt tsl'vt 'shr lbyt
verses.translation: The breadth of the outer wall which belonged to the side-chambers was five cubits; and so that which was left by the structure of the side-chambers that belonged to the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֵ֨ין הַלְּשָׁכ֜וֹת רֹ֣חַב עֶשְׂרִ֥ים אַמָּ֛ה סָבִ֥יב לַבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֥יב ׀ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vbyn hlshkhvt rchb 'shrym 'mh sbyb lbyt sbyb  sbyb
verses.translation: And between the chambers was a breadth of twenty cubits round about the house on every side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפֶ֤תַח הַצֵּלָע֙ לַמֻּנָּ֔ח פֶּ֤תַח אֶחָד֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן וּפֶ֥תַח אֶחָ֖ד לַדָּר֑וֹם וְרֹ֙חַב֙ מְק֣וֹם הַמֻּנָּ֔ח חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת סָבִ֥יב ׀ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vptch htsl' lmnch ptch 'chd drkh htspvn vptch 'chd ldrvm vrchb mqvm hmnch chmsh 'mvt sbyb  sbyb
verses.translation: And the doors of the side-chambers were toward the place that was left, one door toward the north, and another door toward the south; and the breadth of the place that was left was five cubits round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַבִּנְיָ֡ן אֲשֶׁר֩ אֶל־פְּנֵ֨י הַגִּזְרָ֜ה פְּאַ֣ת דֶּֽרֶךְ־הַיָּ֗ם רֹ֚חַב שִׁבְעִ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה וְקִ֧יר הַבִּנְיָ֛ן חָמֵשׁ־אַמּ֥וֹת רֹ֖חַב סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֑יב וְאׇרְכּ֖וֹ תִּשְׁעִ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vhbnyn 'shr 'lpny hgzrh p't drkhhym rchb shb'ym 'mh vqyr hbnyn chmsh'mvt rchb sbyb  sbyb v'rkhv tsh'ym 'mh
verses.translation: And the building that was before the separate place at the side toward the west was seventy cubits broad; and the wall of the building was five cubits thick round about, and the length thereof ninety cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָדַ֣ד אֶת־הַבַּ֔יִת אֹ֖רֶךְ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה וְהַגִּזְרָ֤ה וְהַבִּנְיָה֙ וְקִ֣ירוֹתֶ֔יהָ אֹ֖רֶךְ מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vmdd 'thbyt 'rkh m'h 'mh vhgzrh vhbnyh vqyrvtyh 'rkh m'h 'mh
verses.translation: And he measured the house, a hundred cubits long; and the separate place, and the building, with the walls thereof, a hundred cubits long;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרֹ֩חַב֩ פְּנֵ֨י הַבַּ֧יִת וְהַגִּזְרָ֛ה לַקָּדִ֖ים מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vrchb pny hbyt vhgzrh lqdym m'h 'mh
verses.translation: also the breadth of the face of the house and of the separate place toward the east, a hundred cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָדַ֣ד אֹֽרֶךְ־הַ֠בִּנְיָ֠ן אֶל־פְּנֵ֨י הַגִּזְרָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־אַחֲרֶ֧יהָ (ואתוקיהא) [וְאַתִּיקֶ֛יהָא] מִפּ֥וֹ וּמִפּ֖וֹ מֵאָ֣ה אַמָּ֑ה וְהַהֵיכָל֙ הַפְּנִימִ֔י וְאֻלַמֵּ֖י הֶחָצֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vmdd 'rkhhbnyn 'lpny hgzrh 'shr 'l'chryh (v'tvqyh') [v'tyqyh'] mpv vmpv m'h 'mh vhhykhl hpnymy v'lmy hchtsr
verses.translation: And he measured the length of the building before the separate place which was at the back thereof, and the galleries thereof on the one side and on the other side, a hundred cubits. Now the temple, and the inner place, and the porches of the court,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַסִּפִּ֡ים וְהַחַלּוֹנִ֣ים הָ֠אֲטֻמ֠וֹת וְהָאַתִּיקִ֤ים ׀ סָבִיב֙ לִשְׁלׇשְׁתָּ֔ם נֶ֧גֶד הַסַּ֛ף שְׂחִ֥יף עֵ֖ץ סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֑יב וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ עַד־הַֽחַלּוֹנ֔וֹת וְהַחַלֹּנ֖וֹת מְכֻסּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: hspym vhchlvnym h'tmvt vh'tyqym  sbyb lshlshtm ngd hsf shchyf 'ts sbyb  sbyb vh'rts 'dhchlvnvt vhchlnvt mkhsvt
verses.translation: the jambs, and the narrow windows, and the galleries, that they three had round about, over against the jambs there was a veneering of wood round about, and from the ground up to the windows; and the windows were covered;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־מֵעַ֣ל הַפֶּ֡תַח וְעַד־הַבַּ֩יִת֩ הַפְּנִימִ֨י וְלַח֜וּץ וְאֶל־כׇּל־הַקִּ֨יר סָבִ֧יב ׀ סָבִ֛יב בַּפְּנִימִ֥י וּבַחִיצ֖וֹן מִדּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'lm'l hptch v'dhbyt hpnymy vlchvts v'lkhlhqyr sbyb  sbyb bpnymy vbchytsvn mdvt
verses.translation: to the space above the door, even unto the inner house, and without, and on all the wall round about within and without, by measure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשׂ֥וּי כְּרוּבִ֖ים וְתִמֹרִ֑ים וְתִֽמֹרָה֙ בֵּין־כְּר֣וּב לִכְר֔וּב וּשְׁנַ֥יִם פָּנִ֖ים לַכְּרֽוּב׃
verses.translit: v'shvy khrvbym vtmrym vtmrh bynkhrvb lkhrvb vshnym pnym lkhrvb
verses.translation: And it was made with cherubim and palm-trees; and a palm-tree was between cherub and cherub, and every cherub had two faces;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְנֵ֨י אָדָ֤ם אֶל־הַתִּֽמֹרָה֙ מִפּ֔וֹ וּפְנֵי־כְפִ֥יר אֶל־הַתִּמֹרָ֖ה מִפּ֑וֹ עָשׂ֥וּי אֶל־כׇּל־הַבַּ֖יִת סָבִ֥יב ׀ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vpny 'dm 'lhtmrh mpv vpnykhpyr 'lhtmrh mpv 'shvy 'lkhlhbyt sbyb  sbyb
verses.translation: so that there was the face of a man toward the palm-tree on the one side, and the face of a young lion toward the palm-tree on the other side; thus was it made through all the house round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ עַד־מֵעַ֣ל הַפֶּ֔תַח הַכְּרוּבִ֥ים וְהַתִּמֹרִ֖ים עֲשׂוּיִ֑ם וְקִ֖יר הַׄהֵׄיׄכָֽׄלׄ׃
verses.translit: mh'rts 'dm'l hptch hkhrvbym vhtmrym 'shvym vqyr hhykhl
verses.translation: From the ground unto above the door were cherubim and palm-trees made; and so on the wall of the temple.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַהֵיכָ֖ל מְזוּזַ֣ת רְבֻעָ֑ה וּפְנֵ֣י הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה כַּמַּרְאֶֽה׃
verses.translit: hhykhl mzvzt rb'h vpny hqdsh hmr'h khmr'h
verses.translation: As for the temple, the jambs were squared; and the face of the sanctuary had an appearance such as is the appearance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמִּזְבֵּ֡חַ עֵ֣ץ שָׁלוֹשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת גָּבֹ֜הַּ וְאׇרְכּ֣וֹ שְׁתַּֽיִם־אַמּ֗וֹת וּמִקְצֹֽעוֹתָיו֙ ל֔וֹ וְאׇרְכּ֥וֹ וְקִירֹתָ֖יו עֵ֑ץ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלַ֔י זֶ֚ה הַשֻּׁלְחָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hmzbch 'ts shlvsh 'mvt gbh v'rkhv shtym'mvt vmqts'vtyv lv v'rkhv vqyrtyv 'ts vydbr 'ly zh hshlchn 'shr lpny yhvh
verses.translation: The altar, three cubits high, and the length thereof two cubits, was of wood, and so the corners thereof; the length thereof, and the walls thereof, were also of wood; and he said unto me: ‘This is the table that is before the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁתַּ֧יִם דְּלָת֛וֹת לַהֵיכָ֖ל וְלַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: vshtym dltvt lhykhl vlqdsh
verses.translation: And the temple and the sanctuary had two doors.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁתַּ֥יִם דְּלָת֖וֹת לַדְּלָת֑וֹת שְׁ֚תַּיִם מוּסַבּ֣וֹת דְּלָת֔וֹת שְׁ֚תַּיִם לְדֶ֣לֶת אֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּ֥י דְלָת֖וֹת לָאַחֶֽרֶת׃
verses.translit: vshtym dltvt ldltvt shtym mvsbvt dltvt shtym ldlt 'cht vshty dltvt l'chrt
verses.translation: And the doors had two leaves [apiece], two turning leaves; two leaves for the one door, and two leaves for the other.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲשׂוּיָ֨ה אֲלֵיהֶ֜ן אֶל־דַּלְת֤וֹת הַהֵיכָל֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים וְתִמֹרִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשׂוּיִ֖ם לַקִּיר֑וֹת וְעָ֥ב עֵ֛ץ אֶל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאוּלָ֖ם מֵהַחֽוּץ׃
verses.translit: v'shvyh 'lyhn 'ldltvt hhykhl khrvbym vtmrym kh'shr 'shvym lqyrvt v'b 'ts 'lpny h'vlm mhchvts
verses.translation: And there were made on them, on the doors of the temple, cherubim and palm-trees, like as were made upon the walls; and there were thick beams of wood upon the face of the porch without.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחַלּוֹנִ֨ים אֲטֻמ֤וֹת וְתִֽמֹרִים֙ מִפּ֣וֹ וּמִפּ֔וֹ אֶל־כִּתְפ֖וֹת הָאוּלָ֑ם וְצַלְע֥וֹת הַבַּ֖יִת וְהָעֻבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vchlvnym 'tmvt vtmrym mpv vmpv 'lkhtpvt h'vlm vtsl'vt hbyt vh'bym
verses.translation: And there were narrow windows and palm-trees on the one side and on the other side, on the sides of the porch; there were also the brackets of the house, and the thick beams.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִאֵ֗נִי אֶל־הֶחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֑וֹן וַיְבִאֵ֣נִי אֶל־הַלִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נֶ֧גֶד הַגִּזְרָ֛ה וַאֲשֶֽׁר־נֶ֥גֶד הַבִּנְיָ֖ן אֶל־הַצָּפֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vyvts'ny 'lhchtsr hchytsvnh hdrkh drkh htspvn vyb'ny 'lhlshkhh 'shr ngd hgzrh v'shrngd hbnyn 'lhtspvn
verses.translation: Then he brought me forth into the outer court, the way toward the north; and he brought me into the chamber that was over against the separate place, and which was over against the building, toward the north,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶל־פְּנֵי־אֹ֙רֶךְ֙ אַמּ֣וֹת הַמֵּאָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח הַצָּפ֑וֹן וְהָרֹ֖חַב חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'lpny'rkh 'mvt hm'h ptch htspvn vhrchb chmshym 'mvt
verses.translation: even to the front of the length of a hundred cubits, with the door on the north, and the breadth of fifty cubits,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נֶ֣גֶד הָעֶשְׂרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֙ לֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔י וְנֶ֣גֶד רִֽצְפָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֶחָצֵ֣ר הַחִיצוֹנָ֑ה אַתִּ֥יק אֶל־פְּנֵֽי־אַתִּ֖יק בַּשְּׁלִשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: ngd h'shrym 'shr lchtsr hpnymy vngd rtsph 'shr lchtsr hchytsvnh 'tyq 'lpny'tyq bshlshym
verses.translation: over against the twenty cubits which belonged to the inner court, and over against the pavement which belonged to the outer court; with gallery against gallery in three stories.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִפְנֵ֨י הַלְּשָׁכ֜וֹת מַהֲלַךְ֩ עֶ֨שֶׂר אַמּ֥וֹת רֹ֙חַב֙ אֶל־הַפְּנִימִ֔ית דֶּ֖רֶךְ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּפִתְחֵיהֶ֖ם לַצָּפֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vlpny hlshkhvt mhlkh 'shr 'mvt rchb 'lhpnymyt drkh 'mh 'cht vptchyhm ltspvn
verses.translation: And before the chambers was a walk of ten cubits breadth inward, a way of one cubit; and their doors were toward the north.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַלְּשָׁכ֥וֹת הָעֶלְיוֹנֹ֖ת קְצֻר֑וֹת כִּֽי־יוֹכְל֨וּ אַתִּיקִ֜ים מֵהֵ֗נָּה מֵהַתַּחְתֹּנ֛וֹת וּמֵהַתִּכוֹנ֖וֹת בִּנְיָֽן׃
verses.translit: vhlshkhvt h'lyvnt qtsrvt khyyvkhlv 'tyqym mhnh mhtchtnvt vmhtkhvnvt bnyn
verses.translation: Now the upper chambers were shorter; for the galleries took away from these, more than from the lower and the middlemost, in the building.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י מְשֻׁלָּשׁוֹת֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְאֵ֤ין לָהֶן֙ עַמּוּדִ֔ים כְּעַמּוּדֵ֖י הַחֲצֵר֑וֹת עַל־כֵּ֣ן נֶאֱצַ֗ל מֵהַתַּחְתּוֹנ֛וֹת וּמֵהַתִּיכֹנ֖וֹת מֵהָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khy mshlshvt hnh v'yn lhn 'mvdym kh'mvdy hchtsrvt 'lkhn n'tsl mhtchtvnvt vmhtykhnvt mh'rts
verses.translation: For they were in three stories, and they had not pillars as the pillars of the courts; therefore room was taken away from the lowest and the middlemost, in comparison with the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגָדֵ֤ר אֲשֶׁר־לַחוּץ֙ לְעֻמַּ֣ת הַלְּשָׁכ֔וֹת דֶּ֛רֶךְ הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַחִצוֹנָ֖ה אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י הַלְּשָׁכ֑וֹת אׇרְכּ֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vgdr 'shrlchvts l'mt hlshkhvt drkh hchtsr hchtsvnh 'lpny hlshkhvt 'rkhv chmshym 'mh
verses.translation: And the wall that was without by the side of the chambers, toward the outer court in front of the chambers, the length thereof was fifty cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אֹ֣רֶךְ הַלְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֶחָצֵ֥ר הַחִצוֹנָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַהֵיכָ֖ל מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: khy'rkh hlshkhvt 'shr lchtsr hchtsvnh chmshym 'mh vhnh 'lpny hhykhl m'h 'mh
verses.translation: For the length of the chambers that were toward the outer court was fifty cubits; and, lo, before the temple were a hundred cubits.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ומתחתה לשכות) [וּמִתַּ֖חַת הַלְּשָׁכ֣וֹת] הָאֵ֑לֶּה (המבוא) [הַמֵּבִיא֙] מֵֽהַקָּדִ֔ים בְּבֹא֣וֹ לָהֵ֔נָּה מֵהֶחָצֵ֖ר הַחִצֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: (vmtchth lshkhvt) [vmtcht hlshkhvt] h'lh (hmbv') [hmby'] mhqdym bb'v lhnh mhchtsr hchtsnh
verses.translation: And from under these chambers was the entry on the east side, as one goeth into them from the outer court.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרֹ֣חַב  גֶּ֣דֶר הֶחָצֵ֗ר דֶּ֧רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֛ים אֶל־פְּנֵ֧י הַגִּזְרָ֛ה וְאֶל־פְּנֵ֥י הַבִּנְיָ֖ן לְשָׁכֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: brchb  gdr hchtsr drkh hqdym 'lpny hgzrh v'lpny hbnyn lshkhvt
verses.translation: In the breadth of the wall of the court toward the east, before the separate place, and before the building, there were chambers,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדֶ֙רֶךְ֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה הַלְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן כְּאׇרְכָּ֖ן כֵּ֣ן רׇחְבָּ֑ן וְכֹל֙ מוֹצָ֣אֵיהֶ֔ן וּכְמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶ֖ן וּכְפִתְחֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vdrkh lpnyhm khmr'h hlshkhvt 'shr drkh htspvn kh'rkhn khn rchbn vkhl mvts'yhn vkhmshptyhn vkhptchyhn
verses.translation: with a way before them; like the appearance of the chambers which were toward the north, as long as they, and as broad as they, with all their goings out, and according to their fashions; and as their doors,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְפִתְחֵ֣י הַלְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֔וֹם פֶּ֖תַח בְּרֹ֣אשׁ דָּ֑רֶךְ דֶּ֗רֶךְ בִּפְנֵי֙ הַגְּדֶ֣רֶת הֲגִינָ֔ה דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֖ים בְּבוֹאָֽן׃
verses.translit: vkhptchy hlshkhvt 'shr drkh hdrvm ptch br'sh drkh drkh bpny hgdrt hgynh drkh hqdym bbv'n
verses.translation: so were also the doors of the chambers that were toward the south, there was a door in the head of the way, even the way directly before the wall, toward the way from the east, as one entereth into them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י לִֽשְׁכ֨וֹת הַצָּפ֜וֹן לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת הַדָּרוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י הַגִּזְרָה֒ הֵ֣נָּה  לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֹאכְלוּ־שָׁ֧ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־קְרוֹבִ֥ים לַיהֹוָ֖ה קׇדְשֵׁ֣י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים שָׁ֞ם יַנִּ֣יחוּ  קׇדְשֵׁ֣י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים וְהַמִּנְחָה֙ וְהַחַטָּ֣את וְהָאָשָׁ֔ם כִּ֥י הַמָּק֖וֹם קָדֹֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly lshkhvt htspvn lshkhvt hdrvm 'shr 'lpny hgzrh hnh  lshkhvt hqdsh 'shr y'khlvshm hkhhnym 'shrqrvbym lyhvh qdshy hqdshym shm ynychv  qdshy hqdshym vhmnchh vhcht't vh'shm khy hmqvm qdsh
verses.translation: Then said he unto me: ‘The north chambers and the south chambers, which are before the separate place, they are the holy chambers, where the priests that are near unto the LORD shall eat the most holy things; there shall they lay the most holy things, and the meal-offering, and the sin-offering, and the guilt-offering; for the place is holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּבֹאָ֣ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וְלֹֽא־יֵצְא֤וּ מֵהַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַחִיצוֹנָ֔ה וְשָׁ֞ם יַנִּ֧יחוּ בִגְדֵיהֶ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־יְשָׁרְת֥וּ בָהֶ֖ן כִּֽי־קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑נָּה (ילבשו) [וְלָֽבְשׁוּ֙] בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְקָרְב֖וּ אֶל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: bb'm hkhhnym vl'yts'v mhqdsh 'lhchtsr hchytsvnh vshm ynychv bgdyhm 'shryshrtv bhn khyqdsh hnh (ylbshv) [vlbshv] bgdym 'chrym vqrbv 'l'shr l'm
verses.translation: When the priests enter in, then shall they not go out of the holy place into the outer court, but there they shall lay their garments wherein they minister, for they are holy; and they shall put on other garments, and shall approach to that which pertaineth to the people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִלָּ֗ה אֶת־מִדּוֹת֙ הַבַּ֣יִת הַפְּנִימִ֔י וְהוֹצִיאַ֙נִי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשַּׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וּמְדָד֖וֹ סָבִ֥יב ׀ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vkhlh 'tmdvt hbyt hpnymy vhvtsy'ny drkh hsh'r 'shr pnyv drkh hqdym vmddv sbyb  sbyb
verses.translation: Now when he had made an end of measuring the inner house, he brought me forth by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east, and measured it round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָדַ֛ד ר֥וּחַ הַקָּדִ֖ים בִּקְנֵ֣ה הַמִּדָּ֑ה חֲמֵשׁ־[מֵא֥וֹת] (אמות) קָנִ֛ים בִּקְנֵ֥ה הַמִּדָּ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: mdd rvch hqdym bqnh hmdh chmsh[m'vt] ('mvt) qnym bqnh hmdh sbyb
verses.translation: He measured the east side with the measuring reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָדַ֖ד ר֣וּחַ הַצָּפ֑וֹן חֲמֵשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת קָנִ֛ים בִּקְנֵ֥ה הַמִּדָּ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: mdd rvch htspvn chmshm'vt qnym bqnh hmdh sbyb
verses.translation: He measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֛ת ר֥וּחַ הַדָּר֖וֹם מָדָ֑ד חֲמֵשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת קָנִ֖ים בִּקְנֵ֥ה הַמִּדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 't rvch hdrvm mdd chmshm'vt qnym bqnh hmdh
verses.translation: He measured the south side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סָבַ֖ב אֶל־ר֣וּחַ הַיָּ֑ם מָדַ֛ד חֲמֵשׁ־מֵא֥וֹת קָנִ֖ים בִּקְנֵ֥ה הַמִּדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: sbb 'lrvch hym mdd chmshm'vt qnym bqnh hmdh
verses.translation: He turned about to the west side, and measured five hundred reeds with the measuring reed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְאַרְבַּ֨ע רוּח֜וֹת מְדָד֗וֹ ח֤וֹמָה לוֹ֙ סָבִ֣יב ׀ סָבִ֔יב אֹ֚רֶךְ חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וְרֹ֖חַב חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת לְהַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לְחֹֽל׃
verses.translit: l'rb' rvchvt mddv chvmh lv sbyb  sbyb 'rkh chmsh m'vt vrchb chmsh m'vt lhbdyl byn hqdsh lchl
verses.translation: He measured it by the four sides; it had a wall round about, the length five hundred, and the breadth five hundred, to make a separation between that which was holy and that which was common.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּוֹלִכֵ֖נִי אֶל־הַשָּׁ֑עַר שַׁ֕עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פֹּנֶ֖ה דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyvlkhny 'lhsh'r sh'r 'shr pnh drkh hqdym
verses.translation: Afterward he brought me to the gate, even the gate that looketh toward the east;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֗ה כְּבוֹד֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּ֖א מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וְקוֹל֗וֹ כְּקוֹל֙ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים וְהָאָ֖רֶץ הֵאִ֥ירָה מִכְּבֹדֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhnh khbvd 'lhy yshr'l b' mdrkh hqdym vqvlv khqvl mym rbym vh'rts h'yrh mkhbdv
verses.translation: and, behold, the glory of the God of Israel came from the way of the east; and His voice was like the sound of many waters; and the earth did shine with His glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְמַרְאֵ֨ה הַמַּרְאֶ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֗יתִי כַּמַּרְאֶ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־רָאִ֙יתִי֙ בְּבֹאִי֙ לְשַׁחֵ֣ת אֶת־הָעִ֔יר וּמַרְא֕וֹת כַּמַּרְאֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי אֶל־נְהַר־כְּבָ֑ר וָאֶפֹּ֖ל אֶל־פָּנָֽי׃
verses.translit: vkhmr'h hmr'h 'shr r'yty khmr'h 'shrr'yty bb'y lshcht 'th'yr vmr'vt khmr'h 'shr r'yty 'lnhrkhbr v'pl 'lpny
verses.translation: And the appearance of the vision which I saw was like the vision that I saw when I came to destroy the city; and the visions were like the vision that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְב֥וֹד יְהֹוָ֖ה בָּ֣א אֶל־הַבָּ֑יִת דֶּ֣רֶךְ שַׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vkhbvd yhvh b' 'lhbyt drkh sh'r 'shr pnyv drkh hqdym
verses.translation: And the glory of the LORD came into the house by the way of the gate whose prospect is toward the east.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי ר֔וּחַ וַתְּבִאֵ֕נִי אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֖ר הַפְּנִימִ֑י וְהִנֵּ֛ה מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־יְהֹוָ֖ה הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vtsh'ny rvch vtb'ny 'lhchtsr hpnymy vhnh ml' khbvdyhvh hbyt
verses.translation: And a spirit took me up, and brought me into the inner court; and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁמַ֛ע מִדַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י מֵהַבָּ֑יִת וְאִ֕ישׁ הָיָ֥ה עֹמֵ֖ד אֶצְלִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'shm' mdbr 'ly mhbyt v'ysh hyh 'md 'tsly
verses.translation: And I heard one speaking unto me out of the house; and a man stood by me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־אָדָם֙ אֶת־מְק֣וֹם כִּסְאִ֗י וְאֶת־מְקוֹם֙ כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֶשְׁכׇּן־שָׁ֛ם בְּת֥וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעוֹלָ֑ם וְלֹ֣א יְטַמְּא֣וּ ע֣וֹד בֵּֽית־יִ֠שְׂרָאֵ֠ל שֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשִׁ֞י הֵ֤מָּה וּמַלְכֵיהֶם֙ בִּזְנוּתָ֔ם וּבְפִגְרֵ֥י מַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם בָּמוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm 'tmqvm khs'y v'tmqvm khpvt rgly 'shr 'shkhnshm btvkh bnyyshr'l l'vlm vl' ytm'v 'vd bytyshr'l shm qdshy hmh vmlkhyhm bznvtm vbpgry mlkhyhm bmvtm
verses.translation: And He said unto me: ‘Son of man, this is the place of My throne, and the place of the soles of My feet, where I will dwell in the midst of the children of Israel for ever; and the house of Israel shall no more defile My holy name, neither they, nor their kings, by their harlotry, and by the carcasses of their kings in their high places;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּתִתָּ֨ם סִפָּ֜ם אֶת־סִפִּ֗י וּמְזֽוּזָתָם֙ אֵ֣צֶל מְזוּזָתִ֔י וְהַקִּ֖יר בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֵיהֶ֑ם וְטִמְּא֣וּ  אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם קׇדְשִׁ֗י בְּתֽוֹעֲבוֹתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֔וּ וָאֲכַ֥ל אֹתָ֖ם בְּאַפִּֽי׃
verses.translit: bttm spm 'tspy vmzvztm 'tsl mzvzty vhqyr byny vbynyhm vtm'v  'tshm qdshy btv'bvtm 'shr 'shv v'khl 'tm b'py
verses.translation: in their setting of their threshold by My threshold, and their door-post beside My door-post, and there was but the wall between Me and them; and they have defiled My holy name by their abominations which they have committed; wherefore I have consumed them in Mine anger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּ֞ה יְרַחֲק֧וּ אֶת־זְנוּתָ֛ם וּפִגְרֵ֥י מַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֥י בְתוֹכָ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'th yrchqv 'tznvtm vpgry mlkhyhm mmny vshkhnty btvkhm l'vlm {s}
verses.translation: Now let them put away their harlotry, and the carcasses of their kings, far from Me, and I will dwell in the midst of them for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם הַגֵּ֤ד אֶת־בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־הַבַּ֔יִת וְיִכָּלְמ֖וּ מֵעֲוֺנֽוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וּמָדְד֖וּ אֶת־תׇּכְנִֽית׃
verses.translit: 'th bn'dm hgd 'tbytyshr'l 'thbyt vykhlmv m'vnvtyhm vmddv 'ttkhnyt
verses.translation: Thou, son of man, show the house to the house of Israel, that they may be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure accurately.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִֽם־נִכְלְמ֞וּ מִכֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֗וּ צוּרַ֣ת הַבַּ֡יִת וּתְכוּנָת֡וֹ וּמוֹצָאָ֡יו וּמוֹבָאָ֣יו וְֽכׇל־צוּרֹתָ֡ו וְאֵ֣ת כׇּל־חֻקֹּתָיו֩ וְכׇל־צ֨וּרֹתָ֤ו וְכׇל־תּֽוֹרֹתָו֙ הוֹדַ֣ע אוֹתָ֔ם וּכְתֹ֖ב לְעֵינֵיהֶ֑ם וְיִשְׁמְר֞וּ אֶת־כׇּל־צוּרָת֛וֹ וְאֶת־כׇּל־חֻקֹּתָ֖יו וְעָשׂ֥וּ אוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mnkhlmv mkhl 'shr'shv tsvrt hbyt vtkhvntv vmvts'yv vmvb'yv vkhltsvrtv v't khlchqtyv vkhltsvrtv vkhltvrtv hvd' 'vtm vkhtb l'ynyhm vyshmrv 'tkhltsvrtv v'tkhlchqtyv v'shv 'vtm
verses.translation: And if they be ashamed of all that they have done, make known unto them the form of the house, and the fashion thereof, and the goings out thereof, and the comings in thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and all the forms thereof, and all the laws thereof, and write it in their sight; that they may keep the whole form thereof, and all the ordinances thereof, and do them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֣ת הַבָּ֑יִת עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָ֠הָ֠ר כׇּל־גְּבֻל֞וֹ סָבִ֤יב ׀ סָבִיב֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קׇדָשִׁ֔ים הִנֵּה־זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֥ת הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: z't tvrt hbyt 'lr'sh hhr khlgblv sbyb  sbyb qdsh qdshym hnhz't tvrt hbyt
verses.translation: This is the law of the house: upon the top of the mountain the whole limit thereof round about shall be most holy. Behold, this is the law of the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה מִדּ֤וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ בָּאַמּ֔וֹת אַמָּ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה וָטֹ֑פַח וְחֵ֨יק הָאַמָּ֜ה וְאַמָּה־רֹ֗חַב וּגְבוּלָ֨הּ אֶל־שְׂפָתָ֤הּ סָבִיב֙ זֶ֣רֶת הָאֶחָ֔ד וְזֶ֖ה גַּ֥ב הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: v'lh mdvt hmzbch b'mvt 'mh 'mh vtpch vchyq h'mh v'mhrchb vgbvlh 'lshpth sbyb zrt h'chd vzh gb hmzbch
verses.translation: And these are the measures of the altar by cubits—the cubit is a cubit and a handbreadth: the bottom shall be a cubit, and the breadth a cubit, and the border thereof by the edge thereof round about a span; and this shall be the base of the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵחֵ֨יק הָאָ֜רֶץ עַד־הָעֲזָרָ֤ה הַתַּחְתּוֹנָה֙ שְׁתַּ֣יִם אַמּ֔וֹת וְרֹ֖חַב אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּמֵהָעֲזָרָ֨ה הַקְּטַנָּ֜ה עַד־הָעֲזָרָ֤ה הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ אַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֔וֹת וְרֹ֖חַב הָאַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vmchyq h'rts 'dh'zrh htchtvnh shtym 'mvt vrchb 'mh 'cht vmh'zrh hqtnh 'dh'zrh hgdvlh 'rb' 'mvt vrchb h'mh
verses.translation: And from the bottom upon the ground to the lower settle shall be two cubits, and the breadth one cubit; and from the lesser settle to the greater settle shall be four cubits, and the breadth a cubit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַהַרְאֵ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע אַמּ֑וֹת (ומהאראיל) [וּמֵהָאֲרִיאֵ֣ל] וּלְמַ֔עְלָה הַקְּרָנ֖וֹת אַרְבַּֽע׃
verses.translit: vhhr'l 'rb' 'mvt (vmh'r'yl) [vmh'ry'l] vlm'lh hqrnvt 'rb'
verses.translation: And the hearth shall be four cubits; and from the hearth and upward there shall be four horns.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (והאראיל) [וְהָאֲרִיאֵ֗ל] שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ בִּשְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה רֹ֑חַב רָב֕וּעַ אֶ֖ל אַרְבַּ֥עַת רְבָעָֽיו׃
verses.translit: (vh'r'yl) [vh'ry'l] shtym 'shrh 'rkh bshtym 'shrh rchb rbv' 'l 'rb't rb'yv
verses.translation: And the hearth shall be twelve cubits long by twelve broad, square in the four sides thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָעֲזָרָ֞ה אַרְבַּ֧ע עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה אֹ֗רֶךְ בְּאַרְבַּ֤ע עֶשְׂרֵה֙ רֹ֔חַב אֶ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣עַת רְבָעֶ֑יהָ וְהַגְּבוּל֩ סָבִ֨יב אוֹתָ֜הּ חֲצִ֣י הָאַמָּ֗ה וְהַחֵֽיק־לָ֤הּ אַמָּה֙ סָבִ֔יב וּמַעֲלֹתֵ֖הוּ פְּנ֥וֹת קָדִֽים׃
verses.translit: vh'zrh 'rb' 'shrh 'rkh b'rb' 'shrh rchb 'l 'rb't rb'yh vhgbvl sbyb 'vth chtsy h'mh vhchyqlh 'mh sbyb vm'lthv pnvt qdym
verses.translation: And the settle shall be fourteen cubits long by fourteen broad in the four sides thereof; and the border about it shall be half a cubit; and the bottom thereof shall be a cubit about; and the steps thereof shall look toward the east.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־אָדָם֙ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה אֵ֚לֶּה חֻקּ֣וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּי֖וֹם הֵעָשׂוֹת֑וֹ לְהַעֲל֤וֹת עָלָיו֙ עוֹלָ֔ה וְלִזְרֹ֥ק עָלָ֖יו דָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly bn'dm khh 'mr 'dny yhvh 'lh chqvt hmzbch byvm h'shvtv lh'lvt 'lyv 'vlh vlzrq 'lyv dm
verses.translation: And He said unto me: ‘Son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD: These are the ordinances of the altar in the day when they shall make it, to offer burnt-offerings thereon, and to dash blood against it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים הַלְוִיִּ֡ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵם֩ מִזֶּ֨רַע צָד֜וֹק הַקְּרֹבִ֣ים אֵלַ֗י נְאֻ֛ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֖ה לְשָׁרְתֵ֑נִי פַּ֥ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֖ר לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vntth 'lhkhhnym hlvym 'shr hm mzr' tsdvq hqrbym 'ly n'm 'dny yhvh lshrtny pr bnbqr lcht't
verses.translation: Thou shalt give to the priests the Levites that are of the seed of Zadok, who are near unto Me, to minister unto Me, saith the Lord GOD, a young bullock for a sin-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ מִדָּמ֗וֹ וְנָ֨תַתָּ֜ה עַל־אַרְבַּ֤ע קַרְנֹתָיו֙ וְאֶל־אַרְבַּע֙ פִּנּ֣וֹת הָעֲזָרָ֔ה וְאֶֽל־הַגְּב֖וּל סָבִ֑יב וְחִטֵּאתָ֥ אוֹת֖וֹ וְכִפַּרְתָּֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vlqcht mdmv vntth 'l'rb' qrntyv v'l'rb' pnvt h'zrh v'lhgbvl sbyb vcht't 'vtv vkhprthv
verses.translation: And thou shalt take of the blood thereof, and put it on the four horns of it, and on the four corners of the settle, and upon the border round about; thus shalt thou purify it and make atonement for it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת הַפָּ֣ר הַחַטָּ֑את וּשְׂרָפוֹ֙ בְּמִפְקַ֣ד הַבַּ֔יִת מִח֖וּץ לַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vlqcht 't hpr hcht't vshrpv bmpqd hbyt mchvts lmqdsh
verses.translation: Thou shalt also take the bullock of the sin-offering, and it shall be burnt in the appointed place of the house, without the sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י תַּקְרִ֛יב שְׂעִיר־עִזִּ֥ים תָּמִ֖ים לְחַטָּ֑את וְחִטְּאוּ֙ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר חִטְּא֖וּ בַּפָּֽר׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hshny tqryb sh'yr'zym tmym lcht't vcht'v 'thmzbch kh'shr cht'v bpr
verses.translation: And on the second day thou shalt offer a he-goat without blemish for a sin-offering; and they shall purify the altar, as they did purify it with the bullock.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכַלּוֹתְךָ֖ מֵחַטֵּ֑א תַּקְרִיב֙ פַּ֣ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֣ר תָּמִ֔ים וְאַ֥יִל מִן־הַצֹּ֖אן תָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: bkhlvtkh mcht' tqryb pr bnbqr tmym v'yl mnhts'n tmym
verses.translation: When thou hast made an end of purifying it, thou shalt offer a young bullock without blemish, and a ram out of the flock without blemish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֖ם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְהִשְׁלִ֨יכוּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים עֲלֵיהֶם֙ מֶ֔לַח וְהֶעֱל֥וּ אוֹתָ֛ם עֹלָ֖ה לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhqrbtm lpny yhvh vhshlykhv hkhhnym 'lyhm mlch vh'lv 'vtm 'lh lyhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt present them before the LORD, and the priests shall cast salt upon them, and they shall offer them up for a burnt-offering unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה שְׂעִיר־חַטָּ֖את לַיּ֑וֹם וּפַ֧ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר וְאַ֥יִל מִן־הַצֹּ֖אן תְּמִימִ֥ים יַֽעֲשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: shb't ymym t'shh sh'yrcht't lyvm vpr bnbqr v'yl mnhts'n tmymym y'shv
verses.translation: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin-offering; they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים יְכַפְּרוּ֙ אֶת־הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְטִהֲר֖וּ אֹת֑וֹ וּמִלְא֖וּ יָדָֽו׃
verses.translit: shb't ymym ykhprv 'thmzbch vthrv 'tv vml'v ydv
verses.translation: Seven days shall they make atonement for the altar and cleanse it; so shall they consecrate it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִֽיכַלּ֖וּ אֶת־הַיָּמִ֑ים {ס} וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֜י וָהָ֗לְאָה יַעֲשׂ֨וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ אֶת־עוֹלֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ וְאֶת־שַׁלְמֵיכֶ֔ם וְרָצִ֣אתִי אֶתְכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vykhlv 'thymym {s} vhyh byvm hshmyny vhl'h y'shv hkhhnym 'lhmzbch 't'vlvtykhm v'tshlmykhm vrts'ty 'tkhm n'm 'dny yhvh {s}
verses.translation: And when they have accomplished the days, it shall be that upon the eighth day, and forward, the priests shall make your burnt-offerings upon the altar, and your peace-offerings; and I will accept you, saith the Lord GOD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣שֶׁב אֹתִ֗י דֶּ֣רֶךְ שַׁ֤עַר הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ הַחִיצ֔וֹן הַפֹּנֶ֖ה קָדִ֑ים וְה֖וּא סָגֽוּר׃
verses.translit: vyshb 'ty drkh sh'r hmqdsh hchytsvn hpnh qdym vhv' sgvr
verses.translation: Then he brought me back the way of the outer gate of the sanctuary, which looketh toward the east; and it was shut.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜י יְהֹוָ֗ה הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַזֶּה֩ סָג֨וּר יִֽהְיֶ֜ה לֹ֣א יִפָּתֵ֗חַ וְאִישׁ֙ לֹא־יָ֣בֹא ב֔וֹ כִּ֛י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣א ב֑וֹ וְהָיָ֖ה סָגֽוּר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly yhvh hsh'r hzh sgvr yhyh l' yptch v'ysh l'yb' bv khy yhvh 'lhyyshr'l b' bv vhyh sgvr
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me: ‘This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, neither shall any man enter in by it, for the LORD, the God of Israel, hath entered in by it; therefore it shall be shut.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶֽת־הַנָּשִׂ֗יא נָ֥שִׂיא ה֛וּא יֵשֶׁב־בּ֥וֹ (לאכול) [לֶאֱכׇל־]לֶ֖חֶם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה מִדֶּ֨רֶךְ אוּלָ֤ם הַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ יָב֔וֹא וּמִדַּרְכּ֖וֹ יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: 'thnshy' nshy' hv' yshbbv (l'khvl) [l'khl]lchm lpny yhvh mdrkh 'vlm hsh'r ybv' vmdrkhv yts'
verses.translation: As for the prince, being a prince, he shall sit therein to eat bread before the LORD; he shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate, and shall go out by the way of the same.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֜נִי דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁ֣עַר הַצָּפוֹן֮ אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י הַבַּ֒יִת֒ וָאֵ֕רֶא וְהִנֵּ֛ה מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה וָאֶפֹּ֖ל אֶל־פָּנָֽי׃
verses.translit: vyby'ny drkhsh'r htspvn 'lpny hbyt v'r' vhnh ml' khbvdyhvh 'tbyt yhvh v'pl 'lpny
verses.translation: Then he brought me the way of the north gate before the house; and I looked, and, behold, the glory of the LORD filled the house of the LORD; and I fell upon my face.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜י יְהֹוָ֗ה בֶּן־אָדָ֡ם שִׂ֣ים לִבְּךָ֩ וּרְאֵ֨ה בְעֵינֶ֜יךָ וּבְאׇזְנֶ֣יךָ שְּׁמָ֗ע אֵ֣ת כׇּל־אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אֹתָ֔ךְ לְכׇל־חֻקּ֥וֹת בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֖ה וּלְכׇל־תּוֹרֹתָ֑ו וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ לִבְּךָ֙ לִמְב֣וֹא הַבַּ֔יִת בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹצָאֵ֥י הַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly yhvh bn'dm shym lbkh vr'h b'ynykh vb'znykh shm' 't khl'shr 'ny mdbr 'tkh lkhlchqvt bytyhvh vlkhltvrtv vshmt lbkh lmbv' hbyt bkhl mvts'y hmqdsh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me: ‘Son of man, mark well, and behold with thine eyes, and hear with thine ears all that I say unto thee concerning all the ordinances of the house of the LORD, and all the laws thereof; and mark well the entering in of the house, with every going forth of the sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֶל־מֶ֙רִי֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה רַב־לָכֶ֛ם מִֽכׇּל־תּוֹעֲב֥וֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lmry 'lbyt yshr'l khh 'mr 'dny yhvh rblkhm mkhltv'bvtykhm byt yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt say to the rebellious, even to the house of Israel: Thus saith the Lord GOD: O ye house of Israel, let it suffice you of all your abominations,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּהֲבִיאֲכֶ֣ם בְּנֵי־נֵכָ֗ר עַרְלֵי־לֵב֙ וְעַרְלֵ֣י בָשָׂ֔ר לִהְי֥וֹת בְּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י לְחַלְּל֣וֹ אֶת־בֵּיתִ֑י בְּהַקְרִֽיבְכֶ֤ם אֶת־לַחְמִי֙ חֵ֣לֶב וָדָ֔ם וַיָּפֵ֙רוּ֙ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֔י אֶ֖ל כׇּל־תּוֹעֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: bhby'khm bnynkhr 'rlylb v'rly bshr lhyvt bmqdshy lchllv 'tbyty bhqrybkhm 'tlchmy chlb vdm vyprv 'tbryty 'l khltv'bvtykhm
verses.translation: in that ye have brought in aliens, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, to be in My sanctuary, to profane it, even My house, when ye offer My bread, the fat and the blood, and they have broken My covenant, to add unto all your abominations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת קׇדָשָׁ֑י וַתְּשִׂימ֗וּן לְשֹׁמְרֵ֧י מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֛י בְּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י לָכֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vl' shmrtm mshmrt qdshy vtshymvn lshmry mshmrty bmqdshy lkhm {s}
verses.translation: And ye have not kept the charge of My holy things; but ye have set keepers of My charge in My sanctuary to please yourselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ כׇּל־בֶּן־נֵכָ֗ר עֶ֤רֶל לֵב֙ וְעֶ֣רֶל בָּשָׂ֔ר לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא אֶל־מִקְדָּשִׁ֑י לְכׇ֨ל־בֶּן־נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֕ר בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khh'mr 'dny yhvh khlbnnkhr 'rl lb v'rl bshr l' ybv' 'lmqdshy lkhlbnnkhr 'shr btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: No alien, uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in flesh, shall enter into My sanctuary, even any alien that is among the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָחֲקוּ֙ מֵעָלַ֔י בִּתְע֤וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּע֣וּ מֵעָלַ֔י אַחֲרֵ֖י גִּלּוּלֵיהֶ֑ם וְנָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy 'mhlvym 'shr rchqv m'ly bt'vt yshr'l 'shr t'v m'ly 'chry glvlyhm vnsh'v 'vnm
verses.translation: But the Levites, that went far from Me, when Israel went astray, that went astray from Me after their idols, they shall bear their iniquity;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֤וּ בְמִקְדָּשִׁי֙ מְשָׁ֣רְתִ֔ים פְּקֻדּוֹת֙ אֶל־שַׁעֲרֵ֣י הַבַּ֔יִת וּֽמְשָׁרְתִ֖ים אֶת־הַבָּ֑יִת הֵ֠מָּה יִשְׁחֲט֨וּ אֶת־הָעוֹלָ֤ה וְאֶת־הַזֶּ֙בַח֙ לָעָ֔ם וְהֵ֛מָּה יַעַמְד֥וּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֖ם לְשָׁרְתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyv bmqdshy mshrtym pqdvt 'lsh'ry hbyt vmshrtym 'thbyt hmh yshchtv 'th'vlh v'thzbch l'm vhmh y'mdv lpnyhm lshrtm
verses.translation: and they shall be ministers in My sanctuary, having charge at the gates of the house, and ministering in the house: they shall slay the burnt-offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they shall stand before them to minister unto them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשָׁרְת֤וּ אוֹתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י גִלּוּלֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְבֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְמִכְשׁ֣וֹל עָוֺ֑ן עַל־כֵּן֩ נָשָׂ֨אתִי יָדִ֜י עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה וְנָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.translit: y'n 'shr yshrtv 'vtm lpny glvlyhm vhyv lbytyshr'l lmkhshvl 'vn 'lkhn nsh'ty ydy 'lyhm n'm 'dny yhvh vnsh'v 'vnm
verses.translation: Because they ministered unto them before their idols, and became a stumblingblock of iniquity unto the house of Israel; therefore have I lifted up My hand against them, saith the Lord GOD, and they shall bear their iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־יִגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלַי֙ לְכַהֵ֣ן לִ֔י וְלָגֶ֙שֶׁת֙ עַל־כׇּל־קׇ֣דָשַׁ֔י אֶל־קׇדְשֵׁ֖י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים וְנָֽשְׂאוּ֙ כְּלִמָּתָ֔ם וְתוֹעֲבוֹתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: vl'ygshv 'ly lkhhn ly vlgsht 'lkhlqdshy 'lqdshy hqdshym vnsh'v khlmtm vtv'bvtm 'shr 'shv
verses.translation: And they shall not come near unto Me, to minister unto Me in the priest’s office, nor to come near to any of My holy things, unto the things that are most holy; but they shall bear their shame, and their abominations which they have committed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֔ם שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַבָּ֑יִת לְכֹל֙ עֲבֹ֣דָת֔וֹ וּלְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה בּֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vntty 'vtm shmry mshmrt hbyt lkhl 'bdtv vlkhl 'shr y'shh bv {p}
verses.translation: And I will make them keepers of the charge of the house, for all the service thereof, and for all that shall be done therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם בְּנֵ֣י צָד֗וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁמְר֜וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת מִקְדָּשִׁי֙ בִּתְע֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י הֵ֛מָּה יִקְרְב֥וּ אֵלַ֖י לְשָׁרְתֵ֑נִי וְעָמְד֣וּ לְפָנַ֗י לְהַקְרִ֥יב לִי֙ חֵ֣לֶב וָדָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: vhkhhnym hlvym bny tsdvq 'shr shmrv 'tmshmrt mqdshy bt'vt bnyyshr'l m'ly hmh yqrbv 'ly lshrtny v'mdv lpny lhqryb ly chlb vdm n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: But the priests the Levites, the sons of Zadok, that kept the charge of My sanctuary when the children of Israel went astray from Me, they shall come near to Me to minister unto Me; and they shall stand before Me to offer unto Me the fat and the blood, saith the Lord GOD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֜מָּה יָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־מִקְדָּשִׁ֗י וְהֵ֛מָּה יִקְרְב֥וּ אֶל־שֻׁלְחָנִ֖י לְשָׁרְתֵ֑נִי וְשָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתִּֽי׃
verses.translit: hmh yb'v 'lmqdshy vhmh yqrbv 'lshlchny lshrtny vshmrv 'tmshmrty
verses.translation: they shall enter into My sanctuary, and they shall come near to My table, to minister unto Me, and they shall keep My charge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּבוֹאָם֙ אֶֽל־שַׁעֲרֵי֙ הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔ית בִּגְדֵ֥י פִשְׁתִּ֖ים יִלְבָּ֑שׁוּ וְלֹֽא־יַעֲלֶ֤ה עֲלֵיהֶם֙ צֶ֔מֶר בְּשָׁרְתָ֗ם בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֛י הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖ית וָבָֽיְתָה׃
verses.translit: vhyh bbv'm 'lsh'ry hchtsr hpnymyt bgdy pshtym ylbshv vl'y'lh 'lyhm tsmr bshrtm bsh'ry hchtsr hpnymyt vbyth
verses.translation: And it shall be that when they enter in at the gates of the inner court, they shall be clothed with linen garments; and no wool shall come upon them, while they minister in the gates of the inner court, and within.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פַּאֲרֵ֤י פִשְׁתִּים֙ יִהְי֣וּ עַל־רֹאשָׁ֔ם וּמִכְנְסֵ֣י פִשְׁתִּ֔ים יִֽהְי֖וּ עַל־מׇתְנֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א יַחְגְּר֖וּ בַּיָּֽזַע׃
verses.translit: p'ry pshtym yhyv 'lr'shm vmkhnsy pshtym yhyv 'lmtnyhm l' ychgrv byz'
verses.translation: They shall have linen tires upon their heads, and shall have linen breeches upon their loins; they shall not gird themselves with any thing that causeth sweat.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֠בְצֵאתָ֠ם אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֨ר הַחִיצוֹנָ֜ה אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַחִיצוֹנָה֮ אֶל־הָעָם֒ יִפְשְׁט֣וּ אֶת־בִּגְדֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֙מָּה֙ מְשָׁרְתִ֣ם בָּ֔ם וְהִנִּ֥יחוּ אוֹתָ֖ם בְּלִֽשְׁכֹ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְלָֽבְשׁוּ֙ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְלֹא־יְקַדְּשׁ֥וּ אֶת־הָעָ֖ם בְּבִגְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vbts'tm 'lhchtsr hchytsvnh 'lhchtsr hchytsvnh 'lh'm ypshtv 'tbgdyhm 'shrhmh mshrtm bm vhnychv 'vtm blshkht hqdsh vlbshv bgdym 'chrym vl'yqdshv 'th'm bbgdyhm
verses.translation: And when they go forth into the outer court, even into the outer court to the people, they shall put off their garments wherein they minister, and lay them in the holy chambers, and they shall put on other garments, that they sanctify not the people with their garments.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרֹאשָׁם֙ לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֔חוּ וּפֶ֖רַע לֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑חוּ כָּס֥וֹם יִכְסְמ֖וּ אֶת־רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vr'shm l' yglchv vpr' l' yshlchv khsvm ykhsmv 'tr'shyhm
verses.translation: Neither shall they shave their heads, nor suffer their locks to grow long; they shall only poll their heads.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיַ֥יִן לֹא־יִשְׁתּ֖וּ כׇּל־כֹּהֵ֑ן בְּבוֹאָ֖ם אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִֽית׃
verses.translit: vyyn l'yshtv khlkhhn bbv'm 'lhchtsr hpnymyt
verses.translation: Neither shall any priest drink wine, when they enter into the inner court.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַלְמָנָה֙ וּגְרוּשָׁ֔ה לֹא־יִקְח֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם לְנָשִׁ֑ים כִּ֣י אִם־בְּתוּלֹ֗ת מִזֶּ֙רַע֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהָֽאַלְמָנָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה אַלְמָנָ֔ה מִכֹּהֵ֖ן יִקָּֽחוּ׃
verses.translit: v'lmnh vgrvshh l'yqchv lhm lnshym khy 'mbtvlt mzr' byt yshr'l vh'lmnh 'shr thyh 'lmnh mkhhn yqchv
verses.translation: Neither shall they take for their wives a widow, nor her that is put away; but they shall take virgins of the seed of the house of Israel, or a widow that is the widow of a priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־עַמִּ֣י יוֹר֔וּ בֵּ֥ין קֹ֖דֶשׁ לְחֹ֑ל וּבֵין־טָמֵ֥א לְטָה֖וֹר יוֹדִעֻֽם׃
verses.translit: v't'my yvrv byn qdsh lchl vbyntm' lthvr yvd'm
verses.translation: And they shall teach My people the difference between the holy and the common, and cause them to discern between the unclean and the clean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־רִ֗יב הֵ֚מָּה יַעַמְד֣וּ (לשפט) [לְמִשְׁפָּ֔ט] בְּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י (ושפטהו) [יִשְׁפְּט֑וּהוּ] וְאֶת־תּוֹרֹתַ֤י וְאֶת־חֻקֹּתַי֙ בְּכׇל־מוֹעֲדַ֣י יִשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וְאֶת־שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י יְקַדֵּֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: v'lryb hmh y'mdv (lshpt) [lmshpt] bmshpty (vshpthv) [yshptvhv] v'ttvrty v'tchqty bkhlmv'dy yshmrv v'tshbtvty yqdshv
verses.translation: And in a controversy they shall stand to judge; according to Mine ordinances shall they judge it; and they shall keep My laws and My statutes in all My appointed seasons, and they shall hallow My sabbaths.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־מֵ֣ת אָדָ֔ם לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא לְטׇמְאָ֑ה כִּ֣י אִם־לְאָ֡ב וּ֠לְאֵ֠ם וּלְבֵ֨ן וּלְבַ֜ת לְאָ֗ח וּלְאָח֛וֹת אֲשֶֽׁר־לֹא־הָיְתָ֥ה לְאִ֖ישׁ יִטַּמָּֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: v'lmt 'dm l' ybv' ltm'h khy 'ml'b vl'm vlbn vlbt l'ch vl'chvt 'shrl'hyth l'ysh ytm'v
verses.translation: And they shall come near no dead person to defile themselves; but for father, or for mother, or for son, or for daughter, for brother, or for sister that hath had no husband, they may defile themselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵ֖י טׇהֳרָת֑וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים יִסְפְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'chry thrtv shb't ymym ysprvlv
verses.translation: And after he is cleansed, they shall reckon unto him seven days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְיוֹם֩ בֹּא֨וֹ אֶל־הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֤ר הַפְּנִימִית֙ לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ יַקְרִ֖יב חַטָּאת֑וֹ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: vbyvm b'v 'lhqdsh 'lhchtsr hpnymyt lshrt bqdsh yqryb cht'tv n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And in the day that he goeth into the sanctuary, into the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he shall offer his sin-offering, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לְֽנַחֲלָ֔ה אֲנִ֖י נַחֲלָתָ֑ם וַאֲחֻזָּ֗ה לֹֽא־תִתְּנ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲנִ֖י אֲחֻזָּתָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyth lhm lnchlh 'ny nchltm v'chzh l'ttnv lhm byshr'l 'ny 'chztm
verses.translation: And it shall be unto them for an inheritance: I am their inheritance; and ye shall give them no possession in Israel: I am their possession.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמִּנְחָה֙ וְהַחַטָּ֣את וְהָאָשָׁ֔ם הֵ֖מָּה יֹאכְל֑וּם וְכׇל־חֵ֥רֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָהֶ֥ם יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: hmnchh vhcht't vh'shm hmh y'khlvm vkhlchrm byshr'l lhm yhyh
verses.translation: The meal-offering, and the sin-offering, and the guilt-offering, they, even they, shall eat; and every devoted thing in Israel shall be theirs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרֵאשִׁית֩ כׇּל־בִּכּ֨וּרֵי כֹ֜ל וְכׇל־תְּר֣וּמַת כֹּ֗ל מִכֹּל֙ תְּרוּמ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יִהְיֶ֑ה וְרֵאשִׁ֤ית עֲרִסֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ תִּתְּנ֣וּ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן לְהָנִ֥יחַ בְּרָכָ֖ה אֶל־בֵּיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vr'shyt khlbkhvry khl vkhltrvmt khl mkhl trvmvtykhm lkhhnym yhyh vr'shyt 'rsvtykhm ttnv lkhhn lhnych brkhh 'lbytkh
verses.translation: And the first of all the first-fruits of every thing, and every heave-offering of every thing, of all your offerings, shall be for the priests; ye shall also give unto the priest the first of your dough, to cause a blessing to rest on thy house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־נְבֵלָה֙ וּטְרֵפָ֔ה מִן־הָע֖וֹף וּמִן־הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה לֹ֥א יֹאכְל֖וּ הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khlnblh vtrph mnh'vf vmnhbhmh l' y'khlv hkhhnym {p}
verses.translation: The priests shall not eat of any thing that dieth of itself, or is torn, whether it be fowl or beast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְהַפִּֽילְכֶ֨ם אֶת־הָאָ֜רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֗ה תָּרִ֩ימוּ֩ תְרוּמָ֨ה לַיהֹוָ֥ה ׀ קֹ֘דֶשׁ֮ מִן־הָאָ֒רֶץ֒ אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשָׂ֣רָה אָ֑לֶף קֹדֶשׁ־ה֥וּא בְכׇל־גְּבוּלָ֖הּ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vbhpylkhm 'th'rts bnchlh trymv trvmh lyhvh  qdsh mnh'rts 'rkh chmshh v'shrym 'lf 'rkh vrchb 'shrh 'lf qdshhv' bkhlgbvlh sbyb
verses.translation: Moreover, when ye shall divide by lot the land for inheritance, ye shall set apart an offering unto the LORD, a holy portion of the land; the length shall be the length of five and twenty thousand reeds, and the breadth shall be ten thousand; it shall be holy in all the border thereof round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִֽהְיֶ֤ה מִזֶּה֙ אֶל־הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת בַּחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת מְרֻבָּ֣ע סָבִ֑יב וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה מִגְרָ֥שׁ ל֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: yhyh mzh 'lhqdsh chmsh m'vt bchmsh m'vt mrb' sbyb vchmshym 'mh mgrsh lv sbyb
verses.translation: Of this there shall be for the holy place five hundred in length by five hundred in breadth, square round about; and fifty cubits for the open land round about it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִן־הַמִּדָּ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ תָּמ֔וֹד אֹ֗רֶךְ (חמש) [חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה] וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים וּבֽוֹ־יִהְיֶ֥ה הַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קׇדָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vmnhmdh hz't tmvd 'rkh (chmsh) [chmshh] v'shrym 'lf vrchb 'shrt 'lpym vbvyhyh hmqdsh qdsh qdshym
verses.translation: And of this measure shalt thou measure a length of five and twenty thousand, and a breadth of ten thousand; and in it shall be the sanctuary, which is most holy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קֹ֣דֶשׁ מִן־הָאָ֜רֶץ ה֗וּא לַכֹּ֨הֲנִ֜ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֤י הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה הַקְּרֵבִ֖ים לְשָׁרֵ֣ת אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֨ה לָהֶ֤ם מָקוֹם֙ לְבָ֣תִּ֔ים וּמִקְדָּ֖שׁ לַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: qdsh mnh'rts hv' lkhhnym mshrty hmqdsh yhyh hqrbym lshrt 'tyhvh vhyh lhm mqvm lbtym vmqdsh lmqdsh
verses.translation: It is a holy portion of the land; it shall be for the priests, the ministers of the sanctuary, that come near to minister unto the LORD; and it shall be a place for their houses, and a place consecrated for the sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וַעֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים רֹ֑חַב (יהיה) [וְֽהָיָ֡ה] לַלְוִיִּם֩ מְשָׁרְתֵ֨י הַבַּ֧יִת לָהֶ֛ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים לְשָׁכֹֽת׃
verses.translit: vchmshh v'shrym 'lf 'rkh v'shrt 'lpym rchb (yhyh) [vhyh] llvym mshrty hbyt lhm l'chzh 'shrym lshkht
verses.translation: And five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth, which shall be unto the Levites, the ministers of the house, for a possession unto themselves, for twenty chambers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲחֻזַּ֨ת הָעִ֜יר תִּתְּנ֗וּ חֲמֵ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ רֹ֔חַב וְאֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף לְעֻמַּ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְכׇל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: v'chzt h'yr ttnv chmsht 'lpym rchb v'rkh chmshh v'shrym 'lf l'mt trvmt hqdsh lkhlbyt yshr'l yhyh
verses.translation: And ye shall appoint the possession of the city five thousand broad, and five and twenty thousand long, side by side with the offering of the holy portion; it shall be for the whole house of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלַנָּשִׂ֡יא מִזֶּ֣ה וּמִזֶּה֩ לִתְרוּמַ֨ת הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ וְלַאֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָעִ֗יר אֶל־פְּנֵ֤י תְרֽוּמַת־הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ וְאֶל־פְּנֵי֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָעִ֔יר מִפְּאַת־יָ֣ם יָ֔מָּה וּמִפְּאַת־קֵ֖דְמָה קָדִ֑ימָה וְאֹ֗רֶךְ לְעֻמּוֹת֙ אַחַ֣ד הַחֲלָקִ֔ים מִגְּב֥וּל יָ֖ם אֶל־גְּב֥וּל קָדִֽימָה׃
verses.translit: vlnshy' mzh vmzh ltrvmt hqdsh vl'chzt h'yr 'lpny trvmthqdsh v'lpny 'chzt h'yr mp'tym ymh vmp'tqdmh qdymh v'rkh l'mvt 'chd hchlqym mgbvl ym 'lgbvl qdymh
verses.translation: And for the prince, on the one side and on the other side of the holy offering and of the possession of the city, in front of the holy offering and in front of the possession of the city, on the west side westward, and on the east side eastward; and in length answerable unto one of the portions, from the west border unto the east border
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָאָ֛רֶץ יִֽהְיֶה־לּ֥וֹ לַאֲחֻזָּ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹא־יוֹנ֨וּ ע֤וֹד נְשִׂיאַי֙ אֶת־עַמִּ֔י וְהָאָ֛רֶץ יִתְּנ֥וּ לְבֵֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: l'rts yhyhlv l'chzh byshr'l vl'yvnv 'vd nshy'y 't'my vh'rts ytnv lbytyshr'l lshbtyhm {p}
verses.translation: of the land; it shall be to him for a possession in Israel, and My princes shall no more wrong My people; but they shall give the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה רַב־לָכֶם֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חָמָ֤ס וָשֹׁד֙ הָסִ֔ירוּ וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה עֲשׂ֑וּ הָרִ֤ימוּ גְרֻשֹֽׁתֵיכֶם֙ מֵעַ֣ל עַמִּ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: khh'mr 'dny yhvh rblkhm nshy'y yshr'l chms vshd hsyrv vmshpt vtsdqh 'shv hrymv grshtykhm m'l 'my n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: Let it suffice you, O princes of Israel; remove violence and spoil, and execute justice and righteousness; take away your exactions from My people, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֹֽאזְנֵי־צֶ֧דֶק וְאֵֽיפַת־צֶ֛דֶק וּבַת־צֶ֖דֶק יְהִ֥י לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: m'znytsdq v'ypttsdq vbttsdq yhy lkhm
verses.translation: Ye shall have just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֵיפָ֣ה וְהַבַּ֗ת תֹּ֤כֶן אֶחָד֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה לָשֵׂ֕את מַעְשַׂ֥ר הַחֹ֖מֶר הַבָּ֑ת וַעֲשִׂירִ֤ת הַחֹ֙מֶר֙ הָאֵיפָ֔ה אֶל־הַחֹ֖מֶר יִהְיֶ֥ה מַתְכֻּנְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: h'yph vhbt tkhn 'chd yhyh lsh't m'shr hchmr hbt v'shyrt hchmr h'yph 'lhchmr yhyh mtkhntv
verses.translation: The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain the tenth part of a homer, and the ephah the tenth part of a homer; the measure thereof shall be after the homer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַשֶּׁ֖קֶל עֶשְׂרִ֣ים גֵּרָ֑ה עֶשְׂרִ֨ים שְׁקָלִ֜ים חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֗ים עֲשָׂרָ֤ה וַחֲמִשָּׁה֙ שֶׁ֔קֶל הַמָּנֶ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhshql 'shrym grh 'shrym shqlym chmshh v'shrym shqlym 'shrh vchmshh shql hmnh yhyh lkhm
verses.translation: And the shekel shall be twenty gerahs; twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, ten, and five shekels, shall be your maneh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֥את הַתְּרוּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּרִ֑ימוּ שִׁשִּׁ֤ית הָאֵיפָה֙ מֵחֹ֣מֶר הַחִטִּ֔ים וְשִׁשִּׁיתֶם֙ הָאֵיפָ֔ה מֵחֹ֖מֶר הַשְּׂעֹרִֽים׃
verses.translit: z't htrvmh 'shr trymv shshyt h'yph mchmr hchtym vshshytm h'yph mchmr hsh'rym
verses.translation: This is the offering that ye shall set apart: the sixth part of an ephah out of a homer of wheat, and ye shall give the sixth part of an ephah out of a homer of barley;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחֹ֨ק הַשֶּׁ֜מֶן הַבַּ֣ת הַשֶּׁ֗מֶן מַעְשַׂ֤ר הַבַּת֙ מִן־הַכֹּ֔ר עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַבַּתִּ֖ים חֹ֑מֶר כִּֽי־עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַבַּתִּ֖ים חֹֽמֶר׃
verses.translit: vchq hshmn hbt hshmn m'shr hbt mnhkhr 'shrt hbtym chmr khy'shrt hbtym chmr
verses.translation: and the set portion of oil, the bath of oil, shall be the tithe of the bath out of the cor, which is ten baths, even a homer; for ten baths are a homer;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשֶׂה־אַחַ֨ת מִן־הַצֹּ֤אן מִן־הַמָּאתַ֙יִם֙ מִמַּשְׁקֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִנְחָ֖ה וּלְעוֹלָ֣ה וְלִשְׁלָמִ֑ים לְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshh'cht mnhts'n mnhm'tym mmshqh yshr'l lmnchh vl'vlh vlshlmym lkhpr 'lyhm n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: and one lamb of the flock, out of two hundred, from the well-watered pastures of Israel; for a meal-offering, and for a burnt-offering, and for peace-offerings, to make atonement for them, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל הָעָ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ יִהְי֖וּ אֶל־הַתְּרוּמָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את לַנָּשִׂ֖יא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khl h'm h'rts yhyv 'lhtrvmh hz't lnshy' byshr'l
verses.translation: All the people of the land shall give this offering for the prince in Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַֽל־הַנָּשִׂ֣יא יִֽהְיֶ֗ה הָעוֹל֣וֹת וְהַמִּנְחָה֮ וְהַנֵּ֒סֶךְ֒ בַּחַגִּ֤ים וּבֶחֳדָשִׁים֙ וּבַשַּׁבָּת֔וֹת בְּכׇֽל־מוֹעֲדֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֽוּא־יַעֲשֶׂ֞ה אֶת־הַחַטָּ֣את וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֗ה וְאֶת־הָעוֹלָה֙ וְאֶת־הַשְּׁלָמִ֔ים לְכַפֵּ֖ר בְּעַ֥ד בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'lhnshy' yhyh h'vlvt vhmnchh vhnskh bchgym vbchdshym vbshbtvt bkhlmv'dy byt yshr'l hv'y'shh 'thcht't v'thmnchh v'th'vlh v'thshlmym lkhpr b'd bytyshr'l {s}
verses.translation: And it shall be the prince’s part to give the burnt-offerings, and the meal-offerings, and the drink-offerings, in the feasts, and in the new moons, and in the sabbaths, in all the appointed seasons of the house of Israel; he shall prepare the sin-offering, and the meal-offering, and the burnt-offering, and the peace-offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ בָּֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ תִּקַּ֥ח פַּר־בֶּן־בָּקָ֖ר תָּמִ֑ים וְחִטֵּאתָ֖ אֶת־הַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: khh'mr 'dny yhvh br'shvn b'chd lchdsh tqch prbnbqr tmym vcht't 'thmqdsh
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: In the first month, in the first day of the month, thou shalt take a young bullock without blemish; and thou shalt purify the sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדַּ֣ם הַחַטָּ֗את וְנָתַן֙ אֶל־מְזוּזַ֣ת הַבַּ֔יִת וְאֶל־אַרְבַּ֛ע פִּנּ֥וֹת הָעֲזָרָ֖ה לַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְעַ֨ל־מְזוּזַ֔ת שַׁ֖עַר הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִֽית׃
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mdm hcht't vntn 'lmzvzt hbyt v'l'rb' pnvt h'zrh lmzbch v'lmzvzt sh'r hchtsr hpnymyt
verses.translation: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin-offering, and put it upon the door-posts of the house, and upon the four corners of the settle of the altar, and upon the posts of the gate of the inner court.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֵ֤ן תַּֽעֲשֶׂה֙ בְּשִׁבְעָ֣ה בַחֹ֔דֶשׁ מֵאִ֥ישׁ שֹׁגֶ֖ה וּמִפֶּ֑תִי וְכִפַּרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.translit: vkhn t'shh bshb'h bchdsh m'ysh shgh vmpty vkhprtm 'thbyt
verses.translation: And so thou shalt do on the seventh day of the month for every one that erreth, and for him that is simple; so shall ye make atonement for the house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֠רִאשׁ֠וֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם הַפָּ֑סַח חָ֕ג שְׁבֻע֣וֹת יָמִ֔ים מַצּ֖וֹת יֵאָכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: br'shvn b'rb'h 'shr yvm lchdsh yhyh lkhm hpsch chg shb'vt ymym mtsvt y'khl
verses.translation: In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, ye shall have the passover; a feast of seven days; unleavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַנָּשִׂיא֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא בַּעֲד֕וֹ וּבְעַ֖ד כׇּל־עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ פַּ֖ר חַטָּֽאת׃
verses.translit: v'shh hnshy' byvm hhv' b'dv vb'd khl'm h'rts pr cht't
verses.translation: And upon that day shall the prince prepare for himself and for all the people of the land a bullock for a sin-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁבְעַ֨ת יְמֵי־הֶחָ֜ג יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה עוֹלָ֣ה לַיהֹוָ֗ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת פָּ֠רִ֠ים וְשִׁבְעַ֨ת אֵילִ֤ים תְּמִימִם֙ לַיּ֔וֹם שִׁבְעַ֖ת הַיָּמִ֑ים וְחַטָּ֕את שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים לַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: vshb't ymyhchg y'shh 'vlh lyhvh shb't prym vshb't 'ylym tmymm lyvm shb't hymym vcht't sh'yr 'zym lyvm
verses.translation: And the seven days of the feast he shall prepare a burnt-offering to the LORD, seven bullocks and seven rams without blemish daily the seven days; and a he-goat daily for a sin-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנְחָ֗ה אֵיפָ֥ה לַפָּ֛ר וְאֵיפָ֥ה לָאַ֖יִל יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְשֶׁ֖מֶן הִ֥ין לָאֵיפָֽה׃
verses.translit: vmnchh 'yph lpr v'yph l'yl y'shh vshmn hyn l'yph
verses.translation: And he shall prepare a meal-offering, an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּשְּׁבִיעִ֡י בַּחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֤וֹם לַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ בֶּחָ֔ג יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כָאֵ֖לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֑ים כַּֽחַטָּאת֙ כָּעֹלָ֔ה וְכַמִּנְחָ֖ה וְכַשָּֽׁמֶן׃ {ס}
verses.translit: bshby'y bchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh bchg y'shh kh'lh shb't hymym khcht't kh'lh vkhmnchh vkhshmn {s}
verses.translation: In the seventh month, in the fifteenth day of the month, in the feast, shall he do the like the seven days; to the sin-offering as well as the burnt-offering, and the meal-offering as well as the oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִה֒ שַׁ֜עַר הֶחָצֵ֤ר הַפְּנִימִית֙ הַפֹּנֶ֣ה קָדִ֔ים יִהְיֶ֣ה סָג֔וּר שֵׁ֖שֶׁת יְמֵ֣י הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה וּבְי֤וֹם הַשַּׁבָּת֙ יִפָּתֵ֔חַ וּבְי֥וֹם הַחֹ֖דֶשׁ יִפָּתֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: khh'mr 'dny yhvh sh'r hchtsr hpnymyt hpnh qdym yhyh sgvr shsht ymy hm'shh vbyvm hshbt yptch vbyvm hchdsh yptch
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: The gate of the inner court that looketh toward the east shall be shut the six working days; but on the sabbath day it shall be opened, and in the day of the new moon it shall be opened.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֣א הַנָּשִׂ֡יא דֶּ֩רֶךְ֩ אוּלָ֨ם הַשַּׁ֜עַר מִח֗וּץ וְעָמַד֙ עַל־מְזוּזַ֣ת הַשַּׁ֔עַר וְעָשׂ֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים אֶת־עֽוֹלָתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־שְׁלָמָ֔יו וְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוָ֛ה עַל־מִפְתַּ֥ן הַשַּׁ֖עַר וְיָצָ֑א וְהַשַּׁ֥עַר לֹא־יִסָּגֵ֖ר עַד־הָעָֽרֶב׃
verses.translit: vb' hnshy' drkh 'vlm hsh'r mchvts v'md 'lmzvzt hsh'r v'shv hkhhnym 't'vltv v'tshlmyv vhshtchvh 'lmptn hsh'r vyts' vhsh'r l'ysgr 'dh'rb
verses.translation: And the prince shall enter by the way of the porch of the gate without, and shall stand by the post of the gate, and the priests shall prepare his burnt-offering and his peace-offerings, and he shall worship at the threshold of the gate; then he shall go forth; but the gate shall not be shut until the evening.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ עַם־הָאָ֗רֶץ פֶּ֚תַח הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַה֔וּא בַּשַּׁבָּת֖וֹת וּבֶחֳדָשִׁ֑ים לִפְנֵ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhshtchvv 'mh'rts ptch hsh'r hhv' bshbtvt vbchdshym lpny yhvh
verses.translation: Likewise the people of the land shall worship at the door of that gate before the LORD in the sabbaths and in the new moons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָ֣עֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־יַקְרִ֥ב הַנָּשִׂ֖יא לַיהֹוָ֑ה בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֗ת שִׁשָּׁ֧ה כְבָשִׂ֛ים תְּמִימִ֖ם וְאַ֥יִל תָּמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vh'lh 'shryqrb hnshy' lyhvh byvm hshbt shshh khbshym tmymm v'yl tmym
verses.translation: And the burnt-offering that the prince shall offer unto the LORD shall be in the sabbath day six lambs without blemish and a ram without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנְחָה֙ אֵיפָ֣ה לָאַ֔יִל וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֥ים מִנְחָ֖ה מַתַּ֣ת יָד֑וֹ וְשֶׁ֖מֶן הִ֥ין לָאֵיפָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vmnchh 'yph l'yl vlkhbshym mnchh mtt ydv vshmn hyn l'yph {s}
verses.translation: and the meal-offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and the meal-offering for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְי֣וֹם הַחֹ֔דֶשׁ פַּ֥ר בֶּן־בָּקָ֖ר תְּמִימִ֑ם וְשֵׁ֧שֶׁת כְּבָשִׂ֛ים וָאַ֖יִל תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vbyvm hchdsh pr bnbqr tmymm vshsht khbshym v'yl tmymm yhyv
verses.translation: And in the day of the new moon it shall be a young bullock without blemish; and six lambs, and a ram; they shall be without blemish;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵיפָ֨ה לַפָּ֜ר וְאֵיפָ֤ה לָאַ֙יִל֙ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִנְחָ֔ה וְלַ֨כְּבָשִׂ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּשִּׂ֖יג יָד֑וֹ וְשֶׁ֖מֶן הִ֥ין לָאֵיפָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'yph lpr v'yph l'yl y'shh mnchh vlkhbshym kh'shr tshyg ydv vshmn hyn l'yph
verses.translation: and he shall prepare a meal-offering, an ephah for the bullock, and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs according as his means suffice, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְב֖וֹא הַנָּשִׂ֑יא דֶּ֣רֶךְ אוּלָ֤ם הַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ יָב֔וֹא וּבְדַרְכּ֖וֹ יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vbbv' hnshy' drkh 'vlm hsh'r ybv' vbdrkhv yts'
verses.translation: And when the prince shall enter, he shall go in by the way of the porch of the gate, and he shall go forth by the way thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְב֨וֹא עַם־הָאָ֜רֶץ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהֹוָה֮ בַּמּוֹעֲדִים֒ הַבָּ֡א דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁ֨עַר צָפ֜וֹן לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֗ת יֵצֵא֙ דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁ֣עַר נֶ֔גֶב וְהַבָּא֙ דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁ֣עַר נֶ֔גֶב יֵצֵ֖א דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁ֣עַר צָפ֑וֹנָה לֹ֣א יָשׁ֗וּב דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣א ב֔וֹ כִּ֥י נִכְח֖וֹ (יצאו) [יֵצֵֽא]׃
verses.translit: vbbv' 'mh'rts lpny yhvh bmv'dym hb' drkhsh'r tspvn lhshtchvt yts' drkhsh'r ngb vhb' drkhsh'r ngb yts' drkhsh'r tspvnh l' yshvb drkh hsh'r 'shrb' bv khy nkhchv (yts'v) [yts']
verses.translation: But when the people of the land shall come before the LORD in the appointed seasons, he that entereth by the way of the north gate to worship shall go forth by the way of the south gate; and he that entereth by the way of the south gate shall go forth by the way of the north gate; he shall not return by the way of the gate whereby he came in, but shall go forth straight before him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהַנָּשִׂ֑יא בְּתוֹכָ֤ם בְּבוֹאָם֙ יָב֔וֹא וּבְצֵאתָ֖ם יֵצֵֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: vhnshy' btvkhm bbv'm ybv' vbts'tm yts'v
verses.translation: And the prince, when they go in, shall go in in the midst of them; and when they go forth, they shall go forth together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַחַגִּ֣ים וּבַמּוֹעֲדִ֗ים תִּהְיֶ֤ה הַמִּנְחָה֙ אֵיפָ֤ה לַפָּר֙ וְאֵיפָ֣ה לָאַ֔יִל וְלַכְּבָשִׂ֖ים מַתַּ֣ת יָד֑וֹ וְשֶׁ֖מֶן הִ֥ין לָאֵיפָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbchgym vbmv'dym thyh hmnchh 'yph lpr v'yph l'yl vlkhbshym mtt ydv vshmn hyn l'yph {p}
verses.translation: And in the feasts and in the appointed seasons the meal-offering shall be an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יַעֲשֶׂה֩ הַנָּשִׂ֨יא נְדָבָ֜ה עוֹלָ֣ה אוֹ־שְׁלָמִים֮ נְדָבָ֣ה לַיהֹוָה֒ וּפָ֣תַֽח ל֗וֹ אֶת־הַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ הַפֹּנֶ֣ה קָדִ֔ים וְעָשָׂ֤ה אֶת־עֹֽלָתוֹ֙ וְאֶת־שְׁלָמָ֔יו כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְּי֣וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת וְיָצָ֛א וְסָגַ֥ר אֶת־הַשַּׁ֖עַר אַחֲרֵ֥י צֵאתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vkhyy'shh hnshy' ndbh 'vlh 'vshlmym ndbh lyhvh vptch lv 'thsh'r hpnh qdym v'shh 't'ltv v'tshlmyv kh'shr y'shh byvm hshbt vyts' vsgr 'thsh'r 'chry ts'tv
verses.translation: And when the prince shall prepare a freewill-offering, a burnt-offering or peace-offerings as a freewill-offering unto the LORD, one shall open for him the gate that looketh toward the east, and he shall prepare his burnt-offering and his peace-offerings, as he doth on the sabbath day; then he shall go forth; and after his going forth one shall shut the gate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֶ֨בֶשׂ בֶּן־שְׁנָת֜וֹ תָּמִ֗ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה עוֹלָ֛ה לַיּ֖וֹם לַיהֹוָ֑ה בַּבֹּ֥קֶר בַּבֹּ֖קֶר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vkhbsh bnshntv tmym t'shh 'vlh lyvm lyhvh bbqr bbqr t'shh 'tv
verses.translation: And thou shalt prepare a lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt-offering unto the LORD daily; morning by morning shalt thou prepare it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִנְחָה֩ תַעֲשֶׂ֨ה עָלָ֜יו בַּבֹּ֤קֶר בַּבֹּ֙קֶר֙ שִׁשִּׁ֣ית הָאֵיפָ֔ה וְשֶׁ֛מֶן שְׁלִישִׁ֥ית הַהִ֖ין לָרֹ֣ס אֶת־הַסֹּ֑לֶת מִנְחָה֙ לַיהֹוָ֔ה חֻקּ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: vmnchh t'shh 'lyv bbqr bbqr shshyt h'yph vshmn shlyshyt hhyn lrs 'thslt mnchh lyhvh chqvt 'vlm tmyd
verses.translation: And thou shalt prepare a meal-offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of a hin of oil, to moisten the fine flour: a meal-offering unto the LORD continually by a perpetual ordinance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ועשו) [יַעֲשׂ֨וּ] אֶת־הַכֶּ֧בֶשׂ וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֛ה וְאֶת־הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֑קֶר עוֹלַ֖ת תָּמִֽיד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: (v'shv) [y'shv] 'thkhbsh v'thmnchh v'thshmn bbqr bbqr 'vlt tmyd {s}
verses.translation: Thus shall they prepare the lamb, and the meal-offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt-offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה כִּֽי־יִתֵּ֨ן הַנָּשִׂ֤יא מַתָּנָה֙ לְאִ֣ישׁ מִבָּנָ֔יו נַחֲלָת֥וֹ הִ֖יא לְבָנָ֣יו תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה אֲחֻזָּתָ֥ם הִ֖יא בְּנַחֲלָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khh'mr 'dny yhvh khyytn hnshy' mtnh l'ysh mbnyv nchltv hy' lbnyv thyh 'chztm hy' bnchlh {s}
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: If the prince give a gift unto any of his sons, it is his inheritance, it shall belong to his sons; it is their possession by inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִֽי־יִתֵּ֨ן מַתָּנָ֜ה מִנַּחֲלָת֗וֹ לְאַחַד֙ מֵֽעֲבָדָ֔יו וְהָ֤יְתָה לּוֹ֙ עַד־שְׁנַ֣ת הַדְּר֔וֹר וְשָׁבַ֖ת לַנָּשִׂ֑יא אַ֚ךְ נַחֲלָת֔וֹ בָּנָ֖יו לָהֶ֥ם תִּהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vkhyytn mtnh mnchltv l'chd m'bdyv vhyth lv 'dshnt hdrvr vshbt lnshy' 'kh nchltv bnyv lhm thyh
verses.translation: But if he give of his inheritance a gift to one of his servants, it shall be his to the year of liberty; then it shall return to the prince; but as for his inheritance, it shall be for his sons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־יִקַּ֨ח הַנָּשִׂ֜יא מִנַּחֲלַ֣ת הָעָ֗ם לְהֽוֹנֹתָם֙ מֵאֲחֻזָּתָ֔ם מֵאֲחֻזָּת֖וֹ יַנְחִ֣ל אֶת־בָּנָ֑יו לְמַ֙עַן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־יָפֻ֣צוּ עַמִּ֔י אִ֖ישׁ מֵאֲחֻזָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vl'yqch hnshy' mnchlt h'm lhvntm m'chztm m'chztv ynchl 'tbnyv lm'n 'shr l'yptsv 'my 'ysh m'chztv
verses.translation: Moreover the prince shall not take of the people’s inheritance, to thrust them wrongfully out of their possession; he shall give inheritance to his sons out of his own possession; that My people be not scattered every man from his possession.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֣נִי בַמָּבוֹא֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־כֶּ֣תֶף הַשַּׁ֒עַר֒ אֶל־הַלִּשְׁכ֤וֹת הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֶל־הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים הַפֹּנ֖וֹת צָפ֑וֹנָה וְהִנֵּה־שָׁ֣ם מָק֔וֹם (בירכתם) [בַּיַּרְכָתַ֖יִם] יָֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: vyby'ny bmbv' 'shr 'lkhtf hsh'r 'lhlshkhvt hqdsh 'lhkhhnym hpnvt tspvnh vhnhshm mqvm (byrkhtm) [byrkhtym] ymh
verses.translation: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy chambers for the priests, which looked toward the north; and, behold, there was a place on the hinder part westward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י זֶ֣ה הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְבַשְּׁלוּ־שָׁם֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים אֶת־הָאָשָׁ֖ם וְאֶת־הַחַטָּ֑את אֲשֶׁ֤ר יֹאפוּ֙ אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה לְבִלְתִּ֥י הוֹצִ֛יא אֶל־הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַחִיצוֹנָ֖ה לְקַדֵּ֥שׁ אֶת־הָעָֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly zh hmqvm 'shr ybshlvshm hkhhnym 'th'shm v'thcht't 'shr y'pv 'thmnchh lblty hvtsy' 'lhchtsr hchytsvnh lqdsh 'th'm
verses.translation: And he said unto me: ‘This is the place where the priests shall boil the guilt-offering and the sin-offering, where they shall bake the meal-offering; that they bring them not forth into the outer court, to sanctify the people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִיאֵ֗נִי אֶל־הֶחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה וַיַּ֣עֲבִרֵ֔נִי אֶל־אַרְבַּ֖עַת מִקְצוֹעֵ֣י הֶחָצֵ֑ר וְהִנֵּ֤ה חָצֵר֙ בְּמִקְצֹ֣עַ הֶחָצֵ֔ר חָצֵ֖ר בְּמִקְצֹ֥עַ הֶחָצֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vyvtsy'ny 'lhchtsr hchytsvnh vy'brny 'l'rb't mqtsv'y hchtsr vhnh chtsr bmqts' hchtsr chtsr bmqts' hchtsr
verses.translation: Then he brought me forth into the outer court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and, behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאַרְבַּ֜עַת מִקְצֹע֤וֹת הֶחָצֵר֙ חֲצֵר֣וֹת קְטֻר֔וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֣ים אֹ֔רֶךְ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים רֹ֑חַב מִדָּ֣ה אַחַ֔ת לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֖ם מְׄהֻׄקְׄצָׄעֽׄוֹׄתׄ׃
verses.translit: b'rb't mqts'vt hchtsr chtsrvt qtrvt 'rb'ym 'rkh vshlshym rchb mdh 'cht l'rb'tm mhqts'vt
verses.translation: In the four corners of the court there were courts inclosed, forty cubits long and thirty broad; these four in the corners were of one measure.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְט֨וּר סָבִ֥יב בָּהֶ֛ם סָבִ֖יב לְאַרְבַּעְתָּ֑ם וּמְבַשְּׁל֣וֹת עָשׂ֔וּי מִתַּ֥חַת הַטִּיר֖וֹת סָבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: vtvr sbyb bhm sbyb l'rb'tm vmbshlvt 'shvy mtcht htyrvt sbyb
verses.translation: And there was a row of masonry round about in them, round about the four, and it was made with boiling-places under the rows round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלָ֑י אֵ֚לֶּה בֵּ֣ית הַֽמְבַשְּׁלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְבַשְּׁלוּ־שָׁ֛ם מְשָׁרְתֵ֥י הַבַּ֖יִת אֶת־זֶ֥בַח הָעָֽם׃
