verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly 'lh byt hmbshlym 'shr ybshlvshm mshrty hbyt 'tzbch h'm
verses.translation: Then said he unto me: ‘These are the boiling-places, where the ministers of the house shall boil the sacrifices of the people.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְשִׁבֵ֘נִי֮ אֶל־פֶּ֣תַח הַבַּ֒יִת֒ וְהִנֵּה־מַ֣יִם יֹצְאִ֗ים מִתַּ֨חַת מִפְתַּ֤ן הַבַּ֙יִת֙ קָדִ֔ימָה כִּֽי־פְנֵ֥י הַבַּ֖יִת קָדִ֑ים וְהַמַּ֣יִם יֹרְדִ֗ים מִתַּ֜חַת מִכֶּ֤תֶף הַבַּ֙יִת֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית מִנֶּ֖גֶב לַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: vyshbny 'lptch hbyt vhnhmym yts'ym mtcht mptn hbyt qdymh khypny hbyt qdym vhmym yrdym mtcht mkhtf hbyt hymnyt mngb lmzbch
verses.translation: And he brought me back unto the door of the house; and, behold, waters issued out from under the threshold of the house eastward, for the forefront of the house looked toward the east; and the waters came down from under, from the right side of the house, on the south of the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִאֵ֘נִי֮ דֶּרֶךְ־שַׁ֣עַר צָפ֒וֹנָה֒ וַיְסִבֵּ֙נִי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ ח֔וּץ אֶל־שַׁ֣עַר הַח֔וּץ דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַפּוֹנֶ֣ה קָדִ֑ים וְהִנֵּה־מַ֣יִם מְפַכִּ֔ים מִן־הַכָּתֵ֖ף הַיְמָנִֽית׃
verses.translit: vyvts'ny drkhsh'r tspvnh vysbny drkh chvts 'lsh'r hchvts drkh hpvnh qdym vhnhmym mpkhym mnhkhtf hymnyt
verses.translation: Then brought he me out by the way of the gate northward, and led me round by the way without unto the outer gate, by the way of the gate that looketh toward the east; and, behold, there trickled forth waters on the right side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּצֵאת־הָאִ֥ישׁ קָדִ֖ים וְקָ֣ו בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיָּ֤מׇד אֶ֙לֶף֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וַיַּעֲבִרֵ֥נִי בַמַּ֖יִם מֵ֥י אׇפְסָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: bts'th'ysh qdym vqv bydv vymd 'lf b'mh vy'brny bmym my 'psym
verses.translation: When the man went forth eastward with the line in his hand, he measured a thousand cubits, and he caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the ankles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מׇד אֶ֔לֶף וַיַּעֲבִרֵ֥נִי בַמַּ֖יִם מַ֣יִם בִּרְכָּ֑יִם וַיָּ֣מׇד אֶ֔לֶף וַיַּעֲבִרֵ֖נִי מֵ֥י מׇתְנָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vymd 'lf vy'brny bmym mym brkhym vymd 'lf vy'brny my mtnym
verses.translation: Again he measured a thousand, and caused me to pass through the waters, waters that were to the knees. Again he measured a thousand, and caused me to pass through waters that were to the loins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מׇד אֶ֔לֶף נַ֕חַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־אוּכַ֖ל לַעֲבֹ֑ר כִּֽי־גָא֤וּ הַמַּ֙יִם֙ מֵ֣י שָׂ֔חוּ נַ֖חַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־יֵעָבֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vymd 'lf nchl 'shr l''vkhl l'br khyg'v hmym my shchv nchl 'shr l'y'br
verses.translation: Afterward he measured a thousand; and it was a river that I could not pass through; for the waters were risen, waters to swim in, a river that could not be passed through.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלַ֖י הֲרָאִ֣יתָ בֶן־אָדָ֑ם וַיּוֹלִכֵ֥נִי וַיְשִׁבֵ֖נִי שְׂפַ֥ת הַנָּֽחַל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hr'yt bn'dm vyvlkhny vyshbny shpt hnchl
verses.translation: And he said unto me: ‘Hast thou seen this, O son of man?’ Then he led me, and caused me to return to the bank of the river.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשׁוּבֵ֕נִי וְהִנֵּה֙ אֶל־שְׂפַ֣ת הַנַּ֔חַל עֵ֖ץ רַ֣ב מְאֹ֑ד מִזֶּ֖ה וּמִזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: bshvbny vhnh 'lshpt hnchl 'ts rb m'd mzh vmzh
verses.translation: Now when I had been brought back, behold, upon the bank of the river were very many trees on the one side and on the other.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י הַמַּ֤יִם הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ יוֹצְאִ֗ים אֶל־הַגְּלִילָה֙ הַקַּדְמוֹנָ֔ה וְיָרְד֖וּ עַל־הָעֲרָבָ֑ה וּבָ֣אוּ הַיָּ֔מָּה אֶל־הַיָּ֥מָּה הַמּוּצָאִ֖ים וְנִרְפּ֥אוּ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hmym h'lh yvts'ym 'lhglylh hqdmvnh vyrdv 'lh'rbh vb'v hymh 'lhymh hmvts'ym vnrp'v hmym
verses.translation: Then said he unto me: ‘These waters issue forth toward the eastern region, and shall go down into the Arabah; and when they shall enter into the sea, into the sea of the putrid waters, the waters shall be healed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה כׇל־נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֣ה ׀ אֲֽשֶׁר־יִשְׁרֹ֡ץ אֶ֣ל כׇּל־אֲשֶׁר֩ יָב֨וֹא שָׁ֤ם נַחֲלַ֙יִם֙ יִֽחְיֶ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה הַדָּגָ֖ה רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד כִּי֩ בָ֨אוּ שָׁ֜מָּה הַמַּ֣יִם הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְיֵרָֽפְאוּ֙ וָחָ֔י כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יָ֥בוֹא שָׁ֖מָּה הַנָּֽחַל׃
verses.translit: vhyh khlnpsh chyh  'shryshrts 'l khl'shr ybv' shm nchlym ychyh vhyh hdgh rbh m'd khy b'v shmh hmym h'lh vyrp'v vchy khl 'shrybv' shmh hnchl
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that every living creature wherewith it swarmeth, whithersoever the rivers shall come, shall live; and there shall be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters are come thither, that all things be healed and may live whithersoever the river cometh.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ (יעמדו) [עָמְד֨וּ] עָלָ֜יו דַּוָּגִ֗ים מֵעֵ֥ין גֶּ֙דִי֙ וְעַד־עֵ֣ין עֶגְלַ֔יִם מִשְׁט֥וֹחַ לַחֲרָמִ֖ים יִֽהְי֑וּ לְמִינָהֿ֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה דְגָתָ֔ם כִּדְגַ֛ת הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּד֖וֹל רַבָּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vhyh (y'mdv) ['mdv] 'lyv dvgym m'yn gdy v'd'yn 'glym mshtvch lchrmym yhyv lmynh thyh dgtm khdgt hym hgdvl rbh m'd
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that fishers shall stand by it from En-gedi even unto En-eglaim; there shall be a place for the spreading of nets; their fish shall be after their kinds, as the fish of the Great Sea, exceeding many.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּצֹּאתָ֧ו וּגְבָאָ֛יו וְלֹ֥א יֵרָפְא֖וּ לְמֶ֥לַח נִתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: bts'tv vgb'yv vl' yrp'v lmlch ntnv
verses.translation: But the miry places thereof, and the marshes thereof, shall not be healed; they shall be given for salt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־הַנַּ֣חַל יַעֲלֶ֣ה עַל־שְׂפָת֣וֹ מִזֶּ֣ה ׀ וּמִזֶּ֣ה ׀ כׇּל־עֵֽץ־מַ֠אֲכָ֠ל לֹא־יִבּ֨וֹל עָלֵ֜הוּ וְלֹֽא־יִתֹּ֣ם פִּרְי֗וֹ לׇחֳדָשָׁיו֙ יְבַכֵּ֔ר כִּ֣י מֵימָ֔יו מִן־הַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ הֵ֣מָּה יוֹצְאִ֑ים (והיו) [וְהָיָ֤ה] פִרְיוֹ֙ לְמַאֲכָ֔ל וְעָלֵ֖הוּ לִתְרוּפָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'lhnchl y'lh 'lshptv mzh  vmzh  khl'tsm'khl l'ybvl 'lhv vl'ytm pryv lchdshyv ybkhr khy mymyv mnhmqdsh hmh yvts'ym (vhyv) [vhyh] pryv lm'khl v'lhv ltrvph {p}
verses.translation: And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow every tree for food, whose leaf shall not wither, neither shall the fruit thereof fail; it shall bring forth new fruit every month, because the waters thereof issue out of the sanctuary; and the fruit thereof shall be for food, and the leaf thereof for healing.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה גֵּ֤ה גְבוּל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתְנַחֲל֣וּ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ לִשְׁנֵ֥י עָשָׂ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יוֹסֵ֖ף חֲבָלִֽים׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr 'dny yhvh gh gbvl 'shr ttnchlv 'th'rts lshny 'shr shbty yshr'l yvsf chblym
verses.translation: Thus saith the Lord GOD: ‘This shall be the border, whereby ye shall divide the land for inheritance according to the twelve tribes of Israel, Joseph receiving two portions.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְחַלְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתָהּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ כְּאָחִ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־יָדִ֔י לְתִתָּ֖הּ לַאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וְנָ֨פְלָ֜ה הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את לָכֶ֖ם בְּנַחֲלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vnchltm 'vth 'ysh kh'chyv 'shr nsh'ty 'tydy ltth l'btykhm vnplh h'rts hz't lkhm bnchlh
verses.translation: And ye shall inherit it, one as well as another, concerning which I lifted up My hand to give it unto your fathers; and this land shall fall unto you for inheritance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֶ֖ה גְּב֣וּל הָאָ֑רֶץ לִפְאַ֨ת צָפ֜וֹנָה מִן־הַיָּ֧ם הַגָּד֛וֹל הַדֶּ֥רֶךְ חֶתְלֹ֖ן לְב֥וֹא צְדָֽדָה׃
verses.translit: vzh gbvl h'rts lp't tspvnh mnhym hgdvl hdrkh chtln lbv' tsddh
verses.translation: And this shall be the border of the land: on the north side, from the Great Sea, by the way of Hethlon, unto the entrance of Zedad;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲמָ֤ת ׀ בֵּר֙וֹתָה֙ סִבְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁר֙ בֵּין־גְּב֣וּל דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וּבֵ֖ין גְּב֣וּל חֲמָ֑ת חָצֵר֙ הַתִּיכ֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֶל־גְּב֥וּל חַוְרָֽן׃
verses.translit: chmt  brvth sbrym 'shr byngbvl dmshq vbyn gbvl chmt chtsr htykhvn 'shr 'lgbvl chvrn
verses.translation: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, which is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazer-hatticon, which is by the border of Hauran.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה גְב֜וּל מִן־הַיָּ֗ם חֲצַ֤ר עֵינוֹן֙ גְּב֣וּל דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְצָפ֥וֹן ׀ צָפ֖וֹנָה וּגְב֣וּל חֲמָ֑ת וְאֵ֖ת פְּאַ֥ת צָפֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vhyh gbvl mnhym chtsr 'ynvn gbvl dmshq vtspvn  tspvnh vgbvl chmt v't p't tspvn
verses.translation: And the border from the sea shall be Hazar-enon at the border of Damascus, and on the north northward is the border of Hamath. This is the north side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְאַ֣ת קָדִ֡ים מִבֵּ֣ין חַוְרָ֣ן וּמִבֵּין־דַּמֶּ֩שֶׂק֩ וּמִבֵּ֨ין הַגִּלְעָ֜ד וּמִבֵּ֨ין אֶ֤רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן מִגְּב֛וּל עַל־הַיָּ֥ם הַקַּדְמוֹנִ֖י תָּמֹ֑דּוּ וְאֵ֖ת פְּאַ֥ת קָדִֽימָה׃
verses.translit: vp't qdym mbyn chvrn vmbyndmshq vmbyn hgl'd vmbyn 'rts yshr'l hyrdn mgbvl 'lhym hqdmvny tmdv v't p't qdymh
verses.translation: And the east side, between Hauran and Damascus and Gilead, and the land of Israel, by the Jordan, from the border unto the east sea shall ye measure. This is the east side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְאַת֙ נֶ֣גֶב תֵּימָ֔נָה מִתָּמָ֗ר עַד־מֵי֙ מְרִיב֣וֹת קָדֵ֔שׁ נַחֲלָ֖ה אֶל־הַיָּ֣ם הַגָּד֑וֹל וְאֵ֥ת פְּאַת־תֵּימָ֖נָה נֶֽגְבָּה׃
verses.translit: vp't ngb tymnh mtmr 'dmy mrybvt qdsh nchlh 'lhym hgdvl v't p'ttymnh ngbh
verses.translation: And the south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth-kadesh, to the Brook, unto the Great Sea. This is the south side southward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְאַת־יָם֙ הַיָּ֣ם הַגָּד֔וֹל מִגְּב֕וּל עַד־נֹ֖כַח לְב֣וֹא חֲמָ֑ת זֹ֖את פְּאַת־יָֽם׃
verses.translit: vp'tym hym hgdvl mgbvl 'dnkhch lbv' chmt z't p'tym
verses.translation: And the west side shall be the Great Sea, from the border as far as over against the entrance of Hamath. This is the west side.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחִלַּקְתֶּ֞ם אֶת־הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את לָכֶ֖ם לְשִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vchlqtm 'th'rts hz't lkhm lshbty yshr'l
verses.translation: So shall ye divide this land unto you according to the tribes of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה תַּפִּ֣לוּ אוֹתָהּ֮ בְּנַחֲלָה֒ לָכֶ֗ם וּלְהַגֵּרִים֙ הַגָּרִ֣ים בְּתוֹכְכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הוֹלִ֥דוּ בָנִ֖ים בְּתוֹכְכֶ֑ם וְהָי֣וּ לָכֶ֗ם כְּאֶזְרָח֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִתְּכֶם֙ יִפְּל֣וּ בְנַֽחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vhyh tplv 'vth bnchlh lkhm vlhgrym hgrym btvkhkhm 'shrhvldv bnym btvkhkhm vhyv lkhm kh'zrch bbny yshr'l 'tkhm yplv bnchlh btvkh shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that ye shall divide it by lot for an inheritance unto you and to the strangers that sojourn among you, who shall beget children among you; and they shall be unto you as the home-born among the children of Israel; they shall have inheritance with you among the tribes of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה בַשֵּׁ֔בֶט אֲשֶׁר־גָּ֥ר הַגֵּ֖ר אִתּ֑וֹ שָׁ֚ם תִּתְּנ֣וּ נַחֲלָת֔וֹ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh bshbt 'shrgr hgr 'tv shm ttnv nchltv n'm 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that in what tribe the stranger sojourneth, there shall ye give him his inheritance, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים מִקְצֵ֣ה צָפ֡וֹנָה אֶל־יַ֣ד דֶּֽרֶךְ־חֶתְלֹ֣ן ׀ לְֽבוֹא־חֲמָ֡ת חֲצַ֣ר עֵינָן֩ גְּב֨וּל דַּמֶּ֤שֶׂק צָפ֙וֹנָה֙ אֶל־יַ֣ד חֲמָ֔ת וְהָיוּ־ל֧וֹ פְאַת־קָדִ֛ים הַיָּ֖ם דָּ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt hshbtym mqtsh tspvnh 'lyd drkhchtln  lbv'chmt chtsr 'ynn gbvl dmshq tspvnh 'lyd chmt vhyvlv p'tqdym hym dn 'chd
verses.translation: Now these are the names of the tribes: from the north end, beside the way of Hethlon to the entrance of Hamath, Hazar-enan, at the border of Damascus, northward, beside Hamath; and they shall have their sides east and west: Dan, one portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל  גְּב֣וּל דָּ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה אָשֵׁ֥ר אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'l  gbvl dn mp't qdym 'dp'tymh 'shr 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Dan, from the east side unto the west side: Asher, one portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל  גְּב֣וּל אָשֵׁ֗ר מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה וְעַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה נַפְתָּלִ֥י אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'l  gbvl 'shr mp't qdymh v'dp'tymh nptly 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Asher, from the east side even unto the west side: Naphtali, one portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל  גְּב֣וּל נַפְתָּלִ֗י מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'l  gbvl nptly mp't qdmh 'dp'tymh mnshh 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Naphtali, from the east side unto the west side: Manasseh, one portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל  גְּב֣וּל מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה אֶפְרַ֥יִם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'l  gbvl mnshh mp't qdmh 'dp'tymh 'prym 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Manasseh, from the east side unto the west side: Ephraim, one portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל  גְּב֣וּל אֶפְרַ֗יִם מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים וְעַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה רְאוּבֵ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'l  gbvl 'prym mp't qdym v'dp'tymh r'vbn 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even unto the west side: Reuben, one portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל  גְּב֣וּל רְאוּבֵ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ים עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה יְהוּדָ֥ה אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'l  gbvl r'vbn mp't qdym 'dp'tymh yhvdh 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Reuben, from the east side unto the west side: Judah, one portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל֙ גְּב֣וּל יְהוּדָ֔ה מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֖ים עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֑מָּה תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה הַתְּרוּמָ֣ה אֲֽשֶׁר־תָּרִ֡ימוּ חֲמִשָּׁה֩ וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף רֹ֗חַב וְאֹ֜רֶךְ כְּאַחַ֤ד הַֽחֲלָקִים֙ מִפְּאַ֤ת קָדִ֙ימָה֙ עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֔מָּה וְהָיָ֥ה הַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ בְּתוֹכֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'l gbvl yhvdh mp't qdym 'dp'tymh thyh htrvmh 'shrtrymv chmshh v'shrym 'lf rchb v'rkh kh'chd hchlqym mp't qdymh 'dp'tymh vhyh hmqdsh btvkhv
verses.translation: And by the border of Judah, from the east side unto the west side, shall be the offering which ye shall set aside, five and twenty thousand reeds in breadth, and in length as one of the portions, from the east side unto the west side; and the sanctuary shall be in the midst of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַתְּרוּמָ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּרִ֖ימוּ לַיהֹוָ֑ה אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים׃
verses.translit: htrvmh 'shr trymv lyhvh 'rkh chmshh v'shrym 'lf vrchb 'shrt 'lpym
verses.translation: The offering that ye shall set apart unto the LORD shall be five and twenty thousand reeds in length, and ten thousand in breadth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּ֜֠לְאֵ֜֠לֶּה תִּהְיֶ֣ה תְרוּמַת־הַקֹּ֘דֶשׁ֮ לַכֹּהֲנִים֒ צָפ֜וֹנָה חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֣ים אֶ֗לֶף וְיָ֙מָּה֙ רֹ֚חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְקָדִ֗ימָה רֹ֚חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֔ים וְנֶ֕גְבָּה אֹ֕רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וְהָיָ֥ה מִקְדַּשׁ־יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּתוֹכֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vl'lh thyh trvmthqdsh lkhhnym tspvnh chmshh v'shrym 'lf vymh rchb 'shrt 'lpym vqdymh rchb 'shrt 'lpym vngbh 'rkh chmshh v'shrym 'lf vhyh mqdshyhvh btvkhv
verses.translation: And for these, even for the priests, shall be the holy offering; toward the north five and twenty thousand [in length], and toward the west ten thousand in breadth, and toward the east ten thousand in breadth, and toward the south five and twenty thousand in length; and the sanctuary of the LORD shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַֽמְקֻדָּשׁ֙ מִבְּנֵ֣י צָד֔וֹק אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁמְר֖וּ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֑י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־תָע֗וּ בִּתְעוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּע֖וּ הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: lkhhnym hmqdsh mbny tsdvq 'shr shmrv mshmrty 'shr l't'v bt'vt bny yshr'l kh'shr t'v hlvym
verses.translation: The sanctified portion shall be for the priests of the sons of Zadok, that have kept My charge, that went not astray when the children of Israel went astray, as the Levites went astray.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֨ה לָהֶ֧ם תְּרוּמִיָּ֛ה מִתְּרוּמַ֥ת הָאָ֖רֶץ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קׇדָשִׁ֑ים אֶל־גְּב֖וּל הַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyth lhm trvmyh mtrvmt h'rts qdsh qdshym 'lgbvl hlvym
verses.translation: And it shall be unto them a portion set apart from the offering of the land, a thing most holy, by the border of the Levites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֗ם לְעֻמַּת֙ גְּב֣וּל הַכֹּהֲנִ֔ים חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים כׇּל־אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhlvym l'mt gbvl hkhhnym chmshh v'shrym 'lf 'rkh vrchb 'shrt 'lpym khl'rkh chmshh v'shrym 'lf vrchb 'shrt 'lpym
verses.translation: And answerable unto the border of the priests, the Levites shall have five and twenty thousand in length, and ten thousand in breadth; all the length shall be five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־יִמְכְּר֣וּ מִמֶּ֗נּוּ וְלֹ֥א יָמֵ֛ר וְלֹ֥א (יעבור) [יַעֲבִ֖יר] רֵאשִׁ֣ית הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּי־קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vl'ymkhrv mmnv vl' ymr vl' (y'bvr) [y'byr] r'shyt h'rts khyqdsh lyhvh
verses.translation: And they shall not sell of it, nor exchange, nor alienate the first portion of the land; for it is holy unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַחֲמֵ֨שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֜ים הַנּוֹתָ֣ר בָּרֹ֗חַב עַל־פְּנֵי֙ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף חֹֽל־ה֣וּא לָעִ֔יר לְמוֹשָׁ֖ב וּלְמִגְרָ֑שׁ וְהָיְתָ֥ה הָעִ֖יר בְּתוֹכֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vchmsht 'lpym hnvtr brchb 'lpny chmshh v'shrym 'lf chlhv' l'yr lmvshb vlmgrsh vhyth h'yr btvkhh
verses.translation: And the five thousand that are left in the breadth, in front of the five and twenty thousand, shall be for common use, for the city, for dwelling and for open land; and the city shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֘לֶּה֮ מִדּוֹתֶ֒יהָ֒ פְּאַ֣ת צָפ֗וֹן חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּפְאַת־נֶ֕גֶב חֲמֵ֥שׁ (חמש) מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֑ים וּמִפְּאַ֣ת קָדִ֗ים חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּפְאַת־יָ֕מָּה חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'lh mdvtyh p't tspvn chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym vp'tngb chmsh (chmsh) m'vt v'rb't 'lpym vmp't qdym chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym vp'tymh chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym
verses.translation: And these shall be the measures thereof: the north side four thousand and five hundred, and the south side four thousand and five hundred, and on the east side four thousand and five hundred, and the west side four thousand and five hundred.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה מִגְרָשׁ֮ לָעִיר֒ צָפ֙וֹנָה֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתַ֔יִם וְנֶ֖גְבָּה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם וְקָדִ֙ימָה֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתַ֔יִם וְיָ֖מָּה חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vhyh mgrsh l'yr tspvnh chmshym vm'tym vngbh chmshym vm'tym vqdymh chmshym vm'tym vymh chmshym vm'tym
verses.translation: And the city shall have open land: toward the north two hundred and fifty, and toward the south two hundred and fifty, and toward the east two hundred and fifty, and toward the west two hundred and fifty.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתָ֨ר בָּאֹ֜רֶךְ לְעֻמַּ֣ת  תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֤ים קָדִ֙ימָה֙ וַעֲשֶׂ֤רֶת אֲלָפִים֙ יָ֔מָּה וְהָיָ֕ה לְעֻמַּ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְהָיְתָ֤ה תְבֽוּאָתֹה֙ לְלֶ֔חֶם לְעֹבְדֵ֖י הָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vhnvtr b'rkh l'mt  trvmt hqdsh 'shrt 'lpym qdymh v'shrt 'lpym ymh vhyh l'mt trvmt hqdsh vhyth tbv'th llchm l'bdy h'yr
verses.translation: And the residue in the length, answerable unto the holy offering, shall be ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward; and it shall be answerable unto the holy offering; and the increase thereof shall be for food unto them that serve the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָעֹבֵ֖ד הָעִ֑יר יַעַבְד֕וּהוּ מִכֹּ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vh'bd h'yr y'bdvhv mkhl shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: And they that serve the city, out of all the tribes of Israel, shall till it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־הַתְּרוּמָ֗ה חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף רְבִיעִ֗ית תָּרִ֙ימוּ֙ אֶת־תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֶל־אֲחֻזַּ֖ת הָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: khlhtrvmh chmshh v'shrym 'lf bchmshh v'shrym 'lf rby'yt trymv 'ttrvmt hqdsh 'l'chzt h'yr
verses.translation: All the offering shall be five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand; ye shall set apart the holy offering foursquare, with the possession of the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהַנּוֹתָ֣ר לַנָּשִׂ֣יא מִזֶּ֣ה ׀ וּמִזֶּ֣ה ׀ לִתְרֽוּמַת־הַקֹּ֣דֶשׁ וְלַאֲחֻזַּ֪ת הָעִ֟יר אֶל־פְּנֵ֣י חֲמִשָּׁה֩ וְעֶשְׂרִ֨ים אֶ֥לֶף ׀ תְּרוּמָה֮ עַד־גְּב֣וּל קָדִ֒ימָה֒ וְיָ֗מָּה עַל־פְּ֠נֵ֠י חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ עַל־גְּב֣וּל יָ֔מָּה לְעֻמַּ֥ת חֲלָקִ֖ים לַנָּשִׂ֑יא וְהָֽיְתָה֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וּמִקְדַּ֥שׁ הַבַּ֖יִת בְּתוֹכֹֽה׃
verses.translit: vhnvtr lnshy' mzh  vmzh  ltrvmthqdsh vl'chzt h'yr 'lpny chmshh v'shrym 'lf  trvmh 'dgbvl qdymh vymh 'lpny chmshh v'shrym 'lf 'lgbvl ymh l'mt chlqym lnshy' vhyth trvmt hqdsh vmqdsh hbyt btvkhh
verses.translation: And the residue shall be for the prince, on the one side and on the other of the holy offering and of the possession of the city, in front of the five and twenty thousand of the offering toward the east border, and westward in front of the five and twenty thousand toward the west border, answerable unto the portions, it shall be for the prince; and the holy offering and the sanctuary of the house shall be in the midst thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמֵאֲחֻזַּ֤ת הַלְוִיִּם֙ וּמֵאֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָעִ֔יר בְּת֛וֹךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַנָּשִׂ֖יא יִהְיֶ֑ה בֵּ֣ין  גְּב֣וּל יְהוּדָ֗ה וּבֵין֙ גְּב֣וּל בִּנְיָמִ֔ן לַנָּשִׂ֖יא יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vm'chzt hlvym vm'chzt h'yr btvkh 'shr lnshy' yhyh byn  gbvl yhvdh vbyn gbvl bnymn lnshy' yhyh
verses.translation: Thus the possession of the Levites, and the possession of the city, shall be in the midst of that which is the prince’s; between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin shall be the prince’s.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֶ֖תֶר הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה בִּנְיָמִ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vytr hshbtym mp't qdymh 'dp'tymh bnymn 'chd
verses.translation: And as for the rest of the tribes: from the east side unto the west side: Benjamin, one portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל  גְּב֣וּל בִּנְיָמִ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה שִׁמְע֥וֹן אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'l  gbvl bnymn mp't qdymh 'dp'tymh shm'vn 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Benjamin, from the east side unto the west side: Simeon, one portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל  גְּב֣וּל שִׁמְע֗וֹן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה יִשָּׂשכָ֥ר אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'l  gbvl shm'vn mp't qdymh 'dp'tymh yshshkhr 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Simeon, from the east side unto the west side: Issachar, one portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל  גְּב֣וּל יִשָּׂשכָ֗ר מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛ימָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה זְבוּלֻ֥ן אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'l  gbvl yshshkhr mp't qdymh 'dp'tymh zbvln 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Issachar, from the east side unto the west side: Zebulun, one portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַ֣ל  גְּב֣וּל זְבוּלֻ֗ן מִפְּאַ֥ת קָדִ֛מָה עַד־פְּאַת־יָ֖מָּה גָּ֥ד אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'l  gbvl zbvln mp't qdmh 'dp'tymh gd 'chd
verses.translation: And by the border of Zebulun, from the east side unto the west side: Gad, one portion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל֙ גְּב֣וּל גָּ֔ד אֶל־פְּאַ֖ת נֶ֣גֶב תֵּימָ֑נָה וְהָיָ֨ה גְב֜וּל מִתָּמָ֗ר מֵ֚י מְרִיבַ֣ת קָדֵ֔שׁ נַחֲלָ֖ה עַל־הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: v'l gbvl gd 'lp't ngb tymnh vhyh gbvl mtmr my mrybt qdsh nchlh 'lhym hgdvl
verses.translation: And by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border shall be even from Tamar unto the waters of Meribath-kadesh, to the Brook, unto the Great Sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֥את הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־תַּפִּ֥ילוּ מִֽנַּחֲלָ֖ה לְשִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ מַחְלְקוֹתָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: z't h'rts 'shrtpylv mnchlh lshbty yshr'l v'lh mchlqvtm n'm 'dny yhvh {s}
verses.translation: This is the land which ye shall divide by lot unto the tribes of Israel for inheritance, and these are their portions, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֖לֶּה תּוֹצְאֹ֣ת הָעִ֑יר מִפְּאַ֣ת צָפ֔וֹן חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֥עַת אֲלָפִ֖ים מִדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lh tvts't h'yr mp't tspvn chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym mdh
verses.translation: And these are the goings out of the city: on the north side four thousand and five hundred reeds by measure;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁעֲרֵ֣י הָעִ֗יר עַל־שְׁמוֹת֙ שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁעָרִ֥ים שְׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה צָפ֑וֹנָה שַׁ֣עַר רְאוּבֵ֞ן אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר יְהוּדָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר לֵוִ֖י אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vsh'ry h'yr 'lshmvt shbty yshr'l sh'rym shlvshh tspvnh sh'r r'vbn 'chd sh'r yhvdh 'chd sh'r lvy 'chd
verses.translation: and the gates of the city shall be after the names of the tribes of Israel; three gates northward: the gate of Reuben, one; the gate of Judah, one; the gate of Levi, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־פְּאַ֣ת קָדִ֗ימָה חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּשְׁעָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה וְשַׁ֨עַר יוֹסֵ֜ף אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר בִּנְיָמִן֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר דָּ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: v'lp't qdymh chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym vsh'rym shlshh vsh'r yvsf 'chd sh'r bnymn 'chd sh'r dn 'chd
verses.translation: and at the east side four thousand and five hundred reeds; and three gates: even the gate of Joseph, one; the gate of Benjamin, one; the gate of Dan, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְאַת־נֶ֗גְבָּה חֲמֵ֨שׁ מֵא֜וֹת וְאַרְבַּ֤עַת אֲלָפִים֙ מִדָּ֔ה וּשְׁעָרִ֖ים שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה שַׁ֣עַר שִׁמְע֞וֹן אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר יִשָּׂשכָר֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר זְבוּלֻ֖ן אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vp'tngbh chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym mdh vsh'rym shlshh sh'r shm'vn 'chd sh'r yshshkhr 'chd sh'r zbvln 'chd
verses.translation: and at the south side four thousand and five hundred reeds by measure; and three gates: the gate of Simeon, one; the gate of Issachar, one; the gate of Zebulun, one;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּאַת־יָ֗מָּה חֲמֵ֤שׁ מֵאוֹת֙ וְאַרְבַּ֣עַת אֲלָפִ֔ים שַׁעֲרֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֑ה שַׁ֣עַר גָּ֞ד אֶחָ֗ד שַׁ֤עַר אָשֵׁר֙ אֶחָ֔ד שַׁ֥עַר נַפְתָּלִ֖י אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: p'tymh chmsh m'vt v'rb't 'lpym sh'ryhm shlshh sh'r gd 'chd sh'r 'shr 'chd sh'r nptly 'chd
verses.translation: at the west side four thousand and five hundred reeds, with their three gates: the gate of Gad, one; the gate of Asher, one; the gate of Naphtali, one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סָבִ֕יב שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף וְשֵׁם־הָעִ֥יר מִיּ֖וֹם יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.translit: sbyb shmnh 'shr 'lf vshmh'yr myvm yhvh  shmh
verses.translation: It shall be eighteen thousand reeds round about. And the name of the city from that day shall be, The LORD is there.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֣ה  אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־הוֹשֵׁ֙עַ֙ בֶּן־בְּאֵרִ֔י בִּימֵ֨י עֻזִּיָּ֥ה יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֛י יָרׇבְעָ֥ם בֶּן־יוֹאָ֖שׁ מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: dbryhvh  'shr hyh 'lhvsh' bnb'ry bymy 'zyh yvtm 'chz ychzqyh mlkhy yhvdh vbymy yrb'm bnyv'sh mlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: The word of the LORD that came unto Hosea the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּחִלַּ֥ת דִּבֶּר־יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּהוֹשֵׁ֑עַ {פ} וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־הוֹשֵׁ֗עַ לֵ֣ךְ קַח־לְךָ֞ אֵ֤שֶׁת זְנוּנִים֙ וְיַלְדֵ֣י זְנוּנִ֔ים כִּֽי־זָנֹ֤ה תִזְנֶה֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ מֵאַחֲרֵ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: tchlt dbryhvh bhvsh' {p} vy'mr yhvh 'lhvsh' lkh qchlkh 'sht znvnym vyldy znvnym khyznh tznh h'rts m'chry yhvh
verses.translation: When the LORD spoke at first with Hosea, the LORD said unto Hosea: ‘Go, take unto thee a wife of harlotry and children of harlotry; for the land doth commit great harlotry, departing from the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ וַיִּקַּ֔ח אֶת־גֹּ֖מֶר בַּת־דִּבְלָ֑יִם וַתַּ֥הַר וַתֵּלֶד־ל֖וֹ בֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vylkh vyqch 'tgmr btdblym vthr vtldlv bn
verses.translation: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהֹוָה֙ אֵלָ֔יו קְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ יִזְרְעֶ֑אל כִּי־ע֣וֹד מְעַ֗ט וּפָ֨קַדְתִּ֜י אֶת־דְּמֵ֤י יִזְרְעֶאל֙ עַל־בֵּ֣ית יֵה֔וּא וְהִ֨שְׁבַּתִּ֔י מַמְלְכ֖וּת בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lyv qr' shmv yzr''l khy'vd m't vpqdty 'tdmy yzr''l 'lbyt yhv' vhshbty mmlkhvt byt yshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto him: ‘Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will visit the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וְשָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־קֶ֣שֶׁת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּעֵ֖מֶק יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' vshbrty 'tqsht yshr'l b'mq yzr''l
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּ֤הַר עוֹד֙ וַתֵּ֣לֶד בַּ֔ת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ קְרָ֥א שְׁמָ֖הּ לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה כִּי֩ לֹ֨א אוֹסִ֜יף ע֗וֹד אֲרַחֵם֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי־נָשֹׂ֥א אֶשָּׂ֖א לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vthr 'vd vtld bt vy'mr lv qr' shmh l' rchmh khy l' 'vsyf 'vd 'rchm 'tbyt yshr'l khynsh' 'sh' lhm
verses.translation: And she conceived again, and bore a daughter. And He said unto him: ‘Call her name Lo-ruhamah; for I will no more have compassion upon the house of Israel, that I should in any wise pardon them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ אֲרַחֵ֔ם וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֖ים בַּיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וְלֹ֣א אוֹשִׁיעֵ֗ם בְּקֶ֤שֶׁת וּבְחֶ֙רֶב֙ וּבְמִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּסוּסִ֖ים וּבְפָרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: v'tbyt yhvdh 'rchm vhvsh'tym byhvh 'lhyhm vl' 'vshy'm bqsht vbchrb vbmlchmh bsvsym vbprshym
verses.translation: But I will have compassion upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, nor by horses, nor by horsemen.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּגְמֹ֖ל אֶת־לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה וַתַּ֖הַר וַתֵּ֥לֶד בֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: vtgml 'tl' rchmh vthr vtld bn
verses.translation: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר קְרָ֥א שְׁמ֖וֹ לֹ֣א עַמִּ֑י כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ לֹ֣א עַמִּ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹא־אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr qr' shmv l' 'my khy 'tm l' 'my v'nkhy l''hyh lkhm {p}
verses.translation: And He said: ‘Call his name Lo-ammi; for ye are not My people, and I will not be yours.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽ֠הָיָ֠ה מִסְפַּ֤ר בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ כְּח֣וֹל הַיָּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־יִמַּ֖ד וְלֹ֣א יִסָּפֵ֑ר וְֽ֠הָיָ֠ה בִּמְק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יֵאָמֵ֤ר לָהֶם֙ לֹא־עַמִּ֣י אַתֶּ֔ם יֵאָמֵ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י אֵֽל־חָֽי׃
verses.translit: vhyh mspr bnyyshr'l khchvl hym 'shr l'ymd vl' yspr vhyh bmqvm 'shry'mr lhm l''my 'tm y'mr lhm bny 'lchy
verses.translation: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass that, instead of that which was said unto them: ‘Ye are not My people’, it shall be said unto them: ‘Ye are the children of the living God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠נִקְבְּצ֠וּ בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֤ה וּבְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו וְשָׂמ֥וּ לָהֶ֛ם רֹ֥אשׁ אֶחָ֖ד וְעָל֣וּ מִן־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י גָד֖וֹל י֥וֹם יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
verses.translit: vnqbtsv bnyyhvdh vbnyyshr'l ychdv vshmv lhm r'sh 'chd v'lv mnh'rts khy gdvl yvm yzr''l
verses.translation: And the children of Judah and the children of Israel shall be gathered together, and they shall appoint themselves one head, and shall go up out of the land; for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִמְר֥וּ לַאֲחֵיכֶ֖ם עַמִּ֑י וְלַאֲחוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם רֻחָֽמָה׃
verses.translit: 'mrv l'chykhm 'my vl'chvtykhm rchmh
verses.translation: Say ye unto your brethren: ‘Ammi’; and to your sisters, ‘Ruhamah.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רִ֤יבוּ בְאִמְּכֶם֙ רִ֔יבוּ כִּי־הִיא֙ לֹ֣א אִשְׁתִּ֔י וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֣א אִישָׁ֑הּ וְתָסֵ֤ר זְנוּנֶ֙יהָ֙ מִפָּנֶ֔יהָ וְנַאֲפוּפֶ֖יהָ מִבֵּ֥ין שָׁדֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: rybv b'mkhm rybv khyhy' l' 'shty v'nkhy l' 'yshh vtsr znvnyh mpnyh vn'pvpyh mbyn shdyh
verses.translation: Plead with your mother, plead; For she is not My wife, neither am I her husband; And let her put away her harlotries from her face, And her adulteries from between her breasts;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּן־אַפְשִׁיטֶ֣נָּה עֲרֻמָּ֔ה וְהִ֨צַּגְתִּ֔יהָ כְּי֖וֹם הִוָּֽלְדָ֑הּ וְשַׂמְתִּ֣יהָ כַמִּדְבָּ֗ר וְשַׁתִּ֙הָ֙ כְּאֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֔ה וַהֲמִתִּ֖יהָ בַּצָּמָֽא׃
verses.translit: pn'pshytnh 'rmh vhtsgtyh khyvm hvldh vshmtyh khmdbr vshth kh'rts tsyh vhmtyh btsm'
verses.translation: Lest I strip her naked, And set her as in the day that she was born, And make her as a wilderness, And set her like a dry land, And slay her with thirst.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־בָּנֶ֖יהָ לֹ֣א אֲרַחֵ֑ם כִּֽי־בְנֵ֥י זְנוּנִ֖ים הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: v'tbnyh l' 'rchm khybny znvnym hmh
verses.translation: And I will not have compassion upon her children; For they are children of harlotry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י זָֽנְתָה֙ אִמָּ֔ם הֹבִ֖ישָׁה הוֹרָתָ֑ם כִּ֣י אָמְרָ֗ה אֵלְכָ֞ה אַחֲרֵ֤י מְאַֽהֲבַי֙ נֹתְנֵ֤י לַחְמִי֙ וּמֵימַ֔י צַמְרִ֣י וּפִשְׁתִּ֔י שַׁמְנִ֖י וְשִׁקּוּיָֽי׃
verses.translit: khy znth 'mm hbyshh hvrtm khy 'mrh 'lkhh 'chry m'hby ntny lchmy vmymy tsmry vpshty shmny vshqvyy
verses.translation: For their mother hath played the harlot, She that conceived them hath done shamefully; For she said: ‘I will go after my lovers, That give me my bread and my water, My wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן הִנְנִי־שָׂ֥ךְ אֶת־דַּרְכֵּ֖ךְ בַּסִּירִ֑ים וְגָֽדַרְתִּי֙ אֶת־גְּדֵרָ֔הּ וּנְתִיבוֹתֶ֖יהָ לֹ֥א תִמְצָֽא׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnnyshkh 'tdrkhkh bsyrym vgdrty 'tgdrh vntybvtyh l' tmts'
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, And I will make a wall against her, That she shall not find her paths.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרִדְּפָ֤ה אֶת־מְאַהֲבֶ֙יהָ֙ וְלֹא־תַשִּׂ֣יג אֹתָ֔ם וּבִקְשָׁ֖תַם וְלֹ֣א תִמְצָ֑א וְאָמְרָ֗ה אֵלְכָ֤ה וְאָשׁ֙וּבָה֙ אֶל־אִישִׁ֣י הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן כִּ֣י ט֥וֹב לִ֛י אָ֖ז מֵעָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: vrdph 'tm'hbyh vl'tshyg 'tm vbqshtm vl' tmts' v'mrh 'lkhh v'shvbh 'l'yshy hr'shvn khy tvb ly 'z m'th
verses.translation: And she shall run after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them, And she shall seek them, but shall not find them; Then shall she say: ‘I will go and return to my first husband; For then was it better with me than now.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִיא֙ לֹ֣א יָֽדְעָ֔ה כִּ֤י אָֽנֹכִי֙ נָתַ֣תִּי לָ֔הּ הַדָּגָ֖ן וְהַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֑ר וְכֶ֨סֶף הִרְבֵּ֥יתִי לָ֛הּ וְזָהָ֖ב עָשׂ֥וּ לַבָּֽעַל׃
verses.translit: vhy' l' yd'h khy 'nkhy ntty lh hdgn vhtyrvsh vhytshr vkhsf hrbyty lh vzhb 'shv lb'l
verses.translation: For she did not know that it was I that gave her The corn, and the wine, and the oil, And multiplied unto her silver and gold, Which they used for Baal.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן אָשׁ֔וּב וְלָקַחְתִּ֤י דְגָנִי֙ בְּעִתּ֔וֹ וְתִירוֹשִׁ֖י בְּמוֹעֲד֑וֹ וְהִצַּלְתִּי֙ צַמְרִ֣י וּפִשְׁתִּ֔י לְכַסּ֖וֹת אֶת־עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn 'shvb vlqchty dgny b'tv vtyrvshy bmv'dv vhtslty tsmry vpshty lkhsvt 't'rvth
verses.translation: Therefore will I take back My corn in the time thereof, And My wine in the season thereof, And will snatch away My wool and My flax Given to cover her nakedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֛ה אֲגַלֶּ֥ה אֶת־נַבְלֻתָ֖הּ לְעֵינֵ֣י מְאַהֲבֶ֑יהָ וְאִ֖ישׁ לֹא־יַצִּילֶ֥נָּה מִיָּדִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'th 'glh 'tnblth l'yny m'hbyh v'ysh l'ytsylnh mydy
verses.translation: And now will I uncover her shame in the sight of her lovers, And none shall deliver her out of My hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ כׇּל־מְשׂוֹשָׂ֔הּ חַגָּ֖הּ חׇדְשָׁ֣הּ וְשַׁבַּתָּ֑הּ וְכֹ֖ל מוֹעֲדָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vhshbty khlmshvshh chgh chdshh vshbth vkhl mv'dh
verses.translation: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, Her feasts, her new moons, and her sabbaths, And all her appointed seasons.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲשִׁמֹּתִ֗י גַּפְנָהּ֙ וּתְאֵ֣נָתָ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמְרָ֗ה אֶתְנָ֥ה הֵ֙מָּה֙ לִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתְנוּ־לִ֖י מְאַהֲבָ֑י וְשַׂמְתִּ֣ים לְיַ֔עַר וַאֲכָלָ֖תַם חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vhshmty gpnh vt'nth 'shr 'mrh 'tnh hmh ly 'shr ntnvly m'hby vshmtym ly'r v'khltm chyt hshdh
verses.translation: And I will lay waste her vines and her fig-trees, Whereof she hath said: ‘These are my hire That my lovers have given me’; And I will make them a forest, And the beasts of the field shall eat them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י עָלֶ֗יהָ אֶת־יְמֵ֤י הַבְּעָלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּקְטִ֣יר לָהֶ֔ם וַתַּ֤עַד נִזְמָהּ֙ וְחֶלְיָתָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֖לֶךְ אַחֲרֵ֣י מְאַהֲבֶ֑יהָ וְאֹתִ֥י שָׁכְחָ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vpqdty 'lyh 'tymy hb'lym 'shr tqtyr lhm vt'd nzmh vchlyth vtlkh 'chry m'hbyh v'ty shkhchh n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: And I will visit upon her the days of the Baalim, Wherein she offered unto them, And decked herself with her ear-rings and her jewels, And went after her lovers, And forgot Me, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן הִנֵּ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ מְפַתֶּ֔יהָ וְהֹלַכְתִּ֖יהָ הַמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְדִבַּרְתִּ֖י עַל־לִבָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: lkhn hnh 'nkhy mptyh vhlkhtyh hmdbr vdbrty 'llbh
verses.translation: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, And bring her into the wilderness, And speak tenderly unto her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַ֨תִּי לָ֤הּ אֶת־כְּרָמֶ֙יהָ֙ מִשָּׁ֔ם וְאֶת־עֵ֥מֶק עָכ֖וֹר לְפֶ֣תַח תִּקְוָ֑ה וְעָ֤נְתָה שָּׁ֙מָּה֙ כִּימֵ֣י נְעוּרֶ֔יהָ וּכְי֖וֹם עֲלוֹתָ֥הּ מֵאֶרֶץ־מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: vntty lh 'tkhrmyh mshm v't'mq 'khvr lptch tqvh v'nth shmh khymy n'vryh vkhyvm 'lvth m'rtsmtsrym
verses.translation: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, And the valley of Achor for a door of hope; And she shall respond there, as in the days of her youth, And as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה תִּקְרְאִ֖י אִישִׁ֑י וְלֹא־תִקְרְאִי־לִ֥י ע֖וֹד בַּעְלִֽי׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvmhhv' n'myhvh tqr'y 'yshy vl'tqr'yly 'vd b'ly
verses.translation: And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD, That thou shalt call Me Ishi, And shalt call Me no more Baali.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲסִרֹתִ֛י אֶת־שְׁמ֥וֹת הַבְּעָלִ֖ים מִפִּ֑יהָ וְלֹא־יִזָּכְר֥וּ ע֖וֹד בִּשְׁמָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhsrty 'tshmvt hb'lym mpyh vl'yzkhrv 'vd bshmm
verses.translation: For I will take away the names of the Baalim out of her mouth, And they shall no more be mentioned by their name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכָרַתִּ֨י לָהֶ֤ם בְּרִית֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא עִם־חַיַּ֤ת הַשָּׂדֶה֙ וְעִם־ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְרֶ֖מֶשׂ הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וְקֶ֨שֶׁת וְחֶ֤רֶב וּמִלְחָמָה֙ אֶשְׁבּ֣וֹר מִן־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְהִשְׁכַּבְתִּ֖ים לָבֶֽטַח׃
verses.translit: vkhrty lhm bryt byvm hhv' 'mchyt hshdh v'm'vf hshmym vrmsh h'dmh vqsht vchrb vmlchmh 'shbvr mnh'rts vhshkhbtym lbtch
verses.translation: And in that day will I make a covenant for them With the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, And with the creeping things of the ground; And I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the land, And will make them to lie down safely.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִ֖י לְעוֹלָ֑ם וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִי֙ בְּצֶ֣דֶק וּבְמִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּבְחֶ֖סֶד וּֽבְרַחֲמִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'rshtykh ly l'vlm v'rshtykh ly btsdq vbmshpt vbchsd vbrchmym
verses.translation: And I will betroth thee unto Me for ever; Yea, I will betroth thee unto Me in righteousness, and in justice, And in lovingkindness, and in compassion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵרַשְׂתִּ֥יךְ לִ֖י בֶּאֱמוּנָ֑ה וְיָדַ֖עַתְּ אֶת־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'rshtykh ly b'mvnh vyd't 'tyhvh {p}
verses.translation: And I will betroth thee unto Me in faithfulness; And thou shalt know the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא אֶֽעֱנֶה֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶעֱנֶ֖ה אֶת־הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְהֵ֖ם יַעֲנ֥וּ אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhyh  byvm hhv' ''nh n'myhvh ''nh 'thshmym vhm y'nv 'th'rts
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will respond, saith the LORD, I will respond to the heavens, And they shall respond to the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאָ֣רֶץ תַּעֲנֶ֔ה אֶת־הַדָּגָ֖ן וְאֶת־הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְאֶת־הַיִּצְהָ֑ר וְהֵ֖ם יַעֲנ֥וּ אֶֽת־יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
verses.translit: vh'rts t'nh 'thdgn v'thtyrvsh v'thytshr vhm y'nv 'tyzr''l
verses.translation: And the earth shall respond to the corn, and the wine, and the oil; And they shall respond to Jezreel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּזְרַעְתִּ֤יהָ לִּי֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְרִחַמְתִּ֖י אֶת־לֹ֣א רֻחָ֑מָה וְאָמַרְתִּ֤י לְלֹֽא־עַמִּי֙ עַמִּי־אַ֔תָּה וְה֖וּא יֹאמַ֥ר אֱלֹהָֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vzr'tyh ly b'rts vrchmty 'tl' rchmh v'mrty ll''my 'my'th vhv' y'mr 'lhy {p}
verses.translation: And I will sow her unto Me in the land; And I will have compassion upon her that had not obtained compassion; And I will say to them that were not My people: ‘Thou art My people’; And they shall say: ‘Thou art my God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י ע֚וֹד לֵ֣ךְ אֱֽהַב־אִשָּׁ֔ה אֲהֻ֥בַת רֵ֖עַ וּמְנָאָ֑פֶת כְּאַהֲבַ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהֵ֗ם פֹּנִים֙ אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְאֹהֲבֵ֖י אֲשִׁישֵׁ֥י עֲנָבִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'vd lkh 'hb'shh 'hbt r' vmn'pt kh'hbt yhvh 'tbny yshr'l vhm pnym 'l'lhym 'chrym v'hby 'shyshy 'nbym
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me: ‘Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend and an adulteress, even as the LORD loveth the children of Israel, though they turn unto other gods, and love cakes of raisins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶכְּרֶ֣הָ לִּ֔י בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר כָּ֑סֶף וְחֹ֥מֶר שְׂעֹרִ֖ים וְלֵ֥תֶךְ שְׂעֹרִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'khrh ly bchmshh 'shr khsf vchmr sh'rym vltkh sh'rym
verses.translation: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer of barley, and a half-homer of barley;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֵלֶ֗יהָ יָמִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ תֵּ֣שְׁבִי לִ֔י לֹ֣א תִזְנִ֔י וְלֹ֥א תִֽהְיִ֖י לְאִ֑ישׁ וְגַם־אֲנִ֖י אֵלָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'lyh ymym rbym tshby ly l' tzny vl' thyy l'ysh vgm'ny 'lykh
verses.translation: and I said unto her: ‘Thou shalt sit solitary for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be any man’s wife; nor will I be thine.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י  יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים יֵֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֥ין מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ וְאֵ֣ין שָׂ֔ר וְאֵ֥ין זֶ֖בַח וְאֵ֣ין מַצֵּבָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין אֵפ֖וֹד וּתְרָפִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy  ymym rbym yshbv bny yshr'l 'yn mlkh v'yn shr v'yn zbch v'yn mtsbh v'yn 'pvd vtrpym
verses.translation: For the children of Israel shall sit solitary many days without king, and without prince, and without sacrifice, and without pillar, and without ephod or teraphim;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחַ֗ר יָשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּבִקְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת דָּוִ֣יד מַלְכָּ֑ם וּפָחֲד֧וּ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֛ה וְאֶל־טוּב֖וֹ בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'chr yshbv bny yshr'l vbqshv 'tyhvh 'lhyhm v't dvyd mlkhm vpchdv 'lyhvh v'ltvbv b'chryt hymym {p}
verses.translation: afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and shall come trembling unto the LORD and to His goodness in the end of days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֣י רִ֤יב לַֽיהֹוָה֙ עִם־יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֠י אֵין־אֱמֶ֧ת וְֽאֵין־חֶ֛סֶד וְאֵֽין־דַּ֥עַת אֱלֹהִ֖ים בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: shm'v dbryhvh bny yshr'l khy ryb lyhvh 'myvshby h'rts khy 'yn'mt v'ynchsd v'ynd't 'lhym b'rts
verses.translation: Hear the word of the LORD, ye children of Israel! For the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, Because there is no truth, nor mercy, Nor knowledge of God in the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָלֹ֣ה וְכַחֵ֔שׁ וְרָצֹ֥חַ וְגָנֹ֖ב וְנָאֹ֑ף פָּרָ֕צוּ וְדָמִ֥ים בְּדָמִ֖ים נָגָֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lh vkhchsh vrtsch vgnb vn'f prtsv vdmym bdmym ng'v
verses.translation: Swearing and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery! They break all bounds, and blood toucheth blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֣ן  תֶּאֱבַ֣ל הָאָ֗רֶץ וְאֻמְלַל֙ כׇּל־יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ֔הּ בְּחַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וּבְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְגַם־דְּגֵ֥י הַיָּ֖ם יֵאָסֵֽפוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn  t'bl h'rts v'mll khlyvshb bh bchyt hshdh vb'vf hshmym vgmdgy hym y'spv
verses.translation: Therefore doth the land mourn, And every one that dwelleth therein doth languish, With the beasts of the field, and the fowls of heaven; Yea, the fishes of the sea also are taken away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֥ךְ אִ֛ישׁ אַל־יָרֵ֖ב וְאַל־יוֹכַ֣ח אִ֑ישׁ וְעַמְּךָ֖ כִּמְרִיבֵ֥י כֹהֵֽן׃
verses.translit: 'kh 'ysh 'lyrb v'lyvkhch 'ysh v'mkh khmryby khhn
verses.translation: Yet let no man strive, neither let any man reprove; For thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכָשַׁלְתָּ֣ הַיּ֔וֹם וְכָשַׁ֧ל גַּם־נָבִ֛יא עִמְּךָ֖ לָ֑יְלָה וְדָמִ֖יתִי אִמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vkhshlt hyvm vkhshl gmnby' 'mkh lylh vdmyty 'mkh
verses.translation: Therefore shalt thou stumble in the day, And the prophet also shall stumble with thee in the night; And I will destroy thy mother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִדְמ֥וּ עַמִּ֖י מִבְּלִ֣י הַדָּ֑עַת כִּי־אַתָּ֞ה הַדַּ֣עַת מָאַ֗סְתָּ (ואמאסאך) [וְאֶמְאָֽסְךָ֙] מִכַּהֵ֣ן לִ֔י וַתִּשְׁכַּח֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אֶשְׁכַּ֥ח בָּנֶ֖יךָ גַּם־אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: ndmv 'my mbly hd't khy'th hd't m'st (v'm's'kh) [v'm'skh] mkhhn ly vtshkhch tvrt 'lhykh 'shkhch bnykh gm'ny
verses.translation: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge; Because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to Me; Seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I also will forget thy children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּרֻבָּ֖ם כֵּ֣ן חָטְאוּ־לִ֑י כְּבוֹדָ֖ם בְּקָל֥וֹן אָמִֽיר׃
verses.translit: khrbm khn cht'vly khbvdm bqlvn 'myr
verses.translation: The more they were increased, the more they sinned against Me; I will change their glory into shame.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַטַּ֥את עַמִּ֖י יֹאכֵ֑לוּ וְאֶל־עֲוֺנָ֖ם יִשְׂא֥וּ נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: cht't 'my y'khlv v'l'vnm ysh'v npshv
verses.translation: They feed on the sin of My people, And set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה כָעָ֖ם כַּכֹּהֵ֑ן וּפָקַדְתִּ֤י עָלָיו֙ דְּרָכָ֔יו וּמַעֲלָלָ֖יו אָשִׁ֥יב לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhyh kh'm khkhhn vpqdty 'lyv drkhyv vm'llyv 'shyb lv
verses.translation: And it is like people, like priest; And I will punish him for his ways, And will recompense him his doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָֽכְלוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׂבָּ֔עוּ הִזְנ֖וּ וְלֹ֣א יִפְרֹ֑צוּ כִּֽי־אֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה עָזְב֖וּ לִשְׁמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: v'khlv vl' yshb'v hznv vl' yprtsv khy'tyhvh 'zbv lshmr
verses.translation: And they shall eat, and not have enough, They shall commit harlotry, and shall not increase; Because they have left off to take heed to the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְנ֛וּת וְיַ֥יִן וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ יִֽקַּֽח־לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: znvt vyyn vtyrvsh yqchlb
verses.translation: Harlotry, wine, and new wine take away the heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַמִּי֙ בְּעֵצ֣וֹ יִשְׁאָ֔ל וּמַקְל֖וֹ יַגִּ֣יד ל֑וֹ כִּ֣י ר֤וּחַ זְנוּנִים֙ הִתְעָ֔ה וַיִּזְנ֖וּ מִתַּ֥חַת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'my b'tsv ysh'l vmqlv ygyd lv khy rvch znvnym ht'h vyznv mtcht 'lhyhm
verses.translation: My people ask counsel at their stock, And their staff declareth unto them; For the spirit of harlotry hath caused them to err, And they have gone astray from under their God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־רָאשֵׁ֨י הֶהָרִ֜ים יְזַבֵּ֗חוּ וְעַל־הַגְּבָעוֹת֙ יְקַטֵּ֔רוּ תַּ֣חַת אַלּ֧וֹן וְלִבְנֶ֛ה וְאֵלָ֖ה כִּ֣י ט֣וֹב צִלָּ֑הּ עַל־כֵּ֗ן תִּזְנֶ֙ינָה֙ בְּנ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם וְכַלּוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם תְּנָאַֽפְנָה׃
verses.translit: 'lr'shy hhrym yzbchv v'lhgb'vt yqtrv tcht 'lvn vlbnh v'lh khy tvb tslh 'lkhn tznynh bnvtykhm vkhlvtykhm tn'pnh
verses.translation: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, And offer upon the hills, Under oaks and poplars and terebinths, Because the shadow thereof is good; Therefore your daughters commit harlotry, And your daughters-in-law commit adultery. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־אֶפְק֨וֹד עַל־בְּנוֹתֵיכֶ֜ם כִּ֣י תִזְנֶ֗ינָה וְעַל־כַּלּֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ כִּ֣י תְנָאַ֔פְנָה כִּי־הֵם֙ עִם־הַזֹּנ֣וֹת יְפָרֵ֔דוּ וְעִם־הַקְּדֵשׁ֖וֹת יְזַבֵּ֑חוּ וְעָ֥ם לֹֽא־יָבִ֖ין יִלָּבֵֽט׃
verses.translit: l''pqvd 'lbnvtykhm khy tznynh v'lkhlvtykhm khy tn'pnh khyhm 'mhznvt yprdv v'mhqdshvt yzbchv v'm l'ybyn ylbt
verses.translation: I will not punish your daughters when they commit harlotry, Nor your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery; For they themselves consort with lewd women, And they sacrifice with harlots; And the people that is without understanding is distraught.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־זֹנֶ֤ה אַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַל־יֶאְשַׁ֖ם יְהוּדָ֑ה וְאַל־תָּבֹ֣אוּ הַגִּלְגָּ֗ל וְאַֽל־תַּעֲלוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אָ֔וֶן וְאַל־תִּשָּׁבְע֖וּ חַי־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mznh 'th yshr'l 'ly'shm yhvdh v'ltb'v hglgl v'lt'lv byt 'vn v'ltshb'v chyyhvh
verses.translation: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, Yet let not Judah become guilty; And come not ye unto Gilgal, Neither go ye up to Beth-aven, Nor swear: ‘As the LORD liveth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י כְּפָרָ֣ה סֹרֵרָ֔ה סָרַ֖ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַתָּה֙ יִרְעֵ֣ם יְהֹוָ֔ה כְּכֶ֖בֶשׂ בַּמֶּרְחָֽב׃
verses.translit: khy khprh srrh srr yshr'l 'th yr'm yhvh khkhbsh bmrchb
verses.translation: For Israel is stubborn like a stubborn heifer; Now shall the LORD feed them as a lamb in a large place?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲב֧וּר עֲצַבִּ֛ים אֶפְרָ֖יִם הַֽנַּֽח־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: chbvr 'tsbym 'prym hnchlv
verses.translation: Ephraim is joined to idols; Let him alone.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סָ֖ר סׇבְאָ֑ם הַזְנֵ֣ה הִזְנ֔וּ אָהֲב֥וּ הֵב֛וּ קָל֖וֹן מָגִנֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: sr sb'm hznh hznv 'hbv hbv qlvn mgnyh
verses.translation: When their carouse is over, They take to harlotry; Her rulers deeply love dishonour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צָרַ֥ר ר֛וּחַ אוֹתָ֖הּ בִּכְנָפֶ֑יהָ וְיֵבֹ֖שׁוּ מִזִּבְחוֹתָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: tsrr rvch 'vth bkhnpyh vybshv mzbchvtm {p}
verses.translation: The wind hath bound her up in her skirts; And they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־זֹ֨את הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים וְהַקְשִׁ֣יבוּ  בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּבֵ֤ית הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ הַאֲזִ֔ינוּ כִּ֥י לָכֶ֖ם הַמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּי־פַח֙ הֱיִיתֶ֣ם לְמִצְפָּ֔ה וְרֶ֖שֶׁת פְּרוּשָׂ֥ה עַל־תָּבֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: shm'vz't hkhhnym vhqshybv  byt yshr'l vbyt hmlkh h'zynv khy lkhm hmshpt khypch hyytm lmtsph vrsht prvshh 'ltbvr
verses.translation: Hear this, O ye priests, And attend, ye house of Israel, And give ear, O house of the king, For unto you pertaineth the judgment; For ye have been a snare on Mizpah, And a net spread upon Tabor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁחֲטָ֥ה שֵׂטִ֖ים הֶעְמִ֑יקוּ וַאֲנִ֖י מוּסָ֥ר לְכֻלָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vshchth shtym h'myqv v'ny mvsr lkhlm
verses.translation: And they that fall away are gone deep in making slaughter; And I am rejected of them all.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ יָדַ֣עְתִּי אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֹא־נִכְחַ֣ד מִמֶּ֑נִּי כִּ֤י עַתָּה֙ הִזְנֵ֣יתָ אֶפְרַ֔יִם נִטְמָ֖א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'ny yd'ty 'prym vyshr'l l'nkhchd mmny khy 'th hznyt 'prym ntm' yshr'l
verses.translation: I, even I, know Ephraim, And Israel is not hid from Me; For now, O Ephraim, thou hast committed harlotry, Israel is defiled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א יִתְּנוּ֙ מַ֣עַלְלֵיהֶ֔ם לָשׁ֖וּב אֶל־אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם כִּ֣י ר֤וּחַ זְנוּנִים֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔ם וְאֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה לֹ֥א יָדָֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: l' ytnv m'llyhm lshvb 'l'lhyhm khy rvch znvnym bqrbm v'tyhvh l' yd'v
verses.translation: Their doings will not suffer them To return unto their God; For the spirit of harlotry is within them, And they know not the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָנָ֥ה גְאֽוֹן־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּפָנָ֑יו וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל וְאֶפְרַ֗יִם יִכָּֽשְׁלוּ֙ בַּעֲוֺנָ֔ם כָּשַׁ֥ל גַּם־יְהוּדָ֖ה עִמָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'nh g'vnyshr'l bpnyv vyshr'l v'prym ykhshlv b'vnm khshl gmyhvdh 'mm
verses.translation: But the pride of Israel shall testify to his face; And Israel and Ephraim shall stumble in their iniquity, Judah also shall stumble with them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּצֹאנָ֣ם וּבִבְקָרָ֗ם יֵ֥לְכ֛וּ לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א יִמְצָ֑אוּ חָלַ֖ץ מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: bts'nm vbbqrm ylkhv lbqsh 'tyhvh vl' ymts'v chlts mhm
verses.translation: With their flocks and with their herds they shall go To seek the LORD, but they shall not find Him; He hath withdrawn Himself from them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיהֹוָ֣ה בָּגָ֔דוּ כִּי־בָנִ֥ים זָרִ֖ים יָלָ֑דוּ עַתָּ֛ה יֹאכְלֵ֥ם חֹ֖דֶשׁ אֶת־חֶלְקֵיהֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: byhvh bgdv khybnym zrym yldv 'th y'khlm chdsh 'tchlqyhm {s}
verses.translation: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD, For they have begotten strange children; Now shall the new moon devour them with their portions.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּקְע֤וּ שׁוֹפָר֙ בַּגִּבְעָ֔ה חֲצֹצְרָ֖ה בָּרָמָ֑ה הָרִ֙יעוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית אָ֔וֶן אַחֲרֶ֖יךָ בִּנְיָמִֽין׃
verses.translit: tq'v shvpr bgb'h chtstsrh brmh hry'v byt 'vn 'chrykh bnymyn
verses.translation: Blow ye the horn in Gibeah, And the trumpet in Ramah; Sound an alarm at Beth-aven: ‘Behind thee, O Benjamin! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ לְשַׁמָּ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה בְּי֖וֹם תּוֹכֵחָ֑ה בְּשִׁבְטֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הוֹדַ֖עְתִּי נֶאֱמָנָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'prym lshmh thyh byvm tvkhchh bshbty yshr'l hvd'ty n'mnh
verses.translation: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke; Among the tribes of Israel do I make known that which shall surely be. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָיוּ֙ שָׂרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה כְּמַסִּיגֵ֖י גְּב֑וּל עֲלֵיהֶ֕ם אֶשְׁפּ֥וֹךְ כַּמַּ֖יִם עֶבְרָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: hyv shry yhvdh khmsygy gbvl 'lyhm 'shpvkh khmym 'brty
verses.translation: The princes of Judah are like them that remove the landmark; I will pour out My wrath upon them like water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָשׁ֥וּק אֶפְרַ֖יִם רְצ֣וּץ מִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֣י הוֹאִ֔יל הָלַ֖ךְ אַחֲרֵי־צָֽו׃
verses.translit: 'shvq 'prym rtsvts mshpt khy hv'yl hlkh 'chrytsv
verses.translation: Oppressed is Ephraim, crushed in his right; Because he willingly walked after filth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֥י כָעָ֖שׁ לְאֶפְרָ֑יִם וְכָרָקָ֖ב לְבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'ny kh'sh l'prym vkhrqb lbyt yhvdh
verses.translation: Therefore am I unto Ephraim as a moth, And to the house of Judah as rottenness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨רְא אֶפְרַ֜יִם אֶת־חׇלְי֗וֹ וִֽיהוּדָה֙ אֶת־מְזֹר֔וֹ וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ אֶל־אַשּׁ֔וּר וַיִּשְׁלַ֖ח אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ יָרֵ֑ב וְה֗וּא לֹ֤א יוּכַל֙ לִרְפֹּ֣א לָכֶ֔ם וְלֹא־יִגְהֶ֥ה מִכֶּ֖ם מָזֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vyr' 'prym 'tchlyv vyhvdh 'tmzrv vylkh 'prym 'l'shvr vyshlch 'lmlkh yrb vhv' l' yvkhl lrp' lkhm vl'yghh mkhm mzvr
verses.translation: And when Ephraim saw his sickness, And Judah his wound, Ephraim went to Assyria, And sent to King Contentious; But he is not able to heal you, Neither shall he cure you of your wound.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֤י כַשַּׁ֙חַל֙ לְאֶפְרַ֔יִם וְכַכְּפִ֖יר לְבֵ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲנִ֨י אֲנִ֤י אֶטְרֹף֙ וְאֵלֵ֔ךְ אֶשָּׂ֖א וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: khy 'nkhy khshchl l'prym vkhkhpyr lbyt yhvdh 'ny 'ny 'trf v'lkh 'sh' v'yn mtsyl
verses.translation: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, And as a young lion to the house of Judah; I, even I, will tear and go away, I will take away, and there shall be none to deliver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵלֵ֤ךְ אָשׁ֙וּבָה֙ אֶל־מְקוֹמִ֔י עַ֥ד אֲשֶֽׁר־יֶאְשְׁמ֖וּ וּבִקְשׁ֣וּ פָנָ֑י בַּצַּ֥ר לָהֶ֖ם יְשַׁחֲרֻֽנְנִי׃
verses.translit: 'lkh 'shvbh 'lmqvmy 'd 'shry'shmv vbqshv pny btsr lhm yshchrnny
verses.translation: I will go and return to My place, Till they acknowledge their guilt, and seek My face; In their trouble they will seek Me earnestly:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְכוּ֙ וְנָשׁ֣וּבָה אֶל־יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּ֛י ה֥וּא טָרָ֖ף וְיִרְפָּאֵ֑נוּ יַ֖ךְ וְיַחְבְּשֵֽׁנוּ׃
verses.translit: lkhv vnshvbh 'lyhvh khy hv' trf vyrp'nv ykh vychbshnv
verses.translation: ’Come, and let us return unto the LORD; For He hath torn, and He will heal us, He hath smitten, and He will bind us up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְחַיֵּ֖נוּ מִיֹּמָ֑יִם בַּיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יְקִמֵ֖נוּ וְנִחְיֶ֥ה לְפָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: ychynv mymym byvm hshlyshy yqmnv vnchyh lpnyv
verses.translation: After two days will He revive us, On the third day He will raise us up, that we may live in His presence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֵדְעָ֣ה נִרְדְּפָ֗ה לָדַ֙עַת֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה כְּשַׁ֖חַר נָכ֣וֹן מֹצָא֑וֹ וְיָב֤וֹא כַגֶּ֙שֶׁם֙ לָ֔נוּ כְּמַלְק֖וֹשׁ י֥וֹרֶה אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vnd'h nrdph ld't 'tyhvh khshchr nkhvn mts'v vybv' khgshm lnv khmlqvsh yvrh 'rts
verses.translation: And let us know, eagerly strive to know the LORD, His going forth is sure as the morning; And He shall come unto us as the rain, As the latter rain that watereth the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָ֤ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־לְּךָ֙ אֶפְרַ֔יִם מָ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂה־לְּךָ֖ יְהוּדָ֑ה וְחַסְדְּכֶם֙ כַּעֲנַן־בֹּ֔קֶר וְכַטַּ֖ל מַשְׁכִּ֥ים הֹלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: mh ''shhlkh 'prym mh ''shhlkh yhvdh vchsdkhm kh'nnbqr vkhtl mshkhym hlkh
verses.translation: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? For your goodness is as a morning cloud, And as the dew that early passeth away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֗ן חָצַ֙בְתִּי֙ בַּנְּבִיאִ֔ים הֲרַגְתִּ֖ים בְּאִמְרֵי־פִ֑י וּמִשְׁפָּטֶ֖יךָ א֥וֹר יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn chtsbty bnby'ym hrgtym b'mrypy vmshptykh 'vr yts'
verses.translation: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets, I have slain them by the words of My mouth; And thy judgment goeth forth as the light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י חֶ֥סֶד חָפַ֖צְתִּי וְלֹא־זָ֑בַח וְדַ֥עַת אֱלֹהִ֖ים מֵעֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khy chsd chptsty vl'zbch vd't 'lhym m'lvt
verses.translation: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice, And the knowledge of God rather than burnt-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֕מָּה כְּאָדָ֖ם עָבְר֣וּ בְרִ֑ית שָׁ֖ם בָּ֥גְדוּ בִֽי׃
verses.translit: vhmh kh'dm 'brv bryt shm bgdv by
verses.translation: But they like men have transgressed the covenant; There have they dealt treacherously against Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גִּלְעָ֕ד קִרְיַ֖ת פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן עֲקֻבָּ֖ה מִדָּֽם׃
verses.translit: gl'd qryt p'ly 'vn 'qbh mdm
verses.translation: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, It is covered with footprints of blood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּכְחַכֵּ֨י אִ֜ישׁ גְּדוּדִ֗ים חֶ֚בֶר כֹּהֲנִ֔ים דֶּ֖רֶךְ יְרַצְּחוּ־שֶׁ֑כְמָה כִּ֥י זִמָּ֖ה עָשֽׂוּ׃
verses.translit: vkhchkhy 'ysh gdvdym chbr khhnym drkh yrtschvshkhmh khy zmh 'shv
verses.translation: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, So doth the company of priests; They murder in the way toward Shechem; Yea, they commit enormity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּבֵית֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רָאִ֖יתִי (שעריריה) [שַׁעֲרֽוּרִיָּ֑ה] שָׁ֚ם זְנ֣וּת לְאֶפְרַ֔יִם נִטְמָ֖א יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: bbyt yshr'l r'yty (sh'ryryh) [sh'rvryh] shm znvt l'prym ntm' yshr'l
verses.translation: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing; There harlotry is found in Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־יְהוּדָ֕ה שָׁ֥ת קָצִ֖יר לָ֑ךְ בְּשׁוּבִ֖י שְׁב֥וּת עַמִּֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: gmyhvdh sht qtsyr lkh bshvby shbvt 'my {p}
verses.translation: Also, O Judah, there is a harvest appointed for thee! When I would turn the captivity of My people,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּרׇפְאִ֣י לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְנִגְלָ֞ה עֲוֺ֤ן אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ וְרָע֣וֹת שֹׁמְר֔וֹן כִּ֥י פָעֲל֖וּ שָׁ֑קֶר וְגַנָּ֣ב יָב֔וֹא פָּשַׁ֥ט גְּד֖וּד בַּחֽוּץ׃
verses.translit: khrp'y lyshr'l vnglh 'vn 'prym vr'vt shmrvn khy p'lv shqr vgnb ybv' psht gdvd bchvts
verses.translation: When I would heal Israel, Then is the iniquity of Ephraim uncovered, And the wickedness of Samaria, For they commit falsehood; And the thief entereth in, And the troop of robbers maketh a raid without.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַל־יֹֽאמְרוּ֙ לִלְבָבָ֔ם כׇּל־רָעָתָ֖ם זָכָ֑רְתִּי עַתָּה֙ סְבָב֣וּם מַעַלְלֵיהֶ֔ם נֶ֥גֶד פָּנַ֖י הָיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vbly'mrv llbbm khlr'tm zkhrty 'th sbbvm m'llyhm ngd pny hyv
verses.translation: And let them not say to their heart— I remember all their wickedness; Now their own doings have beset them about, They are before My face.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרָעָתָ֖ם יְשַׂמְּחוּ־מֶ֑לֶךְ וּבְכַחֲשֵׁיהֶ֖ם שָׂרִֽים׃
verses.translit: br'tm yshmchvmlkh vbkhchshyhm shrym
verses.translation: They make the king glad with their wickedness, And the princes with their lies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֻּלָּם֙ מְנָ֣אֲפִ֔ים כְּמ֣וֹ תַנּ֔וּר בֹּעֵ֖רָה מֵאֹפֶ֑ה יִשְׁבּ֣וֹת מֵעִ֔יר מִלּ֥וּשׁ בָּצֵ֖ק עַד־חֻמְצָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khlm mn'pym khmv tnvr b'rh m'ph yshbvt m'yr mlvsh btsq 'dchmtstv
verses.translation: They are all adulterers, As an oven heated by the baker, Who ceaseth to stir From the kneading of the dough until it be leavened.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: י֣וֹם מַלְכֵּ֔נוּ הֶחֱל֥וּ שָׂרִ֖ים חֲמַ֣ת מִיָּ֑יִן מָשַׁ֥ךְ יָד֖וֹ אֶת־לֹצְצִֽים׃
verses.translit: yvm mlkhnv hchlv shrym chmt myyn mshkh ydv 'tltstsym
verses.translation: On the day of our king The princes make him sick with the heat of wine, He stretcheth out his hand with scorners.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־קֵרְב֧וּ כַתַּנּ֛וּר לִבָּ֖ם בְּאׇרְבָּ֑ם כׇּל־הַלַּ֙יְלָה֙ יָשֵׁ֣ן אֹֽפֵהֶ֔ם בֹּ֕קֶר ה֥וּא בֹעֵ֖ר כְּאֵ֥שׁ לֶהָבָֽה׃
verses.translit: khyqrbv khtnvr lbm b'rbm khlhlylh yshn 'phm bqr hv' b'r kh'sh lhbh
verses.translation: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait; Their baker sleepeth all the night, In the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֤ם יֵחַ֙מּוּ֙ כַּתַּנּ֔וּר וְאָכְל֖וּ אֶת־שֹׁפְטֵיהֶ֑ם כׇּל־מַלְכֵיהֶ֣ם נָפָ֔לוּ אֵין־קֹרֵ֥א בָהֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃
verses.translit: khlm ychmv khtnvr v'khlv 'tshptyhm khlmlkhyhm nplv 'ynqr' bhm 'ly
verses.translation: They are all hot as an oven, And devour their judges; All their kings are fallen, There is none among them that calleth unto Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֕יִם בָּעַמִּ֖ים ה֣וּא יִתְבּוֹלָ֑ל אֶפְרַ֛יִם הָיָ֥ה עֻגָ֖ה בְּלִ֥י הֲפוּכָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'prym b'mym hv' ytbvll 'prym hyh 'gh bly hpvkhh
verses.translation: Ephraim, he mixeth himself with the peoples; Ephraim is become a cake not turned.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָכְל֤וּ זָרִים֙ כֹּח֔וֹ וְה֖וּא לֹ֣א יָדָ֑ע גַּם־שֵׂיבָה֙ זָ֣רְקָה בּ֔וֹ וְה֖וּא לֹ֥א יָדָֽע׃
verses.translit: 'khlv zrym khchv vhv' l' yd' gmshybh zrqh bv vhv' l' yd'
verses.translation: Strangers have devoured his strength, And he knoweth it not; Yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, And he knoweth it not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָנָ֥ה גְאֽוֹן־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּפָנָ֑יו וְלֹא־שָׁ֙בוּ֙ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א בִקְשֻׁ֖הוּ בְּכׇל־זֹֽאת׃
verses.translit: v'nh g'vnyshr'l bpnyv vl'shbv 'lyhvh 'lhyhm vl' bqshhv bkhlz't
verses.translation: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face; But they have not returned unto the LORD their God, Nor sought Him, for all this.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם כְּיוֹנָ֥ה פוֹתָ֖ה אֵ֣ין לֵ֑ב מִצְרַ֥יִם קָרָ֖אוּ אַשּׁ֥וּר הָלָֽכוּ׃
verses.translit: vyhy 'prym khyvnh pvth 'yn lb mtsrym qr'v 'shvr hlkhv
verses.translation: And Ephraim is become like a silly dove, without understanding; They call unto Egypt, they go to Assyria.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵלֵ֗כוּ אֶפְר֤וֹשׂ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ רִשְׁתִּ֔י כְּע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם אוֹרִידֵ֑ם אַיְסִירֵ֕ם כְּשֵׁ֖מַע לַעֲדָתָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: kh'shr ylkhv 'prvsh 'lyhm rshty kh'vf hshmym 'vrydm 'ysyrm khshm' l'dtm {s}
verses.translation: Even as they go, I will spread My net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath been made to hear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: א֤וֹי לָהֶם֙ כִּֽי־נָדְד֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נִּי שֹׁ֥ד לָהֶ֖ם כִּי־פָ֣שְׁעוּ בִ֑י וְאָנֹכִ֣י אֶפְדֵּ֔ם וְהֵ֕מָּה דִּבְּר֥וּ עָלַ֖י כְּזָבִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'vy lhm khynddv mmny shd lhm khypsh'v by v'nkhy 'pdm vhmh dbrv 'ly khzbym
verses.translation: Woe unto them! for they have strayed from Me; Destruction unto them! for they have transgressed against Me; Shall I then redeem them, Seeing they have spoken lies against Me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־זָעֲק֤וּ אֵלַי֙ בְּלִבָּ֔ם כִּ֥י יְיֵלִ֖ילוּ עַל־מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָ֑ם עַל־דָּגָ֧ן וְתִיר֛וֹשׁ יִתְגּוֹרָ֖רוּ יָס֥וּרוּ בִֽי׃
verses.translit: vl'z'qv 'ly blbm khy yylylv 'lmshkhbvtm 'ldgn vtyrvsh ytgvrrv ysvrv by
verses.translation: And they have not cried unto Me with their heart, Though they wail upon their beds; They assemble themselves for corn and wine, they rebel against Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י יִסַּ֔רְתִּי חִזַּ֖קְתִּי זְרוֹעֹתָ֑ם וְאֵלַ֖י יְחַשְּׁבוּ־רָֽע׃
verses.translit: v'ny ysrty chzqty zrv'tm v'ly ychshbvr'
verses.translation: Though I have trained and strengthened their arms, Yet do they devise evil against Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ  לֹ֣א עָ֗ל הָיוּ֙ כְּקֶ֣שֶׁת רְמִיָּ֔ה יִפְּל֥וּ בַחֶ֛רֶב שָׂרֵיהֶ֖ם מִזַּ֣עַם לְשׁוֹנָ֑ם ז֥וֹ לַעְגָּ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: yshvbv  l' 'l hyv khqsht rmyh yplv bchrb shryhm mz'm lshvnm zv l'gm b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: They return, but not upwards; They are become like a deceitful bow; Their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue; This shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶל־חִכְּךָ֣ שֹׁפָ֔ר כַּנֶּ֖שֶׁר עַל־בֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה יַ֚עַן עָבְר֣וּ בְרִיתִ֔י וְעַל־תּוֹרָתִ֖י פָּשָֽׁעוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lchkhkh shpr khnshr 'lbyt yhvh y'n 'brv bryty v'ltvrty psh'v
verses.translation: Set the horn to thy mouth. As a vulture he cometh against the house of the LORD; Because they have transgressed My covenant, And trespassed against My law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֖י יִזְעָ֑קוּ אֱלֹהַ֥י יְֽדַעֲנ֖וּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: ly yz'qv 'lhy yd'nvkh yshr'l
verses.translation: Will they cry unto Me: ‘My God, we Israel know Thee’?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָנַ֥ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל ט֑וֹב אוֹיֵ֖ב יִרְדְּפֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: znch yshr'l tvb 'vyb yrdpv
verses.translation: Israel hath cast off that which is good; the enemy shall pursue him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֤ם הִמְלִ֙יכוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א מִמֶּ֔נִּי הֵשִׂ֖ירוּ וְלֹ֣א יָדָ֑עְתִּי כַּסְפָּ֣ם וּזְהָבָ֗ם עָשׂ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ עֲצַבִּ֔ים לְמַ֖עַן יִכָּרֵֽת׃
verses.translit: hm hmlykhv vl' mmny hshyrv vl' yd'ty khspm vzhbm 'shv lhm 'tsbym lm'n ykhrt
verses.translation: They have set up kings, but not from Me, they have made princes, and I knew it not; of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זָנַח֙ עֶגְלֵ֣ךְ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן חָרָ֥ה אַפִּ֖י בָּ֑ם עַד־מָתַ֕י לֹ֥א יוּכְל֖וּ נִקָּיֹֽן׃
verses.translit: znch 'glkh shmrvn chrh 'py bm 'dmty l' yvkhlv nqyn
verses.translation: Thy calf, O Samaria, is cast off; mine anger is kindled against them; how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִיִּשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְה֔וּא חָרָ֣שׁ עָשָׂ֔הוּ וְלֹ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים ה֑וּא כִּֽי־שְׁבָבִ֣ים יִֽהְיֶ֔ה עֵ֖גֶל שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: khy myshr'l vhv' chrsh 'shhv vl' 'lhym hv' khyshbbym yhyh 'gl shmrvn
verses.translation: For from Israel is even this: The craftsman made it, and it is no God; yea, the calf of Samaria shall be broken in shivers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ יִזְרָ֖עוּ וְסוּפָ֣תָה יִקְצֹ֑רוּ קָמָ֣ה אֵֽין־ל֗וֹ צֶ֚מַח בְּלִ֣י יַעֲשֶׂה־קֶּ֔מַח אוּלַ֣י יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה זָרִ֖ים יִבְלָעֻֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: khy rvch yzr'v vsvpth yqtsrv qmh 'ynlv tsmch bly y'shhqmch 'vly y'shh zrym ybl'hv
verses.translation: For they sow the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind; it hath no stalk, the bud that shall yield no meal; if so be it yield, strangers shall swallow it up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִבְלַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַתָּה֙ הָי֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֔ם כִּכְלִ֖י אֵֽין־חֵ֥פֶץ בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: nbl' yshr'l 'th hyv bgvym khkhly 'ynchpts bv
verses.translation: Israel is swallowed up; now are they become among the nations as a vessel wherein is no value.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־הֵ֙מָּה֙ עָל֣וּ אַשּׁ֔וּר פֶּ֖רֶא בּוֹדֵ֣ד ל֑וֹ אֶפְרַ֖יִם הִתְנ֥וּ אֲהָבִֽים׃
verses.translit: khyhmh 'lv 'shvr pr' bvdd lv 'prym htnv 'hbym
verses.translation: For they are gone up to Assyria, like a wild ass alone by himself; Ephraim hath hired lovers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֛ם כִּֽי־יִתְנ֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֖ם עַתָּ֣ה אֲקַבְּצֵ֑ם וַיָּחֵ֣לּוּ מְּעָ֔ט מִמַּשָּׂ֖א מֶ֥לֶךְ שָׂרִֽים׃
verses.translit: gm khyytnv bgvym 'th 'qbtsm vychlv m't mmsh' mlkh shrym
verses.translation: Yea, though they hire among the nations, now will I gather them up; and they begin to be minished by reason of the burden of king and princes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־הִרְבָּ֥ה אֶפְרַ֛יִם מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לַחֲטֹ֑א הָיוּ־ל֥וֹ מִזְבְּח֖וֹת לַחֲטֹֽא׃
verses.translit: khyhrbh 'prym mzbchvt lcht' hyvlv mzbchvt lcht'
