verses.translation: For Ephraim hath multiplied altars to sin, yea, altars have been unto him to sin. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (אכתוב) [אֶ֨כְתׇּב־]ל֔וֹ (רבו) [רֻבֵּ֖י] תּוֹרָתִ֑י כְּמוֹ־זָ֖ר נֶחְשָֽׁבוּ׃
verses.translit: ('khtvb) ['khtb]lv (rbv) [rby] tvrty khmvzr nchshbv
verses.translation: Though I write for him never so many things of My Law, they are accounted as a stranger’s.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִבְחֵ֣י הַבְהָבַ֗י יִזְבְּח֤וּ בָשָׂר֙ וַיֹּאכֵ֔לוּ יְהֹוָ֖ה לֹ֣א רָצָ֑ם עַתָּ֞ה יִזְכֹּ֤ר עֲוֺנָם֙ וְיִפְקֹ֣ד חַטֹּאותָ֔ם הֵ֖מָּה מִצְרַ֥יִם יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃
verses.translit: zbchy hbhby yzbchv bshr vy'khlv yhvh l' rtsm 'th yzkhr 'vnm vypqd cht'vtm hmh mtsrym yshvbv
verses.translation: As for the sacrifices that are made by fire unto Me, let them sacrifice flesh and eat it, For the LORD accepteth them not. Now will He remember their iniquity, and punish their sins; They shall return to Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֨ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־עֹשֵׂ֗הוּ וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ הֵיכָל֔וֹת וִיהוּדָ֕ה הִרְבָּ֖ה עָרִ֣ים בְּצֻר֑וֹת וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־אֵ֣שׁ בְּעָרָ֔יו וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshkhch yshr'l 't'shhv vybn hykhlvt vyhvdh hrbh 'rym btsrvt vshlchty'sh b'ryv v'khlh 'rmntyh {p}
verses.translation: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, And builded palaces, And Judah hath multiplied fortified cities; But I will send a fire upon his cities, And it shall devour the castles thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּשְׂמַ֨ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל ׀ אֶל־גִּיל֙ כָּעַמִּ֔ים כִּ֥י זָנִ֖יתָ מֵעַ֣ל אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אָהַ֣בְתָּ אֶתְנָ֔ן עַ֖ל כׇּל־גׇּרְנ֥וֹת דָּגָֽן׃
verses.translit: 'ltshmch yshr'l  'lgyl kh'mym khy znyt m'l 'lhykh 'hbt 'tnn 'l khlgrnvt dgn
verses.translation: Rejoice not, O Israel, unto exultation, like the peoples, For thou hast gone astray from thy God, Thou hast loved a harlot’s hire upon every corn-floor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֹּ֥רֶן וָיֶ֖קֶב לֹ֣א יִרְעֵ֑ם וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ יְכַ֥חֶשׁ בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: grn vyqb l' yr'm vtyrvsh ykhchsh bh
verses.translation: The threshing-floor and the wine-press shall not feed them, And the new wine shall fail her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֥א יֵשְׁב֖וּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְשָׁ֤ב אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּבְאַשּׁ֖וּר טָמֵ֥א יֹאכֵֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: l' yshbv b'rts yhvh vshb 'prym mtsrym vb'shvr tm' y'khlv
verses.translation: They shall not dwell in the LORD’S land; But Ephraim shall return to Egypt, And they shall eat unclean food in Assyria.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־יִסְּכ֨וּ לַיהֹוָ֥ה ׀ יַ֘יִן֮ וְלֹ֣א יֶעֶרְבוּ־לוֹ֒ זִבְחֵיהֶ֗ם כְּלֶ֤חֶם אוֹנִים֙ לָהֶ֔ם כׇּל־אֹכְלָ֖יו יִטַּמָּ֑אוּ כִּֽי־לַחְמָ֣ם לְנַפְשָׁ֔ם לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: l'yskhv lyhvh  yyn vl' y'rbvlv zbchyhm khlchm 'vnym lhm khl'khlyv ytm'v khylchmm lnpshm l' ybv' byt yhvh
verses.translation: They shall not pour out wine-offerings to the LORD, Neither shall they be pleasing unto Him; Their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners, All that eat thereof shall be polluted; For their bread shall be for their appetite, It shall not come into the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַֽה־תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ לְי֣וֹם מוֹעֵ֑ד וּלְי֖וֹם חַג־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: mht'shv lyvm mv'd vlyvm chgyhvh
verses.translation: What will ye do in the day of the appointed season, And in the day of the feast of the LORD?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֤ה הָֽלְכוּ֙ מִשֹּׁ֔ד מִצְרַ֥יִם תְּקַבְּצֵ֖ם מֹ֣ף תְּקַבְּרֵ֑ם מַחְמַ֣ד לְכַסְפָּ֗ם קִמּוֹשׂ֙ יִֽירָשֵׁ֔ם ח֖וֹחַ בְּאׇהֳלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khyhnh hlkhv mshd mtsrym tqbtsm mf tqbrm mchmd lkhspm qmvsh yyrshm chvch b'hlyhm
verses.translation: For, lo, they are gone away from destruction, Yet Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them; Their precious treasures of silver, nettles shall possess them, Thorns shall be in their tents.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֣אוּ  יְמֵ֣י הַפְּקֻדָּ֗ה בָּ֚אוּ יְמֵ֣י הַשִּׁלֻּ֔ם יֵדְע֖וּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֱוִ֣יל הַנָּבִ֗יא מְשֻׁגָּע֙ אִ֣ישׁ הָר֔וּחַ עַ֚ל רֹ֣ב עֲוֺנְךָ֔ וְרַבָּ֖ה מַשְׂטֵמָֽה׃
verses.translit: b'v  ymy hpqdh b'v ymy hshlm yd'v yshr'l 'vyl hnby' mshg' 'ysh hrvch 'l rb 'vnkh vrbh mshtmh
verses.translation: The days of visitation are come, The days of recompense are come, Israel shall know it. The prophet is a fool, the man of the spirit is mad! For the multitude of thine iniquity, the enmity is great.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֹפֶ֥ה אֶפְרַ֖יִם עִם־אֱלֹהָ֑י נָבִ֞יא פַּ֤ח יָקוֹשׁ֙ עַל־כׇּל־דְּרָכָ֔יו מַשְׂטֵמָ֖ה בְּבֵ֥ית אֱלֹהָֽיו׃
verses.translit: tsph 'prym 'm'lhy nby' pch yqvsh 'lkhldrkhyv mshtmh bbyt 'lhyv
verses.translation: Ephraim is a watchman with my God; As for the prophet, a fowler’s snare is in all his ways, And enmity in the house of his God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶעְמִ֥יקוּ שִׁחֵ֖תוּ כִּימֵ֣י הַגִּבְעָ֑ה יִזְכּ֣וֹר עֲוֺנָ֔ם יִפְק֖וֹד חַטֹּאותָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: h'myqv shchtv khymy hgb'h yzkhvr 'vnm ypqvd cht'vtm {s}
verses.translation: They have deeply corrupted themselves, As in the days of Gibeah; He will remember their iniquity, He will punish their sins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּעֲנָבִ֣ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר מָצָ֙אתִי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּבִכּוּרָ֤הֿ בִתְאֵנָה֙ בְּרֵ֣אשִׁיתָ֔הּ רָאִ֖יתִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם הֵ֜מָּה בָּ֣אוּ בַֽעַל־פְּע֗וֹר וַיִּנָּֽזְרוּ֙ לַבֹּ֔שֶׁת וַיִּהְי֥וּ שִׁקּוּצִ֖ים כְּאׇהֳבָֽם׃
verses.translit: kh'nbym bmdbr mts'ty yshr'l khbkhvrh bt'nh br'shyth r'yty 'bvtykhm hmh b'v b'lp'vr vynzrv lbsht vyhyv shqvtsym kh'hbm
verses.translation: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness, I saw your fathers as the first-ripe in the fig-tree at her first season; But so soon as they came to Baal-peor, They separated themselves unto the shameful thing, And became detestable like that which they loved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֕יִם כָּע֖וֹף יִתְעוֹפֵ֣ף כְּבוֹדָ֑ם מִלֵּדָ֥ה וּמִבֶּ֖טֶן וּמֵהֵרָיֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'prym kh'vf yt'vpf khbvdm mldh vmbtn vmhryvn
verses.translation: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird; There shall be no birth, and none with child, and no conception.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִם־יְגַדְּלוּ֙ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֔ם וְשִׁכַּלְתִּ֖ים מֵאָדָ֑ם כִּֽי־גַם־א֥וֹי לָהֶ֖ם בְּשׂוּרִ֥י מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy 'mygdlv 'tbnyhm vshkhltym m'dm khygm'vy lhm bshvry mhm
verses.translation: Yea, though they bring up their children, Yet will I bereave them, that there be not a man left; Yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֛יִם כַּאֲשֶׁר־רָאִ֥יתִי לְצ֖וֹר שְׁתוּלָ֣ה בְנָוֶ֑ה וְאֶפְרַ֕יִם לְהוֹצִ֥יא אֶל־הֹרֵ֖ג בָּנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'prym kh'shrr'yty ltsvr shtvlh bnvh v'prym lhvtsy' 'lhrg bnyv
verses.translation: Ephraim, like as I have seen Tyre, is planted in a pleasant place; But Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the slayer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֵּן־לָהֶ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה מַה־תִּתֵּ֑ן תֵּן־לָהֶם֙ רֶ֣חֶם מַשְׁכִּ֔יל וְשָׁדַ֖יִם צֹמְקִֽים׃
verses.translit: tnlhm yhvh mhttn tnlhm rchm mshkhyl vshdym tsmqym
verses.translation: Give them, O LORD, whatsoever Thou wilt give; Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־רָעָתָ֤ם בַּגִּלְגָּל֙ כִּי־שָׁ֣ם שְׂנֵאתִ֔ים עַ֚ל רֹ֣עַ מַעַלְלֵיהֶ֔ם מִבֵּיתִ֖י אֲגָרְשֵׁ֑ם לֹ֤א אוֹסֵף֙ אַהֲבָתָ֔ם כׇּל־שָׂרֵיהֶ֖ם סֹרְרִֽים׃
verses.translit: khlr'tm bglgl khyshm shn'tym 'l r' m'llyhm mbyty 'grshm l' 'vsf 'hbtm khlshryhm srrym
verses.translation: All their wickedness is in Gilgal, For there I hated them; Because of the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of My house; I will love them no more, All their princes are rebellious.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֻכָּ֣ה אֶפְרַ֔יִם שׇׁרְשָׁ֥ם יָבֵ֖שׁ פְּרִ֣י (בלי) [בַֽל־]יַעֲשׂ֑וּן גַּ֚ם כִּ֣י יֵלֵד֔וּן וְהֵמַתִּ֖י מַחֲמַדֵּ֥י בִטְנָֽם׃
verses.translit: hkhh 'prym shrshm ybsh pry (bly) [bl]y'shvn gm khy yldvn vhmty mchmdy btnm
verses.translation: Ephraim is smitten, Their root is dried up, They shall bear no fruit; Yea, though they bring forth, Yet will I slay the beloved fruit of their womb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִמְאָסֵ֣ם אֱלֹהַ֔י כִּ֛י לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ ל֑וֹ וְיִֽהְי֥וּ נֹדְדִ֖ים בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ym'sm 'lhy khy l' shm'v lv vyhyv nddym bgvym {s}
verses.translation: My God will cast them away, Because they did not hearken unto Him; And they shall be wanderers among the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֶּ֤פֶן בּוֹקֵק֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל פְּרִ֖י יְשַׁוֶּה־לּ֑וֹ כְּרֹ֣ב לְפִרְי֗וֹ הִרְבָּה֙ לַֽמִּזְבְּח֔וֹת כְּט֣וֹב לְאַרְצ֔וֹ הֵיטִ֖יבוּ מַצֵּבֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: gpn bvqq yshr'l pry yshvhlv khrb lpryv hrbh lmzbchvt khtvb l'rtsv hytybv mtsbvt
verses.translation: Israel was a luxuriant vine, Which put forth fruit freely: As his fruit increased, He increased his altars; The more goodly his land was, The more goodly were his pillars.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָלַ֥ק לִבָּ֖ם עַתָּ֣ה יֶאְשָׁ֑מוּ ה֚וּא יַעֲרֹ֣ף מִזְבְּחוֹתָ֔ם יְשֹׁדֵ֖ד מַצֵּבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: chlq lbm 'th y'shmv hv' y'rf mzbchvtm yshdd mtsbvtm
verses.translation: Their heart is divided; Now shall they bear their guilt; He will break down their altars, He will spoil their pillars.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַתָּה֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ אֵ֥ין מֶ֖לֶךְ לָ֑נוּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָרֵ֙אנוּ֙ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְהַמֶּ֖לֶךְ מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה־לָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: khy 'th y'mrv 'yn mlkh lnv khy l' yr'nv 'tyhvh vhmlkh mhy'shhlnv
verses.translation: Surely now shall they say: ‘We have no king; For we feared not the LORD; And the king, what can he do for us?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְּר֣וּ דְבָרִ֔ים אָל֥וֹת שָׁ֖וְא כָּרֹ֣ת בְּרִ֑ית וּפָרַ֤ח כָּרֹאשׁ֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט עַ֖ל תַּלְמֵ֥י שָׂדָֽי׃
verses.translit: dbrv dbrym 'lvt shv' khrt bryt vprch khr'sh mshpt 'l tlmy shdy
verses.translation: They speak words, They swear falsely, they make covenants; Thus judgment springeth up as hemlock In the furrows of the field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְעֶגְלוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית אָ֔וֶן יָג֖וּרוּ שְׁכַ֣ן שֹׁמְר֑וֹן כִּֽי־אָבַ֨ל עָלָ֜יו עַמּ֗וֹ וּכְמָרָיו֙ עָלָ֣יו יָגִ֔ילוּ עַל־כְּבוֹד֖וֹ כִּי־גָלָ֥ה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: l'glvt byt 'vn ygvrv shkhn shmrvn khy'bl 'lyv 'mv vkhmryv 'lyv ygylv 'lkhbvdv khyglh mmnv
verses.translation: The inhabitants of Samaria shall be in dread For the calves of Beth-aven; For the people thereof shall mourn over it, And the priests thereof shall tremble for it, For its glory, because it is departed from it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אוֹתוֹ֙ לְאַשּׁ֣וּר יוּבָ֔ל מִנְחָ֖ה לְמֶ֣לֶךְ יָרֵ֑ב בׇּשְׁנָה֙ אֶפְרַ֣יִם יִקָּ֔ח וְיֵב֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵעֲצָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: gm'vtv l'shvr yvbl mnchh lmlkh yrb bshnh 'prym yqch vybvsh yshr'l m'tstv
verses.translation: It also shall be carried unto Assyria, For a present to King Contentious; Ephraim shall receive shame, And Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִדְמֶ֥ה שֹׁמְר֖וֹן מַלְכָּ֑הּ כְּקֶ֖צֶף עַל־פְּנֵי־מָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: ndmh shmrvn mlkhh khqtsf 'lpnymym
verses.translation: As for Samaria, her king is cut off, As foam upon the water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִשְׁמְד֞וּ בָּמ֣וֹת אָ֗וֶן חַטַּאת֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל ק֣וֹץ וְדַרְדַּ֔ר יַעֲלֶ֖ה עַל־מִזְבְּחוֹתָ֑ם וְאָמְר֤וּ לֶהָרִים֙ כַּסּ֔וּנוּ וְלַגְּבָע֖וֹת נִפְל֥וּ עָלֵֽינוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vnshmdv bmvt 'vn cht't yshr'l qvts vdrdr y'lh 'lmzbchvtm v'mrv lhrym khsvnv vlgb'vt nplv 'lynv {p}
verses.translation: The high places also of Aven shall be destroyed, Even the sin of Israel. The thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; And they shall say to the mountains: ‘Cover us’, And to the hills: ‘Fall on us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִימֵי֙ הַגִּבְעָ֔ה חָטָ֖אתָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל שָׁ֣ם עָמָ֔דוּ לֹא־תַשִּׂיגֵ֧ם בַּגִּבְעָ֛ה מִלְחָמָ֖ה עַל־בְּנֵ֥י עַֽלְוָֽה׃
verses.translit: mymy hgb'h cht't yshr'l shm 'mdv l'tshygm bgb'h mlchmh 'lbny 'lvh
verses.translation: From the days of Gibeah thou hast sinned, O Israel; There they stood; No battle was to overtake them in Gibeah, Nor the children of arrogancy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּאַוָּתִ֖י וְאֶסֳּרֵ֑ם וְאֻסְּפ֤וּ עֲלֵיהֶם֙ עַמִּ֔ים בְּאׇסְרָ֖ם לִשְׁתֵּ֥י (עינתם) [עוֹנֹתָֽם]׃
verses.translit: b'vty v'srm v'spv 'lyhm 'mym b'srm lshty ('yntm) ['vntm]
verses.translation: When it is My desire, I will chastise them; And the peoples shall be gathered against them, When they are yoked to their two rings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶפְרַ֜יִם עֶגְלָ֤ה מְלֻמָּדָה֙ אֹהַ֣בְתִּי לָד֔וּשׁ וַאֲנִ֣י עָבַ֔רְתִּי עַל־ט֖וּב צַוָּארָ֑הּ אַרְכִּ֤יב אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ יַחֲר֣וֹשׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה יְשַׂדֶּד־ל֖וֹ יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: v'prym 'glh mlmdh 'hbty ldvsh v'ny 'brty 'ltvb tsv'rh 'rkhyb 'prym ychrvsh yhvdh yshddlv y'qb
verses.translation: And Ephraim is a heifer well broken, That loveth to thresh, And I have passed over upon her fair neck; I will make Ephraim to ride, Judah shall plow, Jacob shall break his clods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִרְע֨וּ לָכֶ֤ם לִצְדָקָה֙ קִצְר֣וּ לְפִי־חֶ֔סֶד נִ֥ירוּ לָכֶ֖ם נִ֑יר וְעֵת֙ לִדְר֣וֹשׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֔ה עַד־יָב֕וֹא וְיֹרֶ֥ה צֶ֖דֶק לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: zr'v lkhm ltsdqh qtsrv lpychsd nyrv lkhm nyr v't ldrvsh 'tyhvh 'dybv' vyrh tsdq lkhm
verses.translation: Sow to yourselves according to righteousness, Reap according to mercy, Break up your fallow ground; For it is time to seek the LORD, Till He come and cause righteousness to rain upon you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲרַשְׁתֶּם־רֶ֛שַׁע עַוְלָ֥תָה קְצַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲכַלְתֶּ֣ם פְּרִי־כָ֑חַשׁ כִּי־בָטַ֥חְתָּ בְדַרְכְּךָ֖ בְּרֹ֥ב גִּבּוֹרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: chrshtmrsh' 'vlth qtsrtm 'khltm prykhchsh khybtcht bdrkhkh brb gbvrykh
verses.translation: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity, Ye have eaten the fruit of lies; For thou didst trust in thy way, In the multitude of thy mighty men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקָ֣אם שָׁאוֹן֮ בְּעַמֶּ֒ךָ֒ וְכׇל־מִבְצָרֶ֣יךָ יוּשַּׁ֔ד כְּשֹׁ֧ד שַֽׁלְמַ֛ן בֵּ֥ית אַֽרְבֵ֖אל בְּי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֑ה אֵ֥ם עַל־בָּנִ֖ים רֻטָּֽשָׁה׃
verses.translit: vq'm sh'vn b'mkh vkhlmbtsrykh yvshd khshd shlmn byt 'rb'l byvm mlchmh 'm 'lbnym rtshh
verses.translation: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy hosts, And all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, As Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle; The mother was dashed in pieces with her children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כָּ֗כָה עָשָׂ֤ה לָכֶם֙ בֵּֽית־אֵ֔ל מִפְּנֵ֖י רָעַ֣ת רָעַתְכֶ֑ם בַּשַּׁ֕חַר נִדְמֹ֥ה נִדְמָ֖ה מֶ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khkhh 'shh lkhm byt'l mpny r't r'tkhm bshchr ndmh ndmh mlkh yshr'l
verses.translation: So hath Beth-el done unto you Because of your great wickedness; At daybreak is the king of Israel utterly cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י נַ֥עַר יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וָאֹהֲבֵ֑הוּ וּמִמִּצְרַ֖יִם קָרָ֥אתִי לִבְנִֽי׃
verses.translit: khy n'r yshr'l v'hbhv vmmtsrym qr'ty lbny
verses.translation: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, And out of Egypt I called My son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָרְא֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם כֵּ֚ן הָלְכ֣וּ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם לַבְּעָלִ֣ים יְזַבֵּ֔חוּ וְלַפְּסִלִ֖ים יְקַטֵּרֽוּן׃
verses.translit: qr'v lhm khn hlkhv mpnyhm lb'lym yzbchv vlpslym yqtrvn
verses.translation: The more they called them, the more they went from them; They sacrificed unto the Baalim, And offered to graven images.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֤י תִרְגַּ֙לְתִּי֙ לְאֶפְרַ֔יִם קָחָ֖ם עַל־זְרוֹעֹתָ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ כִּ֥י רְפָאתִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'nkhy trglty l'prym qchm 'lzrv'tyv vl' yd'v khy rp'tym
verses.translation: And I, I taught Ephraim to walk, Taking them by their arms; But they knew not that I healed them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּחַבְלֵ֨י אָדָ֤ם אֶמְשְׁכֵם֙ בַּעֲבֹת֣וֹת אַהֲבָ֔ה וָאֶהְיֶ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם כִּמְרִ֥ימֵי עֹ֖ל עַ֣ל לְחֵיהֶ֑ם וְאַ֥ט אֵלָ֖יו אוֹכִֽיל׃
verses.translit: bchbly 'dm 'mshkhm b'btvt 'hbh v'hyh lhm khmrymy 'l 'l lchyhm v't 'lyv 'vkhyl
verses.translation: I drew them with cords of a man, With bands of love; And I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, And I fed them gently.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א יָשׁוּב֙ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְאַשּׁ֖וּר ה֣וּא מַלְכּ֑וֹ כִּ֥י מֵאֲנ֖וּ לָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: l' yshvb 'l'rts mtsrym v'shvr hv' mlkhv khy m'nv lshvb
verses.translation: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, But the Assyrian shall be his king, Because they refused to return.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָלָ֥ה חֶ֙רֶב֙ בְּעָרָ֔יו וְכִלְּתָ֥ה בַדָּ֖יו וְאָכָ֑לָה מִֽמֹּעֲצ֖וֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vchlh chrb b'ryv vkhlth bdyv v'khlh mm'tsvtyhm
verses.translation: And the sword shall fall upon his cities, And shall consume his bars, and devour them, Because of their own counsels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַמִּ֥י תְלוּאִ֖ים לִמְשׁוּבָתִ֑י וְאֶל־עַל֙ יִקְרָאֻ֔הוּ יַ֖חַד לֹ֥א יְרוֹמֵֽם׃
verses.translit: v'my tlv'ym lmshvbty v'l'l yqr'hv ychd l' yrvmm
verses.translation: And My people are in suspense about returning to Me; And though they call them upwards, None at all will lift himself up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֞יךְ אֶתֶּנְךָ֣ אֶפְרַ֗יִם אֲמַגֶּנְךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֚יךְ אֶתֶּנְךָ֣ כְאַדְמָ֔ה אֲשִֽׂימְךָ֖ כִּצְבֹאיִ֑ם נֶהְפַּ֤ךְ עָלַי֙ לִבִּ֔י יַ֖חַד נִכְמְר֥וּ נִחוּמָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ykh 'tnkh 'prym 'mgnkh yshr'l 'ykh 'tnkh kh'dmh 'shymkh khtsb'ym nhpkh 'ly lby ychd nkhmrv nchvmy
verses.translation: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? How shall I surrender thee, Israel? How shall I make thee as Admah? How shall I set thee as Zeboim? My heart is turned within Me, My compassions are kindled together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א אֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ חֲר֣וֹן אַפִּ֔י לֹ֥א אָשׁ֖וּב לְשַׁחֵ֣ת אֶפְרָ֑יִם כִּ֣י אֵ֤ל אָנֹכִי֙ וְלֹא־אִ֔ישׁ בְּקִרְבְּךָ֣ קָד֔וֹשׁ וְלֹ֥א אָב֖וֹא בְּעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: l' ''shh chrvn 'py l' 'shvb lshcht 'prym khy 'l 'nkhy vl''ysh bqrbkh qdvsh vl' 'bv' b'yr
verses.translation: I will not execute the fierceness of Mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim; For I am God, and not man, The Holy One in the midst of thee; And I will not come in fury.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֧י יְהֹוָ֛ה יֵלְכ֖וּ כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה יִשְׁאָ֑ג כִּֽי־ה֣וּא יִשְׁאַ֔ג וְיֶחֶרְד֥וּ בָנִ֖ים מִיָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'chry yhvh ylkhv kh'ryh ysh'g khyhv' ysh'g vychrdv bnym mym
verses.translation: They shall walk after the LORD, Who shall roar like a lion; For He shall roar, And the children shall come trembling from the west.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֶחֶרְד֤וּ כְצִפּוֹר֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וּכְיוֹנָ֖ה מֵאֶ֣רֶץ אַשּׁ֑וּר וְהוֹשַׁבְתִּ֥ים עַל־בָּתֵּיהֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: ychrdv khtspvr mmtsrym vkhyvnh m'rts 'shvr vhvshbtym 'lbtyhm n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: They shall come trembling as a bird out of Egypt, And as a dove out of the land of Assyria; And I will make them to dwell in their houses, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סְבָבֻ֤נִֽי בְכַ֙חַשׁ֙ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וּבְמִרְמָ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וִיהוּדָ֗ה עֹ֥ד רָד֙ עִם־אֵ֔ל וְעִם־קְדוֹשִׁ֖ים נֶאֱמָֽן׃
verses.translit: sbbny bkhchsh 'prym vbmrmh byt yshr'l vyhvdh 'd rd 'm'l v'mqdvshym n'mn
verses.translation: Ephraim compasseth Me about with lies, And the house of Israel with deceit; And Judah is yet wayward towards God, And towards the Holy One who is faithful.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֜יִם רֹעֶ֥ה ר֙וּחַ֙ וְרֹדֵ֣ף קָדִ֔ים כׇּל־הַיּ֕וֹם כָּזָ֥ב וָשֹׁ֖ד יַרְבֶּ֑ה וּבְרִית֙ עִם־אַשּׁ֣וּר יִכְרֹ֔תוּ וְשֶׁ֖מֶן לְמִצְרַ֥יִם יוּבָֽל׃
verses.translit: 'prym r'h rvch vrdf qdym khlhyvm khzb vshd yrbh vbryt 'm'shvr ykhrtv vshmn lmtsrym yvbl
verses.translation: Ephraim striveth after wind, and followeth after the east wind; All the day he multiplieth lies and desolation; And they make a covenant with Assyria, And oil is carried into Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרִ֥יב לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה עִם־יְהוּדָ֑ה וְלִפְקֹ֤ד עַֽל־יַעֲקֹב֙ כִּדְרָכָ֔יו כְּמַעֲלָלָ֖יו יָשִׁ֥יב לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vryb lyhvh 'myhvdh vlpqd 'ly'qb khdrkhyv khm'llyv yshyb lv
verses.translation: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, And will punish Jacob according to his ways, According to his doings will He recompense him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּבֶּ֖טֶן עָקַ֣ב אֶת־אָחִ֑יו וּבְאוֹנ֖וֹ שָׂרָ֥ה אֶת־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: bbtn 'qb 't'chyv vb'vnv shrh 't'lhym
verses.translation: In the womb he took his brother by the heel, And by his strength he strove with a godlike being;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤שַׂר אֶל־מַלְאָךְ֙ וַיֻּכָ֔ל בָּכָ֖ה וַיִּתְחַנֶּן־ל֑וֹ בֵּֽית־אֵל֙ יִמְצָאֶ֔נּוּ וְשָׁ֖ם יְדַבֵּ֥ר עִמָּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: vyshr 'lml'kh vykhl bkhh vytchnnlv byt'l ymts'nv vshm ydbr 'mnv
verses.translation: So he strove with an angel, and prevailed; He wept, and made supplication unto him; At Beth-el he would find him, And there he would speak with us;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י הַצְּבָא֑וֹת יְהֹוָ֖ה זִכְרֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyhvh 'lhy htsb'vt yhvh zkhrv
verses.translation: But the LORD, the God of hosts, The LORD is His name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֖ה בֵּאלֹהֶ֣יךָ תָשׁ֑וּב חֶ֤סֶד וּמִשְׁפָּט֙ שְׁמֹ֔ר וְקַוֵּ֥ה אֶל־אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: v'th b'lhykh tshvb chsd vmshpt shmr vqvh 'l'lhykh tmyd
verses.translation: Therefore turn thou to thy God; Keep mercy and justice, And wait for thy God continually.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּנַ֗עַן בְּיָד֛וֹ מֹאזְנֵ֥י מִרְמָ֖ה לַעֲשֹׁ֥ק אָהֵֽב׃
verses.translit: khn'n bydv m'zny mrmh l'shq 'hb
verses.translation: As for the trafficker, the balances of deceit are in his hand. He loveth to oppress.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶפְרַ֔יִם אַ֣ךְ עָשַׁ֔רְתִּי מָצָ֥אתִי א֖וֹן לִ֑י כׇּל־יְגִיעַ֕י לֹ֥א יִמְצְאוּ־לִ֖י עָוֺ֥ן אֲשֶׁר־חֵֽטְא׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'prym 'kh 'shrty mts'ty 'vn ly khlygy'y l' ymts'vly 'vn 'shrcht'
verses.translation: And Ephraim said: ‘Surely I am become rich, I have found me wealth; In all my labours they shall find in me No iniquity that were sin.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֛י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם עֹ֛ד אוֹשִֽׁיבְךָ֥ בׇאֳהָלִ֖ים כִּימֵ֥י מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.translit: v'nkhy yhvh 'lhykh m'rts mtsrym 'd 'vshybkh b'hlym khymy mv'd
verses.translation: But I am the LORD thy God From the land of Egypt; I will yet again make thee to dwell in tents, As in the days of the appointed season.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְדִבַּ֙רְתִּי֙ עַל־הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְאָנֹכִ֖י חָז֣וֹן הִרְבֵּ֑יתִי וּבְיַ֥ד הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים אֲדַמֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vdbrty 'lhnby'ym v'nkhy chzvn hrbyty vbyd hnby'ym 'dmh
verses.translation: I have also spoken unto the prophets, And I have multiplied visions; And by the ministry of the prophets have I used similitudes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־גִּלְעָ֥ד אָ֙וֶן֙ אַךְ־שָׁ֣וְא הָי֔וּ בַּגִּלְגָּ֖ל שְׁוָרִ֣ים זִבֵּ֑חוּ גַּ֤ם מִזְבְּחוֹתָם֙ כְּגַלִּ֔ים עַ֖ל תַּלְמֵ֥י שָׂדָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'mgl'd 'vn 'khshv' hyv bglgl shvrym zbchv gm mzbchvtm khglym 'l tlmy shdy
verses.translation: If Gilead be given to iniquity Becoming altogether vanity, In Gilgal they sacrifice unto bullocks; Yea, their altars shall be as heaps In the furrows of the field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּבְרַ֥ח יַעֲקֹ֖ב שְׂדֵ֣ה אֲרָ֑ם וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ד יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּאִשָּׁ֔ה וּבְאִשָּׁ֖ה שָׁמָֽר׃
verses.translit: vybrch y'qb shdh 'rm vy'bd yshr'l b'shh vb'shh shmr
verses.translation: And Jacob fled into the field of Aram, And Israel served for a wife, And for a wife he kept sheep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנָבִ֕יא הֶעֱלָ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וּבְנָבִ֖יא נִשְׁמָֽר׃
verses.translit: vbnby' h'lh yhvh 'tyshr'l mmtsrym vbnby' nshmr
verses.translation: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel up out of Egypt, And by a prophet was he kept.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִכְעִ֥יס אֶפְרַ֖יִם תַּמְרוּרִ֑ים וְדָמָיו֙ עָלָ֣יו יִטּ֔וֹשׁ וְחֶ֨רְפָּת֔וֹ יָשִׁ֥יב ל֖וֹ אֲדֹנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hkh'ys 'prym tmrvrym vdmyv 'lyv ytvsh vchrptv yshyb lv 'dnyv
verses.translation: Ephraim hath provoked most bitterly; Therefore shall his blood be cast upon him, And his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּדַבֵּ֤ר אֶפְרַ֙יִם֙ רְתֵ֔ת נָשָׂ֥א ה֖וּא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֶּאְשַׁ֥ם בַּבַּ֖עַל וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.translit: khdbr 'prym rtt nsh' hv' byshr'l vy'shm bb'l vymt
verses.translation: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling, He exalted himself in Israel; But when he became guilty through Baal, he died.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה  יוֹסִ֣פוּ לַחֲטֹ֗א וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ לָהֶם֩ מַסֵּכָ֨ה מִכַּסְפָּ֤ם כִּתְבוּנָם֙ עֲצַבִּ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חָרָשִׁ֖ים כֻּלֹּ֑ה לָהֶם֙ הֵ֣ם אֹמְרִ֔ים זֹבְחֵ֣י אָדָ֔ם עֲגָלִ֖ים יִשָּׁקֽוּן׃
verses.translit: v'th  yvspv lcht' vy'shv lhm mskhh mkhspm khtbvnm 'tsbym m'shh chrshym khlh lhm hm 'mrym zbchy 'dm 'glym yshqvn
verses.translation: And now they sin more and more, And have made them molten images of their silver, According to their own understanding, even idols, All of them the work of the craftsmen; Of them they say: ‘They that sacrifice men kiss calves.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן יִֽהְיוּ֙ כַּעֲנַן־בֹּ֔קֶר וְכַטַּ֖ל מַשְׁכִּ֣ים הֹלֵ֑ךְ כְּמֹץ֙ יְסֹעֵ֣ר מִגֹּ֔רֶן וּכְעָשָׁ֖ן מֵאֲרֻבָּֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn yhyv kh'nnbqr vkhtl mshkhym hlkh khmts ys'r mgrn vkh'shn m'rbh
verses.translation: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, And as the dew that early passeth away, As the chaff that is driven with the wind out of the threshing-floor, And as the smoke out of the window.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֛י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וֵאלֹהִ֤ים זוּלָתִי֙ לֹ֣א תֵדָ֔ע וּמוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אַ֖יִן בִּלְתִּֽי׃
verses.translit: v'nkhy yhvh 'lhykh m'rts mtsrym v'lhym zvlty l' td' vmvshy' 'yn blty
verses.translation: Yet I am the LORD thy God From the land of Egypt; And thou knowest no God but Me, And beside Me there is no saviour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י יְדַעְתִּ֖יךָ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר בְּאֶ֖רֶץ תַּלְאֻבֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'ny yd'tykh bmdbr b'rts tl'bvt
verses.translation: I did know thee in the wilderness, In the land of great drought.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּמַרְעִיתָם֙ וַיִּשְׂבָּ֔עוּ שָׂבְע֖וּ וַיָּ֣רׇם לִבָּ֑ם עַל־כֵּ֖ן שְׁכֵחֽוּנִי׃
verses.translit: khmr'ytm vyshb'v shb'v vyrm lbm 'lkhn shkhchvny
verses.translation: When they were fed, they became full, They were filled, and their heart was exalted; Therefore have they forgotten Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֱהִ֥י לָהֶ֖ם כְּמוֹ־שָׁ֑חַל כְּנָמֵ֖ר עַל־דֶּ֥רֶךְ אָשֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: v'hy lhm khmvshchl khnmr 'ldrkh 'shvr
verses.translation: Therefore am I become unto them as a lion; As a leopard will I watch by the way;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶפְגְּשֵׁם֙ כְּדֹ֣ב שַׁכּ֔וּל וְאֶקְרַ֖ע סְג֣וֹר לִבָּ֑ם וְאֹכְלֵ֥ם שָׁם֙ כְּלָבִ֔יא חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה תְּבַקְּעֵֽם׃
verses.translit: 'pgshm khdb shkhvl v'qr' sgvr lbm v'khlm shm khlby' chyt hshdh tbq'm
verses.translation: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, And will rend the enclosure of their heart; And there will I devour them like a lioness; The wild beast shall tear them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁחֶתְךָ֥ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כִּי־בִ֥י בְעֶזְרֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: shchtkh yshr'l khyby b'zrkh
verses.translation: It is thy destruction, O Israel, That thou art against Me, against thy help.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱהִ֤י מַלְכְּךָ֙ אֵפ֔וֹא וְיוֹשִׁיעֲךָ֖ בְּכׇל־עָרֶ֑יךָ וְשֹׁ֣פְטֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֔רְתָּ תְּנָה־לִּ֖י מֶ֥לֶךְ וְשָׂרִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'hy mlkhkh 'pv' vyvshy'kh bkhl'rykh vshptykh 'shr 'mrt tnhly mlkh vshrym
verses.translation: Ho, now, thy king, That he may save thee in all thy cities! And thy judges, of whom thou saidst: ‘Give me a king and princes! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶֽתֶּן־לְךָ֥ מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ בְּאַפִּ֔י וְאֶקַּ֖ח בְּעֶבְרָתִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'tnlkh mlkh b'py v'qch b'brty {p}
verses.translation: I give thee a king in Mine anger, And take him away in My wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צָרוּר֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אֶפְרָ֔יִם צְפוּנָ֖ה חַטָּאתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: tsrvr 'vn 'prym tspvnh cht'tv
verses.translation: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; His sin is laid up in store.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶבְלֵ֥י יוֹלֵדָ֖ה יָבֹ֣אוּ ל֑וֹ הוּא־בֵן֙ לֹ֣א חָכָ֔ם כִּי־עֵ֥ת לֹֽא־יַעֲמֹ֖ד בְּמִשְׁבַּ֥ר בָּנִֽים׃
verses.translit: chbly yvldh yb'v lv hv'bn l' chkhm khy't l'y'md bmshbr bnym
verses.translation: The throes of a travailing woman shall come upon him; He is an unwise son; For it is time he should not tarry In the place of the breaking forth of children.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִיַּ֤ד שְׁאוֹל֙ אֶפְדֵּ֔ם מִמָּ֖וֶת אֶגְאָלֵ֑ם אֱהִ֨י דְבָרֶ֜יךָ מָ֗וֶת אֱהִ֤י קׇֽטׇבְךָ֙ שְׁא֔וֹל נֹ֖חַם יִסָּתֵ֥ר מֵעֵינָֽי׃
verses.translit: myd sh'vl 'pdm mmvt 'g'lm 'hy dbrykh mvt 'hy qtbkh sh'vl nchm ystr m'yny
verses.translation: Shall I ransom them from the power of the nether-world? Shall I redeem them from death? Ho, thy plagues, O death! Ho, thy destruction, O netherworld! Repentance be hid from Mine eyes!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י ה֔וּא בֵּ֥ין אַחִ֖ים יַפְרִ֑יא יָב֣וֹא קָדִים֩ ר֨וּחַ יְהֹוָ֜ה מִמִּדְבָּ֣ר עֹלֶ֗ה וְיֵב֤וֹשׁ מְקוֹרוֹ֙ וְיֶחֱרַ֣ב מַעְיָנ֔וֹ ה֣וּא יִשְׁסֶ֔ה אוֹצַ֖ר כׇּל־כְּלִ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: khy hv' byn 'chym ypry' ybv' qdym rvch yhvh mmdbr 'lh vybvsh mqvrv vychrb m'ynv hv' yshsh 'vtsr khlkhly chmdh
verses.translation: For though he be fruitful among the reed-plants, An east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD coming up from the wilderness, And his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up; He shall spoil the treasure of all precious vessels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֶּאְשַׁם֙ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן כִּ֥י מָרְתָ֖ה בֵּאלֹהֶ֑יהָ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֔לוּ עֹלְלֵיהֶ֣ם יְרֻטָּ֔שׁוּ וְהָרִיּוֹתָ֖יו יְבֻקָּֽעוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: t'shm shmrvn khy mrth b'lhyh bchrb yplv 'llyhm yrtshv vhryvtyv ybq'v {p}
verses.translation: Samaria shall bear her guilt, For she hath rebelled against her God; They shall fall by the sword; Their infants shall be dashed in pieces, And their women with child shall be ripped up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁ֚וּבָה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ כִּ֥י כָשַׁ֖לְתָּ בַּעֲוֺנֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: shvbh yshr'l 'd yhvh 'lhykh khy khshlt b'vnkh
verses.translation: Return, O Israel, unto the LORD thy God; For thou hast stumbled in thine iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קְח֤וּ עִמָּכֶם֙ דְּבָרִ֔ים וְשׁ֖וּבוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה אִמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו כׇּל־תִּשָּׂ֤א עָוֺן֙ וְקַח־ט֔וֹב וּֽנְשַׁלְּמָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים שְׂפָתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: qchv 'mkhm dbrym vshvbv 'lyhvh 'mrv 'lyv khltsh' 'vn vqchtvb vnshlmh prym shptynv
verses.translation: Take with you words, And return unto the LORD; Say unto Him: ‘Forgive all iniquity, And accept that which is good; So will we render for bullocks the offering of our lips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַשּׁ֣וּר  לֹ֣א יוֹשִׁיעֵ֗נוּ עַל־סוּס֙ לֹ֣א נִרְכָּ֔ב וְלֹא־נֹ֥אמַר ע֛וֹד אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֵ֑ינוּ אֲשֶׁר־בְּךָ֖ יְרֻחַ֥ם יָתֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: 'shvr  l' yvshy'nv 'lsvs l' nrkhb vl'n'mr 'vd 'lhynv lm'shh ydynv 'shrbkh yrchm ytvm
verses.translation: Asshur shall not save us; We will not ride upon horses; Neither will we call any more the work of our hands our gods; For in Thee the fatherless findeth mercy.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶרְפָּא֙ מְשׁ֣וּבָתָ֔ם אֹהֲבֵ֖ם נְדָבָ֑ה כִּ֛י שָׁ֥ב אַפִּ֖י מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'rp' mshvbtm 'hbm ndbh khy shb 'py mmnv
verses.translation: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely; For Mine anger is turned away from him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶהְיֶ֤ה כַטַּל֙ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִפְרַ֖ח כַּשּׁוֹשַׁנָּ֑ה וְיַ֥ךְ שׇׁרָשָׁ֖יו כַּלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'hyh khtl lyshr'l yprch khshvshnh vykh shrshyv khlbnvn
verses.translation: I will be as the dew unto Israel; He shall blossom as the lily, And cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵֽלְכוּ֙ יֹֽנְקוֹתָ֔יו וִיהִ֥י כַזַּ֖יִת הוֹד֑וֹ וְרֵ֥יחַֽ ל֖וֹ כַּלְּבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: ylkhv ynqvtyv vyhy khzyt hvdv vrych lv khlbnvn
verses.translation: His branches shall spread, And his beauty shall be as the olive-tree, And his fragrance as Lebanon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י בְצִלּ֔וֹ יְחַיּ֥וּ דָגָ֖ן וְיִפְרְח֣וּ כַגָּ֑פֶן זִכְר֖וֹ כְּיֵ֥ין לְבָנֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: yshbv yshby btslv ychyv dgn vyprchv khgpn zkhrv khyyn lbnvn
verses.translation: They that dwell under his shadow shall again Make corn to grow, And shall blossom as the vine; The scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶפְרַ֕יִם מַה־לִּ֥י ע֖וֹד לָעֲצַבִּ֑ים אֲנִ֧י עָנִ֣יתִי וַאֲשׁוּרֶ֗נּוּ אֲנִי֙ כִּבְר֣וֹשׁ רַעֲנָ֔ן מִמֶּ֖נִּי פֶּרְיְךָ֥ נִמְצָֽא׃
verses.translit: 'prym mhly 'vd l'tsbym 'ny 'nyty v'shvrnv 'ny khbrvsh r'nn mmny prykh nmts'
verses.translation: Ephraim [shall say]: ‘What have I to do any more with idols?’ As for Me, I respond and look on him; I am like a leafy cypress-tree; From Me is thy fruit found.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י חָכָם֙ וְיָ֣בֵֽן אֵ֔לֶּה נָב֖וֹן וְיֵדָעֵ֑ם כִּֽי־יְשָׁרִ֞ים דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה וְצַדִּקִים֙ יֵ֣לְכוּ בָ֔ם וּפֹשְׁעִ֖ים יִכָּ֥שְׁלוּ בָֽם׃
verses.translit: my chkhm vybn 'lh nbvn vyd'm khyyshrym drkhy yhvh vtsdqym ylkhv bm vpsh'ym ykhshlv bm
verses.translation: Whoso is wise, let him understand these things, Whoso is prudent, let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are right, And the just do walk in them; But transgressors do stumble therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּבַר־יְהֹוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֔ה אֶל־יוֹאֵ֖ל בֶּן־פְּתוּאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: dbryhvh 'shr hyh 'lyv'l bnptv'l
verses.translation: The word of the LORD that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־זֹאת֙ הַזְּקֵנִ֔ים וְהַֽאֲזִ֔ינוּ כֹּ֖ל יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ הֶהָ֤יְתָה זֹּאת֙ בִּֽימֵיכֶ֔ם וְאִ֖ם בִּימֵ֥י אֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: shm'vz't hzqnym vh'zynv khl yvshby h'rts hhyth z't bymykhm v'm bymy 'btykhm
verses.translation: Hear this, ye old men, And give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, Or in the days of your fathers?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָלֶ֖יהָ לִבְנֵיכֶ֣ם סַפֵּ֑רוּ וּבְנֵיכֶם֙ לִבְנֵיהֶ֔ם וּבְנֵיהֶ֖ם לְד֥וֹר אַחֵֽר׃
verses.translit: 'lyh lbnykhm sprv vbnykhm lbnyhm vbnyhm ldvr 'chr
verses.translation: Tell ye your children of it, And let your children tell their children, And their children another generation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֶ֤תֶר הַגָּזָם֙ אָכַ֣ל הָאַרְבֶּ֔ה וְיֶ֥תֶר הָאַרְבֶּ֖ה אָכַ֣ל הַיָּ֑לֶק וְיֶ֣תֶר הַיֶּ֔לֶק אָכַ֖ל הֶחָסִֽיל׃
verses.translit: ytr hgzm 'khl h'rbh vytr h'rbh 'khl hylq vytr hylq 'khl hchsyl
verses.translation: That which the palmer-worm hath left hath the locust eaten; And that which the locust hath left hath the canker-worm eaten; And that which the canker-worm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָקִ֤יצוּ שִׁכּוֹרִים֙ וּבְכ֔וּ וְהֵילִ֖לוּ כׇּל־שֹׁ֣תֵי יָ֑יִן עַל־עָסִ֕יס כִּ֥י נִכְרַ֖ת מִפִּיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hqytsv shkhvrym vbkhv vhyllv khlshty yyn 'l'sys khy nkhrt mpykhm
verses.translation: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep, And wail, all ye drinkers of wine, Because of the sweet wine, For it is cut off from your mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־גוֹי֙ עָלָ֣ה עַל־אַרְצִ֔י עָצ֖וּם וְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר שִׁנָּיו֙ שִׁנֵּ֣י אַרְיֵ֔ה וּֽמְתַלְּע֥וֹת לָבִ֖יא לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khygvy 'lh 'l'rtsy 'tsvm v'yn mspr shnyv shny 'ryh vmtl'vt lby' lv
verses.translation: For a people is come up upon my land, Mighty, and without number; His teeth are the teeth of a lion, And he hath the jaw-teeth of a lioness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂ֤ם גַּפְנִי֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה וּתְאֵנָתִ֖י לִקְצָפָ֑ה חָשֹׂ֤ף חֲשָׂפָהּ֙ וְהִשְׁלִ֔יךְ הִלְבִּ֖ינוּ שָׂרִיגֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: shm gpny lshmh vt'nty lqtsph chshf chshph vhshlykh hlbynv shrygyh
verses.translation: He hath laid my vine waste, And blasted my fig-tree; He hath made it clean bare, and cast it down, The branches thereof are made white.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱלִ֕י כִּבְתוּלָ֥ה חֲגֻרַת־שַׂ֖ק עַל־בַּ֥עַל נְעוּרֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: 'ly khbtvlh chgrtshq 'lb'l n'vryh
verses.translation: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth For the husband of her youth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הׇכְרַ֥ת מִנְחָ֛ה וָנֶ֖סֶךְ מִבֵּ֣ית יְהֹוָ֑ה אָֽבְלוּ֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hkhrt mnchh vnskh mbyt yhvh 'blv hkhhnym mshrty yhvh
verses.translation: The meal-offering and the drink-offering is cut off From the house of the LORD; The priests mourn, Even the LORD’S ministers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֻׁדַּ֣ד שָׂדֶ֔ה אָבְלָ֖ה אֲדָמָ֑ה כִּ֚י שֻׁדַּ֣ד דָּגָ֔ן הוֹבִ֥ישׁ תִּיר֖וֹשׁ אֻמְלַ֥ל יִצְהָֽר׃
verses.translit: shdd shdh 'blh 'dmh khy shdd dgn hvbysh tyrvsh 'mll ytshr
verses.translation: The field is wasted, The land mourneth; For the corn is wasted, The new wine is dried up, The oil languisheth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֹבִ֣ישׁוּ אִכָּרִ֗ים הֵילִ֙ילוּ֙ כֹּֽרְמִ֔ים עַל־חִטָּ֖ה וְעַל־שְׂעֹרָ֑ה כִּ֥י אָבַ֖ד קְצִ֥יר שָׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: hbyshv 'khrym hylylv khrmym 'lchth v'lsh'rh khy 'bd qtsyr shdh
verses.translation: Be ashamed, O ye husbandmen, Wail, O ye vinedressers, For the wheat and for the barley; Because the harvest of the field is perished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַגֶּ֣פֶן הוֹבִ֔ישָׁה וְהַתְּאֵנָ֖ה אֻמְלָ֑לָה רִמּ֞וֹן גַּם־תָּמָ֣ר וְתַפּ֗וּחַ כׇּל־עֲצֵ֤י הַשָּׂדֶה֙ יָבֵ֔שׁוּ כִּי־הֹבִ֥ישׁ שָׂשׂ֖וֹן מִן־בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hgpn hvbyshh vht'nh 'mllh rmvn gmtmr vtpvch khl'tsy hshdh ybshv khyhbysh shshvn mnbny 'dm {s}
verses.translation: The vine is withered, And the fig-tree languisheth; The pomegranate-tree, the palm-tree also, and the apple-tree, Even all the trees of the field, are withered; For joy is withered away from the sons of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חִגְר֨וּ וְסִפְד֜וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים הֵילִ֙ילוּ֙ מְשָׁרְתֵ֣י מִזְבֵּ֔חַ בֹּ֚אוּ לִ֣ינוּ בַשַּׂקִּ֔ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י אֱלֹהָ֑י כִּ֥י נִמְנַ֛ע מִבֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם מִנְחָ֥ה וָנָֽסֶךְ׃
verses.translit: chgrv vspdv hkhhnym hylylv mshrty mzbch b'v lynv bshqym mshrty 'lhy khy nmn' mbyt 'lhykhm mnchh vnskh
verses.translation: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests, Wail, ye ministers of the altar; Come, lie all night in sackcloth, Ye ministers of my God; For the meal-offering and the drink-offering is withholden From the house of your God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַדְּשׁוּ־צוֹם֙ קִרְא֣וּ עֲצָרָ֔ה אִסְפ֣וּ זְקֵנִ֗ים כֹּ֚ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ בֵּ֖ית יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְזַעֲק֖וּ אֶל־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: qdshvtsvm qr'v 'tsrh 'spv zqnym khl yshby h'rts byt yhvh 'lhykhm vz'qv 'lyhvh
verses.translation: Sanctify ye a fast, Call a solemn assembly, Gather the elders And all the inhabitants of the land Unto the house of the LORD your God, And cry unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲהָ֖הּ לַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם יְהֹוָ֔ה וּכְשֹׁ֖ד מִשַּׁדַּ֥י יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: 'hh lyvm khy qrvb yvm yhvh vkhshd mshdy ybv'
verses.translation: Alas for the day! For the day of the LORD is at hand, And as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֛וֹא נֶ֥גֶד עֵינֵ֖ינוּ אֹ֣כֶל נִכְרָ֑ת מִבֵּ֥ית אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ שִׂמְחָ֥ה וָגִֽיל׃
verses.translit: hlv' ngd 'ynynv 'khl nkhrt mbyt 'lhynv shmchh vgyl
verses.translation: Is not the food cut off Before our eyes, Yea, joy and gladness From the house of our God?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָבְשׁ֣וּ פְרֻד֗וֹת תַּ֚חַת מֶגְרְפֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם נָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ אֹֽצָר֔וֹת נֶהֶרְס֖וּ מַמְּגֻר֑וֹת כִּ֥י הֹבִ֖ישׁ דָּגָֽן׃
verses.translit: 'bshv prdvt tcht mgrptyhm nshmv 'tsrvt nhrsv mmgrvt khy hbysh dgn
verses.translation: The grains shrivel under their hoes; The garners are laid desolate, The barns are broken down; For the corn is withered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־נֶּאֶנְחָ֣ה בְהֵמָ֗ה נָבֹ֙כוּ֙ עֶדְרֵ֣י בָקָ֔ר כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין מִרְעֶ֖ה לָהֶ֑ם גַּם־עֶדְרֵ֥י הַצֹּ֖אן נֶאְשָֽׁמוּ׃
verses.translit: mhn'nchh bhmh nbkhv 'dry bqr khy 'yn mr'h lhm gm'dry hts'n n'shmv
verses.translation: How do the beasts groan! The herds of cattle are perplexed, Because they have no pasture; Yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶקְרָ֑א כִּ֣י אֵ֗שׁ אָֽכְלָה֙ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֔ר וְלֶ֣הָבָ֔ה לִהֲטָ֖ה כׇּל־עֲצֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lykh yhvh 'qr' khy 'sh 'khlh n'vt mdbr vlhbh lhth khl'tsy hshdh
verses.translation: Unto Thee, O LORD, do I cry; For the fire hath devoured The pastures of the wilderness, And the flame hath set ablaze All the trees of the field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־בַּהֲמ֥וֹת שָׂדֶ֖ה תַּעֲר֣וֹג אֵלֶ֑יךָ כִּ֤י יָֽבְשׁוּ֙ אֲפִ֣יקֵי מָ֔יִם וְאֵ֕שׁ אָכְלָ֖ה נְא֥וֹת הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: gmbhmvt shdh t'rvg 'lykh khy ybshv 'pyqy mym v'sh 'khlh n'vt hmdbr {s}
verses.translation: Yea, the beasts of the field pant unto Thee; For the water brooks are dried up, And the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּקְע֨וּ שׁוֹפָ֜ר בְּצִיּ֗וֹן וְהָרִ֙יעוּ֙ בְּהַ֣ר קׇדְשִׁ֔י יִרְגְּז֕וּ כֹּ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּי־בָ֥א יוֹם־יְהֹוָ֖ה כִּ֥י קָרֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: tq'v shvpr btsyvn vhry'v bhr qdshy yrgzv khl yshby h'rts khyb' yvmyhvh khy qrvb
verses.translation: Blow ye the horn in Zion, And sound an alarm in My holy mountain; Let all the inhabitants of the land tremble; For the day of the LORD cometh, For it is at hand;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: י֧וֹם חֹ֣שֶׁךְ וַאֲפֵלָ֗ה י֤וֹם עָנָן֙ וַעֲרָפֶ֔ל כְּשַׁ֖חַר פָּרֻ֣שׂ עַל־הֶהָרִ֑ים עַ֚ם רַ֣ב וְעָצ֔וּם כָּמֹ֗הוּ לֹ֤א נִֽהְיָה֙ מִן־הָ֣עוֹלָ֔ם וְאַֽחֲרָיו֙ לֹ֣א יוֹסֵ֔ף עַד־שְׁנֵ֖י דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: yvm chshkh v'plh yvm 'nn v'rpl khshchr prsh 'lhhrym 'm rb v'tsvm khmhv l' nhyh mnh'vlm v'chryv l' yvsf 'dshny dvr vdvr
verses.translation: A day of darkness and gloominess, A day of clouds and thick darkness, As blackness spread upon the mountains; A great people and a mighty, There hath not been ever the like, Neither shall be any more after them, Even to the years of many generations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְפָנָיו֙ אָ֣כְלָה אֵ֔שׁ וְאַחֲרָ֖יו תְּלַהֵ֣ט לֶהָבָ֑ה כְּגַן־עֵ֨דֶן הָאָ֜רֶץ לְפָנָ֗יו וְאַֽחֲרָיו֙ מִדְבַּ֣ר שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְגַם־פְּלֵיטָ֖ה לֹא־הָ֥יְתָה לּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: lpnyv 'khlh 'sh v'chryv tlht lhbh khgn'dn h'rts lpnyv v'chryv mdbr shmmh vgmplyth l'hyth lv
verses.translation: A fire devoureth before them, And behind them a flame blazeth; The land is as the garden of Eden before them, And behind them a desolate wilderness; Yea, and nothing escapeth them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּמַרְאֵ֥ה סוּסִ֖ים מַרְאֵ֑הוּ וּכְפָרָשִׁ֖ים כֵּ֥ן יְרוּצֽוּן׃
verses.translit: khmr'h svsym mr'hv vkhprshym khn yrvtsvn
verses.translation: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; And as horsemen, so do they run.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּק֣וֹל מַרְכָּב֗וֹת עַל־רָאשֵׁ֤י הֶהָרִים֙ יְרַקֵּד֔וּן כְּקוֹל֙ לַ֣הַב אֵ֔שׁ אֹכְלָ֖ה קָ֑שׁ כְּעַ֣ם עָצ֔וּם עֱר֖וּךְ מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: khqvl mrkhbvt 'lr'shy hhrym yrqdvn khqvl lhb 'sh 'khlh qsh kh'm 'tsvm 'rvkh mlchmh
verses.translation: Like the noise of chariots, On the tops of the mountains do they leap, Like the noise of a flame of fire That devoureth the stubble, As a mighty people set in battle array.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִפָּנָ֖יו יָחִ֣ילוּ עַמִּ֑ים כׇּל־פָּנִ֖ים קִבְּצ֥וּ פָארֽוּר׃
verses.translit: mpnyv ychylv 'mym khlpnym qbtsv p'rvr
verses.translation: At their presence the peoples are in anguish; All faces have gathered blackness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כְּגִבּוֹרִ֣ים יְרֻצ֔וּן כְּאַנְשֵׁ֥י מִלְחָמָ֖ה יַעֲל֣וּ חוֹמָ֑ה וְאִ֤ישׁ בִּדְרָכָיו֙ יֵֽלֵכ֔וּן וְלֹ֥א יְעַבְּט֖וּן אֹרְחוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: khgbvrym yrtsvn kh'nshy mlchmh y'lv chvmh v'ysh bdrkhyv ylkhvn vl' y'btvn 'rchvtm
verses.translation: They run like mighty men, They climb the wall like men of war; And they move on every one in his ways, And they entangle not their paths.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֤ישׁ אָחִיו֙ לֹ֣א יִדְחָק֔וּן גֶּ֥בֶר בִּמְסִלָּת֖וֹ יֵלֵכ֑וּן וּבְעַ֥ד הַשֶּׁ֛לַח יִפֹּ֖לוּ לֹ֥א יִבְצָֽעוּ׃
verses.translit: v'ysh 'chyv l' ydchqvn gbr bmsltv ylkhvn vb'd hshlch yplv l' ybts'v
verses.translation: Neither doth one thrust another, They march every one in his highway; And they break through the weapons, And suffer no harm.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּעִ֣יר יָשֹׁ֗קּוּ בַּֽחוֹמָה֙ יְרֻצ֔וּן בַּבָּתִּ֖ים יַעֲל֑וּ בְּעַ֧ד הַחַלּוֹנִ֛ים יָבֹ֖אוּ כַּגַּנָּֽב׃
verses.translit: b'yr yshqv bchvmh yrtsvn bbtym y'lv b'd hchlvnym yb'v khgnb
verses.translation: They leap upon the city, They run upon the wall, They climb up into the houses; They enter in at the windows like a thief.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְפָנָיו֙ רָ֣גְזָה אֶ֔רֶץ רָעֲשׁ֖וּ שָׁמָ֑יִם שֶׁ֤מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֙חַ֙ קָדָ֔רוּ וְכוֹכָבִ֖ים אָסְפ֥וּ נׇגְהָֽם׃
verses.translit: lpnyv rgzh 'rts r'shv shmym shmsh vyrch qdrv vkhvkhbym 'spv nghm
verses.translation: Before them the earth quaketh, The heavens tremble; The sun and the moon are become black, And the stars withdraw their shining.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיהֹוָ֗ה נָתַ֤ן קוֹלוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י חֵיל֔וֹ כִּ֣י רַ֤ב מְאֹד֙ מַחֲנֵ֔הוּ כִּ֥י עָצ֖וּם עֹשֵׂ֣ה דְבָר֑וֹ כִּֽי־גָד֧וֹל יוֹם־יְהֹוָ֛ה וְנוֹרָ֥א מְאֹ֖ד וּמִ֥י יְכִילֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: vyhvh ntn qvlv lpny chylv khy rb m'd mchnhv khy 'tsvm 'shh dbrv khygdvl yvmyhvh vnvr' m'd vmy ykhylnv
verses.translation: And the LORD uttereth His voice before His army; For His camp is very great, For he is mighty that executeth His word; For great is the day of the LORD and very terrible; And who can abide it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־עַתָּה֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה שֻׁ֥בוּ עָדַ֖י בְּכׇל־לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וּבְצ֥וֹם וּבִבְכִ֖י וּבְמִסְפֵּֽד׃
verses.translit: vgm'th n'myhvh shbv 'dy bkhllbbkhm vbtsvm vbbkhy vbmspd
verses.translation: Yet even now, saith the LORD, Turn ye unto Me with all your heart, And with fasting, and with weeping, and with lamentation;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִרְע֤וּ לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְאַל־בִּגְדֵיכֶ֔ם וְשׁ֖וּבוּ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־חַנּ֤וּן וְרַחוּם֙ ה֔וּא אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֙יִם֙ וְרַב־חֶ֔סֶד וְנִחָ֖ם עַל־הָרָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vqr'v lbbkhm v'lbgdykhm vshvbv 'lyhvh 'lhykhm khychnvn vrchvm hv' 'rkh 'pym vrbchsd vnchm 'lhr'h
verses.translation: And rend your heart, and not your garments, And turn unto the LORD your God; For He is gracious and compassionate, long-suffering, and abundant in mercy, And repenteth Him of the evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֥י יוֹדֵ֖עַ יָשׁ֣וּב וְנִחָ֑ם וְהִשְׁאִ֤יר אַחֲרָיו֙ בְּרָכָ֔ה מִנְחָ֣ה וָנֶ֔סֶךְ לַיהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: my yvd' yshvb vnchm vhsh'yr 'chryv brkhh mnchh vnskh lyhvh 'lhykhm {p}
verses.translation: Who knoweth whether He will not turn and repent, And leave a blessing behind Him, Even a meal-offering and a drink-offering Unto the LORD your God?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּקְע֥וּ שׁוֹפָ֖ר בְּצִיּ֑וֹן קַדְּשׁוּ־צ֖וֹם קִרְא֥וּ עֲצָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: tq'v shvpr btsyvn qdshvtsvm qr'v 'tsrh
verses.translation: Blow the horn in Zion, Sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִסְפוּ־עָ֞ם קַדְּשׁ֤וּ קָהָל֙ קִבְצ֣וּ זְקֵנִ֔ים אִסְפוּ֙ עֽוֹלָלִ֔ים וְיֹנְקֵ֖י שָׁדָ֑יִם יֵצֵ֤א חָתָן֙ מֵֽחֶדְר֔וֹ וְכַלָּ֖ה מֵחֻפָּתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'spv'm qdshv qhl qbtsv zqnym 'spv 'vllym vynqy shdym yts' chtn mchdrv vkhlh mchpth
verses.translation: Gather the people, Sanctify the congregation, Assemble the elders, Gather the children, And those that suck the breasts; Let the bridegroom go forth from his chamber, And the bride out of her pavilion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֤ין הָאוּלָם֙ וְלַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ יִבְכּוּ֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְֽיֹאמְר֞וּ ח֧וּסָה יְהֹוָ֣ה עַל־עַמֶּ֗ךָ וְאַל־תִּתֵּ֨ן נַחֲלָתְךָ֤ לְחֶרְפָּה֙ לִמְשׇׁל־בָּ֣ם גּוֹיִ֔ם לָ֚מָּה יֹאמְר֣וּ בָעַמִּ֔ים אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: byn h'vlm vlmzbch ybkhv hkhhnym mshrty yhvh vy'mrv chvsh yhvh 'l'mkh v'lttn nchltkh lchrph lmshlbm gvym lmh y'mrv b'mym 'yh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: Let the priests, the ministers of the LORD, Weep between the porch and the altar, And let them say: ‘Spare thy people, O LORD, And give not Thy heritage to reproach, That the nations should make them a byword: Wherefore should they say among the peoples: Where is their God?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְקַנֵּ֥א יְהֹוָ֖ה לְאַרְצ֑וֹ וַיַּחְמֹ֖ל עַל־עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyqn' yhvh l'rtsv vychml 'l'mv
verses.translation: Then was the LORD jealous for His land, And had pity on His people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן יְהֹוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לְעַמּ֗וֹ הִנְנִ֨י שֹׁלֵ֤חַ לָכֶם֙ אֶת־הַדָּגָן֙ וְהַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְהַיִּצְהָ֔ר וּשְׂבַעְתֶּ֖ם אֹת֑וֹ וְלֹא־אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶתְכֶ֥ם ע֛וֹד חֶרְפָּ֖ה בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'n yhvh vy'mr l'mv hnny shlch lkhm 'thdgn vhtyrvsh vhytshr vshb'tm 'tv vl''tn 'tkhm 'vd chrph bgvym
verses.translation: And the LORD answered and said unto His people: ‘Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, And ye shall be satisfied therewith; And I will no more make you a reproach among the nations;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־הַצְּפוֹנִ֞י אַרְחִ֣יק מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֗ם וְהִדַּחְתִּיו֮ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ צִיָּ֣ה וּשְׁמָמָה֒ אֶת־פָּנָ֗יו אֶל־הַיָּם֙ הַקַּדְמֹנִ֔י וְסֹפ֖וֹ אֶל־הַיָּ֣ם הָאַחֲר֑וֹן וְעָלָ֣ה בׇאְשׁ֗וֹ וְתַ֙עַל֙ צַחֲנָת֔וֹ כִּ֥י הִגְדִּ֖יל לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'thtspvny 'rchyq m'lykhm vhdchtyv 'l'rts tsyh vshmmh 'tpnyv 'lhym hqdmny vspv 'lhym h'chrvn v'lh b'shv vt'l tschntv khy hgdyl l'shvt
verses.translation: But I will remove far off from you the northern one, And will drive him into a land barren and desolate, With his face toward the eastern sea, And his hinder part toward the western sea; that his foulness may come up, and his ill savour may come up, because he hath done great things.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּֽירְאִ֖י אֲדָמָ֑ה גִּ֣ילִי וּשְׂמָ֔חִי כִּֽי־הִגְדִּ֥יל יְהֹוָ֖ה לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'ltyr'y 'dmh gyly vshmchy khyhgdyl yhvh l'shvt
verses.translation: Fear not, O land, be glad and rejoice; for the LORD hath done great things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּֽירְאוּ֙ בַּהֲמ֣וֹת שָׂדַ֔י כִּ֥י דָשְׁא֖וּ נְא֣וֹת מִדְבָּ֑ר כִּי־עֵץ֙ נָשָׂ֣א פִרְי֔וֹ תְּאֵנָ֥ה וָגֶ֖פֶן נָתְנ֥וּ חֵילָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ltyr'v bhmvt shdy khy dsh'v n'vt mdbr khy'ts nsh' pryv t'nh vgpn ntnv chylm
verses.translation: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth its fruit, the fig-tree and the vine do yield their strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י צִיּ֗וֹן גִּ֤ילוּ וְשִׂמְחוּ֙ בַּיהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־נָתַ֥ן לָכֶ֛ם אֶת־הַמּוֹרֶ֖ה לִצְדָקָ֑ה וַיּ֣וֹרֶד לָכֶ֗ם גֶּ֛שֶׁם מוֹרֶ֥ה וּמַלְק֖וֹשׁ בָּרִאשֽׁוֹן׃
verses.translit: vbny tsyvn gylv vshmchv byhvh 'lhykhm khyntn lkhm 'thmvrh ltsdqh vyvrd lkhm gshm mvrh vmlqvsh br'shvn
verses.translation: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the LORD your God; For He giveth you the former rain in just measure, And He causeth to come down for you the rain, the former rain and the latter rain, at the first.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָלְא֥וּ הַגֳּרָנ֖וֹת בָּ֑ר וְהֵשִׁ֥יקוּ הַיְקָבִ֖ים תִּיר֥וֹשׁ וְיִצְהָֽר׃
verses.translit: vml'v hgrnvt br vhshyqv hyqbym tyrvsh vytshr
verses.translation: And the floors shall be full of corn, and the vats shall overflow with wine and oil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּמְתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ אֶת־הַשָּׁנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר֙ אָכַ֣ל הָאַרְבֶּ֔ה הַיֶּ֖לֶק וְהֶחָסִ֣יל וְהַגָּזָ֑ם חֵילִי֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר שִׁלַּ֖חְתִּי בָּכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vshlmty lkhm 'thshnym 'shr 'khl h'rbh hylq vhchsyl vhgzm chyly hgdvl 'shr shlchty bkhm
verses.translation: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the canker-worm, and the caterpiller, and the palmer-worm, My great army which I sent among you. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אָכוֹל֙ וְשָׂב֔וֹעַ וְהִלַּלְתֶּ֗ם אֶת־שֵׁ֤ם יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה עִמָּכֶ֖ם לְהַפְלִ֑יא וְלֹא־יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ עַמִּ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'khltm 'khvl vshbv' vhlltm 'tshm yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr'shh 'mkhm lhply' vl'ybshv 'my l'vlm
verses.translation: And ye shall eat in plenty and be satisfied, and shall praise the name of the LORD your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you; and My people shall never be ashamed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י בְקֶ֤רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אָ֔נִי וַאֲנִ֛י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם וְאֵ֣ין ע֑וֹד וְלֹא־יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ עַמִּ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyd'tm khy bqrb yshr'l 'ny v'ny yhvh 'lhykhm v'yn 'vd vl'ybshv 'my l'vlm {p}
verses.translation: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the LORD your God, and there is none else; and My people shall never be ashamed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן אֶשְׁפּ֤וֹךְ אֶת־רוּחִי֙ עַל־כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֔ר וְנִבְּא֖וּ בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם וּבְנוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם זִקְנֵיכֶם֙ חֲלֹמ֣וֹת יַחֲלֹמ֔וּן בַּח֣וּרֵיכֶ֔ם חֶזְיֹנ֖וֹת יִרְאֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vhyh 'chrykhn 'shpvkh 'trvchy 'lkhlbshr vnb'v bnykhm vbnvtykhm zqnykhm chlmvt ychlmvn bchvrykhm chzynvt yr'v
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass afterward, That I will pour out My spirit upon all flesh; And your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, Your old men shall dream dreams, Your young men shall see visions;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֥ם עַל־הָעֲבָדִ֖ים וְעַל־הַשְּׁפָח֑וֹת בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔מָּה אֶשְׁפּ֖וֹךְ אֶת־רוּחִֽי׃
verses.translit: vgm 'lh'bdym v'lhshpchvt bymym hhmh 'shpvkh 'trvchy
verses.translation: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids In those days will I pour out My spirit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָֽתַתִּי֙ מֽוֹפְתִ֔ים בַּשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ דָּ֣ם וָאֵ֔שׁ וְתִֽימְר֖וֹת עָשָֽׁן׃
verses.translit: vntty mvptym bshmym vb'rts dm v'sh vtymrvt 'shn
verses.translation: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, Blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ יֵהָפֵ֣ךְ לְחֹ֔שֶׁךְ וְהַיָּרֵ֖חַ לְדָ֑ם לִפְנֵ֗י בּ֚וֹא י֣וֹם יְהֹוָ֔ה הַגָּד֖וֹל וְהַנּוֹרָֽא׃
verses.translit: hshmsh yhpkh lchshkh vhyrch ldm lpny bv' yvm yhvh hgdvl vhnvr'
verses.translation: The sun shall be turned into darkness, And the moon into blood, Before the great and terrible day of the LORD come.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כֹּ֧ל אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָ֛א בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה יִמָּלֵ֑ט כִּ֠י בְּהַר־צִיּ֨וֹן וּבִירוּשָׁלַ֜͏ִם תִּהְיֶ֣ה פְלֵיטָ֗ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה וּבַ֨שְּׂרִידִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהֹוָ֖ה קֹרֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vhyh khl 'shryqr' bshm yhvh ymlt khy bhrtsyvn vbyrvshl͏m thyh plyth kh'shr 'mr yhvh vbshrydym 'shr yhvh qr'
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the LORD shall be delivered; For in mount Zion and in Jerusalem there shall be those that escape, As the LORD hath said, And among the remnant those whom the LORD shall call.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֗י הִנֵּ֛ה בַּיָּמִ֥ים הָהֵ֖מָּה וּבָעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא אֲשֶׁ֥ר (אשוב) [אָשִׁ֛יב] אֶת־שְׁב֥וּת יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: khy hnh bymym hhmh vb't hhy' 'shr ('shvb) ['shyb] 'tshbvt yhvdh vyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, When I shall bring back the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקִבַּצְתִּי֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְה֣וֹרַדְתִּ֔ים אֶל־עֵ֖מֶק יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט וְנִשְׁפַּטְתִּ֨י עִמָּ֜ם שָׁ֗ם עַל־עַמִּ֨י וְנַחֲלָתִ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר פִּזְּר֣וּ בַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְאֶת־אַרְצִ֖י חִלֵּֽקוּ׃
verses.translit: vqbtsty 'tkhlhgvym vhvrdtym 'l'mq yhvshpt vnshptty 'mm shm 'l'my vnchlty yshr'l 'shr pzrv bgvym v't'rtsy chlqv
verses.translation: I will gather all nations, And will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; And I will enter into judgment with them there For My people and for My heritage Israel, Whom they have scattered among the nations, And divided My land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶל־עַמִּ֖י יַדּ֣וּ גוֹרָ֑ל וַֽיִּתְּנ֤וּ הַיֶּ֙לֶד֙ בַּזּוֹנָ֔ה וְהַיַּלְדָּ֛ה מָכְר֥וּ בַיַּ֖יִן וַיִּשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.translit: v'l'my ydv gvrl vytnv hyld bzvnh vhyldh mkhrv byyn vyshtv
verses.translation: And they have cast lots for My people; And have given a boy for an harlot, And sold a girl for wine, and have drunk.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠גַ֠ם מָה־אַתֶּ֥ם לִי֙ צֹ֣ר וְצִיד֔וֹן וְכֹ֖ל גְּלִיל֣וֹת פְּלָ֑שֶׁת הַגְּמ֗וּל אַתֶּם֙ מְשַׁלְּמִ֣ים עָלָ֔י וְאִם־גֹּמְלִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ עָלַ֔י קַ֣ל מְהֵרָ֔ה אָשִׁ֥יב גְּמֻֽלְכֶ֖ם בְּרֹאשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vgm mh'tm ly tsr vtsydvn vkhl glylvt plsht hgmvl 'tm mshlmym 'ly v'mgmlym 'tm 'ly ql mhrh 'shyb gmlkhm br'shkhm
verses.translation: And also what are ye to Me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the regions of Philistia? will ye render retribution on My behalf? and if ye render retribution on My behalf, swiftly, speedily will I return your retribution upon your own head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־כַּסְפִּ֥י וּזְהָבִ֖י לְקַחְתֶּ֑ם וּמַֽחֲמַדַּי֙ הַטֹּבִ֔ים הֲבֵאתֶ֖ם לְהֵיכְלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'shrkhspy vzhby lqchtm vmchmdy htbym hb'tm lhykhlykhm
verses.translation: Forasmuch as ye have taken My silver and My gold, and have carried into your temples My goodly treasures;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֤י יְהוּדָה֙ וּבְנֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם מְכַרְתֶּ֖ם לִבְנֵ֣י הַיְּוָנִ֑ים לְמַ֥עַן הַרְחִיקָ֖ם מֵעַ֥ל גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.translit: vbny yhvdh vbny yrvshl͏m mkhrtm lbny hyvnym lm'n hrchyqm m'l gbvlm
verses.translation: the children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the sons of Jevanim, that ye might remove them far from their border;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י מְעִירָ֔ם מִ֨ן־הַמָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר־מְכַרְתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖ם שָׁ֑מָּה וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י גְמֻֽלְכֶ֖ם בְּרֹאשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hnny m'yrm mnhmqvm 'shrmkhrtm 'tm shmh vhshbty gmlkhm br'shkhm
verses.translation: behold, I will stir them up out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your retribution upon your own head;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמָכַרְתִּ֞י אֶת־בְּנֵיכֶ֣ם וְאֶת־בְּנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם בְּיַד֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּמְכָר֥וּם לִשְׁבָאיִ֖ם אֶל־גּ֣וֹי רָח֑וֹק כִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vmkhrty 'tbnykhm v'tbnvtykhm byd bny yhvdh vmkhrvm lshb'ym 'lgvy rchvq khy yhvh dbr {p}
verses.translation: and I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the men of Sheba, to a nation far off; for the LORD hath spoken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קִרְאוּ־זֹאת֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם קַדְּשׁ֖וּ מִלְחָמָ֑ה הָעִ֙ירוּ֙ הַגִּבּוֹרִ֔ים יִגְּשׁ֣וּ יַֽעֲל֔וּ כֹּ֖ל אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: qr'vz't bgvym qdshv mlchmh h'yrv hgbvrym ygshv y'lv khl 'nshy hmlchmh
verses.translation: Proclaim ye this among the nations, Prepare war; Stir up the mighty men; Let all the men of war draw near, Let them come up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤תּוּ אִתֵּיכֶם֙ לַחֲרָב֔וֹת וּמַזְמְרֹֽתֵיכֶ֖ם לִרְמָחִ֑ים הַֽחַלָּ֔שׁ יֹאמַ֖ר גִּבּ֥וֹר אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: khtv 'tykhm lchrbvt vmzmrtykhm lrmchym hchlsh y'mr gbvr 'ny
verses.translation: Beat your plowshares into swords, And your pruning-hooks into spears; Let the weak say: ‘I am strong.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֣וּשׁוּ וָבֹ֧אוּ כׇֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֛ם מִסָּבִ֖יב וְנִקְבָּ֑צוּ שָׁ֕מָּה הַֽנְחַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֖ה גִּבּוֹרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'vshv vb'v khlhgvym msbyb vnqbtsv shmh hncht yhvh gbvrykh
verses.translation: Haste ye, and come, all ye nations round about, And gather yourselves together; Thither cause Thy mighty ones to come down, O LORD!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵע֙וֹרוּ֙ וְיַעֲל֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֶל־עֵ֖מֶק יְהוֹשָׁפָ֑ט כִּ֣י שָׁ֗ם אֵשֵׁ֛ב לִשְׁפֹּ֥ט אֶת־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם מִסָּבִֽיב׃
verses.translit: y'vrv vy'lv hgvym 'l'mq yhvshpt khy shm 'shb lshpt 'tkhlhgvym msbyb
verses.translation: Let the nations be stirred up, and come up To the valley of Jehoshaphat; For there will I sit to judge All the nations round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁלְח֣וּ מַגָּ֔ל כִּ֥י בָשַׁ֖ל קָצִ֑יר בֹּ֤אֽוּ רְדוּ֙ כִּֽי־מָ֣לְאָה גַּ֔ת הֵשִׁ֙יקוּ֙ הַיְקָבִ֔ים כִּ֥י רַבָּ֖ה רָעָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: shlchv mgl khy bshl qtsyr b'v rdv khyml'h gt hshyqv hyqbym khy rbh r'tm
verses.translation: Put ye in the sickle, For the harvest is ripe; Come, tread ye, For the winepress is full, the vats overflow; For their wickedness is great.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲמוֹנִ֣ים הֲמוֹנִ֔ים בְּעֵ֖מֶק הֶחָר֑וּץ כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּעֵ֖מֶק הֶחָרֽוּץ׃
verses.translit: hmvnym hmvnym b'mq hchrvts khy qrvb yvm yhvh b'mq hchrvts
verses.translation: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision! For the day of the LORD is near in the valley of decision.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֖חַ קָדָ֑רוּ וְכוֹכָבִ֖ים אָסְפ֥וּ נׇגְהָֽם׃
verses.translit: shmsh vyrch qdrv vkhvkhbym 'spv nghm
verses.translation: The sun and the moon are become black, And the stars withdraw their shining.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיהֹוָ֞ה מִצִּיּ֣וֹן יִשְׁאָ֗ג וּמִירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֔וֹ וְרָעֲשׁ֖וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם וָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיהֹוָה֙ מַחֲסֶ֣ה לְעַמּ֔וֹ וּמָע֖וֹז לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyhvh mtsyvn ysh'g vmyrvshl͏m ytn qvlv vr'shv shmym v'rts vyhvh mchsh l'mv vm'vz lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD shall roar from Zion, And utter His voice from Jerusalem, And the heavens and the earth shall shake; But the LORD will be a refuge unto His people, And a stronghold to the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּ֣י אֲנִ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם שֹׁכֵ֖ן בְּצִיּ֣וֹן הַר־קׇדְשִׁ֑י וְהָיְתָ֤ה יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ קֹ֔דֶשׁ וְזָרִ֥ים לֹא־יַֽעַבְרוּ־בָ֖הּ עֽוֹד׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyd'tm khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm shkhn btsyvn hrqdshy vhyth yrvshl͏m qdsh vzrym l'y'brvbh 'vd {s}
verses.translation: So shall ye know that I am the LORD your God, Dwelling in Zion My holy mountain; Then shall Jerusalem be holy, And there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יִטְּפ֧וּ הֶהָרִ֣ים עָסִ֗יס וְהַגְּבָעוֹת֙ תֵּלַ֣כְנָה חָלָ֔ב וְכׇל־אֲפִיקֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה יֵ֣לְכוּ מָ֑יִם וּמַעְיָ֗ן מִבֵּ֤ית יְהֹוָה֙ יֵצֵ֔א וְהִשְׁקָ֖ה אֶת־נַ֥חַל הַשִּׁטִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' ytpv hhrym 'sys vhgb'vt tlkhnh chlb vkhl'pyqy yhvdh ylkhv mym vm'yn mbyt yhvh yts' vhshqh 'tnchl hshtym
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That the mountains shall drop down sweet wine, And the hills shall flow with milk, And all the brooks of Judah shall flow with waters; And a fountain shall come forth of the house of the LORD, And shall water the valley of Shittim.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לִשְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה וֶאֱד֕וֹם לְמִדְבַּ֥ר שְׁמָמָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶ֑ה מֵֽחֲמַס֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־שָׁפְכ֥וּ דָם־נָקִ֖יא בְּאַרְצָֽם׃
verses.translit: mtsrym lshmmh thyh v'dvm lmdbr shmmh thyh mchms bny yhvdh 'shrshpkhv dmnqy' b'rtsm
verses.translation: Egypt shall be a desolation, And Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, For the violence against the children of Judah, Because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהוּדָ֖ה לְעוֹלָ֣ם תֵּשֵׁ֑ב וִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם לְד֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vyhvdh l'vlm tshb vyrvshl͏m ldvr vdvr
verses.translation: But Judah shall be inhabited for ever, And Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִקֵּ֖יתִי דָּמָ֣ם לֹֽא־נִקֵּ֑יתִי וַיהֹוָ֖ה שֹׁכֵ֥ן בְּצִיּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: vnqyty dmm l'nqyty vyhvh shkhn btsyvn
verses.translation: And I will hold as innocent their blood that I have not held as innocent; And the LORD dwelleth in Zion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּבְרֵ֣י עָמ֔וֹס אֲשֶׁר־הָיָ֥ה בַנֹּקְדִ֖ים מִתְּק֑וֹעַ אֲשֶׁר֩ חָזָ֨ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בִּימֵ֣י  עֻזִּיָּ֣ה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֗ה וּבִימֵ֞י יָרׇבְעָ֤ם בֶּן־יוֹאָשׁ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁנָתַ֖יִם לִפְנֵ֥י הָרָֽעַשׁ׃
verses.translit: dbry 'mvs 'shrhyh bnqdym mtqv' 'shr chzh 'lyshr'l bymy  'zyh mlkhyhvdh vbymy yrb'm bnyv'sh mlkh yshr'l shntym lpny hr'sh
verses.translation: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֓ר  יְהֹוָה֙ מִצִּיּ֣וֹן יִשְׁאָ֔ג וּמִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם יִתֵּ֣ן קוֹל֑וֹ וְאָֽבְלוּ֙ נְא֣וֹת הָרֹעִ֔ים וְיָבֵ֖שׁ רֹ֥אשׁ הַכַּרְמֶֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr  yhvh mtsyvn ysh'g vmyrvshl͏m ytn qvlv v'blv n'vt hr'ym vybsh r'sh hkhrml {p}
verses.translation: And he said: The LORD roareth from Zion, And uttereth His voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds shall mourn, and the top of Carmel shall wither.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י דַמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־דּוּשָׁ֛ם בַּחֲרֻצ֥וֹת הַבַּרְזֶ֖ל אֶת־הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lshlshh psh'y dmshq v'l'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'ldvshm bchrtsvt hbrzl 'thgl'd
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD: For three transgressions of Damascus, yea, for four, I will not reverse it: because they have threshed Gilead with sledges of iron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּבֵ֣ית חֲזָאֵ֑ל וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת בֶּן־הֲדָֽד׃
verses.translit: vshlchty 'sh bbyt chz'l v'khlh 'rmnvt bnhdd
verses.translation: So will I send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it shall devour the palaces of Ben-hadad;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָֽׁבַרְתִּי֙ בְּרִ֣יחַ דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ מִבִּקְעַת־אָ֔וֶן וְתוֹמֵ֥ךְ שֵׁ֖בֶט מִבֵּ֣ית עֶ֑דֶן וְגָל֧וּ עַם־אֲרָ֛ם קִ֖ירָה אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshbrty brych dmshq vhkhrty yvshb mbq't'vn vtvmkh shbt mbyt 'dn vglv 'm'rm qyrh 'mr yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from Bikath-Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Beth-eden; and the people of Aram shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י עַזָּ֔ה וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־הַגְלוֹתָ֛ם גָּל֥וּת שְׁלֵמָ֖ה לְהַסְגִּ֥יר לֶאֱדֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lshlshh psh'y 'zh v'l'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'lhglvtm glvt shlmh lhsgyr l'dvm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: For three transgressions of Gaza, yea, for four, I will not reverse it: because they carried away captive a whole captivity, to deliver them up to Edom.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּחוֹמַ֣ת עַזָּ֑ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: vshlchty 'sh bchvmt 'zh v'khlh 'rmntyh
verses.translation: So will I send a fire on the wall of Gaza, and it shall devour the palaces thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י יוֹשֵׁב֙ מֵֽאַשְׁדּ֔וֹד וְתוֹמֵ֥ךְ שֵׁ֖בֶט מֵֽאַשְׁקְל֑וֹן וַהֲשִׁיב֨וֹתִי יָדִ֜י עַל־עֶקְר֗וֹן וְאָֽבְדוּ֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhkhrty yvshb m'shdvd vtvmkh shbt m'shqlvn vhshybvty ydy 'l'qrvn v'bdv sh'ryt plshtym 'mr 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon; and I will turn My hand against Ekron, and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵי־צֹ֔ר וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַֽל־הַסְגִּירָ֞ם גָּל֤וּת שְׁלֵמָה֙ לֶאֱד֔וֹם וְלֹ֥א זָכְר֖וּ בְּרִ֥ית אַחִֽים׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lshlshh psh'ytsr v'l'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'lhsgyrm glvt shlmh l'dvm vl' zkhrv bryt 'chym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: For three transgressions of Tyre, yea, for four, I will not reverse it: because they delivered up a whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּח֣וֹמַת צֹ֑ר וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנוֹתֶֽיהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshlchty 'sh bchvmt tsr v'khlh 'rmnvtyh {p}
verses.translation: So will I send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־רׇדְפ֨וֹ בַחֶ֤רֶב אָחִיו֙ וְשִׁחֵ֣ת רַחֲמָ֔יו וַיִּטְרֹ֤ף לָעַד֙ אַפּ֔וֹ וְעֶבְרָת֖וֹ שְׁמָ֥רָהֿ נֶֽצַח׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lshlshh psh'y 'dvm v'l'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'lrdpv bchrb 'chyv vshcht rchmyv vytrf l'd 'pv v'brtv shmrh ntsch
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: For three transgressions of Edom, yea, for four, I will not reverse it: because he did pursue his brother with the sword, and did cast off all pity, and his anger did tear perpetually, and he kept his wrath for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בְּתֵימָ֑ן וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת בׇּצְרָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshlchty 'sh btymn v'khlh 'rmnvt btsrh {p}
verses.translation: So will I send a fire upon Teman, and it shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־עַמּ֔וֹן וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־בִּקְעָם֙ הָר֣וֹת הַגִּלְעָ֔ד לְמַ֖עַן הַרְחִ֥יב אֶת־גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lshlshh psh'y bny'mvn v'l'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'lbq'm hrvt hgl'd lm'n hrchyb 'tgbvlm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, yea, for four, I will not reverse it: because they have ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִצַּ֤תִּי אֵשׁ֙ בְּחוֹמַ֣ת רַבָּ֔ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ בִּתְרוּעָה֙ בְּי֣וֹם מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּסַ֖עַר בְּי֥וֹם סוּפָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhtsty 'sh bchvmt rbh v'khlh 'rmnvtyh btrv'h byvm mlchmh bs'r byvm svph
verses.translation: So will I kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
