verses.original: וְהָלַ֥ךְ מַלְכָּ֖ם בַּגּוֹלָ֑ה ה֧וּא וְשָׂרָ֛יו יַחְדָּ֖ו אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhlkh mlkhm bgvlh hv' vshryv ychdv 'mr yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־שׇׂרְפ֛וֹ עַצְמ֥וֹת מֶלֶךְ־אֱד֖וֹם לַשִּֽׂיד׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lshlshh psh'y mv'b v'l'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'lshrpv 'tsmvt mlkh'dvm lshyd
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: For three transgressions of Moab, Yea, for four, I will not reverse it: Because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־אֵ֣שׁ בְּמוֹאָ֔ב וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֣וֹת הַקְּרִיּ֑וֹת וּמֵ֤ת בְּשָׁאוֹן֙ מוֹאָ֔ב בִּתְרוּעָ֖ה בְּק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃
verses.translit: vshlchty'sh bmv'b v'khlh 'rmnvt hqryvt vmt bsh'vn mv'b btrv'h bqvl shvpr
verses.translation: So will I send a fire upon Moab, And it shall devour the palaces of Kerioth; And Moab shall die with tumult, With shouting, and with the sound of the horn;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י שׁוֹפֵ֖ט מִקִּרְבָּ֑הּ וְכׇל־שָׂרֶ֛יהָ אֶהֱר֥וֹג עִמּ֖וֹ אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhkhrty shvpt mqrbh vkhlshryh 'hrvg 'mv 'mr yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, And will slay all the princes thereof with him, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַֽל־מׇאֳסָ֞ם אֶת־תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֗ה וְחֻקָּיו֙ לֹ֣א שָׁמָ֔רוּ וַיַּתְעוּם֙ כִּזְבֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־הָלְכ֥וּ אֲבוֹתָ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lshlshh psh'y yhvdh v'l'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'lm'sm 'ttvrt yhvh vchqyv l' shmrv vyt'vm khzbyhm 'shrhlkhv 'bvtm 'chryhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: For three transgressions of Judah, Yea, for four, I will not reverse it: Because they have rejected the law of the LORD, And have not kept His statutes, And their lies have caused them to err, After which their fathers did walk.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בִּֽיהוּדָ֑ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshlchty 'sh byhvdh v'khlh 'rmnvt yrvshl͏m {p}
verses.translation: So will I send a fire upon Judah, And it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעַל־אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־מִכְרָ֤ם בַּכֶּ֙סֶף֙ צַדִּ֔יק וְאֶבְי֖וֹן בַּעֲב֥וּר נַעֲלָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lshlshh psh'y yshr'l v'l'rb'h l' 'shybnv 'lmkhrm bkhsf tsdyq v'byvn b'bvr n'lym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: For three transgressions of Israel, Yea, for four, I will not reverse it: Because they sell the righteous for silver, And the needy for a pair of shoes;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשֹּׁאֲפִ֤ים עַל־עֲפַר־אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ דַּלִּ֔ים וְדֶ֥רֶךְ עֲנָוִ֖ים יַטּ֑וּ וְאִ֣ישׁ וְאָבִ֗יו יֵֽלְכוּ֙ אֶל־הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ה לְמַ֥עַן חַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם קׇדְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: hsh'pym 'l'pr'rts br'sh dlym vdrkh 'nvym ytv v'ysh v'byv ylkhv 'lhn'rh lm'n chll 'tshm qdshy
verses.translation: That pant after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, And turn aside the way of the humble; And a man and his father go unto the same maid, To profane My holy name; .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַל־בְּגָדִ֤ים חֲבֻלִים֙ יַטּ֔וּ אֵ֖צֶל כׇּל־מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וְיֵ֤ין עֲנוּשִׁים֙ יִשְׁתּ֔וּ בֵּ֖ית אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'lbgdym chblym ytv 'tsl khlmzbch vyyn 'nvshym yshtv byt 'lhyhm
verses.translation: And they lay themselves down beside every altar Upon clothes taken in pledge, And in the house of their God they drink The wine of them that have been fined.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָ֨נֹכִ֜י הִשְׁמַ֤דְתִּי אֶת־הָאֱמֹרִי֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר כְּגֹ֤בַהּ אֲרָזִים֙ גׇּבְה֔וֹ וְחָסֹ֥ן ה֖וּא כָּאַלּוֹנִ֑ים וָאַשְׁמִ֤יד פִּרְיוֹ֙ מִמַּ֔עַל וְשׇׁרָשָׁ֖יו מִתָּֽחַת׃
verses.translit: v'nkhy hshmdty 'th'mry mpnyhm 'shr khgbh 'rzym gbhv vchsn hv' kh'lvnym v'shmyd pryv mm'l vshrshyv mtcht
verses.translation: Yet destroyed I the Amorite before them, Whose height was like the height of the cedars, And he was strong as the oaks; Yet I destroyed his fruit from above, And his roots from beneath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֛י הֶעֱלֵ֥יתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וָאוֹלֵ֨ךְ אֶתְכֶ֤ם בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה לָרֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת־אֶ֥רֶץ הָאֱמֹרִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'nkhy h'lyty 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym v'vlkh 'tkhm bmdbr 'rb'ym shnh lrsht 't'rts h'mry
verses.translation: Also I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, And led you forty years in the wilderness, To possess the land of the Amorites.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָקִ֤ים מִבְּנֵיכֶם֙ לִנְבִיאִ֔ים וּמִבַּחוּרֵיכֶ֖ם לִנְזִרִ֑ים הַאַ֥ף אֵֽין־זֹ֛את בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'qym mbnykhm lnby'ym vmbchvrykhm lnzrym h'f 'ynz't bny yshr'l n'myhvh
verses.translation: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, And of your young men for Nazirites. Is it not even thus, O ye children of Israel? Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּשְׁק֥וּ אֶת־הַנְּזִרִ֖ים יָ֑יִן וְעַל־הַנְּבִיאִים֙ צִוִּיתֶ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֖א תִּנָּבְאֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vtshqv 'thnzrym yyn v'lhnby'ym tsvytm l'mr l' tnb'v
verses.translation: But ye gave the Nazirites wine to drink; And commanded the prophets, saying: ‘Prophesy not.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י מֵעִ֖יק תַּחְתֵּיכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר תָּעִיק֙ הָֽעֲגָלָ֔ה הַֽמְלֵאָ֥ה לָ֖הּ עָמִֽיר׃
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy m'yq tchtykhm kh'shr t'yq h'glh hml'h lh 'myr
verses.translation: Behold, I will make it creak under you, As a cart creaketh that is full of sheaves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָבַ֤ד מָנוֹס֙ מִקָּ֔ל וְחָזָ֖ק לֹא־יְאַמֵּ֣ץ כֹּח֑וֹ וְגִבּ֖וֹר לֹא־יְמַלֵּ֥ט נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'bd mnvs mql vchzq l'y'mts khchv vgbvr l'ymlt npshv
verses.translation: And flight shall fail the swift, And the strong shall not exert his strength, Neither shall the mighty deliver himself;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתֹפֵ֤שׂ הַקֶּ֙שֶׁת֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔ד וְקַ֥ל בְּרַגְלָ֖יו לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּ֑ט וְרֹכֵ֣ב הַסּ֔וּס לֹ֥א יְמַלֵּ֖ט נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: vtpsh hqsht l' y'md vql brglyv l' ymlt vrkhb hsvs l' ymlt npshv
verses.translation: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; And he that is swift of foot shall not deliver himself; Neither shall he that rideth the horse deliver himself;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַמִּ֥יץ לִבּ֖וֹ בַּגִּבּוֹרִ֑ים עָר֛וֹם יָנ֥וּס בַּיּוֹם־הַה֖וּא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'myts lbv bgbvrym 'rvm ynvs byvmhhv' n'myhvh {p}
verses.translation: And he that is courageous among the mighty Shall flee away naked in that day, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֞וּ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהֹוָ֛ה עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַ֚ל כׇּל־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הֶעֱלֵ֛יתִי מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: shm'v 'thdbr hzh 'shr dbr yhvh 'lykhm bny yshr'l 'l khlhmshpchh 'shr h'lyty m'rts mtsrym l'mr
verses.translation: Hear this word that the LORD hath spoken against you, O children of Israel, against the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֚ק אֶתְכֶ֣ם יָדַ֔עְתִּי מִכֹּ֖ל מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת הָאֲדָמָ֑ה עַל־כֵּן֙ אֶפְקֹ֣ד עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כׇּל־עֲוֺנֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: rq 'tkhm yd'ty mkhl mshpchvt h'dmh 'lkhn 'pqd 'lykhm 't khl'vntykhm
verses.translation: You only have I known of all the families of the earth; Therefore I will visit upon you all your iniquities.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיֵלְכ֥וּ שְׁנַ֖יִם יַחְדָּ֑ו בִּלְתִּ֖י אִם־נוֹעָֽדוּ׃
verses.translit: hylkhv shnym ychdv blty 'mnv'dv
verses.translation: Will two walk together, Except they have agreed?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיִשְׁאַ֤ג אַרְיֵה֙ בַּיַּ֔עַר וְטֶ֖רֶף אֵ֣ין ל֑וֹ הֲיִתֵּ֨ן כְּפִ֤יר קוֹלוֹ֙ מִמְּעֹ֣נָת֔וֹ בִּלְתִּ֖י אִם־לָכָֽד׃
verses.translit: hysh'g 'ryh by'r vtrf 'yn lv hytn khpyr qvlv mm'ntv blty 'mlkhd
verses.translation: Will a lion roar in the forest, When he hath no prey? Will a young lion give forth his voice out of his den, If he have taken nothing?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲתִפֹּ֤ל צִפּוֹר֙ עַל־פַּ֣ח הָאָ֔רֶץ וּמוֹקֵ֖שׁ אֵ֣ין לָ֑הּ הֲיַֽעֲלֶה־פַּח֙ מִן־הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה וְלָכ֖וֹד לֹ֥א יִלְכּֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: htpl tspvr 'lpch h'rts vmvqsh 'yn lh hy'lhpch mnh'dmh vlkhvd l' ylkhvd
verses.translation: Will a bird fall in a snare upon the earth, Where there is no lure for it? Will a snare spring up from the ground, And have taken nothing at all?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יִתָּקַ֤ע שׁוֹפָר֙ בְּעִ֔יר וְעָ֖ם לֹ֣א יֶחֱרָ֑דוּ אִם־תִּֽהְיֶ֤ה רָעָה֙ בְּעִ֔יר וַיהֹוָ֖ה לֹ֥א עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: 'mytq' shvpr b'yr v'm l' ychrdv 'mthyh r'h b'yr vyhvh l' 'shh
verses.translation: Shall the horn be blown in a city, And the people not tremble? Shall evil befall a city, And the LORD hath not done it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֧א יַעֲשֶׂ֛ה אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֖ה דָּבָ֑ר כִּ֚י אִם־גָּלָ֣ה סוֹד֔וֹ אֶל־עֲבָדָ֖יו הַנְּבִיאִֽים׃
verses.translit: khy l' y'shh 'dny yhvh dbr khy 'mglh svdv 'l'bdyv hnby'ym
verses.translation: For the Lord GOD will do nothing, But He revealeth His counsel unto His servants the prophets.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַרְיֵ֥ה שָׁאָ֖ג מִ֣י לֹ֣א יִירָ֑א אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ דִּבֶּ֔ר מִ֖י לֹ֥א יִנָּבֵֽא׃
verses.translit: 'ryh sh'g my l' yyr' 'dny yhvh dbr my l' ynb'
verses.translation: The lion hath roared, Who will not fear? The Lord GOD hath spoken, Who can but prophesy?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְׁמִ֙יעוּ֙ עַל־אַרְמְנ֣וֹת בְּאַשְׁדּ֔וֹד וְעַֽל־אַרְמְנ֖וֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְאִמְר֗וּ הֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ עַל־הָרֵ֣י שֹׁמְר֔וֹן וּרְא֞וּ מְהוּמֹ֤ת רַבּוֹת֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ וַעֲשׁוּקִ֖ים בְּקִרְבָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: hshmy'v 'l'rmnvt b'shdvd v'l'rmnvt b'rts mtsrym v'mrv h'spv 'lhry shmrvn vr'v mhvmt rbvt btvkhh v'shvqym bqrbh
verses.translation: Proclaim it upon the palaces at Ashdod, And upon the palaces in the land of Egypt, And say: ‘Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, And behold the great confusions therein, And the oppressions in the midst thereof.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־יָדְע֥וּ עֲשׂוֹת־נְכֹחָ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה הָא֥וֹצְרִ֛ים חָמָ֥ס וָשֹׁ֖ד בְּאַרְמְנוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vl'yd'v 'shvtnkhchh n'myhvh h'vtsrym chms vshd b'rmnvtyhm {p}
verses.translation: For they know not to do right, saith the LORD, Who store up violence and robbery in their palaces.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה צַ֖ר וּסְבִ֣יב הָאָ֑רֶץ וְהוֹרִ֤יד מִמֵּךְ֙ עֻזֵּ֔ךְ וְנָבֹ֖זּוּ אַרְמְנוֹתָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr 'dny yhvh tsr vsbyb h'rts vhvryd mmkh 'zkh vnbzv 'rmnvtykh
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD: An adversary, even round about the land! And he shall bring down thy strength from thee, And thy palaces shall be spoiled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה֮ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָה֒ כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ יַצִּ֨יל הָרֹעֶ֜ה מִפִּ֧י הָאֲרִ֛י שְׁתֵּ֥י כְרָעַ֖יִם א֣וֹ בְדַל־אֹ֑זֶן כֵּ֣ן יִנָּצְל֞וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן בִּפְאַ֥ת מִטָּ֖ה וּבִדְמֶ֥שֶׁק עָֽרֶשׂ׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh kh'shr ytsyl hr'h mpy h'ry shty khr'ym 'v bdl'zn khn yntslv bny yshr'l hyshbym bshmrvn bp't mth vbdmshq 'rsh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: As the shepherd rescueth out of the mouth of the lion Two legs, or a piece of an ear, So shall the children of Israel that dwell in Samaria Escape with the corner of a couch, and the leg of a bed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֥וּ וְהָעִ֖ידוּ בְּבֵ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב נְאֻם־אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַצְּבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: shm'v vh'ydv bbyt y'qb n'm'dny yhvh 'lhy htsb'vt
verses.translation: Hear ye, and testify against the house of Jacob, Saith the Lord GOD, the God of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֗י בְּי֛וֹם פׇּקְדִ֥י פִשְׁעֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עָלָ֑יו וּפָֽקַדְתִּי֙ עַל־מִזְבְּח֣וֹת בֵּֽית־אֵ֔ל וְנִגְדְּעוּ֙ קַרְנ֣וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְנָפְל֖וּ לָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khy byvm pqdy psh'yyshr'l 'lyv vpqdty 'lmzbchvt byt'l vngd'v qrnvt hmzbch vnplv l'rts
verses.translation: For in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him, I will also punish the altars of Beth-el, And the horns of the altar shall be cut off, And fall to the ground.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִכֵּיתִ֥י בֵית־הַחֹ֖רֶף עַל־בֵּ֣ית הַקָּ֑יִץ וְאָבְד֞וּ בָּתֵּ֣י הַשֵּׁ֗ן וְסָפ֛וּ בָּתִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhkhyty bythchrf 'lbyt hqyts v'bdv bty hshn vspv btym rbym n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: And I will smite the winter-house with the summer-house; And the houses of ivory shall perish, And the great houses shall have an end, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֞וּ הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה פָּר֤וֹת הַבָּשָׁן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּהַ֣ר שֹׁמְר֔וֹן הָעֹשְׁק֣וֹת דַּלִּ֔ים הָרֹצְצ֖וֹת אֶבְיוֹנִ֑ים הָאֹמְרֹ֥ת לַאֲדֹנֵיהֶ֖ם הָבִ֥יאָה וְנִשְׁתֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: shm'v hdbr hzh prvt hbshn 'shr bhr shmrvn h'shqvt dlym hrtstsvt 'byvnym h'mrt l'dnyhm hby'h vnshth
verses.translation: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, That are in the mountain of Samaria, That oppress the poor, that crush the needy, That say unto their lords: ‘Bring, that we may feast.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֨ע אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ בְּקׇדְשׁ֔וֹ כִּ֛י הִנֵּ֥ה יָמִ֖ים בָּאִ֣ים עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְנִשָּׂ֤א אֶתְכֶם֙ בְּצִנּ֔וֹת וְאַחֲרִֽיתְכֶ֖ן בְּסִיר֥וֹת דּוּגָֽה׃
verses.translit: nshb' 'dny yhvh bqdshv khy hnh ymym b'ym 'lykhm vnsh' 'tkhm btsnvt v'chrytkhn bsyrvt dvgh
verses.translation: The Lord GOD hath sworn by His holiness: Lo, surely the days shall come upon you, That ye shall be taken away with hooks, And your residue with fish-hooks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפְרָצִ֥ים תֵּצֶ֖אנָה אִשָּׁ֣ה נֶגְדָּ֑הּ וְהִשְׁלַכְתֶּ֥נָה הַהַרְמ֖וֹנָה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vprtsym tts'nh 'shh ngdh vhshlkhtnh hhrmvnh n'myhvh
verses.translation: And ye shall go out at the breaches, every one straight before her; And ye shall be cast into Harmon, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֹּ֤אוּ בֵֽית־אֵל֙ וּפִשְׁע֔וּ הַגִּלְגָּ֖ל הַרְבּ֣וּ לִפְשֹׁ֑עַ וְהָבִ֤יאוּ לַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ זִבְחֵיכֶ֔ם לִשְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים מַעְשְׂרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: b'v byt'l vpsh'v hglgl hrbv lpsh' vhby'v lbqr zbchykhm lshlsht ymym m'shrtykhm
verses.translation: Come to Beth-el, and transgress, To Gilgal, and multiply transgression; And bring your sacrifices in the morning, And your tithes after three days;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקַטֵּ֤ר מֵֽחָמֵץ֙ תּוֹדָ֔ה וְקִרְא֥וּ נְדָב֖וֹת הַשְׁמִ֑יעוּ כִּ֣י כֵ֤ן אֲהַבְתֶּם֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃
verses.translit: vqtr mchmts tvdh vqr'v ndbvt hshmy'v khy khn 'hbtm bny yshr'l n'm 'dny yhvh
verses.translation: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving of that which is leavened, And proclaim freewill-offerings and publish them; For so ye love to do, O ye children of Israel, Saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־אֲנִי֩ נָתַ֨תִּי לָכֶ֜ם נִקְי֤וֹן שִׁנַּ֙יִם֙ בְּכׇל־עָ֣רֵיכֶ֔ם וְחֹ֣סֶר לֶ֔חֶם בְּכֹ֖ל מְקוֹמֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וְלֹא־שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vgm'ny ntty lkhm nqyvn shnym bkhl'rykhm vchsr lchm bkhl mqvmtykhm vl'shbtm 'dy n'myhvh
verses.translation: And I also have given you Cleanness of teeth in all your cities, And want of bread in all your places; Yet have ye not returned unto Me, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם אָנֹכִי֩ מָנַ֨עְתִּי מִכֶּ֜ם אֶת־הַגֶּ֗שֶׁם בְּע֨וֹד שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה חֳדָשִׁים֙ לַקָּצִ֔יר וְהִמְטַרְתִּי֙ עַל־עִ֣יר אֶחָ֔ת וְעַל־עִ֥יר אַחַ֖ת לֹ֣א אַמְטִ֑יר חֶלְקָ֤ה אַחַת֙ תִּמָּטֵ֔ר וְחֶלְקָ֛ה אֲשֶֽׁר־לֹֽא־תַמְטִ֥יר עָלֶ֖יהָ תִּיבָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vgm 'nkhy mn'ty mkhm 'thgshm b'vd shlshh chdshym lqtsyr vhmtrty 'l'yr 'cht v'l'yr 'cht l' 'mtyr chlqh 'cht tmtr vchlqh 'shrl'tmtyr 'lyh tybsh
verses.translation: And I also have withholden the rain from you, When there were yet three months to the harvest; And I caused it to rain upon one city, And caused it not to rain upon another city; One piece was rained upon, And the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָע֡וּ שְׁתַּ֩יִם֩ שָׁלֹ֨שׁ עָרִ֜ים אֶל־עִ֥יר אַחַ֛ת לִשְׁתּ֥וֹת מַ֖יִם וְלֹ֣א יִשְׂבָּ֑עוּ וְלֹֽא־שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vn'v shtym shlsh 'rym 'l'yr 'cht lshtvt mym vl' yshb'v vl'shbtm 'dy n'myhvh
verses.translation: So two or three cities wandered unto one city To drink water, and were not satisfied; Yet have ye not returned unto Me, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִכֵּ֣יתִי אֶתְכֶם֮ בַּשִּׁדָּפ֣וֹן וּבַיֵּרָקוֹן֒ הַרְבּ֨וֹת גַּנּוֹתֵיכֶ֧ם וְכַרְמֵיכֶ֛ם וּתְאֵנֵיכֶ֥ם וְזֵיתֵיכֶ֖ם יֹאכַ֣ל הַגָּזָ֑ם וְלֹא־שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hkhyty 'tkhm bshdpvn vbyrqvn hrbvt gnvtykhm vkhrmykhm vt'nykhm vzytykhm y'khl hgzm vl'shbtm 'dy n'myhvh {s}
verses.translation: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew; The multitude of your gardens and your vineyards And your fig-trees and your olive-trees Hath the palmer-worm devoured; Yet have ye not returned unto Me, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁלַּ֨חְתִּי בָכֶ֥ם דֶּ֙בֶר֙ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ מִצְרַ֔יִם הָרַ֤גְתִּי בַחֶ֙רֶב֙ בַּח֣וּרֵיכֶ֔ם עִ֖ם שְׁבִ֣י סוּסֵיכֶ֑ם וָאַעֲלֶ֞ה בְּאֹ֤שׁ מַֽחֲנֵיכֶם֙ וּֽבְאַפְּכֶ֔ם וְלֹֽא־שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: shlchty bkhm dbr bdrkh mtsrym hrgty bchrb bchvrykhm 'm shby svsykhm v''lh b'sh mchnykhm vb'pkhm vl'shbtm 'dy n'myhvh
verses.translation: I have sent among you the pestilence in the way of Egypt; Your young men have I slain with the sword, And have carried away your horses; And I have made the stench of your camp to come up even into your nostrils; Yet have ye not returned unto Me, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָפַ֣כְתִּי בָכֶ֗ם כְּמַהְפֵּכַ֤ת אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־סְדֹ֣ם וְאֶת־עֲמֹרָ֔ה וַתִּהְי֕וּ כְּא֖וּד מֻצָּ֣ל מִשְּׂרֵפָ֑ה וְלֹא־שַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עָדַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hpkhty bkhm khmhpkht 'lhym 'tsdm v't'mrh vthyv kh'vd mtsl mshrph vl'shbtm 'dy n'myhvh
verses.translation: I have overthrown some of you, As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, And ye were as a brand plucked out of the burning; Yet have ye not returned unto Me, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֕ן כֹּ֥ה אֶעֱשֶׂה־לְּךָ֖ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עֵ֚קֶב כִּי־זֹ֣את אֶעֱשֶׂה־לָּ֔ךְ הִכּ֥וֹן לִקְרַאת־אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh ''shhlkh yshr'l 'qb khyz't ''shhlkh hkhvn lqr't'lhykh yshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel; Because I will do this unto thee, Prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֡י הִנֵּה֩ יוֹצֵ֨ר הָרִ֜ים וּבֹרֵ֣א ר֗וּחַ וּמַגִּ֤יד לְאָדָם֙ מַה־שֵּׂח֔וֹ עֹשֵׂ֥ה שַׁ֙חַר֙ עֵיפָ֔ה וְדֹרֵ֖ךְ עַל־בָּ֣מֳתֵי אָ֑רֶץ יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy hnh yvtsr hrym vbr' rvch vmgyd l'dm mhshchv 'shh shchr 'yph vdrkh 'lbmty 'rts yhvh 'lhytsb'vt shmv {p}
verses.translation: For, lo, He that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, And declareth unto man what is his thought, That maketh the morning darkness, And treadeth upon the high places of the earth; The LORD, the God of hosts, is His name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֞וּ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֣ר הַזֶּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י נֹשֵׂ֧א עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם קִינָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: shm'v 'thdbr hzh 'shr 'nkhy nsh' 'lykhm qynh byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Hear ye this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָֽפְלָה֙ לֹא־תוֹסִ֣יף ק֔וּם בְּתוּלַ֖ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נִטְּשָׁ֥ה עַל־אַדְמָתָ֖הּ אֵ֥ין מְקִימָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: nplh l'tvsyf qvm btvlt yshr'l ntshh 'l'dmth 'yn mqymh
verses.translation: The virgin of Israel is fallen, She shall no more rise; She is cast down upon her land, There is none to raise her up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה הָעִ֛יר הַיֹּצֵ֥את אֶ֖לֶף תַּשְׁאִ֣יר מֵאָ֑ה וְהַיּוֹצֵ֥את מֵאָ֛ה תַּשְׁאִ֥יר עֲשָׂרָ֖ה לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr 'dny yhvh h'yr hyts't 'lf tsh'yr m'h vhyvts't m'h tsh'yr 'shrh lbyt yshr'l
verses.translation: For thus saith the Lord GOD: The city that went forth a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went forth a hundred shall have ten left, of the house of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהֹוָ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל דִּרְשׁ֖וּנִי וִֽחְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh lbyt yshr'l drshvny vchyv
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel: Seek ye Me, and live;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַֽל־תִּדְרְשׁוּ֙ בֵּֽית־אֵ֔ל וְהַגִּלְגָּל֙ לֹ֣א תָבֹ֔אוּ וּבְאֵ֥ר שֶׁ֖בַע לֹ֣א תַעֲבֹ֑רוּ כִּ֤י הַגִּלְגָּל֙ גָּלֹ֣ה יִגְלֶ֔ה וּבֵֽית־אֵ֖ל יִהְיֶ֥ה לְאָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: v'ltdrshv byt'l vhglgl l' tb'v vb'r shb' l' t'brv khy hglgl glh yglh vbyt'l yhyh l'vn
verses.translation: But seek not Beth-el, Nor enter into Gilgal, And pass not to Beer-sheba; For Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, And Beth-el shall come to nought.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּרְשׁ֥וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה וִֽחְי֑וּ פֶּן־יִצְלַ֤ח כָּאֵשׁ֙ בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֔ף וְאָכְלָ֥ה וְאֵין־מְכַבֶּ֖ה לְבֵֽית־אֵֽל׃
verses.translit: drshv 'tyhvh vchyv pnytslch kh'sh byt yvsf v'khlh v'ynmkhbh lbyt'l
verses.translation: Seek the LORD, and live— Lest He break out like fire in the house of Joseph, And it devour, and there be none to quench it in Bethel—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַהֹפְכִ֥ים לְלַעֲנָ֖ה מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה לָאָ֥רֶץ הִנִּֽיחוּ׃
verses.translit: hhpkhym ll'nh mshpt vtsdqh l'rts hnychv
verses.translation: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, And cast righteousness to the ground;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֨ה כִימָ֜ה וּכְסִ֗יל וְהֹפֵ֤ךְ לַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ צַלְמָ֔וֶת וְי֖וֹם לַ֣יְלָה הֶחְשִׁ֑יךְ הַקּוֹרֵ֣א לְמֵֽי־הַיָּ֗ם וַֽיִּשְׁפְּכֵ֛ם עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ יְהֹוָ֥ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'shh khymh vkhsyl vhpkh lbqr tslmvt vyvm lylh hchshykh hqvr' lmyhym vyshpkhm 'lpny h'rts yhvh shmv
verses.translation: Him that maketh the Pleiades and Orion, And bringeth on the shadow of death in the morning, And darkeneth the day into night; That calleth for the waters of the sea, And poureth them out upon the face of the earth; The LORD is His name;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמַּבְלִ֥יג שֹׁ֖ד עַל־עָ֑ז וְשֹׁ֖ד עַל־מִבְצָ֥ר יָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: hmblyg shd 'l'z vshd 'lmbtsr ybv'
verses.translation: That causeth destruction to flash upon the strong, So that destruction cometh upon the fortress.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂנְא֥וּ בַשַּׁ֖עַר מוֹכִ֑יחַ וְדֹבֵ֥ר תָּמִ֖ים יְתָעֵֽבוּ׃
verses.translit: shn'v bsh'r mvkhych vdbr tmym yt'bv
verses.translation: They hate him that reproveth in the gate, And they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֠כֵ֠ן יַ֣עַן בּוֹשַׁסְכֶ֞ם עַל־דָּ֗ל וּמַשְׂאַת־בַּר֙ תִּקְח֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ בָּתֵּ֥י גָזִ֛ית בְּנִיתֶ֖ם וְלֹא־תֵ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֑ם כַּרְמֵי־חֶ֣מֶד נְטַעְתֶּ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁתּ֖וּ אֶת־יֵינָֽם׃
verses.translit: lkhn y'n bvshskhm 'ldl vmsh'tbr tqchv mmnv bty gzyt bnytm vl'tshbv bm khrmychmd nt'tm vl' tshtv 'tyynm
verses.translation: Therefore, because ye trample upon the poor, And take from him exactions of wheat; Ye have built houses of hewn stone, But ye shall not dwell in them, Ye have planted pleasant vineyards, But ye shall not drink wine thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יָדַ֙עְתִּי֙ רַבִּ֣ים פִּשְׁעֵיכֶ֔ם וַעֲצֻמִ֖ים חַטֹּאתֵיכֶ֑ם צֹרְרֵ֤י צַדִּיק֙ לֹ֣קְחֵי כֹ֔פֶר וְאֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים בַּשַּׁ֥עַר הִטּֽוּ׃
verses.translit: khy yd'ty rbym psh'ykhm v'tsmym cht'tykhm tsrry tsdyq lqchy khpr v'byvnym bsh'r htv
verses.translation: For I know how manifold are your transgressions, And how mighty are your sins; Ye that afflict the just, that take a ransom, And that turn aside the needy in the gate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן הַמַּשְׂכִּ֛יל בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖יא יִדֹּ֑ם כִּ֛י עֵ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִֽיא׃
verses.translit: lkhn hmshkhyl b't hhy' ydm khy 't r'h hy'
verses.translation: Therefore the prudent doth keep silence in such a time; For it is an evil time.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּרְשׁוּ־ט֥וֹב וְאַל־רָ֖ע לְמַ֣עַן תִּֽחְי֑וּ וִיהִי־כֵ֞ן יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־צְבָא֛וֹת אִתְּכֶ֖ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּֽם׃
verses.translit: drshvtvb v'lr' lm'n tchyv vyhykhn yhvh 'lhytsb'vt 'tkhm kh'shr 'mrtm
verses.translation: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live; And so the LORD, the God of hosts, will be with you, as ye say.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂנְאוּ־רָע֙ וְאֶ֣הֱבוּ ט֔וֹב וְהַצִּ֥יגוּ בַשַּׁ֖עַר מִשְׁפָּ֑ט אוּלַ֗י יֶחֱנַ֛ן יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁאֵרִ֥ית יוֹסֵֽף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: shn'vr' v'hbv tvb vhtsygv bsh'r mshpt 'vly ychnn yhvh 'lhytsb'vt sh'ryt yvsf {s}
verses.translation: Hate the evil, and love the good, And establish justice in the gate; It may be that the LORD, the God of hosts, Will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֠כֵ֠ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֨ר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י צְבָאוֹת֙ אֲדֹנָ֔י בְּכׇל־רְחֹב֣וֹת מִסְפֵּ֔ד וּבְכׇל־חוּצ֖וֹת יֹאמְר֣וּ הוֹ־ה֑וֹ וְקָרְא֤וּ אִכָּר֙ אֶל־אֵ֔בֶל וּמִסְפֵּ֖ד אֶל־י֥וֹדְעֵי נֶֽהִי׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr yhvh 'lhy tsb'vt 'dny bkhlrchbvt mspd vbkhlchvtsvt y'mrv hvhv vqr'v 'khr 'l'bl vmspd 'lyvd'y nhy
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD, The God of hosts, the Lord: Lamentation shall be in all the broad places, And they shall say in all the streets: ‘Alas! alas! ’ And they shall call the husbandman to mourning, And proclaim lamentation to such as are skilful of wailing.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְכׇל־כְּרָמִ֖ים מִסְפֵּ֑ד כִּֽי־אֶעֱבֹ֥ר בְּקִרְבְּךָ֖ אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vbkhlkhrmym mspd khy''br bqrbkh 'mr yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And in all vineyards shall be lamentation; For I will pass through the midst of thee, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֥וֹי הַמִּתְאַוִּ֖ים אֶת־י֣וֹם יְהֹוָ֑ה לָמָּה־זֶּ֥ה לָכֶ֛ם י֥וֹם יְהֹוָ֖ה הוּא־חֹ֥שֶׁךְ וְלֹא־אֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: hvy hmt'vym 'tyvm yhvh lmhzh lkhm yvm yhvh hv'chshkh vl''vr
verses.translation: Woe unto you that desire the day of the LORD! Wherefore would ye have the day of the LORD? It is darkness, and not light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יָנ֥וּס אִישׁ֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֲרִ֔י וּפְגָע֖וֹ הַדֹּ֑ב וּבָ֣א הַבַּ֔יִת וְסָמַ֤ךְ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־הַקִּ֔יר וּנְשָׁכ֖וֹ הַנָּחָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: kh'shr ynvs 'ysh mpny h'ry vpg'v hdb vb' hbyt vsmkh ydv 'lhqyr vnshkhv hnchsh
verses.translation: As if a man did flee from a lion, And a bear met him; And went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, And a serpent bit him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹא־חֹ֛שֶׁךְ י֥וֹם יְהֹוָ֖ה וְלֹא־א֑וֹר וְאָפֵ֖ל וְלֹא־נֹ֥גַֽהּ לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hl'chshkh yvm yhvh vl''vr v'pl vl'ngh lv
verses.translation: Shall not the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂנֵ֥אתִי מָאַ֖סְתִּי חַגֵּיכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֥א אָרִ֖יחַ בְּעַצְּרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: shn'ty m'sty chgykhm vl' 'rych b'tsrtykhm
verses.translation: I hate, I despise your feasts, And I will take no delight in your solemn assemblies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־תַּעֲלוּ־לִ֥י עֹל֛וֹת וּמִנְחֹתֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֣א אֶרְצֶ֑ה וְשֶׁ֥לֶם מְרִיאֵיכֶ֖ם לֹ֥א אַבִּֽיט׃
verses.translit: khy 'mt'lvly 'lvt vmnchtykhm l' 'rtsh vshlm mry'ykhm l' 'byt
verses.translation: Yea, though ye offer me burnt-offerings and your meal-offerings, I will not accept them; Neither will I regard the peace-offerings of your fat beasts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָסֵ֥ר מֵעָלַ֖י הֲמ֣וֹן שִׁרֶ֑יךָ וְזִמְרַ֥ת נְבָלֶ֖יךָ לֹ֥א אֶשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.translit: hsr m'ly hmvn shrykh vzmrt nblykh l' 'shm'
verses.translation: Take thou away from Me the noise of thy songs; And let Me not hear the melody of thy psalteries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִגַּ֥ל כַּמַּ֖יִם מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה כְּנַ֥חַל אֵיתָֽן׃
verses.translit: vygl khmym mshpt vtsdqh khnchl 'ytn
verses.translation: But let justice well up as waters, And righteousness as a mighty stream.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַזְּבָחִ֨ים וּמִנְחָ֜ה הִֽגַּשְׁתֶּם־לִ֧י בַמִּדְבָּ֛ר אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: hzbchym vmnchh hgshtmly bmdbr 'rb'ym shnh byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Did ye bring unto Me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְשָׂאתֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת סִכּ֣וּת מַלְכְּכֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת כִּיּ֣וּן צַלְמֵיכֶ֑ם כּוֹכַב֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם לָכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vnsh'tm 't skhvt mlkhkhm v't khyvn tslmykhm khvkhb 'lhykhm 'shr 'shytm lkhm
verses.translation: So shall ye take up Siccuth your king and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye made to yourselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִגְלֵיתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵהָ֣לְאָה לְדַמָּ֑שֶׂק אָמַ֛ר יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhglyty 'tkhm mhl'h ldmshq 'mr yhvh 'lhytsb'vt shmv {p}
verses.translation: Therefore will I cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith He, whose name is the LORD God of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֚וֹי הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּ֣ים בְּצִיּ֔וֹן וְהַבֹּטְחִ֖ים בְּהַ֣ר שֹׁמְר֑וֹן נְקֻבֵי֙ רֵאשִׁ֣ית הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וּבָ֥אוּ לָהֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: hvy hsh'nnym btsyvn vhbtchym bhr shmrvn nqby r'shyt hgvym vb'v lhm byt yshr'l
verses.translation: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion, And to them that are secure in the mountain of Samaria, The notable men of the first of the nations, To whom the house of Israel come!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִבְר֤וּ כַֽלְנֵה֙ וּרְא֔וּ וּלְכ֥וּ מִשָּׁ֖ם חֲמַ֣ת רַבָּ֑ה וּרְד֣וּ גַת־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֗ים הֲטוֹבִים֙ מִן־הַמַּמְלָכ֣וֹת הָאֵ֔לֶּה אִם־רַ֥ב גְּבוּלָ֖ם מִגְּבֻלְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'brv khlnh vr'v vlkhv mshm chmt rbh vrdv gtplshtym htvbym mnhmmlkhvt h'lh 'mrb gbvlm mgblkhm
verses.translation: Pass ye unto Calneh, and see, And from thence go ye to Hamath the great; Then go down to Gath of the Philistines; Are they better than these kingdoms? Or is their border greater than your border? .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽמְנַדִּ֖ים לְי֣וֹם רָ֑ע וַתַּגִּשׁ֖וּן שֶׁ֥בֶת חָמָֽס׃
verses.translit: hmndym lyvm r' vtgshvn shbt chms
verses.translation: Ye that put far away the evil day, And cause the seat of violence to come near;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשֹּֽׁכְבִים֙ עַל־מִטּ֣וֹת שֵׁ֔ן וּסְרֻחִ֖ים עַל־עַרְשׂוֹתָ֑ם וְאֹכְלִ֤ים כָּרִים֙ מִצֹּ֔אן וַעֲגָלִ֖ים מִתּ֥וֹךְ מַרְבֵּֽק׃
verses.translit: hshkhbym 'lmtvt shn vsrchym 'l'rshvtm v'khlym khrym mts'n v'glym mtvkh mrbq
verses.translation: That lie upon beds of ivory, And stretch themselves upon their couches, And eat the lambs out of the flock, And the calves out of the midst of the stall;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַפֹּרְטִ֖ים עַל־פִּ֣י הַנָּ֑בֶל כְּדָוִ֕יד חָשְׁב֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם כְּלֵי־שִֽׁיר׃
verses.translit: hprtym 'lpy hnbl khdvyd chshbv lhm khlyshyr
verses.translation: That thrum on the psaltery, That devise for themselves instruments of music, like David;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשֹּׁתִ֤ים בְּמִזְרְקֵי֙ יַ֔יִן וְרֵאשִׁ֥ית שְׁמָנִ֖ים יִמְשָׁ֑חוּ וְלֹ֥א נֶחְל֖וּ עַל־שֵׁ֥בֶר יוֹסֵֽף׃
verses.translit: hshtym bmzrqy yyn vr'shyt shmnym ymshchv vl' nchlv 'lshbr yvsf
verses.translation: That drink wine in bowls, And anoint themselves with the chief ointments; But they are not grieved for the hurt of Joseph.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן עַתָּ֥ה יִגְל֖וּ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ גֹּלִ֑ים וְסָ֖ר מִרְזַ֥ח סְרוּחִֽים׃
verses.translit: lkhn 'th yglv br'sh glym vsr mrzch srvchym
verses.translation: Therefore now shall they go captive at the head of them that go captive, And the revelry of them that stretched themselves shall pass away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּע֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י יֱהֹוִ֜ה בְּנַפְשׁ֗וֹ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֔וֹת מְתָאֵ֤ב אָנֹכִי֙ אֶת־גְּא֣וֹן יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְאַרְמְנֹתָ֖יו שָׂנֵ֑אתִי וְהִסְגַּרְתִּ֖י עִ֥יר וּמְלֹאָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: nshb' 'dny yhvh bnpshv n'myhvh 'lhy tsb'vt mt'b 'nkhy 'tg'vn y'qb v'rmntyv shn'ty vhsgrty 'yr vml'h
verses.translation: The Lord GOD hath sworn by Himself, Saith the LORD, the God of hosts: I abhor the pride of Jacob, And hate his palaces; And I will deliver up the city with all that is therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־יִוָּ֨תְר֜וּ עֲשָׂרָ֧ה אֲנָשִׁ֛ים בְּבַ֥יִת אֶחָ֖ד וָמֵֽתוּ׃
verses.translit: vhyh 'myvtrv 'shrh 'nshym bbyt 'chd vmtv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְשָׂא֞וֹ דּוֹד֣וֹ וּמְסָֽרְפ֗וֹ לְהוֹצִ֣יא עֲצָמִים֮ מִן־הַבַּיִת֒ וְאָמַ֞ר לַאֲשֶׁ֨ר בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַבַּ֛יִת הַע֥וֹד עִמָּ֖ךְ וְאָמַ֣ר אָ֑פֶס וְאָמַ֣ר הָ֔ס כִּ֛י לֹ֥א לְהַזְכִּ֖יר בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vnsh'v dvdv vmsrpv lhvtsy' 'tsmym mnhbyt v'mr l'shr byrkhty hbyt h'vd 'mkh v'mr 'ps v'mr hs khy l' lhzkhyr bshm yhvh {s}
verses.translation: And when a man’s uncle shall take him up, even he that burneth him, to bring out the bones out of the house, and shall say unto him that is in the innermost parts of the house: ‘Is there yet any with thee?’ and he shall say: ‘No’; then shall he say: ‘Hold thy peace; for we must not make mention of the name of the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ מְצַוֶּ֔ה וְהִכָּ֛ה הַבַּ֥יִת הַגָּד֖וֹל רְסִיסִ֑ים וְהַבַּ֥יִת הַקָּטֹ֖ן בְּקִעִֽים׃
verses.translit: khyhnh yhvh mtsvh vhkhh hbyt hgdvl rsysym vhbyt hqtn bq'ym
verses.translation: For, behold, the LORD commandeth, And the great house shall be smitten into splinters, And the little house into chips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַיְרֻצ֤וּן בַּסֶּ֙לַע֙ סוּסִ֔ים אִֽם־יַחֲר֖וֹשׁ בַּבְּקָרִ֑ים כִּֽי־הֲפַכְתֶּ֤ם לְרֹאשׁ֙ מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וּפְרִ֥י צְדָקָ֖ה לְלַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.translit: hyrtsvn bsl' svsym 'mychrvsh bbqrym khyhpkhtm lr'sh mshpt vpry tsdqh ll'nh
verses.translation: Do horses run upon the rocks? Doth one plow there with oxen? That ye have turned justice into gall, And the fruit of righteousness into wormwood;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשְּׂמֵחִ֖ים לְלֹ֣א דָבָ֑ר הָאֹ֣מְרִ֔ים הֲל֣וֹא בְחׇזְקֵ֔נוּ לָקַ֥חְנוּ לָ֖נוּ קַרְנָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: hshmchym ll' dbr h'mrym hlv' bchzqnv lqchnv lnv qrnym
verses.translation: Ye that rejoice in a thing of nought, That say: ‘Have we not taken to us horns by our own strength?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֡י הִנְנִי֩ מֵקִ֨ים עֲלֵיכֶ֜ם בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַצְּבָא֖וֹת גּ֑וֹי וְלָחֲצ֥וּ אֶתְכֶ֛ם מִלְּב֥וֹא חֲמָ֖ת עַד־נַ֥חַל הָעֲרָבָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy hnny mqym 'lykhm byt yshr'l n'myhvh 'lhy htsb'vt gvy vlchtsv 'tkhm mlbv' chmt 'dnchl h'rbh {p}
verses.translation: For, behold, I will raise up against you a nation, O house of Israel, saith the LORD, the God of hosts; and they shall afflict you from the entrance of Hamath unto the Brook of the Arabah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה הִרְאַ֙נִי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה וְהִנֵּה֙ יוֹצֵ֣ר גֹּבַ֔י בִּתְחִלַּ֖ת עֲל֣וֹת הַלָּ֑קֶשׁ וְהִ֨נֵּה־לֶ֔קֶשׁ אַחַ֖ר גִּזֵּ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: khh hr'ny 'dny yhvh vhnh yvtsr gby btchlt 'lvt hlqsh vhnhlqsh 'chr gzy hmlkh
verses.translation: Thus the Lord GOD showed me; and, behold, He formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth; and, lo, it was the latter growth after the king’s mowings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אִם־כִּלָּה֙ לֶֽאֱכוֹל֙ אֶת־עֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָ֔רֶץ וָֽאֹמַ֗ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ סְֽלַֽח־נָ֔א מִ֥י יָק֖וּם יַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י קָטֹ֖ן הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vhyh 'mkhlh l'khvl 't'shb h'rts v'mr 'dny yhvh slchn' my yqvm y'qb khy qtn hv'
verses.translation: And if it had come to pass, that when they had made an end of eating the grass of the land—so I said: O Lord GOD, forgive, I beseech Thee; How shall Jacob stand? for he is small.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִחַ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה עַל־זֹ֑את לֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶ֖ה אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: nchm yhvh 'lz't l' thyh 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: The LORD repented concerning this; ‘It shall not be’, saith the LORD. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה הִרְאַ֙נִי֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֥ה קֹרֵ֛א לָרִ֥ב בָּאֵ֖שׁ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה וַתֹּ֙אכַל֙ אֶת־תְּה֣וֹם רַבָּ֔ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אֶת־הַחֵֽלֶק׃
verses.translit: khh hr'ny 'dny yhvh vhnh qr' lrb b'sh 'dny yhvh vt'khl 'tthvm rbh v'khlh 'thchlq
verses.translation: Thus the Lord GOD showed me; and, behold, the Lord GOD called to contend by fire; and it devoured the great deep, and would have eaten up the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ חֲדַל־נָ֔א מִ֥י יָק֖וּם יַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י קָטֹ֖ן הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'dny yhvh chdln' my yqvm y'qb khy qtn hv'
verses.translation: Then said I: O Lord GOD, cease, I beseech Thee; How shall Jacob stand? for he is small.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִחַ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה עַל־זֹ֑את גַּם־הִיא֙ לֹ֣א תִֽהְיֶ֔ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֥י יֱהֹוִֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: nchm yhvh 'lz't gmhy' l' thyh 'mr 'dny yhvh {p}
verses.translation: The LORD repented concerning this; ‘This also shall not be’, saith the Lord GOD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה הִרְאַ֔נִי וְהִנֵּ֧ה אֲדֹנָ֛י נִצָּ֖ב עַל־חוֹמַ֣ת אֲנָ֑ךְ וּבְיָד֖וֹ אֲנָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khh hr'ny vhnh 'dny ntsb 'lchvmt 'nkh vbydv 'nkh
verses.translation: Thus He showed me; and, behold, the Lord stood beside a wall made by a plumbline, with a plumbline in His hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י מָֽה־אַתָּ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ עָמ֔וֹס וָאֹמַ֖ר אֲנָ֑ךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲדֹנָ֗י הִנְנִ֨י שָׂ֤ם אֲנָךְ֙ בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹא־אוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד עֲב֥וֹר לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly mh'th r'h 'mvs v'mr 'nkh vy'mr 'dny hnny shm 'nkh bqrb 'my yshr'l l''vsyf 'vd 'bvr lv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me: ‘Amos, what seest thou?’ And I said: ‘A plumbline.’ Then said the Lord: Behold, I will set a plumbline in the midst of My people Israel; I will not again pardon them any more;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ בָּמ֣וֹת יִשְׂחָ֔ק וּמִקְדְּשֵׁ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יֶחֱרָ֑בוּ וְקַמְתִּ֛י עַל־בֵּ֥ית יָרׇבְעָ֖ם בֶּחָֽרֶב׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vnshmv bmvt yshchq vmqdshy yshr'l ychrbv vqmty 'lbyt yrb'm bchrb {s}
verses.translation: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolate, And the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; And I will rise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח אֲמַצְיָה֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן בֵּֽית־אֵ֔ל אֶל־יָרׇבְעָ֥ם מֶלֶךְ־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר קָשַׁ֨ר עָלֶ֜יךָ עָמ֗וֹס בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹא־תוּכַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ לְהָכִ֖יל אֶת־כׇּל־דְּבָרָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyshlch 'mtsyh khhn byt'l 'lyrb'm mlkhyshr'l l'mr qshr 'lykh 'mvs bqrb byt yshr'l l'tvkhl h'rts lhkhyl 'tkhldbryv
verses.translation: Then Amaziah the priest of Beth-el sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying: ‘Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel; the land is not able to bear all his words.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־כֹה֙ אָמַ֣ר עָמ֔וֹס בַּחֶ֖רֶב יָמ֣וּת יָרׇבְעָ֑ם וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל גָּלֹ֥ה יִגְלֶ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khykhh 'mr 'mvs bchrb ymvt yrb'm vyshr'l glh yglh m'l 'dmtv {s}
verses.translation: For thus Amos saith: Jeroboam shall die by the sword, And Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֲמַצְיָה֙ אֶל־עָמ֔וֹס חֹזֶ֕ה לֵ֥ךְ בְּרַח־לְךָ֖ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֑ה וֶאֱכׇל־שָׁ֣ם לֶ֔חֶם וְשָׁ֖ם תִּנָּבֵֽא׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'mtsyh 'l'mvs chzh lkh brchlkh 'l'rts yhvdh v'khlshm lchm vshm tnb'
verses.translation: Also Amaziah said unto Amos: ‘O thou seer, go, flee thee away into the land of Judah, and there eat bread, and prophesy there;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֵֽית־אֵ֔ל לֹא־תוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד לְהִנָּבֵ֑א כִּ֤י מִקְדַּשׁ־מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ ה֔וּא וּבֵ֥ית מַמְלָכָ֖ה הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vbyt'l l'tvsyf 'vd lhnb' khy mqdshmlkh hv' vbyt mmlkhh hv'
verses.translation: but prophesy not again any more at Beth-el, for it is the king’s sanctuary, and it is a royal house.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַן עָמוֹס֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֶל־אֲמַצְיָ֔ה לֹא־נָבִ֣יא אָנֹ֔כִי וְלֹ֥א בֶן־נָבִ֖יא אָנֹ֑כִי כִּי־בוֹקֵ֥ר אָנֹ֖כִי וּבוֹלֵ֥ס שִׁקְמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'n 'mvs vy'mr 'l'mtsyh l'nby' 'nkhy vl' bnnby' 'nkhy khybvqr 'nkhy vbvls shqmym
verses.translation: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah: ‘I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet’s son; but I was a herdman, and a dresser of sycamore-trees;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקָּחֵ֣נִי יְהֹוָ֔ה מֵאַחֲרֵ֖י הַצֹּ֑אן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה לֵ֥ךְ הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: vyqchny yhvh m'chry hts'n vy'mr 'ly yhvh lkh hnb' 'l'my yshr'l
verses.translation: and the LORD took me from following the flock, and the LORD said unto me: Go, prophesy unto My people Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה שְׁמַ֣ע דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֑ה אַתָּ֣ה אֹמֵ֗ר לֹ֤א תִנָּבֵא֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹ֥א תַטִּ֖יף עַל־בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂחָֽק׃
verses.translit: v'th shm' dbryhvh 'th 'mr l' tnb' 'lyshr'l vl' ttyf 'lbyt yshchq
verses.translation: Now therefore hear thou the word of the LORD: Thou sayest: Prophesy not against Israel, And preach not against the house of Isaac;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּה־אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה אִשְׁתְּךָ֞ בָּעִ֤יר תִּזְנֶה֙ וּבָנֶ֤יךָ וּבְנֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ בַּחֶ֣רֶב יִפֹּ֔לוּ וְאַדְמָתְךָ֖ בַּחֶ֣בֶל תְּחֻלָּ֑ק וְאַתָּ֗ה עַל־אֲדָמָ֤ה טְמֵאָה֙ תָּמ֔וּת וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל גָּלֹ֥ה יִגְלֶ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr yhvh 'shtkh b'yr tznh vbnykh vbntykh bchrb yplv v'dmtkh bchbl tchlq v'th 'l'dmh tm'h tmvt vyshr'l glh yglh m'l 'dmtv {p}
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD: Thy wife shall be a harlot in the city, And thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, And thy land shall be divided by line; And thou thyself shalt die in an unclean land, And Israel shall surely be led away captive out of his land.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה הִרְאַ֖נִי אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֖ה כְּל֥וּב קָֽיִץ׃
verses.translit: khh hr'ny 'dny yhvh vhnh khlvb qyts
verses.translation: Thus the Lord GOD showed me; and behold a basket of summer fruit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר מָֽה־אַתָּ֤ה רֹאֶה֙ עָמ֔וֹס וָאֹמַ֖ר כְּל֣וּב קָ֑יִץ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י בָּ֤א הַקֵּץ֙ אֶל־עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹא־אוֹסִ֥יף ע֖וֹד עֲב֥וֹר לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr mh'th r'h 'mvs v'mr khlvb qyts vy'mr yhvh 'ly b' hqts 'l'my yshr'l l''vsyf 'vd 'bvr lv
verses.translation: And He said: ‘Amos, what seest thou?’ And I said: ‘A basket of summer fruit.’ Then said the LORD unto me: I will not again pardon them any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵילִ֜ילוּ שִׁיר֤וֹת הֵיכָל֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה רַ֣ב הַפֶּ֔גֶר בְּכׇל־מָק֖וֹם הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ הָֽס׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhylylv shyrvt hykhl byvm hhv' n'm 'dny yhvh rb hpgr bkhlmqvm hshlykh hs {p}
verses.translation: And the songs of the palace shall be wailings in that day, Saith the Lord GOD; The dead bodies shall be many; In every place silence shall be cast.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־זֹ֕את הַשֹּׁאֲפִ֖ים אֶבְי֑וֹן וְלַשְׁבִּ֖ית (ענוי) [עֲנִיֵּי־]אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: shm'vz't hsh'pym 'byvn vlshbyt ('nvy) ['nyy]'rts
verses.translation: Hear this, O ye that would swallow the needy, And destroy the poor of the land,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֗ר מָתַ֞י יַעֲבֹ֤ר הַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ וְנַשְׁבִּ֣ירָה שֶּׁ֔בֶר וְהַשַּׁבָּ֖ת וְנִפְתְּחָה־בָּ֑ר לְהַקְטִ֤ין אֵיפָה֙ וּלְהַגְדִּ֣יל שֶׁ֔קֶל וּלְעַוֵּ֖ת מֹאזְנֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: l'mr mty y'br hchdsh vnshbyrh shbr vhshbt vnptchhbr lhqtyn 'yph vlhgdyl shql vl'vt m'zny mrmh
verses.translation: Saying: ‘When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? And the sabbath, that we may set forth corn? Making the ephah small, and the shekel great, And falsifying the balances of deceit;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִקְנ֤וֹת בַּכֶּ֙סֶף֙ דַּלִּ֔ים וְאֶבְי֖וֹן בַּעֲב֣וּר נַעֲלָ֑יִם וּמַפַּ֥ל בַּ֖ר נַשְׁבִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: lqnvt bkhsf dlym v'byvn b'bvr n'lym vmpl br nshbyr
verses.translation: That we may buy the poor for silver, And the needy for a pair of shoes, And sell the refuse of the corn?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהֹוָ֖ה בִּגְא֣וֹן יַעֲקֹ֑ב אִם־אֶשְׁכַּ֥ח לָנֶ֖צַח כׇּל־מַעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: nshb' yhvh bg'vn y'qb 'm'shkhch lntsch khlm'shyhm
verses.translation: The LORD hath sworn by the pride of Jacob: Surely I will never forget any of their works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֤עַל זֹאת֙ לֹא־תִרְגַּ֣ז הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאָבַ֖ל כׇּל־יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ֑הּ וְעָלְתָ֤ה כָאֹר֙ כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְנִגְרְשָׁ֥ה (ונשקה) [וְנִשְׁקְעָ֖ה] כִּיא֥וֹר מִצְרָֽיִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: h'l z't l'trgz h'rts v'bl khlyvshb bh v'lth kh'r khlh vngrshh (vnshqh) [vnshq'h] khy'vr mtsrym {p}
verses.translation: Shall not the land tremble for this, And every one mourn that dwelleth therein? Yea, it shall rise up wholly like the River; And it shall be troubled and sink again, like the River of Egypt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י הַשֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ בַּֽצׇּהֳרָ֑יִם וְהַחֲשַׁכְתִּ֥י לָאָ֖רֶץ בְּי֥וֹם אֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vhyh  byvm hhv' n'm 'dny yhvh vhb'ty hshmsh btshrym vhchshkhty l'rts byvm 'vr
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, Saith the Lord GOD, That I will cause the sun to go down at noon, And I will darken the earth in the clear day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָפַכְתִּ֨י חַגֵּיכֶ֜ם לְאֵ֗בֶל וְכׇל־שִֽׁירֵיכֶם֙ לְקִינָ֔ה וְהַעֲלֵיתִ֤י עַל־כׇּל־מׇתְנַ֙יִם֙ שָׂ֔ק וְעַל־כׇּל־רֹ֖אשׁ קׇרְחָ֑ה וְשַׂמְתִּ֙יהָ֙ כְּאֵ֣בֶל יָחִ֔יד וְאַחֲרִיתָ֖הּ כְּי֥וֹם מָֽר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhpkhty chgykhm l'bl vkhlshyrykhm lqynh vh'lyty 'lkhlmtnym shq v'lkhlr'sh qrchh vshmtyh kh'bl ychyd v'chryth khyvm mr {p}
verses.translation: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, And all your songs into lamentation; And I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, And baldness upon every head; And I will make it as the mourning for an only son, And the end thereof as a bitter day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה  יָמִ֣ים בָּאִ֗ים נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֔ה וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּ֥י רָעָ֖ב בָּאָ֑רֶץ לֹא־רָעָ֤ב לַלֶּ֙חֶם֙ וְלֹא־צָמָ֣א לַמַּ֔יִם כִּ֣י אִם־לִשְׁמֹ֔עַ אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hnh  ymym b'ym n'm 'dny yhvh vhshlchty r'b b'rts l'r'b llchm vl'tsm' lmym khy 'mlshm' 't dbry yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the Lord GOD, That I will send a famine in the land, Not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, But of hearing the words of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָעוּ֙ מִיָּ֣ם עַד־יָ֔ם וּמִצָּפ֖וֹן וְעַד־מִזְרָ֑ח יְשׁ֥וֹטְט֛וּ לְבַקֵּ֥שׁ אֶת־דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יִמְצָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: vn'v mym 'dym vmtspvn v'dmzrch yshvttv lbqsh 'tdbryhvh vl' ymts'v
verses.translation: And they shall wander from sea to sea, And from the north even to the east; They shall run to and fro to seek the word of the LORD, And shall not find it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא תִּ֠תְעַלַּ֠פְנָה הַבְּתוּלֹ֧ת הַיָּפ֛וֹת וְהַבַּחוּרִ֖ים בַּצָּמָֽא׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' tt'lpnh hbtvlt hypvt vhbchvrym btsm'
verses.translation: In that day shall the fair virgins And the young men faint for thirst.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַנִּשְׁבָּעִים֙ בְּאַשְׁמַ֣ת שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וְאָמְר֗וּ חֵ֤י אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ דָּ֔ן וְחֵ֖י דֶּ֣רֶךְ בְּאֵֽר־שָׁ֑בַע וְנָפְל֖וּ וְלֹא־יָק֥וּמוּ עֽוֹד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hnshb'ym b'shmt shmrvn v'mrv chy 'lhykh dn vchy drkh b'rshb' vnplv vl'yqvmv 'vd {p}
verses.translation: They that swear by the sin of Samaria, And say: ‘As thy God, O Dan, liveth’; And: ‘As the way of Beer-sheba liveth’; Even they shall fall, and never rise up again.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֨יתִי אֶת־אֲדֹנָ֜י נִצָּ֣ב עַֽל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ וַיֹּ֩אמֶר֩ הַ֨ךְ הַכַּפְתּ֜וֹר וְיִרְעֲשׁ֣וּ הַסִּפִּ֗ים וּבְצַ֙עַם֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ כֻּלָּ֔ם וְאַחֲרִיתָ֖ם בַּחֶ֣רֶב אֶהֱרֹ֑ג לֹֽא־יָנ֤וּס לָהֶם֙ נָ֔ס וְלֹֽא־יִמָּלֵ֥ט לָהֶ֖ם פָּלִֽיט׃
verses.translit: r'yty 't'dny ntsb 'lhmzbch vy'mr hkh hkhptvr vyr'shv hspym vbts'm br'sh khlm v'chrytm bchrb 'hrg l'ynvs lhm ns vl'ymlt lhm plyt
verses.translation: I saw the Lord standing beside the altar; and He said: Smite the capitals, that the posts may shake; And break them in pieces on the head of all of them; And I will slay the residue of them with the sword; There shall not one of them flee away, And there shall not one of them escape.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־יַחְתְּר֣וּ בִשְׁא֔וֹל מִשָּׁ֖ם יָדִ֣י תִקָּחֵ֑ם וְאִֽם־יַעֲלוּ֙ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם מִשָּׁ֖ם אוֹרִידֵֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mychtrv bsh'vl mshm ydy tqchm v'my'lv hshmym mshm 'vrydm
verses.translation: Though they dig into the nether-world, Thence shall My hand take them; And though they climb up to heaven, Thence will I bring them down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־יֵחָֽבְאוּ֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הַכַּרְמֶ֔ל מִשָּׁ֥ם אֲחַפֵּ֖שׂ וּלְקַחְתִּ֑ים וְאִם־יִסָּ֨תְר֜וּ מִנֶּ֤גֶד עֵינַי֙ בְּקַרְקַ֣ע הַיָּ֔ם מִשָּׁ֛ם אֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶת־הַנָּחָ֖שׁ וּנְשָׁכָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mychb'v br'sh hkhrml mshm 'chpsh vlqchtym v'mystrv mngd 'yny bqrq' hym mshm 'tsvh 'thnchsh vnshkhm
verses.translation: And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; And though they be hid from My sight in the bottom of the sea, Thence will I command the serpent, and he shall bite them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־יֵלְכ֤וּ בַשְּׁבִי֙ לִפְנֵ֣י אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם מִשָּׁ֛ם אֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶת־הַחֶ֖רֶב וַהֲרָגָ֑תַם וְשַׂמְתִּ֨י עֵינִ֧י עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם לְרָעָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א לְטוֹבָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mylkhv bshby lpny 'ybyhm mshm 'tsvh 'thchrb vhrgtm vshmty 'yny 'lyhm lr'h vl' ltvbh
verses.translation: And though they go into captivity before their enemies, Thence will I command the sword, and it shall slay them; And I will set Mine eyes upon them For evil, and not for good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאדֹנָ֨י יֱהֹוִ֜ה הַצְּבָא֗וֹת הַנּוֹגֵ֤עַ בָּאָ֙רֶץ֙ וַתָּמ֔וֹג וְאָבְל֖וּ כׇּל־י֣וֹשְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ וְעָלְתָ֤ה כַיְאֹר֙ כֻּלָּ֔הּ וְשָׁקְעָ֖ה כִּיאֹ֥ר מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v'dny yhvh htsb'vt hnvg' b'rts vtmvg v'blv khlyvshby bh v'lth khy'r khlh vshq'h khy'r mtsrym
verses.translation: For the Lord, the GOD of hosts, Is He that toucheth the land and it melteth, And all that dwell therein mourn; And it riseth up wholly like the River, And sinketh again, like the River of Egypt;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבּוֹנֶ֤ה בַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ מַעֲלוֹתָ֔ו וַאֲגֻדָּת֖וֹ עַל־אֶ֣רֶץ יְסָדָ֑הּ הַקֹּרֵ֣א לְמֵֽי־הַיָּ֗ם וַֽיִּשְׁפְּכֵ֛ם עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ יְהֹוָ֥ה שְׁמֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hbvnh bshmym m'lvtv v'gdtv 'l'rts ysdh hqr' lmyhym vyshpkhm 'lpny h'rts yhvh shmv {p}
verses.translation: It is He that buildeth His upper chambers in the heaven, And hath founded His vault upon the earth; He that calleth for the waters of the sea, And poureth them out upon the face of the earth; The LORD is His name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא כִבְנֵי֩ כֻשִׁיִּ֨ים אַתֶּ֥ם לִ֛י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה הֲל֣וֹא אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הֶעֱלֵ֙יתִי֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּפְלִשְׁתִּיִּ֥ים מִכַּפְתּ֖וֹר וַאֲרָ֥ם מִקִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: hlv' khbny khshyym 'tm ly bny yshr'l n'myhvh hlv' 'tyshr'l h'lyty m'rts mtsrym vplshtyym mkhptvr v'rm mqyr
verses.translation: Are ye not as the children of the Ethiopians unto Me, O children of Israel? saith the LORD. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt, And the Philistines from Caphtor, And Aram from Kir?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֞ה עֵינֵ֣י  אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֗ה בַּמַּמְלָכָה֙ הַֽחַטָּאָ֔ה וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּ֣י אֹתָ֔הּ מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה אֶ֗פֶס כִּ֠י לֹ֣א הַשְׁמֵ֥יד אַשְׁמִ֛יד אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יַעֲקֹ֖ב נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hnh 'yny  'dny yhvh bmmlkhh hcht'h vhshmdty 'th m'l pny h'dmh 'ps khy l' hshmyd 'shmyd 'tbyt y'qb n'myhvh
verses.translation: Behold, the eyes of the Lord GOD Are upon the sinful kingdom, And I will destroy it from off the face of the earth; Saving that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֤ה אָֽנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֔ה וַהֲנִע֥וֹתִי בְכׇֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנּ֙וֹעַ֙ בַּכְּבָרָ֔ה וְלֹֽא־יִפּ֥וֹל צְר֖וֹר אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khyhnh 'nkhy mtsvh vhn'vty bkhlhgvym 'tbyt yshr'l kh'shr ynv' bkhbrh vl'ypvl tsrvr 'rts
verses.translation: For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations, Like as corn is sifted in a sieve, Yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחֶ֣רֶב יָמ֔וּתוּ כֹּ֖ל חַטָּאֵ֣י עַמִּ֑י הָאֹמְרִ֗ים לֹֽא־תַגִּ֧ישׁ וְתַקְדִּ֛ים בַּעֲדֵ֖ינוּ הָרָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: bchrb ymvtv khl cht'y 'my h'mrym l'tgysh vtqdym b'dynv hr'h
verses.translation: All the sinners of My people shall die by the sword, That say: ‘The evil shall not overtake nor confront us.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא אָקִ֛ים אֶת־סֻכַּ֥ת דָּוִ֖יד הַנֹּפֶ֑לֶת וְגָדַרְתִּ֣י אֶת־פִּרְצֵיהֶ֗ן וַהֲרִֽסֹתָיו֙ אָקִ֔ים וּבְנִיתִ֖יהָ כִּימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' 'qym 'tskht dvyd hnplt vgdrty 'tprtsyhn vhrstyv 'qym vbnytyh khymy 'vlm
verses.translation: In that day will I raise up The tabernacle of David that is fallen, And close up the breaches thereof, And I will raise up his ruins, And I will build it as in the days of old;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן יִֽירְשׁ֜וּ אֶת־שְׁאֵרִ֤ית אֱדוֹם֙ וְכׇל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָ֥א שְׁמִ֖י עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֖ה עֹ֥שֶׂה זֹּֽאת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lm'n yyrshv 'tsh'ryt 'dvm vkhlhgvym 'shrnqr' shmy 'lyhm n'myhvh 'shh z't {p}
verses.translation: That they may possess the remnant of Edom, And all the nations, upon whom My name is called, Saith the LORD that doeth this.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה יָמִ֤ים בָּאִים֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְנִגַּ֤שׁ חוֹרֵשׁ֙ בַּקֹּצֵ֔ר וְדֹרֵ֥ךְ עֲנָבִ֖ים בְּמֹשֵׁ֣ךְ הַזָּ֑רַע וְהִטִּ֤יפוּ הֶֽהָרִים֙ עָסִ֔יס וְכׇל־הַגְּבָע֖וֹת תִּתְמוֹגַֽגְנָה׃
verses.translit: hnh ymym b'ym n'myhvh vngsh chvrsh bqtsr vdrkh 'nbym bmshkh hzr' vhtypv hhrym 'sys vkhlhgb'vt ttmvggnh
verses.translation: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, That the plowman shall overtake the reaper, And the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; And the mountains shall drop sweet wine, And all the hills shall melt.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתִּי֮ אֶת־שְׁב֣וּת עַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וּבָנ֞וּ עָרִ֤ים נְשַׁמּוֹת֙ וְיָשָׁ֔בוּ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְשָׁת֖וּ אֶת־יֵינָ֑ם וְעָשׂ֣וּ גַנּ֔וֹת וְאָכְל֖וּ אֶת־פְּרִיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vshbty 'tshbvt 'my yshr'l vbnv 'rym nshmvt vyshbv vnt'v khrmym vshtv 'tyynm v'shv gnvt v'khlv 'tpryhm
verses.translation: And I will turn the captivity of My people Israel, And they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; And they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; They shall also make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּנְטַעְתִּ֖ים עַל־אַדְמָתָ֑ם וְלֹ֨א יִנָּתְשׁ֜וּ ע֗וֹד מֵעַ֤ל אַדְמָתָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתַ֣תִּי לָהֶ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vnt'tym 'l'dmtm vl' yntshv 'vd m'l 'dmtm 'shr ntty lhm 'mr yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: And I will plant them upon their land, And they shall no more be plucked up Out of their land which I have given them, Saith the LORD thy God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲז֖וֹן עֹֽבַדְיָ֑ה כֹּֽה־אָמַר֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י יֱהֹוִ֜ה לֶאֱד֗וֹם שְׁמוּעָ֨ה שָׁמַ֜עְנוּ מֵאֵ֤ת יְהֹוָה֙ וְצִיר֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם שֻׁלָּ֔ח ק֛וּמוּ וְנָק֥וּמָה עָלֶ֖יהָ לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: chzvn 'bdyh khh'mr 'dny yhvh l'dvm shmv'h shm'nv m't yhvh vtsyr bgvym shlch qvmv vnqvmh 'lyh lmlchmh
verses.translation: The vision of Obadiah. Thus saith the Lord GOD concerning Edom: We have heard a message from the LORD, And an ambassador is sent among the nations: ‘Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה קָטֹ֛ן נְתַתִּ֖יךָ בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם בָּז֥וּי אַתָּ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: hnh qtn nttykh bgvym bzvy 'th m'd
verses.translation: Behold, I make thee small among the nations; Thou art greatly despised.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְד֤וֹן לִבְּךָ֙ הִשִּׁיאֶ֔ךָ שֹׁכְנִ֥י בְחַגְוֵי־סֶ֖לַע מְר֣וֹם שִׁבְתּ֑וֹ אֹמֵ֣ר בְּלִבּ֔וֹ מִ֥י יוֹרִדֵ֖נִי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: zdvn lbkh hshy'kh shkhny bchgvysl' mrvm shbtv 'mr blbv my yvrdny 'rts
verses.translation: The pride of thy heart hath beguiled thee, O thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, Thy habitation on high; That sayest in thy heart: ‘Who shall bring me down to the ground?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־תַּגְבִּ֣יהַּ כַּנֶּ֔שֶׁר וְאִם־בֵּ֥ין כּֽוֹכָבִ֖ים שִׂ֣ים קִנֶּ֑ךָ מִשָּׁ֥ם אוֹרִֽידְךָ֖ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'mtgbyh khnshr v'mbyn khvkhbym shym qnkh mshm 'vrydkh n'myhvh
verses.translation: Though thou make thy nest as high as the eagle, And though thou set it among the stars, I will bring thee down from thence, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־גַּנָּבִ֤ים בָּאֽוּ־לְךָ֙ אִם־שׁ֣וֹדְדֵי לַ֔יְלָה אֵ֣יךְ נִדְמֵ֔יתָה הֲל֥וֹא יִגְנְב֖וּ דַּיָּ֑ם אִם־בֹּֽצְרִים֙ בָּ֣אוּ לָ֔ךְ הֲל֖וֹא יַשְׁאִ֥ירוּ עֹלֵלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'mgnbym b'vlkh 'mshvddy lylh 'ykh ndmyth hlv' ygnbv dym 'mbtsrym b'v lkh hlv' ysh'yrv 'llvt
verses.translation: If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night— How art thou cut off!— Would they not steal till they had enough? If grape-gatherers came to thee, Would they not leave some gleaning grapes?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֚יךְ נֶחְפְּשׂ֣וּ עֵשָׂ֔ו נִבְע֖וּ מַצְפֻּנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'ykh nchpshv 'shv nb'v mtspnyv
verses.translation: How is Esau searched out! How are his hidden places sought out!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַֽד־הַגְּב֣וּל שִׁלְּח֗וּךָ כֹּ֚ל אַנְשֵׁ֣י בְרִיתֶ֔ךָ הִשִּׁיא֛וּךָ יָכְל֥וּ לְךָ֖ אַנְשֵׁ֣י שְׁלֹמֶ֑ךָ לַחְמְךָ֗ יָשִׂ֤ימוּ מָזוֹר֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יךָ אֵ֥ין תְּבוּנָ֖ה בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'dhgbvl shlchvkh khl 'nshy brytkh hshy'vkh ykhlv lkh 'nshy shlmkh lchmkh yshymv mzvr tchtykh 'yn tbvnh bv
verses.translation: All the men of thy confederacy Have conducted thee to the border; The men that were at peace with thee Have beguiled thee, and prevailed against thee; They that eat thy bread lay a snare under thee, In whom there is no discernment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֛וֹא בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֤י חֲכָמִים֙ מֵֽאֱד֔וֹם וּתְבוּנָ֖ה מֵהַ֥ר עֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.translit: hlv' byvm hhv' n'myhvh vh'bdty chkhmym m'dvm vtbvnh mhr 'shv
verses.translation: Shall I not in that day, saith the LORD, Destroy the wise men out of Edom, And discernment out of the mount of Esau?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחַתּ֥וּ גִבּוֹרֶ֖יךָ תֵּימָ֑ן לְמַ֧עַן יִכָּֽרֶת־אִ֛ישׁ מֵהַ֥ר עֵשָׂ֖ו מִקָּֽטֶל׃
verses.translit: vchtv gbvrykh tymn lm'n ykhrt'ysh mhr 'shv mqtl
verses.translation: And thy mighty men, O Teman, shall be dismayed, To the end that every one may be cut off from the mount of Esau by slaughter.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵחֲמַ֛ס אָחִ֥יךָ יַעֲקֹ֖ב תְּכַסְּךָ֣ בוּשָׁ֑ה וְנִכְרַ֖תָּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: mchms 'chykh y'qb tkhskh bvshh vnkhrt l'vlm
verses.translation: For the violence done to thy brother Jacob shame shall cover thee, And thou shalt be cut off for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּיוֹם֙ עֲמׇֽדְךָ֣ מִנֶּ֔גֶד בְּי֛וֹם שְׁב֥וֹת זָרִ֖ים חֵיל֑וֹ וְנׇכְרִ֞ים בָּ֣אוּ שְׁעָרָ֗ו וְעַל־יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ יַדּ֣וּ גוֹרָ֔ל גַּם־אַתָּ֖ה כְּאַחַ֥ד מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: byvm 'mdkh mngd byvm shbvt zrym chylv vnkhrym b'v sh'rv v'lyrvshl͏m ydv gvrl gm'th kh'chd mhm
verses.translation: In the day that thou didst stand aloof, In the day that strangers carried away his substance, And foreigners entered into his gates, And cast lots upon Jerusalem, Even thou wast as one of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַל־תֵּ֤רֶא בְיוֹם־אָחִ֙יךָ֙ בְּי֣וֹם נׇכְר֔וֹ וְאַל־תִּשְׂמַ֥ח לִבְנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּי֣וֹם אׇבְדָ֑ם וְאַל־תַּגְדֵּ֥ל פִּ֖יךָ בְּי֥וֹם צָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'ltr' byvm'chykh byvm nkhrv v'ltshmch lbnyyhvdh byvm 'bdm v'ltgdl pykh byvm tsrh
verses.translation: But thou shouldest not have gazed on the day of thy brother In the day of his disaster, Neither shouldest thou have rejoiced over the children of Judah In the day of their destruction; Neither shouldest thou have spoken proudly In the day of distress.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תָּב֤וֹא בְשַֽׁעַר־עַמִּי֙ בְּי֣וֹם אֵידָ֔ם אַל־תֵּ֧רֶא גַם־אַתָּ֛ה בְּרָעָת֖וֹ בְּי֣וֹם אֵיד֑וֹ וְאַל־תִּשְׁלַ֥חְנָה בְחֵיל֖וֹ בְּי֥וֹם אֵידֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'ltbv' bsh'r'my byvm 'ydm 'ltr' gm'th br'tv byvm 'ydv v'ltshlchnh bchylv byvm 'ydv
verses.translation: Thou shouldest not have entered into the gate of My people In the day of their calamity; Yea, thou shouldest not have gazed on their affliction In the day of their calamity, Nor have laid hands on their substance In the day of their calamity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַֽל־תַּעֲמֹד֙ עַל־הַפֶּ֔רֶק לְהַכְרִ֖ית אֶת־פְּלִיטָ֑יו וְאַל־תַּסְגֵּ֥ר שְׂרִידָ֖יו בְּי֥וֹם צָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lt'md 'lhprq lhkhryt 'tplytyv v'ltsgr shrydyv byvm tsrh
verses.translation: Neither shouldest thou have stood in the crossway, To cut off those of his that escape; Neither shouldest thou have delivered up those of his That did remain in the day of distress.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־קָר֥וֹב יוֹם־יְהֹוָ֖ה עַל־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ יֵעָ֣שֶׂה לָּ֔ךְ גְּמֻלְךָ֖ יָשׁ֥וּב בְּרֹאשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: khyqrvb yvmyhvh 'lkhlhgvym kh'shr 'shyt y'shh lkh gmlkh yshvb br'shkh
verses.translation: For the day of the LORD is near upon all the nations; As thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee; Thy dealing shall return upon thine own head. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֗י כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֤ר שְׁתִיתֶם֙ עַל־הַ֣ר קׇדְשִׁ֔י יִשְׁתּ֥וּ כׇֽל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם תָּמִ֑יד וְשָׁת֣וּ וְלָע֔וּ וְהָי֖וּ כְּל֥וֹא הָיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: khy kh'shr shtytm 'lhr qdshy yshtv khlhgvym tmyd vshtv vl'v vhyv khlv' hyv
verses.translation: For as ye have drunk upon My holy mountain, So shall all the nations drink continually, Yea, they shall drink, and swallow down, And shall be as though they had not been.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְהַ֥ר צִיּ֛וֹן תִּהְיֶ֥ה פְלֵיטָ֖ה וְהָ֣יָה קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְיָֽרְשׁוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב אֵ֖ת מוֹרָֽשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vbhr tsyvn thyh plyth vhyh qdsh vyrshv byt y'qb 't mvrshyhm
verses.translation: But in mount Zion there shall be those that escape, And it shall be holy; And the house of Jacob shall possess their possessions.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ בֵית־יַעֲקֹ֨ב אֵ֜שׁ וּבֵ֧ית יוֹסֵ֣ף לֶהָבָ֗ה וּבֵ֤ית עֵשָׂו֙ לְקַ֔שׁ וְדָלְק֥וּ בָהֶ֖ם וַאֲכָל֑וּם וְלֹֽא־יִֽהְיֶ֤ה שָׂרִיד֙ לְבֵ֣ית עֵשָׂ֔ו כִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: vhyh byty'qb 'sh vbyt yvsf lhbh vbyt 'shv lqsh vdlqv bhm v'khlvm vl'yhyh shryd lbyt 'shv khy yhvh dbr
verses.translation: And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, And the house of Joseph a flame, And the house of Esau for stubble, And they shall kindle in them, and devour them; And there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; For the LORD hath spoken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָרְשׁ֨וּ הַנֶּ֜גֶב אֶת־הַ֣ר עֵשָׂ֗ו וְהַשְּׁפֵלָה֙ אֶת־פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְיָרְשׁוּ֙ אֶת־שְׂדֵ֣ה אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְאֵ֖ת שְׂדֵ֣ה שֹׁמְר֑וֹן וּבִנְיָמִ֖ן אֶת־הַגִּלְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: vyrshv hngb 'thr 'shv vhshplh 'tplshtym vyrshv 'tshdh 'prym v't shdh shmrvn vbnymn 'thgl'd
verses.translation: And they of the South shall possess the mount of Esau, And they of the Lowland the Philistines; And they shall possess the field of Ephraim, And the field of Samaria; And Benjamin shall possess Gilead.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגָלֻ֣ת הַֽחֵל־הַ֠זֶּ֠ה לִבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֲשֶֽׁר־כְּנַעֲנִים֙ עַד־צָ֣רְפַ֔ת וְגָלֻ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּסְפָרַ֑ד יִֽרְשׁ֕וּ אֵ֖ת עָרֵ֥י הַנֶּֽגֶב׃
verses.translit: vglt hchlhzh lbny yshr'l 'shrkhn'nym 'dtsrpt vglt yrvshl͏m 'shr bsprd yrshv 't 'ry hngb
verses.translation: And the captivity of this host of the children of Israel, That are among the Canaanites, even unto Zarephath, And the captivity of Jerusalem, that is in Sepharad, Shall possess the cities of the South.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָל֤וּ מֽוֹשִׁעִים֙ בְּהַ֣ר צִיּ֔וֹן לִשְׁפֹּ֖ט אֶת־הַ֣ר עֵשָׂ֑ו וְהָיְתָ֥ה לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה הַמְּלוּכָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'lv mvsh'ym bhr tsyvn lshpt 'thr 'shv vhyth lyhvh hmlvkhh
verses.translation: And saviours shall come up on mount Zion To judge the mount of Esau; And the kingdom shall be the LORD’S.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־יוֹנָ֥ה בֶן־אֲמִתַּ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'lyvnh bn'mty l'mr
verses.translation: Now the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the son of Amittai, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֠וּם לֵ֧ךְ אֶל־נִֽינְוֵ֛ה הָעִ֥יר הַגְּדוֹלָ֖ה וּקְרָ֣א עָלֶ֑יהָ כִּֽי־עָלְתָ֥ה רָעָתָ֖ם לְפָנָֽי׃
verses.translit: qvm lkh 'lnynvh h'yr hgdvlh vqr' 'lyh khy'lth r'tm lpny
verses.translation: ’Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and proclaim against it; for their wickedness is come up before Me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤קׇם יוֹנָה֙ לִבְרֹ֣חַ תַּרְשִׁ֔ישָׁה מִלִּפְנֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֨רֶד יָפ֜וֹ וַיִּמְצָ֥א אֳנִיָּ֣ה  בָּאָ֣ה תַרְשִׁ֗ישׁ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן שְׂכָרָ֜הּ וַיֵּ֤רֶד בָּהּ֙ לָב֤וֹא עִמָּהֶם֙ תַּרְשִׁ֔ישָׁה מִלִּפְנֵ֖י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyqm yvnh lbrch trshyshh mlpny yhvh vyrd ypv vymts' 'nyh  b'h trshysh vytn shkhrh vyrd bh lbv' 'mhm trshyshh mlpny yhvh
verses.translation: But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the LORD; and he went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid the fare thereof, and went down into it, to go with them unto Tarshish, from the presence of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיהֹוָ֗ה הֵטִ֤יל רֽוּחַ־גְּדוֹלָה֙ אֶל־הַיָּ֔ם וַיְהִ֥י סַֽעַר־גָּד֖וֹל בַּיָּ֑ם וְהָ֣אֳנִיָּ֔ה חִשְּׁבָ֖ה לְהִשָּׁבֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhvh htyl rvchgdvlh 'lhym vyhy s'rgdvl bym vh'nyh chshbh lhshbr
verses.translation: But the LORD hurled a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea, so that the ship was like to be broken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽירְא֣וּ הַמַּלָּחִ֗ים וַֽיִּזְעֲקוּ֮ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־אֱלֹהָיו֒ וַיָּטִ֨לוּ אֶת־הַכֵּלִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר בָּֽאֳנִיָּה֙ אֶל־הַיָּ֔ם לְהָקֵ֖ל מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וְיוֹנָ֗ה יָרַד֙ אֶל־יַרְכְּתֵ֣י הַסְּפִינָ֔ה וַיִּשְׁכַּ֖ב וַיֵּרָדַֽם׃
verses.translit: vyyr'v hmlchym vyz'qv 'ysh 'l'lhyv vytlv 'thkhlym 'shr b'nyh 'lhym lhql m'lyhm vyvnh yrd 'lyrkhty hspynh vyshkhb vyrdm
verses.translation: And the mariners were afraid, and cried every man unto his god; and they cast forth the wares that were in the ship into the sea, to lighten it unto them. But Jonah was gone down into the innermost parts of the ship; and he lay, and was fast asleep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרַ֤ב אֵלָיו֙ רַ֣ב הַחֹבֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹ מַה־לְּךָ֣ נִרְדָּ֑ם ק֚וּם קְרָ֣א אֶל־אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ אוּלַ֞י יִתְעַשֵּׁ֧ת הָאֱלֹהִ֛ים לָ֖נוּ וְלֹ֥א נֹאבֵֽד׃
verses.translit: vyqrb 'lyv rb hchbl vy'mr lv mhlkh nrdm qvm qr' 'l'lhykh 'vly yt'sht h'lhym lnv vl' n'bd
verses.translation: So the shipmaster came to him, and said unto him: ‘What meanest thou that thou sleepest? arise, call upon thy God, if so be that God will think upon us, that we perish not.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֗הוּ לְכוּ֙ וְנַפִּ֣ילָה גֽוֹרָל֔וֹת וְנֵ֣דְעָ֔ה בְּשֶׁלְּמִ֛י הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לָ֑נוּ וַיַּפִּ֙לוּ֙ גּֽוֹרָל֔וֹת וַיִּפֹּ֥ל הַגּוֹרָ֖ל עַל־יוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ysh 'lr'hv lkhv vnpylh gvrlvt vnd'h bshlmy hr'h hz't lnv vyplv gvrlvt vypl hgvrl 'lyvnh
verses.translation: And they said every one to his fellow: ‘Come, and let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this evil is upon us.’ So they cast lots, and the lot fell upon Jonah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו הַגִּידָה־נָּ֣א לָ֔נוּ בַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר לְמִי־הָרָעָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לָ֑נוּ מַה־מְּלַאכְתְּךָ֙ וּמֵאַ֣יִן תָּב֔וֹא מָ֣ה אַרְצֶ֔ךָ וְאֵֽי־מִזֶּ֥ה עַ֖ם אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv hgydhn' lnv b'shr lmyhr'h hz't lnv mhml'khtkh vm'yn tbv' mh 'rtskh v'ymzh 'm 'th
verses.translation: Then said they unto him: ‘Tell us, we pray thee, for whose cause this evil is upon us: what is thine occupation? and whence comest thou? what is thy country? and of what people art thou?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם עִבְרִ֣י אָנֹ֑כִי וְאֶת־יְהֹוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ אֲנִ֣י יָרֵ֔א אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־הַיָּ֖ם וְאֶת־הַיַּבָּשָֽׁה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm 'bry 'nkhy v'tyhvh 'lhy hshmym 'ny yr' 'shr'shh 'thym v'thybshh
verses.translation: And he said unto them: ‘I am an Hebrew; and I fear the LORD, the God of heaven, who hath made the sea and the dry land.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽירְא֤וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ יִרְאָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֔ה וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו מַה־זֹּ֣את עָשִׂ֑יתָ כִּֽי־יָדְע֣וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים כִּֽי־מִלִּפְנֵ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ ה֣וּא בֹרֵ֔חַ כִּ֥י הִגִּ֖יד לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vyyr'v h'nshym yr'h gdvlh vy'mrv 'lyv mhz't 'shyt khyyd'v h'nshym khymlpny yhvh hv' brch khy hgyd lhm
verses.translation: Then were the men exceedingly afraid, and said unto him: ‘What is this that thou hast done?’ For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the LORD, because he had told them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ אֵלָיו֙ מַה־נַּ֣עֲשֶׂה לָּ֔ךְ וְיִשְׁתֹּ֥ק הַיָּ֖ם מֵֽעָלֵ֑ינוּ כִּ֥י הַיָּ֖ם הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וְסֹעֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv mhn'shh lkh vyshtq hym m'lynv khy hym hvlkh vs'r
verses.translation: Then said they unto him: ‘What shall we do unto thee, that the sea may be calm unto us?’ for the sea grew more and more tempestuous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם שָׂא֙וּנִי֙ וַהֲטִילֻ֣נִי אֶל־הַיָּ֔ם וְיִשְׁתֹּ֥ק הַיָּ֖ם מֵֽעֲלֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י יוֹדֵ֣עַ אָ֔נִי כִּ֣י בְשֶׁלִּ֔י הַסַּ֧עַר הַגָּד֛וֹל הַזֶּ֖ה עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm sh'vny vhtylny 'lhym vyshtq hym m'lykhm khy yvd' 'ny khy bshly hs'r hgdvl hzh 'lykhm
verses.translation: And he said unto them: ‘Take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; so shall the sea be calm unto you; for I know that for my sake this great tempest is upon you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּחְתְּר֣וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים לְהָשִׁ֛יב אֶל־הַיַּבָּשָׁ֖ה וְלֹ֣א יָכֹ֑לוּ כִּ֣י הַיָּ֔ם הוֹלֵ֥ךְ וְסֹעֵ֖ר עֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vychtrv h'nshym lhshyb 'lhybshh vl' ykhlv khy hym hvlkh vs'r 'lyhm
