verses.translation: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to bring it to the land; but they could not; for the sea grew more and more tempestuous against them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּקְרְא֨וּ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֜ה וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ אָנָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ אַל־נָ֣א נֹאבְדָ֗ה בְּנֶ֙פֶשׁ֙ הָאִ֣ישׁ הַזֶּ֔ה וְאַל־תִּתֵּ֥ן עָלֵ֖ינוּ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֑יא כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר חָפַ֖צְתָּ עָשִֽׂיתָ׃
verses.translit: vyqr'v 'lyhvh vy'mrv 'nh yhvh 'ln' n'bdh bnpsh h'ysh hzh v'lttn 'lynv dm nqy' khy'th yhvh kh'shr chptst 'shyt
verses.translation: Wherefore they cried unto the LORD, and said: ‘We beseech Thee, O LORD, we beseech Thee, let us not perish for this man’s life, and lay not upon us innocent blood; for Thou, O LORD, hast done as it pleased Thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־יוֹנָ֔ה וַיְטִלֻ֖הוּ אֶל־הַיָּ֑ם וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד הַיָּ֖ם מִזַּעְפּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vysh'v 'tyvnh vytlhv 'lhym vy'md hym mz'pv
verses.translation: So they took up Jonah, and cast him forth into the sea; and the sea ceased from its raging.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּֽירְא֧וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֛ים יִרְאָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה אֶת־יְהֹוָ֑ה וַיִּֽזְבְּחוּ־זֶ֙בַח֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה וַֽיִּדְּר֖וּ נְדָרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyyr'v h'nshym yr'h gdvlh 'tyhvh vyzbchvzbch lyhvh vydrv ndrym
verses.translation: Then the men feared the LORD exceedingly; and they offered a sacrifice unto the LORD, and made vows.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְמַ֤ן יְהֹוָה֙ דָּ֣ג גָּד֔וֹל לִבְלֹ֖עַ אֶת־יוֹנָ֑ה וַיְהִ֤י יוֹנָה֙ בִּמְעֵ֣י הַדָּ֔ג שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה יָמִ֖ים וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה לֵילֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vymn yhvh dg gdvl lbl' 'tyvnh vyhy yvnh bm'y hdg shlshh ymym vshlshh lylvt
verses.translation: And the LORD prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah; and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֣ל יוֹנָ֔ה אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו מִמְּעֵ֖י הַדָּגָֽה׃
verses.translit: vytpll yvnh 'lyhvh 'lhyv mm'y hdgh
verses.translation: Then Jonah prayed unto the LORD his God out of the fish’s belly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר קָ֠רָ֠אתִי מִצָּ֥רָה לִ֛י אֶל־יְהֹוָ֖ה וַֽיַּעֲנֵ֑נִי מִבֶּ֧טֶן שְׁא֛וֹל שִׁוַּ֖עְתִּי שָׁמַ֥עְתָּ קוֹלִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr qr'ty mtsrh ly 'lyhvh vy'nny mbtn sh'vl shv'ty shm't qvly
verses.translation: And he said: I called out of mine affliction Unto the LORD, and He answered me; Out of the belly of the nether-world cried I, And Thou heardest my voice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤נִי מְצוּלָה֙ בִּלְבַ֣ב יַמִּ֔ים וְנָהָ֖ר יְסֹבְבֵ֑נִי כׇּל־מִשְׁבָּרֶ֥יךָ וְגַלֶּ֖יךָ עָלַ֥י עָבָֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: vtshlykhny mtsvlh blbb ymym vnhr ysbbny khlmshbrykh vglykh 'ly 'brv
verses.translation: For Thou didst cast me into the depth, In the heart of the seas, And the flood was round about me; All Thy waves and Thy billows Passed over me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי נִגְרַ֖שְׁתִּי מִנֶּ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ אַ֚ךְ אוֹסִ֣יף לְהַבִּ֔יט אֶל־הֵיכַ֖ל קׇדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: v'ny 'mrty ngrshty mngd 'ynykh 'kh 'vsyf lhbyt 'lhykhl qdshkh
verses.translation: And I said: ‘I am cast out From before Thine eyes’; Yet I will look again Toward Thy holy temple.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲפָפ֤וּנִי מַ֙יִם֙ עַד־נֶ֔פֶשׁ תְּה֖וֹם יְסֹבְבֵ֑נִי ס֖וּף חָב֥וּשׁ לְרֹאשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: 'ppvny mym 'dnpsh thvm ysbbny svf chbvsh lr'shy
verses.translation: The waters compassed me about, even to the soul; The deep was round about me; The weeds were wrapped about my head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְקִצְבֵ֤י הָרִים֙ יָרַ֔דְתִּי הָאָ֛רֶץ בְּרִחֶ֥יהָ בַעֲדִ֖י לְעוֹלָ֑ם וַתַּ֧עַל מִשַּׁ֛חַת חַיַּ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: lqtsby hrym yrdty h'rts brchyh b'dy l'vlm vt'l mshcht chyy yhvh 'lhy
verses.translation: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains; The earth with her bars closed upon me for ever; Yet hast Thou brought up my life from the pit, O LORD my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּהִתְעַטֵּ֤ף עָלַי֙ נַפְשִׁ֔י אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה זָכָ֑רְתִּי וַתָּב֤וֹא אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ תְּפִלָּתִ֔י אֶל־הֵיכַ֖ל קׇדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: bht'tf 'ly npshy 'tyhvh zkhrty vtbv' 'lykh tplty 'lhykhl qdshkh
verses.translation: When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD; And my prayer came in unto Thee, Into Thy holy temple.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְשַׁמְּרִ֖ים הַבְלֵי־שָׁ֑וְא חַסְדָּ֖ם יַעֲזֹֽבוּ׃
verses.translit: mshmrym hblyshv' chsdm y'zbv
verses.translation: They that regard lying vanities Forsake their own mercy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּק֤וֹל תּוֹדָה֙ אֶזְבְּחָה־לָּ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָדַ֖רְתִּי אֲשַׁלֵּ֑מָה יְשׁוּעָ֖תָה לַיהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ny bqvl tvdh 'zbchhlkh 'shr ndrty 'shlmh yshv'th lyhvh {p}
verses.translation: But I will sacrifice unto Thee With the voice of thanksgiving; That which I have vowed I will pay. Salvation is of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה לַדָּ֑ג וַיָּקֵ֥א אֶת־יוֹנָ֖ה אֶל־הַיַּבָּשָֽׁה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh ldg vyq' 'tyvnh 'lhybshh {s}
verses.translation: And the LORD spoke unto the fish, and it vomited out Jonah upon the dry land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֧י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶל־יוֹנָ֖ה שֵׁנִ֥ית לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'lyvnh shnyt l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto Jonah the second time, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֛וּם לֵ֥ךְ אֶל־נִֽינְוֵ֖ה הָעִ֣יר הַגְּדוֹלָ֑ה וּקְרָ֤א אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ אֶת־הַקְּרִיאָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י דֹּבֵ֥ר אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: qvm lkh 'lnynvh h'yr hgdvlh vqr' 'lyh 'thqry'h 'shr 'nkhy dbr 'lykh
verses.translation: ’Arise, go unto Nineveh, that great city, and make unto it the proclamation that I bid thee.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קׇם יוֹנָ֗ה וַיֵּ֛לֶךְ אֶל־נִֽינְוֵ֖ה כִּדְבַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה וְנִֽינְוֵ֗ה הָיְתָ֤ה עִיר־גְּדוֹלָה֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים מַהֲלַ֖ךְ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vyqm yvnh vylkh 'lnynvh khdbr yhvh vnynvh hyth 'yrgdvlh l'lhym mhlkh shlsht ymym
verses.translation: So Jonah arose, and went unto Nineveh, according to the word of the LORD. Now Nineveh was an exceeding great city, of three days’journey.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֤חֶל יוֹנָה֙ לָב֣וֹא בָעִ֔יר מַהֲלַ֖ךְ י֣וֹם אֶחָ֑ד וַיִּקְרָא֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר ע֚וֹד אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְנִֽינְוֵ֖ה נֶהְפָּֽכֶת׃
verses.translit: vychl yvnh lbv' b'yr mhlkh yvm 'chd vyqr' vy'mr 'vd 'rb'ym yvm vnynvh nhpkht
verses.translation: And Jonah began to enter into the city a day’s journey, and he proclaimed, and said: ‘Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּאֲמִ֛ינוּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י נִֽינְוֵ֖ה בֵּֽאלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּקְרְאוּ־צוֹם֙ וַיִּלְבְּשׁ֣וּ שַׂקִּ֔ים מִגְּדוֹלָ֖ם וְעַד־קְטַנָּֽם׃
verses.translit: vy'mynv 'nshy nynvh b'lhym vyqr'vtsvm vylbshv shqym mgdvlm v'dqtnm
verses.translation: And the people of Nineveh believed God; and they proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them even to the least of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּגַּ֤ע הַדָּבָר֙ אֶל־מֶ֣לֶךְ נִֽינְוֵ֔ה וַיָּ֙קׇם֙ מִכִּסְא֔וֹ וַיַּעֲבֵ֥ר אַדַּרְתּ֖וֹ מֵֽעָלָ֑יו וַיְכַ֣ס שַׂ֔ק וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב עַל־הָאֵֽפֶר׃
verses.translit: vyg' hdbr 'lmlkh nynvh vyqm mkhs'v vy'br 'drtv m'lyv vykhs shq vyshb 'lh'pr
verses.translation: And the tidings reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, and laid his robe from him, and covered him with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּזְעֵ֗ק וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ בְּנִֽינְוֵ֔ה מִטַּ֧עַם הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ וּגְדֹלָ֖יו לֵאמֹ֑ר הָאָדָ֨ם וְהַבְּהֵמָ֜ה הַבָּקָ֣ר וְהַצֹּ֗אן אַֽל־יִטְעֲמוּ֙ מְא֔וּמָה אַ֨ל־יִרְע֔וּ וּמַ֖יִם אַל־יִשְׁתּֽוּ׃
verses.translit: vyz'q vy'mr bnynvh mt'm hmlkh vgdlyv l'mr h'dm vhbhmh hbqr vhts'n 'lyt'mv m'vmh 'lyr'v vmym 'lyshtv
verses.translation: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published through Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying: ‘Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste any thing; let them not feed, nor drink water;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִתְכַּסּ֣וּ שַׂקִּ֗ים הָֽאָדָם֙ וְהַבְּהֵמָ֔ה וְיִקְרְא֥וּ אֶל־אֱלֹהִ֖ים בְּחׇזְקָ֑ה וְיָשֻׁ֗בוּ אִ֚ישׁ מִדַּרְכּ֣וֹ הָֽרָעָ֔ה וּמִן־הֶחָמָ֖ס אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּכַפֵּיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vytkhsv shqym h'dm vhbhmh vyqr'v 'l'lhym bchzqh vyshbv 'ysh mdrkhv hr'h vmnhchms 'shr bkhpyhm
verses.translation: but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and beast, and let them cry mightily unto God; yea, let them turn every one from his evil way, and from the violence that is in their hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־יוֹדֵ֣עַ יָשׁ֔וּב וְנִחַ֖ם הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְשָׁ֛ב מֵחֲר֥וֹן אַפּ֖וֹ וְלֹ֥א נֹאבֵֽד׃
verses.translit: myyvd' yshvb vnchm h'lhym vshb mchrvn 'pv vl' n'bd
verses.translation: Who knoweth whether God will not turn and repent, and turn away from His fierce anger, that we perish not?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֤רְא הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־מַ֣עֲשֵׂיהֶ֔ם כִּי־שָׁ֖בוּ מִדַּרְכָּ֣ם הָרָעָ֑ה וַיִּנָּ֣חֶם הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים עַל־הָרָעָ֛ה אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר לַעֲשׂוֹת־לָהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א עָשָֽׂה׃
verses.translit: vyr' h'lhym 'tm'shyhm khyshbv mdrkhm hr'h vynchm h'lhym 'lhr'h 'shrdbr l'shvtlhm vl' 'shh
verses.translation: And God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God repented of the evil, which He said He would do unto them; and He did it not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥רַע אֶל־יוֹנָ֖ה רָעָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וַיִּ֖חַר לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyr' 'lyvnh r'h gdvlh vychr lv
verses.translation: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּתְפַּלֵּ֨ל אֶל־יְהֹוָ֜ה וַיֹּאמַ֗ר אָנָּ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ הֲלוֹא־זֶ֣ה דְבָרִ֗י עַד־הֱיוֹתִי֙ עַל־אַדְמָתִ֔י עַל־כֵּ֥ן קִדַּ֖מְתִּי לִבְרֹ֣חַ תַּרְשִׁ֑ישָׁה כִּ֣י יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ אֵֽל־חַנּ֣וּן וְרַח֔וּם אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֙יִם֙ וְרַב־חֶ֔סֶד וְנִחָ֖ם עַל־הָרָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vytpll 'lyhvh vy'mr 'nh yhvh hlv'zh dbry 'dhyvty 'l'dmty 'lkhn qdmty lbrch trshyshh khy yd'ty khy 'th 'lchnvn vrchvm 'rkh 'pym vrbchsd vnchm 'lhr'h
verses.translation: And he prayed unto the LORD, and said: ‘I pray Thee, O LORD, was not this my saying, when I was yet in mine own country? Therefore I fled beforehand unto Tarshish; for I knew that Thou art a gracious God, and compassionate, long-suffering, and abundant in mercy, and repentest Thee of the evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה קַח־נָ֥א אֶת־נַפְשִׁ֖י מִמֶּ֑נִּי כִּ֛י ט֥וֹב מוֹתִ֖י מֵחַיָּֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'th yhvh qchn' 'tnpshy mmny khy tvb mvty mchyy {p}
verses.translation: Therefore now, O LORD, take, I beseech Thee, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֔ה הַהֵיטֵ֖ב חָ֥רָה לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh hhytb chrh lkh
verses.translation: And the LORD said: ‘Art thou greatly angry?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֤א יוֹנָה֙ מִן־הָעִ֔יר וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב מִקֶּ֣דֶם לָעִ֑יר וַיַּ֩עַשׂ֩ ל֨וֹ שָׁ֜ם סֻכָּ֗ה וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב תַּחְתֶּ֙יהָ֙ בַּצֵּ֔ל עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִרְאֶ֔ה מַה־יִּהְיֶ֖ה בָּעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: vyts' yvnh mnh'yr vyshb mqdm l'yr vy'sh lv shm skhh vyshb tchtyh btsl 'd 'shr yr'h mhyhyh b'yr
verses.translation: Then Jonah went out of the city, and sat on the east side of the city, and there made him a booth, and sat under it in the shadow, till he might see what would become of the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְמַ֣ן יְהֹוָֽה־אֱ֠לֹהִ֠ים קִיקָי֞וֹן וַיַּ֣עַל  מֵעַ֣ל לְיוֹנָ֗ה לִֽהְי֥וֹת צֵל֙ עַל־רֹאשׁ֔וֹ לְהַצִּ֥יל ל֖וֹ מֵרָֽעָת֑וֹ וַיִּשְׂמַ֥ח יוֹנָ֛ה עַל־הַקִּֽיקָי֖וֹן שִׂמְחָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vymn yhvh'lhym qyqyvn vy'l  m'l lyvnh lhyvt tsl 'lr'shv lhtsyl lv mr'tv vyshmch yvnh 'lhqyqyvn shmchh gdvlh
verses.translation: And the LORD God prepared a gourd, and made it to come up over Jonah, that it might be a shadow over his head, to deliver him from his evil. So Jonah was exceeding glad because of the gourd.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְמַ֤ן הָֽאֱלֹהִים֙ תּוֹלַ֔עַת בַּעֲל֥וֹת הַשַּׁ֖חַר לַֽמׇּחֳרָ֑ת וַתַּ֥ךְ אֶת־הַקִּֽיקָי֖וֹן וַיִּיבָֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vymn h'lhym tvl't b'lvt hshchr lmchrt vtkh 'thqyqyvn vyybsh
verses.translation: But God prepared a worm when the morning rose the next day, and it smote the gourd, that it withered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י  כִּזְרֹ֣חַ הַשֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ וַיְמַ֨ן אֱלֹהִ֜ים ר֤וּחַ קָדִים֙ חֲרִישִׁ֔ית וַתַּ֥ךְ הַשֶּׁ֛מֶשׁ עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ יוֹנָ֖ה וַיִּתְעַלָּ֑ף וַיִּשְׁאַ֤ל אֶת־נַפְשׁוֹ֙ לָמ֔וּת וַיֹּ֕אמֶר ט֥וֹב מוֹתִ֖י מֵחַיָּֽי׃
verses.translit: vyhy  khzrch hshmsh vymn 'lhym rvch qdym chryshyt vtkh hshmsh 'lr'sh yvnh vyt'lf vysh'l 'tnpshv lmvt vy'mr tvb mvty mchyy
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the sun arose, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat upon the head of Jonah, that he fainted, and requested for himself that he might die, and said: ‘It is better for me to die than to live.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל־יוֹנָ֔ה הַהֵיטֵ֥ב חָרָֽה־לְךָ֖ עַל־הַקִּֽיקָי֑וֹן וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הֵיטֵ֥ב חָֽרָה־לִ֖י עַד־מָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'lyvnh hhytb chrhlkh 'lhqyqyvn vy'mr hytb chrhly 'dmvt
verses.translation: And God said to Jonah: ‘Art thou greatly angry for the gourd?’ And he said: ‘I am greatly angry, even unto death.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יְהֹוָ֔ה אַתָּ֥ה חַ֙סְתָּ֙ עַל־הַקִּ֣יקָי֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־עָמַ֥לְתָּ בּ֖וֹ וְלֹ֣א גִדַּלְתּ֑וֹ שֶׁבִּן־לַ֥יְלָה הָיָ֖ה וּבִן־לַ֥יְלָה אָבָֽד׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'th chst 'lhqyqyvn 'shr l''mlt bv vl' gdltv shbnlylh hyh vbnlylh 'bd
verses.translation: And the LORD said: ‘Thou hast had pity on the gourd, for which thou hast not laboured, neither madest it grow, which came up in a night, and perished in a night;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽאֲנִי֙ לֹ֣א אָח֔וּס עַל־נִינְוֵ֖ה הָעִ֣יר הַגְּדוֹלָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶשׁ־בָּ֡הּ הַרְבֵּה֩ מִֽשְׁתֵּים־עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה רִבּ֜וֹ אָדָ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יָדַע֙ בֵּין־יְמִינ֣וֹ לִשְׂמֹאל֔וֹ וּבְהֵמָ֖ה רַבָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'ny l' 'chvs 'lnynvh h'yr hgdvlh 'shr yshbh hrbh mshtym'shrh rbv 'dm 'shr l'yd' bynymynv lshm'lv vbhmh rbh
verses.translation: and should not I have pity on Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand, and also much cattle?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֣ה  אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־מִיכָה֙ הַמֹּ֣רַשְׁתִּ֔י בִּימֵ֥י יוֹתָ֛ם אָחָ֥ז יְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה מַלְכֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־חָזָ֥ה עַל־שֹׁמְר֖וֹן וִירֽוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: dbryhvh  'shr hyh 'lmykhh hmrshty bymy yvtm 'chz ychzqyh mlkhy yhvdh 'shrchzh 'lshmrvn vyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: The word of the LORD that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw concerning Samaria and Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ֙ עַמִּ֣ים כֻּלָּ֔ם הַקְשִׁ֖יבִי אֶ֣רֶץ וּמְלֹאָ֑הּ וִיהִי֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י יֱהֹוִ֤ה בָּכֶם֙ לְעֵ֔ד אֲדֹנָ֖י מֵהֵיכַ֥ל קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: shm'v 'mym khlm hqshyby 'rts vml'h vyhy 'dny yhvh bkhm l'd 'dny mhykhl qdshv
verses.translation: Hear, ye peoples, all of you; Hearken, O earth, and all that therein is; And let the Lord GOD be witness against you, The Lord from His holy temple.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה יֹצֵ֣א מִמְּקוֹמ֑וֹ וְיָרַ֥ד וְדָרַ֖ךְ עַל־[בָּ֥מֳתֵי] (במותי) אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khyhnh yhvh yts' mmqvmv vyrd vdrkh 'l[bmty] (bmvty) 'rts
verses.translation: For, behold, the LORD cometh forth out of His place, And will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָמַ֤סּוּ הֶֽהָרִים֙ תַּחְתָּ֔יו וְהָעֲמָקִ֖ים יִתְבַּקָּ֑עוּ כַּדּוֹנַג֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָאֵ֔שׁ כְּמַ֖יִם מֻגָּרִ֥ים בְּמוֹרָֽד׃
verses.translit: vnmsv hhrym tchtyv vh'mqym ytbq'v khdvng mpny h'sh khmym mgrym bmvrd
verses.translation: And the mountains shall be molten under Him, And the valleys shall be cleft, As wax before the fire, As waters that are poured down a steep place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּפֶ֤שַׁע יַֽעֲקֹב֙ כׇּל־זֹ֔את וּבְחַטֹּ֖אות בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִֽי־פֶ֣שַׁע יַעֲקֹ֗ב הֲלוֹא֙ שֹֽׁמְר֔וֹן וּמִי֙ בָּמ֣וֹת יְהוּדָ֔ה הֲל֖וֹא יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: bpsh' y'qb khlz't vbcht'vt byt yshr'l mypsh' y'qb hlv' shmrvn vmy bmvt yhvdh hlv' yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: For the transgression of Jacob is all this, And for the sins of the house of Israel. What is the transgression of Jacob? Is it not Samaria? And what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֥י שֹׁמְר֛וֹן לְעִ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה לְמַטָּ֣עֵי כָ֑רֶם וְהִגַּרְתִּ֤י לַגַּי֙ אֲבָנֶ֔יהָ וִיסֹדֶ֖יהָ אֲגַלֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: vshmty shmrvn l'y hshdh lmt'y khrm vhgrty lgy 'bnyh vysdyh 'glh
verses.translation: Therefore I will make Samaria a heap in the field, A place for the planting of vineyards; And I will pour down the stones thereof into the valley, And I will uncover the foundations thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכׇל־פְּסִילֶ֣יהָ יֻכַּ֗תּוּ וְכׇל־אֶתְנַנֶּ֙יהָ֙ יִשָּׂרְפ֣וּ בָאֵ֔שׁ וְכׇל־עֲצַבֶּ֖יהָ אָשִׂ֣ים שְׁמָמָ֑ה כִּ֠י מֵאֶתְנַ֤ן זוֹנָה֙ קִבָּ֔צָה וְעַד־אֶתְנַ֥ן זוֹנָ֖ה יָשֽׁוּבוּ׃
verses.translit: vkhlpsylyh ykhtv vkhl'tnnyh yshrpv b'sh vkhl'tsbyh 'shym shmmh khy m'tnn zvnh qbtsh v'd'tnn zvnh yshvbv
verses.translation: And all her graven images shall be beaten to pieces, And all her hires shall be burned with fire, And all her idols will I lay desolate; For of the hire of a harlot hath she gathered them, And unto the hire of a harlot shall they return.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־זֹאת֙ אֶסְפְּדָ֣ה וְאֵילִ֔ילָה אֵילְכָ֥ה (שילל) [שׁוֹלָ֖ל] וְעָר֑וֹם אֶעֱשֶׂ֤ה מִסְפֵּד֙ כַּתַּנִּ֔ים וְאֵ֖בֶל כִּבְנ֥וֹת יַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lz't 'spdh v'ylylh 'ylkhh (shyll) [shvll] v'rvm ''shh mspd khtnym v'bl khbnvt y'nh
verses.translation: For this will I wail and howl, I will go stripped and naked; I will make a wailing like the jackals, And a mourning like the ostriches.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י אֲנוּשָׁ֖ה מַכּוֹתֶ֑יהָ כִּי־בָ֙אָה֙ עַד־יְהוּדָ֔ה נָגַ֛ע עַד־שַׁ֥עַר עַמִּ֖י עַד־יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: khy 'nvshh mkhvtyh khyb'h 'dyhvdh ng' 'dsh'r 'my 'dyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: For her wound is incurable; For it is come even unto Judah; It reacheth unto the gate of my people, even to Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּגַת֙ אַל־תַּגִּ֔ידוּ בָּכ֖וֹ אַל־תִּבְכּ֑וּ בְּבֵ֣ית לְעַפְרָ֔ה עָפָ֖ר (התפלשתי) [הִתְפַּלָּֽשִׁי]׃
verses.translit: bgt 'ltgydv bkhv 'ltbkhv bbyt l'prh 'pr (htplshty) [htplshy]
verses.translation: Tell it not in Gath, Weep not at all; At Beth-le-aphrah roll thyself in the dust.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִבְרִ֥י לָכֶ֛ם יוֹשֶׁ֥בֶת שָׁפִ֖יר עֶרְיָה־בֹ֑שֶׁת לֹ֤א יָֽצְאָה֙ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת צַֽאֲנָ֔ן מִסְפַּד֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֵ֔צֶל יִקַּ֥ח מִכֶּ֖ם עֶמְדָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'bry lkhm yvshbt shpyr 'ryhbsht l' yts'h yvshbt ts'nn mspd byt h'tsl yqch mkhm 'mdtv
verses.translation: Pass ye away, O inhabitant of Saphir, in nakedness and shame; The inhabitant of Zaanan is not come forth; The wailing of Beth-ezel shall take from you the standing-place thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־חָ֥לָֽה לְט֖וֹב יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת מָר֑וֹת כִּֽי־יָ֤רַד רָע֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה לְשַׁ֖עַר יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: khychlh ltvb yvshbt mrvt khyyrd r' m't yhvh lsh'r yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: For the inhabitant of Maroth waiteth anxiously for good; Because evil is come down from the LORD unto the gate of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְתֹ֧ם הַמֶּרְכָּבָ֛ה לָרֶ֖כֶשׁ יוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת לָכִ֑ישׁ רֵאשִׁ֨ית חַטָּ֥את הִיא֙ לְבַת־צִיּ֔וֹן כִּי־בָ֥ךְ נִמְצְא֖וּ פִּשְׁעֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: rtm hmrkhbh lrkhsh yvshbt lkhysh r'shyt cht't hy' lbttsyvn khybkh nmts'v psh'y yshr'l
verses.translation: Bind the chariots to the swift steeds, O inhabitant of Lachish; She was the beginning of sin to the daughter of Zion; For the transgressions of Israel are found in thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ תִּתְּנִ֣י שִׁלּוּחִ֔ים עַ֖ל מוֹרֶ֣שֶׁת גַּ֑ת בָּתֵּ֤י אַכְזִיב֙ לְאַכְזָ֔ב לְמַלְכֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lkhn ttny shlvchym 'l mvrsht gt bty 'khzyb l'khzb lmlkhy yshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore shalt thou give a parting gift to Moresheth-gath; The houses of Achzib shall be a deceitful thing unto the kings of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֹ֗ד הַיֹּרֵשׁ֙ אָ֣בִי לָ֔ךְ יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת מָֽרֵשָׁ֑ה עַד־עֲדֻלָּ֥ם יָב֖וֹא כְּב֥וֹד יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: 'd hyrsh 'by lkh yvshbt mrshh 'd'dlm ybv' khbvd yshr'l
verses.translation: I will yet bring unto thee, O inhabitant of Mareshah, him that shall possess thee; The glory of Israel shall come even unto Adullam.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קׇרְחִ֣י וָגֹ֔זִּי עַל־בְּנֵ֖י תַּעֲנוּגָ֑יִךְ הַרְחִ֤בִי קׇרְחָתֵךְ֙ כַּנֶּ֔שֶׁר כִּ֥י גָל֖וּ מִמֵּֽךְ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: qrchy vgzy 'lbny t'nvgykh hrchby qrchtkh khnshr khy glv mmkh {s}
verses.translation: Make thee bald, and poll thee for the children of thy delight; Enlarge thy baldness as the vulture; For they are gone into captivity from thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֧וֹי חֹֽשְׁבֵי־אָ֛וֶן וּפֹ֥עֲלֵי רָ֖ע עַל־מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָ֑ם בְּא֤וֹר הַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ יַעֲשׂ֔וּהָ כִּ֥י יֶשׁ־לְאֵ֖ל יָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: hvy chshby'vn vp'ly r' 'lmshkhbvtm b'vr hbqr y'shvh khy yshl'l ydm
verses.translation: Woe to them that devise iniquity And work evil upon their beds! When the morning is light, they execute it, Because it is in the power of their hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָמְד֤וּ שָׂדוֹת֙ וְגָזָ֔לוּ וּבָתִּ֖ים וְנָשָׂ֑אוּ וְעָֽשְׁקוּ֙ גֶּ֣בֶר וּבֵית֔וֹ וְאִ֖ישׁ וְנַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vchmdv shdvt vgzlv vbtym vnsh'v v'shqv gbr vbytv v'ysh vnchltv {s}
verses.translation: And they covet fields, and seize them; And houses, and take them away; Thus they oppress a man and his house, Even a man and his heritage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י חֹשֵׁ֛ב עַל־הַמִּשְׁפָּחָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את רָעָ֑ה אֲ֠שֶׁ֠ר לֹֽא־תָמִ֨ישׁוּ מִשָּׁ֜ם צַוְּארֹֽתֵיכֶ֗ם וְלֹ֤א תֵֽלְכוּ֙ רוֹמָ֔ה כִּ֛י עֵ֥ת רָעָ֖ה הִֽיא׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh 'mr yhvh hnny chshb 'lhmshpchh hz't r'h 'shr l'tmyshv mshm tsv'rtykhm vl' tlkhv rvmh khy 't r'h hy'
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD: Behold, against this family do I devise an evil, From which ye shall not remove your necks, Neither shall ye walk upright; for it shall be an evil time.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא יִשָּׂ֧א עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם מָשָׁ֗ל וְנָהָ֨ה נְהִ֤י נִֽהְיָה֙ אָמַר֙ שָׁד֣וֹד נְשַׁדֻּ֔נוּ חֵ֥לֶק עַמִּ֖י יָמִ֑יר אֵ֚יךְ יָמִ֣ישׁ לִ֔י לְשׁוֹבֵ֥ב שָׂדֵ֖ינוּ יְחַלֵּֽק׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ysh' 'lykhm mshl vnhh nhy nhyh 'mr shdvd nshdnv chlq 'my ymyr 'ykh ymysh ly lshvbb shdynv ychlq
verses.translation: In that day shall they take up a parable against you, And lament with a doleful lamentation, and say: ‘We are utterly ruined; He changeth the portion of my people; How doth he remove it from me! Instead of restoring our fields, he divideth them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ לֹֽא־יִֽהְיֶ֣ה לְךָ֔ מַשְׁלִ֥יךְ חֶ֖בֶל בְּגוֹרָ֑ל בִּקְהַ֖ל יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: lkhn l'yhyh lkh mshlykh chbl bgvrl bqhl yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt have none that shall cast the line by lot In the congregation of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּטִּ֖פוּ יַטִּיפ֑וּן לֹֽא־יַטִּ֣פוּ לָאֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א יִסַּ֖ג כְּלִמּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'lttpv ytypvn l'ytpv l'lh l' ysg khlmvt
verses.translation: ’Preach ye not’, they preach; ‘They shall not preach of these things, That they shall not take shame.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֶאָמ֣וּר בֵּֽית־יַעֲקֹ֗ב הֲקָצַר֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהֹוָ֔ה אִם־אֵ֖לֶּה מַעֲלָלָ֑יו הֲל֤וֹא דְבָרַי֙ יֵיטִ֔יבוּ עִ֖ם הַיָּשָׁ֥ר הֹלֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: h'mvr byty'qb hqtsr rvch yhvh 'm'lh m'llyv hlv' dbry yytybv 'm hyshr hlkh
verses.translation: Do I change, O house of Jacob? Is the spirit of the LORD straitened? Are these His doings? Do not My words do good to him that walketh uprightly?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶתְמ֗וּל עַמִּי֙ לְאוֹיֵ֣ב יְקוֹמֵ֔ם מִמּ֣וּל שַׂלְמָ֔ה אֶ֖דֶר תַּפְשִׁט֑וּן מֵעֹבְרִ֣ים בֶּ֔טַח שׁוּבֵ֖י מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'tmvl 'my l'vyb yqvmm mmvl shlmh 'dr tpshtvn m'brym btch shvby mlchmh
verses.translation: But of late My people is risen up as an enemy; With the garment ye strip also the mantle From them that pass by securely, so that they are as men returning from war.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְשֵׁ֤י עַמִּי֙ תְּגָ֣רְשׁ֔וּן מִבֵּ֖ית תַּֽעֲנֻגֶ֑יהָ מֵעַל֙ עֹֽלָלֶ֔יהָ תִּקְח֥וּ הֲדָרִ֖י לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: nshy 'my tgrshvn mbyt t'ngyh m'l 'llyh tqchv hdry l'vlm
verses.translation: The women of My people ye cast out from their pleasant houses; From their young children ye take away My glory for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֣וּמוּ וּלְכ֔וּ כִּ֥י לֹא־זֹ֖את הַמְּנוּחָ֑ה בַּעֲב֥וּר טָמְאָ֛ה תְּחַבֵּ֖ל וְחֶ֥בֶל נִמְרָֽץ׃
verses.translit: qvmv vlkhv khy l'z't hmnvchh b'bvr tm'h tchbl vchbl nmrts
verses.translation: Arise ye, and depart; for this is not your resting-place; Because of the uncleanness thereof, it shall destroy you, even with a sore destruction.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לוּ־אִ֞ישׁ הֹלֵ֥ךְ ר֙וּחַ֙ וָשֶׁ֣קֶר כִּזֵּ֔ב אַטִּ֣ף לְךָ֔ לַיַּ֖יִן וְלַשֵּׁכָ֑ר וְהָיָ֥ה מַטִּ֖יף הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: lv'ysh hlkh rvch vshqr khzb 'tf lkh lyyn vlshkhr vhyh mtyf h'm hzh
verses.translation: If a man walking in wind and falsehood do lie: ‘I will preach unto thee of wine and of strong drink’; He shall even be the preacher of this people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָסֹ֨ף אֶאֱסֹ֜ף יַעֲקֹ֣ב כֻּלָּ֗ךְ קַבֵּ֤ץ אֲקַבֵּץ֙ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יַ֥חַד אֲשִׂימֶ֖נּוּ כְּצֹ֣אן בׇּצְרָ֑ה כְּעֵ֙דֶר֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַדׇּֽבְר֔וֹ תְּהִימֶ֖נָה מֵאָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'sf ''sf y'qb khlkh qbts 'qbts sh'ryt yshr'l ychd 'shymnv khts'n btsrh kh'dr btvkh hdbrv thymnh m'dm
verses.translation: I will surely assemble, O Jacob, all of thee; I will surely gather the remnant of Israel; I will render them all as sheep in a fold; As a flock in the midst of their pasture; They shall make great noise by reason of the multitude of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָלָ֤ה הַפֹּרֵץ֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם פָּֽרְצוּ֙ וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֔רוּ שַׁ֖עַר וַיֵּ֣צְאוּ ב֑וֹ וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ר מַלְכָּם֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם וַיהֹוָ֖ה בְּרֹאשָֽׁם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'lh hprts lpnyhm prtsv vy'brv sh'r vyts'v bv vy'br mlkhm lpnyhm vyhvh br'shm {p}
verses.translation: The breaker is gone up before them; They have broken forth and passed on, By the gate, and are gone out thereat; And their king is passed on before them, And the LORD at the head of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר שִׁמְעוּ־נָא֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּקְצִינֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲל֣וֹא לָכֶ֔ם לָדַ֖עַת אֶת־הַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: v'mr shm'vn' r'shy y'qb vqtsyny byt yshr'l hlv' lkhm ld't 'thmshpt
verses.translation: And I said: Hear, I pray you, ye heads of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel: Is it not for you to know justice?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֹׂ֥נְאֵי ט֖וֹב וְאֹ֣הֲבֵי (רעה) [רָ֑ע] גֹּזְלֵ֤י עוֹרָם֙ מֵֽעֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וּשְׁאֵרָ֖ם מֵעַ֥ל עַצְמוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: shn'y tvb v'hby (r'h) [r'] gzly 'vrm m'lyhm vsh'rm m'l 'tsmvtm
verses.translation: Who hate the good, and love the evil; who rob their skin from off them, and their flesh from off their bones;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר אָכְלוּ֮ שְׁאֵ֣ר עַמִּי֒ וְעוֹרָם֙ מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֣ם הִפְשִׁ֔יטוּ וְאֶת־עַצְמֹֽתֵיהֶ֖ם פִּצֵּ֑חוּ וּפָֽרְשׂוּ֙ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּסִּ֔יר וּכְבָשָׂ֖ר בְּת֥וֹךְ קַלָּֽחַת׃
verses.translit: v'shr 'khlv sh'r 'my v'vrm m'lyhm hpshytv v't'tsmtyhm ptschv vprshv kh'shr bsyr vkhbshr btvkh qlcht
verses.translation: Who also eat the flesh of my people, and flay their skin from off them, and break their bones; yea, they chop them in pieces, as that which is in the pot, and as flesh within the caldron.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֚ז יִזְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א יַעֲנֶ֖ה אוֹתָ֑ם וְיַסְתֵּ֨ר פָּנָ֤יו מֵהֶם֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵרֵ֖עוּ מַעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'z yz'qv 'lyhvh vl' y'nh 'vtm vystr pnyv mhm b't hhy' kh'shr hr'v m'llyhm {p}
verses.translation: Then shall they cry unto the LORD, But He will not answer them; yea, He will hide His face from them at that time, According as they have wrought evil in their doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה עַל־הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים הַמַּתְעִ֣ים אֶת־עַמִּ֑י הַנֹּשְׁכִ֤ים בְּשִׁנֵּיהֶם֙ וְקָרְא֣וּ שָׁל֔וֹם וַֽאֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא־יִתֵּ֣ן עַל־פִּיהֶ֔ם וְקִדְּשׁ֥וּ עָלָ֖יו מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lhnby'ym hmt'ym 't'my hnshkhym bshnyhm vqr'v shlvm v'shr l'ytn 'lpyhm vqdshv 'lyv mlchmh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD concerning the prophets that make my people to err; that cry: ‘Peace’, when their teeth have any thing to bite; and whoso putteth not into their mouths, they even prepare war against him:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן לַ֤יְלָה לָכֶם֙ מֵֽחָז֔וֹן וְחָשְׁכָ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם מִקְּסֹ֑ם וּבָ֤אָה הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ עַל־הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים וְקָדַ֥ר עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: lkhn lylh lkhm mchzvn vchshkhh lkhm mqsm vb'h hshmsh 'lhnby'ym vqdr 'lyhm hyvm
verses.translation: Therefore it shall be night unto you, that ye shall have no vision; and it shall be dark unto you, that ye shall not divine; and the sun shall go down upon the prophets, and the day shall be black over them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבֹ֣שׁוּ הַחֹזִ֗ים וְחָֽפְרוּ֙ הַקֹּ֣סְמִ֔ים וְעָט֥וּ עַל־שָׂפָ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑ם כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין מַעֲנֵ֖ה אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: vbshv hchzym vchprv hqsmym v'tv 'lshpm khlm khy 'yn m'nh 'lhym
verses.translation: And the seers shall be put to shame, and the diviners confounded; yea, they shall all cover their upper lips; for there shall be no answer of God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאוּלָ֗ם אָנֹכִ֞י מָלֵ֤אתִי כֹ֙חַ֙ אֶת־ר֣וּחַ יְהֹוָ֔ה וּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּגְבוּרָ֑ה לְהַגִּ֤יד לְיַֽעֲקֹב֙ פִּשְׁע֔וֹ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חַטָּאתֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'vlm 'nkhy ml'ty khch 'trvch yhvh vmshpt vgbvrh lhgyd ly'qb psh'v vlyshr'l cht'tv {p}
verses.translation: But I truly am full of power by the spirit of the LORD, and of justice, and of might, to declare unto Jacob his transgression, and to Israel his sin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֣א זֹ֗את רָאשֵׁי֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּקְצִינֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַֽמְתַעֲבִ֣ים מִשְׁפָּ֔ט וְאֵ֥ת כׇּל־הַיְשָׁרָ֖ה יְעַקֵּֽשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: shm'vn' z't r'shy byt y'qb vqtsyny byt yshr'l hmt'bym mshpt v't khlhyshrh y'qshv
verses.translation: Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and rulers of the house of Israel, that abhor justice, and pervert all equity;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֹּנֶ֥ה צִיּ֖וֹן בְּדָמִ֑ים וִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בְּעַוְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: bnh tsyvn bdmym vyrvshl͏m b'vlh
verses.translation: That build up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאשֶׁ֣יהָ  בְּשֹׁ֣חַד יִשְׁפֹּ֗טוּ וְכֹהֲנֶ֙יהָ֙ בִּמְחִ֣יר יוֹר֔וּ וּנְבִיאֶ֖יהָ בְּכֶ֣סֶף יִקְסֹ֑מוּ וְעַל־יְהֹוָה֙ יִשָּׁעֵ֣נוּ לֵאמֹ֔ר הֲל֤וֹא יְהֹוָה֙ בְּקִרְבֵּ֔נוּ לֹֽא־תָב֥וֹא עָלֵ֖ינוּ רָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: r'shyh  bshchd yshptv vkhhnyh bmchyr yvrv vnby'yh bkhsf yqsmv v'lyhvh ysh'nv l'mr hlv' yhvh bqrbnv l'tbv' 'lynv r'h
verses.translation: The heads thereof judge for reward, and the priests thereof teach for hire, and the prophets thereof divine for money; yet will they lean upon the LORD, and say: ‘Is not the LORD in the midst of us? No evil shall come upon us’?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵן֙ בִּגְלַלְכֶ֔ם צִיּ֖וֹן שָׂדֶ֣ה תֵֽחָרֵ֑שׁ וִירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ עִיִּ֣ין תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה וְהַ֥ר הַבַּ֖יִת לְבָמ֥וֹת יָֽעַר׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lkhn bgllkhm tsyvn shdh tchrsh vyrvshl͏m 'yyn thyh vhr hbyt lbmvt y'r {p}
verses.translation: Therefore shall Zion for your sake be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become heaps, and the mountain of the house as the high places of a forest.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֗ים יִ֠הְיֶ֠ה הַ֣ר בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֤ה נָכוֹן֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הֶהָרִ֔ים וְנִשָּׂ֥א ה֖וּא מִגְּבָע֑וֹת וְנָהֲר֥וּ עָלָ֖יו עַמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vhyh  b'chryt hymym yhyh hr bytyhvh nkhvn br'sh hhrym vnsh' hv' mgb'vt vnhrv 'lyv 'mym
verses.translation: But in the end of days it shall come to pass, That the mountain of the LORD’S house shall be established as the top of the mountains, And it shall be exalted above the hills; And peoples shall flow unto it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהָלְכ֞וּ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֗ים וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ  וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל־הַר־יְהֹוָ֗ה וְאֶל־בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיוֹרֵ֙נוּ֙ מִדְּרָכָ֔יו וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּאֹֽרְחֹתָ֑יו כִּ֤י מִצִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּדְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה מִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vhlkhv gvym rbym v'mrv lkhv  vn'lh 'lhryhvh v'lbyt 'lhy y'qb vyvrnv mdrkhyv vnlkhh b'rchtyv khy mtsyvn tts' tvrh vdbryhvh myrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And many nations shall go and say: ‘Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the LORD, And to the house of the God of Jacob; And He will teach us of His ways, And we will walk in His paths’; For out of Zion shall go forth the law, And the word of the LORD from Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁפַ֗ט בֵּ֚ין עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים וְהוֹכִ֛יחַ לְגוֹיִ֥ם עֲצֻמִ֖ים עַד־רָח֑וֹק וְכִתְּת֨וּ חַרְבֹתֵיהֶ֜ם לְאִתִּ֗ים וַחֲנִיתֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ לְמַזְמֵר֔וֹת לֹֽא־יִשְׂא֞וּ גּ֤וֹי אֶל־גּוֹי֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְלֹא־יִלְמְד֥וּן ע֖וֹד מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vshpt byn 'mym rbym vhvkhych lgvym 'tsmym 'drchvq vkhttv chrbtyhm l'tym vchnyttyhm lmzmrvt l'ysh'v gvy 'lgvy chrb vl'ylmdvn 'vd mlchmh
verses.translation: And He shall judge between many peoples, And shall decide concerning mighty nations afar off; And they shall beat their swords into plowshares, And their spears into pruninghooks; Nation shall not lift up sword against nation, Neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָשְׁב֗וּ אִ֣ישׁ תַּ֧חַת גַּפְנ֛וֹ וְתַ֥חַת תְּאֵנָת֖וֹ וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד כִּי־פִ֛י יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת דִּבֵּֽר׃
verses.translit: vyshbv 'ysh tcht gpnv vtcht t'ntv v'yn mchryd khypy yhvh tsb'vt dbr
verses.translation: But they shall sit every man under his vine and under his fig-tree; And none shall make them afraid; For the mouth of the LORD of hosts hath spoken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י כׇּל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים יֵלְכ֕וּ אִ֖ישׁ בְּשֵׁ֣ם אֱלֹהָ֑יו וַאֲנַ֗חְנוּ נֵלֵ֛ךְ בְּשֵׁם־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy khlh'mym ylkhv 'ysh bshm 'lhyv v'nchnv nlkh bshmyhvh 'lhynv l'vlm v'd {p}
verses.translation: For let all the peoples walk each one in the name of its god, But we will walk in the name of the LORD our God for ever and ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֗ה אֹֽסְפָה֙ הַצֹּ֣לֵעָ֔ה וְהַנִּדָּחָ֖ה אֲקַבֵּ֑צָה וַאֲשֶׁ֖ר הֲרֵעֹֽתִי׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' n'myhvh 'sph htsl'h vhndchh 'qbtsh v'shr hr'ty
verses.translation: In that day, saith the LORD, will I assemble her that halteth, And I will gather her that is driven away, And her that I have afflicted;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׂמְתִּ֤י אֶת־הַצֹּֽלֵעָה֙ לִשְׁאֵרִ֔ית וְהַנַּהֲלָאָ֖ה לְג֣וֹי עָצ֑וּם וּמָלַ֨ךְ יְהֹוָ֤ה עֲלֵיהֶם֙ בְּהַ֣ר צִיּ֔וֹן מֵעַתָּ֖ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshmty 'thtsl'h lsh'ryt vhnhl'h lgvy 'tsvm vmlkh yhvh 'lyhm bhr tsyvn m'th v'd'vlm {p}
verses.translation: And I will make her that halted a remnant, And her that was cast far off a mighty nation; And the LORD shall reign over them in mount Zion from thenceforth even for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה מִגְדַּל־עֵ֗דֶר עֹ֛פֶל בַּת־צִיּ֖וֹן עָדֶ֣יךָ תֵּאתֶ֑ה וּבָאָ֗ה הַמֶּמְשָׁלָה֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנָ֔ה מַמְלֶ֖כֶת לְבַ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: v'th mgdl'dr 'pl bttsyvn 'dykh t'th vb'h hmmshlh hr'shnh mmlkht lbt yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And thou, Migdal-eder, the hill of the daughter of Zion, Unto thee shall it come; Yea, the former dominion shall come, The kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּ֕ה לָ֥מָּה תָרִ֖יעִי רֵ֑עַ הֲמֶ֣לֶךְ אֵֽין־בָּ֗ךְ אִֽם־יוֹעֲצֵךְ֙ אָבָ֔ד כִּֽי־הֶחֱזִיקֵ֥ךְ חִ֖יל כַּיּוֹלֵדָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'th lmh try'y r' hmlkh 'ynbkh 'myv'tskh 'bd khyhchzyqkh chyl khyvldh
verses.translation: Now why dost thou cry out aloud? Is there no King in thee, Is thy Counsellor perished, That pangs have taken hold of thee as of a woman in travail?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ח֧וּלִי וָגֹ֛חִי בַּת־צִיּ֖וֹן כַּיּֽוֹלֵדָ֑ה כִּֽי־עַתָּה֩ תֵצְאִ֨י מִקִּרְיָ֜ה וְשָׁכַ֣נְתְּ בַּשָּׂדֶ֗ה וּבָ֤את עַד־בָּבֶל֙ שָׁ֣ם תִּנָּצֵ֔לִי שָׁ֚ם יִגְאָלֵ֣ךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה מִכַּ֖ף אֹיְבָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: chvly vgchy bttsyvn khyvldh khy'th tts'y mqryh vshkhnt bshdh vb't 'dbbl shm tntsly shm yg'lkh yhvh mkhf 'ybykh
verses.translation: Be in pain, and labour to bring forth, O daughter of Zion, Like a woman in travail; For now shalt thou go forth out of the city, And shalt dwell in the field, And shalt come even unto Babylon; There shalt thou be rescued; There shall the LORD redeem thee from the hand of thine enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֛ה נֶאֶסְפ֥וּ עָלַ֖יִךְ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים הָאֹמְרִ֣ים תֶּחֱנָ֔ף וְתַ֥חַז בְּצִיּ֖וֹן עֵינֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: v'th n'spv 'lykh gvym rbym h'mrym tchnf vtchz btsyvn 'ynynv
verses.translation: And now many nations are assembled against thee, That say: ‘Let her be defiled, and let our eye gaze upon Zion.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵ֗מָּה לֹ֤א יָֽדְעוּ֙ מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת יְהֹוָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א הֵבִ֖ינוּ עֲצָת֑וֹ כִּ֥י קִבְּצָ֖ם כֶּעָמִ֥יר גֹּֽרְנָה׃
verses.translit: vhmh l' yd'v mchshbvt yhvh vl' hbynv 'tstv khy qbtsm kh'myr grnh
verses.translation: But they know not the thoughts of the LORD, Neither understand they His counsel; For He hath gathered them as the sheaves to the threshing-floor.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֧וּמִי וָד֣וֹשִׁי בַת־צִיּ֗וֹן כִּֽי־קַרְנֵ֞ךְ אָשִׂ֤ים בַּרְזֶל֙ וּפַרְסֹתַ֙יִךְ֙ אָשִׂ֣ים נְחוּשָׁ֔ה וַהֲדִקּ֖וֹת עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְהַחֲרַמְתִּ֤י לַֽיהֹוָה֙ בִּצְעָ֔ם וְחֵילָ֖ם לַאֲד֥וֹן כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: qvmy vdvshy bttsyvn khyqrnkh 'shym brzl vprstykh 'shym nchvshh vhdqvt 'mym rbym vhchrmty lyhvh bts'm vchylm l'dvn khlh'rts
verses.translation: Arise and thresh, O daughter of Zion; For I will make thy horn iron, And I will make thy hoofs brass; And thou shalt beat in pieces many peoples; And thou shalt devote their gain unto the LORD, And their substance unto the Lord of the whole earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּה֙ תִּתְגֹּדְדִ֣י בַת־גְּד֔וּד מָצ֖וֹר שָׂ֣ם עָלֵ֑ינוּ בַּשֵּׁ֙בֶט֙ יַכּ֣וּ עַֽל־הַלְּחִ֔י אֵ֖ת שֹׁפֵ֥ט יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: 'th ttgddy btgdvd mtsvr shm 'lynv bshbt ykhv 'lhlchy 't shpt yshr'l {s}
verses.translation: Now shalt thou gather thyself in troops, O daughter of troops; They have laid siege against us; They smite the judge of Israel with a rod upon the cheek.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה בֵּֽית־לֶ֣חֶם אֶפְרָ֗תָה צָעִיר֙ לִֽהְיוֹת֙ בְּאַלְפֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מִמְּךָ֙ לִ֣י יֵצֵ֔א לִֽהְי֥וֹת מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמוֹצָאֹתָ֥יו מִקֶּ֖דֶם מִימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th bytlchm 'prth ts'yr lhyvt b'lpy yhvdh mmkh ly yts' lhyvt mvshl byshr'l vmvts'tyv mqdm mymy 'vlm
verses.translation: But thou, Beth-lehem Ephrathah, Which art little to be among the thousands of Judah, Out of thee shall one come forth unto Me that is to be ruler in Israel; Whose goings forth are from of old, from ancient days.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן יִתְּנֵ֔ם עַד־עֵ֥ת יוֹלֵדָ֖ה יָלָ֑דָה וְיֶ֣תֶר אֶחָ֔יו יְשׁוּב֖וּן עַל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: lkhn ytnm 'd't yvldh yldh vytr 'chyv yshvbvn 'lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: Therefore will He give them up, Until the time that she who travaileth hath brought forth; Then the residue of his brethren shall return with the children of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָמַ֗ד וְרָעָה֙ בְּעֹ֣ז יְהֹוָ֔ה בִּגְא֕וֹן שֵׁ֖ם יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וְיָשָׁ֕בוּ כִּֽי־עַתָּ֥ה יִגְדַּ֖ל עַד־אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'md vr'h b'z yhvh bg'vn shm yhvh 'lhyv vyshbv khy'th ygdl 'd'psy'rts
verses.translation: And he shall stand, and shall feed his flock in the strength of the LORD, In the majesty of the name of the LORD his God; And they shall abide, for then shall he be great unto the ends of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֥ה זֶ֖ה שָׁל֑וֹם אַשּׁ֣וּר  כִּֽי־יָב֣וֹא בְאַרְצֵ֗נוּ וְכִ֤י יִדְרֹךְ֙ בְּאַרְמְנוֹתֵ֔ינוּ וַהֲקֵמֹ֤נוּ עָלָיו֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה רֹעִ֔ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֖ה נְסִיכֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyh zh shlvm 'shvr  khyybv' b'rtsnv vkhy ydrkh b'rmnvtynv vhqmnv 'lyv shb'h r'ym vshmnh nsykhy 'dm
verses.translation: And this shall be peace: When the Assyrian shall come into our land, And when he shall tread in our palaces, Then shall we raise against him seven shepherds, And eight princes among men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָע֞וּ אֶת־אֶ֤רֶץ אַשּׁוּר֙ בַּחֶ֔רֶב וְאֶת־אֶ֥רֶץ נִמְרֹ֖ד בִּפְתָחֶ֑יהָ וְהִצִּיל֙ מֵֽאַשּׁ֔וּר כִּֽי־יָב֣וֹא בְאַרְצֵ֔נוּ וְכִ֥י יִדְרֹ֖ךְ בִּגְבוּלֵֽנוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vr'v 't'rts 'shvr bchrb v't'rts nmrd bptchyh vhtsyl m'shvr khyybv' b'rtsnv vkhy ydrkh bgbvlnv {p}
verses.translation: And they shall waste the land of Assyria with the sword, And the land of Nimrod with the keen-edged sword; And he shall deliver us from the Assyrian, when he cometh into our land, And when he treadeth within our border.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֗ב בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים כְּטַל֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּרְבִיבִ֖ים עֲלֵי־עֵ֑שֶׂב אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־יְקַוֶּה֙ לְאִ֔ישׁ וְלֹ֥א יְיַחֵ֖ל לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyh  sh'ryt y'qb bqrb 'mym rbym khtl m't yhvh khrbybym 'ly'shb 'shr l'yqvh l'ysh vl' yychl lbny 'dm {p}
verses.translation: And the remnant of Jacob shall be in the midst of many peoples, As dew from the LORD, as showers upon the grass, That are not looked for from man, Nor awaited at the hands of the sons of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ שְׁאֵרִ֨ית יַעֲקֹ֜ב בַּגּוֹיִ֗ם בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים כְּאַרְיֵה֙ בְּבַהֲמ֣וֹת יַ֔עַר כִּכְפִ֖יר בְּעֶדְרֵי־צֹ֑אן אֲשֶׁ֧ר אִם־עָבַ֛ר וְרָמַ֥ס וְטָרַ֖ף וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: vhyh sh'ryt y'qb bgvym bqrb 'mym rbym kh'ryh bbhmvt y'r khkhpyr b'dryts'n 'shr 'm'br vrms vtrf v'yn mtsyl
verses.translation: And the remnant of Jacob shall be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, As a lion among the beasts of the forest, As a young lion among the flocks of sheep, Who, if he go through, treadeth down and teareth in pieces, And there is none to deliver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּרֹ֥ם יָדְךָ֖ עַל־צָרֶ֑יךָ וְכׇל־אֹיְבֶ֖יךָ יִכָּרֵֽתוּ׃
verses.translit: trm ydkh 'ltsrykh vkhl'ybykh ykhrtv
verses.translation: Let Thy hand be lifted up above Thine adversaries, And let all Thine enemies be cut off. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה בַיּוֹם־הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י סוּסֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖י מַרְכְּבֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvmhhv' n'myhvh vhkhrty svsykh mqrbkh vh'bdty mrkhbtykh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD, That I will cut off thy horses out of the midst of thee, And will destroy thy chariots;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֖י עָרֵ֣י אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְהָרַסְתִּ֖י כׇּל־מִבְצָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vhkhrty 'ry 'rtskh vhrsty khlmbtsrykh
verses.translation: And I will cut off the cities of thy land, And will throw down all thy strongholds;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י כְשָׁפִ֖ים מִיָּדֶ֑ךָ וּֽמְעוֹנְנִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִֽהְיוּ־לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vhkhrty khshpym mydkh vm'vnnym l' yhyvlkh
verses.translation: And I will cut off witchcrafts out of thy hand; And thou shalt have no more soothsayers;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֧י פְסִילֶ֛יךָ וּמַצֵּבוֹתֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְלֹא־תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד לְמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vhkhrty psylykh vmtsbvtykh mqrbkh vl'tshtchvh 'vd lm'shh ydykh
verses.translation: And I will cut off thy graven images and thy pillars out of the midst of thee; And thou shalt no more worship the work of thy hands.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָתַשְׁתִּ֥י אֲשֵׁירֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְהִשְׁמַדְתִּ֖י עָרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: vntshty 'shyrykh mqrbkh vhshmdty 'rykh
verses.translation: And I will pluck up thy Asherim out of the midst of thee; And I will destroy thine enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתִי בְּאַ֧ף וּבְחֵמָ֛ה נָקָ֖ם אֶת־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'shyty b'f vbchmh nqm 'thgvym 'shr l' shm'v {p}
verses.translation: And I will execute vengeance in anger and fury upon the nations, Because they hearkened not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־נָ֕א אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֹמֵ֑ר ק֚וּם רִ֣יב אֶת־הֶהָרִ֔ים וְתִשְׁמַ֥עְנָה הַגְּבָע֖וֹת קוֹלֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: shm'vn' 't 'shryhvh 'mr qvm ryb 'thhrym vtshm'nh hgb'vt qvlkh
verses.translation: Hear ye now what the LORD saith: Arise, contend thou before the mountains, And let the hills hear thy voice.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁמְע֤וּ הָרִים֙ אֶת־רִ֣יב יְהֹוָ֔ה וְהָאֵתָנִ֖ים מ֣וֹסְדֵי אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י רִ֤יב לַֽיהֹוָה֙ עִם־עַמּ֔וֹ וְעִם־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִתְוַכָּֽח׃
verses.translit: shm'v hrym 'tryb yhvh vh'tnym mvsdy 'rts khy ryb lyhvh 'm'mv v'myshr'l ytvkhch
verses.translation: Hear, O ye mountains, the LORD’S controversy, And ye enduring rocks, the foundations of the earth; For the LORD hath a controversy with His people, And He will plead with Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַמִּ֛י מֶה־עָשִׂ֥יתִי לְךָ֖ וּמָ֣ה הֶלְאֵתִ֑יךָ עֲנֵ֥ה בִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'my mh'shyty lkh vmh hl'tykh 'nh by
verses.translation: O My people, what have I done unto thee? And wherein have I wearied thee? Testify against Me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י הֶעֱלִתִ֙יךָ֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּמִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִ֖ים פְּדִיתִ֑יךָ וָאֶשְׁלַ֣ח לְפָנֶ֔יךָ אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּמִרְיָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy h'ltykh m'rts mtsrym vmbyt 'bdym pdytykh v'shlch lpnykh 'tmshh 'hrn vmrym
verses.translation: For I brought thee up out of the land of Egypt, And redeemed thee out of the house of bondage, And I sent before thee Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַמִּ֗י זְכׇר־נָא֙ מַה־יָּעַ֗ץ בָּלָק֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב וּמֶה־עָנָ֥ה אֹת֖וֹ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן־בְּע֑וֹר מִן־הַשִּׁטִּים֙ עַד־הַגִּלְגָּ֔ל לְמַ֕עַן דַּ֖עַת צִדְק֥וֹת יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'my zkhrn' mhy'ts blq mlkh mv'b vmh'nh 'tv bl'm bnb'vr mnhshtym 'dhglgl lm'n d't tsdqvt yhvh
verses.translation: O My people, remember now what Balak king of Moab devised, And what Balaam the son of Beor answered him; From Shittim unto Gilgal, That ye may know the righteous acts of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּמָּה֙ אֲקַדֵּ֣ם יְהֹוָ֔ה אִכַּ֖ף לֵאלֹהֵ֣י מָר֑וֹם הַאֲקַדְּמֶ֣נּוּ בְעוֹל֔וֹת בַּעֲגָלִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: bmh 'qdm yhvh 'khf l'lhy mrvm h'qdmnv b'vlvt b'glym bny shnh
verses.translation: ’Wherewith shall I come before the LORD, And bow myself before God on high? Shall I come before Him with burnt-offerings, With calves of a year old?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיִרְצֶ֤ה יְהֹוָה֙ בְּאַלְפֵ֣י אֵילִ֔ים בְּרִֽבְב֖וֹת נַחֲלֵי־שָׁ֑מֶן הַאֶתֵּ֤ן בְּכוֹרִי֙ פִּשְׁעִ֔י פְּרִ֥י בִטְנִ֖י חַטַּ֥את נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: hyrtsh yhvh b'lpy 'ylym brbbvt nchlyshmn h'tn bkhvry psh'y pry btny cht't npshy
verses.translation: Will the LORD be pleased with thousands of rams, With ten thousands of rivers of oil? Shall I give my first-born for my transgression, The fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִגִּ֥יד לְךָ֛ אָדָ֖ם מַה־טּ֑וֹב וּמָֽה־יְהֹוָ֞ה דּוֹרֵ֣שׁ מִמְּךָ֗ כִּ֣י אִם־עֲשׂ֤וֹת מִשְׁפָּט֙ וְאַ֣הֲבַת חֶ֔סֶד וְהַצְנֵ֥עַ לֶ֖כֶת עִם־אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hgyd lkh 'dm mhtvb vmhyhvh dvrsh mmkh khy 'm'shvt mshpt v'hbt chsd vhtsn' lkht 'm'lhykh {s}
verses.translation: It hath been told thee, O man, what is good, And what the LORD doth require of thee: Only to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֤וֹל יְהֹוָה֙ לָעִ֣יר יִקְרָ֔א וְתוּשִׁיָּ֖ה יִרְאֶ֣ה שְׁמֶ֑ךָ שִׁמְע֥וּ מַטֶּ֖ה וּמִ֥י יְעָדָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: qvl yhvh l'yr yqr' vtvshyh yr'h shmkh shm'v mth vmy y'dh
verses.translation: Hark! the LORD crieth unto the city— And it is wisdom to have regard for Thy name— Hear ye the rod, and who hath appointed it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֗וֹד הַאִשׁ֙ בֵּ֣ית רָשָׁ֔ע אֹצְר֖וֹת רֶ֑שַׁע וְאֵיפַ֥ת רָז֖וֹן זְעוּמָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'vd h'sh byt rsh' 'tsrvt rsh' v'ypt rzvn z'vmh
verses.translation: Are there yet the treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, And the scant measure that is abominable?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַאֶזְכֶּ֖ה בְּמֹ֣אזְנֵי רֶ֑שַׁע וּבְכִ֖יס אַבְנֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: h'zkhh bm'zny rsh' vbkhys 'bny mrmh
verses.translation: ’Shall I be pure with wicked balances, And with a bag of deceitful weights?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר עֲשִׁירֶ֙יהָ֙ מָלְא֣וּ חָמָ֔ס וְיֹשְׁבֶ֖יהָ דִּבְּרוּ־שָׁ֑קֶר וּלְשׁוֹנָ֖ם רְמִיָּ֥ה בְּפִיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'shr 'shyryh ml'v chms vyshbyh dbrvshqr vlshvnm rmyh bpyhm
verses.translation: For the rich men thereof are full of violence, And the inhabitants thereof have spoken lies, And their tongue is deceitful in their mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־אֲנִ֖י הֶחֱלֵ֣יתִי הַכּוֹתֶ֑ךָ הַשְׁמֵ֖ם עַל־חַטֹּאתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vgm'ny hchlyty hkhvtkh hshmm 'lcht'tkh
verses.translation: Therefore I also do smite thee with a grievous wound; I do make thee desolate because of thy sins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה תֹאכַל֙ וְלֹ֣א תִשְׂבָּ֔ע וְיֶשְׁחֲךָ֖ בְּקִרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְתַסֵּג֙ וְלֹ֣א תַפְלִ֔יט וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּפַלֵּ֖ט לַחֶ֥רֶב אֶתֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: 'th t'khl vl' tshb' vyshchkh bqrbkh vtsg vl' tplyt v'shr tplt lchrb 'tn
verses.translation: Thou shalt eat, but not be satisfied; And thy sickness shall be in thine inward parts; And thou shalt conceive, but shalt not bring forth; And whomsoever thou bringest forth will I give up to the sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּ֥ה תִזְרַ֖ע וְלֹ֣א תִקְצ֑וֹר אַתָּ֤ה תִדְרֹֽךְ־זַ֙יִת֙ וְלֹא־תָס֣וּךְ שֶׁ֔מֶן וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁתֶּה־יָּֽיִן׃
verses.translit: 'th tzr' vl' tqtsvr 'th tdrkhzyt vl'tsvkh shmn vtyrvsh vl' tshthyyn
verses.translation: Thou shalt sow, but shalt not reap; Thou shalt tread the olives, but shalt not anoint thee with oil; And the vintage, but shalt not drink wine.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִשְׁתַּמֵּ֞ר חֻקּ֣וֹת עׇמְרִ֗י וְכֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה בֵית־אַחְאָ֔ב וַתֵּלְכ֖וּ בְּמֹעֲצוֹתָ֑ם לְמַ֩עַן֩ תִּתִּ֨י אֹתְךָ֜ לְשַׁמָּ֗ה וְיֹשְׁבֶ֙יהָ֙ לִשְׁרֵקָ֔ה וְחֶרְפַּ֥ת עַמִּ֖י תִּשָּֽׂאוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyshtmr chqvt 'mry vkhl m'shh byt'ch'b vtlkhv bm'tsvtm lm'n tty 'tkh lshmh vyshbyh lshrqh vchrpt 'my tsh'v {p}
verses.translation: For the statutes of Omri are kept, And all the works of the house of Ahab, And ye walk in their counsels; That I may make thee an astonishment, And the inhabitants thereof a hissing; And ye shall bear the reproach of My people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣לְלַי לִ֗י כִּ֤י הָיִ֙יתִי֙ כְּאׇסְפֵּי־קַ֔יִץ כְּעֹלְלֹ֖ת בָּצִ֑יר אֵין־אֶשְׁכּ֣וֹל לֶאֱכ֔וֹל בִּכּוּרָ֖ה אִוְּתָ֥ה נַפְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: 'lly ly khy hyyty kh'spyqyts kh'llt btsyr 'yn'shkhvl l'khvl bkhvrh 'vth npshy
verses.translation: Woe is me! for I am as the last of the summer fruits, As the grape gleanings of the vintage; There is no cluster to eat; Nor first-ripe fig which my soul desireth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָבַ֤ד חָסִיד֙ מִן־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְיָשָׁ֥ר בָּאָדָ֖ם אָ֑יִן כֻּלָּם֙ לְדָמִ֣ים יֶאֱרֹ֔בוּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־אָחִ֖יהוּ יָצ֥וּדוּ חֵֽרֶם׃
verses.translit: 'bd chsyd mnh'rts vyshr b'dm 'yn khlm ldmym y'rbv 'ysh 't'chyhv ytsvdv chrm
verses.translation: The godly man is perished out of the earth, And the upright among men is no more; They all lie in wait for blood; They hunt every man his brother with a net.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־הָרַ֤ע כַּפַּ֙יִם֙ לְהֵיטִ֔יב הַשַּׂ֣ר שֹׁאֵ֔ל וְהַשֹּׁפֵ֖ט בַּשִּׁלּ֑וּם וְהַגָּד֗וֹל דֹּבֵ֨ר הַוַּ֥ת נַפְשׁ֛וֹ ה֖וּא וַֽיְעַבְּתֽוּהָ׃
verses.translit: 'lhr' khpym lhytyb hshr sh'l vhshpt bshlvm vhgdvl dbr hvt npshv hv' vy'btvh
verses.translation: Their hands are upon that which is evil to do it diligently; The prince asketh, and the judge is ready for a reward; And the great man, he uttereth the evil desire of his soul; Thus they weave it together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טוֹבָ֣ם כְּחֵ֔דֶק יָשָׁ֖ר מִמְּסוּכָ֑ה י֤וֹם מְצַפֶּ֙יךָ֙ פְּקֻדָּתְךָ֣ בָ֔אָה עַתָּ֥ה תִהְיֶ֖ה מְבוּכָתָֽם׃
verses.translit: tvbm khchdq yshr mmsvkhh yvm mtspykh pqdtkh b'h 'th thyh mbvkhtm
verses.translation: The best of them is as a brier; The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge; The day of thy watchmen, even thy visitation, is come; Now shall be their perplexity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּאֲמִ֣ינֽוּ בְרֵ֔עַ אַֽל־תִּבְטְח֖וּ בְּאַלּ֑וּף מִשֹּׁכֶ֣בֶת חֵיקֶ֔ךָ שְׁמֹ֖ר פִּתְחֵי־פִֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'lt'mynv br' 'ltbtchv b'lvf mshkhbt chyqkh shmr ptchypykh
verses.translation: Trust ye not in a friend, Put ye not confidence in a familiar friend; Keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־בֵן֙ מְנַבֵּ֣ל אָ֔ב בַּ֚ת קָמָ֣ה בְאִמָּ֔הּ כַּלָּ֖ה בַּחֲמֹתָ֑הּ אֹיְבֵ֥י אִ֖ישׁ אַנְשֵׁ֥י בֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khybn mnbl 'b bt qmh b'mh khlh bchmth 'yby 'ysh 'nshy bytv
verses.translation: For the son dishonoureth the father, The daughter riseth up against her mother, The daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; A man’s enemies are the men of his own house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽאֲנִי֙ בַּיהֹוָ֣ה אֲצַפֶּ֔ה אוֹחִ֖ילָה לֵאלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י יִשְׁמָעֵ֖נִי אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'ny byhvh 'tsph 'vchylh l'lhy ysh'y yshm'ny 'lhy
verses.translation: ’But as for me, I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation; My God will hear me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תִּשְׂמְחִ֤י אֹיַ֙בְתִּי֙ לִ֔י כִּ֥י נָפַ֖לְתִּי קָ֑מְתִּי כִּֽי־אֵשֵׁ֣ב בַּחֹ֔שֶׁךְ יְהֹוָ֖ה א֥וֹר לִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'ltshmchy 'ybty ly khy nplty qmty khy'shb bchshkh yhvh 'vr ly {p}
verses.translation: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy; Though I am fallen, I shall arise; Though I sit in darkness, the LORD is a light unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַ֤עַף יְהֹוָה֙ אֶשָּׂ֔א כִּ֥י חָטָ֖אתִי ל֑וֹ עַד֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֤יב רִיבִי֙ וְעָשָׂ֣ה מִשְׁפָּטִ֔י יוֹצִיאֵ֣נִי לָא֔וֹר אֶרְאֶ֖ה בְּצִדְקָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: z'f yhvh 'sh' khy cht'ty lv 'd 'shr yryb ryby v'shh mshpty yvtsy'ny l'vr 'r'h btsdqtv
verses.translation: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, Because I have sinned against Him; Until He plead my cause, and execute judgment for me; He will bring me forth to the light, And I shall behold His righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְתֵרֶ֤א אֹיַ֙בְתִּי֙ וּתְכַסֶּ֣הָ בוּשָׁ֔ה הָאֹמְרָ֣ה אֵלַ֔י אַיּ֖וֹ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יִךְ עֵינַי֙ תִּרְאֶ֣ינָּה בָּ֔הּ עַתָּ֛ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְמִרְמָ֖ס כְּטִ֥יט חוּצֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vtr' 'ybty vtkhsh bvshh h'mrh 'ly 'yv yhvh 'lhykh 'yny tr'ynh bh 'th thyh lmrms khtyt chvtsvt
verses.translation: Then mine enemy shall see it, and shame shall cover her; Who said unto me: Where is the LORD thy God? Mine eyes shall gaze upon her; Now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: י֖וֹם לִבְנ֣וֹת גְּדֵרָ֑יִךְ י֥וֹם הַה֖וּא יִרְחַק־חֹֽק׃
verses.translit: yvm lbnvt gdrykh yvm hhv' yrchqchq
verses.translation: ’The day for building thy walls, even that day, shall be far removed.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: י֥וֹם הוּא֙ וְעָדֶ֣יךָ יָב֔וֹא לְמִנִּ֥י אַשּׁ֖וּר וְעָרֵ֣י מָצ֑וֹר וּלְמִנִּ֤י מָצוֹר֙ וְעַד־נָהָ֔ר וְיָ֥ם מִיָּ֖ם וְהַ֥ר הָהָֽר׃
verses.translit: yvm hv' v'dykh ybv' lmny 'shvr v'ry mtsvr vlmny mtsvr v'dnhr vym mym vhr hhr
verses.translation: There shall be a day when they shall come unto thee, From Assyria even to the cities of Egypt, And from Egypt even to the River, And from sea to sea, and from mountain to mountain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ לִשְׁמָמָ֖ה עַל־יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ מִפְּרִ֖י מַעַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhyth h'rts lshmmh 'lyshbyh mpry m'llyhm {p}
verses.translation: And the land shall be desolate for them that dwell therein, Because of the fruit of their doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְעֵ֧ה עַמְּךָ֣ בְשִׁבְטֶ֗ךָ צֹ֚אן נַחֲלָתֶ֔ךָ שֹׁכְנִ֣י לְבָדָ֔ד יַ֖עַר בְּת֣וֹךְ כַּרְמֶ֑ל יִרְע֥וּ בָשָׁ֛ן וְגִלְעָ֖ד כִּימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: r'h 'mkh bshbtkh ts'n nchltkh shkhny lbdd y'r btvkh khrml yr'v bshn vgl'd khymy 'vlm
verses.translation: Tend Thy people with Thy staff, the flock of Thy heritage, That dwell solitarily, as a forest in the midst of the fruitful field; Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּימֵ֥י צֵאתְךָ֖ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אַרְאֶ֖נּוּ נִפְלָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khymy ts'tkh m'rts mtsrym 'r'nv npl'vt
verses.translation: ’As in the days of thy coming forth out of the land of Egypt Will I show unto him marvellous things.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְא֤וּ גוֹיִם֙ וְיֵבֹ֔שׁוּ מִכֹּ֖ל גְּבוּרָתָ֑ם יָשִׂ֤ימוּ יָד֙ עַל־פֶּ֔ה אׇזְנֵיהֶ֖ם תֶּחֱרַֽשְׁנָה׃
verses.translit: yr'v gvym vybshv mkhl gbvrtm yshymv yd 'lph 'znyhm tchrshnh
verses.translation: The nations shall see and be put to shame for all their might; They shall lay their hand upon their mouth, Their ears shall be deaf.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְלַחֲכ֤וּ עָפָר֙ כַּנָּחָ֔שׁ כְּזֹחֲלֵ֣י אֶ֔רֶץ יִרְגְּז֖וּ מִמִּסְגְּרֹֽתֵיהֶ֑ם אֶל־יְהֹוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ יִפְחָ֔דוּ וְיִֽרְא֖וּ מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: ylchkhv 'pr khnchsh khzchly 'rts yrgzv mmsgrtyhm 'lyhvh 'lhynv ypchdv vyr'v mmkh
verses.translation: They shall lick the dust like a serpent; Like crawling things of the earth they shall come trembling out of their close places; They shall come with fear unto the LORD our God, And shall be afraid because of Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־אֵ֣ל כָּמ֗וֹךָ נֹשֵׂ֤א עָוֺן֙ וְעֹבֵ֣ר עַל־פֶּ֔שַׁע לִשְׁאֵרִ֖ית נַחֲלָת֑וֹ לֹֽא־הֶחֱזִ֤יק לָעַד֙ אַפּ֔וֹ כִּֽי־חָפֵ֥ץ חֶ֖סֶד הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: my'l khmvkh nsh' 'vn v'br 'lpsh' lsh'ryt nchltv l'hchzyq l'd 'pv khychpts chsd hv'
verses.translation: Who is a God like unto Thee, that pardoneth the iniquity, And passeth by the transgression of the remnant of His heritage? He retaineth not His anger for ever, Because He delighteth in mercy. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּב יְרַחֲמֵ֔נוּ יִכְבֹּ֖שׁ עֲוֺנֹתֵ֑ינוּ וְתַשְׁלִ֛יךְ בִּמְצֻל֥וֹת יָ֖ם כׇּל־חַטֹּאותָֽם׃
verses.translit: yshvb yrchmnv ykhbsh 'vntynv vtshlykh bmtslvt ym khlcht'vtm
verses.translation: He will again have compassion upon us; He will subdue our iniquities; And Thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּתֵּ֤ן אֱמֶת֙ לְיַֽעֲקֹ֔ב חֶ֖סֶד לְאַבְרָהָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵ֖ינוּ מִ֥ימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃
verses.translit: ttn 'mt ly'qb chsd l'brhm 'shrnshb't l'btynv mymy qdm
verses.translation: Thou wilt show faithfulness to Jacob, mercy to Abraham, As Thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֖א נִֽינְוֵ֑ה סֵ֧פֶר חֲז֛וֹן נַח֖וּם הָאֶלְקֹשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: msh' nynvh spr chzvn nchvm h'lqshy
verses.translation: The burden of Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣ל קַנּ֤וֹא וְנֹקֵם֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה נֹקֵ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה וּבַ֣עַל חֵמָ֑ה נֹקֵ֤ם יְהֹוָה֙ לְצָרָ֔יו וְנוֹטֵ֥ר ה֖וּא לְאֹיְבָֽיו׃
verses.translit: 'l qnv' vnqm yhvh nqm yhvh vb'l chmh nqm yhvh ltsryv vnvtr hv' l'ybyv
verses.translation: The LORD is a jealous and avenging God, The LORD avengeth and is full of wrath; The LORD taketh vengeance on His adversaries, And He reserveth wrath for His enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֙יִם֙ (וגדול) [וּגְדׇל־]כֹּ֔חַ וְנַקֵּ֖ה לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֑ה יְהֹוָ֗ה בְּסוּפָ֤ה וּבִשְׂעָרָה֙ דַּרְכּ֔וֹ וְעָנָ֖ן אֲבַ֥ק רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'rkh 'pym (vgdvl) [vgdl]khch vnqh l' ynqh yhvh bsvph vbsh'rh drkhv v'nn 'bq rglyv
verses.translation: The LORD is long-suffering, and great in power, And will by no means clear the guilty; The LORD, in the whirlwind and in the storm is His way, And the clouds are the dust of His feet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גּוֹעֵ֤ר בַּיָּם֙ וַֽיַּבְּשֵׁ֔הוּ וְכׇל־הַנְּהָר֖וֹת הֶחֱרִ֑יב אֻמְלַ֤ל בָּשָׁן֙ וְכַרְמֶ֔ל וּפֶ֥רַח לְבָנ֖וֹן אֻמְלָֽל׃
verses.translit: gv'r bym vybshhv vkhlhnhrvt hchryb 'mll bshn vkhrml vprch lbnvn 'mll
verses.translation: He rebuketh the sea, and maketh it dry, And drieth up all the rivers; Bashan languisheth, and Carmel, And the flower of Lebanon languisheth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָרִים֙ רָעֲשׁ֣וּ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ וְהַגְּבָע֖וֹת הִתְמֹגָ֑גוּ וַתִּשָּׂ֤א הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ מִפָּנָ֔יו וְתֵבֵ֖ל וְכׇל־י֥וֹשְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: hrym r'shv mmnv vhgb'vt htmggv vtsh' h'rts mpnyv vtbl vkhlyvshby bh
verses.translation: The mountains quake at Him, And the hills melt; And the earth is upheaved at His presence, Yea, the world, and all that dwell therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִפְנֵ֤י זַעְמוֹ֙ מִ֣י יַעֲמ֔וֹד וּמִ֥י יָק֖וּם בַּחֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֑וֹ חֲמָתוֹ֙ נִתְּכָ֣ה כָאֵ֔שׁ וְהַצֻּרִ֖ים נִתְּצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: lpny z'mv my y'mvd vmy yqvm bchrvn 'pv chmtv ntkhh kh'sh vhtsrym nttsv mmnv
verses.translation: Who can stand before His indignation? And who can abide in the fierceness of His anger? His fury is poured out like fire, And the rocks are broken asunder before Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ט֣וֹב יְהֹוָ֔ה לְמָע֖וֹז בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה וְיֹדֵ֖עַ חֹ֥סֵי בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: tvb yhvh lm'vz byvm tsrh vyd' chsy bv
verses.translation: The LORD is good, A stronghold in the day of trouble; And He knoweth them that take refuge in Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבְשֶׁ֣טֶף עֹבֵ֔ר כָּלָ֖ה יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה מְקוֹמָ֑הּ וְאֹיְבָ֖יו יְרַדֶּף־חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.translit: vbshtf 'br khlh y'shh mqvmh v'ybyv yrdfchshkh
verses.translation: But with an overrunning flood He will make a full end of the place thereof, And darkness shall pursue His enemies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַה־תְּחַשְּׁבוּן֙ אֶל־יְהֹוָ֔ה כָּלָ֖ה ה֣וּא עֹשֶׂ֑ה לֹא־תָק֥וּם פַּעֲמַ֖יִם צָרָֽה׃
verses.translit: mhtchshbvn 'lyhvh khlh hv' 'shh l'tqvm p'mym tsrh
verses.translation: What do ye devise against the LORD? He will make a full end; Trouble shall not rise up the second time. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י עַד־סִירִ֣ים סְבֻכִ֔ים וּכְסׇבְאָ֖ם סְבוּאִ֑ים אֻ֨כְּל֔וּ כְּקַ֥שׁ יָבֵ֖שׁ מָלֵֽא׃
verses.translit: khy 'dsyrym sbkhym vkhsb'm sbv'ym 'khlv khqsh ybsh ml'
verses.translation: For though they be like tangled thorns, And be drunken according to their drink, They shall be devoured as stubble fully dry.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִמֵּ֣ךְ יָצָ֔א חֹשֵׁ֥ב עַל־יְהֹוָ֖ה רָעָ֑ה יֹעֵ֖ץ בְּלִיָּֽעַל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mmkh yts' chshb 'lyhvh r'h y'ts bly'l {s}
verses.translation: Out of thee came he forth, That deviseth evil against the LORD, That counselleth wickedness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה  אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה אִם־שְׁלֵמִים֙ וְכֵ֣ן רַבִּ֔ים וְכֵ֥ן נָג֖וֹזּוּ וְעָבָ֑ר וְעִ֨נִּתִ֔ךְ לֹ֥א אֲעַנֵּ֖ךְ עֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: khh  'mr yhvh 'mshlmym vkhn rbym vkhn ngvzv v'br v'ntkh l' ''nkh 'vd
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: Though they be in full strength, and likewise many, Even so shall they be cut down, and he shall pass away; And though I have afflicted thee, I will afflict thee no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה אֶשְׁבֹּ֥ר מֹטֵ֖הוּ מֵעָלָ֑יִךְ וּמוֹסְרֹתַ֖יִךְ אֲנַתֵּֽק׃
verses.translit: v'th 'shbr mthv m'lykh vmvsrtykh 'ntq
verses.translation: And now will I break his yoke from off thee, And will burst thy bonds in sunder.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְצִוָּ֤ה עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ יְהֹוָ֔ה לֹא־יִזָּרַ֥ע מִשִּׁמְךָ֖ ע֑וֹד מִבֵּ֨ית אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ אַכְרִ֨ית פֶּ֧סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֛ה אָשִׂ֥ים קִבְרֶ֖ךָ כִּ֥י קַלּֽוֹתָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vtsvh 'lykh yhvh l'yzr' mshmkh 'vd mbyt 'lhykh 'khryt psl vmskhh 'shym qbrkh khy qlvt {p}
verses.translation: And the LORD hath given commandment concerning thee, That no more of thy name be sown; Out of the house of thy god will I cut off The graven image and the molten image; I will make thy grave; for thou art become worthless.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה עַל־הֶהָרִ֜ים רַגְלֵ֤י מְבַשֵּׂר֙ מַשְׁמִ֣יעַ שָׁל֔וֹם חׇגִּ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה חַגַּ֖יִךְ שַׁלְּמִ֣י נְדָרָ֑יִךְ כִּי֩ לֹ֨א יוֹסִ֥יף ע֛וֹד (לעבור) [לַעֲבׇר־]בָּ֥ךְ בְּלִיַּ֖עַל כֻּלֹּ֥ה נִכְרָֽת׃
verses.translit: hnh 'lhhrym rgly mbshr mshmy' shlvm chgy yhvdh chgykh shlmy ndrykh khy l' yvsyf 'vd (l'bvr) [l'br]bkh bly'l khlh nkhrt
verses.translation: Behold upon the mountains the feet of him That bringeth good tidings, that announceth peace! Keep thy feasts, O Judah, Perform thy vows; For the wicked one shall no more pass through thee; He is utterly cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָלָ֥ה מֵפִ֛יץ עַל־פָּנַ֖יִךְ נָצ֣וֹר מְצוּרָ֑ה צַפֵּֽה־דֶ֙רֶךְ֙ חַזֵּ֣ק מׇתְנַ֔יִם אַמֵּ֥ץ כֹּ֖חַ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: 'lh mpyts 'lpnykh ntsvr mtsvrh tsphdrkh chzq mtnym 'mts khch m'd
verses.translation: A maul is come up before thy face; Guard the defences, Watch the way, make thy loins strong, Fortify thy power mightily!—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י שָׁ֤ב יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־גְּא֣וֹן יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּגְא֖וֹן יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י בְקָקוּם֙ בֹּֽקְקִ֔ים וּזְמֹרֵיהֶ֖ם שִׁחֵֽתוּ׃
verses.translit: khy shb yhvh 'tg'vn y'qb khg'vn yshr'l khy bqqvm bqqym vzmryhm shchtv
verses.translation: For the LORD restoreth the pride of Jacob, As the pride of Israel; For the emptiers have emptied them out, And marred their vine-branches.—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָגֵ֨ן גִּבֹּרֵ֜יהוּ מְאׇדָּ֗ם אַנְשֵֽׁי־חַ֙יִל֙ מְתֻלָּעִ֔ים בְּאֵשׁ־פְּלָדֹ֥ת הָרֶ֖כֶב בְּי֣וֹם הֲכִינ֑וֹ וְהַבְּרֹשִׁ֖ים הׇרְעָֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: mgn gbryhv m'dm 'nshychyl mtl'ym b'shpldt hrkhb byvm hkhynv vhbrshym hr'lv
verses.translation: The shield of his mighty men is made red, The valiant men are in scarlet; The chariots are fire of steel in the day of his preparation, And the cypress spears are made to quiver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחוּצוֹת֙ יִתְהוֹלְל֣וּ הָרֶ֔כֶב יִֽשְׁתַּקְשְׁק֖וּן בָּרְחֹב֑וֹת מַרְאֵיהֶן֙ כַּלַּפִּידִ֔ים כַּבְּרָקִ֖ים יְרוֹצֵֽצוּ׃
verses.translit: bchvtsvt ythvllv hrkhb yshtqshqvn brchbvt mr'yhn khlpydym khbrqym yrvtstsv
verses.translation: The chariots rush madly in the streets, They jostle one against another in the broad places; The appearance of them is like torches, They run to and fro like the lightnings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִזְכֹּר֙ אַדִּירָ֔יו יִכָּשְׁל֖וּ (בהלכותם) [בַּהֲלִיכָתָ֑ם] יְמַֽהֲרוּ֙ חֽוֹמָתָ֔הּ וְהֻכַ֖ן הַסֹּכֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: yzkhr 'dyryv ykhshlv (bhlkhvtm) [bhlykhtm] ymhrv chvmth vhkhn hskhkh
verses.translation: He bethinketh himself of his worthies; They stumble in their march; They make haste to the wall thereof, And the mantelet is prepared.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁעֲרֵ֥י הַנְּהָר֖וֹת נִפְתָּ֑חוּ וְהַהֵיכָ֖ל נָמֽוֹג׃
verses.translit: sh'ry hnhrvt nptchv vhhykhl nmvg
verses.translation: The gates of the rivers are opened, And the palace is dissolved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֻצַּ֖ב גֻּלְּתָ֣ה הֹֽעֲלָ֑תָה וְאַמְהֹתֶ֗יהָ מְנַֽהֲגוֹת֙ כְּק֣וֹל יוֹנִ֔ים מְתֹפְפֹ֖ת עַל־לִבְבֵהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: vhtsb glth h'lth v'mhtyh mnhgvt khqvl yvnym mtppt 'llbbhn
verses.translation: And the queen is uncovered, she is carried away, And her handmaids moan as with the voice of doves, Tabering upon their breasts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִֽינְוֵ֥ה כִבְרֵכַת־מַ֖יִם מִ֣ימֵי הִ֑יא וְהֵ֣מָּה נָסִ֔ים עִמְד֥וּ עֲמֹ֖דוּ וְאֵ֥ין מַפְנֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vnynvh khbrkhtmym mymy hy' vhmh nsym 'mdv 'mdv v'yn mpnh
verses.translation: But Nineveh hath been from of old like a pool of water; Yet they flee away; ‘Stand, stand’; But none looketh back.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֹּ֥זּוּ כֶ֖סֶף בֹּ֣זּוּ זָהָ֑ב וְאֵ֥ין קֵ֙צֶה֙ לַתְּכוּנָ֔ה כָּבֹ֕ד מִכֹּ֖ל כְּלִ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: bzv khsf bzv zhb v'yn qtsh ltkhvnh khbd mkhl khly chmdh
verses.translation: Take ye the spoil of silver, take the spoil of gold; For there is no end of the store, Rich with all precious vessels.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בּוּקָ֥ה וּמְבוּקָ֖ה וּמְבֻלָּקָ֑ה וְלֵ֨ב נָמֵ֜ס וּפִ֣ק בִּרְכַּ֗יִם וְחַלְחָלָה֙ בְּכׇל־מׇתְנַ֔יִם וּפְנֵ֥י כֻלָּ֖ם קִבְּצ֥וּ פָארֽוּר׃
verses.translit: bvqh vmbvqh vmblqh vlb nms vpq brkhym vchlchlh bkhlmtnym vpny khlm qbtsv p'rvr
verses.translation: She is empty, and void, and waste; And the heart melteth, and the knees smite together, And convulsion is in all loins, And the faces of them all have gathered blackness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַיֵּה֙ מְע֣וֹן אֲרָי֔וֹת וּמִרְעֶ֥ה ה֖וּא לַכְּפִרִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַךְ֩ אַרְיֵ֨ה לָבִ֥יא שָׁ֛ם גּ֥וּר אַרְיֵ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃
verses.translit: 'yh m'vn 'ryvt vmr'h hv' lkhprym 'shr hlkh 'ryh lby' shm gvr 'ryh v'yn mchryd
verses.translation: Where is the den of the lions, Which was the feeding-place of the young lions, Where the lion and the lioness walked, and the lion’s whelp, And none made them afraid?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַרְיֵ֤ה טֹרֵף֙ בְּדֵ֣י גֹרוֹתָ֔יו וּמְחַנֵּ֖ק לְלִבְאֹתָ֑יו וַיְמַלֵּא־טֶ֣רֶף חֹרָ֔יו וּמְעֹנֹתָ֖יו טְרֵפָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'ryh trf bdy grvtyv vmchnq llb'tyv vyml'trf chryv vm'ntyv trph
verses.translation: The lion did tear in pieces enough for his whelps, And strangled for his lionesses, And filled his caves with prey, And his dens with ravin.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י אֵלַ֗יִךְ נְאֻם֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְהִבְעַרְתִּ֤י בֶעָשָׁן֙ רִכְבָּ֔הּ וּכְפִירַ֖יִךְ תֹּ֣אכַל חָ֑רֶב וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י מֵאֶ֙רֶץ֙ טַרְפֵּ֔ךְ וְלֹא־יִשָּׁמַ֥ע ע֖וֹד ק֥וֹל מַלְאָכֵֽכֵה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hnny 'lykh n'm yhvh tsb'vt vhb'rty b'shn rkhbh vkhpyrykh t'khl chrb vhkhrty m'rts trpkh vl'yshm' 'vd qvl ml'khkhh {p}
verses.translation: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts, And I will burn her chariots in the smoke, And the sword shall devour thy young lions; And I will cut off thy prey from the earth, And the voice of thy messengers shall no more be heard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֖וֹי עִ֣יר דָּמִ֑ים כֻּלָּ֗הּ כַּ֤חַשׁ פֶּ֙רֶק֙ מְלֵאָ֔ה לֹ֥א יָמִ֖ישׁ טָֽרֶף׃
verses.translit: hvy 'yr dmym khlh khchsh prq ml'h l' ymysh trf
