verses.translation: Woe to the bloody city! It is all full of lies and rapine; The prey departeth not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֣וֹל שׁ֔וֹט וְק֖וֹל רַ֣עַשׁ אוֹפָ֑ן וְס֣וּס דֹּהֵ֔ר וּמֶרְכָּבָ֖ה מְרַקֵּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: qvl shvt vqvl r'sh 'vpn vsvs dhr vmrkhbh mrqdh
verses.translation: Hark! the whip, and hark! the rattling of the wheels; And prancing horses, and bounding chariots;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּרָ֣שׁ מַעֲלֶ֗ה וְלַ֤הַב חֶ֙רֶב֙ וּבְרַ֣ק חֲנִ֔ית וְרֹ֥ב חָלָ֖ל וְכֹ֣בֶד פָּ֑גֶר וְאֵ֥ין קֵ֙צֶה֙ לַגְּוִיָּ֔ה (יכשלו) [וְכָשְׁל֖וּ] בִּגְוִיָּתָֽם׃
verses.translit: prsh m'lh vlhb chrb vbrq chnyt vrb chll vkhbd pgr v'yn qtsh lgvyh (ykhshlv) [vkhshlv] bgvytm
verses.translation: The horseman charging, And the flashing sword, and the glittering spear; And a multitude of slain, and a heap of carcases; And there is no end of the corpses, and they stumble upon their corpses;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵרֹב֙ זְנוּנֵ֣י זוֹנָ֔ה ט֥וֹבַת חֵ֖ן בַּעֲלַ֣ת כְּשָׁפִ֑ים הַמֹּכֶ֤רֶת גּוֹיִם֙ בִּזְנוּנֶ֔יהָ וּמִשְׁפָּח֖וֹת בִּכְשָׁפֶֽיהָ׃
verses.translit: mrb znvny zvnh tvbt chn b'lt khshpym hmkhrt gvym bznvnyh vmshpchvt bkhshpyh
verses.translation: Because of the multitude of the harlotries of the well-favoured harlot, The mistress of witchcrafts, That selleth nations through her harlotries, And families through her witchcrafts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י אֵלַ֗יִךְ נְאֻם֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְגִלֵּיתִ֥י שׁוּלַ֖יִךְ עַל־פָּנָ֑יִךְ וְהַרְאֵיתִ֤י גוֹיִם֙ מַעְרֵ֔ךְ וּמַמְלָכ֖וֹת קְלוֹנֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: hnny 'lykh n'm yhvh tsb'vt vglyty shvlykh 'lpnykh vhr'yty gvym m'rkh vmmlkhvt qlvnkh
verses.translation: Behold, I am against thee, saith the LORD of hosts, And I will uncover thy skirts upon thy face, And I will shew the nations thy nakedness, And the kingdoms thy shame.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁלַכְתִּ֥י עָלַ֛יִךְ שִׁקֻּצִ֖ים וְנִבַּלְתִּ֑יךְ וְשַׂמְתִּ֖יךְ כְּרֹֽאִי׃
verses.translit: vhshlkhty 'lykh shqtsym vnbltykh vshmtykh khr'y
verses.translation: And I will cast detestable things upon thee, and make thee vile, And will make thee as dung.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה כׇל־רֹאַ֙יִךְ֙ יִדּ֣וֹד מִמֵּ֔ךְ וְאָמַר֙ שׇׁדְּדָ֣ה נִֽינְוֵ֔ה מִ֖י יָנ֣וּד לָ֑הּ מֵאַ֛יִן אֲבַקֵּ֥שׁ מְנַחֲמִ֖ים לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khlr'ykh ydvd mmkh v'mr shddh nynvh my ynvd lh m'yn 'bqsh mnchmym lkh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that all they that look upon thee Shall flee from thee, And say: ‘Nineveh is laid waste; Who will bemoan her? Whence shall I seek comforters for thee?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲתֵֽיטְבִי֙ מִנֹּ֣א אָמ֔וֹן הַיֹּֽשְׁבָה֙ בַּיְאֹרִ֔ים מַ֖יִם סָבִ֣יב לָ֑הּ אֲשֶׁר־חֵ֣יל יָ֔ם מִיָּ֖ם חוֹמָתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: htytby mn' 'mvn hyshbh by'rym mym sbyb lh 'shrchyl ym mym chvmth
verses.translation: Art thou better than No-amon, That was situate among the rivers, That had the waters round about her; Whose rampart was the sea, and of the sea her wall?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כּ֥וּשׁ עׇצְמָ֛ה וּמִצְרַ֖יִם וְאֵ֣ין קֵ֑צֶה פּ֣וּט וְלוּבִ֔ים הָי֖וּ בְּעֶזְרָתֵֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khvsh 'tsmh vmtsrym v'yn qtsh pvt vlvbym hyv b'zrtkh
verses.translation: Ethiopia and Egypt were thy strength, and it was infinite; Put and Lubim were thy helpers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־הִ֗יא לַגֹּלָה֙ הָלְכָ֣ה בַשֶּׁ֔בִי גַּ֧ם עֹלָלֶ֛יהָ יְרֻטְּשׁ֖וּ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ כׇּל־חוּצ֑וֹת וְעַל־נִכְבַּדֶּ֙יהָ֙ יַדּ֣וּ גוֹרָ֔ל וְכׇל־גְּדוֹלֶ֖יהָ רֻתְּק֥וּ בַזִּקִּֽים׃
verses.translit: gmhy' lglh hlkhh bshby gm 'llyh yrtshv br'sh khlchvtsvt v'lnkhbdyh ydv gvrl vkhlgdvlyh rtqv bzqym
verses.translation: Yet was she carried away, She went into captivity; Her young children also were dashed in pieces At the head of all the streets; And they cast lots for her honourable men, And all her great men were bound in chains.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אַ֣תְּ תִּשְׁכְּרִ֔י תְּהִ֖י נַעֲלָמָ֑ה גַּם־אַ֛תְּ תְּבַקְשִׁ֥י מָע֖וֹז מֵאוֹיֵֽב׃
verses.translit: gm't tshkhry thy n'lmh gm't tbqshy m'vz m'vyb
verses.translation: Thou also shalt be drunken, Thou shalt swoon; Thou also shalt seek a refuge Because of the enemy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּ֨ל־מִבְצָרַ֔יִךְ תְּאֵנִ֖ים עִם־בִּכּוּרִ֑ים אִם־יִנּ֕וֹעוּ וְנָפְל֖וּ עַל־פִּ֥י אוֹכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: khlmbtsrykh t'nym 'mbkhvrym 'mynv'v vnplv 'lpy 'vkhl
verses.translation: All thy fortresses shall be like fig-trees with the first-ripe figs: If they be shaken, they fall into the mouth of the eater.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֨ה עַמֵּ֤ךְ נָשִׁים֙ בְּקִרְבֵּ֔ךְ לְאֹ֣יְבַ֔יִךְ פָּת֥וֹחַ נִפְתְּח֖וּ שַׁעֲרֵ֣י אַרְצֵ֑ךְ אָכְלָ֥ה אֵ֖שׁ בְּרִיחָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: hnh 'mkh nshym bqrbkh l'ybykh ptvch nptchv sh'ry 'rtskh 'khlh 'sh brychykh
verses.translation: Behold, thy people in the midst of thee are women; The gates of thy land are set wide open unto thine enemies; The fire hath devoured thy bars.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵ֤י מָצוֹר֙ שַֽׁאֲבִי־לָ֔ךְ חַזְּקִ֖י מִבְצָרָ֑יִךְ בֹּ֧אִי בַטִּ֛יט וְרִמְסִ֥י בַחֹ֖מֶר הַחֲזִ֥יקִי מַלְבֵּֽן׃
verses.translit: my mtsvr sh'bylkh chzqy mbtsrykh b'y btyt vrmsy bchmr hchzyqy mlbn
verses.translation: Draw thee water for the siege, Strengthen thy fortresses; Go into the clay, and tread the mortar, Lay hold of the brickmould.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֚ם תֹּאכְלֵ֣ךְ אֵ֔שׁ תַּכְרִיתֵ֣ךְ חֶ֔רֶב תֹּאכְלֵ֖ךְ כַּיָּ֑לֶק הִתְכַּבֵּ֣ד כַּיֶּ֔לֶק הִֽתְכַּבְּדִ֖י כָּאַרְבֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: shm t'khlkh 'sh tkhrytkh chrb t'khlkh khylq htkhbd khylq htkhbdy kh'rbh
verses.translation: There shall the fire devour thee; The sword shall cut thee off, It shall devour thee like the canker-worm; Make thyself many as the canker-worm, Make thyself many as the locusts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִרְבֵּית֙ רֹכְלַ֔יִךְ מִכּוֹכְבֵ֖י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם יֶ֥לֶק פָּשַׁ֖ט וַיָּעֹֽף׃
verses.translit: hrbyt rkhlykh mkhvkhby hshmym ylq psht vy'f
verses.translation: Thou hast multiplied thy merchants Above the stars of heaven; The canker-worm spreadeth itself, and flieth away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִנְּזָרַ֙יִךְ֙ כָּֽאַרְבֶּ֔ה וְטַפְסְרַ֖יִךְ כְּג֣וֹב גֹּבָ֑י הַחוֹנִ֤ים בַּגְּדֵרוֹת֙ בְּי֣וֹם קָרָ֔ה שֶׁ֤מֶשׁ זָֽרְחָה֙ וְנוֹדַ֔ד וְלֹא־נוֹדַ֥ע מְקוֹמ֖וֹ אַיָּֽם׃
verses.translit: mnzrykh kh'rbh vtpsrykh khgvb gby hchvnym bgdrvt byvm qrh shmsh zrchh vnvdd vl'nvd' mqvmv 'ym
verses.translation: Thy crowned are as the locusts, And thy marshals as the swarms of grasshoppers, Which camp in the walls in the cold day, But when the sun ariseth they flee away, And their place is not known where they are.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָמ֤וּ רֹעֶ֙יךָ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַשּׁ֔וּר יִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ אַדִּירֶ֑יךָ נָפֹ֧שׁוּ עַמְּךָ֛ עַל־הֶהָרִ֖ים וְאֵ֥ין מְקַבֵּֽץ׃
verses.translit: nmv r'ykh mlkh 'shvr yshkhnv 'dyrykh npshv 'mkh 'lhhrym v'yn mqbts
verses.translation: Thy shepherds slumber, O king of Assyria, Thy worthies are at rest; Thy people are scattered upon the mountains, And there is none to gather them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵין־כֵּהָ֣ה לְשִׁבְרֶ֔ךָ נַחְלָ֖ה מַכָּתֶ֑ךָ כֹּ֣ל  שֹׁמְעֵ֣י שִׁמְעֲךָ֗ תָּ֤קְעוּ כַף֙ עָלֶ֔יךָ כִּ֗י עַל־מִ֛י לֹא־עָבְרָ֥ה רָעָתְךָ֖ תָּמִֽיד׃
verses.translit: 'ynkhhh lshbrkh nchlh mkhtkh khl  shm'y shm'kh tq'v khf 'lykh khy 'lmy l''brh r'tkh tmyd
verses.translation: There is no assuaging of thy hurt, Thy wound is grievous; All that hear the report of thee Clap the hands over thee; For upon whom hath not thy wickedness passed continually?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַמַּשָּׂא֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָזָ֔ה חֲבַקּ֖וּק הַנָּבִֽיא׃
verses.translit: hmsh' 'shr chzh chbqvq hnby'
verses.translation: THE burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־אָ֧נָה יְהֹוָ֛ה שִׁוַּ֖עְתִּי וְלֹ֣א תִשְׁמָ֑ע אֶזְעַ֥ק אֵלֶ֛יךָ חָמָ֖ס וְלֹ֥א תוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃
verses.translit: 'd'nh yhvh shv'ty vl' tshm' 'z'q 'lykh chms vl' tvshy'
verses.translation: How long, O LORD, shall I cry, And Thou wilt not hear? I cry out unto Thee of violence, And Thou wilt not save.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֣מָּה תַרְאֵ֤נִי אָ֙וֶן֙ וְעָמָ֣ל תַּבִּ֔יט וְשֹׁ֥ד וְחָמָ֖ס לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וַיְהִ֧י רִ֦יב וּמָד֖וֹן יִשָּֽׂא׃
verses.translit: lmh tr'ny 'vn v'ml tbyt vshd vchms lngdy vyhy ryb vmdvn ysh'
verses.translation: Why dost Thou show me iniquity, And beholdest mischief? And why are spoiling and violence before me? So that there is strife, and contention ariseth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּן֙ תָּפ֣וּג תּוֹרָ֔ה וְלֹא־יֵצֵ֥א לָנֶ֖צַח מִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֤י רָשָׁע֙ מַכְתִּ֣יר אֶת־הַצַּדִּ֔יק עַל־כֵּ֛ן יֵצֵ֥א מִשְׁפָּ֖ט מְעֻקָּֽל׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn tpvg tvrh vl'yts' lntsch mshpt khy rsh' mkhtyr 'thtsdyq 'lkhn yts' mshpt m'ql
verses.translation: Therefore the law is slacked, And right doth never go forth; For the wicked doth beset the righteous; Therefore right goeth forth perverted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְא֤וּ בַגּוֹיִם֙ וְֽהַבִּ֔יטוּ וְהִֽתַּמְּה֖וּ תְּמָ֑הוּ כִּי־פֹ֙עַל֙ פֹּעֵ֣ל בִּימֵיכֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַאֲמִ֖ינוּ כִּ֥י יְסֻפָּֽר׃
verses.translit: r'v bgvym vhbytv vhtmhv tmhv khyp'l p'l bymykhm l' t'mynv khy yspr
verses.translation: Look ye among the nations, and behold, And wonder marvellously; For, behold, a work shall be wrought in your days, Which ye will not believe though it be told you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנְנִ֤י מֵקִים֙ אֶת־הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים הַגּ֖וֹי הַמַּ֣ר וְהַנִּמְהָ֑ר הַהוֹלֵךְ֙ לְמֶרְחֲבֵי־אֶ֔רֶץ לָרֶ֖שֶׁת מִשְׁכָּנ֥וֹת לֹּא־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khyhnny mqym 'thkhshdym hgvy hmr vhnmhr hhvlkh lmrchby'rts lrsht mshkhnvt l'lv
verses.translation: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, That bitter and impetuous nation, That march through the breadth of the earth, To possess dwelling-places that are not theirs.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָיֹ֥ם וְנוֹרָ֖א ה֑וּא מִמֶּ֕נּוּ מִשְׁפָּט֥וֹ וּשְׂאֵת֖וֹ יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.translit: 'ym vnvr' hv' mmnv mshptv vsh'tv yts'
verses.translation: They are terrible and dreadful; Their law and their majesty proceed from themselves.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקַלּ֨וּ מִנְּמֵרִ֜ים סוּסָ֗יו וְחַדּוּ֙ מִזְּאֵ֣בֵי עֶ֔רֶב וּפָ֖שׁוּ פָּרָשָׁ֑יו וּפָֽרָשָׁיו֙ מֵרָח֣וֹק יָבֹ֔אוּ יָעֻ֕פוּ כְּנֶ֖שֶׁר חָ֥שׁ לֶאֱכֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vqlv mnmrym svsyv vchdv mz'by 'rb vpshv prshyv vprshyv mrchvq yb'v y'pv khnshr chsh l'khvl
verses.translation: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, And are more fierce than the wolves of the desert; And their horsemen spread themselves; Yea, their horsemen come from far, They fly as a vulture that hasteth to devour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֻּלֹּה֙ לְחָמָ֣ס יָב֔וֹא מְגַמַּ֥ת פְּנֵיהֶ֖ם קָדִ֑ימָה וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף כַּח֖וֹל שֶֽׁבִי׃
verses.translit: khlh lchms ybv' mgmt pnyhm qdymh vy'sf khchvl shby
verses.translation: They come all of them for violence; Their faces are set eagerly as the east wind; And they gather captives as the sand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוּא֙ בַּמְּלָכִ֣ים יִתְקַלָּ֔ס וְרֹזְנִ֖ים מִשְׂחָ֣ק ל֑וֹ ה֚וּא לְכׇל־מִבְצָ֣ר יִשְׂחָ֔ק וַיִּצְבֹּ֥ר עָפָ֖ר וַֽיִּלְכְּדָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vhv' bmlkhym ytqls vrznym mshchq lv hv' lkhlmbtsr yshchq vytsbr 'pr vylkhdh
verses.translation: And they scoff at kings, And princes are a derision unto them; They deride every stronghold, For they heap up earth, and take it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֣ז חָלַ֥ף ר֛וּחַ וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר וְאָשֵׁ֑ם ז֥וּ כֹח֖וֹ לֵאלֹהֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'z chlf rvch vy'br v'shm zv khchv l'lhv
verses.translation: Then their spirit doth pass over and transgress, And they become guilty: Even they who impute their might unto their god.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֧וֹא אַתָּ֣ה מִקֶּ֗דֶם יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛י קְדֹשִׁ֖י לֹ֣א נָמ֑וּת יְהֹוָה֙ לְמִשְׁפָּ֣ט שַׂמְתּ֔וֹ וְצ֖וּר לְהוֹכִ֥יחַ יְסַדְתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hlv' 'th mqdm yhvh 'lhy qdshy l' nmvt yhvh lmshpt shmtv vtsvr lhvkhych ysdtv
verses.translation: Art not Thou from everlasting, O LORD my God, my Holy One? We shall not die. O LORD, Thou hast ordained them for judgment, And Thou, O Rock, hast established them for correction. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טְה֤וֹר עֵינַ֙יִם֙ מֵרְא֣וֹת רָ֔ע וְהַבִּ֥יט אֶל־עָמָ֖ל לֹ֣א תוּכָ֑ל לָ֤מָּה תַבִּיט֙ בּֽוֹגְדִ֔ים תַּחֲרִ֕ישׁ בְּבַלַּ֥ע רָשָׁ֖ע צַדִּ֥יק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: thvr 'ynym mr'vt r' vhbyt 'l'ml l' tvkhl lmh tbyt bvgdym tchrysh bbl' rsh' tsdyq mmnv
verses.translation: Thou that art of eyes too pure to behold evil, And that canst not look on mischief, Wherefore lookest Thou, when they deal treacherously, And holdest Thy peace, when the wicked swalloweth up The man that is more righteous than he;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אָדָ֖ם כִּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם כְּרֶ֖מֶשׂ לֹא־מֹשֵׁ֥ל בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vt'shh 'dm khdgy hym khrmsh l'mshl bv
verses.translation: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, As the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֻּלֹּה֙ בְּחַכָּ֣ה הֵֽעֲלָ֔ה יְגֹרֵ֣הוּ בְחֶרְמ֔וֹ וְיַאַסְפֵ֖הוּ בְּמִכְמַרְתּ֑וֹ עַל־כֵּ֖ן יִשְׂמַ֥ח וְיָגִֽיל׃
verses.translit: khlh bchkhh h'lh ygrhv bchrmv vy'sphv bmkhmrtv 'lkhn yshmch vygyl
verses.translation: They take up all of them with the angle, They catch them in their net, And gather them in their drag; Therefore they rejoice and exult.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּן֙ יְזַבֵּ֣חַ לְחֶרְמ֔וֹ וִֽיקַטֵּ֖ר לְמִכְמַרְתּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י בָהֵ֙מָּה֙ שָׁמֵ֣ן חֶלְק֔וֹ וּמַאֲכָל֖וֹ בְּרִאָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn yzbch lchrmv vyqtr lmkhmrtv khy bhmh shmn chlqv vm'khlv br'h
verses.translation: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, And offer unto their drag; Because by them their portion is fat, And their food plenteous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥עַל כֵּ֖ן יָרִ֣יק חֶרְמ֑וֹ וְתָמִ֛יד לַהֲרֹ֥ג גּוֹיִ֖ם לֹ֥א יַחְמֽוֹל׃ {ס}
verses.translit: h'l khn yryq chrmv vtmyd lhrg gvym l' ychmvl {s}
verses.translation: Shall they therefore empty their net, And not spare to slay the nations continually?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֣י אֶֽעֱמֹ֔דָה וְאֶֽתְיַצְּבָ֖ה עַל־מָצ֑וֹר וַאֲצַפֶּ֗ה לִרְאוֹת֙ מַה־יְדַבֶּר־בִּ֔י וּמָ֥ה אָשִׁ֖יב עַל־תּוֹכַחְתִּֽי׃
verses.translit: 'lmshmrty ''mdh v'tytsbh 'lmtsvr v'tsph lr'vt mhydbrby vmh 'shyb 'ltvkhchty
verses.translation: I will stand upon my watch, And set me upon the tower, And will look out to see what He will speak by me, And what I shall answer when I am reproved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּעֲנֵ֤נִי יְהֹוָה֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר כְּתֹ֣ב חָז֔וֹן וּבָאֵ֖ר עַל־הַלֻּח֑וֹת לְמַ֥עַן יָר֖וּץ ק֥וֹרֵא בֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vy'nny yhvh vy'mr khtb chzvn vb'r 'lhlchvt lm'n yrvts qvr' bv
verses.translation: And the LORD answered me, and said: ‘Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, That a man may read it swiftly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י ע֤וֹד חָזוֹן֙ לַמּוֹעֵ֔ד וְיָפֵ֥חַ לַקֵּ֖ץ וְלֹ֣א יְכַזֵּ֑ב אִם־יִתְמַהְמָהּ֙ חַכֵּה־ל֔וֹ כִּי־בֹ֥א יָבֹ֖א לֹ֥א יְאַחֵֽר׃
verses.translit: khy 'vd chzvn lmv'd vypch lqts vl' ykhzb 'mytmhmh chkhhlv khyb' yb' l' y'chr
verses.translation: For the vision is yet for the appointed time, And it declareth of the end, and doth not lie; Though it tarry, wait for it; Because it will surely come, it will not delay.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה עֻפְּלָ֔ה לֹא־יָשְׁרָ֥ה נַפְשׁ֖וֹ בּ֑וֹ וְצַדִּ֖יק בֶּאֱמוּנָת֥וֹ יִֽחְיֶֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hnh 'plh l'yshrh npshv bv vtsdyq b'mvntv ychyh {s}
verses.translation: Behold, his soul is puffed up, it is not upright in him; But the righteous shall live by his faith.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַף֙ כִּֽי־הַיַּ֣יִן בֹּגֵ֔ד גֶּ֥בֶר יָהִ֖יר וְלֹ֣א יִנְוֶ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֩ הִרְחִ֨יב כִּשְׁא֜וֹל נַפְשׁ֗וֹ וְה֤וּא כַמָּ֙וֶת֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׂבָּ֔ע וַיֶּאֱסֹ֤ף אֵלָיו֙ כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וַיִּקְבֹּ֥ץ אֵלָ֖יו כׇּל־הָעַמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: v'f khyhyyn bgd gbr yhyr vl' ynvh 'shr hrchyb khsh'vl npshv vhv' khmvt vl' yshb' vy'sf 'lyv khlhgvym vyqbts 'lyv khlh'mym
verses.translation: Yea, moreover, wine is a treacherous dealer; The haughty man abideth not; He who enlargeth his desire as the nether-world, And is as death, and cannot be satisfied, But gathereth unto him all nations, And heapeth unto him all peoples.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלוֹא־אֵ֣לֶּה כֻלָּ֗ם עָלָיו֙ מָשָׁ֣ל יִשָּׂ֔אוּ וּמְלִיצָ֖ה חִיד֣וֹת ל֑וֹ וְיֹאמַ֗ר ה֚וֹי הַמַּרְבֶּ֣ה לֹּא־ל֔וֹ עַד־מָתַ֕י וּמַכְבִּ֥יד עָלָ֖יו עַבְטִֽיט׃
verses.translit: hlv''lh khlm 'lyv mshl ysh'v vmlytsh chydvt lv vy'mr hvy hmrbh l'lv 'dmty vmkhbyd 'lyv 'btyt
verses.translation: Shall not all these take up a parable against him, And a taunting riddle against him, And say: ‘Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! How long? and that ladeth himself with many pledges! ’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא פֶ֗תַע יָק֙וּמוּ֙ נֹֽשְׁכֶ֔יךָ וְיִקְצ֖וּ מְזַעְזְעֶ֑יךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ לִמְשִׁסּ֖וֹת לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: hlv' pt' yqvmv nshkhykh vyqtsv mz'z'ykh vhyyt lmshsvt lmv
verses.translation: Shall they not rise up suddenly that shall exact interest of thee, And awake that shall violently shake thee, And thou shalt be for booties unto them?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֤ה שַׁלּ֙וֹתָ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים יְשׇׁלּ֖וּךָ כׇּל־יֶ֣תֶר עַמִּ֑ים מִדְּמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ וַֽחֲמַס־אֶ֔רֶץ קִרְיָ֖ה וְכׇל־יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy'th shlvt gvym rbym yshlvkh khlytr 'mym mdmy 'dm vchms'rts qryh vkhlyshby bh {p}
verses.translation: Because thou hast spoiled many nations, All the remnant of the peoples shall spoil thee; Because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, To the city and to all that dwell therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֗וֹי בֹּצֵ֛עַ בֶּ֥צַע רָ֖ע לְבֵית֑וֹ לָשׂ֤וּם בַּמָּרוֹם֙ קִנּ֔וֹ לְהִנָּצֵ֖ל מִכַּף־רָֽע׃
verses.translit: hvy bts' bts' r' lbytv lshvm bmrvm qnv lhntsl mkhfr'
verses.translation: Woe to him that gaineth evil gains for his house, That he may set his nest on high, That he may be delivered from the power of evil!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָעַ֥צְתָּ בֹּ֖שֶׁת לְבֵיתֶ֑ךָ קְצוֹת־עַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים וְחוֹטֵ֥א נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: y'tst bsht lbytkh qtsvt'mym rbym vchvt' npshkh
verses.translation: Thou hast devised shame to thy house, By cutting off many peoples, And hast forfeited thy life.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־אֶ֖בֶן מִקִּ֣יר תִּזְעָ֑ק וְכָפִ֖יס מֵעֵ֥ץ יַעֲנֶֽנָּה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy'bn mqyr tz'q vkhpys m'ts y'nnh {p}
verses.translation: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, And the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֛וֹי בֹּנֶ֥ה עִ֖יר בְּדָמִ֑ים וְכוֹנֵ֥ן קִרְיָ֖ה בְּעַוְלָֽה׃
verses.translit: hvy bnh 'yr bdmym vkhvnn qryh b'vlh
verses.translation: Woe to him that buildeth a town with blood, And establisheth a city by iniquity!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא הִנֵּ֔ה מֵאֵ֖ת יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְיִֽיגְע֤וּ עַמִּים֙ בְּדֵי־אֵ֔שׁ וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים בְּדֵי־רִ֥יק יִעָֽפוּ׃
verses.translit: hlv' hnh m't yhvh tsb'vt vyyg'v 'mym bdy'sh vl'mym bdyryq y'pv
verses.translation: Behold, is it not of the LORD of hosts That the peoples labour for the fire, And the nations weary themselves for vanity?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֚י תִּמָּלֵ֣א הָאָ֔רֶץ לָדַ֖עַת אֶת־כְּב֣וֹד יְהֹוָ֑ה כַּמַּ֖יִם יְכַסּ֥וּ עַל־יָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy tml' h'rts ld't 'tkhbvd yhvh khmym ykhsv 'lym {p}
verses.translation: For the earth shall be filled With the knowledge of the glory of the LORD, As the waters cover the sea.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֚וֹי מַשְׁקֵ֣ה רֵעֵ֔הוּ מְסַפֵּ֥חַ חֲמָתְךָ֖ וְאַ֣ף שַׁכֵּ֑ר לְמַ֥עַן הַבִּ֖יט עַל־מְעוֹרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: hvy mshqh r'hv mspch chmtkh v'f shkhr lm'n hbyt 'lm'vryhm
verses.translation: Woe unto him that giveth his neighbour drink, That puttest thy venom thereto, and makest him drunken also, That thou mayest look on their nakedness!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂבַ֤עְתָּ קָלוֹן֙ מִכָּב֔וֹד שְׁתֵ֥ה גַם־אַ֖תָּה וְהֵעָרֵ֑ל תִּסּ֣וֹב עָלֶ֗יךָ כּ֚וֹס יְמִ֣ין יְהֹוָ֔ה וְקִיקָל֖וֹן עַל־כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: shb't qlvn mkhbvd shth gm'th vh'rl tsvb 'lykh khvs ymyn yhvh vqyqlvn 'lkhbvdkh
verses.translation: Thou art filled with shame instead of glory, Drink thou also, and be uncovered; The cup of the LORD’S right hand shall be turned unto thee, And filthiness shall be upon thy glory.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י חֲמַ֤ס לְבָנוֹן֙ יְכַסֶּ֔ךָּ וְשֹׁ֥ד בְּהֵמ֖וֹת יְחִיתַ֑ן מִדְּמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ וַחֲמַס־אֶ֔רֶץ קִרְיָ֖ה וְכׇל־יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khy chms lbnvn ykhskh vshd bhmvt ychytn mdmy 'dm vchms'rts qryh vkhlyshby bh
verses.translation: For the violence done to Lebanon shall cover thee, And the destruction of the beasts, which made them afraid; Because of men’s blood, and for the violence done to the land, To the city and to all that dwell therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָה־הוֹעִ֣יל פֶּ֗סֶל כִּ֤י פְסָלוֹ֙ יֹֽצְר֔וֹ מַסֵּכָ֖ה וּמ֣וֹרֶה שָּׁ֑קֶר כִּ֣י בָטַ֞ח יֹצֵ֤ר יִצְרוֹ֙ עָלָ֔יו לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֱלִילִ֥ים אִלְּמִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: mhhv'yl psl khy pslv ytsrv mskhh vmvrh shqr khy btch ytsr ytsrv 'lyv l'shvt 'lylym 'lmym {s}
verses.translation: What profiteth the graven image, That the maker thereof hath graven it, Even the molten image, and the teacher of lies; That the maker of his work trusteth therein, To make dumb idols?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וֹי אֹמֵ֤ר לָעֵץ֙ הָקִ֔יצָה ע֖וּרִי לְאֶ֣בֶן דּוּמָ֑ם ה֣וּא יוֹרֶ֔ה הִנֵּה־ה֗וּא תָּפוּשׂ֙ זָהָ֣ב וָכֶ֔סֶף וְכׇל־ר֖וּחַ אֵ֥ין בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hvy 'mr l'ts hqytsh 'vry l'bn dvmm hv' yvrh hnhhv' tpvsh zhb vkhsf vkhlrvch 'yn bqrbv
verses.translation: Woe unto him that saith to the wood: ‘Awake’, To the dumb stone: ‘Arise! ’ Can this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, And there is no breath at all in the midst of it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיהֹוָ֖ה בְּהֵיכַ֣ל קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ הַ֥ס מִפָּנָ֖יו כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyhvh bhykhl qdshv hs mpnyv khlh'rts {s}
verses.translation: But the LORD is in His holy temple; Let all the earth keep silence before Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּפִלָּ֖ה לַחֲבַקּ֣וּק הַנָּבִ֑יא עַ֖ל שִׁגְיֹנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: tplh lchbqvq hnby' 'l shgynvt
verses.translation: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet. Upon Shigionoth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֗ה שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי שִׁמְעֲךָ֮ יָרֵ֒אתִי֒ יְהֹוָ֗ה פׇּֽעׇלְךָ֙ בְּקֶ֤רֶב שָׁנִים֙ חַיֵּ֔יהוּ בְּקֶ֥רֶב שָׁנִ֖ים תּוֹדִ֑יעַ בְּרֹ֖גֶז רַחֵ֥ם תִּזְכּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: yhvh shm'ty shm'kh yr'ty yhvh p'lkh bqrb shnym chyyhv bqrb shnym tvdy' brgz rchm tzkhvr
verses.translation: O LORD, I have heard the report of Thee, and am afraid; O LORD, revive Thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make it known; In wrath remember compassion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱל֙וֹהַּ֙ מִתֵּימָ֣ן יָב֔וֹא וְקָד֥וֹשׁ מֵהַר־פָּארָ֖ן סֶ֑לָה כִּסָּ֤ה שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ הוֹד֔וֹ וּתְהִלָּת֖וֹ מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 'lvh mtymn ybv' vqdvsh mhrp'rn slh khsh shmym hvdv vthltv ml'h h'rts
verses.translation: God cometh from Teman, And the Holy One from mount Paran. Selah His glory covereth the heavens, And the earth is full of His praise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנֹ֙גַהּ֙ כָּא֣וֹר תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה קַרְנַ֥יִם מִיָּד֖וֹ ל֑וֹ וְשָׁ֖ם חֶבְי֥וֹן עֻזֹּֽה׃
verses.translit: vngh kh'vr thyh qrnym mydv lv vshm chbyvn 'zh
verses.translation: And a brightness appeareth as the light; rays hath He at His side; and there is the hiding of His power.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְפָנָ֖יו יֵ֣לֶךְ דָּ֑בֶר וְיֵצֵ֥א רֶ֖שֶׁף לְרַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: lpnyv ylkh dbr vyts' rshf lrglyv
verses.translation: Before him goeth the pestilence, and fiery bolts go forth at His feet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָמַ֣ד  וַיְמֹ֣דֶד אֶ֗רֶץ רָאָה֙ וַיַּתֵּ֣ר גּוֹיִ֔ם וַיִּתְפֹּֽצְצוּ֙ הַרְרֵי־עַ֔ד שַׁח֖וּ גִּבְע֣וֹת עוֹלָ֑ם הֲלִיכ֥וֹת עוֹלָ֖ם לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'md  vymdd 'rts r'h vytr gvym vytptstsv hrry'd shchv gb'vt 'vlm hlykhvt 'vlm lv
verses.translation: He standeth, and shaketh the earth, He beholdeth, and maketh the nations to tremble; And the everlasting mountains are dashed in pieces, The ancient hills do bow; His goings are as of old.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת אָ֔וֶן רָאִ֖יתִי אׇהֳלֵ֣י כוּשָׁ֑ן יִרְגְּז֕וּן יְרִיע֖וֹת אֶ֥רֶץ מִדְיָֽן׃
verses.translit: tcht 'vn r'yty 'hly khvshn yrgzvn yry'vt 'rts mdyn
verses.translation: I see the tents of Cushan in affliction; The curtains of the land of Midian do tremble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲבִנְהָרִים֙ חָרָ֣ה יְהֹוָ֔ה אִ֤ם בַּנְּהָרִים֙ אַפֶּ֔ךָ אִם־בַּיָּ֖ם עֶבְרָתֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י תִרְכַּב֙ עַל־סוּסֶ֔יךָ מַרְכְּבֹתֶ֖יךָ יְשׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.translit: hbnhrym chrh yhvh 'm bnhrym 'pkh 'mbym 'brtkh khy trkhb 'lsvsykh mrkhbtykh yshv'h
verses.translation: Is it, O LORD, that against the rivers, is it that Thine anger is kindled against the rivers, or Thy wrath against the sea? That Thou dost ride upon Thy horses, upon Thy chariots of victory?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֶרְיָ֤ה תֵעוֹר֙ קַשְׁתֶּ֔ךָ שְׁבֻע֥וֹת מַטּ֖וֹת אֹ֣מֶר סֶ֑לָה נְהָר֖וֹת תְּבַקַּע־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 'ryh t'vr qshtkh shb'vt mtvt 'mr slh nhrvt tbq''rts
verses.translation: Thy bow is made quite bare; Sworn are the rods of the word. Selah. Thou dost cleave the earth with rivers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָא֤וּךָ יָחִ֙ילוּ֙ הָרִ֔ים זֶ֥רֶם מַ֖יִם עָבָ֑ר נָתַ֤ן תְּהוֹם֙ קוֹל֔וֹ ר֖וֹם יָדֵ֥יהוּ נָשָֽׂא׃
verses.translit: r'vkh ychylv hrym zrm mym 'br ntn thvm qvlv rvm ydyhv nsh'
verses.translation: The mountains have seen Thee, and they tremble; the tempest of waters floweth over; the deep uttereth its voice, And lifteth up its hands on high.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שֶׁ֥מֶשׁ יָרֵ֖חַ עָ֣מַד זְבֻ֑לָה לְא֤וֹר חִצֶּ֙יךָ֙ יְהַלֵּ֔כוּ לְנֹ֖גַהּ בְּרַ֥ק חֲנִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: shmsh yrch 'md zblh l'vr chtsykh yhlkhv lngh brq chnytkh
verses.translation: The sun and moon stand still in their habitation; at the light of Thine arrows as they go, At the shining of Thy glittering spear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּזַ֖עַם תִּצְעַד־אָ֑רֶץ בְּאַ֖ף תָּד֥וּשׁ גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: bz'm tts'd'rts b'f tdvsh gvym
verses.translation: Thou marchest through the earth in indignation, Thou threshest the nations in anger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָצָ֙אתָ֙ לְיֵ֣שַׁע עַמֶּ֔ךָ לְיֵ֖שַׁע אֶת־מְשִׁיחֶ֑ךָ מָחַ֤צְתָּ רֹּאשׁ֙ מִבֵּ֣ית רָשָׁ֔ע עָר֛וֹת יְס֥וֹד עַד־צַוָּ֖אר סֶֽלָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yts't lysh' 'mkh lysh' 'tmshychkh mchtst r'sh mbyt rsh' 'rvt ysvd 'dtsv'r slh {p}
verses.translation: Thou art come forth for the deliverance of Thy people, for the deliverance of Thine anointed; Thou woundest the head out of the house of the wicked, uncovering the foundation even unto the neck. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָקַ֤בְתָּ בְמַטָּיו֙ רֹ֣אשׁ פְּרָזָ֔ו יִסְעֲר֖וּ לַהֲפִיצֵ֑נִי עֲלִ֣יצֻתָ֔ם כְּמוֹ־לֶאֱכֹ֥ל עָנִ֖י בַּמִּסְתָּֽר׃
verses.translit: nqbt bmtyv r'sh przv ys'rv lhpytsny 'lytstm khmvl'khl 'ny bmstr
verses.translation: Thou hast stricken through with his own rods the head of his rulers, that come as a whirlwind to scatter me; whose rejoicing is as to devour the poor secretly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דָּרַ֥כְתָּ בַיָּ֖ם סוּסֶ֑יךָ חֹ֖מֶר מַ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: drkht bym svsykh chmr mym rbym
verses.translation: Thou hast trodden the sea with Thy horses, the foaming of mighty waters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי  וַתִּרְגַּ֣ז בִּטְנִ֗י לְקוֹל֙ צָלְל֣וּ שְׂפָתַ֔י יָב֥וֹא רָקָ֛ב בַּעֲצָמַ֖י וְתַחְתַּ֣י אֶרְגָּ֑ז אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנ֙וּחַ֙ לְי֣וֹם צָרָ֔ה לַעֲל֖וֹת לְעַ֥ם יְגוּדֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: shm'ty  vtrgz btny lqvl tsllv shpty ybv' rqb b'tsmy vtchty 'rgz 'shr 'nvch lyvm tsrh l'lvt l'm ygvdnv
verses.translation: When I heard, mine inward parts trembled, My lips quivered at the voice; Rottenness entereth into my bones, And I tremble where I stand; that I should wait for the day of trouble, when he cometh up against the people that he invadeth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תְאֵנָ֣ה לֹֽא־תִפְרָ֗ח וְאֵ֤ין יְבוּל֙ בַּגְּפָנִ֔ים כִּחֵשׁ֙ מַֽעֲשֵׂה־זַ֔יִת וּשְׁדֵמ֖וֹת לֹא־עָ֣שָׂה אֹ֑כֶל גָּזַ֤ר מִמִּכְלָה֙ צֹ֔אן וְאֵ֥ין בָּקָ֖ר בָּרְפָתִֽים׃
verses.translit: khyt'nh l'tprch v'yn ybvl bgpnym khchsh m'shhzyt vshdmvt l''shh 'khl gzr mmkhlh ts'n v'yn bqr brptym
verses.translation: For though the fig-tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, And the fields shall yield no food; The flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֖י בַּיהֹוָ֣ה אֶעְל֑וֹזָה אָגִ֖ילָה בֵּאלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'ny byhvh ''lvzh 'gylh b'lhy ysh'y
verses.translation: Yet I will rejoice in the LORD, I will exult in the God of my salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֱהֹוִ֤ה אֲדֹנָי֙ חֵילִ֔י וַיָּ֤שֶׂם רַגְלַי֙ כָּאַיָּל֔וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּמוֹתַ֖י יַדְרִכֵ֑נִי לַמְנַצֵּ֖חַ בִּנְגִינוֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'dny chyly vyshm rgly kh'ylvt v'l bmvty ydrkhny lmntsch bngynvty
verses.translation: God, the Lord, is my strength, And He maketh my feet like hinds’feet, And He maketh me to walk upon my high places. For the Leader. With my string-music.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֣ה  אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֗ה אֶל־צְפַנְיָה֙ בֶּן־כּוּשִׁ֣י בֶן־גְּדַלְיָ֔ה בֶּן־אֲמַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן־חִזְקִיָּ֑ה בִּימֵ֛י יֹאשִׁיָּ֥הוּ בֶן־אָמ֖וֹן מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: dbryhvh  'shr hyh 'ltspnyh bnkhvshy bngdlyh bn'mryh bnchzqyh bymy y'shyhv bn'mvn mlkh yhvdh
verses.translation: The word of the LORD which came unto Zephaniah the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah the son of Amon, king of Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָסֹ֨ף אָסֵ֜ף כֹּ֗ל מֵעַ֛ל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'sf 'sf khl m'l pny h'dmh n'myhvh
verses.translation: I will utterly consume all things from off the face of the earth, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָסֵ֨ף אָדָ֜ם וּבְהֵמָ֗ה אָסֵ֤ף עוֹף־הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֔ם וְהַמַּכְשֵׁל֖וֹת אֶת־הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים וְהִכְרַתִּ֣י אֶת־הָאָדָ֗ם מֵעַ֛ל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'sf 'dm vbhmh 'sf 'vfhshmym vdgy hym vhmkhshlvt 'thrsh'ym vhkhrty 'th'dm m'l pny h'dmh n'myhvh
verses.translation: I will consume man and beast, I will consume the fowls of the heaven, and the fishes of the sea, And the stumblingblocks with the wicked; And I will cut off man from off the face of the earth, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עַל־יְהוּדָ֔ה וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־יוֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְהִכְרַתִּ֞י מִן־הַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ אֶת־שְׁאָ֣ר הַבַּ֔עַל אֶת־שֵׁ֥ם הַכְּמָרִ֖ים עִם־הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
verses.translit: vntyty ydy 'lyhvdh v'l khlyvshby yrvshl͏m vhkhrty mnhmqvm hzh 'tsh'r hb'l 'tshm hkhmrym 'mhkhhnym
verses.translation: And I will stretch out My hand upon Judah, And upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; And I will cut off the remnant of Baal from this place, And the name of the idolatrous priests with the priests;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַמִּשְׁתַּחֲוִ֥ים עַל־הַגַּגּ֖וֹת לִצְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְאֶת־הַמִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוִים֙ הַנִּשְׁבָּעִ֣ים לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה וְהַנִּשְׁבָּעִ֖ים בְּמַלְכָּֽם׃
verses.translit: v'thmshtchvym 'lhggvt ltsb' hshmym v'thmshtchvym hnshb'ym lyhvh vhnshb'ym bmlkhm
verses.translation: And them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; And them that worship, that swear to the LORD And swear by Malcam;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־הַנְּסוֹגִ֖ים מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וַאֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־בִקְשׁ֥וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א דְרָשֻֽׁהוּ׃
verses.translit: v'thnsvgym m'chry yhvh v'shr l'bqshv 'tyhvh vl' drshhv
verses.translation: Them also that are turned back from following the LORD; And those that have not sought the LORD, nor inquired after Him. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֕ס מִפְּנֵ֖י אֲדֹנָ֣י יֱהֹוִ֑ה כִּ֤י קָרוֹב֙ י֣וֹם יְהֹוָ֔ה כִּֽי־הֵכִ֧ין יְהֹוָ֛ה זֶ֖בַח הִקְדִּ֥ישׁ קְרֻאָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hs mpny 'dny yhvh khy qrvb yvm yhvh khyhkhyn yhvh zbch hqdysh qr'yv
verses.translation: Hold thy peace at the presence of the Lord GOD; For the day of the LORD is at hand, For the LORD hath prepared a sacrifice, He hath consecrated His guests.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּיוֹם֙ זֶ֣בַח יְהֹוָ֔ה וּפָקַדְתִּ֥י עַל־הַשָּׂרִ֖ים וְעַל־בְּנֵ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְעַ֥ל כׇּל־הַלֹּבְשִׁ֖ים מַלְבּ֥וּשׁ נׇכְרִֽי׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm zbch yhvh vpqdty 'lhshrym v'lbny hmlkh v'l khlhlbshym mlbvsh nkhry
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in the day of the LORD’S sacrifice, That I will punish the princes, and the king’s sons, And all such as are clothed with foreign apparel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֗י עַ֧ל כׇּל־הַדּוֹלֵ֛ג עַל־הַמִּפְתָּ֖ן בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא הַֽמְמַלְאִ֛ים בֵּ֥ית אֲדֹנֵיהֶ֖ם חָמָ֥ס וּמִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: vpqdty 'l khlhdvlg 'lhmptn byvm hhv' hmml'ym byt 'dnyhm chms vmrmh
verses.translation: In the same day also will I punish all those that leap over the threshold, That fill their master’s house with violence and deceit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֗ה ק֤וֹל צְעָקָה֙ מִשַּׁ֣עַר הַדָּגִ֔ים וִֽילָלָ֖ה מִן־הַמִּשְׁנֶ֑ה וְשֶׁ֥בֶר גָּד֖וֹל מֵהַגְּבָעֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' n'myhvh qvl ts'qh msh'r hdgym vyllh mnhmshnh vshbr gdvl mhgb'vt
verses.translation: And in that day, saith the LORD, Hark! a cry from the fish gate, And a wailing from the second quarter, And a great crashing from the hills.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵילִ֖ילוּ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הַמַּכְתֵּ֑שׁ כִּ֤י נִדְמָה֙ כׇּל־עַ֣ם כְּנַ֔עַן נִכְרְת֖וּ כׇּל־נְטִ֥ילֵי כָֽסֶף׃ {ס}
verses.translit: hylylv yshby hmkhtsh khy ndmh khl'm khn'n nkhrtv khlntyly khsf {s}
verses.translation: Wail, ye inhabitants of Maktesh, For all the merchant people are undone; All they that were laden with silver are cut off.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא אֲחַפֵּ֥שׂ אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם בַּנֵּר֑וֹת וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י עַל־הָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים הַקֹּֽפְאִים֙ עַל־שִׁמְרֵיהֶ֔ם הָאֹֽמְרִים֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔ם לֹא־יֵיטִ֥יב יְהֹוָ֖ה וְלֹ֥א יָרֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: vhyh b't hhy' 'chpsh 'tyrvshl͏m bnrvt vpqdty 'lh'nshym hqp'ym 'lshmryhm h'mrym blbbm l'yytyb yhvh vl' yr'
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass at that time, That I will search Jerusalem with lamps; And I will punish the men that are settled on their lees, That say in their heart: ‘The LORD will not do good, neither will He do evil.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה חֵילָם֙ לִמְשִׁסָּ֔ה וּבָתֵּיהֶ֖ם לִשְׁמָמָ֑ה וּבָנ֤וּ בָתִּים֙ וְלֹ֣א יֵשֵׁ֔בוּ וְנָטְע֣וּ כְרָמִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁתּ֖וּ אֶת־יֵינָֽם׃
verses.translit: vhyh chylm lmshsh vbtyhm lshmmh vbnv btym vl' yshbv vnt'v khrmym vl' yshtv 'tyynm
verses.translation: Therefore their wealth shall become a booty, And their houses a desolation; Yea, they shall build houses, but shall not inhabit them, And they shall plant vineyards, but shall not drink the wine thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָר֤וֹב יוֹם־יְהֹוָה֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל קָר֖וֹב וּמַהֵ֣ר מְאֹ֑ד ק֚וֹל י֣וֹם יְהֹוָ֔ה מַ֥ר צֹרֵ֖חַ שָׁ֥ם גִּבּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: qrvb yvmyhvh hgdvl qrvb vmhr m'd qvl yvm yhvh mr tsrch shm gbvr
verses.translation: The great day of the LORD is near, It is near and hasteth greatly, Even the voice of the day of the LORD, Wherein the mighty man crieth bitterly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: י֥וֹם עֶבְרָ֖ה הַיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא י֧וֹם צָרָ֣ה וּמְצוּקָ֗ה י֤וֹם שֹׁאָה֙ וּמְשׁוֹאָ֔ה י֥וֹם חֹ֙שֶׁךְ֙ וַאֲפֵלָ֔ה י֥וֹם עָנָ֖ן וַעֲרָפֶֽל׃
verses.translit: yvm 'brh hyvm hhv' yvm tsrh vmtsvqh yvm sh'h vmshv'h yvm chshkh v'plh yvm 'nn v'rpl
verses.translation: That day is a day of wrath, A day of trouble and distress, A day of wasteness and desolation, A day of darkness and gloominess, A day of clouds and thick darkness,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: י֥וֹם שׁוֹפָ֖ר וּתְרוּעָ֑ה עַ֚ל הֶעָרִ֣ים הַבְּצֻר֔וֹת וְעַ֖ל הַפִּנּ֥וֹת הַגְּבֹהֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: yvm shvpr vtrv'h 'l h'rym hbtsrvt v'l hpnvt hgbhvt
verses.translation: A day of the horn and alarm, Against the fortified cities, and against the high towers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲצֵרֹ֣תִי לָאָדָ֗ם וְהָֽלְכוּ֙ כַּֽעִוְרִ֔ים כִּ֥י לַֽיהֹוָ֖ה חָטָ֑אוּ וְשֻׁפַּ֤ךְ דָּמָם֙ כֶּעָפָ֔ר וּלְחֻמָ֖ם כַּגְּלָלִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhtsrty l'dm vhlkhv kh'vrym khy lyhvh cht'v vshpkh dmm kh'pr vlchmm khgllym
verses.translation: And I will bring distress upon men, That they shall walk like the blind, Because they have sinned against the LORD; And their blood shall be poured out as dust, And their flesh as dung.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־כַּסְפָּ֨ם גַּם־זְהָבָ֜ם לֹא־יוּכַ֣ל לְהַצִּילָ֗ם בְּיוֹם֙ עֶבְרַ֣ת יְהֹוָ֔ה וּבְאֵשׁ֙ קִנְאָת֔וֹ תֵּאָכֵ֖ל כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־כָלָ֤ה אַךְ־נִבְהָלָה֙ יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֵ֥ת כׇּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: gmkhspm gmzhbm l'yvkhl lhtsylm byvm 'brt yhvh vb'sh qn'tv t'khl khlh'rts khykhlh 'khnbhlh y'shh 't khlyshby h'rts {s}
verses.translation: Neither their silver nor their gold Shall be able to deliver them In the day of the LORD’S wrath; But the whole earth shall be devoured by the fire of His jealousy; For He will make and end, yea, a terrible end, Of all them that dwell in the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִֽתְקוֹשְׁשׁ֖וּ וָק֑וֹשּׁוּ הַגּ֖וֹי לֹ֥א נִכְסָֽף׃
verses.translit: htqvshshv vqvshv hgvy l' nkhsf
verses.translation: Gather yourselves together, yea, gather together, O shameless nation;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּטֶ֙רֶם֙ לֶ֣דֶת חֹ֔ק כְּמֹ֖ץ עָ֣בַר י֑וֹם בְּטֶ֣רֶם  לֹא־יָב֣וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם חֲרוֹן֙ אַף־יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּטֶ֙רֶם֙ לֹא־יָב֣וֹא עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם י֖וֹם אַף־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: btrm ldt chq khmts 'br yvm btrm  l'ybv' 'lykhm chrvn 'fyhvh btrm l'ybv' 'lykhm yvm 'fyhvh
verses.translation: Before the decree bring forth The day when one passeth as the chaff, Before the fierce anger of the LORD come upon you, Before the day of the LORD’S anger come upon you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּקְּשׁ֤וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָה֙ כׇּל־עַנְוֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִשְׁפָּט֖וֹ פָּעָ֑לוּ בַּקְּשׁוּ־צֶ֙דֶק֙ בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ עֲנָוָ֔ה אוּלַי֙ תִּסָּ֣תְר֔וּ בְּי֖וֹם אַף־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: bqshv 'tyhvh khl'nvy h'rts 'shr mshptv p'lv bqshvtsdq bqshv 'nvh 'vly tstrv byvm 'fyhvh
verses.translation: Seek ye the LORD, all ye humble of the earth, That have executed His ordinance; Seek righteousness, seek humility. It may be ye shall be hid in the day of the LORD’S anger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י עַזָּה֙ עֲזוּבָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֔ה וְאַשְׁקְל֖וֹן לִשְׁמָמָ֑ה אַשְׁדּ֗וֹד בַּֽצׇּהֳרַ֙יִם֙ יְגָ֣רְשׁ֔וּהָ וְעֶקְר֖וֹן תֵּעָקֵֽר׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy 'zh 'zvbh thyh v'shqlvn lshmmh 'shdvd btshrym ygrshvh v'qrvn t'qr {s}
verses.translation: For Gaza shall be forsaken, And Ashkelon a desolation; They shall drive out Ashdod at the noonday, And Ekron shall be rooted up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֗וֹי יֹ֥שְׁבֵ֛י חֶ֥בֶל הַיָּ֖ם גּ֣וֹי כְּרֵתִ֑ים דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֣ה עֲלֵיכֶ֗ם כְּנַ֙עַן֙ אֶ֣רֶץ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖יךְ מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: hvy yshby chbl hym gvy khrtym dbryhvh 'lykhm khn'n 'rts plshtym vh'bdtykh m'yn yvshb
verses.translation: Woe unto the inhabitants of the sea-coast, The nation of the Cherethites! The word of the LORD is against you, O Canaan, the land of the Philistines; I will even destroy thee, that there shall be no inhabitant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהָיְתָ֞ה חֶ֣בֶל הַיָּ֗ם נְוֺ֛ת כְּרֹ֥ת רֹעִ֖ים וְגִדְר֥וֹת צֹֽאן׃
verses.translit: vhyth chbl hym nvt khrt r'ym vgdrvt ts'n
verses.translation: And the sea-coast shall be pastures, Even meadows for shepherds, and folds for flocks.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָ֣יָה חֶ֗בֶל לִשְׁאֵרִ֛ית בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יִרְע֑וּן בְּבָתֵּ֣י אַשְׁקְל֗וֹן בָּעֶ֙רֶב֙ יִרְבָּצ֔וּן כִּ֧י יִפְקְדֵ֛ם יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם וְשָׁ֥ב (שבותם) [שְׁבִיתָֽם]׃
verses.translit: vhyh chbl lsh'ryt byt yhvdh 'lyhm yr'vn bbty 'shqlvn b'rb yrbtsvn khy ypqdm yhvh 'lhyhm vshb (shbvtm) [shbytm]
verses.translation: And it shall be a portion for the remnant of the house of Judah, Whereon they shall feed; In the houses of Ashkelon shall they lie down in the evening; For the LORD their God will remember them, And turn their captivity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֙עְתִּי֙ חֶרְפַּ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב וְגִדֻּפֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁ֤ר חֵֽרְפוּ֙ אֶת־עַמִּ֔י וַיַּגְדִּ֖ילוּ עַל־גְּבוּלָֽם׃
verses.translit: shm'ty chrpt mv'b vgdpy bny 'mvn 'shr chrpv 't'my vygdylv 'lgbvlm
verses.translation: I have heard the taunt of Moab, And the revilings of the children of Ammon, Wherewith they have taunted My people, And spoken boastfully concerning their border.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן חַי־אָ֡נִי נְאֻם֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה צְבָא֜וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כִּי־מוֹאָ֞ב כִּסְדֹ֤ם תִּֽהְיֶה֙ וּבְנֵ֤י עַמּוֹן֙ כַּעֲמֹרָ֔ה מִמְשַׁ֥ק חָר֛וּל וּמִכְרֵה־מֶ֥לַח וּשְׁמָמָ֖ה עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם שְׁאֵרִ֤ית עַמִּי֙ יְבׇזּ֔וּם וְיֶ֥תֶר גּוֹיִ֖ יִנְחָלֽוּם׃
verses.translit: lkhn chy'ny n'm yhvh tsb'vt 'lhy yshr'l khymv'b khsdm thyh vbny 'mvn kh'mrh mmshq chrvl vmkhrhmlch vshmmh 'd'vlm sh'ryt 'my ybzvm vytr gvy ynchlvm
verses.translation: Therefore as I live, Saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel: Surely Moab shall be as Sodom, And the children of Ammon as Gomorrah, Even the breeding-place of nettles, and saltpits, And a desolation, for ever; The residue of My people shall spoil them, And the remnant of My nation shall inherit them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֥את לָהֶ֖ם תַּ֣חַת גְּאוֹנָ֑ם כִּ֤י חֵֽרְפוּ֙ וַיַּגְדִּ֔לוּ עַל־עַ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: z't lhm tcht g'vnm khy chrpv vygdlv 'l'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: This shall they have for their pride, Because they have taunted and spoken boastfully Against the people of the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נוֹרָ֤א יְהֹוָה֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כִּ֣י רָזָ֔ה אֵ֖ת כׇּל־אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁתַּֽחֲווּ־לוֹ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִמְּקוֹמ֔וֹ כֹּ֖ל אִיֵּ֥י הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: nvr' yhvh 'lyhm khy rzh 't khl'lhy h'rts vyshtchvvlv 'ysh mmqvmv khl 'yy hgvym
verses.translation: The LORD will be terrible unto them; For He will famish all the gods of the earth; Then shall all the isles of the nations worship Him, Every one from its place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אַתֶּ֣ם כּוּשִׁ֔ים חַֽלְלֵ֥י חַרְבִּ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: gm'tm khvshym chlly chrby hmh
verses.translation: Ye Ethiopians also, Ye shall be slain by My sword.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיֵ֤ט יָדוֹ֙ עַל־צָפ֔וֹן וִֽיאַבֵּ֖ד אֶת־אַשּׁ֑וּר וְיָשֵׂ֤ם אֶת־נִֽינְוֵה֙ לִשְׁמָמָ֔ה צִיָּ֖ה כַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: vyt ydv 'ltspvn vy'bd 't'shvr vyshm 'tnynvh lshmmh tsyh khmdbr
verses.translation: And He will stretch out His hand against the north, And destroy Assyria; And will make Nineveh a desolation, And dry like the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְרָבְצ֨וּ בְתוֹכָ֤הּ עֲדָרִים֙ כׇּל־חַיְתוֹ־ג֔וֹי גַּם־קָאַת֙ גַּם־קִפֹּ֔ד בְּכַפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ יָלִ֑ינוּ ק֠וֹל יְשׁוֹרֵ֤ר בַּֽחַלּוֹן֙ חֹ֣רֶב בַּסַּ֔ף כִּ֥י אַרְזָ֖הֿ עֵרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vrbtsv btvkhh 'drym khlchytvgvy gmq't gmqpd bkhptryh ylynv qvl yshvrr bchlvn chrb bsf khy 'rzh 'rh
verses.translation: And all beasts of every kind Shall lie down in the midst of her in herds; Both the pelican and the bittern Shall lodge in the capitals thereof; Voices shall sing in the windows; Desolation shall be in the posts; For the cedar-work thereof shall be uncovered.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֞֠את הָעִ֤יר הָעַלִּיזָה֙ הַיּוֹשֶׁ֣בֶת לָבֶ֔טַח הָאֹֽמְרָה֙ בִּלְבָבָ֔הּ אֲנִ֖י וְאַפְסִ֣י ע֑וֹד אֵ֣יךְ  הָיְתָ֣ה לְשַׁמָּ֗ה מַרְבֵּץ֙ לַֽחַיָּ֔ה כֹּ֚ל עוֹבֵ֣ר עָלֶ֔יהָ יִשְׁרֹ֖ק יָנִ֥יעַ יָדֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: z't h'yr h'lyzh hyvshbt lbtch h'mrh blbbh 'ny v'psy 'vd 'ykh  hyth lshmh mrbts lchyh khl 'vbr 'lyh yshrq yny' ydv {p}
verses.translation: This is the joyous city That dwelt without care, That said in her heart: ‘I am, and there is none else beside me’; How is she become a desolation, A place for beasts to lie down in! Every one that passeth by her Shall hiss, and wag his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֥וֹי מֹרְאָ֖ה וְנִגְאָלָ֑ה הָעִ֖יר הַיּוֹנָֽה׃
verses.translit: hvy mr'h vng'lh h'yr hyvnh
verses.translation: Woe to her that is filthy and polluted, To the oppressing city!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹ֤א שָֽׁמְעָה֙ בְּק֔וֹל לֹ֥א לָקְחָ֖ה מוּסָ֑ר בַּֽיהֹוָה֙ לֹ֣א בָטָ֔חָה אֶל־אֱלֹהֶ֖יהָ לֹ֥א קָרֵֽבָה׃
verses.translit: l' shm'h bqvl l' lqchh mvsr byhvh l' btchh 'l'lhyh l' qrbh
verses.translation: She hearkened not the voice, She received not correction; She trusted not in the LORD, She drew not near to her God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂרֶ֣יהָ בְקִרְבָּ֔הּ אֲרָי֖וֹת שֹׁאֲגִ֑ים שֹׁפְטֶ֙יהָ֙ זְאֵ֣בֵי עֶ֔רֶב לֹ֥א גָרְמ֖וּ לַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.translit: shryh bqrbh 'ryvt sh'gym shptyh z'by 'rb l' grmv lbqr
verses.translation: Her princes in the midst of her are roaring lions; Her judges are wolves of the desert, They leave not a bone for the morrow.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְבִיאֶ֙יהָ֙ פֹּֽחֲזִ֔ים אַנְשֵׁ֖י בֹּֽגְד֑וֹת כֹּהֲנֶ֙יהָ֙ חִלְּלוּ־קֹ֔דֶשׁ חָמְס֖וּ תּוֹרָֽה׃
verses.translit: nby'yh pchzym 'nshy bgdvt khhnyh chllvqdsh chmsv tvrh
verses.translation: Her prophets are wanton And treacherous persons; Her priests have profaned that which is holy, They have done violence to the law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֤ה צַדִּיק֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א יַעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַוְלָ֑ה בַּבֹּ֨קֶר בַּבֹּ֜קֶר מִשְׁפָּט֨וֹ יִתֵּ֤ן לָאוֹר֙ לֹ֣א נֶעְדָּ֔ר וְלֹא־יוֹדֵ֥עַ עַוָּ֖ל בֹּֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: yhvh tsdyq bqrbh l' y'shh 'vlh bbqr bbqr mshptv ytn l'vr l' n'dr vl'yvd' 'vl bsht
verses.translation: The LORD who is righteous is in the midst of her, He will not do unrighteousness; Every morning doth He bring His right to light, It faileth not; But the unrighteous knoweth no shame.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִכְרַ֣תִּי גוֹיִ֗ם נָשַׁ֙מּוּ֙ פִּנּוֹתָ֔ם הֶחֱרַ֥בְתִּי חוּצוֹתָ֖ם מִבְּלִ֣י עוֹבֵ֑ר נִצְדּ֧וּ עָרֵיהֶ֛ם מִבְּלִי־אִ֖ישׁ מֵאֵ֥ין יוֹשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: hkhrty gvym nshmv pnvtm hchrbty chvtsvtm mbly 'vbr ntsdv 'ryhm mbly'ysh m'yn yvshb
verses.translation: I have cut off nations, Their corners are desolate; I have made their streets waste, So that none passeth by; Their cities are destroyed, so that there is no man, So that there is no inhabitant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֜רְתִּי אַךְ־תִּֽירְאִ֤י אוֹתִי֙ תִּקְחִ֣י מוּסָ֔ר וְלֹֽא־יִכָּרֵ֣ת מְעוֹנָ֔הּ כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־פָּקַ֖דְתִּי עָלֶ֑יהָ אָכֵן֙ הִשְׁכִּ֣ימוּ הִשְׁחִ֔יתוּ כֹּ֖ל עֲלִילוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mrty 'khtyr'y 'vty tqchy mvsr vl'ykhrt m'vnh khl 'shrpqdty 'lyh 'khn hshkhymv hshchytv khl 'lylvtm
verses.translation: I said: ‘Surely thou wilt fear Me, Thou wilt receive correction; So her dwelling shall not be cut off, Despite all that I have visited upon her’; But they betimes corrupted all their doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֤ן חַכּוּ־לִי֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה לְי֖וֹם קוּמִ֣י לְעַ֑ד כִּ֣י מִשְׁפָּטִי֩ לֶאֱסֹ֨ף גּוֹיִ֜ם לְקׇבְצִ֣י מַמְלָכ֗וֹת לִשְׁפֹּ֨ךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם זַעְמִי֙ כֹּ֚ל חֲר֣וֹן אַפִּ֔י כִּ֚י בְּאֵ֣שׁ קִנְאָתִ֔י תֵּאָכֵ֖ל כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: lkhn chkhvly n'myhvh lyvm qvmy l'd khy mshpty l'sf gvym lqbtsy mmlkhvt lshpkh 'lyhm z'my khl chrvn 'py khy b'sh qn'ty t'khl khlh'rts
verses.translation: Therefore wait ye for Me, saith the LORD, Until the day that I rise up to the prey; For My determination is to gather the nations, That I may assemble the kingdoms, To pour upon them Mine indignation, Even all My fierce anger; For all the earth shall be devoured With the fire of My jealousy.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־אָ֛ז אֶהְפֹּ֥ךְ אֶל־עַמִּ֖ים שָׂפָ֣ה בְרוּרָ֑ה לִקְרֹ֤א כֻלָּם֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֔ה לְעׇבְד֖וֹ שְׁכֶ֥ם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: khy'z 'hpkh 'l'mym shph brvrh lqr' khlm bshm yhvh l'bdv shkhm 'chd
verses.translation: For then will I turn to the peoples A pure language, That they may all call upon the name of the LORD, To serve Him with one consent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵעֵ֖בֶר לְנַהֲרֵי־כ֑וּשׁ עֲתָרַי֙ בַּת־פּוּצַ֔י יוֹבִל֖וּן מִנְחָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: m'br lnhrykhvsh 'try btpvtsy yvblvn mnchty
verses.translation: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia Shall they bring My suppliants, Even the daughter of My dispersed, As Mine offering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא לֹ֤א תֵב֙וֹשִׁי֙ מִכֹּ֣ל עֲלִילֹתַ֔יִךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּשַׁ֖עַתְּ בִּ֑י כִּי־אָ֣ז  אָסִ֣יר מִקִּרְבֵּ֗ךְ עַלִּיזֵי֙ גַּאֲוָתֵ֔ךְ וְלֹא־תוֹסִ֧פִי לְגׇבְהָ֛ה ע֖וֹד בְּהַ֥ר קׇדְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' l' tbvshy mkhl 'lyltykh 'shr psh't by khy'z  'syr mqrbkh 'lyzy g'vtkh vl'tvspy lgbhh 'vd bhr qdshy
verses.translation: In that day shalt thou not be ashamed for all thy doings, Wherein thou hast transgressed against Me; For then I will take away out of the midst of thee Thy proudly exulting ones, And thou shalt no more be haughty In My holy mountain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִשְׁאַרְתִּ֣י בְקִרְבֵּ֔ךְ עַ֥ם עָנִ֖י וָדָ֑ל וְחָס֖וּ בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhsh'rty bqrbkh 'm 'ny vdl vchsv bshm yhvh
verses.translation: And I will leave in the midst of thee An afflicted and poor people, And they shall take refuge in the name of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁאֵרִ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֹֽא־יַעֲשׂ֤וּ עַוְלָה֙ וְלֹֽא־יְדַבְּר֣וּ כָזָ֔ב וְלֹֽא־יִמָּצֵ֥א בְּפִיהֶ֖ם לְשׁ֣וֹן תַּרְמִ֑ית כִּי־הֵ֛מָּה יִרְע֥וּ וְרָבְצ֖וּ וְאֵ֥ין מַחֲרִֽיד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: sh'ryt yshr'l l'y'shv 'vlh vl'ydbrv khzb vl'ymts' bpyhm lshvn trmyt khyhmh yr'v vrbtsv v'yn mchryd {p}
verses.translation: The remnant of Israel shall not do iniquity, Nor speak lies, Neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth; For they shall feed and lie down, And none shall make them afraid.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רׇנִּי֙ בַּת־צִיּ֔וֹן הָרִ֖יעוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל שִׂמְחִ֤י וְעׇלְזִי֙ בְּכׇל־לֵ֔ב בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: rny bttsyvn hry'v yshr'l shmchy v'lzy bkhllb bt yrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Sing, O daughter of Zion, Shout, O Israel; Be glad and rejoice with all the heart, O daughter of Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵסִ֤יר יְהֹוָה֙ מִשְׁפָּטַ֔יִךְ פִּנָּ֖ה אֹֽיְבֵ֑ךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל ׀ יְהֹוָה֙ בְּקִרְבֵּ֔ךְ לֹא־תִֽירְאִ֥י רָ֖ע עֽוֹד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hsyr yhvh mshptykh pnh 'ybkh mlkh yshr'l  yhvh bqrbkh l'tyr'y r' 'vd {p}
verses.translation: The LORD hath taken away thy judgments, He hath cast out thine enemy; The King of Israel, even the LORD, is in the midst of thee; Thou shalt not fear evil any more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יֵאָמֵ֥ר לִירוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם אַל־תִּירָ֑אִי צִיּ֖וֹן אַל־יִרְפּ֥וּ יָדָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' y'mr lyrvshl͏m 'ltyr'y tsyvn 'lyrpv ydykh
verses.translation: In that day it shall be said to Jerusalem: ‘Fear thou not; O Zion, let not thy hands be slack.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛יִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּ֖ךְ גִּבּ֣וֹר יוֹשִׁ֑יעַ יָשִׂ֨ישׂ עָלַ֜יִךְ בְּשִׂמְחָ֗ה יַֽחֲרִישׁ֙ בְּאַ֣הֲבָת֔וֹ יָגִ֥יל עָלַ֖יִךְ בְּרִנָּֽה׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhykh bqrbkh gbvr yvshy' yshysh 'lykh bshmchh ychrysh b'hbtv ygyl 'lykh brnh
verses.translation: The LORD thy God is in the midst of thee, A Mighty One who will save; He will rejoice over thee with joy, He will be silent in His love, He will joy over thee with singing.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נוּגֵ֧י מִמּוֹעֵ֛ד אָסַ֖פְתִּי מִמֵּ֣ךְ הָי֑וּ מַשְׂאֵ֥ת עָלֶ֖יהָ חֶרְפָּֽה׃
verses.translit: nvgy mmv'd 'spty mmkh hyv msh't 'lyh chrph
verses.translation: I will gather them that are far from the appointed season, who are of thee, That hast borne the burden of reproach.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֛ה אֶת־כׇּל־מְעַנַּ֖יִךְ בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶת־הַצֹּלֵעָ֗ה וְהַנִּדָּחָה֙ אֲקַבֵּ֔ץ וְשַׂמְתִּים֙ לִתְהִלָּ֣ה וּלְשֵׁ֔ם בְּכׇל־הָאָ֖רֶץ בׇּשְׁתָּֽם׃
verses.translit: hnny 'shh 'tkhlm'nykh b't hhy' vhvsh'ty 'thtsl'h vhndchh 'qbts vshmtym lthlh vlshm bkhlh'rts bshtm
verses.translation: Behold, at that time I will deal with all them that afflict thee; And I will save her that is lame, And gather her that was driven away; And I will make them to be a praise and a name, Whose shame hath been in all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּעֵ֤ת הַהִיא֙ אָבִ֣יא אֶתְכֶ֔ם וּבָעֵ֖ת קַבְּצִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֑ם כִּֽי־אֶתֵּ֨ן אֶתְכֶ֜ם לְשֵׁ֣ם וְלִתְהִלָּ֗ה בְּכֹל֙ עַמֵּ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ בְּשׁוּבִ֧י אֶת־שְׁבוּתֵיכֶ֛ם לְעֵינֵיכֶ֖ם אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: b't hhy' 'by' 'tkhm vb't qbtsy 'tkhm khy'tn 'tkhm lshm vlthlh bkhl 'my h'rts bshvby 'tshbvtykhm l'ynykhm 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: At that time will I bring you in, And at that time will I gather you; For I will make you to be a name and a praise Among all the peoples of the earth, When I turn your captivity before your eyes, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּשְׁנַ֤ת שְׁתַּ֙יִם֙ לְדָרְיָ֣וֶשׁ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָ֖ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֨ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֜ה בְּיַד־חַגַּ֣י הַנָּבִ֗יא אֶל־זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵל֙ פַּחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ בֶּן־יְהוֹצָדָ֛ק הַכֹּהֵ֥ן הַגָּד֖וֹל לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: bshnt shtym ldryvsh hmlkh bchdsh hshshy byvm 'chd lchdsh hyh dbryhvh bydchgy hnby' 'lzrbbl bnsh'lty'l pcht yhvdh v'lyhvsh' bnyhvtsdq hkhhn hgdvl l'mr
verses.translation: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, in the first day of the month, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet unto Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר הָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א עֶת־בֹּ֛א עֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָ֖ה לְהִבָּנֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt l'mr h'm hzh 'mrv l' 'tb' 'tbyt yhvh lhbnvt {p}
verses.translation: ’Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying: This people say: The time is not come, the time that the LORD’S house should be built.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּיַד־חַגַּ֥י הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh bydchgy hnby' l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַעֵ֤ת לָכֶם֙ אַתֶּ֔ם לָשֶׁ֖בֶת בְּבָתֵּיכֶ֣ם סְפוּנִ֑ים וְהַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה חָרֵֽב׃
verses.translit: h't lkhm 'tm lshbt bbtykhm spvnym vhbyt hzh chrb
verses.translation: ’Is it a time for you yourselves to dwell in your cieled houses, while this house lieth waste?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְכֶ֖ם עַל־דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'th khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt shymv lbbkhm 'ldrkhykhm
verses.translation: Now therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts: Consider your ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְרַעְתֶּ֨ם הַרְבֵּ֜ה וְהָבֵ֣א מְעָ֗ט אָכ֤וֹל וְאֵין־לְשׇׂבְעָה֙ שָׁת֣וֹ וְאֵין־לְשׇׁכְרָ֔ה לָב֖וֹשׁ וְאֵין־לְחֹ֣ם ל֑וֹ וְהַ֨מִּשְׂתַּכֵּ֔ר מִשְׂתַּכֵּ֖ר אֶל־צְר֥וֹר נָקֽוּב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: zr'tm hrbh vhb' m't 'khvl v'ynlshb'h shtv v'ynlshkhrh lbvsh v'ynlchm lv vhmshtkhr mshtkhr 'ltsrvr nqvb {p}
verses.translation: Ye have sown much, and brought in little, Ye eat, but ye have not enough, Ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink, Ye clothe you, but there is none warm; And he that earneth wages earneth wages For a bag with holes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְכֶ֖ם עַל־דַּרְכֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt shymv lbbkhm 'ldrkhykhm
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: Consider your ways.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲל֥וּ הָהָ֛ר וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם עֵ֖ץ וּבְנ֣וּ הַבָּ֑יִת וְאֶרְצֶה־בּ֥וֹ (ואכבד) [וְאֶכָּבְדָ֖ה] אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lv hhr vhb'tm 'ts vbnv hbyt v'rtshbv (v'khbd) [v'khbdh] 'mr yhvh
verses.translation: Go up to the hill-country, and bring wood, and build the house; and I will take pleasure in it, and I will be glorified, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּנֹ֤ה אֶל־הַרְבֵּה֙ וְהִנֵּ֣ה לִמְעָ֔ט וַהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם הַבַּ֖יִת וְנָפַ֣חְתִּי ב֑וֹ יַ֣עַן מֶ֗ה נְאֻם֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת יַ֗עַן בֵּיתִי֙ אֲשֶׁר־ה֣וּא חָרֵ֔ב וְאַתֶּ֥ם רָצִ֖ים אִ֥ישׁ לְבֵיתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: pnh 'lhrbh vhnh lm't vhb'tm hbyt vnpchty bv y'n mh n'm yhvh tsb'vt y'n byty 'shrhv' chrb v'tm rtsym 'ysh lbytv
verses.translation: Ye looked for much, and, lo, it came to little; and when ye brought it home, I did blow upon it. Why? saith the LORD of hosts. Because of My house that lieth waste, while ye run every man for his own house.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֣ן עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם כָּלְא֥וּ שָׁמַ֖יִם מִטָּ֑ל וְהָאָ֖רֶץ כָּלְאָ֥ה יְבוּלָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn 'lykhm khl'v shmym mtl vh'rts khl'h ybvlh
verses.translation: Therefore over you the heaven hath kept back, so that there is no dew, and the earth hath kept back her produce.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶקְרָ֨א חֹ֜רֶב עַל־הָאָ֣רֶץ וְעַל־הֶהָרִ֗ים וְעַל־הַדָּגָן֙ וְעַל־הַתִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְעַל־הַיִּצְהָ֔ר וְעַ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תּוֹצִ֖יא הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וְעַל־הָֽאָדָם֙ וְעַל־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה וְעַ֖ל כׇּל־יְגִ֥יעַ כַּפָּֽיִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'qr' chrb 'lh'rts v'lhhrym v'lhdgn v'lhtyrvsh v'lhytshr v'l 'shr tvtsy' h'dmh v'lh'dm v'lhbhmh v'l khlygy' khpym {p}
verses.translation: And I called for a drought upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the wine, and upon the oil, and upon that which the ground bringeth forth, and upon men, and upon cattle, and upon all the labour of the hands.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל ׀ בֶּֽן־שַׁלְתִּיאֵ֡ל וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בֶּן־יְהוֹצָדָק֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וְכֹ֣ל  שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָעָ֗ם בְּקוֹל֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֔ם וְעַל־דִּבְרֵי֙ חַגַּ֣י הַנָּבִ֔יא כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר שְׁלָח֖וֹ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּֽירְא֥וּ הָעָ֖ם מִפְּנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshm' zrbbl  bnshlty'l vyhvsh' bnyhvtsdq hkhhn hgdvl vkhl  sh'ryt h'm bqvl yhvh 'lhyhm v'ldbry chgy hnby' kh'shr shlchv yhvh 'lhyhm vyyr'v h'm mpny yhvh
verses.translation: Then Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, with all the remnant of the people, hearkened unto the voice of the LORD their God, and unto the words of Haggai the prophet, as the LORD their God had sent him; and the people did fear before the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יֹּ֠אמֶר חַגַּ֞י מַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהֹוָ֛ה בְּמַלְאֲכ֥וּת יְהֹוָ֖ה לָעָ֣ם לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֥י אִתְּכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr chgy ml'kh yhvh bml'khvt yhvh l'm l'mr 'ny 'tkhm n'myhvh
verses.translation: Then spoke Haggai the LORD’S messenger in the LORD’S message unto the people, saying: ‘I am with you, saith the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֣עַר יְהֹוָ֡ה אֶת־ר֩וּחַ֩ זְרֻבָּבֶ֨ל בֶּן־שַׁלְתִּיאֵ֜ל פַּחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֗ה וְאֶת־ר֙וּחַ֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בֶּן־יְהוֹצָדָק֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל וְֽאֶת־ר֔וּחַ כֹּ֖ל שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָעָ֑ם וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ מְלָאכָ֔ה בְּבֵית־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'r yhvh 'trvch zrbbl bnshlty'l pcht yhvdh v'trvch yhvsh' bnyhvtsdq hkhhn hgdvl v'trvch khl sh'ryt h'm vyb'v vy'shv ml'khh bbytyhvh tsb'vt 'lhyhm {p}
verses.translation: And the LORD stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and the spirit of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the remnant of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the LORD of hosts, their God,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּי֨וֹם עֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֛ה לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ בַּשִּׁשִּׁ֑י בִּשְׁנַ֥ת שְׁתַּ֖יִם לְדָרְיָ֥וֶשׁ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: byvm 'shrym v'rb'h lchdsh bshshy bshnt shtym ldryvsh hmlkh
verses.translation: in the four and twentieth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּשְּׁבִיעִ֕י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאֶחָ֖ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָה֙ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּיַד־חַגַּ֥י הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: bshby'y b'shrym v'chd lchdsh hyh dbryhvh bydchgy hnby' l'mr
verses.translation: In the seventh month, in the one and twentieth day of the month, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱמׇר־נָ֗א אֶל־זְרֻבָּבֶ֤ל בֶּן־שַׁלְתִּיאֵל֙ פַּחַ֣ת יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶל־יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בֶּן־יְהוֹצָדָ֖ק הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֑וֹל וְאֶל־שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: 'mrn' 'lzrbbl bnshlty'l pcht yhvdh v'lyhvsh' bnyhvtsdq hkhhn hgdvl v'lsh'ryt h'm l'mr
verses.translation: ’Speak now to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel, governor of Judah, and to Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the remnant of the people, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י בָכֶם֙ הַנִּשְׁאָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָאָה֙ אֶת־הַבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֔ה בִּכְבוֹד֖וֹ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן וּמָ֨ה אַתֶּ֜ם רֹאִ֤ים אֹתוֹ֙ עַ֔תָּה הֲל֥וֹא כָמֹ֛הוּ כְּאַ֖יִן בְּעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: my bkhm hnsh'r 'shr r'h 'thbyt hzh bkhbvdv hr'shvn vmh 'tm r'ym 'tv 'th hlv' khmhv kh'yn b'ynykhm
verses.translation: Who is left among you that saw this house in its former glory? and how do ye see it now? is not such a one as nothing in your eyes?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה חֲזַ֣ק זְרֻבָּבֶ֣ל ׀ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֡ה וַחֲזַ֣ק יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בֶּן־יְהוֹצָדָק֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן הַגָּד֜וֹל וַחֲזַ֨ק כׇּל־עַ֥ם הָאָ֛רֶץ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֖ה וַֽעֲשׂ֑וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י אִתְּכֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'th chzq zrbbl  n'myhvh vchzq yhvsh' bnyhvtsdq hkhhn hgdvl vchzq khl'm h'rts n'myhvh v'shv khy'ny 'tkhm n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Yet now be strong, O Zerubbabel, saith the LORD; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the LORD, and work; for I am with you, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶֽת־הַדָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר־כָּרַ֤תִּי אִתְּכֶם֙ בְּצֵאתְכֶ֣ם מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וְרוּחִ֖י עֹמֶ֣דֶת בְּתוֹכְכֶ֑ם אַל־תִּירָֽאוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'thdbr 'shrkhrty 'tkhm bts'tkhm mmtsrym vrvchy 'mdt btvkhkhm 'ltyr'v {p}
verses.translation: The word that I covenanted with you when ye came out of Egypt have I established, and My spirit abideth among you; fear ye not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת ע֥וֹד אַחַ֖ת מְעַ֣ט הִ֑יא וַאֲנִ֗י מַרְעִישׁ֙ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֶת־הַיָּ֖ם וְאֶת־הֶחָרָבָֽה׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'vd 'cht m't hy' v'ny mr'ysh 'thshmym v'th'rts v'thym v'thchrbh
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts: Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִרְעַשְׁתִּי֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וּבָ֖אוּ חֶמְדַּ֣ת כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּמִלֵּאתִ֞י אֶת־הַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ כָּב֔וֹד אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vhr'shty 'tkhlhgvym vb'v chmdt khlhgvym vml'ty 'thbyt hzh khbvd 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: and I will shake all nations, and the choicest things of all nations shall come, and I will fill this house with glory, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֥י הַכֶּ֖סֶף וְלִ֣י הַזָּהָ֑ב נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: ly hkhsf vly hzhb n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Mine is the silver, and Mine the gold, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּד֣וֹל יִֽהְיֶ֡ה כְּבוֹד֩ הַבַּ֨יִת הַזֶּ֤ה הָאַֽחֲרוֹן֙ מִן־הָ֣רִאשׁ֔וֹן אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וּבַמָּק֤וֹם הַזֶּה֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן שָׁל֔וֹם נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: gdvl yhyh khbvd hbyt hzh h'chrvn mnhr'shvn 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vbmqvm hzh 'tn shlvm n'm yhvh tsb'vt {p}
verses.translation: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than that of the former, saith the LORD of hosts; and in this place will I give peace, saith the LORD of hosts.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּעֶשְׂרִ֤ים וְאַרְבָּעָה֙ לַתְּשִׁיעִ֔י בִּשְׁנַ֥ת שְׁתַּ֖יִם לְדָרְיָ֑וֶשׁ הָיָה֙ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־חַגַּ֥י הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: b'shrym v'rb'h ltshy'y bshnt shtym ldryvsh hyh dbryhvh 'lchgy hnby' l'mr
verses.translation: In the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD by Haggai the prophet, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת שְׁאַל־נָ֧א אֶת־הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים תּוֹרָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt sh'ln' 'thkhhnym tvrh l'mr
verses.translation: ’Thus saith the LORD of hosts: Ask now the priests for instruction, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֣ן  יִשָּׂא־אִ֨ישׁ בְּשַׂר־קֹ֜דֶשׁ בִּכְנַ֣ף בִּגְד֗וֹ וְנָגַ֣ע בִּ֠כְנָפ֠וֹ אֶל־הַלֶּ֨חֶם וְאֶל־הַנָּזִ֜יד וְאֶל־הַיַּ֧יִן וְאֶל־שֶׁ֛מֶן וְאֶל־כׇּל־מַאֲכָ֖ל הֲיִקְדָּ֑שׁ וַיַּעֲנ֧וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹֽא׃
verses.translit: hn  ysh''ysh bshrqdsh bkhnf bgdv vng' bkhnpv 'lhlchm v'lhnzyd v'lhyyn v'lshmn v'lkhlm'khl hyqdsh vy'nv hkhhnym vy'mrv l'
verses.translation: If one bear hallowed flesh in the skirt of his garment, and with his skirt do touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any food, shall it be holy?’ And the priests answered and said: ‘No.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר חַגַּ֔י אִם־יִגַּ֧ע טְמֵא־נֶ֛פֶשׁ בְּכׇל־אֵ֖לֶּה הֲיִטְמָ֑א וַיַּעֲנ֧וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ יִטְמָֽא׃
verses.translit: vy'mr chgy 'myg' tm'npsh bkhl'lh hytm' vy'nv hkhhnym vy'mrv ytm'
verses.translation: Then said Haggai: ‘If one that is unclean by a dead body touch any of these, shall it be unclean?’ And the priests answered and said: ‘It shall be unclean.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן חַגַּ֜י וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כֵּ֣ן הָֽעָם־הַ֠זֶּ֠ה וְכֵן־הַגּ֨וֹי הַזֶּ֤ה לְפָנַי֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְכֵ֖ן כׇּל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיהֶ֑ם וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יַקְרִ֛יבוּ שָׁ֖ם טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vy'n chgy vy'mr khn h'mhzh vkhnhgvy hzh lpny n'myhvh vkhn khlm'shh ydyhm v'shr yqrybv shm tm' hv'
verses.translation: Then answered Haggai, and said: ‘So is this people, and so is this nation before me, saith the LORD; and so is every work of their hands; and that which they offer there is unclean.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ שִֽׂימוּ־נָ֣א לְבַבְכֶ֔ם מִן־הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה מִטֶּ֧רֶם שֽׂוּם־אֶ֛בֶן אֶל־אֶ֖בֶן בְּהֵיכַ֥ל יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th shymvn' lbbkhm mnhyvm hzh vm'lh mtrm shvm'bn 'l'bn bhykhl yhvh
verses.translation: And now, I pray you, consider from this day and forward—before a stone was laid upon a stone in the temple of the LORD,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽהְיוֹתָ֥ם בָּא֙ אֶל־עֲרֵמַ֣ת עֶשְׂרִ֔ים וְהָיְתָ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֑ה בָּ֣א אֶל־הַיֶּ֗קֶב לַחְשֹׂף֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים פּוּרָ֔ה וְהָיְתָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִֽים׃
verses.translit: mhyvtm b' 'l'rmt 'shrym vhyth 'shrh b' 'lhyqb lchshf chmshym pvrh vhyth 'shrym
verses.translation: through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were but ten; when one came to the winevat to draw out fifty press-measures, there were but twenty;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִכֵּ֨יתִי אֶתְכֶ֜ם בַּשִּׁדָּפ֤וֹן וּבַיֵּֽרָקוֹן֙ וּבַבָּרָ֔ד אֵ֖ת כׇּל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְדֵיכֶ֑ם וְאֵין־אֶתְכֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hkhyty 'tkhm bshdpvn vbyrqvn vbbrd 't khlm'shh ydykhm v'yn'tkhm 'ly n'myhvh
verses.translation: I smote you with blasting and with mildew and with hail in all the work of your hands; yet ye turned not to Me, saith the LORD—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׂימוּ־נָ֣א לְבַבְכֶ֔ם מִן־הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה מִיּוֹם֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֜ה לַתְּשִׁיעִ֗י לְמִן־הַיּ֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־יֻסַּ֥ד הֵֽיכַל־יְהֹוָ֖ה שִׂ֥ימוּ לְבַבְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: shymvn' lbbkhm mnhyvm hzh vm'lh myvm 'shrym v'rb'h ltshy'y lmnhyvm 'shrysd hykhlyhvh shymv lbbkhm
verses.translation: consider, I pray you, from this day and forward, from the four and twentieth day of the ninth month, even from the day that the foundation of the LORD’S temple was laid, consider it;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַע֤וֹד הַזֶּ֙רַע֙ בַּמְּגוּרָ֔ה וְעַד־הַגֶּ֨פֶן וְהַתְּאֵנָ֧ה וְהָרִמּ֛וֹן וְעֵ֥ץ הַזַּ֖יִת לֹ֣א נָשָׂ֑א מִן־הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּ֖ה אֲבָרֵֽךְ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: h'vd hzr' bmgvrh v'dhgpn vht'nh vhrmvn v'ts hzyt l' nsh' mnhyvm hzh 'brkh {p}
verses.translation: is the seed yet in the barn? yea, the vine, and the fig-tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive-tree hath not brought forth—from this day will I bless you.’ .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֤ה ׀ שֵׁנִית֙ אֶל־חַגַּ֔י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֧ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֛ה לַחֹ֖דֶשׁ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh  shnyt 'lchgy b'shrym v'rb'h lchdsh l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came the second time unto Haggai in the four and twentieth day of the month, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱמֹ֕ר אֶל־זְרֻבָּבֶ֥ל פַּֽחַת־יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר אֲנִ֣י מַרְעִ֔ישׁ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 'mr 'lzrbbl pchtyhvdh l'mr 'ny mr'ysh 'thshmym v'th'rts
verses.translation: ’Speak to Zerubbabel, governor of Judah, saying: I will shake the heavens and the earth;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָֽפַכְתִּי֙ כִּסֵּ֣א מַמְלָכ֔וֹת וְהִ֨שְׁמַדְתִּ֔י חֹ֖זֶק מַמְלְכ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְהָפַכְתִּ֤י מֶרְכָּבָה֙ וְרֹ֣כְבֶ֔יהָ וְיָרְד֤וּ סוּסִים֙ וְרֹ֣כְבֵיהֶ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ בְּחֶ֥רֶב אָחִֽיו׃
verses.translit: vhpkhty khs' mmlkhvt vhshmdty chzq mmlkhvt hgvym vhpkhty mrkhbh vrkhbyh vyrdv svsym vrkhbyhm 'ysh bchrb 'chyv
verses.translation: and I will overthrow the throne of kingdoms, and I will destroy the strength of the kingdoms of the nations; and I will overthrow the chariots, and those that ride in them; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword of his brother.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֣וּא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֡וֹת אֶ֠קָּחֲךָ֠ זְרֻבָּבֶ֨ל בֶּן־שְׁאַלְתִּיאֵ֤ל עַבְדִּי֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וְשַׂמְתִּ֖יךָ כַּֽחוֹתָ֑ם כִּֽי־בְךָ֣ בָחַ֔רְתִּי נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' n'myhvh tsb'vt 'qchkh zrbbl bnsh'lty'l 'bdy n'myhvh vshmtykh khchvtm khybkh bchrty n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, will I take thee, O Zerubbabel, My servant, the son of Shealtiel, saith the LORD, and will make thee as a signet; for I have chosen thee, saith the LORD of hosts.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י בִּשְׁנַ֥ת שְׁתַּ֖יִם לְדָרְיָ֑וֶשׁ הָיָ֣ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶל־זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּן־בֶּ֣רֶכְיָ֔ה בֶּן־עִדּ֥וֹ הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: bchdsh hshmyny bshnt shtym ldryvsh hyh dbryhvh 'lzkhryh bnbrkhyh bn'dv hnby' l'mr
verses.translation: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, the prophet, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קָצַ֧ף יְהֹוָ֛ה עַל־אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם קָֽצֶף׃
verses.translit: qtsf yhvh 'l'bvtykhm qtsf
verses.translation: ’The LORD hath been sore displeased with your fathers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
