verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵהֶ֗ם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת שׁ֣וּבוּ אֵלַ֔י נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְאָשׁ֣וּב אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lhm khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt shvbv 'ly n'm yhvh tsb'vt v'shvb 'lykhm 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Therefore say thou unto them, Thus saith the LORD of hosts: Return unto Me, saith the LORD of hosts, and I will return unto you, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּהְי֣וּ כַאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֡ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר קָרְאֽוּ־אֲלֵיהֶם֩ הַנְּבִיאִ֨ים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִ֜ים לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת שׁ֤וּבוּ נָא֙ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֣ם הָרָעִ֔ים (ומעליליכם) [וּמַֽעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם] הָֽרָעִ֑ים וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֛וּ וְלֹֽא־הִקְשִׁ֥יבוּ אֵלַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lthyv kh'btykhm 'shr qr'v'lyhm hnby'ym hr'shnym l'mr khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt shvbv n' mdrkhykhm hr'ym (vm'lylykhm) [vm'llykhm] hr'ym vl' shm'v vl'hqshybv 'ly n'myhvh
verses.translation: Be ye not as your fathers, unto whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: Return ye now from your evil ways, and from your evil doings; but they did not hear, nor attend unto Me, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם אַיֵּה־הֵ֑ם וְהַ֨נְּבִאִ֔ים הַלְעוֹלָ֖ם יִֽחְיֽוּ׃
verses.translit: 'bvtykhm 'yhhm vhnb'ym hl'vlm ychyv
verses.translation: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they live for ever?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ  דְּבָרַ֣י וְחֻקַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוִּ֙יתִי֙ אֶת־עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים הֲל֥וֹא הִשִּׂ֖יגוּ אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וַיָּשׁ֣וּבוּ וַיֹּאמְר֗וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר זָמַ֜ם יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָ֔נוּ כִּדְרָכֵ֙ינוּ֙ וּכְמַ֣עֲלָלֵ֔ינוּ כֵּ֖ן עָשָׂ֥ה אִתָּֽנוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'kh  dbry vchqy 'shr tsvyty 't'bdy hnby'ym hlv' hshygv 'btykhm vyshvbv vy'mrv kh'shr zmm yhvh tsb'vt l'shvt lnv khdrkhynv vkhm'llynv khn 'shh 'tnv {p}
verses.translation: But My words and My statutes, which I commanded My servants the prophets, did they not overtake your fathers? so that they turned and said: Like as the LORD of hosts purposed to do unto us, according to our ways, and according to our doings, so hath He dealt with us.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּיוֹם֩ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֜ה לְעַשְׁתֵּֽי־עָשָׂ֥ר חֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הוּא־חֹ֣דֶשׁ שְׁבָ֔ט בִּשְׁנַ֥ת שְׁתַּ֖יִם לְדָרְיָ֑וֶשׁ הָיָ֣ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶל־זְכַרְיָה֙ בֶּן־בֶּ֣רֶכְיָ֔הוּ בֶּן־עִדּ֥וֹא הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: byvm 'shrym v'rb'h l'shty'shr chdsh hv'chdsh shbt bshnt shtym ldryvsh hyh dbryhvh 'lzkhryh bnbrkhyhv bn'dv' hnby' l'mr
verses.translation: Upon the four and twentieth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, came the word of the LORD unto Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, the prophet, saying—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֣יתִי  הַלַּ֗יְלָה וְהִנֵּה־אִישׁ֙ רֹכֵב֙ עַל־ס֣וּס אָדֹ֔ם וְה֣וּא עֹמֵ֔ד בֵּ֥ין הַהֲדַסִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמְּצֻלָ֑ה וְאַחֲרָיו֙ סוּסִ֣ים אֲדֻמִּ֔ים שְׂרֻקִּ֖ים וּלְבָנִֽים׃
verses.translit: r'yty  hlylh vhnh'ysh rkhb 'lsvs 'dm vhv' 'md byn hhdsym 'shr bmtslh v'chryv svsym 'dmym shrqym vlbnym
verses.translation: I saw in the night, and behold a man riding upon a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle-trees that were in the bottom; and behind him there were horses, red, sorrel, and white.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר מָה־אֵ֣לֶּה אֲדֹנִ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י הַמַּלְאָךְ֙ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֔י אֲנִ֥י אַרְאֶ֖ךָּ מָה־הֵ֥מָּה אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: v'mr mh'lh 'dny vy'mr 'ly hml'kh hdbr by 'ny 'r'kh mhhmh 'lh
verses.translation: Then said I: ‘O my lord, what are these?’ And the angel that spoke with me said unto me: ‘I will show thee what these are.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֗עַן הָאִ֛ישׁ הָעֹמֵ֥ד בֵּין־הַהֲדַסִּ֖ים וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֵ֚לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁלַ֣ח יְהֹוָ֔ה לְהִתְהַלֵּ֖ךְ בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vy'n h'ysh h'md bynhhdsym vy'mr 'lh 'shr shlch yhvh lhthlkh b'rts
verses.translation: And the man that stood among the myrtle-trees answered and said: ‘These are they whom the LORD hath sent to walk to and fro through the earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיַּעֲנ֞וּ אֶת־מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהֹוָ֗ה הָֽעֹמֵד֙ בֵּ֣ין הַהֲדַסִּ֔ים וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ הִתְהַלַּ֣כְנוּ בָאָ֑רֶץ וְהִנֵּ֥ה כׇל־הָאָ֖רֶץ יֹשֶׁ֥בֶת וְשֹׁקָֽטֶת׃
verses.translit: vy'nv 'tml'kh yhvh h'md byn hhdsym vy'mrv hthlkhnv b'rts vhnh khlh'rts yshbt vshqtt
verses.translation: And they answered the angel of the LORD that stood among the myrtle-trees, and said: ‘We have walked to and fro through the earth, and, behold, all the earth sitteth still, and is at rest.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַן מַלְאַךְ־יְהֹוָה֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עַד־מָתַ֗י אַתָּה֙ לֹֽא־תְרַחֵ֣ם אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וְאֵ֖ת עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר זָעַ֔מְתָּה זֶ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'n ml'khyhvh vy'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'dmty 'th l'trchm 'tyrvshl͏m v't 'ry yhvdh 'shr z'mth zh shb'ym shnh
verses.translation: Then the angel of the LORD spoke and said: ‘O LORD of hosts, how long wilt Thou not have compassion on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which Thou hast had indignation these threescore and ten years?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַן יְהֹוָ֗ה אֶת־הַמַּלְאָ֛ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ֖י דְּבָרִ֣ים טוֹבִ֑ים דְּבָרִ֖ים נִחֻמִֽים׃
verses.translit: vy'n yhvh 'thml'kh hdbr by dbrym tvbym dbrym nchmym
verses.translation: And the LORD answered the angel that spoke with me with good words, even comforting words—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י הַמַּלְאָךְ֙ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֔י קְרָ֣א לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת קִנֵּ֧אתִי לִירוּשָׁלַ֛͏ִם וּלְצִיּ֖וֹן קִנְאָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly hml'kh hdbr by qr' l'mr khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt qn'ty lyrvshl͏m vltsyvn qn'h gdvlh
verses.translation: so the angel that spoke with me said unto me: ‘Proclaim thou, saying: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקֶ֤צֶף גָּדוֹל֙ אֲנִ֣י קֹצֵ֔ף עַל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם הַשַּֽׁאֲנַנִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ קָצַ֣פְתִּי מְּעָ֔ט וְהֵ֖מָּה עָזְר֥וּ לְרָעָֽה׃
verses.translit: vqtsf gdvl 'ny qtsf 'lhgvym hsh'nnym 'shr 'ny qtspty m't vhmh 'zrv lr'h
verses.translation: and I am very sore displeased with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, and they helped for evil.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֗ה שַׁ֤בְתִּי לִירוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ בְּֽרַחֲמִ֔ים בֵּיתִי֙ יִבָּ֣נֶה בָּ֔הּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת (וקוה) [וְקָ֥ו] יִנָּטֶ֖ה עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: lkhn khh'mr yhvh shbty lyrvshl͏m brchmym byty ybnh bh n'm yhvh tsb'vt (vqvh) [vqv] ynth 'lyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Therefore thus saith the LORD: I return to Jerusalem with compassions: My house shall be built in it, saith the LORD of hosts, and a line shall be stretched forth over Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ע֣וֹד  קְרָ֣א לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת ע֛וֹד תְּפוּצֶ֥נָה עָרַ֖י מִטּ֑וֹב וְנִחַ֨ם יְהֹוָ֥ה עוֹד֙ אֶת־צִיּ֔וֹן וּבָחַ֥ר ע֖וֹד בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'vd  qr' l'mr khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'vd tpvtsnh 'ry mtvb vnchm yhvh 'vd 'ttsyvn vbchr 'vd byrvshl͏m {p}
verses.translation: Again, proclaim, saying: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: My cities shall again overflow with prosperity; and the LORD shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת־עֵינַ֖י וָאֵ֑רֶא וְהִנֵּ֖ה אַרְבַּ֥ע קְרָנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'sh' 't'yny v'r' vhnh 'rb' qrnvt
verses.translation: And I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and behold four horns.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֗ר אֶל־הַמַּלְאָ֛ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ֖י מָה־אֵ֑לֶּה וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י אֵ֤לֶּה הַקְּרָנוֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר זֵר֣וּ אֶת־יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mr 'lhml'kh hdbr by mh'lh vy'mr 'ly 'lh hqrnvt 'shr zrv 'tyhvdh 'tyshr'l vyrvshl͏m {p}
verses.translation: And I said unto the angel that spoke with me: ‘What are these?’ And he said unto me: ‘These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּרְאֵ֣נִי יְהֹוָ֔ה אַרְבָּעָ֖ה חָרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.translit: vyr'ny yhvh 'rb'h chrshym
verses.translation: And the LORD showed me four craftsmen.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר מָ֛ה אֵ֥לֶּה בָאִ֖ים לַֽעֲשׂ֑וֹת וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לֵאמֹ֗ר אֵ֣לֶּה הַקְּרָנ֞וֹת אֲשֶׁר־זֵ֣רוּ אֶת־יְהוּדָ֗ה כְּפִי־אִישׁ֙ לֹא־נָשָׂ֣א רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֤אוּ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ לְהַחֲרִ֣יד אֹתָ֔ם לְיַדּ֞וֹת אֶת־קַרְנ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֗ם הַנֹּשְׂאִ֥ים קֶ֛רֶן אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָ֖ה לְזָרוֹתָֽהּ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'mr mh 'lh b'ym l'shvt vy'mr l'mr 'lh hqrnvt 'shrzrv 'tyhvdh khpy'ysh l'nsh' r'shv vyb'v 'lh lhchryd 'tm lydvt 'tqrnvt hgvym hnsh'ym qrn 'l'rts yhvdh lzrvth {s}
verses.translation: Then said I: ‘What come these to do?’ And he spoke, saying: ‘These—the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man did lift up his head—these then are come to frighten them, to cast down the horns of the nations, which lifted up their horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשָּׂ֥א עֵינַ֛י וָאֵ֖רֶא וְהִנֵּה־אִ֑ישׁ וּבְיָד֖וֹ חֶ֥בֶל מִדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: v'sh' 'yny v'r' vhnh'ysh vbydv chbl mdh
verses.translation: And I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and behold a man with a measuring line in his hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר אָ֖נָה אַתָּ֣ה הֹלֵ֑ךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י לָמֹד֙ אֶת־יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם לִרְא֥וֹת כַּמָּֽה־רׇחְבָּ֖הּ וְכַמָּ֥ה אׇרְכָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'nh 'th hlkh vy'mr 'ly lmd 'tyrvshl͏m lr'vt khmhrchbh vkhmh 'rkhh
verses.translation: Then said I: ‘Whither goest thou?’ And he said unto me: ‘To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth thereof, and what is the length thereof.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֗ה הַמַּלְאָ֛ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ֖י יֹצֵ֑א וּמַלְאָ֣ךְ אַחֵ֔ר יֹצֵ֖א לִקְרָאתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhnh hml'kh hdbr by yts' vml'kh 'chr yts' lqr'tv
verses.translation: And, behold, the angel that spoke with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔ו רֻ֗ץ דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל־הַנַּ֥עַר הַלָּ֖ז לֵאמֹ֑ר פְּרָזוֹת֙ תֵּשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם מֵרֹ֥ב אָדָ֛ם וּבְהֵמָ֖ה בְּתוֹכָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lv rts dbr 'lhn'r hlz l'mr przvt tshb yrvshl͏m mrb 'dm vbhmh btvkhh
verses.translation: and said unto him: ‘Run, speak to this young man, saying: ‘Jerusalem shall be inhabited without walls for the multitude of men and cattle therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י אֶֽהְיֶה־לָּהּ֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה ח֥וֹמַת אֵ֖שׁ סָבִ֑יב וּלְכָב֖וֹד אֶהְיֶ֥ה בְתוֹכָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ny 'hyhlh n'myhvh chvmt 'sh sbyb vlkhbvd 'hyh btvkhh {p}
verses.translation: For I, saith the LORD, will be unto her a wall of fire round about, and I will be the glory in the midst of her.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וֹי ה֗וֹי וְנֻ֛סוּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ צָפ֖וֹן נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֠י כְּאַרְבַּ֞ע רוּח֧וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֛יִם פֵּרַ֥שְׂתִּי אֶתְכֶ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: hvy hvy vnsv m'rts tspvn n'myhvh khy kh'rb' rvchvt hshmym prshty 'tkhm n'myhvh
verses.translation: Ho, ho, flee then from the land of the north, saith the LORD; for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֥וֹי צִיּ֖וֹן הִמָּלְטִ֑י יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בַּת־בָּבֶֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hvy tsyvn hmlty yvshbt btbbl {p}
verses.translation: Ho, Zion, escape, thou that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָמַר֮ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ אַחַ֣ר כָּב֔וֹד שְׁלָחַ֕נִי אֶל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם הַשֹּׁלְלִ֣ים אֶתְכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י הַנֹּגֵ֣עַ בָּכֶ֔ם נֹגֵ֖עַ בְּבָבַ֥ת עֵינֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'chr khbvd shlchny 'lhgvym hshllym 'tkhm khy hng' bkhm ng' bbbt 'ynv
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of hosts who sent me after glory unto the nations which spoiled you: ‘Surely, he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י הִנְנִ֨י מֵנִ֤יף אֶת־יָדִי֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ שָׁלָ֖ל לְעַבְדֵיהֶ֑ם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחָֽנִי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: khy hnny mnyf 'tydy 'lyhm vhyv shll l'bdyhm vyd'tm khyyhvh tsb'vt shlchny {s}
verses.translation: For, behold, I will shake My hand over them, and they shall be a spoil to those that served them’; and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רׇנִּ֥י וְשִׂמְחִ֖י בַּת־צִיּ֑וֹן כִּ֧י הִנְנִי־בָ֛א וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֥י בְתוֹכֵ֖ךְ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: rny vshmchy bttsyvn khy hnnyb' vshkhnty btvkhkh n'myhvh
verses.translation: ’Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion; for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנִלְווּ֩ גוֹיִ֨ם רַבִּ֤ים אֶל־יְהֹוָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י לְעָ֑ם וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֣י בְתוֹכֵ֔ךְ וְיָדַ֕עַתְּ כִּי־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחַ֥נִי אֵלָֽיִךְ׃
verses.translit: vnlvv gvym rbym 'lyhvh byvm hhv' vhyv ly l'm vshkhnty btvkhkh vyd't khyyhvh tsb'vt shlchny 'lykh
verses.translation: And many nations shall join themselves to the LORD in that day, and shall be My people, and I will dwell in the midst of thee’; and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנָחַ֨ל יְהֹוָ֤ה אֶת־יְהוּדָה֙ חֶלְק֔וֹ עַ֖ל אַדְמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּבָחַ֥ר ע֖וֹד בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vnchl yhvh 'tyhvdh chlqv 'l 'dmt hqdsh vbchr 'vd byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And the LORD shall inherit Judah as His portion in the holy land, and shall choose Jerusalem again.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥ס כׇּל־בָּשָׂ֖ר מִפְּנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֥י נֵע֖וֹר מִמְּע֥וֹן קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hs khlbshr mpny yhvh khy n'vr mm'vn qdshv {p}
verses.translation: Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD; for He is aroused out of His holy habitation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּרְאֵ֗נִי אֶת־יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֔וֹל עֹמֵ֕ד לִפְנֵ֖י מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְהַשָּׂטָ֛ן עֹמֵ֥ד עַל־יְמִינ֖וֹ לְשִׂטְנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyr'ny 'tyhvsh' hkhhn hgdvl 'md lpny ml'kh yhvh vhshtn 'md 'lymynv lshtnv
verses.translation: And he showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of the LORD, and Satan standing at his right hand to accuse him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־הַשָּׂטָ֗ן יִגְעַ֨ר יְהֹוָ֤ה בְּךָ֙ הַשָּׂטָ֔ן וְיִגְעַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ בְּךָ֔ הַבֹּחֵ֖ר בִּירֽוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם הֲל֧וֹא זֶ֦ה א֖וּד מֻצָּ֥ל מֵאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'lhshtn yg'r yhvh bkh hshtn vyg'r yhvh bkh hbchr byrvshl͏m hlv' zh 'vd mtsl m'sh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Satan: ‘The LORD rebuke thee, O Satan, yea, the LORD that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee; is not this man a brand plucked out of the fire?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֕עַ הָיָ֥ה לָבֻ֖שׁ בְּגָדִ֣ים צוֹאִ֑ים וְעֹמֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י הַמַּלְאָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vyhvsh' hyh lbsh bgdym tsv'ym v'md lpny hml'kh
verses.translation: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַן וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אֶל־הָעֹמְדִ֤ים לְפָנָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הָסִ֛ירוּ הַבְּגָדִ֥ים הַצֹּאִ֖ים מֵעָלָ֑יו וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו רְאֵ֨ה הֶעֱבַ֤רְתִּי מֵעָלֶ֙יךָ֙ עֲוֺנֶ֔ךָ וְהַלְבֵּ֥שׁ אֹתְךָ֖ מַחֲלָצֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'n vy'mr 'lh'mdym lpnyv l'mr hsyrv hbgdym hts'ym m'lyv vy'mr 'lyv r'h h'brty m'lykh 'vnkh vhlbsh 'tkh mchltsvt
verses.translation: And he answered and spoke unto those that stood before him, saying: ‘Take the filthy garments from off him.’ And unto him he said: ‘Behold, I cause thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with robes.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר יָשִׂ֛ימוּ צָנִ֥יף טָה֖וֹר עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיָּשִׂ֩ימוּ֩ הַצָּנִ֨יף הַטָּה֜וֹר עַל־רֹאשׁ֗וֹ וַיַּלְבִּשֻׁ֙הוּ֙ בְּגָדִ֔ים וּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהֹוָ֖ה עֹמֵֽד׃
verses.translit: v'mr yshymv tsnyf thvr 'lr'shv vyshymv htsnyf hthvr 'lr'shv vylbshhv bgdym vml'kh yhvh 'md
verses.translation: And I said: ‘Let them set a fair mitre upon his head.’ So they set a fair mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments; and the angel of the LORD stood by.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֙עַד֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהֹוָ֔ה בִּיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'd ml'kh yhvh byhvsh' l'mr
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD forewarned Joshua, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּה־אָמַ֞ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אִם־בִּדְרָכַ֤י תֵּלֵךְ֙ וְאִ֣ם אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֣י תִשְׁמֹ֔ר וְגַם־אַתָּה֙ תָּדִ֣ין אֶת־בֵּיתִ֔י וְגַ֖ם תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר אֶת־חֲצֵרָ֑י וְנָתַתִּ֤י לְךָ֙ מַהְלְכִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָעֹמְדִ֖ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'mbdrkhy tlkh v'm 'tmshmrty tshmr vgm'th tdyn 'tbyty vgm tshmr 'tchtsry vntty lkh mhlkhym byn h'mdym h'lh
verses.translation: ’Thus saith the LORD of hosts: If thou wilt walk in My ways, and if thou wilt keep My charge, and wilt also judge My house, and wilt also keep My courts, then I will give thee free access among these that stand by.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְֽׁמַֽע־נָ֞א יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ  הַכֹּהֵ֣ן הַגָּד֗וֹל אַתָּה֙ וְרֵעֶ֙יךָ֙ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֣ים לְפָנֶ֔יךָ כִּֽי־אַנְשֵׁ֥י מוֹפֵ֖ת הֵ֑מָּה כִּֽי־הִנְנִ֥י מֵבִ֛יא אֶת־עַבְדִּ֖י צֶֽמַח׃
verses.translit: shm'n' yhvsh'  hkhhn hgdvl 'th vr'ykh hyshbym lpnykh khy'nshy mvpt hmh khyhnny mby' 't'bdy tsmch
verses.translation: Hear now, O Joshua the high priest, thou and thy fellows that sit before thee; for they are men that are a sign; for, behold, I will bring forth My servant the Shoot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י  הִנֵּ֣ה הָאֶ֗בֶן אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַ֙תִּי֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עַל־אֶ֥בֶן אַחַ֖ת שִׁבְעָ֣ה עֵינָ֑יִם הִנְנִ֧י מְפַתֵּ֣חַ פִּתֻּחָ֗הּ נְאֻם֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּמַשְׁתִּ֛י אֶת־עֲוֺ֥ן הָאָֽרֶץ־הַהִ֖יא בְּי֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: khy  hnh h'bn 'shr ntty lpny yhvsh' 'l'bn 'cht shb'h 'ynym hnny mptch ptchh n'm yhvh tsb'vt vmshty 't'vn h'rtshhy' byvm 'chd
verses.translation: For behold the stone that I have laid before Joshua; upon one stone are seven facets; behold, I will engrave the graving thereof, saith the LORD of hosts: And I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נְאֻם֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת תִּקְרְא֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ לְרֵעֵ֑הוּ אֶל־תַּ֥חַת גֶּ֖פֶן וְאֶל־תַּ֥חַת תְּאֵנָֽה׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' n'm yhvh tsb'vt tqr'v 'ysh lr'hv 'ltcht gpn v'ltcht t'nh
verses.translation: In that day, saith the LORD of hosts, shall ye call every man his neighbour under the vine and under the fig-tree.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּ֕שׇׁב הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י וַיְעִירֵ֕נִי כְּאִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־יֵע֥וֹר מִשְּׁנָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyshb hml'kh hdbr by vy'yrny kh'ysh 'shry'vr mshntv
verses.translation: And the angel that spoke with me returned, and waked me, as a man that is wakened out of his sleep.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה (ויאמר) [וָאֹמַ֡ר] רָאִ֣יתִי ׀ וְהִנֵּ֣ה מְנוֹרַת֩ זָהָ֨ב כֻּלָּ֜הּ וְגֻלָּ֣הּ עַל־רֹאשָׁ֗הּ וְשִׁבְעָ֤ה נֵרֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ שִׁבְעָ֤ה וְשִׁבְעָה֙ מֽוּצָק֔וֹת לַנֵּר֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל־רֹאשָֽׁהּ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly mh 'th r'h (vy'mr) [v'mr] r'yty  vhnh mnvrt zhb khlh vglh 'lr'shh vshb'h nrtyh 'lyh shb'h vshb'h mvtsqvt lnrvt 'shr 'lr'shh
verses.translation: And he said unto me: ‘What seest thou?’ And I said: ‘I have seen, and behold a candlestick all of gold, with a bowl upon the top of it, and its seven lamps thereon; there are seven pipes, yea, seven, to the lamps, which are upon the top thereof;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּשְׁנַ֥יִם זֵיתִ֖ים עָלֶ֑יהָ אֶחָד֙ מִימִ֣ין הַגֻּלָּ֔ה וְאֶחָ֖ד עַל־שְׂמֹאלָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vshnym zytym 'lyh 'chd mymyn hglh v'chd 'lshm'lh
verses.translation: and two olive-trees by it, one upon the right side of the bowl, and the other upon the left side thereof.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאַ֙עַן֙ וָֽאֹמַ֔ר אֶל־הַמַּלְאָ֛ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֥ר בִּ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר מָה־אֵ֖לֶּה אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: v''n v'mr 'lhml'kh hdbr by l'mr mh'lh 'dny
verses.translation: And I answered and spoke to the angel that spoke with me, saying: ‘What are these, my lord?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֠יַּ֠עַן הַמַּלְאָ֞ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֥ר בִּי֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י הֲל֥וֹא יָדַ֖עְתָּ מָה־הֵ֣מָּה אֵ֑לֶּה וָאֹמַ֖ר לֹ֥א אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'n hml'kh hdbr by vy'mr 'ly hlv' yd't mhhmh 'lh v'mr l' 'dny
verses.translation: Then the angel that spoke with me answered and said unto me: ‘Knowest thou not what these are?’ And I said: ‘No, my lord.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֜עַן וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר זֶ֚ה דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹ֤א בְחַ֙יִל֙ וְלֹ֣א בְכֹ֔חַ כִּ֣י אִם־בְּרוּחִ֔י אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vy'n vy'mr 'ly l'mr zh dbryhvh 'lzrbbl l'mr l' bchyl vl' bkhch khy 'mbrvchy 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Then he answered and spoke unto me, saying: ‘This is the word of the LORD unto Zerubbabel, saying: Not by might, nor by power, but by My spirit, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־אַתָּ֧ה הַֽר־הַגָּד֛וֹל לִפְנֵ֥י זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל לְמִישֹׁ֑ר וְהוֹצִיא֙ אֶת־הָאֶ֣בֶן הָרֹאשָׁ֔הֿ תְּשֻׁא֕וֹת חֵ֥ן חֵ֖ן לָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: my'th hrhgdvl lpny zrbbl lmyshr vhvtsy' 'th'bn hr'shh tsh'vt chn chn lh {p}
verses.translation: Who art thou, O great mountain before Zerubbabel? thou shalt become a plain; and he shall bring forth the top stone with shoutings of Grace, grace, unto it.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְדֵ֣י זְרֻבָּבֶ֗ל יִסְּד֛וּ הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּ֖ה וְיָדָ֣יו תְּבַצַּ֑עְנָה וְיָ֣דַעְתָּ֔ כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחַ֥נִי אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: ydy zrbbl ysdv hbyt hzh vydyv tbts'nh vyd't khyyhvh tsb'vt shlchny 'lykhm
verses.translation: ’The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house; his hands shall also finish it; and thou shalt know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֣י בַז֮ לְי֣וֹם קְטַנּוֹת֒ וְשָׂמְח֗וּ וְרָא֞וּ אֶת־הָאֶ֧בֶן הַבְּדִ֛יל בְּיַ֥ד זְרֻבָּבֶ֖ל שִׁבְעָה־אֵ֑לֶּה עֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה הֵ֥מָּה מְשׁוֹטְטִ֖ים בְּכׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: khy my bz lyvm qtnvt vshmchv vr'v 'th'bn hbdyl byd zrbbl shb'h'lh 'yny yhvh hmh mshvttym bkhlh'rts
verses.translation: For who hath despised the day of small things? even they shall see with joy the plummet in the hand of Zerubbabel, even these seven, which are the eyes of the LORD, that run to and fro through the whole earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאַ֖עַן וָאֹמַ֣ר אֵלָ֑יו מַה־שְּׁנֵ֤י הַזֵּיתִים֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה עַל־יְמִ֥ין הַמְּנוֹרָ֖ה וְעַל־שְׂמֹאולָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v''n v'mr 'lyv mhshny hzytym h'lh 'lymyn hmnvrh v'lshm'vlh
verses.translation: Then answered I, and said unto him: ‘What are these two olive-trees upon the right side of the candlestick and upon the left side thereof?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאַ֣עַן שֵׁנִ֔ית וָאֹמַ֖ר אֵלָ֑יו מַה־שְׁתֵּ֞י שִׁבְּלֵ֣י הַזֵּיתִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּיַ֗ד שְׁנֵי֙ צַנְתְּר֣וֹת הַזָּהָ֔ב הַֽמְרִיקִ֥ים מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם הַזָּהָֽב׃
verses.translit: v''n shnyt v'mr 'lyv mhshty shbly hzytym 'shr byd shny tsntrvt hzhb hmryqym m'lyhm hzhb
verses.translation: And I answered the second time, and said unto him: ‘What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts, that empty the golden oil out of themselves?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הֲל֥וֹא יָדַ֖עְתָּ מָה־אֵ֑לֶּה וָאֹמַ֖ר לֹ֥א אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly l'mr hlv' yd't mh'lh v'mr l' 'dny
verses.translation: And he answered me and said: ‘Knowest thou not what these are?’ And I said: ‘No, my lord.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֵ֖לֶּה שְׁנֵ֣י בְנֵֽי־הַיִּצְהָ֑ר הָעֹמְדִ֖ים עַל־אֲד֥וֹן כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lh shny bnyhytshr h'mdym 'l'dvn khlh'rts
verses.translation: Then said he: ‘These are the two anointed ones, that stand by the Lord of the whole earth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָשׁ֕וּב וָאֶשָּׂ֥א עֵינַ֖י וָֽאֶרְאֶ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֖ה מְגִלָּ֥ה עָפָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'shvb v'sh' 'yny v'r'h vhnh mglh 'ph
verses.translation: Then again I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and behold a flying scroll.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י מָ֥ה אַתָּ֖ה רֹאֶ֑ה וָאֹמַ֗ר אֲנִ֤י רֹאֶה֙ מְגִלָּ֣ה עָפָ֔ה אׇרְכָּהּ֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וְרׇחְבָּ֖הּ עֶ֥שֶׂר בָּאַמָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly mh 'th r'h v'mr 'ny r'h mglh 'ph 'rkhh 'shrym b'mh vrchbh 'shr b'mh
verses.translation: And he said unto me: ‘What seest thou?’ And I answered: ‘I see a flying scroll; the length thereof is twenty cubits, and the breadth thereof ten cubits.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י זֹ֚את הָֽאָלָ֔ה הַיּוֹצֵ֖את עַל־פְּנֵ֣י כׇל־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י כׇל־הַגֹּנֵ֗ב מִזֶּה֙ כָּמ֣וֹהָ נִקָּ֔ה וְכׇ֨ל־הַנִּשְׁבָּ֔ע מִזֶּ֖ה כָּמ֥וֹהָ נִקָּֽה׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly z't h'lh hyvts't 'lpny khlh'rts khy khlhgnb mzh khmvh nqh vkhlhnshb' mzh khmvh nqh
verses.translation: Then said he unto me: ‘This is the curse that goeth forth over the face of the whole land; for every one that stealeth shall be swept away on the one side like it; and every one that sweareth shall be swept away on the other side like it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹצֵאתִ֗יהָ נְאֻם֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּבָ֙אָה֙ אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הַגַּנָּ֔ב וְאֶל־בֵּ֛ית הַנִּשְׁבָּ֥ע בִּשְׁמִ֖י לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וְלָ֙נֶה֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ בֵּית֔וֹ וְכִלַּ֖תּוּ וְאֶת־עֵצָ֥יו וְאֶת־אֲבָנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hvts'tyh n'm yhvh tsb'vt vb'h 'lbyt hgnb v'lbyt hnshb' bshmy lshqr vlnh btvkh bytv vkhltv v't'tsyv v't'bnyv
verses.translation: I cause it to go forth, saith the LORD of hosts, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that sweareth falsely by My name; and it shall abide in the midst of his house, and shall consume it with the timber thereof and the stones thereof.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֕א הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י שָׂ֣א נָ֤א עֵינֶ֙יךָ֙ וּרְאֵ֔ה מָ֖ה הַיּוֹצֵ֥את הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vyts' hml'kh hdbr by vy'mr 'ly sh' n' 'ynykh vr'h mh hyvts't hz't
verses.translation: Then the angel that spoke with me went forth, and said unto me: ‘Lift up now thine eyes, and see what is this that goeth forth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר מַה־הִ֑יא וַיֹּ֗אמֶר זֹ֤את הָֽאֵיפָה֙ הַיּוֹצֵ֔את וַיֹּ֕אמֶר זֹ֥את עֵינָ֖ם בְּכׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'mr mhhy' vy'mr z't h'yph hyvts't vy'mr z't 'ynm bkhlh'rts
verses.translation: And I said: ‘What is it?’ And he said: ‘This is the measure that goeth forth.’ He said moreover: ‘This is their eye in all the land—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֛ה כִּכַּ֥ר עֹפֶ֖רֶת נִשֵּׂ֑את וְזֹאת֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה אַחַ֔ת יוֹשֶׁ֖בֶת בְּת֥וֹךְ הָאֵיפָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhnh khkhr 'prt nsh't vz't 'shh 'cht yvshbt btvkh h'yph
verses.translation: and, behold, there was lifted up a round piece of lead—and this is a woman sitting in the midst of the measure.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ זֹ֣את הָרִשְׁעָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֥ךְ אֹתָ֖הּ אֶל־תּ֣וֹךְ הָֽאֵיפָ֑ה וַיַּשְׁלֵ֛ךְ אֶת־אֶ֥בֶן הָעוֹפֶ֖רֶת אֶל־פִּֽיהָ׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vy'mr z't hrsh'h vyshlkh 'th 'ltvkh h'yph vyshlkh 't'bn h'vprt 'lpyh {s}
verses.translation: And he said: ‘This is Wickedness.’ And he cast her down into the midst of the measure, and he cast the weight of lead upon the mouth thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶשָּׂ֨א עֵינַ֜י וָאֵ֗רֶא וְהִנֵּה֩ שְׁתַּ֨יִם נָשִׁ֤ים יֽוֹצְאוֹת֙ וְר֣וּחַ בְּכַנְפֵיהֶ֔ם וְלָהֵ֥נָּה כְנָפַ֖יִם כְּכַנְפֵ֣י הַחֲסִידָ֑ה וַתִּשֶּׂ֙אנָה֙ אֶת־הָ֣אֵיפָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבֵ֥ין הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: v'sh' 'yny v'r' vhnh shtym nshym yvts'vt vrvch bkhnpyhm vlhnh khnpym khkhnpy hchsydh vtsh'nh 'th'yph byn h'rts vbyn hshmym
verses.translation: Then lifted I up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there came forth two women, and the wind was in their wings; for they had wings like the wings of a stork; and they lifted up the measure between the earth and the heaven.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר אֶל־הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י אָ֛נָה הֵ֥מָּה מֽוֹלִכ֖וֹת אֶת־הָאֵיפָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'lhml'kh hdbr by 'nh hmh mvlkhvt 'th'yph
verses.translation: Then said I to the angel that spoke with me: ‘Whither do these bear the measure?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י לִבְנֽוֹת־לָ֥הֿ בַ֖יִת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ שִׁנְעָ֑ר וְהוּכַ֛ן וְהֻנִּ֥יחָה שָּׁ֖ם עַל־מְכֻנָתָֽהּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vy'mr 'ly lbnvtlh byt b'rts shn'r vhvkhn vhnychh shm 'lmkhnth {p}
verses.translation: And he said unto me: ‘To build her a house in the land of Shinar; and when it is prepared, she shall be set there in her own place.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאָשֻׁ֗ב וָאֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַי֙ וָֽאֶרְאֶ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה אַרְבַּ֤ע מַרְכָּבוֹת֙ יֹֽצְא֔וֹת מִבֵּ֖ין שְׁנֵ֣י הֶֽהָרִ֑ים וְהֶהָרִ֖ים הָרֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.translit: v'shb v'sh' 'yny v'r'h vhnh 'rb' mrkhbvt yts'vt mbyn shny hhrym vhhrym hry nchsht
verses.translation: And again I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there came four chariots out from between the two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּמֶּרְכָּבָ֥ה הָרִֽאשֹׁנָ֖ה סוּסִ֣ים אֲדֻמִּ֑ים וּבַמֶּרְכָּבָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית סוּסִ֥ים שְׁחֹרִֽים׃
verses.translit: bmrkhbh hr'shnh svsym 'dmym vbmrkhbh hshnyt svsym shchrym
verses.translation: In the first chariot were red horses; and in the second chariot black horses;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבַמֶּרְכָּבָ֥ה הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית סוּסִ֣ים לְבָנִ֑ים וּבַמֶּרְכָּבָה֙ הָרְבִעִ֔ית סוּסִ֥ים בְּרֻדִּ֖ים אֲמֻצִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vbmrkhbh hshlshyt svsym lbnym vbmrkhbh hrb'yt svsym brdym 'mtsym
verses.translation: and in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot grizzled bay horses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאַ֙עַן֙ וָֽאֹמַ֔ר אֶל־הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י מָה־אֵ֖לֶּה אֲדֹנִֽי׃
verses.translit: v''n v'mr 'lhml'kh hdbr by mh'lh 'dny
verses.translation: Then I answered and said unto the angel that spoke with me: ‘What are these, my lord?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַן הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֑י אֵ֗לֶּה אַרְבַּע֙ רוּח֣וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם יוֹצְא֕וֹת מֵֽהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־אֲד֥וֹן כׇּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vy'n hml'kh vy'mr 'ly 'lh 'rb' rvchvt hshmym yvts'vt mhtytsb 'l'dvn khlh'rts
verses.translation: And the angel answered and said unto me: ‘These chariots go forth to the four winds of heaven, after presenting themselves before the Lord of all the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֞הּ הַסּוּסִ֣ים הַשְּׁחֹרִ֗ים יֹֽצְאִים֙ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן וְהַ֨לְּבָנִ֔ים יָצְא֖וּ אֶל־אַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וְהַ֨בְּרֻדִּ֔ים יָצְא֖וּ אֶל־אֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָֽן׃
verses.translit: 'shrbh hsvsym hshchrym yts'ym 'l'rts tspvn vhlbnym yts'v 'l'chryhm vhbrdym yts'v 'l'rts htymn
verses.translation: That wherein are the black horses goeth forth toward the north country; and the white went forth after them; and the grizzled went forth toward the south country;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָאֲמֻצִּ֣ים יָצְא֗וּ וַיְבַקְשׁוּ֙ לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ לְהִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ בָּאָ֔רֶץ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לְכ֖וּ הִתְהַלְּכ֣וּ בָאָ֑רֶץ וַתִּתְהַלַּ֖כְנָה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vh'mtsym yts'v vybqshv llkht lhthlkh b'rts vy'mr lkhv hthlkhv b'rts vtthlkhnh b'rts
verses.translation: and the bay went forth’. And they sought to go that they might walk to and fro through the earth; and he said: ‘Get you hence, walk to and fro through the earth.’ So they walked to and fro through the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּזְעֵ֣ק אֹתִ֔י וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר רְאֵ֗ה הַיּֽוֹצְאִים֙ אֶל־אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן הֵנִ֥יחוּ אֶת־רוּחִ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ צָפֽוֹן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vyz'q 'ty vydbr 'ly l'mr r'h hyvts'ym 'l'rts tspvn hnychv 'trvchy b'rts tspvn {p}
verses.translation: Then cried he upon me, and spoke unto me, saying: ‘Behold, they that go toward the north country have eased My spirit in the north country.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָק֙וֹחַ֙ מֵאֵ֣ת הַגּוֹלָ֔ה מֵחֶלְדַּ֕י וּמֵאֵ֥ת טוֹבִיָּ֖ה וּמֵאֵ֣ת יְדַֽעְיָ֑ה וּבָאתָ֤ אַתָּה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וּבָ֗אתָ בֵּ֚ית יֹאשִׁיָּ֣ה בֶן־צְפַנְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֖אוּ מִבָּבֶֽל׃
verses.translit: lqvch m't hgvlh mchldy vm't tvbyh vm't yd'yh vb't 'th byvm hhv' vb't byt y'shyh bntspnyh 'shrb'v mbbl
verses.translation: ’Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah, that are come from Babylon; and come thou the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ כֶֽסֶף־וְזָהָ֖ב וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ עֲטָר֑וֹת וְשַׂמְתָּ֗ בְּרֹ֛אשׁ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בֶּן־יְהוֹצָדָ֖ק הַכֹּהֵ֥ן הַגָּדֽוֹל׃
verses.translit: vlqcht khsfvzhb v'shyt 'trvt vshmt br'sh yhvsh' bnyhvtsdq hkhhn hgdvl
verses.translation: yea, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set the one upon the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּה־אִ֞ישׁ צֶ֤מַח שְׁמוֹ֙ וּמִתַּחְתָּ֣יו יִצְמָ֔ח וּבָנָ֖ה אֶת־הֵיכַ֥ל יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lyv l'mr khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt l'mr hnh'ysh tsmch shmv vmtchtyv ytsmch vbnh 'thykhl yhvh
verses.translation: and speak unto him, saying: Thus speaketh the LORD of hosts, saying: Behold, a man whose name is the Shoot, and who shall shoot up out of his place, and build the temple of the LORD;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠ה֠וּא יִבְנֶ֞ה אֶת־הֵיכַ֤ל יְהֹוָה֙ וְהֽוּא־יִשָּׂ֣א ה֔וֹד וְיָשַׁ֥ב וּמָשַׁ֖ל עַל־כִּסְא֑וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה כֹהֵן֙ עַל־כִּסְא֔וֹ וַעֲצַ֣ת שָׁל֔וֹם תִּהְיֶ֖ה בֵּ֥ין שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhv' ybnh 'thykhl yhvh vhv'ysh' hvd vyshb vmshl 'lkhs'v vhyh khhn 'lkhs'v v'tst shlvm thyh byn shnyhm
verses.translation: even he shall build the temple of the LORD; and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and there shall be a priest before his throne; and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָעֲטָרֹ֗ת תִּֽהְיֶה֙ לְחֵ֙לֶם֙ וּלְטוֹבִיָּ֣ה וְלִידַֽעְיָ֔ה וּלְחֵ֖ן בֶּן־צְפַנְיָ֑ה לְזִכָּר֖וֹן בְּהֵיכַ֥ל יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vh'trt thyh lchlm vltvbyh vlyd'yh vlchn bntspnyh lzkhrvn bhykhl yhvh
verses.translation: And the crowns shall be to Helem, and to Tobijah, and to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, as a memorial in the temple of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּרְחוֹקִ֣ים  יָבֹ֗אוּ וּבָנוּ֙ בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהֹוָ֔ה וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּֽי־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחַ֣נִי אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָיָה֙ אִם־שָׁמ֣וֹעַ תִּשְׁמְע֔וּן בְּק֖וֹל יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vrchvqym  yb'v vbnv bhykhl yhvh vyd'tm khyyhvh tsb'vt shlchny 'lykhm vhyh 'mshmv' tshm'vn bqvl yhvh 'lhykhm {p}
verses.translation: And they that are far off shall come and build in the temple of the LORD, and ye shall know that the LORD of hosts hath sent me unto you. And it shall come to pass, if ye will diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD your God—.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּשְׁנַ֣ת אַרְבַּ֔ע לְדָרְיָ֖וֶשׁ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ הָיָ֨ה דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֜ה אֶל־זְכַרְיָ֗ה בְּאַרְבָּעָ֛ה לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הַתְּשִׁעִ֖י בְּכִסְלֵֽו׃
verses.translit: vyhy bshnt 'rb' ldryvsh hmlkh hyh dbryhvh 'lzkhryh b'rb'h lchdsh htsh'y bkhslv
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the fourth year of king Darius, that the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, even in Chislev;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ בֵּֽית־אֵ֔ל שַׂרְאֶ֕צֶר וְרֶ֥גֶם מֶ֖לֶךְ וַֽאֲנָשָׁ֑יו לְחַלּ֖וֹת אֶת־פְּנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshlch byt'l shr'tsr vrgm mlkh v'nshyv lchlvt 'tpny yhvh
verses.translation: When Bethel-sarezer, and Regem-melech and his men, had sent to entreat the favour of the LORD,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֵאמֹ֗ר אֶל־הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לְבֵית־יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְאֶל־הַנְּבִיאִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר הַֽאֶבְכֶּה֙ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַחֲמִשִׁ֔י הִנָּזֵ֕ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔יתִי זֶ֖ה כַּמֶּ֥ה שָׁנִֽים׃ {ס}
verses.translit: l'mr 'lhkhhnym 'shr lbytyhvh tsb'vt v'lhnby'ym l'mr h'bkhh bchdsh hchmshy hnzr kh'shr 'shyty zh khmh shnym {s}
verses.translation: and to speak unto the priests of the house of the LORD of hosts, and to the prophets, saying: ‘Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh tsb'vt 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: Then came the word of the LORD of hosts unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱמֹר֙ אֶל־כׇּל־עַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֶל־הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר כִּֽי־צַמְתֶּ֨ם וְסָפ֜וֹד בַּחֲמִישִׁ֣י וּבַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י וְזֶה֙ שִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה הֲצ֥וֹם צַמְתֻּ֖נִי אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'mr 'lkhl'm h'rts v'lhkhhnym l'mr khytsmtm vspvd bchmyshy vbshby'y vzh shb'ym shnh htsvm tsmtny 'ny
verses.translation: ’Speak unto all the people of the land, and to the priests, saying: When ye fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month, even these seventy years, did ye at all fast unto Me, even to Me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִ֥י תֹאכְל֖וּ וְכִ֣י תִשְׁתּ֑וּ הֲל֤וֹא אַתֶּם֙ הָאֹ֣כְלִ֔ים וְאַתֶּ֖ם הַשֹּׁתִֽים׃
verses.translit: vkhy t'khlv vkhy tshtv hlv' 'tm h'khlym v'tm hshtym
verses.translation: And when ye eat, and when ye did drink, are ye not they that eat, and they that drink?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָרָ֤א יְהֹוָה֙ בְּיַד֙ הַנְּבִיאִ֣ים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִ֔ים בִּהְי֤וֹת יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ יֹשֶׁ֣בֶת וּשְׁלֵוָ֔ה וְעָרֶ֖יהָ סְבִיבֹתֶ֑יהָ וְהַנֶּ֥גֶב וְהַשְּׁפֵלָ֖ה יֹשֵֽׁב׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hlv' 'thdbrym 'shr qr' yhvh byd hnby'ym hr'shnym bhyvt yrvshl͏m yshbt vshlvh v'ryh sbybtyh vhngb vhshplh yshb {p}
verses.translation: Should ye not hearken to the words which the LORD hath proclaimed by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and the cities thereof round about her, and the South and the Lowland were inhabited?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֔ה אֶל־זְכַרְיָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh 'lzkhryh l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD came unto Zechariah, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱמֶת֙ שְׁפֹ֔טוּ וְחֶ֣סֶד וְרַֽחֲמִ֔ים עֲשׂ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת־אָחִֽיו׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt l'mr mshpt 'mt shptv vchsd vrchmym 'shv 'ysh 't'chyv
verses.translation: ’Thus hath the LORD of hosts spoken, saying: Execute true judgment, and show mercy and compassion every man to his brother;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַלְמָנָ֧ה וְיָת֛וֹם גֵּ֥ר וְעָנִ֖י אַֽל־תַּעֲשֹׁ֑קוּ וְרָעַת֙ אִ֣ישׁ אָחִ֔יו אַֽל־תַּחְשְׁב֖וּ בִּלְבַבְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'lmnh vytvm gr v'ny 'lt'shqv vr't 'ysh 'chyv 'ltchshbv blbbkhm
verses.translation: and oppress not the widow, nor the fatherless, the stranger, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְמָאֲנ֣וּ לְהַקְשִׁ֔יב וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ כָתֵ֖ף סֹרָ֑רֶת וְאׇזְנֵיהֶ֖ם הִכְבִּ֥ידוּ מִשְּׁמֽוֹעַ׃
verses.translit: vym'nv lhqshyb vytnv khtf srrt v'znyhm hkhbydv mshmv'
verses.translation: But they refused to attend, and turned a stubborn shoulder, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלִבָּ֞ם שָׂ֣מוּ שָׁמִ֗יר מִ֠שְּׁמ֠וֹעַ אֶת־הַתּוֹרָ֤ה וְאֶת־הַדְּבָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁלַ֜ח יְהֹוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ בְּרוּח֔וֹ בְּיַ֖ד הַנְּבִיאִ֣ים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִ֑ים וַֽיְהִי֙ קֶ֣צֶף גָּד֔וֹל מֵאֵ֖ת יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vlbm shmv shmyr mshmv' 'thtvrh v'thdbrym 'shr shlch yhvh tsb'vt brvchv byd hnby'ym hr'shnym vyhy qtsf gdvl m't yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Yea, they made their hearts as an adamant stone, lest they should hear the law, and the words which the LORD of hosts had sent by His spirit by the hand of the former prophets; therefore came there great wrath from the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י כַאֲשֶׁר־קָרָ֖א וְלֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֑עוּ כֵּ֤ן יִקְרְאוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א אֶשְׁמָ֔ע אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shrqr' vl' shm'v khn yqr'v vl' 'shm' 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And it came to pass that, as He called, and they would not hear; so they shall call, and I will not hear, said the LORD of hosts;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֵ֣סָעֲרֵ֗ם עַ֤ל כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־יְדָע֔וּם וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ נָשַׁ֣מָּה אַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֔ם מֵֽעֹבֵ֖ר וּמִשָּׁ֑ב וַיָּשִׂ֥ימוּ אֶֽרֶץ־חֶמְדָּ֖ה לְשַׁמָּֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v's'rm 'l khlhgvym 'shr l'yd'vm vh'rts nshmh 'chryhm m'br vmshb vyshymv 'rtschmdh lshmh {p}
verses.translation: but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations whom they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they laid the pleasant land desolate.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh tsb'vt l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD of hosts came, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת קִנֵּ֥אתִי לְצִיּ֖וֹן קִנְאָ֣ה גְדוֹלָ֑ה וְחֵמָ֥ה גְדוֹלָ֖ה קִנֵּ֥אתִי לָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt qn'ty ltsyvn qn'h gdvlh vchmh gdvlh qn'ty lh
verses.translation: ’Thus saith the LORD of hosts: I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great fury.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה שַׁ֚בְתִּי אֶל־צִיּ֔וֹן וְשָׁכַנְתִּ֖י בְּת֣וֹךְ יְרֽוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְנִקְרְאָ֤ה יְרוּשָׁלַ֙͏ִם֙ עִ֣יר הָֽאֱמֶ֔ת וְהַר־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת הַ֥ר הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh shbty 'ltsyvn vshkhnty btvkh yrvshl͏m vnqr'h yrvshl͏m 'yr h'mt vhryhvh tsb'vt hr hqdsh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD: I return unto Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem; and Jerusalem shall be called The city of truth; and the mountain of the LORD of hosts The holy mountain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת עֹ֤ד יֵֽשְׁבוּ֙ זְקֵנִ֣ים וּזְקֵנ֔וֹת בִּרְחֹב֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְאִ֧ישׁ מִשְׁעַנְתּ֛וֹ בְּיָד֖וֹ מֵרֹ֥ב יָמִֽים׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'd yshbv zqnym vzqnvt brchbvt yrvshl͏m v'ysh msh'ntv bydv mrb ymym
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: There shall yet old men and old women sit in the broad places of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand for very age.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּרְחֹב֤וֹת הָעִיר֙ יִמָּ֣לְא֔וּ יְלָדִ֖ים וִֽילָד֑וֹת מְשַׂחֲקִ֖ים בִּרְחֹֽבֹתֶֽיהָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vrchbvt h'yr yml'v yldym vyldvt mshchqym brchbtyh {p}
verses.translation: And the broad places of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in the broad places thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת כִּ֣י יִפָּלֵ֗א בְּעֵינֵי֙ שְׁאֵרִית֙ הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה בַּיָּמִ֖ים הָהֵ֑ם גַּם־בְּעֵינַי֙ יִפָּלֵ֔א נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt khy ypl' b'yny sh'ryt h'm hzh bymym hhm gmb'yny ypl' n'm yhvh tsb'vt {p}
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: If it be marvellous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvellous in Mine eyes? saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הִנְנִ֥י מוֹשִׁ֛יעַ אֶת־עַמִּ֖י מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִזְרָ֑ח וּמֵאֶ֖רֶץ מְב֥וֹא הַשָּֽׁמֶשׁ׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt hnny mvshy' 't'my m'rts mzrch vm'rts mbv' hshmsh
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: Behold, I will save My people from the east country, and from the west country;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔ם וְשָׁכְנ֖וּ בְּת֣וֹךְ יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְהָיוּ־לִ֣י לְעָ֗ם וַֽאֲנִי֙ אֶהְיֶ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים בֶּאֱמֶ֖ת וּבִצְדָקָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhb'ty 'tm vshkhnv btvkh yrvshl͏m vhyvly l'm v'ny 'hyh lhm l'lhym b'mt vbtsdqh {p}
verses.translation: And I will bring them, and they shall dwell in the midst of Jerusalem; and they shall be My people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ תֶּחֱזַ֣קְנָה יְדֵיכֶ֔ם הַשֹּֽׁמְעִים֙ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֵ֖ת הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה מִפִּי֙ הַנְּבִיאִ֔ים אֲ֠שֶׁ֠ר בְּי֞וֹם יֻסַּ֨ד בֵּית־יְהֹוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת הַהֵיכָ֖ל לְהִבָּנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt tchzqnh ydykhm hshm'ym bymym h'lh 't hdbrym h'lh mpy hnby'ym 'shr byvm ysd bytyhvh tsb'vt hhykhl lhbnvt
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: Let your hands be strong, ye that hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets that were in the day that the foundation of the house of the LORD of hosts was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֗י לִפְנֵי֙ הַיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם שְׂכַ֤ר הָֽאָדָם֙ לֹ֣א נִֽהְיָ֔ה וּשְׂכַ֥ר הַבְּהֵמָ֖ה אֵינֶ֑נָּה וְלַיּוֹצֵ֨א וְלַבָּ֤א אֵין־שָׁלוֹם֙ מִן־הַצָּ֔ר וַאֲשַׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־כׇּל־הָאָדָ֖ם אִ֥ישׁ בְּרֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: khy lpny hymym hhm shkhr h'dm l' nhyh vshkhr hbhmh 'ynnh vlyvts' vlb' 'ynshlvm mnhtsr v'shlch 'tkhlh'dm 'ysh br'hv
verses.translation: For before those days there was no hire for man, nor any hire for beast; neither was there any peace to him that went out or came in because of the adversary; for I set all men every one against his neighbour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה לֹ֣א כַיָּמִ֤ים הָרִֽאשֹׁנִים֙ אֲנִ֔י לִשְׁאֵרִ֖ית הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'th l' khymym hr'shnym 'ny lsh'ryt h'm hzh n'm yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: But now I will not be unto the remnant of this people as in the former days, saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־זֶ֣רַע הַשָּׁל֗וֹם הַגֶּ֜פֶן תִּתֵּ֤ן פִּרְיָהּ֙ וְהָאָ֙רֶץ֙ תִּתֵּ֣ן אֶת־יְבוּלָ֔הּ וְהַשָּׁמַ֖יִם יִתְּנ֣וּ טַלָּ֑ם וְהִנְחַלְתִּ֗י אֶת־שְׁאֵרִ֛ית הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֖ה אֶת־כׇּל־אֵֽלֶּה׃
verses.translit: khyzr' hshlvm hgpn ttn pryh vh'rts ttn 'tybvlh vhshmym ytnv tlm vhnchlty 'tsh'ryt h'm hzh 'tkhl'lh
verses.translation: For as the seed of peace, the vine shall give her fruit, and the ground shall give her increase, and the heavens shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֡ה כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ הֱיִיתֶ֨ם קְלָלָ֜ה בַּגּוֹיִ֗ם בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ וּבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֵּ֚ן אוֹשִׁ֣יעַ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וִהְיִיתֶ֖ם בְּרָכָ֑ה אַל־תִּירָ֖אוּ תֶּחֱזַ֥קְנָה יְדֵיכֶֽם׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vhyh kh'shr hyytm qllh bgvym byt yhvdh vbyt yshr'l khn 'vshy' 'tkhm vhyytm brkhh 'ltyr'v tchzqnh ydykhm {s}
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass that, as ye were a curse among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing; fear not, but let your hands be strong.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָמַר֮ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר זָמַ֜מְתִּי לְהָרַ֣ע לָכֶ֗ם בְּהַקְצִ֤יף אֲבֹֽתֵיכֶם֙ אֹתִ֔י אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְלֹ֖א נִחָֽמְתִּי׃
verses.translit: khy khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt kh'shr zmmty lhr' lkhm bhqtsyf 'btykhm 'ty 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vl' nchmty
verses.translation: For thus saith the LORD of host: As I purposed to do evil unto you, when your fathers provoked Me, saith the LORD of hosts, and I repented not;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֵּ֣ן שַׁ֤בְתִּי זָמַ֙מְתִּי֙ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לְהֵיטִ֥יב אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם וְאֶת־בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֑ה אַל־תִּירָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: khn shbty zmmty bymym h'lh lhytyb 'tyrvshl͏m v'tbyt yhvdh 'ltyr'v
verses.translation: so again do I purpose in these days to do good unto Jerusalem and to the house of Judah; fear ye not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֥לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּֽעֲשׂ֑וּ דַּבְּר֤וּ אֱמֶת֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵ֔הוּ אֱמֶת֙ וּמִשְׁפַּ֣ט שָׁל֔וֹם שִׁפְט֖וּ בְּשַׁעֲרֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: 'lh hdbrym 'shr t'shv dbrv 'mt 'ysh 'tr'hv 'mt vmshpt shlvm shptv bsh'rykhm
verses.translation: These are the things that ye shall do: Speak ye every man the truth with his neighbour; execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִ֣ישׁ  אֶת־רָעַ֣ת רֵעֵ֗הוּ אַֽל־תַּחְשְׁבוּ֙ בִּלְבַבְכֶ֔ם וּשְׁבֻ֥עַת שֶׁ֖קֶר אַֽל־תֶּאֱהָ֑בוּ כִּ֧י אֶת־כׇּל־אֵ֛לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂנֵ֖אתִי נְאֻם־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ysh  'tr't r'hv 'ltchshbv blbbkhm vshb't shqr 'lt'hbv khy 'tkhl'lh 'shr shn'ty n'myhvh {p}
verses.translation: and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbour; and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate, saith the LORD.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י דְּבַר־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.translit: vyhy dbryhvh tsb'vt 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the word of the LORD of hosts came unto me, saying:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת צ֣וֹם הָרְבִיעִ֡י וְצ֣וֹם הַחֲמִישִׁי֩ וְצ֨וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֜י וְצ֣וֹם הָעֲשִׂירִ֗י יִהְיֶ֤ה לְבֵית־יְהוּדָה֙ לְשָׂשׂ֣וֹן וּלְשִׂמְחָ֔ה וּֽלְמֹעֲדִ֖ים טוֹבִ֑ים וְהָאֱמֶ֥ת וְהַשָּׁל֖וֹם אֱהָֽבוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt tsvm hrby'y vtsvm hchmyshy vtsvm hshby'y vtsvm h'shyry yhyh lbytyhvdh lshshvn vlshmchh vlm'dym tvbym vh'mt vhshlvm 'hbv {p}
verses.translation: ’Thus saith the LORD of hosts: The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be to the house of Judah joy and gladness, and cheerful seasons; therefore love ye truth and peace.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת עֹ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָבֹ֣אוּ עַמִּ֔ים וְיֹשְׁבֵ֖י עָרִ֥ים רַבּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'd 'shr yb'v 'mym vyshby 'rym rbvt
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: It shall yet come to pass, that there shall come peoples, and the inhabitants of many cities;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהָלְכ֡וּ יוֹשְׁבֵי֩ אַחַ֨ת אֶל־אַחַ֜ת לֵאמֹ֗ר נֵלְכָ֤ה הָלוֹךְ֙ לְחַלּוֹת֙ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וּלְבַקֵּ֖שׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אֵלְכָ֖ה גַּם־אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vhlkhv yvshby 'cht 'l'cht l'mr nlkhh hlvkh lchlvt 'tpny yhvh vlbqsh 'tyhvh tsb'vt 'lkhh gm'ny
verses.translation: and the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying: Let us go speedily to entreat the favour of the LORD, and to seek the LORD of hosts; I will go also.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּבָ֨אוּ עַמִּ֤ים רַבִּים֙ וְגוֹיִ֣ם עֲצוּמִ֔ים לְבַקֵּ֛שׁ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וּלְחַלּ֖וֹת אֶת־פְּנֵ֥י יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vb'v 'mym rbym vgvym 'tsvmym lbqsh 'tyhvh tsb'vt byrvshl͏m vlchlvt 'tpny yhvh {s}
verses.translation: Yea, many peoples and mighty nations shall come to seek the LORD of hosts in Jerusalem, and to entreat the favour of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּֽה־אָמַר֮ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֒ בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔מָּה אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַחֲזִ֙יקוּ֙ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִכֹּ֖ל לְשֹׁנ֣וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְֽהֶחֱזִ֡יקוּ בִּכְנַף֩ אִ֨ישׁ יְהוּדִ֜י לֵאמֹ֗ר נֵֽלְכָה֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם כִּ֥י שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים עִמָּכֶֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khh'mr yhvh tsb'vt bymym hhmh 'shr ychzyqv 'shrh 'nshym mkhl lshnvt hgvym vhchzyqv bkhnf 'ysh yhvdy l'mr nlkhh 'mkhm khy shm'nv 'lhym 'mkhm {p}
verses.translation: Thus saith the LORD of hosts: In those days it shall come to pass, that ten men shall take hold, out of all the languages of the nations, shall even take hold of the skirt of him that is a Jew, saying: We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֤א דְבַר־יְהֹוָה֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַדְרָ֔ךְ וְדַמֶּ֖שֶׂק מְנֻחָת֑וֹ כִּ֤י לַֽיהֹוָה֙ עֵ֣ין אָדָ֔ם וְכֹ֖ל שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: msh' dbryhvh b'rts chdrkh vdmshq mnchtv khy lyhvh 'yn 'dm vkhl shbty yshr'l
verses.translation: The burden of the word of the LORD. In the land of Hadrach, And in Damascus shall be His resting-place; For the LORD’S is the eye of man And all the tribes of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־חֲמָ֖ת תִּגְבׇּל־בָּ֑הּ צֹ֣ר וְצִיד֔וֹן כִּ֥י חָֽכְמָ֖ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vgmchmt tgblbh tsr vtsydvn khy chkhmh m'd
verses.translation: And Hamath also shall border thereon; Tyre and Zidon, for she is very wise.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּ֥בֶן צֹ֛ר מָצ֖וֹר לָ֑הּ וַתִּצְבׇּר־כֶּ֙סֶף֙ כֶּֽעָפָ֔ר וְחָר֖וּץ כְּטִ֥יט חוּצֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vtbn tsr mtsvr lh vttsbrkhsf kh'pr vchrvts khtyt chvtsvt
verses.translation: And Tyre did build herself a stronghold, And heaped up silver as the dust, And fine gold as the mire of the streets.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אֲדֹנָי֙ יֽוֹרִשֶׁ֔נָּה וְהִכָּ֥ה בַיָּ֖ם חֵילָ֑הּ וְהִ֖יא בָּאֵ֥שׁ תֵּאָכֵֽל׃
verses.translit: hnh 'dny yvrshnh vhkhh bym chylh vhy' b'sh t'khl
verses.translation: Behold, the Lord will impoverish her, And He will smite her power into the sea; And she shall be devoured with fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֵּרֶ֨א אַשְׁקְל֜וֹן וְתִירָ֗א וְעַזָּה֙ וְתָחִ֣יל מְאֹ֔ד וְעֶקְר֖וֹן כִּֽי־הֹבִ֣ישׁ מֶבָּטָ֑הּ וְאָ֤בַד מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ מֵֽעַזָּ֔ה וְאַשְׁקְל֖וֹן לֹ֥א תֵשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: tr' 'shqlvn vtyr' v'zh vtchyl m'd v'qrvn khyhbysh mbth v'bd mlkh m'zh v'shqlvn l' tshb
verses.translation: Ashkelon shall see it, and fear, Gaza also, and shall be sore pained, And Ekron, for her expectation shall be ashamed; And the king shall perish from Gaza, And Ashkelon shall not be inhabited.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָשַׁ֥ב מַמְזֵ֖ר בְּאַשְׁדּ֑וֹד וְהִכְרַתִּ֖י גְּא֥וֹן פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.translit: vyshb mmzr b'shdvd vhkhrty g'vn plshtym
verses.translation: And a bastard shall dwell in Ashdod, And I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲסִרֹתִ֨י דָמָ֜יו מִפִּ֗יו וְשִׁקֻּצָיו֙ מִבֵּ֣ין שִׁנָּ֔יו וְנִשְׁאַ֥ר גַּם־ה֖וּא לֵֽאלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וְהָיָה֙ כְּאַלֻּ֣ף בִּֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְעֶקְר֖וֹן כִּיבוּסִֽי׃
verses.translit: vhsrty dmyv mpyv vshqtsyv mbyn shnyv vnsh'r gmhv' l'lhynv vhyh kh'lf byhvdh v'qrvn khybvsy
verses.translation: And I will take away his blood out of his mouth, And his detestable things from between his teeth, And he also shall be a remnant for our God; And he shall be as a chief in Judah, And Ekron as a Jebusite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְחָנִ֨יתִי לְבֵיתִ֤י מִצָּבָה֙ מֵעֹבֵ֣ר וּמִשָּׁ֔ב וְלֹֽא־יַעֲבֹ֧ר עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם ע֖וֹד נֹגֵ֑שׂ כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה רָאִ֥יתִי בְעֵינָֽי׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vchnyty lbyty mtsbh m'br vmshb vl'y'br 'lyhm 'vd ngsh khy 'th r'yty b'yny {s}
verses.translation: And I will encamp about My house against the army, That none pass through or return; And no oppressor shall pass through them any more; For now have I seen with Mine eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גִּילִ֨י מְאֹ֜ד בַּת־צִיּ֗וֹן הָרִ֙יעִי֙ בַּ֣ת יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם הִנֵּ֤ה מַלְכֵּךְ֙ יָ֣בוֹא לָ֔ךְ צַדִּ֥יק וְנוֹשָׁ֖ע ה֑וּא עָנִי֙ וְרֹכֵ֣ב עַל־חֲמ֔וֹר וְעַל־עַ֖יִר בֶּן־אֲתֹנֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: gyly m'd bttsyvn hry'y bt yrvshl͏m hnh mlkhkh ybv' lkh tsdyq vnvsh' hv' 'ny vrkhb 'lchmvr v'l'yr bn'tnvt
verses.translation: Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Zion, Shout, O daughter of Jerusalem; Behold, thy king cometh unto thee, He is triumphant, and victorious, Lowly, and riding upon an ass, Even upon a colt the foal of an ass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהִכְרַתִּי־רֶ֣כֶב מֵאֶפְרַ֗יִם וְסוּס֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וְנִכְרְתָה֙ קֶ֣שֶׁת מִלְחָמָ֔ה וְדִבֶּ֥ר שָׁל֖וֹם לַגּוֹיִ֑ם וּמׇשְׁלוֹ֙ מִיָּ֣ם עַד־יָ֔ם וּמִנָּהָ֖ר עַד־אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhkhrtyrkhb m'prym vsvs myrvshl͏m vnkhrth qsht mlchmh vdbr shlvm lgvym vmshlv mym 'dym vmnhr 'd'psy'rts
verses.translation: And I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim, And the horse from Jerusalem, And the battle bow shall be cut off, And he shall speak peace unto the nations; And his dominion shall be from sea to sea, And from the River to the ends of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּם־אַ֣תְּ בְּדַם־בְּרִיתֵ֗ךְ שִׁלַּ֤חְתִּי אֲסִירַ֙יִךְ֙ מִבּ֔וֹר אֵ֥ין מַ֖יִם בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: gm't bdmbrytkh shlchty 'syrykh mbvr 'yn mym bv
verses.translation: As for thee also, because of the blood of thy covenant I send forth thy prisoners out of the pit Wherein is no water.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁ֚וּבוּ לְבִצָּר֔וֹן אֲסִירֵ֖י הַתִּקְוָ֑ה גַּם־הַיּ֕וֹם מַגִּ֥יד מִשְׁנֶ֖ה אָשִׁ֥יב לָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: shvbv lbtsrvn 'syry htqvh gmhyvm mgyd mshnh 'shyb lkh
verses.translation: Return to the stronghold, Ye prisoners of hope; Even to-day do I declare That I will render double unto thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־דָרַ֨כְתִּי לִ֜י יְהוּדָ֗ה קֶ֚שֶׁת מִלֵּ֣אתִי אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְעוֹרַרְתִּ֤י בָנַ֙יִךְ֙ צִיּ֔וֹן עַל־בָּנַ֖יִךְ יָוָ֑ן וְשַׂמְתִּ֖יךְ כְּחֶ֥רֶב גִּבּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: khydrkhty ly yhvdh qsht ml'ty 'prym v'vrrty bnykh tsyvn 'lbnykh yvn vshmtykh khchrb gbvr
verses.translation: For I bend Judah for Me, I fill the bow with Ephraim; And I will stir up thy sons, O Zion, Against thy sons, O Javan, And will make thee as the sword of a mighty man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽיהֹוָה֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֣ם יֵֽרָאֶ֔ה וְיָצָ֥א כַבָּרָ֖ק חִצּ֑וֹ וַֽאדֹנָ֤י יֱהֹוִה֙ בַּשּׁוֹפָ֣ר יִתְקָ֔ע וְהָלַ֖ךְ בְּסַעֲר֥וֹת תֵּימָֽן׃
verses.translit: vyhvh 'lyhm yr'h vyts' khbrq chtsv v'dny yhvh bshvpr ytq' vhlkh bs'rvt tymn
verses.translation: And the LORD shall be seen over them, And His arrow shall go forth as the lightning; And the Lord GOD will blow the horn, And will go with whirlwinds of the south.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָאוֹת֮ יָגֵ֣ן עֲלֵיהֶם֒ וְאָכְל֗וּ וְכָֽבְשׁוּ֙ אַבְנֵי־קֶ֔לַע וְשָׁת֥וּ הָמ֖וּ כְּמוֹ־יָ֑יִן וּמָֽלְאוּ֙ כַּמִּזְרָ֔ק כְּזָוִיּ֖וֹת מִזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: yhvh tsb'vt ygn 'lyhm v'khlv vkhbshv 'bnyql' vshtv hmv khmvyyn vml'v khmzrq khzvyvt mzbch
verses.translation: The LORD of hosts will defend them; And they shall devour, and shall tread down the sling-stones; And they shall drink, and make a noise as through wine; And they shall be filled like the basins, like the corners of the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהוֹשִׁיעָ֞ם יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כְּצֹ֣אן עַמּ֑וֹ כִּ֚י אַבְנֵי־נֵ֔זֶר מִֽתְנוֹסְס֖וֹת עַל־אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhvshy'm yhvh 'lhyhm byvm hhv' khts'n 'mv khy 'bnynzr mtnvssvt 'l'dmtv
verses.translation: And the LORD their God shall save them in that day As the flock of His people; For they shall be as the stones of a crown, Glittering over His land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י מַה־טּוּב֖וֹ וּמַה־יׇּפְי֑וֹ דָּגָן֙ בַּחוּרִ֔ים וְתִיר֖וֹשׁ יְנוֹבֵ֥ב בְּתֻלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khy mhtvbv vmhypyv dgn bchvrym vtyrvsh ynvbb btlvt
verses.translation: For how great is their goodness, and how great is their beauty! Corn shall make the young men flourish, And new wine the maids.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שַׁאֲל֨וּ מֵיְהֹוָ֤ה מָטָר֙ בְּעֵ֣ת מַלְק֔וֹשׁ יְהֹוָ֖ה עֹשֶׂ֣ה חֲזִיזִ֑ים וּמְטַר־גֶּ֙שֶׁם֙ יִתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם לְאִ֖ישׁ עֵ֥שֶׂב בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.translit: sh'lv myhvh mtr b't mlqvsh yhvh 'shh chzyzym vmtrgshm ytn lhm l'ysh 'shb bshdh
verses.translation: Ask ye of the LORD rain in the time of the latter rain, Even of the LORD that maketh lightnings; And He will give them showers of rain, To every one grass in the field.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֧י הַתְּרָפִ֣ים דִּבְּרוּ־אָ֗וֶן וְהַקּֽוֹסְמִים֙ חָ֣זוּ שֶׁ֔קֶר וַֽחֲלֹמוֹת֙ הַשָּׁ֣וְא יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ הֶ֖בֶל יְנַחֵמ֑וּן עַל־כֵּן֙ נָסְע֣וּ כְמוֹ־צֹ֔אן יַעֲנ֖וּ כִּי־אֵ֥ין רֹעֶֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy htrpym dbrv'vn vhqvsmym chzv shqr vchlmvt hshv' ydbrv hbl ynchmvn 'lkhn ns'v khmvts'n y'nv khy'yn r'h {p}
verses.translation: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, And the diviners have seen a lie, And the dreams speak falsely, They comfort in vain; Therefore they go their way like sheep, They are afflicted, because there is no shepherd.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־הָֽרֹעִים֙ חָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֔י וְעַל־הָעַתּוּדִ֖ים אֶפְק֑וֹד כִּֽי־פָקַד֩ יְהֹוָ֨ה צְבָא֤וֹת אֶת־עֶדְרוֹ֙ אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה וְשָׂ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם כְּס֥וּס הוֹד֖וֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'lhr'ym chrh 'py v'lh'tvdym 'pqvd khypqd yhvh tsb'vt 't'drv 'tbyt yhvdh vshm 'vtm khsvs hvdv bmlchmh
verses.translation: Mine anger is kindled against the shepherds, And I will punish the he-goats; For the LORD of hosts hath remembered His flock the house of Judah, And maketh them as His majestic horse in the battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִמֶּ֤נּוּ פִנָּה֙ מִמֶּ֣נּוּ יָתֵ֔ד מִמֶּ֖נּוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת מִלְחָמָ֑ה מִמֶּ֛נּוּ יֵצֵ֥א כׇל־נוֹגֵ֖שׂ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.translit: mmnv pnh mmnv ytd mmnv qsht mlchmh mmnv yts' khlnvgsh ychdv
verses.translation: Out of them shall come forth the corner-stone, Out of them the stake, Out of them the battle bow, Out of them every master together.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֨וּ כְגִבֹּרִ֜ים בּוֹסִ֨ים בְּטִ֤יט חוּצוֹת֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְנִ֨לְחֲמ֔וּ כִּ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑ם וְהֹבִ֖ישׁוּ רֹכְבֵ֥י סוּסִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhyv khgbrym bvsym btyt chvtsvt bmlchmh vnlchmv khy yhvh 'mm vhbyshv rkhby svsym
verses.translation: And they shall be as mighty men, Treading down in the mire of the streets in the battle, And they shall fight, because the LORD is with them; And the riders on horses shall be confounded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגִבַּרְתִּ֣י  אֶת־בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה וְאֶת־בֵּ֤ית יוֹסֵף֙ אוֹשִׁ֔יעַ וְהֽוֹשְׁבוֹתִים֙ כִּ֣י רִֽחַמְתִּ֔ים וְהָי֖וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־זְנַחְתִּ֑ים כִּ֗י אֲנִ֛י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶעֱנֵֽם׃
verses.translit: vgbrty  'tbyt yhvdh v'tbyt yvsf 'vshy' vhvshbvtym khy rchmtym vhyv kh'shr l'znchtym khy 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm v''nm
verses.translation: And I will strengthen the house of Judah, And I will save the house of Joseph, And I will bring them back, for I have compassion upon them, And they shall be as though I had not cast them off; For I am the LORD their God, and I will hear them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָי֤וּ כְגִבּוֹר֙ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְשָׂמַ֥ח לִבָּ֖ם כְּמוֹ־יָ֑יִן וּבְנֵיהֶם֙ יִרְא֣וּ וְשָׂמֵ֔חוּ יָגֵ֥ל לִבָּ֖ם בַּיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyv khgbvr 'prym vshmch lbm khmvyyn vbnyhm yr'v vshmchv ygl lbm byhvh
verses.translation: And they of Ephraim shall be like a mighty man, And their heart shall rejoice as through wine; Yea, their children shall see it, And rejoice, their heart shall be glad in the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶשְׁרְקָ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם וַאֲקַבְּצֵ֖ם כִּ֣י פְדִיתִ֑ים וְרָב֖וּ כְּמ֥וֹ רָבֽוּ׃
verses.translit: 'shrqh lhm v'qbtsm khy pdytym vrbv khmv rbv
verses.translation: I will hiss for them, and gather them, For I have redeemed them; And they shall increase as they have increased.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶזְרָעֵם֙ בָּעַמִּ֔ים וּבַמֶּרְחַקִּ֖ים יִזְכְּר֑וּנִי וְחָי֥וּ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם וָשָֽׁבוּ׃
verses.translit: v'zr'm b'mym vbmrchqym yzkhrvny vchyv 'tbnyhm vshbv
verses.translation: And I will sow them among the peoples, And they shall remember Me in far countries; And they shall live with their children, and shall return.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַהֲשִֽׁבוֹתִים֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּמֵאַשּׁ֖וּר אֲקַבְּצֵ֑ם וְאֶל־אֶ֨רֶץ גִּלְעָ֤ד וּלְבָנוֹן֙ אֲבִיאֵ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יִמָּצֵ֖א לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vhshbvtym m'rts mtsrym vm'shvr 'qbtsm v'l'rts gl'd vlbnvn 'by'm vl' ymts' lhm
verses.translation: I will bring them back also out of the land of Egypt, And gather them out of Assyria; And I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; And place shall not suffice them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָבַ֨ר בַּיָּ֜ם צָרָ֗ה וְהִכָּ֤ה בַיָּם֙ גַּלִּ֔ים וְהֹבִ֕ישׁוּ כֹּ֖ל מְצוּל֣וֹת יְאֹ֑ר וְהוּרַד֙ גְּא֣וֹן אַשּׁ֔וּר וְשֵׁ֥בֶט מִצְרַ֖יִם יָסֽוּר׃
verses.translit: v'br bym tsrh vhkhh bym glym vhbyshv khl mtsvlvt y'r vhvrd g'vn 'shvr vshbt mtsrym ysvr
verses.translation: And over the sea affliction shall pass, And the waves shall be smitten in the sea, And all the depths of the Nile shall dry up; And the pride of Assyria shall be brought down, And the sceptre of Egypt shall depart away. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגִבַּרְתִּים֙ בַּיהֹוָ֔ה וּבִשְׁמ֖וֹ יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vgbrtym byhvh vbshmv ythlkhv n'm yhvh {p}
verses.translation: And I will strengthen them in the LORD; And they shall walk up and down in His name, Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּתַ֥ח לְבָנ֖וֹן דְּלָתֶ֑יךָ וְתֹאכַ֥ל אֵ֖שׁ בַּאֲרָזֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: ptch lbnvn dltykh vt'khl 'sh b'rzykh
verses.translation: Open thy doors, O Lebanon, That the fire may devour thy cedars.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵילֵ֤ל בְּרוֹשׁ֙ כִּֽי־נָ֣פַל אֶ֔רֶז אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַדִּרִ֖ים שֻׁדָּ֑דוּ הֵילִ֙ילוּ֙ אַלּוֹנֵ֣י בָשָׁ֔ן כִּ֥י יָרַ֖ד יַ֥עַר (הבצור) [הַבָּצִֽיר]׃
verses.translit: hyll brvsh khynpl 'rz 'shr 'drym shddv hylylv 'lvny bshn khy yrd y'r (hbtsvr) [hbtsyr]
verses.translation: Wail, O cypress-tree, for the cedar is fallen; Because the glorious ones are spoiled; Wail, O ye oaks of Bashan, For the strong forest is come down.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֚וֹל יִֽלְלַ֣ת הָרֹעִ֔ים כִּ֥י שֻׁדְּדָ֖ה אַדַּרְתָּ֑ם ק֚וֹל שַׁאֲגַ֣ת כְּפִירִ֔ים כִּ֥י שֻׁדַּ֖ד גְּא֥וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: qvl yllt hr'ym khy shddh 'drtm qvl sh'gt khpyrym khy shdd g'vn hyrdn {p}
verses.translation: Hark! the wailing of the shepherds, For their glory is spoiled; Hark! the roaring of young lions, For the thickets of the Jordan are spoiled.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י רְעֵ֖ה אֶת־צֹ֥אן הַהֲרֵגָֽה׃
verses.translit: khh 'mr yhvh 'lhy r'h 'tts'n hhrgh
verses.translation: Thus said the LORD my God: ‘Feed the flock of slaughter;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר קֹנֵיהֶ֤ן יַֽהַרְגֻן֙ וְלֹ֣א יֶאְשָׁ֔מוּ וּמֹכְרֵיהֶ֣ן יֹאמַ֔ר בָּר֥וּךְ יְהֹוָ֖ה וַאעְשִׁ֑ר וְרֹ֣עֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א יַחְמ֖וֹל עֲלֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.translit: 'shr qnyhn yhrgn vl' y'shmv vmkhryhn y'mr brvkh yhvh v''shr vr'yhm l' ychmvl 'lyhn
verses.translation: whose buyers slay them, and hold themselves not guilty; and they that sell them say: Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich; and their own shepherds pity them not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֠י לֹ֣א אֶחְמ֥וֹל ע֛וֹד עַל־יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י מַמְצִ֣יא אֶת־הָאָדָ֗ם אִ֤ישׁ בְּיַד־רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ וּבְיַ֣ד מַלְכּ֔וֹ וְכִתְּתוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹ֥א אַצִּ֖יל מִיָּדָֽם׃
verses.translit: khy l' 'chmvl 'vd 'lyshby h'rts n'myhvh vhnh 'nkhy mmtsy' 'th'dm 'ysh bydr'hv vbyd mlkhv vkhttv 'th'rts vl' 'tsyl mydm
verses.translation: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land, saith the LORD; but, lo, I will deliver the men every one into his neighbour’s hand, and into the hand of his king; and they shall smite the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָֽאֶרְעֶה֙ אֶת־צֹ֣אן הַהֲרֵגָ֔ה לָכֵ֖ן עֲנִיֵּ֣י הַצֹּ֑אן וָאֶקַּֽח־לִ֞י שְׁנֵ֣י מַקְל֗וֹת לְאַחַ֞ד קָרָ֤אתִֽי נֹ֙עַם֙ וּלְאַחַד֙ קָרָ֣אתִי חֹֽבְלִ֔ים וָֽאֶרְעֶ֖ה אֶת־הַצֹּֽאן׃
verses.translit: v'r'h 'tts'n hhrgh lkhn 'nyy hts'n v'qchly shny mqlvt l'chd qr'ty n'm vl'chd qr'ty chblym v'r'h 'thts'n
verses.translation: So I fed the flock of slaughter, verily the poor of the flock. And I took unto me two staves; the one I called Graciousness, and the other I called Binders; and I fed the flock.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאַכְחִ֛ד אֶת־שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת הָרֹעִ֖ים בְּיֶ֣רַח אֶחָ֑ד וַתִּקְצַ֤ר נַפְשִׁי֙ בָּהֶ֔ם וְגַם־נַפְשָׁ֖ם בָּחֲלָ֥ה בִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'khchd 'tshlsht hr'ym byrch 'chd vtqtsr npshy bhm vgmnpshm bchlh by
verses.translation: And I cut off the three shepherds in one month; ‘for My soul became impatient of them, and their soul also loathed Me.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֕ר לֹ֥א אֶרְעֶ֖ה אֶתְכֶ֑ם הַמֵּתָ֣ה תָמ֗וּת וְהַנִּכְחֶ֙דֶת֙ תִּכָּחֵ֔ד וְהַ֨נִּשְׁאָר֔וֹת תֹּאכַ֕לְנָה אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת־בְּשַׂ֥ר רְעוּתָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: v'mr l' 'r'h 'tkhm hmth tmvt vhnkhchdt tkhchd vhnsh'rvt t'khlnh 'shh 'tbshr r'vth
verses.translation: Then said I: ‘I will not feed you; that which dieth, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let them that are left eat every one the flesh of another.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֶקַּ֤ח אֶת־מַקְלִי֙ אֶת־נֹ֔עַם וָאֶגְדַּ֖ע אֹת֑וֹ לְהָפֵיר֙ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖תִּי אֶת־כׇּל־הָעַמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: v'qch 'tmqly 'tn'm v'gd' 'tv lhpyr 'tbryty 'shr khrty 'tkhlh'mym
verses.translation: And I took my staff Graciousness, and cut it asunder, ‘that I might break My covenant which I had made with all the peoples.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתֻּפַ֖ר בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיֵּדְע֨וּ כֵ֜ן עֲנִיֵּ֤י הַצֹּאן֙ הַשֹּׁמְרִ֣ים אֹתִ֔י כִּ֥י דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vtpr byvm hhv' vyd'v khn 'nyy hts'n hshmrym 'ty khy dbryhvh hv' {s}
verses.translation: And it was broken in that day; and the poor of the flock that gave heed unto me knew of a truth that it was the word of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם אִם־ט֧וֹב בְּעֵינֵיכֶ֛ם הָב֥וּ שְׂכָרִ֖י וְאִם־לֹ֣א ׀ חֲדָ֑לוּ וַיִּשְׁקְל֥וּ אֶת־שְׂכָרִ֖י שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים כָּֽסֶף׃
verses.translit: v'mr 'lyhm 'mtvb b'ynykhm hbv shkhry v'ml'  chdlv vyshqlv 'tshkhry shlshym khsf
verses.translation: And I said unto them: ‘If ye think good, give me my hire; and if not, forbear.’ So they weighed for my hire thirty pieces of silver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהֹוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י הַשְׁלִיכֵ֙הוּ֙ אֶל־הַיּוֹצֵ֔ר אֶ֣דֶר הַיְקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָקַ֖רְתִּי מֵעֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וָֽאֶקְחָה֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים הַכֶּ֔סֶף וָאַשְׁלִ֥יךְ אֹת֛וֹ בֵּ֥ית יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־הַיּוֹצֵֽר׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly hshlykhhv 'lhyvtsr 'dr hyqr 'shr yqrty m'lyhm v'qchh shlshym hkhsf v'shlykh 'tv byt yhvh 'lhyvtsr
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me: ‘Cast it into the treasury, the goodly price that I was prized at of them.’ And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them into the treasury, in the house of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָֽאֶגְדַּע֙ אֶת־מַקְלִ֣י הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֵ֖ת הַחֹֽבְלִ֑ים לְהָפֵר֙ אֶת־הָאַֽחֲוָ֔ה בֵּ֥ין יְהוּדָ֖ה וּבֵ֥ין יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'gd' 'tmqly hshny 't hchblym lhpr 'th'chvh byn yhvdh vbyn yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: Then I cut asunder mine other staff, even Binders, that the brotherhood between Judah and Israel might be broken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהֹוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑י ע֣וֹד קַח־לְךָ֔ כְּלִ֖י רֹעֶ֥ה אֱוִלִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'vd qchlkh khly r'h 'vly
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me: ‘Take unto thee yet the instruments of a foolish shepherd.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י הִנֵּֽה־אָנֹכִי֩ מֵקִ֨ים רֹעֶ֜ה בָּאָ֗רֶץ הַנִּכְחָד֤וֹת לֹֽא־יִפְקֹד֙ הַנַּ֣עַר לֹֽא־יְבַקֵּ֔שׁ וְהַנִּשְׁבֶּ֖רֶת לֹ֣א יְרַפֵּ֑א הַנִּצָּבָה֙ לֹ֣א יְכַלְכֵּ֔ל וּבְשַׂ֤ר הַבְּרִיאָה֙ יֹאכַ֔ל וּפַרְסֵיהֶ֖ן יְפָרֵֽק׃
verses.translit: khy hnh'nkhy mqym r'h b'rts hnkhchdvt l'ypqd hn'r l'ybqsh vhnshbrt l' yrp' hntsbh l' ykhlkhl vbshr hbry'h y'khl vprsyhn yprq
