verses.translation: For, lo, I will raise up a shepherd in the land, who will not think of those that are cut off, neither will seek those that are young, nor heal that which is broken; neither will he feed that which standeth still, but he will eat the flesh of the fat, and will break their hoofs in pieces.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֣וֹי רֹעִ֤י הָאֱלִיל֙ עֹזְבִ֣י הַצֹּ֔אן חֶ֥רֶב עַל־זְרוֹע֖וֹ וְעַל־עֵ֣ין יְמִינ֑וֹ זְרֹעוֹ֙ יָב֣וֹשׁ תִּיבָ֔שׁ וְעֵ֥ין יְמִינ֖וֹ כָּהֹ֥ה תִכְהֶֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hvy r'y h'lyl 'zby hts'n chrb 'lzrv'v v'l'yn ymynv zr'v ybvsh tybsh v'yn ymynv khhh tkhhh {p}
verses.translation: Woe to the worthless shepherd That leaveth the flock! The sword shall be upon his arm, And upon his right eye; His arm shall be clean dried up, And his right eye shall be utterly darkened.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֥א דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֗ה נֹטֶ֤ה שָׁמַ֙יִם֙ וְיֹסֵ֣ד אָ֔רֶץ וְיֹצֵ֥ר רֽוּחַ־אָדָ֖ם בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: msh' dbryhvh 'lyshr'l n'myhvh nth shmym vysd 'rts vytsr rvch'dm bqrbv
verses.translation: The burden of the word of the LORD concerning Israel. The saying of the LORD, who stretched forth the heavens, And laid the foundation of the earth, And formed the spirit of man within him:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה אָ֠נֹכִ֠י שָׂ֣ם אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֧͏ִם סַף־רַ֛עַל לְכׇל־הָעַמִּ֖ים סָבִ֑יב וְגַ֧ם עַל־יְהוּדָ֛ה יִהְיֶ֥ה בַמָּצ֖וֹר עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy shm 'tyrvshl͏m sfr'l lkhlh'mym sbyb vgm 'lyhvdh yhyh bmtsvr 'lyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of staggering Unto all the peoples round about, And upon Judah also shall it fall to be in the siege against Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה בַיּוֹם־הַ֠ה֠וּא אָשִׂ֨ים אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלַ֜͏ִם אֶ֤בֶן מַֽעֲמָסָה֙ לְכׇל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים כׇּל־עֹמְסֶ֖יהָ שָׂר֣וֹט יִשָּׂרֵ֑טוּ וְנֶאֶסְפ֣וּ עָלֶ֔יהָ כֹּ֖ל גּוֹיֵ֥י הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvmhhv' 'shym 'tyrvshl͏m 'bn m'msh lkhlh'mym khl'msyh shrvt yshrtv vn'spv 'lyh khl gvyy h'rts
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That I will make Jerusalem a stone of burden for all the peoples; All that burden themselves with it shall be sore wounded; And all the nations of the earth shall be gathered together against it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֗ה אַכֶּ֤ה כׇל־סוּס֙ בַּתִּמָּה֔וֹן וְרֹכְב֖וֹ בַּשִּׁגָּע֑וֹן וְעַל־בֵּ֤ית יְהוּדָה֙ אֶפְקַ֣ח אֶת־עֵינַ֔י וְכֹל֙ ס֣וּס הָעַמִּ֔ים אַכֶּ֖ה בַּעִוָּרֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' n'myhvh 'khh khlsvs btmhvn vrkhbv bshg'vn v'lbyt yhvdh 'pqch 't'yny vkhl svs h'mym 'khh b'vrvn
verses.translation: In that day, saith the LORD, I will smite every horse with bewilderment, And his rider with madness; And I will open Mine eyes upon the house of Judah, And will smite every horse of the peoples with blindness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָ֥מְר֛וּ אַלֻּפֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּלִבָּ֑ם אַמְצָ֥ה לִי֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם בַּיהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: v'mrv 'lpy yhvdh blbm 'mtsh ly yshby yrvshl͏m byhvh tsb'vt 'lhyhm
verses.translation: And the chiefs of Judah shall say in their heart: ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength Through the LORD of hosts their God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֡וּא אָשִׂים֩ אֶת־אַלֻּפֵ֨י יְהוּדָ֜ה כְּֽכִיּ֧וֹר אֵ֣שׁ בְּעֵצִ֗ים וּכְלַפִּ֥יד אֵשׁ֙ בְּעָמִ֔יר וְאָ֨כְל֜וּ עַל־יָמִ֧ין וְעַל־שְׂמֹ֛אול אֶת־כׇּל־הָעַמִּ֖ים סָבִ֑יב וְיָשְׁבָ֨ה יְרוּשָׁלַ֥͏ִם ע֛וֹד תַּחְתֶּ֖יהָ בִּירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' 'shym 't'lpy yhvdh khkhyvr 'sh b'tsym vkhlpyd 'sh b'myr v'khlv 'lymyn v'lshm'vl 'tkhlh'mym sbyb vyshbh yrvshl͏m 'vd tchtyh byrvshl͏m
verses.translation: In that day will I make the chiefs of Judah Like a pan of fire among the wood, And like a torch of fire among sheaves; And they shall devour all the peoples round about, On the right hand and on the left; And Jerusalem shall be inhabited again in her own place, even in Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהוֹשִׁ֧עַ יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶת־אׇהֳלֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה בָּרִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה לְמַ֨עַן לֹֽא־תִגְדַּ֜ל תִּפְאֶ֣רֶת בֵּית־דָּוִ֗יד וְתִפְאֶ֛רֶת יֹשֵׁ֥ב יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם עַל־יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.translit: vhvsh' yhvh 't'hly yhvdh br'shnh lm'n l'tgdl tp'rt bytdvyd vtp'rt yshb yrvshl͏m 'lyhvdh
verses.translation: The LORD also shall save the tents of Judah first, That the glory of the house of David And the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem be not magnified above Judah.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יָגֵ֤ן יְהֹוָה֙ בְּעַד֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם וְהָיָ֞ה הַנִּכְשָׁ֥ל בָּהֶ֛ם בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא כְּדָוִ֑יד וּבֵ֤ית דָּוִיד֙ כֵּֽאלֹהִ֔ים כְּמַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהֹוָ֖ה לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ygn yhvh b'd yvshb yrvshl͏m vhyh hnkhshl bhm byvm hhv' khdvyd vbyt dvyd kh'lhym khml'kh yhvh lpnyhm
verses.translation: In that day shall the LORD defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; And he that stumbleth among them at that day shall be as David; And the house of David shall be as a godlike being, As the angel of the LORD before them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא אֲבַקֵּ֗שׁ לְהַשְׁמִיד֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַבָּאִ֖ים עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' 'bqsh lhshmyd 'tkhlhgvym hb'ym 'lyrvshl͏m
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That I will seek to destroy all the nations That come against Jerusalem.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשָׁפַכְתִּי֩ עַל־בֵּ֨ית דָּוִ֜יד וְעַ֣ל  יוֹשֵׁ֣ב יְרוּשָׁלַ֗͏ִם ר֤וּחַ חֵן֙ וְתַ֣חֲנוּנִ֔ים וְהִבִּ֥יטוּ אֵלַ֖י אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־דָּקָ֑רוּ וְסָפְד֣וּ עָלָ֗יו כְּמִסְפֵּד֙ עַל־הַיָּחִ֔יד וְהָמֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו כְּהָמֵ֥ר עַֽל־הַבְּכֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vshpkhty 'lbyt dvyd v'l  yvshb yrvshl͏m rvch chn vtchnvnym vhbytv 'ly 't 'shrdqrv vspdv 'lyv khmspd 'lhychyd vhmr 'lyv khhmr 'lhbkhvr
verses.translation: And I will pour upon the house of David, And upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, The spirit of grace and of supplication; And they shall look unto Me because athey have thrust him through; And they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son, And shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his first-born.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִגְדַּ֤ל הַמִּסְפֵּד֙ בִּיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם כְּמִסְפַּ֥ד הֲדַד־רִמּ֖וֹן בְּבִקְעַ֥ת מְגִדּֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' ygdl hmspd byrvshl͏m khmspd hddrmvn bbq't mgdvn
verses.translation: In that day shall there be a great mourning in Jerusalem, As the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְסָפְדָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ מִשְׁפָּח֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּח֖וֹת לְבָ֑ד מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת בֵּית־דָּוִ֤יד לְבָד֙ וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֣ם לְבָ֔ד מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בֵּית־נָתָן֙ לְבָ֔ד וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם לְבָֽד׃
verses.translit: vspdh h'rts mshpchvt mshpchvt lbd mshpcht bytdvyd lbd vnshyhm lbd mshpcht bytntn lbd vnshyhm lbd
verses.translation: And the land shall mourn, every family apart: The family of the house of David apart, and their wives apart; The family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בֵּית־לֵוִי֙ לְבָ֔ד וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם לְבָ֑ד מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַשִּׁמְעִי֙ לְבָ֔ד וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם לְבָֽד׃
verses.translit: mshpcht bytlvy lbd vnshyhm lbd mshpcht hshm'y lbd vnshyhm lbd
verses.translation: The family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; The family of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כֹּ֗ל הַמִּשְׁפָּחוֹת֙ הַנִּשְׁאָר֔וֹת מִשְׁפָּחֹ֥ת מִשְׁפָּחֹ֖ת לְבָ֑ד וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם לְבָֽד׃
verses.translit: khl hmshpchvt hnsh'rvt mshpcht mshpcht lbd vnshyhm lbd
verses.translation: All the families that remain, Every family apart, and their wives apart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ מָק֣וֹר נִפְתָּ֔ח לְבֵ֥ית דָּוִ֖יד וּלְיֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם לְחַטַּ֖את וּלְנִדָּֽה׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh mqvr nptch lbyt dvyd vlyshby yrvshl͏m lcht't vlndh
verses.translation: In that day there shall be a fountain opened To the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, For purification and for sprinkling.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַה֜וּא נְאֻ֣ם  יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת אַכְרִ֞ית אֶת־שְׁמ֤וֹת הָעֲצַבִּים֙ מִן־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹ֥א יִזָּכְר֖וּ ע֑וֹד וְגַ֧ם אֶת־הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים וְאֶת־ר֥וּחַ הַטֻּמְאָ֖ה אַעֲבִ֥יר מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' n'm  yhvh tsb'vt 'khryt 'tshmvt h'tsbym mnh'rts vl' yzkhrv 'vd vgm 'thnby'ym v'trvch htm'h ''byr mnh'rts
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, Saith the LORD of hosts, That I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, And they shall no more be remembered; And also I will cause the prophets And the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כִּי־יִנָּבֵ֣א אִישׁ֮ עוֹד֒ וְאָמְר֣וּ אֵ֠לָ֠יו אָבִ֨יו וְאִמּ֤וֹ יֹֽלְדָיו֙ לֹ֣א תִֽחְיֶ֔ה כִּ֛י שֶׁ֥קֶר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהֹוָ֑ה וּדְקָרֻ֜הוּ אָבִ֧יהוּ וְאִמּ֛וֹ יֹלְדָ֖יו בְּהִנָּֽבְאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhyh khyynb' 'ysh 'vd v'mrv 'lyv 'byv v'mv yldyv l' tchyh khy shqr dbrt bshm yhvh vdqrhv 'byhv v'mv yldyv bhnb'v
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass that, when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begot him shall say unto him: ‘Thou shalt not live, for thou speakest lies in the name of the LORD’; and his father and his mother that begot him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יֵבֹ֧שׁוּ הַנְּבִיאִ֛ים אִ֥ישׁ מֵחֶזְיֹנ֖וֹ בְּהִנָּֽבְאֹת֑וֹ וְלֹ֧א יִלְבְּשׁ֛וּ אַדֶּ֥רֶת שֵׂעָ֖ר לְמַ֥עַן כַּחֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vhyh  byvm hhv' ybshv hnby'ym 'ysh mchzynv bhnb'tv vl' ylbshv 'drt sh'r lm'n khchsh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the prophets shall be brought to shame every one through his vision, when he prophesieth; neither shall they wear a hairy mantle to deceive;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַ֕ר לֹ֥א נָבִ֖יא אָנֹ֑כִי אִישׁ־עֹבֵ֤ד אֲדָמָה֙ אָנֹ֔כִי כִּ֥י אָדָ֖ם הִקְנַ֥נִי מִנְּעוּרָֽי׃
verses.translit: v'mr l' nby' 'nkhy 'ysh'bd 'dmh 'nkhy khy 'dm hqnny mn'vry
verses.translation: but he shall say: ‘I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground; for I have been made a bondman from my youth.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָמַ֣ר אֵלָ֔יו מָ֧ה הַמַּכּ֛וֹת הָאֵ֖לֶּה בֵּ֣ין יָדֶ֑יךָ וְאָמַ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֻכֵּ֖יתִי בֵּ֥ית מְאַהֲבָֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'mr 'lyv mh hmkhvt h'lh byn ydykh v'mr 'shr hkhyty byt m'hby {p}
verses.translation: And one shall say unto him: ‘What are these wounds between thy hands?’ Then he shall answer: ‘Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶ֗רֶב עוּרִ֤י עַל־רֹעִי֙ וְעַל־גֶּ֣בֶר עֲמִיתִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת הַ֤ךְ אֶת־הָרֹעֶה֙ וּתְפוּצֶ֣יןָ הַצֹּ֔אן וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֥י יָדִ֖י עַל־הַצֹּעֲרִֽים׃
verses.translit: chrb 'vry 'lr'y v'lgbr 'myty n'm yhvh tsb'vt hkh 'thr'h vtpvtsyn hts'n vhshbty ydy 'lhts'rym
verses.translation: Awake, O sword, against My shepherd, And against the man that is near unto Me, Saith the LORD of hosts; Smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered; And I will turn My hand upon the little ones.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה בְכׇל־הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה פִּֽי־שְׁנַ֣יִם בָּ֔הּ יִכָּרְת֖וּ יִגְוָ֑עוּ וְהַשְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית יִוָּ֥תֶר בָּֽהּ׃
verses.translit: vhyh bkhlh'rts n'myhvh pyshnym bh ykhrtv ygv'v vhshlshyt yvtr bh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that in all the land, saith the LORD, Two parts therein shall be cut off and die; But the third shall be left therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵבֵאתִ֤י אֶת־הַשְּׁלִשִׁית֙ בָּאֵ֔שׁ וּצְרַפְתִּים֙ כִּצְרֹ֣ף אֶת־הַכֶּ֔סֶף וּבְחַנְתִּ֖ים כִּבְחֹ֣ן אֶת־הַזָּהָ֑ב ה֣וּא  יִקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֗י וַֽאֲנִי֙ אֶעֱנֶ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ עַמִּ֣י ה֔וּא וְה֥וּא יֹאמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vhb'ty 'thshlshyt b'sh vtsrptym khtsrf 'thkhsf vbchntym khbchn 'thzhb hv'  yqr' bshmy v'ny ''nh 'tv 'mrty 'my hv' vhv' y'mr yhvh 'lhy {p}
verses.translation: And I will bring the third part through the fire, And will refine them as silver is refined, And will try them as gold is tried; They shall call on My name, And I will answer them; I will say: ‘It is My people’, And they shall say: ‘The LORD is my God.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה יֽוֹם־בָּ֖א לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְחֻלַּ֥ק שְׁלָלֵ֖ךְ בְּקִרְבֵּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: hnh yvmb' lyhvh vchlq shllkh bqrbkh
verses.translation: Behold, a day of the LORD cometh, When thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָסַפְתִּ֨י אֶת־כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֥ם ׀ אֶֽל־יְרוּשָׁלַ֘͏ִם֮ לַמִּלְחָמָה֒ וְנִלְכְּדָ֣ה הָעִ֗יר וְנָשַׁ֙סּוּ֙ הַבָּ֣תִּ֔ים וְהַנָּשִׁ֖ים (תשגלנה) [תִּשָּׁכַ֑בְנָה] וְיָצָ֞א חֲצִ֤י הָעִיר֙ בַּגּוֹלָ֔ה וְיֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם לֹ֥א יִכָּרֵ֖ת מִן־הָעִֽיר׃
verses.translit: v'spty 'tkhlhgvym  'lyrvshl͏m lmlchmh vnlkhdh h'yr vnshsv hbtym vhnshym (tshglnh) [tshkhbnh] vyts' chtsy h'yr bgvlh vytr h'm l' ykhrt mnh'yr
verses.translation: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; And the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, And the women ravished; And half of the city shall go forth into captivity, But the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָצָ֣א יְהֹוָ֔ה וְנִלְחַ֖ם בַּגּוֹיִ֣ם הָהֵ֑ם כְּי֥וֹם הִֽלָּחֲמ֖וֹ בְּי֥וֹם קְרָֽב׃
verses.translit: vyts' yhvh vnlchm bgvym hhm khyvm hlchmv byvm qrb
verses.translation: Then shall the LORD go forth, And fight against those nations, As when He fighteth in the day of battle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָמְד֣וּ רַגְלָ֣יו בַּיּוֹם־הַ֠ה֠וּא עַל־הַ֨ר הַזֵּיתִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י יְרֽוּשָׁלַ֘͏ִם֮ מִקֶּ֒דֶם֒ וְנִבְקַע֩ הַ֨ר הַזֵּיתִ֤ים מֵֽחֶצְיוֹ֙ מִזְרָ֣חָה וָיָ֔מָּה גֵּ֖יא גְּדוֹלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד וּמָ֨שׁ חֲצִ֥י הָהָ֛ר צָפ֖וֹנָה וְחֶצְיוֹ־נֶֽגְבָּה׃
verses.translit: v'mdv rglyv byvmhhv' 'lhr hzytym 'shr 'lpny yrvshl͏m mqdm vnbq' hr hzytym mchtsyv mzrchh vymh gy' gdvlh m'd vmsh chtsy hhr tspvnh vchtsyvngbh
verses.translation: And His feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, Which is before Jerusalem on the east, And the mount of Olives shall cleft in the midst thereof Toward the east and toward the west, So that there shall be a very great valley; And half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, And half of it toward the south.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְנַסְתֶּ֣ם גֵּיא־הָרַ֗י כִּי־יַגִּ֣יעַ גֵּֽי־הָרִים֮ אֶל־אָצַל֒ וְנַסְתֶּ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר נַסְתֶּם֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י הָרַ֔עַשׁ בִּימֵ֖י עֻזִּיָּ֣ה מֶלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֑ה וּבָא֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֔י כׇּל־קְדֹשִׁ֖ים עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: vnstm gy'hry khyygy' gyhrym 'l'tsl vnstm kh'shr nstm mpny hr'sh bymy 'zyh mlkhyhvdh vb' yhvh 'lhy khlqdshym 'mkh
verses.translation: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; For the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azel; Yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake In the days of Uzziah king of Judah; And the LORD my God shall come, And all the holy ones with Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא לֹֽא־יִֽהְיֶ֣ה א֔וֹר יְקָר֖וֹת (יקפאון) [וְקִפָּאֽוֹן]׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' l'yhyh 'vr yqrvt (yqp'vn) [vqp'vn]
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, that there shall not be light, But heavy clouds and thick;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה יוֹם־אֶחָ֗ד ה֛וּא יִוָּדַ֥ע לַיהֹוָ֖ה לֹא־י֣וֹם וְלֹא־לָ֑יְלָה וְהָיָ֥ה לְעֵֽת־עֶ֖רֶב יִֽהְיֶה־אֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: vhyh yvm'chd hv' yvd' lyhvh l'yvm vl'lylh vhyh l't'rb yhyh'vr
verses.translation: And there shall be one day Which shall be known as the LORD’S, Not day, and not night; But it shall come to pass, that at evening time there shall be light.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה  בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יֵצְא֤וּ מַֽיִם־חַיִּים֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם חֶצְיָ֗ם אֶל־הַיָּם֙ הַקַּדְמוֹנִ֔י וְחֶצְיָ֖ם אֶל־הַיָּ֣ם הָאַחֲר֑וֹן בַּקַּ֥יִץ וּבָחֹ֖רֶף יִֽהְיֶֽה׃
verses.translit: vhyh  byvm hhv' yts'v mymchyym myrvshl͏m chtsym 'lhym hqdmvny vchtsym 'lhym h'chrvn bqyts vbchrf yhyh
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That living waters shall go out from Jerusalem: Half of them toward the eastern sea, And half of them toward the western sea; In summer and in winter shall it be.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־כׇּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִהְיֶ֧ה יְהֹוָ֛ה אֶחָ֖ד וּשְׁמ֥וֹ אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: vhyh yhvh lmlkh 'lkhlh'rts byvm hhv' yhyh yhvh 'chd vshmv 'chd
verses.translation: And the LORD shall be King over all the earth; In that day shall the LORD be One, and His name one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִסּ֨וֹב כׇּל־הָאָ֤רֶץ כָּֽעֲרָבָה֙ מִגֶּ֣בַע לְרִמּ֔וֹן נֶ֖גֶב יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְֽרָאֲמָה֩ וְיָשְׁבָ֨ה תַחְתֶּ֜יהָ לְמִשַּׁ֣עַר בִּנְיָמִ֗ן עַד־מְק֞וֹם שַׁ֤עַר הָֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ עַד־שַׁ֣עַר הַפִּנִּ֔ים וּמִגְדַּ֣ל חֲנַנְאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד יִקְבֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.translit: ysvb khlh'rts kh'rbh mgb' lrmvn ngb yrvshl͏m vr'mh vyshbh tchtyh lmsh'r bnymn 'dmqvm sh'r hr'shvn 'dsh'r hpnym vmgdl chnn'l 'd yqby hmlkh
verses.translation: All the land shall be turned as the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin’s gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel unto the king’s winepresses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֔הּ וְחֵ֖רֶם לֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶה־ע֑וֹד וְיָשְׁבָ֥ה יְרוּשָׁלַ֖͏ִם לָבֶֽטַח׃ {ס}
verses.translit: vyshbv bh vchrm l' yhyh'vd vyshbh yrvshl͏m lbtch {s}
verses.translation: And men shall dwell therein, And there shall be no more extermination; But Jerusalem shall dwell safely.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹ֣את  תִּהְיֶ֣ה הַמַּגֵּפָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִגֹּ֤ף יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־כׇּל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צָבְא֖וּ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם הָמֵ֣ק  בְּשָׂר֗וֹ וְהוּא֙ עֹמֵ֣ד עַל־רַגְלָ֔יו וְעֵינָיו֙ תִּמַּ֣קְנָה בְחֹֽרֵיהֶ֔ן וּלְשׁוֹנ֖וֹ תִּמַּ֥ק בְּפִיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vz't  thyh hmgph 'shr ygf yhvh 'tkhlh'mym 'shr tsb'v 'lyrvshl͏m hmq  bshrv vhv' 'md 'lrglyv v'ynyv tmqnh bchryhn vlshvnv tmq bpyhm
verses.translation: And this shall be the plague wherewith the LORD will smite All the peoples that have warred against Jerusalem: Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, And their eyes shall consume away in their sockets, And their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא תִּהְיֶ֧ה מְהֽוּמַת־יְהֹוָ֛ה רַבָּ֖ה בָּהֶ֑ם וְהֶחֱזִ֗יקוּ אִ֚ישׁ יַ֣ד רֵעֵ֔הוּ וְעָלְתָ֥ה יָד֖וֹ עַל־יַ֥ד רֵעֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hhv' thyh mhvmtyhvh rbh bhm vhchzyqv 'ysh yd r'hv v'lth ydv 'lyd r'hv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass in that day, That a great tumult from the LORD shall be among them; And they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, And his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַ֨ם־יְהוּדָ֔ה תִּלָּחֵ֖ם בִּירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְאֻסַּף֩ חֵ֨יל כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֜ם סָבִ֗יב זָהָ֥ב וָכֶ֛סֶף וּבְגָדִ֖ים לָרֹ֥ב מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: vgmyhvdh tlchm byrvshl͏m v'sf chyl khlhgvym sbyb zhb vkhsf vbgdym lrb m'd
verses.translation: And Judah also shall fight against Jerusalem; And the wealth of all the nations round about shall be gathered together, Gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכֵ֨ן תִּהְיֶ֜ה מַגֵּפַ֣ת הַסּ֗וּס הַפֶּ֙רֶד֙ הַגָּמָ֣ל וְהַחֲמ֔וֹר וְכׇ֨ל־הַבְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽהְיֶ֖ה בַּמַּחֲנ֣וֹת הָהֵ֑מָּה כַּמַּגֵּפָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.translit: vkhn thyh mgpt hsvs hprd hgml vhchmvr vkhlhbhmh 'shr yhyh bmchnvt hhmh khmgph hz't
verses.translation: And so shall be the plague of the horse, Of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, And of all the beasts that shall be in those camps, as this plague.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה כׇּל־הַנּוֹתָר֙ מִכׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם הַבָּאִ֖ים עַל־יְרוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם וְעָל֞וּ מִדֵּ֧י שָׁנָ֣ה בְשָׁנָ֗ה לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺת֙ לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְלָחֹ֖ג אֶת־חַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vhyh khlhnvtr mkhlhgvym hb'ym 'lyrvshl͏m v'lv mdy shnh bshnh lhshtchvt lmlkh yhvh tsb'vt vlchg 'tchg hskhvt
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem shall go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הָיָ֠ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא־יַעֲלֶ֜ה מֵאֵ֨ת מִשְׁפְּח֤וֹת הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶל־יְר֣וּשָׁלַ֔͏ִם לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֔ת לְמֶ֖לֶךְ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְלֹ֥א עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם יִהְיֶ֥ה הַגָּֽשֶׁם׃
verses.translit: vhyh 'shr l'y'lh m't mshpchvt h'rts 'lyrvshl͏m lhshtchvt lmlkh yhvh tsb'vt vl' 'lyhm yhyh hgshm
verses.translation: And it shall be, that whoso of the families of the earth goeth not up unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, upon them there shall be no rain.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִם־מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת מִצְרַ֧יִם לֹֽא־תַעֲלֶ֛ה וְלֹ֥א בָאָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה הַמַּגֵּפָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִגֹּ֤ף יְהֹוָה֙ אֶת־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲל֔וּ לָחֹ֖ג אֶת־חַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'mmshpcht mtsrym l't'lh vl' b'h vl' 'lyhm thyh hmgph 'shr ygf yhvh 'thgvym 'shr l' y'lv lchg 'tchg hskhvt
verses.translation: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, they shall have no overflow; there shall be the plague, wherewith the LORD will smite the nations that go not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֹ֥את תִּהְיֶ֖ה חַטַּ֣את מִצְרָ֑יִם וְחַטַּאת֙ כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲל֔וּ לָחֹ֖ג אֶת־חַ֥ג הַסֻּכּֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: z't thyh cht't mtsrym vcht't khlhgvym 'shr l' y'lv lchg 'tchg hskhvt
verses.translation: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations that go not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִֽהְיֶה֙ עַל־מְצִלּ֣וֹת הַסּ֔וּס קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהֹוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֤ה הַסִּירוֹת֙ בְּבֵ֣ית יְהֹוָ֔ה כַּמִּזְרָקִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.translit: byvm hhv' yhyh 'lmtslvt hsvs qdsh lyhvh vhyh hsyrvt bbyt yhvh khmzrqym lpny hmzbch
verses.translation: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses: HOLY UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD’S house shall be like the basins before the altar.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֠הָיָ֠ה כׇּל־סִ֨יר בִּירוּשָׁלַ֜͏ִם וּבִיהוּדָ֗ה קֹ֚דֶשׁ לַיהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּבָ֙אוּ֙ כׇּל־הַזֹּ֣בְחִ֔ים וְלָקְח֥וּ מֵהֶ֖ם וּבִשְּׁל֣וּ בָהֶ֑ם וְלֹֽא־יִֽהְיֶ֨ה כְנַעֲנִ֥י ע֛וֹד בְּבֵית־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃
verses.translit: vhyh khlsyr byrvshl͏m vbyhvdh qdsh lyhvh tsb'vt vb'v khlhzbchym vlqchv mhm vbshlv bhm vl'yhyh khn'ny 'vd bbytyhvh tsb'vt byvm hhv'
verses.translation: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holy unto the LORD of hosts; and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein; and in that day there shall be no more a trafficker in the house of the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַשָּׂ֥א דְבַר־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֶל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּיַ֖ד מַלְאָכִֽי׃
verses.translit: msh' dbryhvh 'lyshr'l byd ml'khy
verses.translation: The burden of the word of the LORD to Israel by Malachi.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָהַ֤בְתִּי אֶתְכֶם֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּמָּ֣ה אֲהַבְתָּ֑נוּ הֲלוֹא־אָ֨ח עֵשָׂ֤ו לְיַֽעֲקֹב֙ נְאֻם־יְהֹוָ֔ה וָאֹהַ֖ב אֶֽת־יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: 'hbty 'tkhm 'mr yhvh v'mrtm bmh 'hbtnv hlv''ch 'shv ly'qb n'myhvh v'hb 'ty'qb
verses.translation: I have loved you, saith the LORD. Yet ye say: ‘Wherein hast Thou loved us?’ Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? Saith the LORD; Yet I loved Jacob;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאֶת־עֵשָׂ֖ו שָׂנֵ֑אתִי וָאָשִׂ֤ים אֶת־הָרָיו֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְאֶת־נַחֲלָת֖וֹ לְתַנּ֥וֹת מִדְבָּֽר׃
verses.translit: v't'shv shn'ty v'shym 'thryv shmmh v'tnchltv ltnvt mdbr
verses.translation: But Esau I hated, And made his mountains a desolation, And gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־תֹאמַ֨ר אֱד֜וֹם רֻשַּׁ֗שְׁנוּ וְנָשׁוּב֙ וְנִבְנֶ֣ה חֳרָב֔וֹת כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת הֵ֥מָּה יִבְנ֖וּ וַאֲנִ֣י אֶהֱר֑וֹס וְקָרְא֤וּ לָהֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל רִשְׁעָ֔ה וְהָעָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־זָעַ֥ם יְהֹוָ֖ה עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: khyt'mr 'dvm rshshnv vnshvb vnbnh chrbvt khh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt hmh ybnv v'ny 'hrvs vqr'v lhm gbvl rsh'h vh'm 'shrz'm yhvh 'd'vlm
verses.translation: Whereas Edom saith: ‘We are beaten down, But we will return and build the waste places’; Thus saith the LORD of hosts: They shall build, but I will throw down; And they shall be called The border of wickedness, And The people whom the LORD execrateth for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעֵינֵיכֶ֖ם תִּרְאֶ֑ינָה וְאַתֶּ֤ם תֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהֹוָ֔ה מֵעַ֖ל לִגְב֥וּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'ynykhm tr'ynh v'tm t'mrv ygdl yhvh m'l lgbvl yshr'l
verses.translation: And your eyes shall see, And ye shall say: ‘The LORD is great beyond the border of Israel.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בֵּ֛ן יְכַבֵּ֥ד אָ֖ב וְעֶ֣בֶד אֲדֹנָ֑יו וְאִם־אָ֣ב אָ֣נִי אַיֵּ֣ה כְבוֹדִ֡י וְאִם־אֲדוֹנִ֣ים אָ֩נִי֩ אַיֵּ֨ה מוֹרָאִ֜י אָמַ֣ר  יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת לָכֶם֙ הַכֹּֽהֲנִים֙ בּוֹזֵ֣י שְׁמִ֔י וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם בַּמֶּ֥ה בָזִ֖ינוּ אֶת־שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: bn ykhbd 'b v'bd 'dnyv v'm'b 'ny 'yh khbvdy v'm'dvnym 'ny 'yh mvr'y 'mr  yhvh tsb'vt lkhm hkhhnym bvzy shmy v'mrtm bmh bzynv 'tshmkh
verses.translation: A son honoureth his father, And a servant his master; If then I be a father, Where is My honour? And if I be a master, Where is My fear? Saith the LORD of hosts Unto you, O priests, that despise My name. And ye say: ‘Wherein have we despised Thy name?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַגִּישִׁ֤ים עַֽל־מִזְבְּחִי֙ לֶ֣חֶם מְגֹאָ֔ל וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּמֶּ֣ה גֵאַלְנ֑וּךָ בֶּאֱמׇרְכֶ֕ם שֻׁלְחַ֥ן יְהֹוָ֖ה נִבְזֶ֥ה הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: mgyshym 'lmzbchy lchm mg'l v'mrtm bmh g'lnvkh b'mrkhm shlchn yhvh nbzh hv'
verses.translation: Ye offer polluted bread upon Mine altar. And ye say: ‘Wherein have we polluted thee?’ In that ye say: ‘The table of the LORD is contemptible.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְכִי־תַגִּישׁ֨וּן עִוֵּ֤ר לִזְבֹּ֙חַ֙ אֵ֣ין רָ֔ע וְכִ֥י תַגִּ֛ישׁוּ פִּסֵּ֥חַ וְחֹלֶ֖ה אֵ֣ין רָ֑ע הַקְרִיבֵ֨הוּ נָ֜א לְפֶחָתֶ֗ךָ הֲיִרְצְךָ֙ א֚וֹ הֲיִשָּׂ֣א פָנֶ֔יךָ אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vkhytgyshvn 'vr lzbch 'yn r' vkhy tgyshv psch vchlh 'yn r' hqrybhv n' lpchtkh hyrtskh 'v hysh' pnykh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And when ye offer the blind for sacrifice, is it no evil! And when ye offer the lame and sick, is it no evil! Present it now unto thy governor; will he be pleased with thee? Or will he accept thy person? Saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֛ה חַלּוּ־נָ֥א פְנֵי־אֵ֖ל וִֽיחׇנֵּ֑נוּ מִיֶּדְכֶם֙ הָ֣יְתָה זֹּ֔את הֲיִשָּׂ֤א מִכֶּם֙ פָּנִ֔ים אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'th chlvn' pny'l vychnnv mydkhm hyth z't hysh' mkhm pnym 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And now, I pray you, entreat the favour of God That He may be gracious unto us!— This hath been of your doing.— Will He accept any of your persons? Saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י גַם־בָּכֶם֙ וְיִסְגֹּ֣ר דְּלָתַ֔יִם וְלֹא־תָאִ֥ירוּ מִזְבְּחִ֖י חִנָּ֑ם אֵֽין־לִ֨י חֵ֜פֶץ בָּכֶ֗ם אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּמִנְחָ֖ה לֹא־אֶרְצֶ֥ה מִיֶּדְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: my gmbkhm vysgr dltym vl't'yrv mzbchy chnm 'ynly chpts bkhm 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vmnchh l''rtsh mydkhm
verses.translation: Oh that there were even one among you that would shut the doors, That ye might not kindle fire on Mine altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you, Saith the LORD of hosts, Neither will I accept an offering at your hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִמִּזְרַח־שֶׁ֜מֶשׁ וְעַד־מְבוֹא֗וֹ גָּד֤וֹל שְׁמִי֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וּבְכׇל־מָק֗וֹם מֻקְטָ֥ר מֻגָּ֛שׁ לִשְׁמִ֖י וּמִנְחָ֣ה טְהוֹרָ֑ה כִּֽי־גָד֤וֹל שְׁמִי֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: khy mmzrchshmsh v'dmbv'v gdvl shmy bgvym vbkhlmqvm mqtr mgsh lshmy vmnchh thvrh khygdvl shmy bgvym 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: For from the rising of the sun even unto the going down of the same My name is great among the nations; And in every place offerings are presented unto My name, Even pure oblations; For My name is great among the nations, Saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֖ם מְחַלְּלִ֣ים אוֹת֑וֹ בֶּאֱמׇרְכֶ֗ם שֻׁלְחַ֤ן אֲדֹנָי֙ מְגֹאָ֣ל ה֔וּא וְנִיב֖וֹ נִבְזֶ֥ה אׇכְלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: v'tm mchllym 'vtv b'mrkhm shlchn 'dny mg'l hv' vnybv nbzh 'khlv
verses.translation: But ye profane it, In that ye say: ‘The table of the LORD is polluted, And the fruit thereof, even the food thereof, is contemptible.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם֩ הִנֵּ֨ה מַתְּלָאָ֜ה וְהִפַּחְתֶּ֣ם אוֹת֗וֹ אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וַהֲבֵאתֶ֣ם גָּז֗וּל וְאֶת־הַפִּסֵּ֙חַ֙ וְאֶת־הַ֣חוֹלֶ֔ה וַהֲבֵאתֶ֖ם אֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֑ה הַאֶרְצֶ֥ה אוֹתָ֛הּ מִיֶּדְכֶ֖ם אָמַ֥ר יְהֹוָֽה׃ {ס}
verses.translit: v'mrtm hnh mtl'h vhpchtm 'vtv 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vhb'tm gzvl v'thpsch v'thchvlh vhb'tm 'thmnchh h'rtsh 'vth mydkhm 'mr yhvh {s}
verses.translation: Ye say also: ‘Behold, what a weariness is it!’ And ye have snuffed at it, Saith the LORD of hosts; And ye have brought that which was taken by violence, And the lame, and the sick; Thus ye bring the offering; Should I accept this of your hand? Saith the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָר֣וּר נוֹכֵ֗ל וְיֵ֤שׁ בְּעֶדְרוֹ֙ זָכָ֔ר וְנֹדֵ֛ר וְזֹבֵ֥חַ מׇשְׁחָ֖ת לַאדֹנָ֑י כִּי֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ גָּד֜וֹל אָ֗נִי אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּשְׁמִ֖י נוֹרָ֥א בַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: v'rvr nvkhl vysh b'drv zkhr vndr vzbch mshcht l'dny khy mlkh gdvl 'ny 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vshmy nvr' bgvym
verses.translation: But cursed be he that dealeth craftily, Whereas he hath in his flock a male, And voweth, and sacrificeth unto the Lord a blemished thing; For I am a great King, Saith the LORD of hosts, And My name is feared among the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה אֲלֵיכֶ֛ם הַמִּצְוָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃
verses.translit: v'th 'lykhm hmtsvh hz't hkhhnym
verses.translation: And now, this commandment Is for you, O ye priests.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־לֹ֣א תִשְׁמְע֡וּ וְאִם־לֹא֩ תָשִׂ֨ימוּ עַל־לֵ֜ב לָתֵ֧ת כָּב֣וֹד לִשְׁמִ֗י אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וְשִׁלַּחְתִּ֤י בָכֶם֙ אֶת־הַמְּאֵרָ֔ה וְאָרוֹתִ֖י אֶת־בִּרְכוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְגַם֙ אָרוֹתִ֔יהָ כִּ֥י אֵינְכֶ֖ם שָׂמִ֥ים עַל־לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: 'ml' tshm'v v'ml' tshymv 'llb ltt khbvd lshmy 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vshlchty bkhm 'thm'rh v'rvty 'tbrkhvtykhm vgm 'rvtyh khy 'ynkhm shmym 'llb
verses.translation: If ye will not hearken, and if ye will not lay it to heart, To give glory unto My name, Saith the LORD of hosts, Then will I send the curse upon you, And I will curse your blessings; Yea, I curse them, Because ye do not lay it to heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י גֹעֵ֤ר לָכֶם֙ אֶת־הַזֶּ֔רַע וְזֵרִ֤יתִֽי פֶ֙רֶשׁ֙ עַל־פְּנֵיכֶ֔ם פֶּ֖רֶשׁ חַגֵּיכֶ֑ם וְנָשָׂ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: hnny g'r lkhm 'thzr' vzryty prsh 'lpnykhm prsh chgykhm vnsh' 'tkhm 'lyv
verses.translation: Behold, I will rebuke the seed for your hurt, And will spread dung upon your faces, Even the dung of your sacrifices; And ye shall be taken away unto it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֚י שִׁלַּ֣חְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת הַמִּצְוָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את לִהְי֤וֹת בְּרִיתִי֙ אֶת־לֵוִ֔י אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vyd'tm khy shlchty 'lykhm 't hmtsvh hz't lhyvt bryty 'tlvy 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Know then that I have sent This commandment unto you, That My covenant might be with Levi, Saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּרִיתִ֣י  הָיְתָ֣ה אִתּ֗וֹ הַֽחַיִּים֙ וְהַשָּׁל֔וֹם וָאֶתְּנֵֽם־ל֥וֹ מוֹרָ֖א וַיִּֽירָאֵ֑נִי וּמִפְּנֵ֥י שְׁמִ֖י נִחַ֥ת הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: bryty  hyth 'tv hchyym vhshlvm v'tnmlv mvr' vyyr'ny vmpny shmy ncht hv'
verses.translation: My covenant was with him Of life and peace, and I gave them to him, And of fear, and he feared Me, And was afraid of My name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּוֹרַ֤ת אֱמֶת֙ הָיְתָ֣ה בְּפִ֔יהוּ וְעַוְלָ֖ה לֹא־נִמְצָ֣א בִשְׂפָתָ֑יו בְּשָׁל֤וֹם וּבְמִישׁוֹר֙ הָלַ֣ךְ אִתִּ֔י וְרַבִּ֖ים הֵשִׁ֥יב מֵעָוֺֽן׃
verses.translit: tvrt 'mt hyth bpyhv v'vlh l'nmts' bshptyv bshlvm vbmyshvr hlkh 'ty vrbym hshyb m'vn
verses.translation: The law of truth was in his mouth, And unrighteousness was not found in his lips; He walked with Me in peace and uprightness, And did turn many away from iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־שִׂפְתֵ֤י כֹהֵן֙ יִשְׁמְרוּ־דַ֔עַת וְתוֹרָ֖ה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ מִפִּ֑יהוּ כִּ֛י מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהֹוָֽה־צְבָא֖וֹת הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: khyshpty khhn yshmrvd't vtvrh ybqshv mpyhv khy ml'kh yhvhtsb'vt hv'
verses.translation: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, And they should seek the law at his mouth; For he is the messenger of the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתֶּם֙ סַרְתֶּ֣ם מִן־הַדֶּ֔רֶךְ הִכְשַׁלְתֶּ֥ם רַבִּ֖ים בַּתּוֹרָ֑ה שִֽׁחַתֶּם֙ בְּרִ֣ית הַלֵּוִ֔י אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: v'tm srtm mnhdrkh hkhshltm rbym btvrh shchtm bryt hlvy 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: But ye are turned aside out of the way; Ye have caused many to stumble in the law; Ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, Saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגַם־אֲנִ֞י נָתַ֧תִּי אֶתְכֶ֛ם נִבְזִ֥ים וּשְׁפָלִ֖ים לְכׇל־הָעָ֑ם כְּפִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵֽינְכֶם֙ שֹׁמְרִ֣ים אֶת־דְּרָכַ֔י וְנֹשְׂאִ֥ים פָּנִ֖ים בַּתּוֹרָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vgm'ny ntty 'tkhm nbzym vshplym lkhlh'm khpy 'shr 'ynkhm shmrym 'tdrkhy vnsh'ym pnym btvrh {p}
verses.translation: Therefore have I also made you Contemptible and base before all the people, According as ye have not kept My ways, But have had respect of persons in the law.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲל֨וֹא אָ֤ב אֶחָד֙ לְכֻלָּ֔נוּ הֲל֛וֹא אֵ֥ל אֶחָ֖ד בְּרָאָ֑נוּ מַדּ֗וּעַ נִבְגַּד֙ אִ֣ישׁ בְּאָחִ֔יו לְחַלֵּ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית אֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: hlv' 'b 'chd lkhlnv hlv' 'l 'chd br'nv mdv' nbgd 'ysh b'chyv lchll bryt 'btynv
verses.translation: Have we not all one father? Hath not one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, Profaning the covenant of our fathers?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּגְדָ֣ה יְהוּדָ֔ה וְתוֹעֵבָ֛ה נֶעֶשְׂתָ֥ה בְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וּבִירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם כִּ֣י  חִלֵּ֣ל יְהוּדָ֗ה קֹ֤דֶשׁ יְהֹוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָהֵ֔ב וּבָעַ֖ל בַּת־אֵ֥ל נֵכָֽר׃
verses.translit: bgdh yhvdh vtv'bh n'shth byshr'l vbyrvshl͏m khy  chll yhvdh qdsh yhvh 'shr 'hb vb'l bt'l nkhr
verses.translation: Judah hath dealt treacherously, And an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; For Judah hath profaned the holiness of the LORD which He loveth, And hath married the daughter of a strange god.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַכְרֵ֨ת יְהֹוָ֜ה לָאִ֨ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַעֲשֶׂ֙נָּה֙ עֵ֣ר וְעֹנֶ֔ה מֵאׇהֳלֵ֖י יַעֲקֹ֑ב וּמַגִּ֣ישׁ מִנְחָ֔ה לַיהֹוָ֖ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ykhrt yhvh l'ysh 'shr y'shnh 'r v'nh m'hly y'qb vmgysh mnchh lyhvh tsb'vt {p}
verses.translation: May the LORD cut off to the man that doeth this, Him that calleth and him that answereth out of the tents of Jacob, And him that offereth an offering unto the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזֹאת֙ שֵׁנִ֣ית תַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּסּ֤וֹת דִּמְעָה֙ אֶת־מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהֹוָ֔ה בְּכִ֖י וַאֲנָקָ֑ה מֵאֵ֣ין ע֗וֹד פְּנוֹת֙ אֶל־הַמִּנְחָ֔ה וְלָקַ֥חַת רָצ֖וֹן מִיֶּדְכֶֽם׃
verses.translit: vz't shnyt t'shv khsvt dm'h 'tmzbch yhvh bkhy v'nqh m'yn 'vd pnvt 'lhmnchh vlqcht rtsvn mydkhm
verses.translation: And this further ye do: Ye cover the altar of the LORD with tears, With weeping, and with sighing, Insomuch that He regardeth not the offering any more, Neither receiveth it with good will at your hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם עַל־מָ֑ה עַ֡ל כִּֽי־יְהֹוָה֩ הֵעִ֨יד בֵּינְךָ֜ וּבֵ֣ין  אֵ֣שֶׁת נְעוּרֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ בָּגַ֣דְתָּה בָּ֔הּ וְהִ֥יא חֲבֶרְתְּךָ֖ וְאֵ֥שֶׁת בְּרִיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'mrtm 'lmh 'l khyyhvh h'yd bynkh vbyn  'sht n'vrykh 'shr 'th bgdth bh vhy' chbrtkh v'sht brytkh
verses.translation: Yet ye say: ‘Wherefore?’ Because the LORD hath been witness Between thee and the wife of thy youth, Against whom thou hast dealt treacherously, Though she is thy companion, And the wife of thy covenant.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְלֹא־אֶחָ֣ד עָשָׂ֗ה וּשְׁאָ֥ר ר֙וּחַ֙ ל֔וֹ וּמָה֙ הָאֶחָ֔ד מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ זֶ֣רַע אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ בְּר֣וּחֲכֶ֔ם וּבְאֵ֥שֶׁת נְעוּרֶ֖יךָ אַל־יִבְגֹּֽד׃
verses.translit: vl''chd 'shh vsh'r rvch lv vmh h'chd mbqsh zr' 'lhym vnshmrtm brvchkhm vb'sht n'vrykh 'lybgd
verses.translation: And not one hath done so Who had exuberance of spirit! For what seeketh the one? A seed given of God. Therefore take heed to your spirit, And let none deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־שָׂנֵ֣א שַׁלַּ֗ח אָמַ֤ר יְהֹוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְכִסָּ֤ה חָמָס֙ עַל־לְבוּשׁ֔וֹ אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְנִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם בְּרוּחֲכֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א תִבְגֹּֽדוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khyshn' shlch 'mr yhvh 'lhy yshr'l vkhsh chms 'llbvshv 'mr yhvh tsb'vt vnshmrtm brvchkhm vl' tbgdv {p}
verses.translation: For I hate putting away, Saith the LORD, the God of Israel, And him that covereth his garment with violence, Saith the LORD of hosts; Therefore take heed to your spirit, That ye deal not treacherously.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹגַעְתֶּ֤ם יְהֹוָה֙ בְּדִבְרֵיכֶ֔ם וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּמָּ֣ה הוֹגָ֑עְנוּ בֶּאֱמׇרְכֶ֗ם כׇּל־עֹ֨שֵׂה רָ֜ע ט֣וֹב  בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֗ה וּבָהֶם֙ ה֣וּא חָפֵ֔ץ א֥וֹ אַיֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַמִּשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.translit: hvg'tm yhvh bdbrykhm v'mrtm bmh hvg'nv b'mrkhm khl'shh r' tvb  b'yny yhvh vbhm hv' chpts 'v 'yh 'lhy hmshpt
verses.translation: Ye have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet ye say: ‘Wherein have we wearied Him?’ In that ye say: ‘Every one that doeth evil Is good in the sight of the LORD, And He delighteth in them; Or where is the God of justice?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנְנִ֤י שֹׁלֵ֙חַ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔י וּפִנָּה־דֶ֖רֶךְ לְפָנָ֑י וּפִתְאֹם֩ יָב֨וֹא אֶל־הֵיכָל֜וֹ הָאָד֣וֹן  אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֣ם מְבַקְשִׁ֗ים וּמַלְאַ֨ךְ הַבְּרִ֜ית אֲשֶׁר־אַתֶּ֤ם חֲפֵצִים֙ הִנֵּה־בָ֔א אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: hnny shlch ml'khy vpnhdrkh lpny vpt'm ybv' 'lhykhlv h'dvn  'shr'tm mbqshym vml'kh hbryt 'shr'tm chptsym hnhb' 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Behold, I send My messenger, and he shall clear the way before Me; and the Lord, whom ye seek, will suddenly come to His temple, and the messenger of the covenant, Whom ye delight in, Behold, he cometh, Saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּמִ֤י מְכַלְכֵּל֙ אֶת־י֣וֹם בּוֹא֔וֹ וּמִ֥י הָעֹמֵ֖ד בְּהֵרָאוֹת֑וֹ כִּי־הוּא֙ כְּאֵ֣שׁ מְצָרֵ֔ף וּכְבֹרִ֖ית מְכַבְּסִֽים׃
verses.translit: vmy mkhlkhl 'tyvm bv'v vmy h'md bhr'vtv khyhv' kh'sh mtsrf vkhbryt mkhbsym
verses.translation: But who may abide the day of his coming? And who shall stand when he appeareth? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like fullers’soap;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיָשַׁ֨ב מְצָרֵ֤ף וּמְטַהֵר֙ כֶּ֔סֶף וְטִהַ֤ר אֶת־בְּנֵֽי־לֵוִי֙ וְזִקַּ֣ק אֹתָ֔ם כַּזָּהָ֖ב וְכַכָּ֑סֶף וְהָיוּ֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה מַגִּישֵׁ֥י מִנְחָ֖ה בִּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyshb mtsrf vmthr khsf vthr 'tbnylvy vzqq 'tm khzhb vkhkhsf vhyv lyhvh mgyshy mnchh btsdqh
verses.translation: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver; and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver; and there shall be they that shall offer unto the LORD offerings in righteousness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעָֽרְבָה֙ לַֽיהֹוָ֔ה מִנְחַ֥ת יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלָ֑͏ִם כִּימֵ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם וּכְשָׁנִ֖ים קַדְמֹנִיֹּֽת׃
verses.translit: v'rbh lyhvh mncht yhvdh vyrvshl͏m khymy 'vlm vkhshnym qdmnyt
verses.translation: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the LORD, as in the days of old, and as in ancient years.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְקָרַבְתִּ֣י אֲלֵיכֶם֮ לַמִּשְׁפָּט֒ וְהָיִ֣יתִי  עֵ֣ד מְמַהֵ֗ר בַּֽמְכַשְּׁפִים֙ וּבַמְנָ֣אֲפִ֔ים וּבַנִּשְׁבָּעִ֖ים לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וּבְעֹשְׁקֵ֣י שְׂכַר־שָׂ֠כִ֠יר אַלְמָנָ֨ה וְיָת֤וֹם וּמַטֵּי־גֵר֙ וְלֹ֣א יְרֵא֔וּנִי אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vqrbty 'lykhm lmshpt vhyyty  'd mmhr bmkhshpym vbmn'pym vbnshb'ym lshqr vb'shqy shkhrshkhyr 'lmnh vytvm vmtygr vl' yr'vny 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers; and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, The widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not Me, Saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה לֹ֣א שָׁנִ֑יתִי וְאַתֶּ֥ם בְּנֵֽי־יַעֲקֹ֖ב לֹ֥א כְלִיתֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy 'ny yhvh l' shnyty v'tm bnyy'qb l' khlytm
verses.translation: For I the LORD change not; and ye, O sons of Jacob, are not consumed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמִימֵ֨י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֜ם סַרְתֶּ֤ם מֵֽחֻקַּי֙ וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַרְתֶּ֔ם שׁ֤וּבוּ אֵלַי֙ וְאָשׁ֣וּבָה אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּמֶּ֥ה נָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.translit: lmymy 'btykhm srtm mchqy vl' shmrtm shvbv 'ly v'shvbh 'lykhm 'mr yhvh tsb'vt v'mrtm bmh nshvb
verses.translation: From the days of your fathers ye have turned aside from Mine ordinances, and have not kept them. Return unto Me, and I will return unto you, Saith the LORD of hosts. But ye say: ‘Wherein shall we return?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲיִקְבַּ֨ע אָדָ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ קֹבְעִ֣ים אֹתִ֔י וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּמֶּ֣ה קְבַֽעֲנ֑וּךָ הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֖ר וְהַתְּרוּמָֽה׃
verses.translit: hyqb' 'dm 'lhym khy 'tm qb'ym 'ty v'mrtm bmh qb'nvkh hm'shr vhtrvmh
verses.translation: Will a man rob God? Yet ye rob Me. But ye say: ‘Wherein have we robbed Thee?’ In tithes and heave-offerings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּמְּאֵרָה֙ אַתֶּ֣ם נֵֽאָרִ֔ים וְאֹתִ֖י אַתֶּ֣ם קֹבְעִ֑ים הַגּ֖וֹי כֻּלּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: bm'rh 'tm n'rym v'ty 'tm qb'ym hgvy khlv
verses.translation: Ye are cursed with the curse, Yet ye rob Me, Even this whole nation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־כׇּל־הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֜ר אֶל־בֵּ֣ית הָאוֹצָ֗ר וִיהִ֥י טֶ֙רֶף֙ בְּבֵיתִ֔י וּבְחָנ֤וּנִי נָא֙ בָּזֹ֔את אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם־לֹ֧א אֶפְתַּ֣ח לָכֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲרֻבּ֣וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַהֲרִיקֹתִ֥י לָכֶ֛ם בְּרָכָ֖ה עַד־בְּלִי־דָֽי׃
verses.translit: hby'v 'tkhlhm'shr 'lbyt h'vtsr vyhy trf bbyty vbchnvny n' bz't 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'ml' 'ptch lkhm 't 'rbvt hshmym vhryqty lkhm brkhh 'dblydy
verses.translation: Bring ye the whole tithe into the store-house, that there may be food in My house, and try Me now herewith, Saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall be more than sufficiency. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְגָעַרְתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ בָּֽאֹכֵ֔ל וְלֹא־יַשְׁחִ֥ת לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־פְּרִ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וְלֹא־תְשַׁכֵּ֨ל לָכֶ֤ם הַגֶּ֙פֶן֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: vg'rty lkhm b'khl vl'yshcht lkhm 'tpry h'dmh vl'tshkhl lkhm hgpn bshdh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: And I will rebuke the devourer for your good, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your land; Neither shall your vine cast its fruit before the time in the field, Saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאִשְּׁר֥וּ אֶתְכֶ֖ם כׇּל־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם כִּֽי־תִהְי֤וּ אַתֶּם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֵ֔פֶץ אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'shrv 'tkhm khlhgvym khythyv 'tm 'rts chpts 'mr yhvh tsb'vt {p}
verses.translation: And all nations shall call you happy; For ye shall be a delightsome land, Saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָזְק֥וּ עָלַ֛י דִּבְרֵיכֶ֖ם אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם מַה־נִּדְבַּ֖רְנוּ עָלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: chzqv 'ly dbrykhm 'mr yhvh v'mrtm mhndbrnv 'lykh
verses.translation: Your words have been all too strong against Me, Saith the LORD. Yet ye say: ‘Wherein have we spoken against thee?’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם שָׁ֖וְא עֲבֹ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּמַה־בֶּ֗צַע כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֙רְנוּ֙ מִשְׁמַרְתּ֔וֹ וְכִ֤י הָלַ֙כְנוּ֙ קְדֹ֣רַנִּ֔ית מִפְּנֵ֖י יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: 'mrtm shv' 'bd 'lhym vmhbts' khy shmrnv mshmrtv vkhy hlkhnv qdrnyt mpny yhvh tsb'vt
verses.translation: Ye have said: ‘It is vain to serve God; and what profit is it that we have kept His charge, and that we have walked mournfully because of the LORD of hosts?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה אֲנַ֖חְנוּ מְאַשְּׁרִ֣ים זֵדִ֑ים גַּם־נִבְנוּ֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י רִשְׁעָ֔ה גַּ֧ם בָּחֲנ֛וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַיִּמָּלֵֽטוּ׃
verses.translit: v'th 'nchnv m'shrym zdym gmnbnv 'shy rsh'h gm bchnv 'lhym vymltv
verses.translation: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are built up; yea, they try God, and are delivered.’
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֧ז נִדְבְּר֛וּ יִרְאֵ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַיַּקְשֵׁ֤ב יְהֹוָה֙ וַיִּשְׁמָ֔ע וַ֠יִּכָּתֵ֠ב סֵ֣פֶר זִכָּר֤וֹן לְפָנָיו֙ לְיִרְאֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֔ה וּלְחֹשְׁבֵ֖י שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'z ndbrv yr'y yhvh 'ysh 'lr'hv vyqshb yhvh vyshm' vykhtb spr zkhrvn lpnyv lyr'y yhvh vlchshby shmv
verses.translation: Then they that feared the LORD Spoke one with another; and the LORD hearkened, and heard, and a book of remembrance was written before Him, for them that feared the LORD, and that thought upon His name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהָ֣יוּ לִ֗י אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לַיּ֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֣ה סְגֻלָּ֑ה וְחָמַלְתִּ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ יַחְמֹ֣ל אִ֔ישׁ עַל־בְּנ֖וֹ הָעֹבֵ֥ד אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vhyv ly 'mr yhvh tsb'vt lyvm 'shr 'ny 'shh sglh vchmlty 'lyhm kh'shr ychml 'ysh 'lbnv h'bd 'tv
verses.translation: And they shall be Mine, saith the LORD of hosts, in the day that I do make, even Mine own treasure; and I will spare them, as a man spareth His own son that serveth him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתֶּם֙ וּרְאִיתֶ֔ם בֵּ֥ין צַדִּ֖יק לְרָשָׁ֑ע בֵּ֚ין עֹבֵ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֔ים לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א עֲבָדֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: vshbtm vr'ytm byn tsdyq lrsh' byn 'bd 'lhym l'shr l' 'bdv {p}
verses.translation: Then shall ye again discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth Him not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִנֵּ֤ה הַיּוֹם֙ בָּ֔א בֹּעֵ֖ר כַּתַּנּ֑וּר וְהָי֨וּ כׇל־זֵדִ֜ים וְכׇל־עֹשֵׂ֤ה רִשְׁעָה֙ קַ֔שׁ וְלִהַ֨ט אֹתָ֜ם הַיּ֣וֹם הַבָּ֗א אָמַר֙ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־יַעֲזֹ֥ב לָהֶ֖ם שֹׁ֥רֶשׁ וְעָנָֽף׃
verses.translit: khyhnh hyvm b' b'r khtnvr vhyv khlzdym vkhl'shh rsh'h qsh vlht 'tm hyvm hb' 'mr yhvh tsb'vt 'shr l'y'zb lhm shrsh v'nf
verses.translation: For, behold, the day cometh, It burneth as a furnace; and all the proud, and all that work wickedness, shall be stubble; and the day that cometh shall set them ablaze, Saith the LORD of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְזָרְחָ֨ה לָכֶ֜ם יִרְאֵ֤י שְׁמִי֙ שֶׁ֣מֶשׁ צְדָקָ֔ה וּמַרְפֵּ֖א בִּכְנָפֶ֑יהָ וִיצָאתֶ֥ם וּפִשְׁתֶּ֖ם כְּעֶגְלֵ֥י מַרְבֵּֽק׃
verses.translit: vzrchh lkhm yr'y shmy shmsh tsdqh vmrp' bkhnpyh vyts'tm vpshtm kh'gly mrbq
verses.translation: But unto you that fear My name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings; and ye shall go forth, and gambol as calves of the stall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַסּוֹתֶ֣ם רְשָׁעִ֔ים כִּֽי־יִהְי֣וּ אֵ֔פֶר תַּ֖חַת כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלֵיכֶ֑ם בַּיּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנִ֣י עֹשֶׂ֔ה אָמַ֖ר יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'svtm rsh'ym khyyhyv 'pr tcht khpvt rglykhm byvm 'shr 'ny 'shh 'mr yhvh tsb'vt {p}
verses.translation: And ye shall tread down the wicked; for they shall be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I do make, Saith the LORD of hosts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִכְר֕וּ תּוֹרַ֖ת מֹשֶׁ֣ה עַבְדִּ֑י אֲשֶׁר֩ צִוִּ֨יתִי אוֹת֤וֹ בְחֹרֵב֙ עַל־כׇּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חֻקִּ֖ים וּמִשְׁפָּטִֽים׃
verses.translit: zkhrv tvrt mshh 'bdy 'shr tsvyty 'vtv bchrb 'lkhlyshr'l chqym vmshptym
verses.translation: Remember ye the law of Moses My servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ שֹׁלֵ֣חַ לָכֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת אֵלִיָּ֣ה הַנָּבִ֑יא לִפְנֵ֗י בּ֚וֹא י֣וֹם יְהֹוָ֔ה הַגָּד֖וֹל וְהַנּוֹרָֽא׃
verses.translit: hnh 'nkhy shlch lkhm 't 'lyh hnby' lpny bv' yvm yhvh hgdvl vhnvr'
verses.translation: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet Before the coming Of the great and terrible day of the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְהֵשִׁ֤יב לֵב־אָבוֹת֙ עַל־בָּנִ֔ים וְלֵ֥ב בָּנִ֖ים עַל־אֲבוֹתָ֑ם פֶּן־אָב֕וֹא וְהִכֵּיתִ֥י אֶת־הָאָ֖רֶץ חֵֽרֶם׃
verses.translit: vhshyb lb'bvt 'lbnym vlb bnym 'l'bvtm pn'bv' vhkhyty 'th'rts chrm
verses.translation: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers; lest I come and smite the land with utter destruction. [Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and terrible day of the LORD.]
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי־הָאִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר  לֹ֥א הָלַךְ֮ בַּעֲצַ֢ת רְשָׁ֫עִ֥ים וּבְדֶ֣רֶךְ חַ֭טָּאִים לֹ֥א עָמָ֑ד וּבְמוֹשַׁ֥ב לֵ֝צִ֗ים לֹ֣א יָשָֽׁב׃
verses.translit: 'shryh'ysh 'shr  l' hlkh b'tst rsh'ym vbdrkh cht'ym l' 'md vbmvshb ltsym l' yshb
verses.translation: HAPPY IS the man that hath not walked in the counsel of the wicked, Nor stood in the way of sinners, nor sat in the seat of the scornful.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אִ֥ם־בְּתוֹרַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֗ה חֶ֫פְצ֥וֹ וּֽבְתוֹרָת֥וֹ יֶהְגֶּ֗ה יוֹמָ֥ם וָלָֽיְלָה׃
verses.translit: khy 'mbtvrt yhvh chptsv vbtvrtv yhgh yvmm vlylh
verses.translation: But his delight is in the law of the LORD; and in His law doth he meditate day and night.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽהָיָ֗ה כְּעֵץ֮ שָׁת֢וּל עַֽל־פַּלְגֵ֫י־מָ֥יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר פִּרְי֨וֹ  יִתֵּ֬ן בְּעִתּ֗וֹ וְעָלֵ֥הוּ לֹֽא־יִבּ֑וֹל וְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁר־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יַצְלִֽיחַ׃
verses.translit: vhyh kh'ts shtvl 'lplgymym 'shr pryv  ytn b'tv v'lhv l'ybvl vkhl 'shry'shh ytslych
verses.translation: And he shall be like a tree planted by streams of water, that bringeth forth its fruit in its season, and whose leaf doth not wither; and in whatsoever he doeth he shall prosper.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹא־כֵ֥ן הָרְשָׁעִ֑ים כִּ֥י אִם־כַּ֝מֹּ֗ץ אֲֽשֶׁר־תִּדְּפֶ֥נּוּ רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: l'khn hrsh'ym khy 'mkhmts 'shrtdpnv rvch
verses.translation: Not so the wicked; but they are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֤ן  לֹא־יָקֻ֣מוּ רְ֭שָׁעִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ֝חַטָּאִ֗ים בַּעֲדַ֥ת צַדִּיקִֽים׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn  l'yqmv rsh'ym bmshpt vcht'ym b'dt tsdyqym
verses.translation: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הֹוָה דֶּ֣רֶךְ צַדִּיקִ֑ים וְדֶ֖רֶךְ רְשָׁעִ֣ים תֹּאבֵֽד׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khyyvd' yhvh drkh tsdyqym vdrkh rsh'ym t'bd {p}
verses.translation: For the LORD regardeth the way of the righteous; but the way of the wicked shall perish.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָ֭מָּה רָגְשׁ֣וּ גוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְאֻמִּ֗ים יֶהְגּוּ־רִֽיק׃
verses.translit: lmh rgshv gvym vl'mym yhgvryq
verses.translation: Why are the nations in an uproar? And why do the peoples mutter in vain?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֥תְיַצְּב֨וּ  מַלְכֵי־אֶ֗רֶץ וְרוֹזְנִ֥ים נֽוֹסְדוּ־יָ֑חַד עַל־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה וְעַל־מְשִׁיחֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ytytsbv  mlkhy'rts vrvznym nvsdvychd 'lyhvh v'lmshychv
verses.translation: The kings of the earth stand up, And the rulers take counsel together, Against the LORD, and against His anointed:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְֽ֭נַתְּקָה אֶת־מֽוֹסְרוֹתֵ֑ימוֹ וְנַשְׁלִ֖יכָה מִמֶּ֣נּוּ עֲבֹתֵֽימוֹ׃
verses.translit: nntqh 'tmvsrvtymv vnshlykhh mmnv 'btymv
verses.translation: 'Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בַּשָּׁמַ֣יִם יִשְׂחָ֑ק אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י יִלְעַג־לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: yvshb bshmym yshchq 'dny yl'glmv
verses.translation: He that sitteth in heaven laugheth, the Lord hath them in derision.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָ֤ז יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֣ימוֹ בְאַפּ֑וֹ וּֽבַחֲרוֹנ֥וֹ יְבַהֲלֵֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'z ydbr 'lymv b'pv vbchrvnv ybhlmv
verses.translation: Then will He speak unto them in His wrath, and affright them in His sore displeasure:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭אֲנִי נָסַ֣כְתִּי מַלְכִּ֑י עַל־צִ֝יּ֗וֹן הַר־קׇדְשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: v'ny nskhty mlkhy 'ltsyvn hrqdshy
verses.translation: 'Truly it is I that have established My king upon Zion, My holy mountain.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה אֶֽ֫ל־חֹ֥ק יְֽהֹוָ֗ה אָמַ֘ר־אֵלַ֥י בְּנִ֥י אַ֑תָּה אֲ֝נִ֗י הַיּ֥וֹם יְלִדְתִּֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'sprh 'lchq yhvh 'mr'ly bny 'th 'ny hyvm yldtykh
verses.translation: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said unto me: 'Thou art My son, this day have I begotten thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁאַ֤ל מִמֶּ֗נִּי וְאֶתְּנָ֣ה ג֭וֹיִם נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וַ֝אֲחֻזָּתְךָ֗ אַפְסֵי־אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: sh'l mmny v'tnh gvym nchltkh v'chztkh 'psy'rts
verses.translation: Ask of Me, and I will give the nations for thine inheritance, and the ends of the earth for thy possession.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּ֭רֹעֵם בְּשֵׁ֣בֶט בַּרְזֶ֑ל כִּכְלִ֖י יוֹצֵ֣ר תְּנַפְּצֵֽם׃
verses.translit: tr'm bshbt brzl khkhly yvtsr tnptsm
verses.translation: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭עַתָּה מְלָכִ֣ים הַשְׂכִּ֑ילוּ הִ֝וָּסְר֗וּ שֹׁ֣פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: v'th mlkhym hshkhylv hvsrv shpty 'rts
verses.translation: Now therefore, O ye kings, be wise; be admonished, ye judges of the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּיִרְאָ֑ה וְ֝גִ֗ילוּ בִּרְעָדָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'bdv 'tyhvh byr'h vgylv br'dh
verses.translation: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַשְּׁקוּ־בַ֡ר פֶּן־יֶאֱנַ֤ף  וְתֹ֬אבְדוּ דֶ֗רֶךְ כִּֽי־יִבְעַ֣ר כִּמְעַ֣ט אַפּ֑וֹ אַ֝שְׁרֵ֗י כׇּל־ח֥וֹסֵי בֽוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: nshqvbr pny'nf  vt'bdv drkh khyyb'r khm't 'pv 'shry khlchvsy bv {p}
verses.translation: Do homage in purity, lest He be angry, and ye perish in the way, when suddenly His wrath is kindled. Happy are all they that take refuge in Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בְּ֝בׇרְח֗וֹ מִפְּנֵ֤י  אַבְשָׁל֬וֹם בְּנֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd bbrchv mpny  'bshlvm bnv
verses.translation: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְ֭הֹוָה מָה־רַבּ֣וּ צָרָ֑י רַ֝בִּ֗ים קָמִ֥ים עָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: yhvh mhrbv tsry rbym qmym 'ly
verses.translation: LORD, how many are mine adversaries become! Many are they that rise up against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַבִּים֮ אֹמְרִ֢ים לְנַ֫פְשִׁ֥י אֵ֤ין יְֽשׁוּעָ֓תָה לּ֬וֹ בֵאלֹהִ֬ים סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: rbym 'mrym lnpshy 'yn yshv'th lv b'lhym slh
verses.translation: Many there are that say of my soul: 'There is no salvation for him in God.' Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה מָגֵ֣ן בַּעֲדִ֑י כְּ֝בוֹדִ֗י וּמֵרִ֥ים רֹאשִֽׁי׃
verses.translit: v'th yhvh mgn b'dy khbvdy vmrym r'shy
verses.translation: But thou, O LORD, art a shield about me; My glory, and the lifter up of my head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֭וֹלִי אֶל־יְהֹוָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א וַיַּעֲנֵ֨נִי מֵהַ֖ר קׇדְשׁ֣וֹ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: qvly 'lyhvh 'qr' vy'nny mhr qdshv slh
verses.translation: With my voice I call unto the LORD, and He answereth me out of His holy mountain. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֥י שָׁכַ֗בְתִּי וָאִ֫ישָׁ֥נָה הֱקִיצ֑וֹתִי כִּ֖י יְהֹוָ֣ה יִסְמְכֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: 'ny shkhbty v'yshnh hqytsvty khy yhvh ysmkhny
verses.translation: I lay me down, and I sleep; I awake, for the LORD sustaineth me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־אִ֭ירָא מֵרִבְב֥וֹת עָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סָ֝בִ֗יב שָׁ֣תוּ עָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: l''yr' mrbbvt 'm 'shr sbyb shtv 'ly
verses.translation: I am not afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהֹוָ֨ה  הוֹשִׁ֘יעֵ֤נִי אֱלֹהַ֗י כִּֽי־הִכִּ֣יתָ אֶת־כׇּל־אֹיְבַ֣י לֶ֑חִי שִׁנֵּ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים שִׁבַּֽרְתָּ׃
verses.translit: qvmh yhvh  hvshy'ny 'lhy khyhkhyt 'tkhl'yby lchy shny rsh'ym shbrt
verses.translation: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God; for Thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek, Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַֽיהֹוָ֥ה הַיְשׁוּעָ֑ה עַֽל־עַמְּךָ֖ בִרְכָתֶ֣ךָ סֶּֽלָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lyhvh hyshv'h 'l'mkh brkhtkh slh {p}
verses.translation: Salvation belongeth unto the LORD; Thy blessing be upon Thy people. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינ֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translit: lmntsch bngynvt mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּקׇרְאִ֡י עֲנֵ֤נִי  אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צִדְקִ֗י בַּ֭צָּר הִרְחַ֣בְתָּ לִּ֑י חׇ֝נֵּ֗נִי וּשְׁמַ֥ע תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
verses.translit: bqr'y 'nny  'lhy tsdqy btsr hrchbt ly chnny vshm' tplty
verses.translation: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness, Thou who didst set me free when I was in distress; be gracious unto me, and hear my prayer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י אִ֡ישׁ עַד־מֶ֬ה כְבוֹדִ֣י לִ֭כְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָב֣וּן רִ֑יק תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ כָזָ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: bny 'ysh 'dmh khbvdy lkhlmh t'hbvn ryq tbqshv khzb slh
verses.translation: O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be put to shame, in that ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וּדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־הִפְלָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה חָסִ֣יד ל֑וֹ יְהֹוָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע בְּקׇרְאִ֥י אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vd'v khyhplh yhvh chsyd lv yhvh yshm' bqr'y 'lyv
verses.translation: But know that the LORD hath set apart the godly man as His own; The LORD will hear when I call unto Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רִגְז֗וּ וְֽאַל־תֶּ֫חֱטָ֥אוּ אִמְר֣וּ בִ֭לְבַבְכֶם עַֽל־מִשְׁכַּבְכֶ֗ם וְדֹ֣מּוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: rgzv v'ltcht'v 'mrv blbbkhm 'lmshkhbkhm vdmv slh
verses.translation: Tremble, and sin not; commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זִבְח֥וּ זִבְחֵי־צֶ֑דֶק וּ֝בִטְח֗וּ אֶל־יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: zbchv zbchytsdq vbtchv 'lyhvh
verses.translation: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַבִּ֥ים אֹמְרִים֮ מִֽי־יַרְאֵ֢נ֫וּ ט֥וֹב נְֽסָה־עָ֭לֵינוּ א֨וֹר פָּנֶ֬יךָ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: rbym 'mrym myyr'nv tvb nsh'lynv 'vr pnykh yhvh
verses.translation: Many there are that say: 'Oh that we could see some good!' LORD, lift Thou up the light of Thy countenance upon us.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נָתַ֣תָּה שִׂמְחָ֣ה בְלִבִּ֑י מֵעֵ֬ת דְּגָנָ֖ם וְתִירוֹשָׁ֣ם רָֽבּוּ׃
verses.translit: ntth shmchh blby m't dgnm vtyrvshm rbv
verses.translation: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than when their corn and their wine increase.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשָׁל֣וֹם יַחְדָּו֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֢ה וְאִ֫ישָׁ֥ן כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהֹוָ֣ה לְבָדָ֑ד לָ֝בֶ֗טַח תּוֹשִׁיבֵֽנִי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: bshlvm ychdv 'shkhbh v'yshn khy'th yhvh lbdd lbtch tvshybny {p}
verses.translation: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; for Thou, LORD, makest me dwell alone in safety.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ אֶֽל־הַנְּחִיל֗וֹת מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translit: lmntsch 'lhnchylvt mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: For the Leader; upon the Nehiloth. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲמָרַ֖י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה ׀ יְהֹוָ֗ה בִּ֣ינָה הֲגִיגִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'mry h'zynh  yhvh bynh hgygy
verses.translation: Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה  לְק֬וֹל שַׁוְעִ֗י מַלְכִּ֥י וֵאלֹהָ֑י כִּֽי־אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ אֶתְפַּלָּֽל׃
verses.translit: hqshybh  lqvl shv'y mlkhy v'lhy khy'lykh 'tpll
verses.translation: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God; For unto Thee do I pray.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה בֹּ֭קֶר תִּשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלִ֑י בֹּ֥קֶר אֶעֱרׇךְ־לְ֝ךָ֗ וַאֲצַפֶּֽה׃
verses.translit: yhvh bqr tshm' qvly bqr ''rkhlkh v'tsph
verses.translation: O LORD, in the morning shalt Thou hear my voice; In the morning will I order my prayer unto Thee, and will look forward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י  לֹ֤א אֵֽל־חָפֵ֘ץ־רֶ֥שַׁע ׀ אָ֑תָּה לֹ֖א יְגֻרְךָ֣ רָֽע׃
verses.translit: khy  l' 'lchptsrsh'  'th l' ygrkh r'
verses.translation: For Thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness; Evil shall not sojourn with Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־יִתְיַצְּב֣וּ ה֭וֹלְלִים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׂ֝נֵ֗אתָ כׇּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: l'ytytsbv hvllym lngd 'ynykh shn't khlp'ly 'vn
verses.translation: The boasters shall not stand in Thy sight; Thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּאַבֵּד֮ דֹּבְרֵ֢י כָ֫זָ֥ב אִישׁ־דָּמִ֥ים וּמִרְמָ֗ה יְתָ֘עֵ֥ב ׀ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: t'bd dbry khzb 'yshdmym vmrmh yt'b  yhvh
verses.translation: Thou destroyest them that speak falsehood; The LORD abhorreth the man of blood and of deceit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּרֹ֣ב חַ֭סְדְּךָ אָב֣וֹא בֵיתֶ֑ךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה אֶל־הֵֽיכַל־קׇ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: v'ny brb chsdkh 'bv' bytkh 'shtchvh 'lhykhlqdshkh byr'tkh
verses.translation: But as for me, in the abundance of Thy lovingkindness will I come into Thy house; I will bow down toward Thy holy temple in the fear of Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֤ה  נְחֵ֬נִי בְצִדְקָתֶ֗ךָ לְמַ֥עַן שׁוֹרְרָ֑י (הושר) [הַיְשַׁ֖ר] לְפָנַ֣י דַּרְכֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: yhvh  nchny btsdqtkh lm'n shvrry (hvshr) [hyshr] lpny drkhkh
verses.translation: O LORD, lead me in Thy righteousness because of them that lie in wait for me; Make Thy way straight before my face.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֪ין בְּפִ֡יהוּ נְכוֹנָה֮ קִרְבָּ֢ם הַ֫וּ֥וֹת קֶֽבֶר־פָּת֥וּחַ גְּרֹנָ֑ם לְ֝שׁוֹנָ֗ם יַחֲלִיקֽוּן׃
verses.translit: khy 'yn bpyhv nkhvnh qrbm hvvt qbrptvch grnm lshvnm ychlyqvn
verses.translation: For there is no sincerity in their mouth; Their inward part is a yawning gulf, Their throat is an open sepulchre; They make smooth their tongue.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַ֥אֲשִׁימֵ֨ם  אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים יִפְּלוּ֮ מִֽמֹּעֲצ֢וֹתֵ֫יהֶ֥ם בְּרֹ֣ב פִּ֭שְׁעֵיהֶם הַדִּיחֵ֑מוֹ כִּי־מָ֥רוּ בָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: h'shymm  'lhym yplv mm'tsvtyhm brb psh'yhm hdychmv khymrv bkh
verses.translation: Hold them guilty, O God, Let them fall by their own counsels; Cast them down in the multitude of their transgressions; For they have rebelled against Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ כׇל־ח֪וֹסֵי בָ֡ךְ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יְ֭רַנֵּנוּ וְתָסֵ֣ךְ עָלֵ֑ימוֹ וְֽיַעְלְצ֥וּ בְ֝ךָ֗ אֹהֲבֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vyshmchv khlchvsy bkh l'vlm yrnnv vtskh 'lymv vy'ltsv bkh 'hby shmkh
verses.translation: So shall all those that take refuge in Thee rejoice, They shall ever shout for joy, And Thou shalt shelter them; Let them also that love Thy name exult in Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַתָּה֮ תְּבָרֵ֢ךְ צַ֫דִּ֥יק יְהֹוָ֑ה כַּ֝צִּנָּ֗ה רָצ֥וֹן תַּעְטְרֶֽנּוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khy'th tbrkh tsdyq yhvh khtsnh rtsvn t'trnv {p}
verses.translation: For Thou dost bless the righteous; O LORD, Thou dost encompass him with favour as with a shield.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ בִּ֭נְגִינוֹת עַֽל־הַשְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translit: lmntsch bngynvt 'lhshmynyt mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: For the Leader; with string-music; on the Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה אַל־בְּאַפְּךָ֥ תוֹכִיחֵ֑נִי וְֽאַל־בַּחֲמָתְךָ֥ תְיַסְּרֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lb'pkh tvkhychny v'lbchmtkh tysrny
verses.translation: O LORD, rebuke me not in Thine anger, Neither chasten me in Thy wrath.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חׇנֵּ֥נִי יְהֹוָה֮ כִּ֤י אֻמְלַ֫ל־אָ֥נִי רְפָאֵ֥נִי יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֖י נִבְהֲל֣וּ עֲצָמָֽי׃
verses.translit: chnny yhvh khy 'mll'ny rp'ny yhvh khy nbhlv 'tsmy
verses.translation: Be gracious unto me, O LORD, for I languish away; Heal me, O LORD, for my bones are affrighted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭נַפְשִׁי נִבְהֲלָ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד (ואת) [וְאַתָּ֥ה] יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה עַד־מָתָֽי׃
verses.translit: vnpshy nbhlh m'd (v't) [v'th] yhvh 'dmty
verses.translation: My soul also is sore affrighted; And Thou, O LORD, how long?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׁוּבָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה חַלְּצָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י ה֝וֹשִׁיעֵ֗נִי לְמַ֣עַן חַסְדֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: shvbh yhvh chltsh npshy hvshy'ny lm'n chsdkh
verses.translation: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul; Save me for Thy mercy's sake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין בַּמָּ֣וֶת זִכְרֶ֑ךָ בִּ֝שְׁא֗וֹל מִ֣י יֽוֹדֶה־לָּֽךְ׃
verses.translit: khy 'yn bmvt zkhrkh bsh'vl my yvdhlkh
verses.translation: For in death there is no remembrance of Thee; In the nether-world who will give Thee thanks?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָגַ֤עְתִּי  בְּֽאַנְחָתִ֗י אַשְׂחֶ֣ה בְכׇל־לַ֭יְלָה מִטָּתִ֑י בְּ֝דִמְעָתִ֗י עַרְשִׂ֥י אַמְסֶֽה׃
verses.translit: yg'ty  b'nchty 'shchh bkhllylh mtty bdm'ty 'rshy 'msh
verses.translation: I am weary with my groaning; Every night make I my bed to swim; I melt away my couch with my tears.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָשְׁשָׁ֣ה מִכַּ֣עַס עֵינִ֑י עָ֝תְקָ֗ה בְּכׇל־צוֹרְרָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'shshh mkh's 'yny 'tqh bkhltsvrry
verses.translation: Mine eye is dimmed because of vexation; It waxeth old because of all mine adversaries.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ס֣וּרוּ מִ֭מֶּנִּי כׇּל־פֹּ֣עֲלֵי אָ֑וֶן כִּֽי־שָׁמַ֥ע יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל בִּכְיִֽי׃
verses.translit: svrv mmny khlp'ly 'vn khyshm' yhvh qvl bkhyy
verses.translation: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; For the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁמַ֣ע יְ֭הֹוָה תְּחִנָּתִ֑י יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה תְּֽפִלָּתִ֥י יִקָּֽח׃
verses.translit: shm' yhvh tchnty yhvh tplty yqch
verses.translation: The LORD hath heard my supplication; The LORD receiveth my prayer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵבֹ֤שׁוּ  וְיִבָּהֲל֣וּ מְ֭אֹד כׇּל־אֹיְבָ֑י יָ֝שֻׁ֗בוּ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רָֽגַע׃ {פ}
verses.translit: ybshv  vybhlv m'd khl'yby yshbv ybshv rg' {p}
verses.translation: All mine enemies shall be ashamed and sore affrighted; They shall turn back, they shall be ashamed suddenly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁגָּי֗וֹן לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־שָׁ֥ר לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה עַל־דִּבְרֵי־כ֝֗וּשׁ בֶּן־יְמִינִֽי׃
verses.translit: shgyvn ldvd 'shrshr lyhvh 'ldbrykhvsh bnymyny
verses.translation: Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the LORD, concerning Cush a Benjamite.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּךָ֣ חָסִ֑יתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי מִכׇּל־רֹ֝דְפַ֗י וְהַצִּילֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy bkh chsyty hvshy'ny mkhlrdpy vhtsylny
verses.translation: O LORD my God, in Thee have I taken refuge; Save me from all them that pursue me, and deliver me;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּן־יִטְרֹ֣ף כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י פֹּ֝רֵ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: pnytrf kh'ryh npshy prq v'yn mtsyl
verses.translation: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, Rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי אִם־עָשִׂ֣יתִי זֹ֑את אִֽם־יֶשׁ־עָ֥וֶל בְּכַפָּֽי׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy 'm'shyty z't 'mysh'vl bkhpy
verses.translation: O LORD my God, if I have done this; If there be iniquity in my hands;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־גָּ֭מַלְתִּי שֽׁוֹלְמִ֥י רָ֑ע וָאֲחַלְּצָ֖ה צֽוֹרְרִ֣י רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mgmlty shvlmy r' v'chltsh tsvrry ryqm
verses.translation: If I have requited him that did evil unto me, Or spoiled mine adversary unto emptiness;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֥רַדֹּֽף־אוֹיֵ֨ב  נַפְשִׁ֡י וְיַשֵּׂ֗ג וְיִרְמֹ֣ס לָאָ֣רֶץ חַיָּ֑י וּכְבוֹדִ֓י  לֶעָפָ֖ר יַשְׁכֵּ֣ן סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: yrdf'vyb  npshy vyshg vyrms l'rts chyy vkhbvdy  l'pr yshkhn slh
verses.translation: Let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it, And tread my life down to the earth; Yea, let him lay my glory in the dust. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהֹוָ֨ה  בְּאַפֶּ֗ךָ הִ֭נָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְר֣וֹת צוֹרְרָ֑י וְע֥וּרָה אֵ֝לַ֗י מִשְׁפָּ֥ט צִוִּֽיתָ׃
verses.translit: qvmh yhvh  b'pkh hnsh' b'brvt tsvrry v'vrh 'ly mshpt tsvyt
verses.translation: Arise, O LORD, in Thine anger, Lift up Thyself in indignation against mine adversaries; Yea, awake for me at the judgment which Thou hast commanded.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַעֲדַ֣ת לְ֭אֻמִּים תְּסֽוֹבְבֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ לַמָּר֥וֹם שֽׁוּבָה׃
verses.translit: v'dt l'mym tsvbbkh v'lyh lmrvm shvbh
verses.translation: And let the congregation of the peoples compass Thee about, And over them return Thou on high.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָה֮ יָדִ֢ין עַ֫מִּ֥ים שׇׁפְטֵ֥נִי יְהֹוָ֑ה כְּצִדְקִ֖י וּכְתֻמִּ֣י עָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: yhvh ydyn 'mym shptny yhvh khtsdqy vkhtmy 'ly
verses.translation: O LORD, who ministerest judgment to the peoples, Judge me, O LORD, According to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִגְמׇר־נָ֬א רַ֨ע  רְשָׁעִים֮ וּתְכוֹנֵ֢ן צַ֫דִּ֥יק וּבֹחֵ֣ן לִ֭בּוֹת וּכְלָי֗וֹת אֱלֹהִ֥ים צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.translit: ygmrn' r'  rsh'ym vtkhvnn tsdyq vbchn lbvt vkhlyvt 'lhym tsdyq
verses.translation: Oh that a full measure of evil might come upon the wicked, And that Thou wouldest establish the righteous; For the righteous God trieth the heart and reins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָגִנִּ֥י עַל־אֱלֹהִ֑ים מ֝וֹשִׁ֗יעַ יִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: mgny 'l'lhym mvshy' yshrylb
verses.translation: My shield is with God, Who saveth the upright in heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱ֭לֹהִים שׁוֹפֵ֣ט צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝אֵ֗ל זֹעֵ֥ם בְּכׇל־יֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: 'lhym shvpt tsdyq v'l z'm bkhlyvm
verses.translation: God is a righteous judge, Yea, a God that hath indignation every day:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
