verses.original: אִם־לֹ֣א יָ֭שׁוּב חַרְבּ֣וֹ יִלְט֑וֹשׁ קַשְׁתּ֥וֹ דָ֝רַ֗ךְ וַֽיְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃
verses.translit: 'ml' yshvb chrbv yltvsh qshtv drkh vykhvnnh
verses.translation: If a man turn not, He will whet His sword, He hath bent His bow, and made it ready;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְ֭לוֹ הֵכִ֣ין כְּלֵי־מָ֑וֶת חִ֝צָּ֗יו לְֽדֹלְקִ֥ים יִפְעָֽל׃
verses.translit: vlv hkhyn khlymvt chtsyv ldlqym yp'l
verses.translation: He hath also prepared for him the weapons of death, Yea, His arrows which He made sharp.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה יְחַבֶּל־אָ֑וֶן וְהָרָ֥ה עָ֝מָ֗ל וְיָ֣לַד שָֽׁקֶר׃
verses.translit: hnh ychbl'vn vhrh 'ml vyld shqr
verses.translation: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity; Yea, he conceiveth mischief, and bringeth forth falsehood.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בּ֣וֹר כָּ֭רָה וַֽיַּחְפְּרֵ֑הוּ וַ֝יִּפֹּ֗ל בְּשַׁ֣חַת יִפְעָֽל׃
verses.translit: bvr khrh vychprhv vypl bshcht yp'l
verses.translation: He hath digged a pit, and hollowed it, And is fallen into the ditch which he made.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּב עֲמָל֣וֹ בְרֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְעַ֥ל קׇ֝דְקֳד֗וֹ חֲמָס֥וֹ יֵרֵֽד׃
verses.translit: yshvb 'mlv br'shv v'l qdqdv chmsv yrd
verses.translation: His mischief shall return upon his own head, And his violence shall come down upon his own pate.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹדֶ֣ה יְהֹוָ֣ה כְּצִדְק֑וֹ וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה שֵֽׁם־יְהֹוָ֥ה עֶלְיֽוֹן׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'vdh yhvh khtsdqv v'zmrh shmyhvh 'lyvn {p}
verses.translation: I will give thanks unto the LORD according to His righteousness; And will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־הַגִּתִּ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translit: lmntsch 'lhgtyt mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: For the Leader; upon the Gittith. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֤ה אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מָה־אַדִּ֣יר שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכׇל־הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּנָ֥ה ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ עַל־הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'dnynv mh'dyr shmkh bkhlh'rts 'shr tnh hvdkh 'lhshmym
verses.translation: O LORD, our Lord, How glorious is Thy name in all the earth! Whose majesty is rehearsed above the heavens.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִפִּ֤י עוֹלְלִ֨ים  וְֽיֹנְקִים֮ יִסַּ֢דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צוֹרְרֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁבִּ֥ית א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: mpy 'vllym  vynqym ysdt 'z lm'n tsvrrykh lhshbyt 'vyb vmtnqm
verses.translation: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast Thou founded strength, Because of Thine adversaries; That Thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אֶרְאֶ֣ה שָׁ֭מֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ יָרֵ֥חַ וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כּוֹנָֽנְתָּה׃
verses.translit: khy'r'h shmykh m'shh 'tsb'tykh yrch vkhvkhbym 'shr khvnnth
verses.translation: When I behold Thy heavens, the work of Thy fingers, The moon and the stars, which Thou hast established;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מָה־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־תִזְכְּרֶ֑נּוּ וּבֶן־אָ֝דָ֗ם כִּ֣י תִפְקְדֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: mh'nvsh khytzkhrnv vbn'dm khy tpqdnv
verses.translation: What is man, that Thou art mindful of him? And the son of man, that Thou thinkest of him?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: vtchsrhv m't m'lhym vkhbvd vhdr t'trhv
verses.translation: Yet Thou hast made him but little lower than the angels, And hast crowned him with glory and honour.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּ֭מְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָדֶ֑יךָ כֹּ֝֗ל שַׁ֣תָּה תַֽחַת־רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: tmshylhv bm'shy ydykh khl shth tchtrglyv
verses.translation: Thou hast made him to have dominion over the works of Thy hands; Thou hast put all things under His feet:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צֹנֶ֣ה וַאֲלָפִ֣ים כֻּלָּ֑ם וְ֝גַ֗ם בַּהֲמ֥וֹת שָׂדָֽי׃
verses.translit: tsnh v'lpym khlm vgm bhmvt shdy
verses.translation: Sheep and oxen, all of them, Yea, and the beasts of the field;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צִפּ֣וֹר שָׁ֭מַיִם וּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם עֹ֝בֵ֗ר אׇרְח֥וֹת יַמִּֽים׃
verses.translit: tspvr shmym vdgy hym 'br 'rchvt ymym
verses.translation: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea; Whatsoever passeth through the paths of the seas.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֥ה אֲדֹנֵ֑ינוּ מָה־אַדִּ֥יר שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ בְּכׇל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yhvh 'dnynv mh'dyr shmkh bkhlh'rts {p}
verses.translation: O LORD, our Lord, How glorious is Thy name in all the earth!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל־מ֥וּת לַבֵּ֗ן מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translit: lmntsch 'lmvt lbn mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: For the Leader; upon Muthlabben. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אוֹדֶ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה בְּכׇל־לִבִּ֑י אֲ֝סַפְּרָ֗ה כׇּל־נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'vdh yhvh bkhllby 'sprh khlnpl'vtykh
verses.translation: I will give thanks unto the LORD with my whole heart; I will tell of all Thy marvellous works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶשְׂמְחָ֣ה וְאֶעֶלְצָ֣ה בָ֑ךְ אֲזַמְּרָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.translit: 'shmchh v''ltsh bkh 'zmrh shmkh 'lyvn
verses.translation: I will be glad and exult in Thee; I will sing praise to Thy name, O Most High:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּשׁוּב־אוֹיְבַ֥י אָח֑וֹר יִכָּשְׁל֥וּ וְ֝יֹאבְד֗וּ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: bshvb'vyby 'chvr ykhshlv vy'bdv mpnykh
verses.translation: When mine enemies are turned back, They stumble and perish at Thy presence;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־עָ֭שִׂיתָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י וְדִינִ֑י יָשַׁ֥בְתָּ לְ֝כִסֵּ֗א שׁוֹפֵ֥ט צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.translit: khy'shyt mshpty vdyny yshbt lkhs' shvpt tsdq
verses.translation: For Thou hast maintained my right and my cause; Thou sattest upon the throne as the righteous Judge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּעַ֣רְתָּ ג֭וֹיִם אִבַּ֣דְתָּ רָשָׁ֑ע שְׁמָ֥ם מָ֝חִ֗יתָ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.translit: g'rt gvym 'bdt rsh' shmm mchyt l'vlm v'd
verses.translation: Thou hast rebuked the nations, Thou hast destroyed the wicked, Thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָֽאוֹיֵ֨ב  תַּ֥מּוּ חֳרָב֗וֹת לָ֫נֶ֥צַח וְעָרִ֥ים נָתַ֑שְׁתָּ אָבַ֖ד זִכְרָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: h'vyb  tmv chrbvt lntsch v'rym ntsht 'bd zkhrm hmh
verses.translation: O thou enemy, the waste places are come to an end for ever; And the cities which thou didst uproot, Their very memorial is perished.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַֽ֭יהֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם יֵשֵׁ֑ב כּוֹנֵ֖ן לַמִּשְׁפָּ֣ט כִּסְאֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vyhvh l'vlm yshb khvnn lmshpt khs'v
verses.translation: But the LORD is enthroned for ever; He hath established His throne for judgment.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְה֗וּא יִשְׁפֹּֽט־תֵּבֵ֥ל בְּצֶ֑דֶק יָדִ֥ין לְ֝אֻמִּ֗ים בְּמֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.translit: vhv' yshpttbl btsdq ydyn l'mym bmyshrym
verses.translation: And He will judge the world in righteousness, He will minister judgment to the peoples with equity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וִ֘יהִ֤י יְהֹוָ֣ה מִשְׂגָּ֣ב לַדָּ֑ךְ מִ֝שְׂגָּ֗ב לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃
verses.translit: vyhy yhvh mshgb ldkh mshgb l'tvt btsrh
verses.translation: The LORD also will be a high tower for the oppressed, A high tower in times of trouble;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְיִבְטְח֣וּ בְ֭ךָ יוֹדְעֵ֣י שְׁמֶ֑ךָ כִּ֤י לֹֽא־עָזַ֖בְתָּ דֹרְשֶׁ֣יךָ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: vybtchv bkh yvd'y shmkh khy l''zbt drshykh yhvh
verses.translation: And they that know Thy name will put their trust in Thee; For thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זַמְּר֗וּ לַ֭יהֹוָה יֹשֵׁ֣ב צִיּ֑וֹן הַגִּ֥ידוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִֽילוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: zmrv lyhvh yshb tsyvn hgydv b'mym 'lylvtyv
verses.translation: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwelleth in Zion; Declare among the peoples His doings.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־דֹרֵ֣שׁ דָּ֭מִים אוֹתָ֣ם זָכָ֑ר לֹֽא־שָׁ֝כַ֗ח צַעֲקַ֥ת (עניים) [עֲנָוִֽים]׃
verses.translit: khydrsh dmym 'vtm zkhr l'shkhch ts'qt ('nyym) ['nvym]
verses.translation: For He that avengeth blood hath remembered them; He hath not forgotten the cry of the humble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חָֽנְנֵ֬נִי יְהֹוָ֗ה רְאֵ֣ה עׇ֭נְיִי מִשֹּׂנְאָ֑י מְ֝רוֹמְמִ֗י מִשַּׁ֥עֲרֵי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: chnnny yhvh r'h 'nyy mshn'y mrvmmy msh'ry mvt
verses.translation: Be gracious unto me, O LORD, Behold mine affliction at the hands of them that hate me; Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַ֥עַן אֲסַפְּרָ֗ה כׇּֽל־תְּהִלָּ֫תֶ֥יךָ בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֥י בַת־צִיּ֑וֹן אָ֝גִ֗ילָה בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: lm'n 'sprh khlthltykh bsh'ry bttsyvn 'gylh byshv'tkh
verses.translation: That I may tell of all Thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion, That I may rejoice in Thy salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טָבְע֣וּ ג֭וֹיִם בְּשַׁ֣חַת עָשׂ֑וּ בְּרֶֽשֶׁת־ז֥וּ טָ֝מָ֗נוּ נִלְכְּדָ֥ה רַגְלָֽם׃
verses.translit: tb'v gvym bshcht 'shv brshtzv tmnv nlkhdh rglm
verses.translation: The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made; In the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נ֤וֹדַ֨ע  יְהֹוָה֮ מִשְׁפָּ֢ט עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בְּפֹ֣עַל כַּ֭פָּיו נוֹקֵ֣שׁ רָשָׁ֑ע הִגָּי֥וֹן סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: nvd'  yhvh mshpt 'shh bp'l khpyv nvqsh rsh' hgyvn slh
verses.translation: The LORD hath made Himself known, He hath executed judgment, The wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָשׁ֣וּבוּ רְשָׁעִ֣ים לִשְׁא֑וֹלָה כׇּל־גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם שְׁכֵחֵ֥י אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: yshvbv rsh'ym lsh'vlh khlgvym shkhchy 'lhym
verses.translation: The wicked shall return to the nether-world, Even all the nations that forget God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לָ֭נֶצַח יִשָּׁכַ֣ח אֶבְי֑וֹן תִּקְוַ֥ת (ענוים) [עֲ֝נִיִּ֗ים] תֹּאבַ֥ד לָעַֽד׃
verses.translit: khy l' lntsch yshkhch 'byvn tqvt ('nvym) ['nyym] t'bd l'd
verses.translation: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten, Nor the expectation of the poor perish for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוּמָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה אַל־יָעֹ֣ז אֱנ֑וֹשׁ יִשָּׁפְט֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם עַל־פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: qvmh yhvh 'ly'z 'nvsh yshptv gvym 'lpnykh
verses.translation: Arise, O LORD, let not man prevail; Let the nations be judged in Thy sight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁ֘יתָ֤ה יְהֹוָ֨ה  מוֹרָ֗ה לָ֫הֶ֥ם יֵדְע֥וּ גוֹיִ֑ם אֱנ֖וֹשׁ הֵ֣מָּה סֶּֽלָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: shyth yhvh  mvrh lhm yd'v gvym 'nvsh hmh slh {p}
verses.translation: Set terror over them, O LORD; Let the nations know they are but men. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָמָ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה תַּעֲמֹ֣ד בְּרָח֑וֹק תַּ֝עְלִ֗ים לְעִתּ֥וֹת בַּצָּרָֽה׃
verses.translit: lmh yhvh t'md brchvq t'lym l'tvt btsrh
verses.translation: Why standest Thou afar off, O LORD? Why hidest Thou Thyself in times of trouble?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּגַאֲוַ֣ת רָ֭שָׁע יִדְלַ֣ק עָנִ֑י יִתָּפְשׂ֓וּ  בִּמְזִמּ֖וֹת ז֣וּ חָשָֽׁבוּ׃
verses.translit: bg'vt rsh' ydlq 'ny ytpshv  bmzmvt zv chshbv
verses.translation: Through the pride of the wicked the poor is hotly pursued, They are taken in the devices that they have imagined.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הִלֵּ֣ל רָ֭שָׁע עַל־תַּאֲוַ֣ת נַפְשׁ֑וֹ וּבֹצֵ֥עַ בֵּ֝רֵ֗ךְ נִ֘אֵ֥ץ ׀ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: khyhll rsh' 'lt'vt npshv vbts' brkh n'ts  yhvh
verses.translation: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, And the covetous vaunteth himself, though he contemn the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָשָׁ֗ע כְּגֹ֣בַהּ אַ֭פּוֹ בַּל־יִדְרֹ֑שׁ אֵ֥ין אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים כׇּל־מְזִמּוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: rsh' khgbh 'pv blydrsh 'yn 'lhym khlmzmvtyv
verses.translation: The wicked, in the pride of his countenance [, saith]: 'He will not require'; All his thoughts are: 'There is no God.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֘חִ֤ילוּ דְרָכָ֨ו  בְּכׇל־עֵ֗ת מָר֣וֹם מִ֭שְׁפָּטֶיךָ מִנֶּגְדּ֑וֹ כׇּל־צ֝וֹרְרָ֗יו יָפִ֥יחַ בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: ychylv drkhv  bkhl't mrvm mshptykh mngdv khltsvrryv ypych bhm
verses.translation: His ways prosper at all times; Thy judgments are far above out of his sight; As for all his adversaries, he puffeth at them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ בַּל־אֶמּ֑וֹט לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־בְרָֽע׃
verses.translit: 'mr blbv bl'mvt ldr vdr 'shr l'br'
verses.translation: He saith in his heart: 'I shall not be moved, I who to all generations shall not be in adversity.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָלָ֤ה  פִּ֣יהוּ מָ֭לֵא וּמִרְמ֣וֹת וָתֹ֑ךְ תַּ֥חַת לְ֝שׁוֹנ֗וֹ עָמָ֥ל וָאָֽוֶן׃
verses.translit: 'lh  pyhv ml' vmrmvt vtkh tcht lshvnv 'ml v'vn
verses.translation: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression; Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֵשֵׁ֤ב  בְּמַאְרַ֬ב חֲצֵרִ֗ים בַּֽ֭מִּסְתָּרִים יַהֲרֹ֣ג נָקִ֑י עֵ֝ינָ֗יו לְֽחֵלְכָ֥ה יִצְפֹּֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: yshb  bm'rb chtsrym bmstrym yhrg nqy 'ynyv lchlkhh ytspnv
verses.translation: He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; In secret places doth he slay the innocent; His eyes are on the watch for the helpless.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֶאֱרֹ֬ב בַּמִּסְתָּ֨ר  כְּאַרְיֵ֬ה בְסֻכֹּ֗ה יֶ֭אֱרֹב לַחֲט֣וֹף עָנִ֑י יַחְטֹ֥ף עָ֝נִ֗י בְּמׇשְׁכ֥וֹ בְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: y'rb bmstr  kh'ryh bskhh y'rb lchtvf 'ny ychtf 'ny bmshkhv brshtv
verses.translation: He lieth in wait in a secret place as a lion in his lair, He lieth in wait to catch the poor; He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him up in his net.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: (ודכה) [יִדְכֶּ֥ה] יָשֹׁ֑חַ וְנָפַ֥ל בַּ֝עֲצוּמָ֗יו (חלכאים) [חֵ֣ל כָּאִֽים]׃
verses.translit: (vdkhh) [ydkhh] yshch vnpl b'tsvmyv (chlkh'ym) [chl kh'ym]
verses.translation: He croucheth, he boweth down, And the helpless fall into his mighty claws.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר בְּ֭לִבּוֹ שָׁ֣כַֽח אֵ֑ל הִסְתִּ֥יר פָּ֝נָ֗יו בַּל־רָאָ֥ה לָנֶֽצַח׃
verses.translit: 'mr blbv shkhch 'l hstyr pnyv blr'h lntsch
verses.translation: He hath said in his heart: 'God hath forgotten; He hideth His face; He will never see.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוּמָ֤ה יְהֹוָ֗ה אֵ֭ל נְשָׂ֣א יָדֶ֑ךָ אַל־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ח (עניים) [עֲנָוִֽים]׃
verses.translit: qvmh yhvh 'l nsh' ydkh 'ltshkhch ('nyym) ['nvym]
verses.translation: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up Thy hand; Forget not the humble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־מֶ֤ה  נִאֵ֖ץ רָשָׁ֥ע ׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים אָמַ֥ר בְּ֝לִבּ֗וֹ לֹ֣א תִדְרֹֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: 'lmh  n'ts rsh'  'lhym 'mr blbv l' tdrsh
verses.translation: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God, And say in his heart: 'Thou wilt not require'?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רָאִ֡תָה כִּי־אַתָּ֤ה  עָ֘מָ֤ל וָכַ֨עַס  תַּבִּיט֮ לָתֵ֢ת בְּיָ֫דֶ֥ךָ עָ֭לֶיךָ יַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵלֵ֑כָה יָ֝ת֗וֹם אַתָּ֤ה  הָיִ֬יתָ עוֹזֵֽר׃
verses.translit: r'th khy'th  'ml vkh's  tbyt ltt bydkh 'lykh y'zb chlkhh ytvm 'th  hyyt 'vzr
verses.translation: Thou hast seen; for Thou beholdest trouble and vexation, to requite them with Thy hand; Unto Thee the helpless committeth himself; Thou hast been the helper of the fatherless.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁ֭בֹר זְר֣וֹעַ רָשָׁ֑ע וָ֝רָ֗ע תִּֽדְרוֹשׁ־רִשְׁע֥וֹ בַל־תִּמְצָֽא׃
verses.translit: shbr zrv' rsh' vr' tdrvshrsh'v bltmts'
verses.translation: Break Thou the arm of the wicked; And as for the evil man, search out his wickedness, till none be found.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֣ה מֶ֭לֶךְ עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד אָבְד֥וּ ג֝וֹיִ֗ם מֵאַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: yhvh mlkh 'vlm v'd 'bdv gvym m'rtsv
verses.translation: The LORD is King for ever and ever; The nations are perished out of His land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֬ת עֲנָוִ֣ים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ יְהֹוָ֑ה תָּכִ֥ין לִ֝בָּ֗ם תַּקְשִׁ֥יב אׇזְנֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: t'vt 'nvym shm't yhvh tkhyn lbm tqshyb 'znkh
verses.translation: LORD, Thou hast heard the desire of the humble: Thou wilt direct their heart, Thou wilt cause Thine ear to attend;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִשְׁפֹּ֥ט יָת֗וֹם וָ֫דָ֥ךְ בַּל־יוֹסִ֥יף ע֑וֹד לַעֲרֹ֥ץ אֱ֝נ֗וֹשׁ מִן־הָאָֽרֶץ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: lshpt ytvm vdkh blyvsyf 'vd l'rts 'nvsh mnh'rts {p}
verses.translation: To right the fatherless and the oppressed, That man who is of the earth may be terrible no more.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד בַּֽיהֹוָ֨ה  חָסִ֗יתִי אֵ֭יךְ תֹּאמְר֣וּ לְנַפְשִׁ֑י (נודו) [נ֝֗וּדִי] הַרְכֶ֥ם צִפּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: lmntsch ldvd byhvh  chsyty 'ykh t'mrv lnpshy (nvdv) [nvdy] hrkhm tspvr
verses.translation: For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David. In the LORD have I taken refuge; how say ye to my soul: 'Flee thou! to your mountain, ye birds'?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י הִנֵּ֪ה הָרְשָׁעִ֡ים יִדְרְכ֬וּן קֶ֗שֶׁת כּוֹנְנ֣וּ חִצָּ֣ם עַל־יֶ֑תֶר לִיר֥וֹת בְּמוֹ־אֹ֝֗פֶל לְיִשְׁרֵי־לֵֽב׃
verses.translit: khy hnh hrsh'ym ydrkhvn qsht khvnnv chtsm 'lytr lyrvt bmv'pl lyshrylb
verses.translation: For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, they have made ready their arrow upon the string, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י הַ֭שָּׁתוֹת יֵהָרֵס֑וּן צַ֝דִּ֗יק מַה־פָּעָֽל׃
verses.translit: khy hshtvt yhrsvn tsdyq mhp'l
verses.translation: When the foundations are destroyed, what hath the righteous wrought?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֤ה  בְּֽהֵ֘יכַ֤ל קׇדְשׁ֗וֹ יְהֹוָה֮ בַּשָּׁמַ֢יִם כִּ֫סְא֥וֹ עֵינָ֥יו יֶחֱז֑וּ עַפְעַפָּ֥יו יִ֝בְחֲנ֗וּ בְּנֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: yhvh  bhykhl qdshv yhvh bshmym khs'v 'ynyv ychzv 'p'pyv ybchnv bny 'dm
verses.translation: The LORD is in His holy temple, the LORD, His throne is in heaven; His eyes behold, His eyelids try, the children of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָה֮ צַדִּ֢יק יִ֫בְחָ֥ן וְ֭רָשָׁע וְאֹהֵ֣ב חָמָ֑ס שָֽׂנְאָ֥ה נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: yhvh tsdyq ybchn vrsh' v'hb chms shn'h npshv
verses.translation: The LORD trieth the righteous; but the wicked and him that loveth violence His soul hateth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַמְטֵ֥ר עַל־רְשָׁעִ֗ים פַּ֫חִ֥ים אֵ֣שׁ וְ֭גׇפְרִית וְר֥וּחַ זִלְעָפ֗וֹת מְנָ֣ת כּוֹסָֽם׃
verses.translit: ymtr 'lrsh'ym pchym 'sh vgpryt vrvch zl'pvt mnt khvsm
verses.translation: Upon the wicked He will cause to rain coals; fire and brimstone and burning wind shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הֹוָה צְדָק֣וֹת אָהֵ֑ב יָ֝שָׁ֗ר יֶחֱז֥וּ פָנֵֽימוֹ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khytsdyq yhvh tsdqvt 'hb yshr ychzv pnymv {p}
verses.translation: For the LORD is righteous, He loveth righteousness; the upright shall behold His face.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־הַשְּׁמִינִ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translit: lmntsch 'lhshmynyt mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: For the Leader; on the Sheminith. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹשִׁ֣יעָה יְ֭הֹוָה כִּֽי־גָמַ֣ר חָסִ֑יד כִּי־פַ֥סּוּ אֱ֝מוּנִ֗ים מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: hvshy'h yhvh khygmr chsyd khypsv 'mvnym mbny 'dm
verses.translation: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֤וְא  יְֽדַבְּרוּ֮ אִ֤ישׁ אֶת־רֵ֫עֵ֥הוּ שְׂפַ֥ת חֲלָק֑וֹת בְּלֵ֖ב וָלֵ֣ב יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃
verses.translit: shv'  ydbrv 'ysh 'tr'hv shpt chlqvt blb vlb ydbrv
verses.translation: They speak falsehood every one with his neighbour; With flattering lip, and with a double heart, do they speak.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַכְרֵ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־שִׂפְתֵ֣י חֲלָק֑וֹת לָ֝שׁ֗וֹן מְדַבֶּ֥רֶת גְּדֹלֽוֹת׃
verses.translit: ykhrt yhvh khlshpty chlqvt lshvn mdbrt gdlvt
verses.translation: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, The tongue that speaketh proud things!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָמְר֨וּ  לִלְשֹׁנֵ֣נוּ נַ֭גְבִּיר שְׂפָתֵ֣ינוּ אִתָּ֑נוּ מִ֖י אָד֣וֹן לָֽנוּ׃
verses.translit: 'shr 'mrv  llshnnv ngbyr shptynv 'tnv my 'dvn lnv
verses.translation: Who have said: 'Our tongue will we make mighty; Our lips are with us: who is lord over us?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִשֹּׁ֥ד עֲנִיִּים֮ מֵאֶנְקַ֢ת אֶבְי֫וֹנִ֥ים עַתָּ֣ה אָ֭קוּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ית בְּ֝יֵ֗שַׁע יָפִ֥יחַֽ־לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mshd 'nyym m'nqt 'byvnym 'th 'qvm y'mr yhvh 'shyt bysh' ypychlv
verses.translation: 'For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, Now will I arise', saith the LORD; 'I will set him in safety at whom they puff.' .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִ֥מְר֣וֹת יְהֹוָה֮ אֲמָר֢וֹת טְהֹ֫ר֥וֹת כֶּ֣סֶף צָ֭רוּף בַּעֲלִ֣יל לָאָ֑רֶץ מְ֝זֻקָּ֗ק שִׁבְעָתָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: 'mrvt yhvh 'mrvt thrvt khsf tsrvf b'lyl l'rts mzqq shb'tym
verses.translation: The words of the LORD are pure words, As silver tried in a crucible on the earth, refined seven times.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַתָּֽה־יְהֹוָ֥ה תִּשְׁמְרֵ֑ם תִּצְּרֶ֓נּוּ  מִן־הַדּ֖וֹר ז֣וּ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'thyhvh tshmrm ttsrnv  mnhdvr zv l'vlm
verses.translation: Thou wilt keep them, O LORD; Thou wilt preserve us from this generation for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סָבִ֗יב רְשָׁעִ֥ים יִתְהַלָּכ֑וּן כְּרֻ֥ם זֻ֝לּ֗וּת לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: sbyb rsh'ym ythlkhvn khrm zlvt lbny 'dm {p}
verses.translation: The wicked walk on every side, When vileness is exalted among the sons of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־אָ֣נָה יְ֭הֹוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֣נִי נֶ֑צַח עַד־אָ֓נָה  תַּסְתִּ֖יר אֶת־פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: 'd'nh yhvh tshkhchny ntsch 'd'nh  tstyr 'tpnykh mmny
verses.translation: How long, O LORD, wilt Thou forget me for ever? How long wilt Thou hide Thy face from me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַד־אָ֨נָה אָשִׁ֪ית עֵצ֡וֹת בְּנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וֹן בִּלְבָבִ֣י יוֹמָ֑ם עַד־אָ֓נָה  יָר֖וּם אֹיְבִ֣י עָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'd'nh 'shyt 'tsvt bnpshy ygvn blbby yvmm 'd'nh  yrvm 'yby 'ly
verses.translation: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart by day? How long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַבִּ֣יטָֽה עֲ֭נֵנִי יְהֹוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י הָאִ֥ירָה עֵ֝ינַ֗י פֶּן־אִישַׁ֥ן הַמָּֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: hbyth 'nny yhvh 'lhy h'yrh 'yny pn'yshn hmvt
verses.translation: Behold Thou, and answer me, O LORD my God; Lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פֶּן־יֹאמַ֣ר אֹיְבִ֣י יְכׇלְתִּ֑יו צָרַ֥י יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ כִּ֣י אֶמּֽוֹט׃
verses.translit: pny'mr 'yby ykhltyv tsry ygylv khy 'mvt
verses.translation: Lest mine enemy say: 'I have prevailed against him'; Lest mine adversaries rejoice when I am moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י  בְּחַסְדְּךָ֣ בָטַחְתִּי֮ יָ֤גֵ֥ל לִבִּ֗י בִּישׁוּעָ֫תֶ֥ךָ אָשִׁ֥ירָה לַֽיהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֖י גָמַ֣ל עָלָֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: v'ny  bchsdkh btchty ygl lby byshv'tkh 'shyrh lyhvh khy gml 'ly {p}
verses.translation: But as for me, in Thy mercy do I trust; My heart shall rejoice in Thy salvation. I will sing unto the LORD, Because He hath dealt bountifully with me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבּוֹ אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽשְׁחִ֗יתוּ הִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עֲלִילָ֗ה אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה־טֽוֹב׃
verses.translit: lmntsch ldvd 'mr nbl blbv 'yn 'lhym hshchytv ht'ybv 'lylh 'yn 'shhtvb
verses.translation: For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David. The fool hath said in his heart: 'There is no God'; they have dealt corruptly, they have done abominably; there is none that doeth good.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֢יף עַֽל־בְּנֵי־אָ֫דָ֥ם לִ֭רְאוֹת הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵ֗שׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.translit: yhvh mshmym hshqyf 'lbny'dm lr'vt hysh mshkhyl drsh 't'lhym
verses.translation: The LORD looked forth from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any man of understanding, that did seek after God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַכֹּ֥ל סָר֮ יַחְדָּ֢ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם־אֶחָֽד׃
verses.translit: hkhl sr ychdv n'lchv 'yn 'shhtvb 'yn gm'chd
verses.translation: They are all corrupt, they are together become impure; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ כׇּל־פֹּ֢עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃
verses.translit: hl' yd'v khlp'ly 'vn 'khly 'my 'khlv lchm yhvh l' qr'v
verses.translation: ’Shall not all the workers of iniquity know it, who eat up My people as they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD?'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם  פָּ֣חֲדוּ פָ֑חַד כִּֽי־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּד֣וֹר צַדִּֽיק׃
verses.translit: shm  pchdv pchd khy'lhym bdvr tsdyq
verses.translation: There are they in great fear; for God is with the righteous generation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֲצַת־עָנִ֥י תָבִ֑ישׁוּ כִּ֖י יְהֹוָ֣ה מַחְסֵֽהוּ׃
verses.translit: 'tst'ny tbyshv khy yhvh mchshv
verses.translation: Ye would put to shame the counsel of the poor, but the LORD is his refuge.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֥י־יִתֵּ֣ן מִצִּיּוֹן֮ יְשׁוּעַ֢ת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל בְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הֹוָה שְׁב֣וּת עַמּ֑וֹ יָגֵ֥ל יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יִשְׂמַ֥ח יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ {פ}
verses.translit: myytn mtsyvn yshv't yshr'l bshvb yhvh shbvt 'mv ygl y'qb yshmch yshr'l {p}
verses.translation: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When the LORD turneth the captivity of His people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֗וֹר לְדָ֫וִ֥ד יְ֭הֹוָה מִי־יָג֣וּר בְּאׇהֳלֶ֑ךָ מִֽי־יִ֝שְׁכֹּ֗ן בְּהַ֣ר קׇדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd yhvh myygvr b'hlkh myyshkhn bhr qdshkh
verses.translation: A Psalm of David. LORD, who shall sojourn in Thy tabernacle? Who shall dwell upon Thy holy mountain?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ תָּ֭מִים וּפֹעֵ֥ל צֶ֑דֶק וְדֹבֵ֥ר אֱ֝מֶ֗ת בִּלְבָבֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: hvlkh tmym vp'l tsdq vdbr 'mt blbbv
verses.translation: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, And speaketh truth in his heart;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־רָגַ֨ל  עַל־לְשֹׁנ֗וֹ לֹא־עָשָׂ֣ה לְרֵעֵ֣הוּ רָעָ֑ה וְ֝חֶרְפָּ֗ה לֹא־נָשָׂ֥א עַל־קְרֹבֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: l'rgl  'llshnv l''shh lr'hv r'h vchrph l'nsh' 'lqrbv
verses.translation: That hath no slander upon his tongue, Nor doeth evil to his fellow, Nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נִבְזֶ֤ה  בְּֽעֵ֘ינָ֤יו נִמְאָ֗ס וְאֶת־יִרְאֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֣ה יְכַבֵּ֑ד נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לְ֝הָרַ֗ע וְלֹ֣א יָמִֽר׃
verses.translit: nbzh  b'ynyv nm's v'tyr'y yhvh ykhbd nshb' lhr' vl' ymr
verses.translation: In whose eyes a vile person is despised, But he honoureth them that fear the LORD; He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּסְפּ֤וֹ  לֹא־נָתַ֣ן בְּנֶשֶׁךְ֮ וְשֹׁ֥חַד עַל־נָקִ֗י לֹ֥א־לָ֫קָ֥ח עֹֽשֵׂה־אֵ֑לֶּה לֹ֖א יִמּ֣וֹט לְעוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: khspv  l'ntn bnshkh vshchd 'lnqy l'lqch 'shh'lh l' ymvt l'vlm {p}
verses.translation: He that putteth not out his money on interest, Nor taketh a bribe against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִכְתָּ֥ם לְדָוִ֑ד שׇֽׁמְרֵ֥נִי אֵ֝֗ל כִּֽי־חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: mkhtm ldvd shmrny 'l khychsyty bkh
verses.translation: Michtam of David. Keep me, O God; for I have taken refuge in Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָמַ֣רְתְּ לַֽ֭יהֹוָה אֲדֹנָ֣י אָ֑תָּה ט֝וֹבָתִ֗י בַּל־עָלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: 'mrt lyhvh 'dny 'th tvbty bl'lykh
verses.translation: I have said unto the LORD: 'Thou art my Lord; I have no good but in Thee';
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִ֭קְדוֹשִׁים אֲשֶׁר־בָּאָ֣רֶץ הֵ֑מָּה וְ֝אַדִּירֵ֗י כׇּל־חֶפְצִי־בָֽם׃
verses.translit: lqdvshym 'shrb'rts hmh v'dyry khlchptsybm
verses.translation: As for the holy that are in the earth, They are the excellent in whom is all my delight.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְבּ֥וּ עַצְּבוֹתָם֮ אַחֵ֢ר מָ֫הָ֥רוּ בַּל־אַסִּ֣יךְ נִסְכֵּיהֶ֣ם מִדָּ֑ם וּֽבַל־אֶשָּׂ֥א אֶת־שְׁ֝מוֹתָ֗ם עַל־שְׂפָתָֽי׃
verses.translit: yrbv 'tsbvtm 'chr mhrv bl'sykh nskhyhm mdm vbl'sh' 'tshmvtm 'lshpty
verses.translation: Let the idols of them be multiplied that make suit unto another; Their drink-offerings of blood will I not offer, Nor take their names upon my lips.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה מְנָת־חֶלְקִ֥י וְכוֹסִ֑י אַ֝תָּ֗ה תּוֹמִ֥יךְ גּוֹרָלִֽי׃
verses.translit: yhvh mntchlqy vkhvsy 'th tvmykh gvrly
verses.translation: O LORD, the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup, Thou maintainest my lot.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֲבָלִ֣ים נָֽפְלוּ־לִ֭י בַּנְּעִמִ֑ים אַף־נַ֝חֲלָ֗ת שָֽׁפְרָ֥ה עָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: chblym nplvly bn'mym 'fnchlt shprh 'ly
verses.translation: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; Yea, I have a goodly heritage.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲבָרֵ֗ךְ אֶת־יְ֭הֹוָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצָ֑נִי אַף־לֵ֝יל֗וֹת יִסְּר֥וּנִי כִלְיוֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'brkh 'tyhvh 'shr y'tsny 'flylvt ysrvny khlyvty
verses.translation: I will bless the LORD, who hath given me counsel; Yea, in the night seasons my reins instruct me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שִׁוִּ֬יתִי יְהֹוָ֣ה לְנֶגְדִּ֣י תָמִ֑יד כִּ֥י מִֽ֝ימִינִ֗י בַּל־אֶמּֽוֹט׃
verses.translit: shvyty yhvh lngdy tmyd khy mymyny bl'mvt
verses.translation: I have set the LORD always before me; Surely He is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לָכֵ֤ן  שָׂמַ֣ח לִ֭בִּי וַיָּ֣גֶל כְּבוֹדִ֑י אַף־בְּ֝שָׂרִ֗י יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶֽטַח׃
verses.translit: lkhn  shmch lby vygl khbvdy 'fbshry yshkhn lbtch
verses.translation: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoiceth; my flesh also dwelleth in safety;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י  לֹא־תַעֲזֹ֣ב נַפְשִׁ֣י לִשְׁא֑וֹל לֹֽא־תִתֵּ֥ן חֲ֝סִידְךָ֗ לִרְא֥וֹת שָֽׁחַת׃
verses.translit: khy  l't'zb npshy lsh'vl l'ttn chsydkh lr'vt shcht
verses.translation: For Thou wilt not abandon my soul to the nether-world; Neither wilt Thou suffer Thy godly one to see the pit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּֽוֹדִיעֵנִי֮ אֹ֤רַח חַ֫יִּ֥ים שֹׂ֣בַע שְׂ֭מָחוֹת אֶת־פָּנֶ֑יךָ נְעִמ֖וֹת בִּימִינְךָ֣ נֶֽצַח׃ {פ}
verses.translit: tvdy'ny 'rch chyym shb' shmchvt 'tpnykh n'mvt bymynkh ntsch {p}
verses.translation: Thou makest me to know the path of life; In Thy presence is fulness of joy, In Thy right hand bliss for evermore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד שִׁמְעָ֤ה יְהֹוָ֨ה  צֶ֗דֶק הַקְשִׁ֥יבָה רִנָּתִ֗י הַאֲזִ֥ינָה תְפִלָּתִ֑י בְּ֝לֹ֗א שִׂפְתֵ֥י מִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: tplh ldvd shm'h yhvh  tsdq hqshybh rnty h'zynh tplty bl' shpty mrmh
verses.translation: A Prayer of David. Hear the right, O LORD, attend unto my cry; Give ear unto my prayer from lips without deceit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֭לְּפָנֶיךָ מִשְׁפָּטִ֣י יֵצֵ֑א עֵ֝ינֶ֗יךָ תֶּחֱזֶ֥ינָה מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.translit: mlpnykh mshpty yts' 'ynykh tchzynh myshrym
verses.translation: Let my judgment come forth from Thy presence; Let Thine eyes behold equity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּ֘חַ֤נְתָּ לִבִּ֨י  פָּ֘קַ֤דְתָּ לַּ֗יְלָה צְרַפְתַּ֥נִי בַל־תִּמְצָ֑א זַ֝מֹּתִ֗י בַּל־יַעֲבׇר־פִּֽי׃
verses.translit: bchnt lby  pqdt lylh tsrptny bltmts' zmty bly'brpy
verses.translation: Thou hast tried my heart, Thou hast visited it in the night; Thou hast tested me, and Thou findest not That I had a thought which should not pass my mouth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לִפְעֻלּ֣וֹת אָ֭דָם בִּדְבַ֣ר שְׂפָתֶ֑יךָ אֲנִ֥י שָׁ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אׇרְח֥וֹת פָּרִֽיץ׃
verses.translit: lp'lvt 'dm bdbr shptykh 'ny shmrty 'rchvt pryts
verses.translation: As for the doings of men, by the word of Thy lips I have kept me from the ways of the violent.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תָּמֹ֣ךְ אֲ֭שֻׁרַי בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתֶ֑יךָ בַּל־נָמ֥וֹטּוּ פְעָמָֽי׃
verses.translit: tmkh 'shry bm'glvtykh blnmvtv p'my
verses.translation: My steps have held fast to Thy paths, My feet have not slipped.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִֽי־קְרָאתִ֣יךָ כִֽי־תַעֲנֵ֣נִי אֵ֑ל הַֽט־אׇזְנְךָ֥ לִ֝֗י שְׁמַ֣ע אִמְרָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'nyqr'tykh khyt'nny 'l ht'znkh ly shm' 'mrty
verses.translation: As for me, I call upon Thee, for Thou wilt answer me, O God; Incline Thine ear unto me, hear my speech.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַפְלֵ֣ה חֲ֭סָדֶיךָ מוֹשִׁ֣יעַ חוֹסִ֑ים מִ֝מִּתְקוֹמְמִ֗ים בִּֽימִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: hplh chsdykh mvshy' chvsym mmtqvmmym bymynkh
verses.translation: Make passing great Thy mercies, O Thou that savest by Thy right hand From assailants them that take refuge in Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׇׁ֭מְרֵנִי כְּאִישׁ֣וֹן בַּת־עָ֑יִן בְּצֵ֥ל כְּ֝נָפֶ֗יךָ תַּסְתִּירֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: shmrny kh'yshvn bt'yn btsl khnpykh tstyrny
verses.translation: Keep me as the apple of the eye, Hide me in the shadow of Thy wings,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִפְּנֵ֣י רְ֭שָׁעִים ז֣וּ שַׁדּ֑וּנִי אֹיְבַ֥י בְּ֝נֶ֗פֶשׁ יַקִּ֥יפוּ עָלָֽי׃
verses.translit: mpny rsh'ym zv shdvny 'yby bnpsh yqypv 'ly
verses.translation: From the wicked that oppress, My deadly enemies, that compass me about.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶלְבָּ֥מוֹ סָּגְר֑וּ פִּ֝֗ימוֹ דִּבְּר֥וּ בְגֵאֽוּת׃
verses.translit: chlbmv sgrv pymv dbrv bg'vt
verses.translation: Their gross heart they have shut tight, With their mouth they speak proudly.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֭שֻּׁרֵינוּ עַתָּ֣ה (סבבוני) [סְבָב֑וּנוּ] עֵינֵיהֶ֥ם יָ֝שִׁ֗יתוּ לִנְט֥וֹת בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: 'shrynv 'th (sbbvny) [sbbvnv] 'ynyhm yshytv lntvt b'rts
verses.translation: At our every step they have now encompassed us; They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דִּמְיֹנ֗וֹ כְּ֭אַרְיֵה יִכְס֣וֹף לִטְרֹ֑ף וְ֝כִכְפִ֗יר יֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּמִסְתָּרִֽים׃
verses.translit: dmynv kh'ryh ykhsvf ltrf vkhkhpyr yshb bmstrym
verses.translation: He is like a lion that is eager to tear in pieces, And like a young lion lurking in secret places.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קוּמָ֤ה יְהֹוָ֗ה קַדְּמָ֣ה פָ֭נָיו הַכְרִיעֵ֑הוּ פַּלְּטָ֥ה נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י מֵרָשָׁ֥ע חַרְבֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: qvmh yhvh qdmh pnyv hkhry'hv plth npshy mrsh' chrbkh
verses.translation: Arise, O LORD, confront him, cast him down; Deliver my soul from the wicked, by Thy sword;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֥מְתִֽים־יָדְךָ֨  יְהֹוָ֡ה מִֽמְתִ֬ים מֵחֶ֗לֶד חֶלְקָ֥ם בַּֽחַיִּים֮ (וצפינך) [וּֽצְפוּנְךָ֮] תְּמַלֵּ֢א בִ֫טְנָ֥ם יִשְׂבְּע֥וּ בָנִ֑ים וְהִנִּ֥יחוּ יִ֝תְרָ֗ם לְעוֹלְלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: mmtymydkh  yhvh mmtym mchld chlqm bchyym (vtspynkh) [vtspvnkh] tml' btnm yshb'v bnym vhnychv ytrm l'vllyhm
verses.translation: From men, by Thy hand, O LORD, From men of the world, whose portion is in this life, And whose belly Thou fillest with Thy treasure; Who have children in plenty, And leave their abundance to their babes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲנִ֗י בְּ֭צֶדֶק אֶחֱזֶ֣ה פָנֶ֑יךָ אֶשְׂבְּעָ֥ה בְ֝הָקִ֗יץ תְּמוּנָתֶֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'ny btsdq 'chzh pnykh 'shb'h bhqyts tmvntkh {p}
verses.translation: As for me, I shall behold Thy face in righteousness; I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with Thy likeness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֤חַ  לְעֶ֥בֶד יְהֹוָ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲשֶׁ֤ר דִּבֶּ֨ר  לַיהֹוָ֗ה אֶת־דִּ֭בְרֵי הַשִּׁירָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את בְּי֤וֹם הִֽצִּיל־יְהֹוָ֘ה־אוֹת֥וֹ מִכַּ֥ף כׇּל־אֹ֝יְבָ֗יו וּמִיַּ֥ד שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.translit: lmntsch  l'bd yhvh ldvd 'shr dbr  lyhvh 'tdbry hshyrh hz't byvm htsylyhvh'vtv mkhf khl'ybyv vmyd sh'vl
verses.translation: For the Leader. [A Psalm] of David the servant of the LORD, who spoke unto the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֹּאמַ֡ר אֶרְחׇמְךָ֖ יְהֹוָ֣ה חִזְקִֽי׃
verses.translit: vy'mr 'rchmkh yhvh chzqy
verses.translation: And he said: I love thee, O LORD, my strength.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֤ה  סַ֥לְעִ֥י וּמְצוּדָתִ֗י וּמְפַ֫לְטִ֥י אֵלִ֣י צ֭וּרִי אֶֽחֱסֶה־בּ֑וֹ מָֽגִנִּ֥י וְקֶֽרֶן־יִ֝שְׁעִ֗י מִשְׂגַּבִּֽי׃
verses.translit: yhvh  sl'y vmtsvdty vmplty 'ly tsvry 'chshbv mgny vqrnysh'y mshgby
verses.translation: The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; My God, my rock, in Him I take refuge; my shield, and my horn of salvation, my high tower.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְ֭הֻלָּל אֶקְרָ֣א יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמִן־אֹ֝יְבַ֗י אִוָּשֵֽׁעַ׃
verses.translit: mhll 'qr' yhvh vmn'yby 'vsh'
verses.translation: Praised, I cry, is the LORD, and I am saved from mine enemies. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲפָפ֥וּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָ֑וֶת וְֽנַחֲלֵ֖י בְלִיַּ֣עַל יְבַֽעֲתֽוּנִי׃
verses.translit: 'ppvny chblymvt vnchly bly'l yb'tvny
verses.translation: The cords of Death compassed me, and the floods of Belial assailed me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חֶבְלֵ֣י שְׁא֣וֹל סְבָב֑וּנִי קִ֝דְּמ֗וּנִי מ֣וֹקְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃
verses.translit: chbly sh'vl sbbvny qdmvny mvqshy mvt
verses.translation: The cords of Sheol surrounded me; the snares of Death confronted me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בַּצַּר־לִ֤י  אֶ֥קְרָ֣א יְהֹוָה֮ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהַ֢י אֲשַׁ֫וֵּ֥עַ יִשְׁמַ֣ע מֵהֵיכָל֣וֹ קוֹלִ֑י וְ֝שַׁוְעָתִ֗י לְפָנָ֤יו  תָּב֬וֹא בְאׇזְנָֽיו׃
verses.translit: btsrly  'qr' yhvh v'l'lhy 'shv' yshm' mhykhlv qvly vshv'ty lpnyv  tbv' b'znyv
verses.translation: In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God; out of His temple He heard my voice, and my cry came before Him unto His ears.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּגְעַ֬שׁ וַתִּרְעַ֨שׁ  הָאָ֗רֶץ וּמוֹסְדֵ֣י הָרִ֣ים יִרְגָּ֑זוּ וַ֝יִּתְגָּֽעֲשׁ֗וּ כִּי־חָ֥רָה לֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: vtg'sh vtr'sh  h'rts vmvsdy hrym yrgzv vytg'shv khychrh lv
verses.translation: Then the earth did shake and quake, the foundations also of the mountains did tremble; they were shaken, because He was wroth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָ֘לָ֤ה עָשָׁ֨ן  בְּאַפּ֗וֹ וְאֵשׁ־מִפִּ֥יו תֹּאכֵ֑ל גֶּ֝חָלִ֗ים בָּעֲר֥וּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lh 'shn  b'pv v'shmpyv t'khl gchlym b'rv mmnv
verses.translation: Smoke arose up in His nostrils, and fire out of His mouth did devour; coals flamed forth from Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֣ט שָׁ֭מַיִם וַיֵּרַ֑ד וַ֝עֲרָפֶ֗ל תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyt shmym vyrd v'rpl tcht rglyv
verses.translation: He bowed the heavens also, and came down; and thick darkness was under His feet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּרְכַּ֣ב עַל־כְּ֭רוּב וַיָּעֹ֑ף וַ֝יֵּ֗דֶא עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רֽוּחַ׃
verses.translit: vyrkhb 'lkhrvb vy'f vyd' 'lkhnpyrvch
verses.translation: And He rode upon a cherub, and did fly; yea, He did swoop down upon the wings of the wind.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֤שֶׁת־חֹ֨שֶׁךְ  סִתְר֗וֹ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֥יו סֻכָּת֑וֹ חֶשְׁכַת־מַ֝֗יִם עָבֵ֥י שְׁחָקִֽים׃
verses.translit: yshtchshkh  strv sbybvtyv skhtv chshkhtmym 'by shchqym
verses.translation: He made darkness His hiding-place, His pavilion round about Him; darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִנֹּ֗גַהּ נֶ֫גְדּ֥וֹ עָבָ֥יו עָבְר֑וּ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: mngh ngdv 'byv 'brv brd vgchly'sh
verses.translation: At the brightness before Him, there passed through His thick clouds Hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיַּרְעֵ֬ם בַּשָּׁמַ֨יִם  יְֽהֹוָ֗ה וְ֭עֶלְיוֹן יִתֵּ֣ן קֹל֑וֹ בָּ֝רָ֗ד וְגַֽחֲלֵי־אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: vyr'm bshmym  yhvh v'lyvn ytn qlv brd vgchly'sh
verses.translation: The LORD also thundered in the heavens, and the Most High gave forth His voice; hailstones and coals of fire.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חִ֭צָּיו וַיְפִיצֵ֑ם וּבְרָקִ֥ים רָ֝֗ב וַיְהֻמֵּֽם׃
verses.translit: vyshlch chtsyv vypytsm vbrqym rb vyhmm
verses.translation: And He sent out His arrows, and scattered them; and He shot forth lightnings, and discomfited them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיֵּ֤רָא֨וּ  אֲפִ֥יקֵי מַ֗יִם וַֽיִּגָּלוּ֮ מוֹסְד֢וֹת תֵּ֫בֵ֥ל מִגַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ֣ יְהֹוָ֑ה מִ֝נִּשְׁמַ֗ת ר֣וּחַ אַפֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: vyr'v  'pyqy mym vyglv mvsdvt tbl mg'rtkh yhvh mnshmt rvch 'pkh
verses.translation: And the channels of waters appeared, and the foundations of the world were laid bare, at Thy rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of Thy nostrils.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁלַ֣ח מִ֭מָּרוֹם יִקָּחֵ֑נִי יַֽ֝מְשֵׁ֗נִי מִמַּ֥יִם רַבִּֽים׃
verses.translit: yshlch mmrvm yqchny ymshny mmym rbym
verses.translation: He sent from on high, He took me; He drew me out of many waters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַצִּילֵ֗נִי מֵאֹיְבִ֥י עָ֑ז וּ֝מִשֹּׂנְאַ֗י כִּֽי־אָמְצ֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: ytsylny m'yby 'z vmshn'y khy'mtsv mmny
verses.translation: He delivered me from mine enemy most strong, and from them that hated me, for they were too mighty for me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְקַדְּמ֥וּנִי בְיוֹם־אֵידִ֑י וַֽיְהִי־יְהֹוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁעָ֣ן לִֽי׃
verses.translit: yqdmvny byvm'ydy vyhyyhvh lmsh'n ly
verses.translation: They confronted me in the day of my calamity; but the LORD was a stay unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִיאֵ֥נִי לַמֶּרְחָ֑ב יְ֝חַלְּצֵ֗נִי כִּ֘י־חָ֥פֵֽץ־בִּֽי׃
verses.translit: vyvtsy'ny lmrchb ychltsny khychptsby
verses.translation: He brought me forth also into a large place; He delivered me, because He delighted in me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִגְמְלֵ֣נִי יְהֹוָ֣ה כְּצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י יָשִׁ֥יב לִֽי׃
verses.translit: ygmlny yhvh khtsdqy khbr ydy yshyb ly
verses.translation: The LORD rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath He recompensed me. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־שָׁ֭מַרְתִּי דַּרְכֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־רָ֝שַׁ֗עְתִּי מֵאֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.translit: khyshmrty drkhy yhvh vl'rsh'ty m'lhy
verses.translation: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י כׇל־מִשְׁפָּטָ֣יו לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וְ֝חֻקֹּתָ֗יו לֹא־אָסִ֥יר מֶֽנִּי׃
verses.translit: khy khlmshptyv lngdy vchqtyv l''syr mny
verses.translation: For all His ordinances were before me, and I put not away His statutes from me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וָאֱהִ֣י תָמִ֣ים עִמּ֑וֹ וָ֝אֶשְׁתַּמֵּ֗ר מֵעֲוֺנִֽי׃
verses.translit: v'hy tmym 'mv v'shtmr m'vny
verses.translation: And I was single-hearted with Him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַיָּֽשֶׁב־יְהֹוָ֣ה לִ֣י כְצִדְקִ֑י כְּבֹ֥ר יָ֝דַ֗י לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.translit: vyshbyhvh ly khtsdqy khbr ydy lngd 'ynyv
verses.translation: Therefore hath the LORD recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִם־חָסִ֥יד תִּתְחַסָּ֑ד עִם־גְּבַ֥ר תָּ֝מִ֗ים תִּתַּמָּֽם׃
verses.translit: 'mchsyd ttchsd 'mgbr tmym ttmm
verses.translation: With the merciful Thou dost show Thyself merciful, with the upright man Thou dost show Thyself upright;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עִם־נָבָ֥ר תִּתְבָּרָ֑ר וְעִם־עִ֝קֵּ֗שׁ תִּתְפַּתָּֽל׃
verses.translit: 'mnbr ttbrr v'm'qsh ttptl
verses.translation: With the pure Thou dost show Thyself pure; and with the crooked Thou dost show Thyself subtle.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה עַם־עָנִ֣י תוֹשִׁ֑יעַ וְעֵינַ֖יִם רָמ֣וֹת תַּשְׁפִּֽיל׃
verses.translit: khy'th 'm'ny tvshy' v'ynym rmvt tshpyl
verses.translation: For Thou dost save the afflicted people; but the haughty eyes Thou dost humble.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה תָּאִ֣יר נֵרִ֑י יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י יַגִּ֥יהַּ חׇשְׁכִּֽי׃
verses.translit: khy'th t'yr nry yhvh 'lhy ygyh chshkhy
verses.translation: For Thou dost light my lamp; the LORD my God doth lighten my darkness.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־בְ֭ךָ אָרֻ֣ץ גְּד֑וּד וּ֝בֵֽאלֹהַ֗י אֲדַלֶּג־שֽׁוּר׃
verses.translit: khybkh 'rts gdvd vb'lhy 'dlgshvr
verses.translation: For by Thee I run upon a troop; and by my God do I scale a wall.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֵל֮ תָּמִ֢ים דַּ֫רְכּ֥וֹ אִמְרַֽת־יְהֹוָ֥ה צְרוּפָ֑ה מָגֵ֥ן ה֝֗וּא לְכֹ֤ל  הַחֹסִ֬ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: h'l tmym drkhv 'mrtyhvh tsrvph mgn hv' lkhl  hchsym bv
verses.translation: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is tried; He is a shield unto all them that take refuge in Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י מִ֣י אֱ֭לוֹהַּ מִבַּלְעֲדֵ֣י יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמִ֥י צ֝֗וּר זוּלָתִ֥י אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.translit: khy my 'lvh mbl'dy yhvh vmy tsvr zvlty 'lhynv
verses.translation: For who is God, save the LORD? And who is a Rock, except our God?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָ֭אֵל הַמְאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חָ֑יִל וַיִּתֵּ֖ן תָּמִ֣ים דַּרְכִּֽי׃
verses.translit: h'l hm'zrny chyl vytn tmym drkhy
verses.translation: The God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way straight;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְשַׁוֶּ֣ה רַ֭גְלַי כָּאַיָּל֑וֹת וְעַ֥ל בָּ֝מֹתַ֗י יַעֲמִידֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: mshvh rgly kh'ylvt v'l bmty y'mydny
verses.translation: Who maketh my feet like hinds', and setteth me upon my high places;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְלַמֵּ֣ד יָ֭דַי לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְֽנִחֲתָ֥ה קֶֽשֶׁת־נְ֝חוּשָׁ֗ה זְרוֹעֹתָֽי׃
verses.translit: mlmd ydy lmlchmh vnchth qshtnchvshh zrv'ty
verses.translation: Who traineth my hands for war, so that mine arms do bend a bow of brass.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתִּתֶּן־לִי֮ מָגֵ֢ן יִ֫שְׁעֶ֥ךָ וִֽימִינְךָ֥ תִסְעָדֵ֑נִי וְֽעַנְוַתְךָ֥ תַרְבֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: vttnly mgn ysh'kh vymynkh ts'dny v'nvtkh trbny
verses.translation: Thou hast also given me Thy shield of salvation, and Thy right hand hath holden me up; and Thy condescension hath made me great.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּרְחִ֣יב צַעֲדִ֣י תַחְתָּ֑י וְלֹ֥א מָ֝עֲד֗וּ קַרְסֻלָּֽי׃
verses.translit: trchyb ts'dy tchty vl' m'dv qrsly
verses.translation: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, and my feet have not slipped.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶרְדּ֣וֹף א֭וֹיְבַי וְאַשִּׂיגֵ֑ם וְלֹֽא־אָ֝שׁ֗וּב עַד־כַּלּוֹתָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'rdvf 'vyby v'shygm vl''shvb 'dkhlvtm
verses.translation: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them; neither did I turn back till they were consumed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶ֭מְחָצֵם וְלֹא־יֻ֣כְלוּ ק֑וּם יִ֝פְּל֗וּ תַּ֣חַת רַגְלָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'mchtsm vl'ykhlv qvm yplv tcht rgly
verses.translation: I have smitten them through, so that they are not able to rise; they are fallen under my feet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַתְּאַזְּרֵ֣נִי חַ֭יִל לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה תַּכְרִ֖יעַ קָמַ֣י תַּחְתָּֽי׃
verses.translit: vt'zrny chyl lmlchmh tkhry' qmy tchty
verses.translation: For Thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle; Thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֹיְבַ֗י נָתַ֣תָּה לִּ֣י עֹ֑רֶף וּ֝מְשַׂנְאַ֗י אַצְמִיתֵֽם׃
verses.translit: v'yby ntth ly 'rf vmshn'y 'tsmytm
verses.translation: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me, and I did cut off them that hate me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְשַׁוְּע֥וּ וְאֵין־מוֹשִׁ֑יעַ עַל־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה וְלֹ֣א עָנָֽם׃
verses.translit: yshv'v v'ynmvshy' 'lyhvh vl' 'nm
verses.translation: They cried, but there was none to save; even unto the LORD, but He answered them not.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְֽאֶשְׁחָקֵ֗ם כְּעָפָ֥ר עַל־פְּנֵי־ר֑וּחַ כְּטִ֖יט חוּצ֣וֹת אֲרִיקֵֽם׃
verses.translit: v'shchqm kh'pr 'lpnyrvch khtyt chvtsvt 'ryqm
verses.translation: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind; I did cast them out as the mire of the streets.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּפַלְּטֵנִי֮ מֵרִ֢יבֵ֫י עָ֥ם תְּ֭שִׂימֵנִי לְרֹ֣אשׁ גּוֹיִ֑ם עַ֖ם לֹא־יָדַ֣עְתִּי יַֽעַבְדֽוּנִי׃
verses.translit: tpltny mryby 'm tshymny lr'sh gvym 'm l'yd'ty y'bdvny
verses.translation: Thou hast delivered me from the contentions of the people; Thou hast made me the head of the nations; a people whom I have not known serve me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְשֵׁ֣מַֽע אֹ֭זֶן יִשָּׁ֣מְעוּ לִ֑י בְּנֵֽי־נֵ֝כָ֗ר יְכַחֲשׁוּ־לִֽי׃
verses.translit: lshm' 'zn yshm'v ly bnynkhr ykhchshvly
verses.translation: As soon as they hear of me, they obey me; The sons of the stranger dwindle away before me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּנֵי־נֵכָ֥ר יִבֹּ֑לוּ וְ֝יַחְרְג֗וּ מִֽמִּסְגְּרֽוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: bnynkhr yblv vychrgv mmsgrvtyhm
verses.translation: The sons of the stranger fade away, and come trembling out of their close places.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַי־יְ֭הֹוָה וּבָר֣וּךְ צוּרִ֑י וְ֝יָר֗וּם אֱלוֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃
verses.translit: chyyhvh vbrvkh tsvry vyrvm 'lvhy ysh'y
verses.translation: The LORD liveth, and blessed be my Rock; and exalted be the God of my salvation;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הָאֵ֗ל הַנּוֹתֵ֣ן נְקָמ֣וֹת לִ֑י וַיַּדְבֵּ֖ר עַמִּ֣ים תַּחְתָּֽי׃
verses.translit: h'l hnvtn nqmvt ly vydbr 'mym tchty
verses.translation: Even the God that executeth vengeance for me, and subdueth peoples under me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מְפַלְּטִ֗י מֵאֹ֫יְבָ֥י אַ֣ף מִן־קָ֭מַי תְּרוֹמְמֵ֑נִי מֵאִ֥ישׁ חָ֝מָ֗ס תַּצִּילֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: mplty m'yby 'f mnqmy trvmmny m'ysh chms ttsylny
verses.translation: He delivereth me from mine enemies; yea, Thou liftest me up above them that rise up against me; Thou deliverest me from the violent man.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַל־כֵּ֤ן  אוֹדְךָ֖ בַגּוֹיִ֥ם ׀ יְהֹוָ֑ה וּלְשִׁמְךָ֥ אֲזַמֵּֽרָה׃
verses.translit: 'lkhn  'vdkh bgvym  yhvh vlshmkh 'zmrh
verses.translation: Therefore I will give thanks unto Thee, O LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises unto Thy name.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מַגְדִּל֮ יְשׁוּע֢וֹת מַ֫לְכּ֥וֹ וְעֹ֤שֶׂה חֶ֨סֶד  לִמְשִׁיח֗וֹ לְדָוִ֥ד וּלְזַרְע֗וֹ עַד־עוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: mgdl yshv'vt mlkhv v'shh chsd  lmshychv ldvd vlzr'v 'd'vlm {p}
verses.translation: Great salvation giveth He to His king; and showeth mercy to His anointed, To David and to his seed, for evermore.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם מְֽסַפְּרִ֥ים כְּבֽוֹד־אֵ֑ל וּֽמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָ֝דָ֗יו מַגִּ֥יד הָרָקִֽיעַ׃
verses.translit: hshmym msprym khbvd'l vm'shh ydyv mgyd hrqy'
verses.translation: The heavens declare the glory of God, and the firmament showeth His handiwork;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: י֣וֹם לְ֭יוֹם יַבִּ֣יעַֽ אֹ֑מֶר וְלַ֥יְלָה לְּ֝לַ֗יְלָה יְחַוֶּה־דָּֽעַת׃
verses.translit: yvm lyvm yby' 'mr vlylh llylh ychvhd't
verses.translation: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night revealeth knowledge;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵֽין־אֹ֭מֶר וְאֵ֣ין דְּבָרִ֑ים בְּ֝לִ֗י נִשְׁמָ֥ע קוֹלָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'yn'mr v'yn dbrym bly nshm' qvlm
verses.translation: There is no speech, there are no words, neither is their voice heard.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּכׇל־הָאָ֨רֶץ  יָ֘צָ֤א קַוָּ֗ם וּבִקְצֵ֣ה תֵ֭בֵל מִלֵּיהֶ֑ם לַ֝שֶּׁ֗מֶשׁ שָֽׂם־אֹ֥הֶל בָּהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: bkhlh'rts  yts' qvm vbqtsh tbl mlyhm lshmsh shm'hl bhm
verses.translation: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath He set a tent for the sun,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְה֗וּא כְּ֭חָתָן יֹצֵ֣א מֵחֻפָּת֑וֹ יָשִׂ֥ישׂ כְּ֝גִבּ֗וֹר לָר֥וּץ אֹֽרַח׃
verses.translit: vhv' khchtn yts' mchptv yshysh khgbvr lrvts 'rch
verses.translation: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run his course.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִקְצֵ֤ה הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם  מֽוֹצָא֗וֹ וּתְקוּפָת֥וֹ עַל־קְצוֹתָ֑ם וְאֵ֥ין נִ֝סְתָּ֗ר מֵחַמָּתֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: mqtsh hshmym  mvts'v vtqvptv 'lqtsvtm v'yn nstr mchmtv
verses.translation: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it; and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תּ֘וֹרַ֤ת יְהֹוָ֣ה תְּ֭מִימָה מְשִׁ֣יבַת נָ֑פֶשׁ עֵד֥וּת יְהֹוָ֥ה נֶ֝אֱמָנָ֗ה מַחְכִּ֥ימַת פֶּֽתִי׃
verses.translit: tvrt yhvh tmymh mshybt npsh 'dvt yhvh n'mnh mchkhymt pty
verses.translation: The law of the LORD is perfect, restoring the soul; the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּקּ֘וּדֵ֤י יְהֹוָ֣ה יְ֭שָׁרִים מְשַׂמְּחֵי־לֵ֑ב מִצְוַ֥ת יְהֹוָ֥ה בָּ֝רָ֗ה מְאִירַ֥ת עֵינָֽיִם׃
verses.translit: pqvdy yhvh yshrym mshmchylb mtsvt yhvh brh m'yrt 'ynym
verses.translation: The precepts of the LORD are right, rejoicing the heart; the commandment of the LORD is pure, enlightening the eyes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְאַ֤ת יְהֹוָ֨ה  טְהוֹרָה֮ עוֹמֶ֢דֶת לָ֫עַ֥ד מִֽשְׁפְּטֵי־יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱמֶ֑ת צָֽדְק֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.translit: yr't yhvh  thvrh 'vmdt l'd mshptyyhvh 'mt tsdqv ychdv
verses.translation: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring for ever; the ordinances of the LORD are true, they are righteous altogether;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַֽנֶּחֱמָדִ֗ים מִ֭זָּהָב וּמִפַּ֣ז רָ֑ב וּמְתוּקִ֥ים מִ֝דְּבַ֗שׁ וְנֹ֣פֶת צוּפִֽים׃
verses.translit: hnchmdym mzhb vmpz rb vmtvqym mdbsh vnpt tsvpym
verses.translation: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold; sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּֽם־עַ֭בְדְּךָ נִזְהָ֣ר בָּהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שׇׁמְרָ֗ם עֵ֣קֶב רָֽב׃
verses.translit: gm'bdkh nzhr bhm bshmrm 'qb rb
verses.translation: Moreover by them is Thy servant warned; in keeping of them there is great reward.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁגִיא֥וֹת מִֽי־יָבִ֑ין מִֽנִּסְתָּר֥וֹת נַקֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: shgy'vt myybyn mnstrvt nqny
verses.translation: Who can discern his errors? Clear Thou me from hidden faults.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֤ם מִזֵּדִ֨ים  חֲשֹׂ֬ךְ עַבְדֶּ֗ךָ אַֽל־יִמְשְׁלוּ־בִ֣י אָ֣ז אֵיתָ֑ם וְ֝נִקֵּ֗יתִי מִפֶּ֥שַֽׁע רָֽב׃
verses.translit: gm mzdym  chshkh 'bdkh 'lymshlvby 'z 'ytm vnqyty mpsh' rb
verses.translation: Keep back Thy servant also from presumptuous sins, that they may not have dominion over me; then shall I be faultless, and I shall be clear from great transgression.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִ֥הְיֽוּ־לְרָצ֨וֹן  אִמְרֵי־פִ֡י וְהֶגְי֣וֹן לִבִּ֣י לְפָנֶ֑יךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה צוּרִ֥י וְגֹאֲלִֽי׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yhyvlrtsvn  'mrypy vhgyvn lby lpnykh yhvh tsvry vg'ly {p}
verses.translation: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable before Thee, O LORD, my Rock, and my Redeemer.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הֹוָה בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם  אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.translit: y'nkh yhvh byvm tsrh yshgbkh shm  'lhy y'qb
verses.translation: The LORD answer thee in the day of trouble; The name of the God of Jacob set thee up on high;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשְׁלַֽח־עֶזְרְךָ֥ מִקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וּ֝מִצִּיּ֗וֹן יִסְעָדֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: yshlch'zrkh mqdsh vmtsyvn ys'dkh
verses.translation: Send forth thy help from the sanctuary, And support thee out of Zion;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִזְכֹּ֥ר כׇּל־מִנְחֹתֶ֑ךָ וְעוֹלָתְךָ֖ יְדַשְּׁנֶ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: yzkhr khlmnchtkh v'vltkh ydshnh slh
verses.translation: Receive the memorial of all thy meal-offerings, And accept the fat of thy burnt-sacrifice; Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִֽתֶּן־לְךָ֥ כִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְֽכׇל־עֲצָתְךָ֥ יְמַלֵּֽא׃
verses.translit: ytnlkh khlbbkh vkhl'tstkh yml'
verses.translation: Grant thee according to thine own heart, And fulfil all thy counsel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְרַנְּנָ֤ה  בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם־אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה כׇּל־מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: nrnnh  byshv'tkh vbshm'lhynv ndgl yml' yhvh khlmsh'lvtykh
verses.translation: We will shout for joy in thy victory, And in the name of our God we will set up our standards; The LORD fulfil all thy petitions.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ ׀ יְהֹוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קׇדְשׁ֑וֹ בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'th yd'ty khy hvshy'  yhvh mshychv y'nhv mshmy qdshv bgbrvt ysh' ymynv
verses.translation: Now know I that the LORD saveth His anointed; He will answer him from His holy heaven With the mighty acts of His saving right hand.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭רֶכֶב וְאֵ֣לֶּה בַסּוּסִ֑ים וַאֲנַ֓חְנוּ  בְּשֵׁם־יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.translit: 'lh brkhb v'lh bsvsym v'nchnv  bshmyhvh 'lhynv nzkhyr
verses.translation: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses; But we will make mention of the name of the LORD our God.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְנָפָ֑לוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד׃
verses.translit: hmh khr'v vnplv v'nchnv qmnv vnt'vdd
verses.translation: They are bowed down and fallen; But we are risen, and stand upright.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־קׇרְאֵֽנוּ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yhvh hvshy'h hmlkh y'nnv byvmqr'nv {p}
verses.translation: Save, LORD; Let the King answer us in the day that we call.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translit: lmntsch mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה בְּעׇזְּךָ֥ יִשְׂמַח־מֶ֑לֶךְ וּ֝בִישׁ֥וּעָתְךָ֗ מַה־[יָּ֥גֶל] (יגיל) מְאֹֽד׃
verses.translit: yhvh b'zkh yshmchmlkh vbyshv'tkh mh[ygl] (ygyl) m'd
verses.translation: O LORD, in Thy strength the king rejoiceth; and in Thy salvation how greatly doth he exult!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת לִ֭בּוֹ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ וַאֲרֶ֥שֶׁת שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו בַּל־מָנַ֥עְתָּ סֶּֽלָה׃
verses.translit: t'vt lbv ntth lv v'rsht shptyv blmn't slh
verses.translation: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and the request of his lips Thou hast not withholden. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תְ֭קַדְּמֶנּוּ בִּרְכ֣וֹת ט֑וֹב תָּשִׁ֥ית לְ֝רֹאשׁ֗וֹ עֲטֶ֣רֶת פָּֽז׃
verses.translit: khytqdmnv brkhvt tvb tshyt lr'shv 'trt pz
verses.translation: For Thou meetest him with choicest blessings; Thou settest a crown of fine gold on his head.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַיִּ֤ים  שָׁאַ֣ל מִ֭מְּךָ נָתַ֣תָּה לּ֑וֹ אֹ֥רֶךְ יָ֝מִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.translit: chyym  sh'l mmkh ntth lv 'rkh ymym 'vlm v'd
verses.translation: He asked life of Thee, Thou gavest it him; even length of days for ever and ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גָּד֣וֹל כְּ֭בוֹדוֹ בִּישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ ה֥וֹד וְ֝הָדָ֗ר תְּשַׁוֶּ֥ה עָלָֽיו׃
verses.translit: gdvl khbvdv byshv'tkh hvd vhdr tshvh 'lyv
verses.translation: His glory is great through Thy salvation; Honour and majesty dost Thou lay upon him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־תְשִׁיתֵ֣הוּ בְרָכ֣וֹת לָעַ֑ד תְּחַדֵּ֥הוּ בְ֝שִׂמְחָ֗ה אֶת־פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: khytshythv brkhvt l'd tchdhv bshmchh 'tpnykh
verses.translation: For Thou makest him most blessed for ever; Thou makest him glad with joy in Thy presence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־הַ֭מֶּלֶךְ בֹּטֵ֣חַ בַּיהֹוָ֑ה וּבְחֶ֥סֶד עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן בַּל־יִמּֽוֹט׃
verses.translit: khyhmlkh btch byhvh vbchsd 'lyvn blymvt
verses.translation: For the king trusteth in the LORD, yea, in the mercy of the Most High; he shall not be moved.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תִּמְצָ֣א יָ֭דְךָ לְכׇל־אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ יְ֝מִֽינְךָ֗ תִּמְצָ֥א שֹׂנְאֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: tmts' ydkh lkhl'ybykh ymynkh tmts' shn'ykh
verses.translation: Thy hand shall be equal to all thine enemies; Thy right hand shall overtake those that hate thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תְּשִׁיתֵ֤מוֹ  כְּתַנּ֥וּר אֵשׁ֮ לְעֵ֢ת פָּ֫נֶ֥יךָ יְ֭הֹוָה בְּאַפּ֣וֹ יְבַלְּעֵ֑ם וְֽתֹאכְלֵ֥ם אֵֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: tshytmv  khtnvr 'sh l't pnykh yhvh b'pv ybl'm vt'khlm 'sh
verses.translation: Thou shalt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thine anger; The LORD shall swallow them up in His wrath, and the fire shall devour them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פִּ֭רְיָמוֹ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תְּאַבֵּ֑ד וְ֝זַרְעָ֗ם מִבְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.translit: prymv m'rts t'bd vzr'm mbny 'dm
verses.translation: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־נָט֣וּ עָלֶ֣יךָ רָעָ֑ה חָֽשְׁב֥וּ מְ֝זִמָּ֗ה בַּל־יוּכָֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: khyntv 'lykh r'h chshbv mzmh blyvkhlv
verses.translation: For they intended evil against thee, They imagined a device, wherewith they shall not prevail.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֭י תְּשִׁיתֵ֣מוֹ שֶׁ֑כֶם בְּ֝מֵֽיתָרֶ֗יךָ תְּכוֹנֵ֥ן עַל־פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: khy tshytmv shkhm bmytrykh tkhvnn 'lpnyhm
verses.translation: For thou shalt make them turn their back, Thou shalt make ready with thy bowstrings against the face of them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ר֣וּמָה יְהֹוָ֣ה בְּעֻזֶּ֑ךָ נָשִׁ֥ירָה וּֽ֝נְזַמְּרָ֗ה גְּבוּרָתֶֽךָ׃ {פ}
verses.translit: rvmh yhvh b'zkh nshyrh vnzmrh gbvrtkh {p}
verses.translation: Be Thou exalted, O LORD, in Thy strength; so will we sing and praise Thy power.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ עַל־אַיֶּ֥לֶת הַשַּׁ֗חַר מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.translit: lmntsch 'l'ylt hshchr mzmvr ldvd
verses.translation: For the Leader; upon Aijeleth ha-Shahar. A Psalm of David.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵלִ֣י אֵ֭לִי לָמָ֣ה עֲזַבְתָּ֑נִי רָח֥וֹק מִֽ֝ישׁוּעָתִ֗י דִּבְרֵ֥י שַׁאֲגָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ly 'ly lmh 'zbtny rchvq myshv'ty dbry sh'gty
verses.translation: My God, my God, why hast Thou forsaken me, and art far from my help at the words of my cry?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י אֶקְרָ֣א י֭וֹמָם וְלֹ֣א תַעֲנֶ֑ה וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה וְֽלֹא־דֻֽמִיָּ֥ה לִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'lhy 'qr' yvmm vl' t'nh vlylh vl'dmyh ly
verses.translation: O my God, I call by day, but Thou answerest not; and at night, and there is no surcease for me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.translit: v'th qdvsh yvshb thlvt yshr'l
verses.translation: Yet Thou art holy, O Thou that art enthroned upon the praises of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּ֭ךָ בָּטְח֣וּ אֲבֹתֵ֑ינוּ בָּ֝טְח֗וּ וַֽתְּפַלְּטֵֽמוֹ׃
verses.translit: bkh btchv 'btynv btchv vtpltmv
verses.translation: In Thee did our fathers trust; they trusted, and Thou didst deliver them.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֵלֶ֣יךָ זָעֲק֣וּ וְנִמְלָ֑טוּ בְּךָ֖ בָטְח֣וּ וְלֹא־בֽוֹשׁוּ׃
verses.translit: 'lykh z'qv vnmltv bkh btchv vl'bvshv
verses.translation: Unto Thee they cried, and escaped; in Thee did they trust, and were not ashamed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאָנֹכִ֣י תוֹלַ֣עַת וְלֹא־אִ֑ישׁ חֶרְפַּ֥ת אָ֝דָ֗ם וּבְז֥וּי עָֽם׃
verses.translit: v'nkhy tvl't vl''ysh chrpt 'dm vbzvy 'm
verses.translation: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־רֹ֭אַי יַלְעִ֣גוּ לִ֑י יַפְטִ֥ירוּ בְ֝שָׂפָ֗ה יָנִ֥יעוּ רֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.translit: khlr'y yl'gv ly yptyrv bshph yny'v r'sh
verses.translation: All they that see me laugh me to scorn; they shoot out the lip, they shake the head:
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גֹּ֣ל אֶל־יְהֹוָ֣ה יְפַלְּטֵ֑הוּ יַ֝צִּילֵ֗הוּ כִּ֘י־חָ֥פֵֽץ־בּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: gl 'lyhvh yplthv ytsylhv khychptsbv
verses.translation: 'Let him commit himself unto the LORD! let Him rescue him; let Him deliver him, seeing He delighteth in him.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה גֹחִ֣י מִבָּ֑טֶן מַ֝בְטִיחִ֗י עַל־שְׁדֵ֥י אִמִּֽי׃
verses.translit: khy'th gchy mbtn mbtychy 'lshdy 'my
verses.translation: For Thou art He that took me out of the womb; Thou madest me trust when I was upon my mother's breasts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עָ֭לֶיךָ הׇשְׁלַ֣כְתִּי מֵרָ֑חֶם מִבֶּ֥טֶן אִ֝מִּ֗י אֵ֣לִי אָֽתָּה׃
verses.translit: 'lykh hshlkhty mrchm mbtn 'my 'ly 'th
verses.translation: Upon Thee I have been cast from my birth; Thou art my God from my mother's womb.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּרְחַ֣ק מִ֭מֶּנִּי כִּי־צָרָ֣ה קְרוֹבָ֑ה כִּי־אֵ֥ין עוֹזֵֽר׃
verses.translit: 'ltrchq mmny khytsrh qrvbh khy'yn 'vzr
verses.translation: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: סְ֭בָבוּנִי פָּרִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים אַבִּירֵ֖י בָשָׁ֣ן כִּתְּרֽוּנִי׃
verses.translit: sbbvny prym rbym 'byry bshn khtrvny
verses.translation: Many bulls have encompassed me; strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פָּצ֣וּ עָלַ֣י פִּיהֶ֑ם אַ֝רְיֵ֗ה טֹרֵ֥ף וְשֹׁאֵֽג׃
verses.translit: ptsv 'ly pyhm 'ryh trf vsh'g
verses.translation: They open wide their mouth against me, as a ravening and a roaring lion.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כַּמַּ֥יִם נִשְׁפַּכְתִּי֮ וְהִתְפָּֽרְד֗וּ כׇּֽל־עַצְמ֫וֹתָ֥י הָיָ֣ה לִ֭בִּי כַּדּוֹנָ֑ג נָ֝מֵ֗ס בְּת֣וֹךְ מֵעָֽי׃
verses.translit: khmym nshpkhty vhtprdv khl'tsmvty hyh lby khdvng nms btvkh m'y
verses.translation: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint; my heart is become like wax; it is melted in mine inmost parts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֘בֵ֤שׁ כַּחֶ֨רֶשׂ  כֹּחִ֗י וּ֭לְשׁוֹנִי מֻדְבָּ֣ק מַלְקוֹחָ֑י וְֽלַעֲפַר־מָ֥וֶת תִּשְׁפְּתֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: ybsh khchrsh  khchy vlshvny mdbq mlqvchy vl'prmvt tshptny
verses.translation: My strength is dried up like a potsherd; and my tongue cleaveth to my throat; and Thou layest me in the dust of death.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֥י סְבָב֗וּנִי כְּלָ֫בִ֥ים עֲדַ֣ת מְ֭רֵעִים הִקִּיפ֑וּנִי כָּ֝אֲרִ֗י יָדַ֥י וְרַגְלָֽי׃
verses.translit: khy sbbvny khlbym 'dt mr'ym hqypvny kh'ry ydy vrgly
verses.translation: For dogs have encompassed me; a company of evil-doers have inclosed me; like a lion, they are at my hands and my feet.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲסַפֵּ֥ר כׇּל־עַצְמוֹתָ֑י הֵ֥מָּה יַ֝בִּ֗יטוּ יִרְאוּ־בִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'spr khl'tsmvty hmh ybytv yr'vby
verses.translation: I may count all my bones; they look and gloat over me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְחַלְּק֣וּ בְגָדַ֣י לָהֶ֑ם וְעַל־לְ֝בוּשִׁ֗י יַפִּ֥ילוּ גוֹרָֽל׃
verses.translit: ychlqv bgdy lhm v'llbvshy ypylv gvrl
verses.translation: They part my garments among them, and for my vesture do they cast lots.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה יְ֭הֹוָה אַל־תִּרְחָ֑ק אֱ֝יָלוּתִ֗י לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה׃
verses.translit: v'th yhvh 'ltrchq 'ylvty l'zrty chvshh
verses.translation: But Thou, O LORD, be not far off; O Thou my strength, hasten to help me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַצִּ֣ילָה מֵחֶ֣רֶב נַפְשִׁ֑י מִיַּד־כֶּ֝֗לֶב יְחִידָתִֽי׃
verses.translit: htsylh mchrb npshy mydkhlb ychydty
verses.translation: Deliver my soul from the sword; mine only one from the power of the dog.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֭וֹשִׁיעֵנִי מִפִּ֣י אַרְיֵ֑ה וּמִקַּרְנֵ֖י רֵמִ֣ים עֲנִיתָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: hvshy'ny mpy 'ryh vmqrny rmym 'nytny
verses.translation: Save me from the lion's mouth; yea, from the horns of the wild-oxen do Thou answer me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲסַפְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְאֶחָ֑י בְּת֖וֹךְ קָהָ֣ל אֲהַלְלֶֽךָּ׃
verses.translit: 'sprh shmkh l'chy btvkh qhl 'hllkh
verses.translation: I will declare Thy name unto my brethren; in the midst of the congregation will I praise Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִרְאֵ֤י יְהֹוָ֨ה  הַֽלְל֗וּהוּ כׇּל־זֶ֣רַע יַעֲקֹ֣ב כַּבְּד֑וּהוּ וְג֥וּרוּ מִ֝מֶּ֗נּוּ כׇּל־זֶ֥רַע יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
