verses.translit: yr'y yhvh  hllvhv khlzr' y'qb khbdvhv vgvrv mmnv khlzr' yshr'l
verses.translation: 'Ye that fear the LORD, praise Him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify Him; and stand in awe of Him, all ye the seed of Israel.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹֽא־בָזָ֨ה וְלֹ֪א שִׁקַּ֡ץ עֱנ֬וּת עָנִ֗י וְלֹא־הִסְתִּ֣יר פָּנָ֣יו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וּֽבְשַׁוְּע֖וֹ אֵלָ֣יו שָׁמֵֽעַ׃
verses.translit: khy l'bzh vl' shqts 'nvt 'ny vl'hstyr pnyv mmnv vbshv'v 'lyv shm'
verses.translation: For He hath not despised nor abhorred the lowliness of the poor; neither hath He hid His face from him; but when he cried unto Him, He heard.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מֵ֥אִתְּךָ֗ תְּֽהִלָּ֫תִ֥י בְּקָהָ֥ל רָ֑ב נְדָרַ֥י אֲ֝שַׁלֵּ֗ם נֶ֣גֶד יְרֵאָֽיו׃
verses.translit: m'tkh thlty bqhl rb ndry 'shlm ngd yr'yv
verses.translation: From Thee cometh my praise in the great congregation; I will pay my vows before them that fear Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יֹאכְל֬וּ עֲנָוִ֨ים  וְיִשְׂבָּ֗עוּ יְהַֽלְל֣וּ יְ֭הֹוָה דֹּ֣רְשָׁ֑יו יְחִ֖י לְבַבְכֶ֣ם לָעַֽד׃
verses.translit: y'khlv 'nvym  vyshb'v yhllv yhvh drshyv ychy lbbkhm l'd
verses.translation: Let the humble eat and be satisfied; let them praise the LORD that seek after Him; may your heart be quickened for ever!
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִזְכְּר֤וּ  וְיָשֻׁ֣בוּ אֶל־יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לְ֝פָנֶ֗יךָ כׇּֽל־מִשְׁפְּח֥וֹת גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: yzkhrv  vyshbv 'lyhvh khl'psy'rts vyshtchvv lpnykh khlmshpchvt gvym
verses.translation: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn unto the LORD; and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֣י לַ֭יהֹוָה הַמְּלוּכָ֑ה וּ֝מֹשֵׁ֗ל בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.translit: khy lyhvh hmlvkhh vmshl bgvym
verses.translation: For the kingdom is the LORD’S; and He is the ruler over the nations.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אָכְל֬וּ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֨וּ  כׇּֽל־דִּשְׁנֵי־אֶ֗רֶץ לְפָנָ֣יו יִ֭כְרְעוּ כׇּל־יוֹרְדֵ֣י עָפָ֑ר וְ֝נַפְשׁ֗וֹ לֹ֣א חִיָּֽה׃
verses.translit: 'khlv vyshtchvv  khldshny'rts lpnyv ykhr'v khlyvrdy 'pr vnpshv l' chyh
verses.translation: All the fat ones of the earth shall eat and worship; all they that go down to the dust shall kneel before Him, even he that cannot keep his soul alive.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֥רַע יַֽעַבְדֶ֑נּוּ יְסֻפַּ֖ר לַֽאדֹנָ֣י לַדּֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: zr' y'bdnv yspr l'dny ldvr
verses.translation: A seed shall serve him; It shall be told of the Lord unto the next generation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יָ֭בֹאוּ וְיַגִּ֣ידוּ צִדְקָת֑וֹ לְעַ֥ם נ֝וֹלָ֗ד כִּ֣י עָשָֽׂה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: yb'v vygydv tsdqtv l'm nvld khy 'shh {p}
verses.translation: They shall come and shall declare His righteousness Unto a people that shall be born, that He hath done it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד יְהֹוָ֥ה רֹ֝עִ֗י לֹ֣א אֶחְסָֽר׃
verses.translit: mzmvr ldvd yhvh r'y l' 'chsr
verses.translation: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּנְא֣וֹת דֶּ֭שֶׁא יַרְבִּיצֵ֑נִי עַל־מֵ֖י מְנֻח֣וֹת יְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: bn'vt dsh' yrbytsny 'lmy mnchvt ynhlny
verses.translation: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures; He leadeth me beside the still waters.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַפְשִׁ֥י יְשׁוֹבֵ֑ב יַֽנְחֵ֥נִי בְמַעְגְּלֵי־צֶ֝֗דֶק לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: npshy yshvbb ynchny bm'glytsdq lm'n shmv
verses.translation: He restoreth my soul; He guideth me in straight paths for His name's sake.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֤ם כִּֽי־אֵלֵ֨ךְ בְּגֵ֪יא צַלְמָ֡וֶת לֹא־אִ֘ירָ֤א רָ֗ע כִּי־אַתָּ֥ה עִמָּדִ֑י שִׁבְטְךָ֥ וּ֝מִשְׁעַנְתֶּ֗ךָ הֵ֣מָּה יְנַֽחֲמֻֽנִי׃
verses.translit: gm khy'lkh bgy' tslmvt l''yr' r' khy'th 'mdy shbtkh vmsh'ntkh hmh ynchmny
verses.translation: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for Thou art with me; Thy rod and Thy staff, they comfort me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תַּעֲרֹ֬ךְ לְפָנַ֨י  שֻׁלְחָ֗ן נֶ֥גֶד צֹרְרָ֑י דִּשַּׁ֥נְתָּ בַשֶּׁ֥מֶן רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י כּוֹסִ֥י רְוָיָֽה׃
verses.translit: t'rkh lpny  shlchn ngd tsrry dshnt bshmn r'shy khvsy rvyh
verses.translation: Thou preparest a table before me in the presence of mine enemies; Thou hast anointed my head with oil; my cup runneth over.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ  ט֤וֹב וָחֶ֣סֶד יִ֭רְדְּפוּנִי כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑י וְשַׁבְתִּ֥י בְּבֵית־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃ {פ}
verses.translit: 'kh  tvb vchsd yrdpvny khlymy chyy vshbty bbytyhvh l'rkh ymym {p}
verses.translation: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life; And I shall dwell in the house of the LORD for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֗ד מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר לַֽ֭יהֹוָה הָאָ֣רֶץ וּמְלוֹאָ֑הּ תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל וְיֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃
verses.translit: ldvd mzmvr lyhvh h'rts vmlv'h tbl vyshby bh
verses.translation: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’S, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּי־ה֭וּא עַל־יַמִּ֣ים יְסָדָ֑הּ וְעַל־נְ֝הָר֗וֹת יְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃
verses.translit: khyhv' 'lymym ysdh v'lnhrvt ykhvnnh
verses.translation: For He hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִֽי־יַעֲלֶ֥ה בְהַר־יְהֹוָ֑ה וּמִי־יָ֝ק֗וּם בִּמְק֥וֹם קׇדְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.translit: myy'lh bhryhvh vmyyqvm bmqvm qdshv
verses.translation: Who shall ascend into the mountain of the LORD? And who shall stand in His holy place?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נְקִ֥י כַפַּ֗יִם וּֽבַר־לֵ֫בָ֥ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר  לֹא־נָשָׂ֣א לַשָּׁ֣וְא נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לְמִרְמָֽה׃
verses.translit: nqy khpym vbrlbb 'shr  l'nsh' lshv' npshy vl' nshb' lmrmh
verses.translation: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not taken My name in vain, and hath not sworn deceitfully.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יִשָּׂ֣א בְ֭רָכָה מֵאֵ֣ת יְהֹוָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה מֵאֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ysh' brkhh m't yhvh vtsdqh m'lhy ysh'v
verses.translation: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זֶ֭ה דּ֣וֹר דֹּרְשָׁ֑ו מְבַקְשֵׁ֨י פָנֶ֖יךָ יַעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.translit: zh dvr drshv mbqshy pnykh y'qb slh
verses.translation: Such is the generation of them that seek after Him, that seek Thy face, even Jacob. Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים  רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וְֽ֭הִנָּשְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָב֗וֹא מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: sh'v sh'rym  r'shykhm vhnsh'v ptchy 'vlm vybv' mlkh hkhbvd
verses.translation: Lift up your heads, O ye gates, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors; that the King of glory may come in.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֥י זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְ֭הֹוָה עִזּ֣וּז וְגִבּ֑וֹר יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה גִּבּ֥וֹר מִלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.translit: my zh mlkh hkhbvd yhvh 'zvz vgbvr yhvh gbvr mlchmh
verses.translation: 'Who is the King of glory?' 'The LORD strong and mighty, The LORD mighty in battle.'
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׂא֤וּ שְׁעָרִ֨ים  רָֽאשֵׁיכֶ֗ם וּ֭שְׂאוּ פִּתְחֵ֣י עוֹלָ֑ם וְ֝יָבֹ֗א מֶ֣לֶךְ הַכָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.translit: sh'v sh'rym  r'shykhm vsh'v ptchy 'vlm vyb' mlkh hkhbvd
verses.translation: Lift up your heads, O ye gates, Yea, lift them up, ye everlasting doors; That the King of glory may come in.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִ֤י־ה֣וּא זֶה֮ מֶ֤לֶךְ הַכָּ֫ב֥וֹד יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת ה֤וּא מֶ֖לֶךְ הַכָּב֣וֹד סֶֽלָה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: myhv' zh mlkh hkhbvd yhvh tsb'vt hv' mlkh hkhbvd slh {p}
verses.translation: 'Who then is the King of glory?' 'The LORD of hosts; He is the King of glory.' Selah
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃
verses.translit: ldvd 'lykh yhvh npshy 'sh'
verses.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Unto Thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י בְּךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל־אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל־יַעַלְצ֖וּ אוֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'lhy bkh btchty 'l'bvshh 'ly'ltsv 'vyby ly
verses.translation: O my God, in Thee have I trusted, let me not be ashamed; Let not mine enemies triumph over me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: גַּ֣ם כׇּל־קֹ֭וֶיךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם׃
verses.translit: gm khlqvykh l' ybshv ybshv hbvgdym ryqm
verses.translation: Yea, none that wait for Thee shall be ashamed; They shall be ashamed that deal treacherously without cause.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הֹוָה הוֹדִיעֵ֑נִי אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: drkhykh yhvh hvdy'ny 'rchvtykh lmdny
verses.translation: Show me Thy ways, O LORD; teach me Thy paths.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ  וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי־אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אוֹתְךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כׇּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.translit: hdrykhny b'mtkh  vlmdny khy'th 'lhy ysh'y 'vtkh qvyty khlhyvm
verses.translation: Guide me in Thy truth, and teach me; For Thou art the God of my salvation; For Thee do I wait all the day.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: זְכֹר־רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הֹוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.translit: zkhrrchmykh yhvh vchsdykh khy m'vlm hmh
verses.translation: Remember, O LORD, Thy compassions and Thy mercies; For they have been from of old.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י  וּפְשָׁעַ֗י אַל־תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ זְכׇר־לִי־אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: cht'vt n'vry  vpsh'y 'ltzkhr khchsdkh zkhrly'th lm'n tvbkh yhvh
verses.translation: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions; According to Thy mercy remember Thou me, For Thy goodness' sake, O LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: טוֹב־וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְהֹוָ֑ה עַל־כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.translit: tvbvyshr yhvh 'lkhn yvrh cht'ym bdrkh
verses.translation: Good and upright is the LORD; Therefore doth He instruct sinners in the way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: ydrkh 'nvym bmshpt vylmd 'nvym drkhv
verses.translation: He guideth The humble in justice; And He teacheth the humble His way.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כׇּל־אׇרְח֣וֹת יְ֭הֹוָה חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗וֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו׃
verses.translit: khl'rchvt yhvh chsd v'mt lntsry brytv v'dtyv
verses.translation: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth Unto such as keep His covenant and His testimonies.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְמַֽעַן־שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב־הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: lm'nshmkh yhvh vslcht l'vny khy rbhv'
verses.translation: For Thy name's sake, O LORD, Pardon mine iniquity, for it is great.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: מִי־זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהֹוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃
verses.translit: myzh h'ysh yr' yhvh yvrnv bdrkh ybchr
verses.translation: What man is he that feareth the LORD? Him will He instruct in the way that He should choose.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּט֣וֹב תָּלִ֑ין וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.translit: npshv btvb tlyn vzr'v yyrsh 'rts
verses.translation: His soul shall abide in prosperity; And his seed shall inherit the land.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ס֣וֹד יְ֭הֹוָה לִירֵאָ֑יו וּ֝בְרִית֗וֹ לְהוֹדִיעָֽם׃
verses.translit: svd yhvh lyr'yv vbrytv lhvdy'm
verses.translation: The counsel of the LORD is with them that fear Him; And His covenant, to make them know it.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: עֵינַ֣י תָּ֭מִיד אֶל־יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֽוּא־יוֹצִ֖יא מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת רַגְלָֽי׃
verses.translit: 'yny tmyd 'lyhvh khy hv'yvtsy' mrsht rgly
verses.translation: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; For He will bring forth my feet out of the net.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּנֵֽה־אֵלַ֥י וְחׇנֵּ֑נִי כִּֽי־יָחִ֖יד וְעָנִ֣י אָֽנִי׃
verses.translit: pnh'ly vchnny khyychyd v'ny 'ny
verses.translation: Turn Thee unto me, and be gracious unto me; For I am solitary and afflicted.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: צָר֣וֹת לְבָבִ֣י הִרְחִ֑יבוּ מִ֝מְּצוּקוֹתַ֗י הוֹצִיאֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: tsrvt lbby hrchybv mmtsvqvty hvtsy'ny
verses.translation: The troubles of my heart are enlarged; O bring Thou me out of my distresses.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵ֣ה עׇ֭נְיִי וַעֲמָלִ֑י וְ֝שָׂ֗א לְכׇל־חַטֹּאותָֽי׃
verses.translit: r'h 'nyy v'mly vsh' lkhlcht'vty
verses.translation: See mine affliction and my travail; And forgive all my sins.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רְאֵֽה־אֹיְבַ֥י כִּי־רָ֑בּוּ וְשִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי׃
verses.translit: r'h'yby khyrbv vshn't chms shn'vny
verses.translation: Consider how many are mine enemies, And the cruel hatred wherewith they hate me. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שׇׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי אַל־אֵ֝ב֗וֹשׁ כִּֽי־חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃
verses.translit: shmrh npshy vhtsylny 'l'bvsh khychsyty bkh
verses.translation: O keep my soul, and deliver me; Let me not be ashamed, for I have taken refuge in Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֹּם־וָיֹ֥שֶׁר יִצְּר֑וּנִי כִּ֝֗י קִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: tmvyshr ytsrvny khy qvytykh
verses.translation: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, Because I wait for Thee.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: פְּדֵ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל צָרוֹתָֽיו׃ {פ}
verses.translit: pdh 'lhym 'tyshr'l mkhl tsrvtyv {p}
verses.translation: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד  שׇׁפְטֵ֤נִי יְהֹוָ֗ה כִּֽי־אֲ֭נִי בְּתֻמִּ֣י הָלַ֑כְתִּי וּבַיהֹוָ֥ה בָּ֝טַ֗חְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶמְעָֽד׃
verses.translit: ldvd  shptny yhvh khy'ny btmy hlkhty vbyhvh btchty l' 'm'd
verses.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Judge me, O LORD, for I have walked in mine integrity, and I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בְּחָנֵ֣נִי יְהֹוָ֣ה וְנַסֵּ֑נִי (צרופה) [צׇרְפָ֖ה] כִלְיוֹתַ֣י וְלִבִּֽי׃
verses.translit: bchnny yhvh vnsny (tsrvph) [tsrph] khlyvty vlby
verses.translation: Examine me, O LORD, and try me; test my reins and my heart.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־חַ֭סְדְּךָ לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינָ֑י וְ֝הִתְהַלַּ֗כְתִּי בַּאֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.translit: khychsdkh lngd 'yny vhthlkhty b'mtkh
verses.translation: For Thy mercy is before mine eyes; and I have walked in Thy truth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לֹֽא־יָ֭שַׁבְתִּי עִם־מְתֵי־שָׁ֑וְא וְעִ֥ם נַ֝עֲלָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א אָבֽוֹא׃
verses.translit: l'yshbty 'mmtyshv' v'm n'lmym l' 'bv'
verses.translation: I have not sat with men of falsehood; neither will I go in with dissemblers.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שָׂ֭נֵאתִי קְהַ֣ל מְרֵעִ֑ים וְעִם־רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א אֵשֵֽׁב׃
verses.translit: shn'ty qhl mr'ym v'mrsh'ym l' 'shb
verses.translation: I hate the gathering of evil doers, and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֶרְחַ֣ץ בְּנִקָּי֣וֹן כַּפָּ֑י וַאֲסֹבְבָ֖ה אֶת־מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ יְהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: 'rchts bnqyvn khpy v'sbbh 'tmzbchkh yhvh
verses.translation: I will wash my hands in innocency; so will I compass Thine altar, O LORD,
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לַ֭שְׁמִעַ בְּק֣וֹל תּוֹדָ֑ה וּ֝לְסַפֵּ֗ר כׇּל־נִפְלְאוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.translit: lshm' bqvl tvdh vlspr khlnpl'vtykh
verses.translation: That I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, and tell of all Thy wondrous works.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְֽהֹוָ֗ה אָ֭הַבְתִּי מְע֣וֹן בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מְק֗וֹם מִשְׁכַּ֥ן כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'hbty m'vn bytkh vmqvm mshkhn khbvdkh
verses.translation: LORD, I love the habitation of Thy house, and the place where Thy glory dwelleth.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תֶּאֱסֹ֣ף עִם־חַטָּאִ֣ים נַפְשִׁ֑י וְעִם־אַנְשֵׁ֖י דָמִ֣ים חַיָּֽי׃
verses.translit: 'lt'sf 'mcht'ym npshy v'm'nshy dmym chyy
verses.translation: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with men of blood;
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר־בִּידֵיהֶ֥ם זִמָּ֑ה וִ֝ימִינָ֗ם מָ֣לְאָה שֹּֽׁחַד׃
verses.translit: 'shrbydyhm zmh vymynm ml'h shchd
verses.translation: In whose hands is craftiness, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וַ֭אֲנִי בְּתֻמִּ֥י אֵלֵ֗ךְ פְּדֵ֣נִי וְחׇנֵּֽנִי׃
verses.translit: v'ny btmy 'lkh pdny vchnny
verses.translation: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity; Redeem me, and be gracious unto me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: רַ֭גְלִי עָמְדָ֣ה בְמִישׁ֑וֹר בְּ֝מַקְהֵלִ֗ים אֲבָרֵ֥ךְ יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: rgly 'mdh bmyshvr bmqhlym 'brkh yhvh {p}
verses.translation: My foot standeth in an even place; in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֨ד  יְהֹוָ֤ה  אוֹרִ֣י וְ֭יִשְׁעִי מִמִּ֣י אִירָ֑א יְהֹוָ֥ה מָעוֹז־חַ֝יַּ֗י מִמִּ֥י אֶפְחָֽד׃
verses.translit: ldvd  yhvh  'vry vysh'y mmy 'yr' yhvh m'vzchyy mmy 'pchd
verses.translation: [A Psalm] of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בִּקְרֹ֤ב עָלַ֨י  מְרֵעִים֮ לֶאֱכֹ֢ל אֶת־בְּשָׂ֫רִ֥י צָרַ֣י וְאֹיְבַ֣י לִ֑י הֵ֖מָּה כָשְׁל֣וּ וְנָפָֽלוּ׃
verses.translit: bqrb 'ly  mr'ym l'khl 'tbshry tsry v'yby ly hmh khshlv vnplv
verses.translation: When evil-doers came upon me to eat up my flesh, Even mine adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אִם־תַּחֲנֶ֬ה עָלַ֨י  מַחֲנֶה֮ לֹא־יִירָ֢א לִ֫בִּ֥י אִם־תָּק֣וּם עָ֭לַי מִלְחָמָ֑ה בְּ֝זֹ֗את אֲנִ֣י בוֹטֵֽחַ׃
verses.translit: 'mtchnh 'ly  mchnh l'yyr' lby 'mtqvm 'ly mlchmh bz't 'ny bvtch
verses.translation: Though a host should encamp against me, My heart shall not fear; Though war should rise up against me, Even then will I be confident.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַחַ֤ת  שָׁאַ֣לְתִּי מֵאֵת־יְהֹוָה֮ אוֹתָ֢הּ אֲבַ֫קֵּ֥שׁ שִׁבְתִּ֣י בְּבֵית־יְ֭הֹוָה כׇּל־יְמֵ֣י חַיַּ֑י לַחֲז֥וֹת בְּנֹעַם־יְ֝הֹוָ֗ה וּלְבַקֵּ֥ר בְּהֵֽיכָלֽוֹ׃
verses.translit: 'cht  sh'lty m'tyhvh 'vth 'bqsh shbty bbytyhvh khlymy chyy lchzvt bn'myhvh vlbqr bhykhlv
verses.translation: One thing have I asked of the LORD, that will I seek after: That I may dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, To behold the graciousness of the LORD, and to visit early in His temple.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י יִצְפְּנֵ֨נִי  בְּסֻכֹּה֮ בְּי֢וֹם רָ֫עָ֥ה יַ֭סְתִּרֵנִי בְּסֵ֣תֶר אׇהֳל֑וֹ בְּ֝צ֗וּר יְרוֹמְמֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: khy ytspnny  bskhh byvm r'h ystrny bstr 'hlv btsvr yrvmmny
verses.translation: For He concealeth me in His pavilion in the day of evil; He hideth me in the covert of His tent; He lifteth me up upon a rock. .
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֨ה יָר֪וּם רֹאשִׁ֡י עַ֤ל אֹיְבַ֬י סְֽבִיבוֹתַ֗י וְאֶזְבְּחָ֣ה בְ֭אׇהֳלוֹ זִבְחֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה אָשִׁ֥ירָה וַ֝אֲזַמְּרָ֗ה לַֽיהֹוָֽה׃
verses.translit: v'th yrvm r'shy 'l 'yby sbybvty v'zbchh b'hlv zbchy trv'h 'shyrh v'zmrh lyhvh
verses.translation: And now shall my head be lifted up above mine enemies round about me; And I will offer in His tabernacle sacrifices with trumpet-sound; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises unto the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַע־יְהֹוָ֖ה קוֹלִ֥י אֶקְרָ֗א וְחׇנֵּ֥נִי וַעֲנֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: shm'yhvh qvly 'qr' vchnny v'nny
verses.translation: Hear, O LORD, when I call with my voice, And be gracious unto me, and answer me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְךָ֤  אָמַ֣ר לִ֭בִּי בַּקְּשׁ֣וּ פָנָ֑י אֶת־פָּנֶ֖יךָ יְהֹוָ֣ה אֲבַקֵּֽשׁ׃
verses.translit: lkh  'mr lby bqshv pny 'tpnykh yhvh 'bqsh
verses.translation: In Thy behalf my heart hath said: ‘Seek ye My face'; Thy face, LORD, will I seek.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תַּסְתֵּ֬ר פָּנֶ֨יךָ  מִמֶּנִּי֮ אַ֥ל תַּט־בְּאַ֗ף עַ֫בְדֶּ֥ךָ עֶזְרָתִ֥י הָיִ֑יתָ אַֽל־תִּטְּשֵׁ֥נִי וְאַל־תַּ֝עַזְבֵ֗נִי אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׁעִֽי׃
verses.translit: 'ltstr pnykh  mmny 'l ttb'f 'bdkh 'zrty hyyt 'lttshny v'lt'zbny 'lhy ysh'y
verses.translation: Hide not Thy face far from me; Put not Thy servant away in anger; Thou hast been my help; Cast me not off, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּֽי־אָבִ֣י וְאִמִּ֣י עֲזָב֑וּנִי וַֽיהֹוָ֣ה יַאַסְפֵֽנִי׃
verses.translit: khy'by v'my 'zbvny vyhvh y'spny
verses.translation: For though my father and my mother have forsaken me, The LORD will take me up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: ה֤וֹרֵ֥נִי יְהֹוָ֗ה דַּ֫רְכֶּ֥ךָ וּ֭נְחֵנִי בְּאֹ֣רַח מִישׁ֑וֹר לְ֝מַ֗עַן שֽׁוֹרְרָֽי׃
verses.translit: hvrny yhvh drkhkh vnchny b'rch myshvr lm'n shvrry
verses.translation: Teach me Thy way, O LORD; And lead me in an even path, Because of them that lie in wait for me.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַֽל־תִּ֭תְּנֵנִי בְּנֶ֣פֶשׁ צָרָ֑י כִּ֥י קָמוּ־בִ֥י עֵדֵי־שֶׁ֝֗קֶר וִיפֵ֥חַ חָמָֽס׃
verses.translit: 'lttnny bnpsh tsry khy qmvby 'dyshqr vypch chms
verses.translation: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine adversaries; For false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out violence.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לׅׄוּׅׄלֵׅ֗ׄאׅׄ הֶ֭אֱמַנְתִּי לִרְא֥וֹת בְּֽטוּב־יְהֹוָ֗ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃
verses.translit: lvl' h'mnty lr'vt btvbyhvh b'rts chyym
verses.translation: If I had not believed to look upon the goodness of the LORD In the land of the living!—
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל־יְ֫הֹוָ֥ה חֲ֭זַק וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝קַוֵּ֗ה אֶל־יְהֹוָֽה׃ {פ}
verses.translit: qvh 'lyhvh chzq vy'mts lbkh vqvh 'lyhvh {p}
verses.translation: Wait on the LORD; Be strong, and let thy heart take courage; Yea, wait thou for the LORD.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵ֘לֶ֤יךָ יְהֹוָ֨ה  אֶקְרָ֗א צוּרִי֮ אַֽל־תֶּחֱרַ֢שׁ מִ֫מֶּ֥נִּי פֶּן־תֶּחֱשֶׁ֥ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי וְ֝נִמְשַׁ֗לְתִּי עִם־י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.translit: ldvd 'lykh yhvh  'qr' tsvry 'ltchrsh mmny pntchshh mmny vnmshlty 'myvrdy bvr
verses.translation: [A Psalm] of David. Unto thee, O LORD, do I call; My Rock, be not Thou deaf unto me; Lest, if Thou be silent unto me, I become like them that go down into the pit.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: שְׁמַ֤ע ק֣וֹל תַּ֭חֲנוּנַי בְּשַׁוְּעִ֣י אֵלֶ֑יךָ בְּנׇשְׂאִ֥י יָ֝דַ֗י אֶל־דְּבִ֥יר קׇדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.translit: shm' qvl tchnvny bshv'y 'lykh bnsh'y ydy 'ldbyr qdshkh
verses.translation: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto Thee, When I lift up my hands toward Thy holy Sanctuary.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: אַל־תִּמְשְׁכֵ֣נִי עִם־רְשָׁעִים֮ וְעִם־פֹּ֢עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן דֹּבְרֵ֣י שָׁ֭לוֹם עִם־רֵעֵיהֶ֑ם וְ֝רָעָ֗ה בִּלְבָבָֽם׃
verses.translit: 'ltmshkhny 'mrsh'ym v'mp'ly 'vn dbry shlvm 'mr'yhm vr'h blbbm
verses.translation: Draw me not away with the wicked, And with the workers of iniquity; Who speak peace with their neighbours, But evil is in their hearts.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: תֶּן־לָהֶ֣ם כְּפׇעֳלָם֮ וּכְרֹ֢עַ מַעַלְלֵ֫יהֶ֥ם כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְ֭דֵיהֶם תֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֑ם הָשֵׁ֖ב גְּמוּלָ֣ם לָהֶֽם׃
verses.translit: tnlhm khp'lm vkhr' m'llyhm khm'shh ydyhm tn lhm hshb gmvlm lhm
verses.translation: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the evil of their endeavours; Give them after the work of their hands; Render to them their desert.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹ֪א יָבִ֡ינוּ אֶל־פְּעֻלֹּ֣ת יְ֭הֹוָה וְאֶל־מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדָ֑יו יֶ֝הֶרְסֵ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִבְנֵֽם׃
verses.translit: khy l' ybynv 'lp'lt yhvh v'lm'shh ydyv yhrsm vl' ybnm
verses.translation: Because they give no heed to the works of the LORD, Nor to the operation of His hands; He will break them down and not build them up.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהֹוָ֑ה כִּי־שָׁ֝מַ֗ע ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
verses.translit: brvkh yhvh khyshm' qvl tchnvny
verses.translation: Blessed be the LORD, Because He hath heard the voice of my supplications.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֤ה  עֻזִּ֥י וּמָגִנִּי֮ בּ֤וֹ בָטַ֥ח לִבִּ֗י וְֽנֶ֫עֱזָ֥רְתִּי וַיַּעֲלֹ֥ז לִבִּ֑י וּֽמִשִּׁירִ֥י אֲהוֹדֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.translit: yhvh  'zy vmgny bv btch lby vn'zrty vy'lz lby vmshyry 'hvdnv
verses.translation: The LORD is my strength and my shield, In Him hath my heart trusted, And I am helped; Therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth, And with my song will I praise Him.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֥ה עֹֽז־לָ֑מוֹ וּמָ֘ע֤וֹז יְשׁוּע֖וֹת מְשִׁיח֣וֹ הֽוּא׃
verses.translit: yhvh 'zlmv vm'vz yshv'vt mshychv hv'
verses.translation: The LORD is a strength unto them; And He is a stronghold of salvation to His anointed.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)

verses.original: הוֹשִׁ֤יעָה  אֶת־עַמֶּ֗ךָ וּבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת־נַחֲלָתֶ֑ךָ וּֽרְעֵ֥ם וְ֝נַשְּׂאֵ֗ם עַד־הָעוֹלָֽם׃ {פ}
verses.translit: hvshy'h  't'mkh vbrkh 'tnchltkh vr'm vnsh'm 'dh'vlm {p}
verses.translation: Save Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance; And tend them, and carry them for ever.
verses.translationName: The Holy Scriptures: A New Translation (JPS 1917)
